Uthe udadewabo, indodakazi ka-Phinehasi, wayekhulelwe, begodu wafika isikhathi sokubeletha. Ke kaloku, lapho ekhuluma ngezindaba zokuthi ibhokisi likaThixo lithathwe, nokuthi udadewabo nomfazi wakhe bafa, waqala ukukhulelwa, wazalwa ngobuhlungu obuningi.
Wathi, "Ungakhathazeki; uzali indodana." Kodwana yena akhenge aphendule noma ukucabangela ngaso soke isikhathi. Nokho, lapho wavuka, wafumana ingane yakhe.
Wabiza igama lakhe ngegama lika-Ikhabhodi, esithi, Ubuhle busuka eSirayeli. Yathi lokhu ngenxa yokuthi isibuko sikaThixo sathathwa, begodu ngombana ubaba wakhe nomfazi bakhe babefile.
Wathi, Ubuhle buphuma eSirayeli; ngombana isikhokelo sikaThixo sithathelwe.
Kwathi amaFilisti athathe ibhokisi likaThixo, lasuka e-Ebenezere lafika eAshdodi.
Bafaka ibhokisi likaThixo ethempelini likaDagon, umbingeleli wabo, babeka eduze kwesithombe sikaDagon.
Bavuka abantu base-Ashdodi ngobusuku obulandelayo, babone uDagon ekhoneni lakhe elibukhali ezweni, phambi kwebhokisi likaYehova; baphakamisa uDagon, bambeka endaweni yakhe.

Bavuka ngobusuku obulandelayo, babona uDagon ehlanzekile ebusweni bakhe emhlabeni phambi kwebhokisi likaYehova; intamo yakhe nezandla zakhe ziboshwe, zibekwe emgwaqeni wesango, begodu ikhanda lakhe kuphela elisele.
Ngenxa lalokho ababhishobhi bakaDagon, nanoma ubani ophuma ethempelini likaDagon eAshdodi, bangase bagweme ukufinyelela emgwaqweni, kuze kube namuhla.
Isandla sikaYehova sasinda phezu kwabahlali base-Ashdodi nezindawo ezingaphansi kwayo, waza wabangela ubuhlungu kubo, wababulala ngezinhlayiya ezinkulu.
Bathe abantu baseAshdodi bebona lokhu, bathi, Isikhombi soNkulunkulu wakwaSirayeli asihlale sihlala lapha nathi; ngombana isandla sakhe sinzima kithi nakweDagon, uzimu wethu.

Bahlangana khona bonke abaphathi bamaFilisti, bathi kubo, Sikwenzeni kuphi ibhokisi leNkosi uzimu kaSirayeli? Baphendula bathi, Nciphisa ibhokisi leNkosi uzimu kaSirayeli lifike eGathi. Bafaka khona khona ibhokisi leNkosi uzimu kaSirayeli,
Kodwana lapho beyihambisa khona, isandla sikaYehova safika kulo mzi, sawuphazamisa khulu; wabulala abantu balo mzi, abancane nababadala, ngamahlombe aphukile.
Bathumela khona ibhokisi likaThixo e-Ekron. Kwathi lapho lifika e-Ekron, abantu base-Ekron baphoqa, bathi, Lithunyelwe nathi ibhokisi loMdali wakwaSirayeli, ukuze lisindise mina nemindeni yethu.

Bahlanganisa bonke abaphathi bamaFilisti, bathi, Yisuseni ibhokisi likaThixo kaSirayeli, liphinde libuye endaweni yayo, ukuze lingasindisi mina nomndeni wami. Umlilo wokufa ugcwele lo mzi, ngombana isandla sikaNkulunkulu sinzima khulu kiwo.
Nabo abazange bafe, bahlaselwa yizilonda; begodu inkulumo yedolobha yafika esibhakabhakeni.
Ibhokisi likaYehova lahlala ezweni lamaFilisti iminyaka eyisikhombisa.
Bathi amaFilisti, babiza ababhishobhi babo nabangani babo, besithi: Sikwenzeni kuphi isibambo sikaYehova? Sitsheleni bona siyibuyisele kanjani endaweni yayo.

Bathi kubo, Uma niyithumela ibhokisi likaThixo kaSirayeli, ningayithumeli ingasebenzi; kodwana zinikele kuye umnikelo wesono; khona-ke nizophiliswa, begodu nizokwazi bona kungani isandla sakhe singeke sishintshe kusuka kuwe.

Bathi abaFilisti, Sizothumela yini isondlo sokuhlukunyezwa kuye? Baphendula bathi, Izingqungquthela zegolide eziyisishiyagalombili, nezinhlanzi zegolide eziyisishiyagalombili, ngaye ngamnye wabaphathi bamaFilisti abane; ngombana ubuhlungu obufanayo bukhona phakathi kwenu na PNu.
yenzani izifanekiso zezinhlayiya, nezibonakaliso zezinhlanzi ezibulala izwe, ninikeze ukuthula kuThixo kaSirayeli; kungase kube khona bona asuse isandla sakhe phezu kwenu, nasemhlabeni wenu.
Kungani na bona nigweme inhlonipho yenu, njengokuthi iMisra neFaro, lapho uzimu ewenza khona izinto ezinzima kubo, bengazivumela kanjani izingane zakwaSirayeli ukuba zihambe indlela sabo?
Ngalokho-ke, thola imoto entsha elungiselelwe, ngezinkomo ezimbili ezibe nezingane begodu ezingazange zihlolwe. Hlela izinkomo kwimoto, kodwana khipha izingane zabo bese uzibeka phasi.
Nciphisa ibhokisi leNkosi, ulibeke phezu kwemoto; ubeke eduze kwayo ibhokisi elinezinto zegolide ozithumelelayo njengomnikelo wesono; uyithumelele indlela yayo.

bhekani; uma ihamba phambili ezweni layo, eBethe-shemesi, khona-ke ikosi uletha phezu kwethu lo monakalo omkhulu; kodwana uma ingabi njalo, sizokwazi bona ayikho isandla sakhe esithule nathi. Kube yingozi kuphela.
Bakwenza njalo, bathatha izinkomo ezimbili ezinamadodakazi, bazibophezela ebhasini, baveza amadodakazi abo.
Babeka ibhokisi likaYehova phezu kwemoto, kanye nebhodlela eliqukethe izinyamazane zegolide, namamodeli wezinhlayiya.

Wathi uNdikhoyo kuSawule: "Uya eBhethe-shemeshi," begodu izingulube zahamba ngokuqondile, zisuka eBet-shemeshi. Zihlala emgwaqweni, ziphuza igazi ngaso soke isikhathi; azishintshi ngakwesokudla noma ngasekhohlo.
Amadoda aseBhethe-shemeshi, lapho eqotha khona imbewu sabo emfuleni, waphakamisa amehlo akhe, wabona ibhokisi, waba mnandi.
Imoto yafika ezindaweni zikaYoshuwa waseBethe-shemesi, yahlala khona eduze kwengcindezi enkulu; abantu bamisa imithi yemoto, banikela izinkomo zibe ngumnikelo wokushiswa kuYehova.

Bakhuphula khona ibhokisi likaYehova, naleyo bhokisi elinezinto zegolide, bazibeka phezu kwengcindezi enkulu; begodu abantu baseBhethe-shemeshi banikela ngomnikelo wokushiswa ngalolusuku lwawo, banikela ngenhlanhla kukaNkulunkulu.
Babona lokhu bonke abaphathi bamaFilisti abahlanu, babuyela e-Ekroni ngalolusuku.
Lezi ziyizilonda zegolide, abaFilisti bazisa umnikelo wesono kuYehova; ngazo zonke izifundazwe: ngoAshdodi, noGaza, noAshkeloni, noGathi, noEkroni.

begodu inani lezi zimvu zegolide, ngokuya ngenani lamadolobha amaFilisti, okungukuthi, idolobhana elihlanganisiwe, kanye nezindawo zasemaphandleni. Umlilo omkhulu, lapho babeka khona ibhokisi likaYehova, ukhona kuze kube manje, ezindaweni zikaYoshuwa waseBhethe-shemesi.

Wabulala abantu baseBhethe-shemeshi, ngenxa yokuthi babheka ebhokisini likaYehova; wababulala abantu abangumakhulu amahlanu anamashumi asixhenxe. Lawo madoda ahlupheka khulu ngenxa yokubulala okukhulu okwenzeke kubo ikosi.
Bathi abantu baseBhethe-shemeshi, Nguwubani ongakwazi ukuhlala phambi kukaNkulunkulu, lowo uzimu ongcwele? Ingabe ibhokisi lizohamba kuphi?
Bathumela abathunywa kubo bonke abahlala eKiriyati-yearimi, bathi, AbaFilisti babuyisele isihlalo sobukhosi sikaYehova; zinikele, niyithatheni ifike edolobhaneni lenu.
Bafika ke abantu baseKiriyati-yearimi, baphakamisa ibhokisi likaYehova, babe lifike endlwini ka-Abinadabu, emfuleni; begodu bamisa uElazare, unyana wakhe, ukuba agcine ibhokisi likaYehova.
Ibhokisi lahlala eKiriyati-yearimi isikhathi eside, iminyaka eyishumi nambili; begodu bonke abantu bakaSirayeli babuyela kuYehova.

Wathi uSamuweli kubo bonke abantu bakaSirayeli, ethi, Uma nizobuyela kuYehova ngenhliziyo yenu yonke, khiphani izitha zakwamanye amazwe eziphakathi kwenu, nama-Ashtorethi, nizinikela ngokupheleleko kuYehova, niwusebenzele yena kuphela; naye uzokusindisa ebusweni bamaFilisti.
Bathi ke amadodana aseSirayeli asuse amaBaali abo, nama-Ashtorethi abo, bakhonza ikosi kuphela.
Wathi uSamuweli, Zihlanganisani bonke isiSirayeli eMizpa, ngizothandaza kuYehova ngenxa yenu.
Bahlangana eMizpa, baqoqa amanzi, balivalela phambi koYehova; baphuza amanzi ngalolusuku, bathi, Sithole isono kukaNkulunkulu. USamuweli walungisa amaSirayeli eMizpa, waba ngummeli.
Bathe abaFilisti beva bona isizwe samaSirayeli sihlangane eMizpa, bakhuphuka abaholi babo ukubhekana nabo. Amadodakazi kaSirayeli ayewaqonda la mazwi, waphoqa ukuba aboshwe yimikhosi yamaFilisti.
Bathi kubo uSamuweli, "Akekho ongeke agweme ukudumisa kuYehova uzimu wethu ngenxa yethu, ukuze asisindise ebusweni bamaFilisti."
Wathi uSamuweli, athathe inkomo encane, wanikela ngayo yonke, ibe ngumnikelo wokushiswa kuYehova; wathandaza kuYehova ngenxa yamaSirayeli, ikosi wamphendula.

Kwathi lapho uSamuweli enikela khona ngenhlanhla yokudlwengula, amaFilisti afika ukuhlasela amaSirayeli; kodwana ikosi wehlisa umsindo omkhulu phezu kwamaFilisti ngalolu busuku, wabaphazamisa khulu, babulawa phambi kwaSirayeli.
Baphuma amadoda aseSirayeli eMizpa, walandela amaFilisti, wababulala kuze kube yilapho ngezansi kweBet-kar.
Wathi uSamuweli, ethatha itshe elilodwa, waligqugquzela phakathi kweMizpa neShen; wathi igama lakhe ngu-Ebenezere, esithi, UYehova usisiza kuze kube manje.
Ngaleyo le abaFilisti bahlaselwa, bangafikanga ezweni lakwaSirayeli; begodu isandla sikaYehova sakuba phezu kwabaFilisti zonke amalanga wokuphila kukaSamuweli.

Kwaba khona ukuthula phakathi kukaSirayeli namadodana ka-Amoni; begodu amadolobha, abaFilisti ababewathathe kuSirayeli, abuyiselwe kwaSirayeli, kusukela e-Ekronni kuya eGathi; begodu isizwe sakwaSirayeli sabuyiselwa kumaFilisti.
Waqhubeka uSamuweli ephatha isizwe samaSirayeli zonke amalanga wokuphila kwakhe.
Wahamba ngonyaka wonke, esuka eBhetheleli waya eGalgali, waya eMizpa, walungisa amaSirayeli kiwo onke lamadolobha.
Wabuyela eRama, lapho kwakuyikhaya lakhe, waphuma khona nakwaSirayeli, wakwakha khona isibingelelo kuYehova.
Kwathi lapho uSamuweli eneminyaka emikhulu, wabeka izingane zakhe zibe ngamagoli kuSirayeli.
Igama lomzali wakhe nguYoweli, negama lowesifazane wakhe nguAbiha; babe ngamagoli eBhe-shebha.
Kodwana-ke, udadewabo abazange bahambe ngendlela yakhe. Babe bathanda imali, bathatha izipho, begodu baguqula inqubekelaphambili.
Bahlangana bonke abakhulu baseSirayeli, bafika kuSamuweli eRama.
Bathi kuye, Sekuyisikhathi sakho sobudala, begodu izingane zakho azikho eziphilako njengezingane zakho; ngalokho-ke unganqume nathi ukumkani, njengazo zonke izizwe.
Bathi ke, Sinike ukumkani ukuba akhulume nathi. USamuweli wakhathazeka khulu, wathandaza ikosi.
Wathi ikosi kuye, Lingisa zonke izinto ezikhuluma ngazo lezi zinto abantu; akukubi bona bakunqume wena, kodwana benqume mina ukuba ngibe ngukumkani wabo.
Ngokungafani nalokho abakwenzayo kusukela ngosuku lapho ngibakhuphe khona eYiputa, kuze kube manje, bemishiya, bakhonza amadini amanye.
Ngalokho-ke, lalela amazwi abo; kodwana ukhulume nabo ngokuqinile, wazise bona uzokwenzani ukumkani olawula phezu kwabo.
Wathi uSamuweli kiwo wonke amazwi kaYehova kubo bonke abantu ababemcela ukumkani.
Wathi, Lolu hlobo luzokwenziwa ngukumkani olawula phezu kwenu; uzothatha izingane zenu, azozibeka ezimotoni zakhe, namabhayisikili akhe; bazohamba phambi kwezimoto zakhe.

Uzobeka abanye kubo abaphathi bezinkulungwane, nabanye abaphathi bezinkulungwane eziyisishiyagalombili; abanye bazomisa izihlahla zakhe, begodu bazovuna imbewu yakhe; abanye bazokwenza amathuluzi empi, kanye nengxenye yemoto yakhe.
Uzothatha izingane zenu ukuze zikhiqize iziphuzo, begodu zilungiselele ukudla.
Uzothatha iimila zenu ezingcono, nezivinine zenu, nezihlahla ze-olive zenu, azinikeze abaphathi bakhe.
Uzothatha ishumi lembewu yenu, nembewu yewayini yenu, azozinika abaphathi bakhe nabasebenzi bakhe.
Uzothatha abakhonzi benu, nezisebenzi zenu, nezingane zenu ezingcono khulu, namabhuzane wenu, azowasebenzisa emisebenzini yakhe.
Uzothatha ingxenye yesishiyagalombili yezingulube zenu, begodu nizoba ngabakhonzi bakhe.
Ngosuku olulodwa nizokhala ngenxa yombuso wenu owazikhethela wona; kodwana ikosi ngeke akuphendule ngalolusuku.
Akekho umuntu ofuna ukulalela uSamuweli; bathi, Ngabe sizodinga ukumkani phezu kwethu?
Sizobe sifana nezinye izizwe zonke, sibe nokumkani ukuba ahambe phambi kwethu, begodu aphume ebusweni bethu, abe nemibhikisho yethu.
Wathi uSamuweli, ekhuluma ngamazwi onke abantu, waveza kuYehova.
Wathi ikosi, Nciphisa izingcingo zabo, wamisa ukumkani kubo. USamuweli wathi kwabaSirayeli, Yiya wonke umuntu edolobhaneni lakhe.
Kwabe kukhona umuntu wesizwe sikaBhenjamin, igama lakhe nguKishi, indodana ka-Abiyeli, indodana ka-Zerori, indodana ka-Bekorathi, indodana ka-Afiya; ube ngumntu onamandla amakhulu.
UKishi ubenomntwana okuthiwa nguShawule, indodakazi ebukekayo. Akukho mntu eSirayeli obukekayo kunaye; waphakama ikhanda ngaphezu kwabanye bonke.
Kwathi ngosuku oluthile, amabhungane kaKishi ubaba kaSawule elahlekile; wathi ke uKishi kuSawule unyana wakhe, Thola omunye wabakhonzi wakho nawe, uye ufune amabhungane.

USawule wadlula ezindaweni eziphakeme zakwaEfrayim, nasendaweni yaseShalisha, kodwana abakwazi ukuzithola. Bafika ezindaweni zaseShaalim, kodwana izidumbu azikho khona. Wadlula ezweni laseBhenjamini, kodwana bangeke bazithole.
Bafika ezweni lase-Zuphu, uSawule wathi kulowo mntwana owahamba naye: Yiya, sihambe; uma kungenjalo, ubaba wami uzoyeka ukukhathazeka ngezinkomo, aze akhathazeke ngathi.
Wathi kuye, Thola, kukhona umuntu kaThixo kulo mzi, begodu udume khulu; konke akutjhoko kwenziwa. Siyaye khona manje; mhlawumbe uzositshela indlela esihamba ngayo.
Wathi uSawule kulowo osebenza naye, Uma sihamba, yini esizoyinika lowo muntu? Ngokuba isidlo sethu saphela emithonjeni yethu; asikho nesipho esizoyisa kumntu kaThixo. Sitholani?
Waphendula lo mkhonzi wathi kuye, Thola lapha ngezansi kweshekeli elilodwa legolide; ngizolimalela lowo muntu kaThixo, ukuze acacisele indlela esihamba ngayo.
Esikhathini esedlule eSirayeli, uma umuntu ehamba ukubuza uzimu into ethile, bathi, "Hlela, sihambe kulowo okubonayo," ngombana umprofeti wanamuhla wayebizwa bona ubona.
Wathi uSawule kulowo mkhonzi wakhe, Kulungile; ndiza, sihambe. Basuka ke beya edolobhaneni lapho umntu kaThixo wayehlala khona.
Bathi, "Ngalokho-ke," wathi uMosis, "uma behamba phambili ezindaweni eziphakeme zedolobha, bahlangana namadodakazi aphumayo ukuqoqa amanzi.
Bathi kuye, Ukhona; bheka, ukhambe phambi kwakho. Yiya ngokushesha, ngombana manje nje wafika edolobhaneni lethu, ngombana abantu banesibingelelo esihlalweni sezulu.

Uma nje nifika edolobhaneni, nizomuthola ngaphambi kokuba afike enkabeni yokudlela; ngombana abantu ngeke baqale ukudla kuze afike, ngombana yena kumele abe yikosi yomnikelo wokudla; begodu ngemuva kwalokho bazodla labo abamenywe. Chofoza phezulu manje; uma sekuyisikhathi, nizomuthola.
Baye benyuka bafika edolobhaneni. Bafika lapho, kwabonakalisa bona uSamuweli wayehamba ukuwathola, esuka ethempelini.
Imini ngaphambi kokuba uSawule afike, ikosi ubewutshela uSamuweli, esithi,

Ngosuku oluthile ngalolu sikhathi, ngizokulethela umuntu ezweni likaBhenjamini; uzowuphazamisa abe ngumholi phezu kwabantu bam baseSirayeli; naye uzowasindisa abantu bami ezinyaweni zesiFilisti. Ngibone abantu bami, ngombana inkulumo sabo ifike kuye.
Kwathi lapho uSamuweli nakabona uSawule, ikosi wathi kuye, Lowo ngumuntu engikutshele ngawo; yena ozolawula abantu bam.
Wafika uSawule kuSamuweli emnyango, wathi, Ngicela, ngisazise bona ikuphi indlu yombona.
Wathi uSamuweli, Ngimi lowo obonayo; zula phambi kwami ethempelini, ngombana namhlanje uzokudla nami ukudla; begodu ngesonto ngizokushiya ukhambe, ngizokutshela konke okusenhliziyoni yakho.
Uma kukhulunywa ngezinkomo ozilahle ngosuku oludlule, ungakhathazeki ngazo, ngombana zitholeke; begodu yini leyo efuna yona izwe lonke laseSirayeli? Awukho wena, nomndeni wonke kayise wakho?
Waphendula uSawule, wathi, Ngami nginguBhenjamini, mkhulu ukudlula bonke isizwe samaSirayeli, begodu inkosikazi yami incane kunazo zonke izinkosikazi zikaBhenjamini; kungani ukhuluma ngalokhu?
USamuweli wabeka uSawule nomkhonzi wakhe embhedeni, wababeka phezulu phakathi kwabamenywa, abantu abangamashumi amathathu.
Wathi uSamuweli kulowo opheki, Thola le ngxenye yokudla engikulethelayo, engingakutshele ngayo bona uyibeke phasi.

Wathi umpheki, athathe isifuba, nalokho bekukhona kuso, wamisa phambi kukaSawule. Wathi uSamuweli, Thola lokhu okugcinwe kuwe; dle, ngombana kugcinwe kuwe ngalolu daba, kusukela ngosuku lapho ngithe khona: "Ngimemele abantu." USawule wadla noSamuweli ngalolusuku.
Kwathi lapho bephuma khona ethempelini, bafika edolobhaneni, uSamuweli wakhuluma noSawule phezu kwendlu yakhe.
Bavuka ngobusuku bokuqala, uSamuweli wayalela uSawule phezu kwendlu yangasese, wathi: "Thinakela, ngizokushiya ukhambe." USawule wehla, waphuma naye noSamuweli.

Kwathi, lapho behamba ekugcineni komgwaqo, uSamuweli wathi kuSawule, Uthi yini kumngane wakho ukuba ahambe phambi kwethu? Wakwenza njalo; wathi uSamuweli, Uma kunjalo, hlala lapha, ukuze ngikutshele ilizwi likaThixo.
Wathi uSamuweli, ethatha ibhodlela elincane le-oyile, walifutha phezu kwekhanda lakhe, wamxosha, wathi, uzimu unciphise wena ukuba ube ngumholi abantu bakhe.

Uma uphuma ngimi namuhla, bona, uzothola abantu ababili emgodini kaRakeli eZilza, enhliziyweni kaBhenjamini; bazokutshela bona: Izidlovukazi ozidlulele uzifuna zithe zatholakala, begodu ubaba wakho usazizwa ekhathazekile ngenxa yenu, esithi, Ngingakwenzani ngonyana wami?

Uzoqhubeka khona lapho, kuze ufike emuthini omkhulu waseTabori; khona-ke uzothola khona abantu abathathu besuka eBhetelehem. Omunye uzothwala izinkomo ezincane amathathu, nomunye uzothwala amakhowe amathathu, nomunye uzothwala ibhodlela lewayini.
Bazokuhalalisela, begodu bakulethe izithelo ezimbili; uzozithola kuzona.

begodu, ngemva kwalokho, uzofika eGibeha kaThixo, lapho kukhona isibhedlela samaFilisti; begodu, uma ufinyelela kulo mzi, uzothola iqembu amaprofeta aphuma emgodini ophakeme, bedlala ngezinhlamvu, nezingcweti, neziphuzo, nama-harps, begodu bekhuluma ngokuprofeti.
begodu uMoya kaYehova uzofika kuwe, nawe uzoprofetisa nabo; begodu uzoshintshwa ube umuntu othile.
Uma lezi zibonakaliso zenzeka, ukwenze konke okudingeka kwenziwe; ngombana uzimu uya nawe.
Hamba udlule phambi kwami eGalgali; ngizofika kuwe, nginikeze izipho ezibomvu nezipho zokuthula. Uzohlala usuku oluyisixhenxe, kuze ngifike kuwe, ngikutshele bona yini okufanele uyikwenze.
Kwathi lapho uSawule ebhekene noSamuweli, uzimu washintsha intliziyo kaSawule; begodu lezi zibonakaliso zonke zafika ngalolusuku.
Wafika uSawule nomkhonzi wakhe eGibeha, yabona iqembu lamaprofeti lihlangana naye. UMoya kaThixo wehla phezu kwakhe, waqala ukushumayela phakathi kwabo.
Bathi labo bonke ababemthanda ngaphambilini, bebona bona yena uprofetisa phakathi nabaprofeti, bathi omunye kulowo: Uthini lo mwana kaKishi? Ingabe noSawule unguye wabaprofeti?
Waphendula umuntu oyedwa ohlala khona, wathi, Ubani ubaba wabo? Ngalokho kwathiwa, Ingabe noSawule ungumprofeti?
Kwathi lapho uSawule eqedile ukuprofeti, waya endaweni yokuzinikela.
Wathi udadewabo kaSawule kuye, wathi kuye nomuntu wakhe osebenza naye, Niyaphi na? Wathi yena, Sifuna izinkomo; begodu sabona bona azikho, safika kuSamuweli.
Wathi udadewabo kaSawule, Ngitshele bona uSamuweli uthe yini kuwe?
Waphendula uSawule, wathi: "Uthi wazitshela bona izinkomo zitholakale." Kodwana uSawule akhenge azitshele isinqumo sikaSamuweli sokuthi uzobe ngukumkani.
USamuweli wahlanganisa bonke abantu bakaSirayeli phambi koYehova eMizpa.
Wathi kubo, Usho lokhu ikosi, uzimu kaSirayeli: Ngiwakhuphule amaSirayeli eYiputa, begodu ngiwasindise emathunjini aseYiputa, nasezandleni zazo zonke izizwe eziphazamisayo.

Kodwana-ke, namhlanje nigweme uzimu wenu, owakusindisa kuzo zonke izimo zenu ezibi nezinkinga zenu, nithi, Uzobeka ukumkani phezu kwethu; ngalokho-ke manje, zinikele phambi kukaNkulunkulu ngezizwe zenu, nangenkolo yenu.
USamuweli wabeka zonke izizwe zakwaSirayeli zibheke phambili, begodu isizwe sikaBhenjamin sathathwa ngesandla.
Wabeka isizwe sakwaBhenjamin esihamba phambili, isizukulwane ngasizukulwane; begodu isizukulwane sakwaMatri sathathwa. Sathathwa uSawule unyana kaKishi. Baye bamfuna, kodwana akatholakalanga.
Babuza ikosi, bathi, Ingabe lo mntu wafika lapha? Wathi ikosi, Yebo, ufihlakele phakathi kwezinto ezisetshenziswayo.
Baye behamba, baphuma naye; begodu lapho uhlala phakathi kwabantu, waphakama ikhanda ngaphezu kwanoma ubani kubo.
Wathi uSamuweli kubo bonke abantu, "Ubonani lo muntu owazikhethela yena ikosi? Akunamuntu ofana naye phakathi kwalabo bonke abantu." Bathi ke bonke abantu, "Kube nokuphila ukumkani!"
Wathi uSamuweli kilabo abantu umthetho wombuso, wabhala kiwo encwadini, wayibeka phambi koYehova. USamuele wabasusa bonke abantu, wonke umuntu waya ekhaya lakhe.
USawule wabuyela ekhaya lakhe, waya eGibeha, yena nomndeni wakhe, abantu abanothando, amehlo abo ahlotshiswe nguzimu.
Bathi abanye abantu ababi, Ingabe lo muntu uzosisindisa kanjani? Bemkhohlisa, begodu bengenazo izipho kuye; kodwana uSawule wanyamalala.
Waphuma uNahasi umAmoni, wahlasela iYabhesi-Gileyadi. Bathi kuye bonke abantu baseYabhesi, Yenza isiqiniseko nathi, sizokukhonza wena.
Wathi uNahashi umAmoni kuye, Ngalokhu nje ngizokwenza inxanxathela nani: bona ngiphuze ngamehlo wenu onke akunene, ukuze ngibeke ukungcola ezweni lonke likaSirayeli.
Bathi kuye abakhulu baseYabheshi, Sivumele usuku oluyisixhenxe, ukuze sithumelele abantu ezweni lonke laseSirayeli; uma kungenjalo umuntu ozosisindisa, sizophuma thina.
Befika labo abathunyelwe eGibeha, lapho uSawule uhlala khona, batshela abantu la mazwi; begodu bonke abantu bekhala.
Ngabona uSawule efika emazweni, elandela izinkomo zakhe. Wathi uSawule, "Kuthini na labo bonke abantu? Kungani bekhala?" Bathi kuye, "Amadoda aseYabheshi asho ukuthini?"
Kwathi lapho uSawule ekubona amazwi abo, wafika phezu kwakhe umoya kaThixo, waza waba namandla.

Wathatha izinkomo ezimbili, wazenza iziqephu, wabathumela ngeziqephu ngezandla zabathunywa ezweni lonke likaSirayeli, esithi, Uma umuntu engalandela uSawule noSamuweli, lokhu kuzokwenziwa ngezinkomo zakhe. Ubuhlungu bukaYehova belubopha abantu; baphuma bonke bengamuntu oyedwa.
USawule wababala eBezeki; kwaba ngumakhulu amathathu amaphesenti amadoda aseSirayeli, namaphesenti amathathu amadoda aseYuda.

Bathi kilabo abathunyelwe, bathi kubo: "Kungezwa abantu baseYabhesi eGileyadi bona: 'Ngokulandelayo uma ilanga liqala ukushisa, nizosindiswa.'" Besuka labo abathunyelwe, bakhuluma ngalokhu kubantu baseYabhesi, begodu babe mnandi khulu.
Bathi kubo amadodana ka-Amoni, NgoMsombuluko sizophuma siye kuwe, ukwenze nathi konke okungekuhle emehlo akho.

Kwathi ngosuku olulandelayo, uSawule wahlukanisa abantu bakhe abe ngamaqembu amathathu. Bafika esiteshini sama-Amoni ngaphambi kwemini, babulala bonke abahlala khona, kuze kube yilapho ekuseni khulu; begodu labo abafayo bahlukaniswa, ukuze bangabi nababili phakathi kwabo.
Bathi abantu kuSamuweli, Nguwubani lowo owathi, Ingabe uSawule uyakuba ngukumkani wethu? Thola lapha, sizowabulala.
Wathi uSawule, Akukho muntu ozofa namuhla; ngombana namhlanje ikosi wasindisa isiSirayeli.
Wathi uSamuweli kubo bonke abantu, Yeni, sihambe siye eGalgali, siphinde sibeke khona uSawule njengomphathi.
Baye bonke abantu eGalgali, bakwenza uSawule waba ngukumkani phambi koYehova; banikela khona izipho zokuthula phambi koYehova. USawule namadodana aseSirayeli wonke babe nenjabulo enkulu.
Wathi uSamuweli kiwo wonke amakhosi aseSirayeli, Ngikulalela konke okungithembisile, begodu ngikulethela ukumkani.
Manje ninenkosi ezokuphatha. Ngami, ngineminyaka emikhulu khulu, begodu ubuso bami bumnyama, nabangani bam bakhona lapha phakathi kwenu. Ngibe ngumholi wenu kusukela ngasencane kuze kube manje.

Ngilokhu ngikhona; khuluma ngami phambi kweNkosi, begodu phambi komphathi wakhe okhethiwe. Ngathatha yini inkomo yomngani wami? Ngathatha yini ibhokhwe yomngani wami? Ngakhohlisa yini umngani wami? Ngaphazamisa yini umngani wami? Ngathola yini umnikelo kumngani wami ukuze ngigweme ukubheka phambili? Uma ngikwenze noma yiziphi zalezi zinto, ngizozibuyisela.
Bathi kuye, Awunakusikhohlisa, awunakusicindezela, begodu awuthathenga lutho kumuntu.
Wathi kubo uSamuweli, UYehova ube ngumholi phakathi kwenu, begodu ukumkani wakhe okhethiwe abe ngumholi namuhla, bona ningathola nalutho esandla sami. Bathi, uzimu ube nguMengameli.
Wathi uSamuweli kubo bonke abantu, uzimu nguwo owenza uMoses no-Aron, nowakhipha abazali benu ezweni laseYiputa.
Manje, hlalani lapha; ngombana ngizobhekana nani phambi kukaNkulunkulu ngezinto zonke ezilungile ikosi awazenzayo kuwe, nababa bakho.
Kwathi lapho uYakobi efika eYiputa, abazalwane benu bekhala kuYehova; wathumela ikosi uMoses noAron, bakhipha abazalwane benu emazweni aseYiputa, babeka lapha endaweni.
Baze bakhohlwa ikosi uzimu wabo; wabathengisa kuSisera, umphathi womkhosi waseHazori, namaFilisti, nokumkani wakwaMowabi; bahlaselana nabo.
Baphoqa ikosi, bathi, Sithole isono, ngombana sishiye ikosi, sakhonza amaBaali nama-Ashtorethi; kodwana manje sisindise ebusweni bomshayeli wethu, begodu siyakukhonza.
Wathumela ikosi uYerubahali, noBhedan, noJephthah, noSamuweli; wakwenza bona nikhululwe ezimpini zenu zonke ezingcebeni zenu, nihlale niphephile.
Uma nibona bona uNahashe ukumkani wakwa-Amoni useza kuni, nithi kuye: Akunjalo, kodwana kufanele kube ngukumkani olawula phezu kwethu; naphezu kokuthi ikosi uzimu wenu ungumkani wenu.
Begodu manje, bhekani, ubukhosi obuwakhethayo, obuwucelayo; bhekani, ikosi wamisa ukumkani phezu kwenu.
Uma nje nimthanda ikosi, niwukhonza, niwuphulaphule umthetho wakhe, begodu ningayiphula imiyalelo yakhe; uma nilandela ikosi uzimu wenu, niwe nokumkani olawula phezu kwenu, khona-ke kuzobe sekuhleni.
Uma nithi, Akufanele silalele amazwi kaYehova; uma nithi, Sizophula umthetho wakhe, isandla sakhe sizoba phezu kwenu, njengokuba kwaba phezu kwababanu.
Manje ke, hlalani, nibone le nto enkulu ikosi ozoyenza phambi kwezindlebe zenu!
Ngizobiza ikosi, ukuze anikeze inkungu nemvula; begodu nizokwazi bona yini le nto ebuhlungu enhliziyweni yenu engiyenze phambi kweNkosi, lapho nicela khona ukumkani.
USamuweli wehlalela ikosi, begodu ikosi wathumela inkungu nemvula ngalolusuku olulodwa; abantu bonke bakhathazeka ngoYehova noSamuweli.
Bathi abantu bonke kuSamuweli, Buza ikosi uzimu wakho ngezisebenzi zakho, ukuze singafa; ngombana sithembise isono sethu soke ngalesi sinqumo esibi sokucela ukumkani.
Wathi uSamuweli, Musa ukukhathazeka; kungenxa yokuthi wenza konke lokhu okumbi; kodwana-ke ungagcini ngokulandela ikosi, kodwana usebenzele ikosi intliziyo yenu yonke.
"Musa ukubhekana nabo, ngombana ngeke bakwazi ukukunika inzuzo noma usizo."
UYehova ngeke ashiye abantu bakhe, ngenxa yegama lakhe elikhulu; ngombana ikosi wathanda ukukwenza ube yindawo yakhe.
Ngami-ke, ngeke ngibe nephutha phambi kukaNkulunkulu, uma ngiyeka ukuthandaza ngenxa yenu; kodwana ngizokuzifundisa indlela engcono neyeqiniso.
Ngiyakucela nje bona nigweme ikosi, niwusebenzele ngobuqotho inhliziyweni yenu yonke; begodu nizicabangele zonke izinto zakhe ezikhulu azenzayo kuwe.
Uma nje niqhubeka nokwenza okumbi, nizosuswa niye nomphathi wenu. "
USawule ubeneminyaka engama-30 ubudala lapho eqala ukumkani; waba ngukumkani phezu kwaSirayeli iminyaka engamashumi amane nabini.

USawule wakhetha abantu abangumakhulu amathathu eSirayeli; abekhona naye abantu abangumakhulu amabili eMikmasi, nasezindaweni eziphakeme zaseBheteli, begodu abekhona naye uYonatan unyana wakhe eGibeha kaBhenjamin. Amanye amadoda awashiya, waya ekhaya lakhe.
UYonathani wahlasela isibhedlela samaFilisti eGibeha, begodu amaFilisti akubona. Wathi uSawule waphonsa umbhoshongo phezu kwezwe lonke, esithi, Lawa maHebhere azolalela.

Bathe bonke amaSirayeli bakhuluma bona, USawule wahlasela isibhedlela samaFilisti; begodu namanje amaSirayeli abe yinto engathandeki kilabo abaFilisti. Baphoqelela abantu ukuba bafike eGalgali kuSawule.

Bahlangana amaFilisti ukubhekana noIsrayeli, nemoto ezingu-30, namabhayisikili ayizinkulungwane eziyisishiyagalombili, nabantu abaningi njengamatshe esiqhingini selwandle; benyuka bamisa isibhedlela eMikmash, ngasenyakatho yeBhethaweni.
Babona isizwe sakwaSirayeli bona sisemngciphekweni, begodu ikosi sabo icindezelwe khulu, bafihla ezindaweni ezishisayo, nasezintaba-mlilo, nasezingqimba-mlilo, nasezingqimba-mhlaba.
Baningi abaHebheru babedlula iJordani, befika ezweni likaGadi neGileyadi. USawule wahlala eGalgali; bonke abantu bakhe ababenabo bakhathazeka khulu.
Walinde amalanga ezisixhenxe, ngokwesikhathi uSamuweli esinqumile; kodwana uSamuweli akhenge afike eGalgali, abantu bakaSawule baqala ukushiya.
Wathi uSawule, Ninikele isonka esiqhutshwayo, nezipho zokuthula. Wanikela ngosonka esiqhutshwayo;
Kwathi lapho eqedile ukunikela khona, kwafika uSamuweli; waphuma uSawule ukubamthokozele.
Wathi uSamuweli, Ukwenze kuphi? Wathi uSawule, Ngabona bona abantu besuka ngami, begodu wena ungafikanga ngesikhathi esinqunyiwe, begodu amaFilisti ahlanganisane eMikmash;
Ngitjho, Manje bazongihlasela amaFilisti eGilgal, begodu angizange ngibuze ikosi; ngalokho ngacabanga bona kufanele nginikeze isonka esiqhutshwayo.
Wathi uSamuweli, Ukwenze kahle; awugcinenga umyalo kaYehova uzimu wakho owawukuwisela wona. Uma ubewugcinele, wayekuqinise ubukumkani bakho phezu kwaSirayeli kuze kube sekupheleni.

Kodwana manje ubukumkani bakho abuzohlala isikhathi eside; ikosi usethole umuntu ngokwenhliziyo yakhe, wabhekana naye ukuba abe ngummengameli kwabahlali bakhe; ngombana wena awugcinenga umthetho kaYehova.
USamuweli waphuma eGilgal, waya eGibeha kaBhenjamin. USawule wababala abantu ababenabo, kwaba ngamakhulu ayisishiyagalombili.
USawule noYonatan unyana wakhe, namadodana abo, bahlala eGibeha yaseBhenjamini; kodwana amaFilisti ayeseMikmasha.
Baphuma esiteji samaFilisti, bahlukaniswe abe ngamaqembu amathathu; elinye iqembu libhekene ne-Ofra, ezweni laseShuali.
omunye usuka eBethoroni, nomunye usuka emfuleni waseZeboyim, obhekene nesiqhingi.
Ngalokho-ke, kwakungatholakali umuntu osebenza ngegolide ezweni lonke likaSirayeli; ngombana amaFilisti ayethi, Uma kungenjalo abaHebhere bangakwenza amacwecwe noma izibhamu.
Amadodakazi kaSirayeli wonke ayewela eFilisti, ukuze aqinise izitsha zakhe, nezibhamu zakhe, nama-apile akhe, namahhashi akhe.

Intengo yaba ngamaphesenti amabili engxenyeni yesithathu yeshekeli yokusika ama-ploughs nama-hoes, namaphesenti amathathu engxenyeni yesithathu yeshekeli yokusika ama-forks nama-axis kanye nokulungisa izintambo zengulube.
Kwathi ngosuku lokulwa, bekukhona umuntu othile phakathi kwamadodana kaSawule noYonathani, oneqhwa noma inqwaba esandlani sakhe; kwaba khona uSawule noYonatan unyana wakhe kuphela.
Ke kaloku kwaphuma iqembu labantu baseFilisti, besuka eMikmashheni.
Ngosuku oluthile uYonathani, indodana kaSawule, wathi kulowo ophethe isibhamu sakhe: Yiza, sidlule eqenjini labaseFilisti elisemaphandleni; kodwana akawutshela ubaba wakhe.
USawule wayehlala enhliziyweni yeGibeha, ngaphasi komnqumo eMigron; kwabekho naye amadoda angamakhulu amathandathu.

Kwabekho phakathi kwabo uAhiya, owayegqoka i-ephodi, indodana ka-Ahitubhu, umshado ka-Ikhabhodi, indodana kaPhinehasi, indodana ka-Eli, ukumkani kaYehova eShilo; begodu akukho muntu owaziyo bona uYonathan wasuka.
Kwaba khona isibhakabhaka esiphakeme ngakwesobunxele nakwesokudla, lapho uYonathan efuna ukudlula khona, ukuze afike emgodini wamaFilisti; igama elinye libizwa bona yiBozezi, kanti elinye iShene.
Omunye uphakama ngasenyakatho, ebhekene neMikmash; omunye uphakama ngasentshonalanga, ebhekene neGeba.

Wathi uYonathani kulowo wesifazane othwala isibhamu sakhe, Yeza, sidlule esiteshini salabo abangatholanga; kungase kube bona ikosi akwenzele okuthile; ngombana akukho okungeke kuvimbele ikosi ekusindiseni abantu abaningi noma abancane.
"Yenza konke okusemandleni akho," kusho umthwalo wakhe wensimbi. "Chofoza phambili. Nginenhliziyo yakho nengqondo."
Wathi uYonathani, Siyahamba, sidlule kilabo abantu, sibonise kubo.
Uma bathi kuthi, Thumelani lapha, kuze sifike kuwe; khona-ke sizohlala lapho sikhona, begodu asizikhuphuli kubo.
Uma bathi, Nciphisani nathi; khona-ke sizokhuphuka; ngombana lokhu kuzoba yisibonakaliso sethu sokuthi ikosi wabanikela emlenzeni wethu.
Babonisana nabo bobabili emkhosini wamaFilisti. Bathi amaFilisti, "Njengombana abaHebhere bephuma ezigodini, lapho befihla khona."

Bathi amadoda asesiteji kuYonathani, nomuntu ophethe isithuthuthu sakhe, sithi, Yindeni nathi, begodu sizokuzifundisa. Wathi uYonathani komuntu ophethe isithuthuthu sakhe, Yiya phezulu ngemuva kwami; ngombana ikosi wabanikela esandlani samaSirayeli.

UYonathani wehla ngezandla zakhe nezinyawo zakhe, nomuntu ophethe isibhamu sakhe walandela emuva kwakhe; begodu abaFilisti bawela phambi kukaYonathani, nomuntu ophethe isibhamu sakhe wababulala emuva kwakhe.
Kulesi simo sokuqala, uJonathan nomuntu ophethe isibhamu sakhe babulala abantu abangu-20 endaweni elingana nengxenye yobukhulu bendawo encane.

Kwaba khona ubuhlungu obukhulu emikhosini yamaFilisti, emgwaqeni, nasezindaweni zomhlaba. Nabo bonke ababhikishe emgwaqweni, nalabo abahlaselayo, bakhathazeka; begodu izwe licindezelwa, ngenxa yobuhlungu obuvela kuThixo.
USaule ohlala eGibeha, eBhenjamini, wabona ikosi ihamba ngaso soke isikhathi.
Wathi uSawule kubo bonke abantu ababenabo, Nibala abantu, nibone bona ubani osuka kuthiwe. Bathe babalwa, bona, uYonathani nomfazi ophethe isibhamu sakhe abakho.
Wathi uSawule ku-Ahiya, Nciphisa lapha ibhokisi likaThixo; kwabe sekuphakathi kwabaSirayeli ngalolu xesha.
USawule ekhuluma nombingeleli, kwabonakala bona umsindo emgwaqweni wamaFilisti ukhula begodu ukhula; uSawule wathi kumbingeleli, Sula konke okwenze.
Wahlangana uSawule nabantu bakhe bonke, wafika emdlalweni, wafumana amaFilisti ephazamisekile, ngaso soke isikhathi, ahlaselana ngeqhwa.
Baningi namadoda aseHibhuri, abelokhu ehamba nabaFilisti ngaphambilini, afike nabo esibhedlela, washintsha uhlangothi, waya kumaSirayeli, waba nguSawule noYonathani.
Bathe bonke amadoda aseSirayeli afihlakele ezweni eliphakeme laseEphrayime, akubona bona abaFilisti babaleka, waqala ukulwa, wabalandela.
Wasindisa ikosi isizwe samaSirayeli ngalolu busuku. Ukulwa kwadlula eBhethe-Aweni.

Amadoda aseSirayeli ayephukile ngalolu busuku; ngombana uSawule wabeka abantu emkhondweni, esithi, Utholwe umuntu odla ukudla ngaphambi kokuphuma kwelanga, kuze kube yilapho ngithole inkohliso ezimpini zami. Ngalokho bonke abantu abazange badla ukudla.
Wonke umkhosi wafika emfuleni, begodu bekukhona ujusi ezweni.
Baye befika emfuleni, babone ujusi uphuma emlonyeni wabo; kodwana akukho muntu okwaziyo ukuwubeka emlonyeni wabo, ngombana babekhathazekile ngenxa yesinqumo.

UYonathani ke akakwazi ukulalela bona ubaba wakhe wabeka isizwe ngaphasi komshado, ngalokho waphakamisa ikhanda lentambo esesandlani sakhe, wayifaka emgodini wengulube; waveza isandla sakhe emphinjeni yakhe, begodu amehlo akhe akhanya.
Wathi omunye kubo kuye, uthi: Ubaba wakho wabeka isandla sakhe esiqinile emkhosini, esithi, Kulahlekile wonke umuntu odla ukudla namuhla; ngalokho abantu bahlupheka.
Wathi uYonathani, Ubaba wami unqobile izwe; bhekani bona amehlo ami akhanya kanjani, ngombana ngadla inkomishi encane yalo mhlophe.
Kungakuhle yini uma abantu bedla namuhla isiphuzo esithathwe ezimpilweni zabo, ukuze sikwazi ukubulala abantu abaningi baseFilisti?
Kwathi ngalolu busuku amaSirayeli ahlasela amaFilisti, esuka eMikmasi waya eAyaloni; begodu abaSirayeli balahleka.
Basuka bathatha izinkomo, namahhashi, nengulube, namabele, bazibulala phezu komhlaba, badla inyama negazi layo.
Wathi umuntu kuSawule, "Njengombana labo bantu besenza isono phambi koYehova, bedla inyama negazi kuyo." USawule wathi, "Uyihloniphile; cindezela lapha phasi itshe elikhulu!"

Wathi uMosis, Yiya phakathi kwalabo abantu, sithi kubo, Ninikele nami wonke umuntu inkomo yakhe, noma ingulube yakhe, nizibulala lapha, nizidle; begodu ningabi nesono kuYehova, nidla inyama enegazi. Wathatha khona wonke umuntu inkomo yakhe ngaleyo busuku, wayizibulala khona.
Wakha uSawule isibingelelo kuYehova; kwaba yilapho waqala khona ukwakha isibingelelo kuzimu.

Wathi uSawule, "Siye kulandela abaFilisti ngobusuku, begodu sizobalaza phakathi kwabo kuze kube yimini; ngeke sishiye umuntu ophilayo kubo." Baphendula bathi, "Yenza konke okulungile engqondweni yenu." Wathi umbingeleli, "Sizobuza uzimu lapha.
USawule wabuza uzimu, esithi, Ngizohamba ngilandela abaFilistimi? Ingabe uzobanikela esandlani sakwaSirayeli? Kodwana uzimu akhenge amphendule ngalolusuku.
Wathi uSawule, "Nifike lapha, bonke abaphathi bezinkomo, ukuze sibone bona yini isono esibekiwe namuhla.
Ngokuba ikosi, umsindisi wakwaSirayeli, ephilayo, noma ngabe nguYonathan, unyana wami, kufanele aphele. Akukho muntu owaziyo phakathi kwamadodana lawo.
Wathi uSawule kiwo wonke amadoda aseSirayeli, Nihlale lapha; nami noYonathani unyana wami sihlale lapha. Baphendula abantu, bathi, Ukwenzeni konke okulungile emehlo wenu.
USawule wathandaza kuYehova, uzimu kaSirayeli, wathi, Siphendule ngokucacile. Watholakalela uYonathani noSawule, begodu laba bantu bahlanzwa.
Wathi uSawule, Thola isibhamu phakathi kwami noYonathani unyana wami. UJonathani uthethwe.
Wathi uSawule kuYonathani, Ngitshele bona yini oyenze. UYonathani wathi kuye, Ngadla ijusi elilodwa ngengxenye yesandla sami; namuhla ngizofa!
Wathi uSawule, "uzimu akwenze lokhu nokunye okuningi, uma ungafanga, Jonathan."

Bathi abantu kuSawule, Uzofa yini uYonathani, owenza lo kulwa olukhulu ezweni laseSirayeli? Akufanele kube njalo; njengombana ikosi ephilayo, angeke izinwele zakhe zibe ngaphasi komhlaba, ngombana wakwenza lokhu namhlanje ngesandla sikaThixo. Basindisa ke labo bantu uYonathani, akafanga.
Wabuya uSawule, walandela amaFilisti; babuyela ezweni labo langempela.

USawule waba ngukumkani phezu kwaSirayeli, wabhekana nezitha zakhe ngazo zonke izingcezu: namaMowabi, namadodakazi ka-Amoni, neEdomu, namakhosi aseSobha, namaFilisti; lapho ebuyela khona, wayewahlasela.
Wagquma ukulwa, wahlasela ama-Amaleki, wavikela isiSirayeli kilabo ababebathutha.
Onyana bakaSawule: uYonathani, noIshivi, noMalki-shuha; igama lenkosikazi yakhe lalinguMerabhi, negama lendodakazi yakhe linguMikhayeli.
Unkosikazi wakhe wayengu-Ahinoamu intombi ka-Ahimahazi; umphathi wesibhakabhaka sikaSawule waba ngu-Abner, unyana ka-Neri, umfazi kaSawule.
UKishi ubaba kaSawule, noNeri ubaba ka-Abner, babe yizingane zikaAbiyeli.
Ngazo zonke amalanga wokuphila kukaSawule, bekukhona ukulwa okunzima khulu namaFilisti; ngaso soke isikhathi lapho uSawule nakabona khona umuntu onamandla, noma indodana yothando, wayemthatha.
Wathi uSamuweli kuSawule, "Ngithunyelwe nguYehova bona ngikukhiphe wena ube ngukumkani phezu kwabantu bakhe baseSirayeli; namuhla ke lalela ilizwi likaNkulunkulu.
Usho lokhu ikosi wezizwe zonke, uthi: Ngizobhekana namadodakazi ka-Amaleki ngenxa yezinto azenzayo ezweni lakwaSirayeli, lapho ahlasela khona amaSirayeli, ngesikhathi bephuma eYiputa.
Hamba manje, uhlasele ama-Amalekhi, upheleze ngokupheleleko yonke into sabo; ungawathandeki; ubulala amadoda nabesifazane, izingane nezingane ezinyathelisayo, izinkomo nengulube, izikelemu nezinkomo.
USawule waqoqa abantu eTelayimu, wababala; kwaba ngumakhulu amabili amawaka amadoda ahamba ngezinyawo, namadodana kaYuda amakhulu ayisithupha.
USawule waya edolobhaneni lakwa-Amaleki, wamisa isikhala esibheke emfuleni.

Wathi uMosis kwabaKenisi, Yiya, shiya ama-Amaleki, ukuze ngikusindise wena kanye nabo; ngombana wena wabonisa ubulungisa kubo bonke abantu bakaSirayeli, lapho bephuma eYiputa. Basuka ke abaKenisi phakathi kwa-Amaleki.
USawule wahlasela ama-Amaleki, kusukela eHavila kuya eShure, eningizimu yeYiputa.
Wathatha uAgagi, ukumkani wama-Amaleki, ephilayo, wabulala bonke abantu bakhe ngeqhwa.

Kodwana uSawule namadodana akhe baxosha uAgagi, namakhowe angcono, namakhowe amakhulu, nezingulube ezinomsoco, nezinkomo, konke okungcono; abafuni ukuzisola ngokupheleleko; kodwana konke okumbi, nento encane, bazisola ngokupheleleko.
Kwafika ke igama likaYehova kuSamuweli, lithi,
Wathi uSamuweli: "Kungibuhlungu bona ngakwenza uSawule ube ngukumkani, ngombana ushintshile engilandela, akhenge enze amazwi ami." USamuweli wakhathazeka khulu, wathi kuYehova yonke le busuku.
Wavuka ke uSamuweli ekuseni, waya ebhekana noSawule. Bathi kuye: "USawule useKarmeli, begodu wamisa khona isikhumbuzo sakhe, waphuma waya eGalgali." USawule wathi kuSamuweli: "Kulungile! Kulungile!"
Wafika uSamuweli kuye, wathi uSawule, UYehova akubabaze; ngikwenzele umthetho kazimu.
Wathi uSamuweli, Ngabe yini le nto yokubhema kwengulube enhliziyweni yami? Ingabe yini le nto yokubhaka kwezinkomo engingayibona?
Waphendula uSawule, wathi: Kusuka ku-Amaleki babuya nabo; ngombana begcine okungcono kwezingulube nezimvu, ukuze babe yisondlo kuYehova uzimu wakho; kodwana konke okunye sakuvama.
Wathi uSamuweli kuSawule, Kulungile; ngizokutshela bona yini leyo ikosi engikutshele yona ngobusuku obudlule. Wathi uSawule, Ubani?
Wathi uSamuweli, Ngabe wena, lapho ubencane emehlo akho, awuzange ube yinhloko yezizwe zakwaSirayeli? UYehova wakwenza ube ngukumkani phezu kwaSirayeli.
Wakuthumela wena ikosi, wathi, Iya, zulazula ngaso soke isikhathi labo ababusi base-Amaleki; bhekana nabo, kuze kube wukuphela kwabo.
Kungani na bona ungamlalela ikosi? Kungani na bona ukhambe uhamba-hamba, wenze okumbi emehloni kaYehova?
Wathi uSawule, "Ngenakho ngitholele ilizwi likaYehova; ngahamba ngendlela ikosi angisithumelele yona, ngabulala wonke ama-Amaleki, ngabuyisela uAgagi ukumkani wabo.
Bathatha amakhowe, namabhokhwe, empilweni yazo zonke izinto ezilahliwe, ukuze banikela kuYehova uzimu wakho eGiligali.

Wathi uSamuweli, Ingabe ikosi uthanda izipho zokudlwengula nezipho zokudla, njengokuba ethanda ukulalela uMoya oNgcwele? Ukulalela kungcono kunesibopho sokudla, nokulalela kungcono kunamafutha omnqumo.
Ukwephula umthetho kufana nokwenza izimanga, begodu ukukhohlisa kufana nokukhonza amatshe; ngenxa yokuthi ushiye igama likaYehova, naye ushiye wena ukuba ungukumkani.
Wathi uSawule kuSamuweli, Nginqunyelwe, ngombana ngaphula umthetho kaYehova, namazwi akho; begodu ngibe nomoya wabo bonke abantu, ngabavumela.
Manje ke, ngiyakucela, usindise isono sami; buyela nami, ngizibophezele kuYehova.
Wathi uSamuweli kuye, Ngizobuyelanga nawe; ngombana usuke wakhohlisa ilizwi likaYehova, begodu ikosi usekukhohlise wena bona ungaba ngukumkani phezu kwaSirayeli.
Kwathi lapho uSamuweli ebhekene nokuphuma, uSawule wathatha isibambo sakhe, saqhuma.
Wathi uSamuweli kuye, UYehova usale ubukumkani bamaSirayeli kuwe namuhla, wawunikeze umngane wakho ongcono kunakho konke.
uzimu onguMhlonishwa waseSirayeli akakhohlisi, begodu akashintshi ingqondo yakhe; ngombana uzimu awumuntu oshintsha ingqondo yakhe.
Wathi yena uSawule, Ngibizile; kodwana ngikucela, ngihloniphe ngami phambi kwabakhulu bezinhlanga zami, begodu phambi kwamadodana aseSirayeli; buyela nami, ukuze ngiwukhonze ikosi uzimu wakho.
Wabuya uSamuweli elandela uSawule, wathandaza uSawule kuYehova.
Wathi uSamuweli, "Ninikele ku-Agagi ukumkani wama-Amaleki." U-Agagi wafika kuye ngethemba elikhulu, wathi, "Kuyinto ecacile bona ibuhlungu bokufa budlule."
Wathi uSamuweli, Njengekhephu lakho elihlukumeza izingane zabesifazane, ngaleyo le ubaba wakho uzohlukumeza izingane phakathi kwabesifazane. USamuele wabulala uAgagi phambi koYehova eGilgal.
USamuweli wehla waya eRama, uShawule wafika ekhaya lakhe eGibeha kaShawule.
USamuweli akhenge aphinde abone uSawule, kuze kube yimini yokufa kwakhe; kodwana uSamuweli wahlupheka ngenxa kaSawule; begodu ikosi wakhathazeka ngokuba wenza uSawule ukumkani phezu kwaSirayeli.

Wathi ikosi kuSamuweli, Ingabe usuzokhala isikhathi esingakanani ngenxa kaSawule, uma ngiwuphoqisile ukuba angeke abe ngukumkani phezu kwaSirayeli? Ugcwalise isikhunta sakho ngophethiloli, uye; ngiyakuthumela kuYese waseBethelehemu, ngombana ngithole omunye umfazi wakhe bona abe ngumphathi.
Wathi uSamuweli, Ngabe ngizohamba kanjani? Uma uSawule engazi, uzongibulala. Wathi ikosi, Thola inkomo encane nawe, uthi, Ngiye ukunikela ngenhlanhla kukaNkulunkulu;
Ngizokukhombisa bona yini okufanele uyenze, begodu wena uzowuphazamisa lowo ngizokutshela wona.
Wakwenza uSamuweli njengombana wathi ikosi. Yafika eBethelehemu, baphuma amadoda amakhulu edolobhaneni layo, akhathazekile, wamthola, bathi kuye, Ufika kanjani ngokuthula?

Wathi uSamuweli, "Kulungile; ngifikile ukunikela ngenhlanhla kuYehova; zinikeleni, nifike nami emkhondweni." Wazinikela uYese nabantwana bakhe, wababiza emkhondweni, wathi kubo, "Njengombana niphila, nizophila.
Bafika, uSamuweli nakabona uElibha, wathi: "Kulungile bona lo nguwo okhethiwe nguYehova ukuba ahlale lapha phambi kukaYehova."

Wathi ikosi kuSamuweli, Ungambhekanga ngobuhle bakhe, noma ngokuphakama kwakhe; ngombana ngiwubeke phasi. uzimu akabhekanga ngobuso bomuntu; ngombana umuntu ubheka izinto ezingaphandle, kodwana uzimu ubheka intamo.
UYese wabiza uAbinabadi, wamhambisa phambi kukaSamuweli. Wathi uSamuweli, "uzimu akawakhethi nawo la maqembu."
Wathi uYese: "Uzohamba naye uShama," kodwana uSamuweli wathi, "ikosi akawakhethi nalowo."
Wathi uYese, wabeka izingane zakhe ezisixhenxe zihambe phambi kukaSamuweli; kodwana uSamuweli wathi kuye, UYehova akawakhethi lawa.

Wathi uYese, Ingabe lezo zonke izingane zakho? Wathi uJese, Kushiwo bona, Ukhona oncane; yena ugcina izinkomo. Wathi uSamuweli, Sebenzisa umphathi ukuba afike, ngombana singeke sihlale sidla ukudla kuze afike.
Wathumela uYese, wamthola; wabona bona isithombe sakhe sikhanya khulu, namazinyo akhe abukeka kahle, nobuso bakhe buhle. Wathi ikosi kuye, Yiya, umhlobise, ngombana lo nguye.
Wathi uSamuweli, ethatha iphoyinti le-oyile, wamenza umhluzi phambi kwabazalwane bakhe. UMoya kaYehova wehla phezu kukaDavide kusukela ngalolusuku naphezu kwalo; wabuya ke uSamuweli waya eRama.
UMoya kaYehova wawusuka kuSawule, uMoya ongcolile osuka eNkosini wamangalisa uSauli.
Bathi abakhonzi bakaSawule kuye, Thola, umphefumulo ombi osuka kuThixo ubuhlungu kuwe.
Ngiyacela bona umnikazi wethu atshele abakhonzi bakhe bona bafune umuntu odlala kahle i-harp, ukuze uma uMoya oyiNgcwele ovela kuThixo efika kuwe, abe ngumuntu odlalayo, begodu ube nempilo.
Wathi uSawule kwabakhonzi bakhe, Bukelani umuntu odlala kahle, nimveze kuye.

Waphendula omunye wamadodakazi, wathi, Ngibone unyana kaYese waseBethelehemu owazi ukubhoza, begodu ungumuntu onamandla amakhulu, nomfazi ongumnqobi, begodu unomsindo omuhle, naye ungumuntu obukekayo; begodu ikosi usenakhe.
USawule wathumela abathunywa kuYeshaya, esithi, Thumela kum uDavide, unyana wakho, ohlala ezindleni.
Wathi uYese, ethatha ibhuza elihlanganisiwe nokudla, nebhodlela lewayini, nenyama yenkomo, wazisa kuSawule ngoDavide unyana wakhe.
Wafika uDavide kuSawule, wasebenza kuye. USawule wamthanda khulu uDavide; waba ngumphathi wezikhali zakhe.
USawule wathumela kuYeshaya, esithi, Akufanele uDavide ahlale enhliziyweni yami; ngombana unenhlonipho kuye.

Ngaso soke isikhathi lapho umphefumulo ovela kuThixo efika kuSawule, uDavide wayethatha i-harp yakhe, wadlala; khona-ke uSawule waba nokuthula. Wazizwa engcono, begodu lo mphefumulo omubi wawuyaphuma kuye.
Baqoqa amaFilisti imikhosi sabo ukubhikisha, bahlangana eSokho ezweni laseYuda, bamisa isibhedlela phakathi kweSoko ne-Azeka, e-Efesu Dammim.
USawule namadodana aseSirayeli bahlangana, bamisa isikhashana eGoli lase-Ela, balungiselela ukulwa nabaFilisti.
AbaFilisti bahlala emfuleni owodwa, begodu amaSirayeli ahlala emfuleni owodwa; bekhona umlambo phakathi kwabo.
Waphuma ezweni lakwaFilisti umnqobi okuthiwa nguGolida, waseGathi; ubude bakhe kwakuyimitha eziyisishiyagalombili.
Wagqoka isibhamu segolide kanye ne-coat yensimbi eyenziwe ngezinhlayiya zesiliva, eyisisindo esingaphezu kwamakhilogremu ayishumi nesishiyagalolunye.
Ube ne-bronze armor emilenzeni yakhe, begodu i-bronze spear yafakwa emuva kwakhe.

Umcibisholo wakhe, umbhoshongo wakhe, ubukhulu bawo befana nentambo yombukiso, begodu ikhanda lakhe lensimbi lalingamakhilogremu ayisishiyagalombili. Uwesifazane ophethe isibhamu sakhe sahamba phambi kwakhe.
UGoliyati wahlala, wathi kubo bonke abantu baseSirayeli: Yini na bona nisesiteji sokulwa? NginguFilisti, begodu niyimikhonzi kaSawule; khetheni umuntu othile phakathi kwenu, nimkhuphule.
Uma ekwazi ukulwa nami, begodu embulala, khona-ke sizoba ngabakhonzi benu; kodwana uma ngikwazi ukumnqoba, begodu embulala, khona-ke nizobe ngabakhonzi bethu, nisebenzele.
Wathi uFilisti: Namuhla ngizimangalisa izikhulu zakwaSirayeli; ngisinike umuntu, sihlangane.
USawule namadoda amakhulu aseSirayeli wonke akubona amazwi alo mFilisti, baphoqeleka ukuba bakhathazeke khulu.
UDavide ubengumntwana kaYese, umEfrati waseBethelehemu eYuda; uJese wayenezingane eziyisishiyagalombili. UYese waba mkhulu khulu eminyakeni kaSawule.
Omkhulu wabo bonke oonyana bakaYese, uElibha, omkhulu kubo, no-Abinabadi owesibili, no-Shama owesithathu, balandela uSawule ezweni.
UDavide wayeyindodana encane. Abakhulu abathathu balandela uSawule,
UDavide ke wayehamba esuka kuSawule, waya eBethelehemu, ukuze agcine izinkomo zikababa wakhe.
Lo mFilisti wayefika ekuseni nakusihlwa, uhlala khona amalanga ezimashumi mane.
Wathi uYese kuDavide, unyana wakhe, Thola le bhokisi lenkomo ethosiwe, nalezi nkomishi eziyisithupha zezinkukhu, uzithumelele abazalwane bakho emgodini.
Thola lezi zingulube ezingu-10 kumphathi weyunithi sabo. Bona bona abazalwane bakho banganjani, bese uthola ezinye izindaba kubo
Bakhona uSawule namadoda amakhulu aseSirayeli eGoli le-Ela, bebhekana nabaFilisti.
UDavide washiya ingulube ngasemini, wazisa izimpahla, waphuma, njengombana uYese abemtshela. Wafika esiteshini samaphoyisa ngesikhathi isizwe sisuka esihlalweni sayo sokulwa, sishaya umsindo wokulwa.
AbaSirayeli nabaseFilisti bahlanganisana, bebhekene nomunye.
UDavide washiya izinto zakhe kumuntu ophethe izimpahla, wahamba eqenjini lempi, wabuza abazalwane bakhe bona bangani.
Wakhuluma nabo, yabona uGoliyati, umnqobi wamaFilisti waseGathi, ephuma emidlalweni yakhe, eshaya ngezwi lakhe elijwayelekile; uDavide walalela.
Amadodakazi aseSirayeli, lapho nakabona lo mntu, baphuma phambi kwakhe, bekhathazeka khulu.

Bathi amadoda aseSirayeli, Ubona yini lo muntu ophumayo? Uphuma ukukhohlisa amakhosikazi aseSirayeli. Uma umuntu ebulala yena, ukumkani uzomnika impahla enkulu, begodu uzomnika intombi yakhe njengomkakhe, begodu umndeni wakhe awudingi ukuba ukhokhe inzalo eSirayeli.

Wathi uDavide kubo bonke abantu abakhona, esithi, Kuzokwenziwani umuntu obulala lo mFilisti, begodu asuse isidumbu eSirayeli? Ubani lo Mfilisithi ongatholwe ukutholwa, bona agweme amaqembu kaThixo ophilayo?
Bathi kuye bona yini okufanele yenziwe ngomuntu obulalayo.

UElibha, udadewabo omdala, ekhuluma nalabo abantu, wazwa uElibha, udadewabo omkhulu, bona uDavide usekhuluma nabo. Waphoqelela uDavide, wathi: "Iyini inhloso yokufika kwakho lapha? Ngabe ubani owashiya naye amakhowe ambalwa esiqhingini? Ngiyazi inhlonipho yakho, nobubi benhliziyo yakho; ufike ukubhekana nempi kuphela."
Wathi uDavide, Ngakwenza yini manje? Ingabe ngingeke ngikhulume?
Kwathi lapho wabuyela kuye omunye umuntu, wabuza umbuzo ofanayo, begodu abantu baphendule yena njengokuba ngaphambili.
Wathi uDavide bona, "Ngikutshela lokho," kwathiwa kuSawule; wathumela uSawule ukuba afike.
Wathi uDavide kuSawule, "Akukho muntu ongeke akhohlwe ngenxa yalo mFilisti; umkhonzi wakho uzoya nokulwa naye.
Wathi uSawule, Awukwazi ukuyobhekana nalo mFilisti, bona ube nokulwa naye; ngombana wena ungumfundi, yena ke unkosikazi onamandla kusukela emncane.
Wathi uDavide kuSawule, Umkhonzi wakho wagcina izinkomo zikababa wakhe; kwafika ingulube, noma inkomo, yathatha inkomo emndenini.
Ngiye ngayilandela, ngayishaya, ngayikhulula ingulube emlonyeni wayo. Xa yabuyela kum, ngayithatha ngezinwele zayo, ngayibetha, ngayibulala.
Ngiye ngabulala ingulube, begodu ngiye ngabulala ingulube; umkhonzi wakho uzoba njengomunye wabo, nalowo mFilisti ongeke atholwe ukutholwa, ngenxa yokuthi waduduza amaqembu kaThixo ophilayo.
UYehova osindisele enhliziyweni yengulube, nasenhliziyweni yomdlavuza, uzongisindisa begodu engqondweni yalo mFilisti. Wathi uSawule kuDavide, Yiya; ikosi abe nawe.
USawule wagqoka uDavide izicathulo zakhe, wabeka phezu kwakhe isigqoko sokulwa, wabeka isibhamu segolide ekhanda lakhe.

UDavide wagqoka ikhebula likaSawule phezu kwezicathulo zakhe, wazama ukuhamba; ngombana akhenge alisebenzise. Wathi uDavide kuSawule, Ngangikwazi ukuhamba ngale nto, ngombana angiyisebenzisile. Wazisusa.

Wathatha inkomishi yakhe esandlani sakhe, wakhetha izintaba eziyisishiyagalombili eziqinile emfuleni, wazibeka ephaketheni lakhe lenyamakazi; intambo yakhe ibe esandlani sakhe, wafika kulowo mFilisti.
Uthe lo mFilisti, ophethe isibhamu sakhe phambi kwakhe, wafika waya eDavideni.
Wabheka uDavide, wabona bona ungumfundi omusha kuphela, onempilo nobuhle obuhle; wabheka phasi kuye.
Wathi uFilisti kuDavide, Ngiyinja yini mina, bona ungene kum ngezinkomishi? UFilisti wehlaza uDavide ngoThixo wakhe.
Wathi, "Njima lapha, begodu ngizonikela inyama yakho izilwane ezifuywayo kanye namazinyoni!"
Wathi uDavide kulowo mFilisti, Ufika kimi ngeqhwa, nesihlalo somlilo, nesibhamu; kodwana mina ngiya kuwe ngegama likaYehova wezizwe zonke, uzimu wamabhishobhi aseSirayeli, owawumbulela yena.

Namuhla ikosi uzokunikela esandla sami, ngizokubulala, ngizokususa ikhanda lakho; begodu namhlanje ngizobeka izicubu zesizwe samaFilisti ezilwaneni eziphilako nezinyamazane, ukuze umhlaba wonke wazi bona kukhona uzimu eSirayeli.
Nabo bonke abakhona lapha bayazi bona ikosi akasindisi ngeqhwa, noma ngemikhosi; ngombana ukunqoba kukaNkulunkulu, begodu uzokunikela esandla sethu.
Kwathi lapho lo Mfilisita ehamba ebhekene naye, uDavide wahamba ngokushesha, waya emgwaqweni wokulwa.
Wafika ebhokisini lakhe, wathatha khona itshe, wehla, wamshaya uFilisti emlonyeni wakhe; itshe lalibanjwa emlonyeni wakhe, waba phantsi ngobuso bakhe emhlabeni.
UDavide wanqoba uFilisti ngentambo netshe, begodu angeke kube nekhebula esandla sakhe; wahlasela lo philistimi, wambulala.

Wahamba uDavide, wahlala phezu kwakhe, wathatha ikhebula likaFilisti, lalimaza lisuka emgodini wayo, wabulala uFilisti, wamisa intamo yakhe ngekhebula. Babona amaFilisti bona umnqobi wabo ufile, babuyela emuva, babaleka.

Amadoda aseSirayeli nawaseYuda aphuma, eshaya ngezwi elikhulu, alandela amaFilisti kuze kufike emgwaqeni waseGathi, namasango ase-Ekron; begodu izicubu zamaFilisti zasakazeka emigwaqweni yaseShaaraim, kuze kufike eGathi nase-Ekron.
Babuya amaSirayeli belandela abaFilisti, bahlasela isibhedlela sabo.
UDavide wathatha ikhanda lomFilisti, waya eYerusalem; izithuthuthu zakhe zazibeka ehhovisi lakhe.

Kwathi lapho uSawule nakabona uDavide ephuma ebhekana nalo mFilisti, wathi ku-Abneri, umphathi womkhosi, ethi, U-Abneri, lo mfundi unguye yini? Waphendula u-Abneri, esithi, Kuphila inhliziyo yakho, Kosi yami, angikazi.
Wathi ukumkani, "Qiniseka bona ngubani unyana lo mfundi?"
Nokho, lapho uDavide ebuya ehlasela umFilisti, uAbheri wamthatha, wamletha phambi kukaSawule; nokho uDavide wagcina ikhanda lomFilisti.
Wathi uSawule kuye, Ungubani unyana wakho, umshado? UDavide wathi, Ngiye unyana womkhonzi wakho uYese waseBethelehemu.
Kwathi, lapho uDavide eqedile ukuxoxa noSawule, uYonathani waba ngumoya owodwa noDavide; wathandana naye njengothando lwakhe.
Ngalowo mhla, uSawule wathatha uDavide naye, akhenge amvumele bona abuye endlwini yobaba wakhe.
Wakwenza uYonathani isivumelwano noDavide, ngombana wayemthanda njengomuntu wakhe.
UYonathani wasusa isigqoko sakhe, wamnika uDavide, kanye nezigqoko zakhe zonke, naphezu kweqhwa lakhe, nempucuko yakhe, nesibhamu sakhe.

USawule wathumela uDavide kiwo wonke umsebenzi wakhe, waba nempumelelo enkulu; ngalokho uSawule wambeka phezu kwazo zonke izikhulu zomndeni kaSawule. Kwabe kumnandi kubo bonke abantu, nakwabo bonke abavikeli bakaSawule.
Uma bebuya, lapho uDavide wabulala khona umFilisti, kwaphuma amadoda kuzo zonke izifundazwe zakwaSirayeli, ukuhlangabezana noSawule ukumkani, ekhuluma, edansela, nezingcweti, nokuzijabulisa.
Kwathi lapho bedlala khona, bathi: USawule wabulala amawaka akhe, noDavide amashumi amane amawaka akhe.
Wathi uSawule: "Bemnike uDavide amawaka amashumi amabili, kodwana mina nginika amawaka ambalwa. Ingabe angathola lutho ngaphandle kobukhosi?"
Ngaleso sikhathi, uSawule wabhekana noDavide ngesandla esibi.

Kwathi ngosuku olulandelayo, kwafika umphefumulo omubi osuka kuThixo phezu kukaShawule. Wayehamba efulethini lakhe, begodu uDavide wayedlala i-harp, njengombana evame ukukwenza. UShawule ubenesibhamu esandleni sakhe,
Wayisusa, wathi, Ngizowubeka uDavide emgodini. UDavide waphuma kuye izikhathi ezimbili;
USawule wakhathazeka ngoDavide, ngombana ikosi ube noDavide, kodwana uSaule wayeseshayele.
USawule wasusa uDavide kuye, wammisa njengomphathi wamaphesenti ayikhulu; uDavide wayehamba ezindaweni zokulwa.
Waphumelela khulu kiwo wonke umsebenzi wakhe, ngombana ikosi waye naye.
Kwathi lapho uSawule nakabona bona waphumelela kanjani, wakhathazeka khulu ngaye.
Kodwana wonke amaSirayeli namadodana kaYuda ayemthanda uDavide, ngombana wayehamba nabo emidlalweni.

Wathi uSawule kuDavide, Thola lapha intombi yami enkulu, uMerabhi; ngizokuyinika wena ukuba ngumkakhe; kodwana ube ngumuntu onamandla khulu, uyeke ukunqoba imibhikisho kaYehova. USawule wathi, Ngingawukhuphula umlomo wami kuye; bakwenze amaFilisti.
Wathi uDavide kuSawule, Ngibani nami, nokuthi yini imindeni yami, noma inkosikazi yobaba wami eSirayeli, bona ngibe ngumkakhe wombuso?
Kwafika ke isikhathi sokuthi uMerabhi, intombi kaSawule, anikezelwe kuDavide; wafakwa njengowesifazane ku-Adriyeli waseMehola.
UMikhayeli, intombi kaSawule, wathanda uDavide; kwathi lapho kuthunyelwe khona uSawule, kwamangala.
Wathi uSawule, Ngizomunika yena, ukuze abe yintambo yakhe, begodu abaFilisti bagweme ukumbulala. Wathi uSawule kuDavide, Ngalokhu uzoba ngumngane wami wesifazane.
Wathi uSawule kubo abakhonzi bakhe, Nikhulume noDavide ngokufihlakeleyo, nithi, Thola bona ukumkani uthandana nawe, begodu bonke abakhonzi bakhe bakuthanda wena; namuhla ke ube ngumngane wakhe.
Wathi uDavide, Ingabe kuncane kuwe ukuba ube ngumngane womkakhe? Ngingumuntu ogama lingu-Abhisheki, begodu angikaze ngibhekwe. UDavide wathi kubo: Kunzima yini kuwe ukuba ngumngane womkakhe?
Bathi abakhonzi bakaSawule kuye amazwi kaDavide,

Waphendula uSawule, wathi: Uzothi kuDavide bona, "Ubukhosi abufunanga lutho ngaphandle kwempahla yomtshali-zimali, kodwana isikhumba esincane samaFilisti elinamakhulu amahlanu, ukuze agweme izimpi zakhe."
Bathi abakhonzi bakaDavide lokhu, wathanda uDavide ukuba abe ngumngane womkakhe; begodu ngaphambi kokuba amalanga ziphele,

Wathatha uDavide abantu bakhe, waphuma, wabulala amaFilisti amakhulu amabili, waveza isikhumba sabo esingenalutho, wababala bonke emkhosini, ukuze abe ngumngane wombuso. USawule wamnika intombi yakhe uMikhayeli ukuba ibe ngumfazi.
Wabona uSawule bona ikosi ube noDavide, begodu inkosikazi yakhe iMikhayeli ibithanda uDavide.
Waqala ukukhathazeka khulu ngoDavide, wahlala eyisitha sikaDavide kuze kube sekuphele impilo yakhe.
Baphuma abaphathi bamaFilisti emdlalweni; begodu lapho bephuma khona, uDavide waphumelela khulu ukudlula bonke abaholi bakaSawule; begodu igama lakhe laziwa khulu.
USawule wakhuluma noYonathani unyana wakhe, nabangane bakhe bonke, bona babulala uDavide; kodwana uYonatan unyana kaSawule wayethanda khulu uDavide.
Wathi kuDavide, "USawule ubaba wami ufuna ukukubulala; qaphela ngoMsombuluko, uye ezindaweni ezifihlakeleyo, uhlale khona.
Ngizophuma ngihlale nobaba wami ezweni lapho uzobe ukhona; ngizokhuluma naye ngawe, begodu uma ngibona okuthile, ngizokutshela.
UYonathani wakhuluma ngoDavide kuSawule ubaba wakhe, wathi kuye, Akufanele ukumkani akwenze kabi umkhonzi wakhe uDavide; ngombana akakwenzanga kahle kuwe, begodu enze izinto eziningi ezisiza wena.

Wabeka impilo yakhe engozini, wabulala uFilisti; begodu ikosi wenza ukusindisa okukhulu kiwo wonke amaSirayeli, nawe wawubona, waba mnandi. Ngabe ke wena ungenza kabi kumuntu ongenacala ofana noDavide, ukumbulala ngaphandle kwesizathu?
USawule walalela uYonathani, wathi, Kuphila ikosi bona uDavide ngeke abulawe.
UYonatan wabiza uDavide, wamtshela zonke izinto, wamletha kuSawule. Wasebenza uDavide kuSawule njengangaphambili.
Baphinde baqala ukulwa. UDavide waphuma, wabhekana nabaFilisti; wababulala ngokukhulu khulu, besuka phambi kwakhe.
Ke kaloku uMoya oyiNgcwele osuka kuYehova wafika kuSawule, lapho uhlala khona ekhaya lakhe, enesibhamu sakhe esandleni sakhe. UDavide wayedlala i-harp;
USawule wazama ukuwubopha edonga ngentambo yakhe, kodwana uDavide wehlulekile, intambo yakhe yafika edonga. Lo busuku uDavide wabaleka, waphuma.
USawule wathumela abantu endlwini kaDavide, ukuba balinde, ukuze bambulala ekuseni; kodwana uMikhayeli, indodana kaDavide, yathi kuye, Uma ungagcini ngempilo yakho namuhla, ngoMsombuluko uzofa.
Wathi uMikhayeli: "Lala ngezansi uDavide ngefasitela." UDavidu wabaleka, waphuma.
Wathi uMikhayeli, athathe i-teraphim, wayibeka phezu kwebhedu, yayigqoka ngendwangu, yafaka inwele yengulube emlonyeni.
Kwathi lapho uSawule ethumela abantu ukuba bathathe uDavide, uMikhayeli wathi, Unesifo.
USawule wathumela abantu ukuba babhekane noDavide, wathi: "Ninikele kuye embhedeni wakhe, ukuze ngiwususe."
Baye befika, babone bona itshe likhona embhedeni, nezinwele zengulube eduze kwekhanda.
Wathi uSawule ku-Mikhayeli, Kungani na ungenza lokhu ngami, washiya umnakwabo wami, waphuma? Yathi i-Mikhayeli kuye, Uthi kimi, Lahla, ngizokubulala yini wena?
UDavide wehla, waphuma, waya kuSamuweli eRama, wamtshela zonke izinto azenzayo uSawule kuye. Wahamba yena noSamuweli waya eNayiothi, bahlala khona.
Batshela uSawule, bathi, UDavide useNayothi eRama.

Wathumela abantu ukuba amthathe. Bathe babona ibandla lamaprofeti likhuluma ngezulu, noSamuweli uhlala phezulu phakathi kwabo; khona-ke uMoya kaThixo waba phezu kwamadodana kaSawule, nabo bathetha ngezulu.
Wathi uSawule, uma kwaziwa lokhu, wathumela abantu abaningi; bona nabo baprofetisa. USaule wathumela abantu besibili, bona nabo baprofeta.
Waphuma yena waya eRama, wafika esiqhingini esikhulu esiseSeku, wathi, Ngawaphi uSamuweli noDavide? Bathi kuye: ENayothi, eRama.
Wahamba uSawule waya eNayiothi, eRama. UMoya kaThixo wafika kuye, wahamba begodu, eprofetisa, kuze kwafika eNayiothi.
Wasusa izigqoko zakhe, waphuma ephupheni phambi kukaSamuweli; wahlala ephupheni ngalo lonke usuku nalolo busuku bonke; ngalokho kwathiwa, USawule naye ungumprofeti?
Waphuma uDavide eNayothi, eRama, waya kuYonathani, wathi kuye, Ngikwenze kuphi? Ngakwenza kuphi iphutha lami? Ngakwenza kuphi okumbi phambi kobaba wakho, bona afuna ukumibulala?
Wathi uYonathani, "Akekho! Awuzofa; cabanga bona ubaba wami akakwenzanga lutho olukhulu noma oluncane, ngaphandle kokungitshela. Ngabe ungazifihla yini lokhu kum? Akunaqiniso!"

Wathi uDavide: "Ubaba wakho uyazi kahle bona ungithanda, ngalokho wathi engqondweni yakhe: 'Akufanele uYonathani akwazi lokhu, ukuze angabi nobuhlungu.' Kodwana-ke, njengombana ikosi ephilayo, begodu wena uphilayo, ngizohlala nje inyawo elinye kude nokufa."
Wathi uYonatan kuDavide, Ngizokwenza wena konke okubona bona ngikwenze.
Wathi uDavide, Khangelani, kusasa kuzoba yinyanga entsha, lapho ngizodla khona ukudla nobukhosi; kodwana ngiya, ngizifihla ezweni kuze kube ngobusuku bosuku oluzayo.

Uma ubaba wakho engazi bona ngikhona, uzothi kuye, UDavide ungicela ngamandla ukuba ahambe ngokushesha eBethlehem, edolobhaneni lakhe; ngombana kukhona khona isibingelelo seminyaka yonke somndeni wakhe wonke.
Uma ethi, 'Kuhle khulu,' khona-ke ngiphephile. Kodwana uma elahlekelwa inhliziyo yakhe, ungaqinisekile bona uthathe isigqibo sokungasindisa.

Nakho ke wena, ngicela, ngenza ubuhle ngami; ngombana sekuyisikhathi engingakwenza khona umhlangano nami phambi koNkulunkulu. Uma ngabe kukhona okumbi engikwenzayo, bulala mina wena; kungani nanginikela kubaba wakho?
Wathi uJonathane, "Uma ngikwazi bona ubaba wami uthathe isigqibo sokukukhohlisa, angakutshela yini wena?"
Wathi uDavide, Ubani ozongitshela bona uma ubaba wakho ephendula ngokujulile?
Wathi uYonathani, Yeza, siphume ezweni. Baye khona ndawonye;

Wathi uYonathani kuDavide, Ngizobe ngikhuluma ngeNkosi, uzimu kaSirayeli, bona ngizokwazi ngaleso sikhathi, noma ngosuku olulandelayo, bona ubaba wami ucabangani; begodu uma ethandana nawe, ngeke yini ngithumele ngikutshele?
Uma ubaba wami efuna ukukwenza kahle kuwe, ikosi angikwenze lokhu nakunye, uma sengikungakuxwayisa bona ngizokushiya ungenawo umonakalo. UYehova abe nawe, njengokuba ube nobaba wami.
Uma ngiphila, bengibonise inhlonipho kaYehova, ukuze ngingeke ngibulawa.
Ngiyakucela begodu, ungagcini ngothando lwakho emndenini wami, kuze kube yilapho ikosi egqumeni zonke izitha zikaDavide phezu komhlaba.
Wakwenza uYonathani isivumelwano nendlu kaDavide, wathi, UYehova abhekane nabangane bakaDavide.
Wathi uYonatan kuDavide, Uzophinde ukwenze lokhu; ngombana wayemthanda uDavide njengothando lwakhe.
Wathi uYonatan kuDavide, NgoMsombuluko yinyanga entsha; begodu uzobiwa, ngombana isikhala sakho sizoba sithiwe.
Ngosuku olulandelayo, ngobusuku obungamashumi amabili, ukhambe uye endaweni ofihlakele kuyo lapho kwaqala khona lokhu okumbi, uhlale eduze kwengcindezi ebizwa bona yi-Ezel.
Ngizoshaya ama-arrows amathathu ngakwesobunxele kwalo, njengokuthi ngizoshaya eqenjini.

Ngizothumela umfana, ngitjho kuye, Iya, thola amabhodlela. Uma ngitjho kuye, Bona, amabhodlela akhona ngakwesobunxele kwakho, uzisa lapha; khona-ke uya; ngombana, njengombana uphila ikosi, awunankinga, akukho okumbi.
Uma ngitjho kulowo mfundi, Thola, amabhodlela angaphandle kwakho; khona-ke kufanele ukhambe, ngombana ikosi uyakushiya.
uzimu uzoba ngumshushisi phakathi kwami nawe, kuze kube sekupheleni kwezinsuku zokugcina.
Wayifihla uDavide ezweni. Kwafika usuku lwenyanga entsha, ukumkani wahlala ekudlaleni.
UDavide wahlala endaweni yakhe, ngasedonga, ebhekene noYonathani; begodu uAbheri wahlala eduze kukaSawule; kodwana indawo kaDavide yayingenalutho.
USawule akhenge akhulume ngalolu busuku; ngombana wathi, Kubekho okuthile okwenzekile kuDavide, ukuze ahlanzeke; ngokuqinisekile ungcolile.

Kwathi ngosuku olulandelayo, ngomhla wesithathu wenyanga, lapho indawo kaDavide ingekho khona, uSawule wathi kuYonathani unyana wakhe, Kungani na bona unyana kaYese afike emdlalweni, noma namhlanje noma kusasa?
Waphendula uYonathani, wathi, UDavide wawungicela bona amvumele ahambe eBhetheleyimu.

Wathi, Ngicela, ngiya; ngombana imindeni yethu ingumnikelo wokudla edolobhaneni, begodu udadewethu ungitshela bona ngizofika. Uma ungumngane wami, vumelani ngiye ngibone udadewethu; ngalokho-ke akaze afike embhedeni kabukhosi.

USawule waphoqa uJonathane, wathi kuye: "Umuntu othandekako, indodakazi yowesifazane okhohlakelayo; angazi yini bona uthathe isandla somntwana kaYese, ukuze kube yingozi kuwe, begodu ibe yingozi nomzali wakho owakuzala?
Ngaso soke isikhathi lapho unyana kaYese ephila khona emhlabeni, wena nobukhosi bakho ngeke nihlale; thumela ke manje, nimwise lapha kimi, ngombana kumele aphile.
Wathi uJonathane kubaba wakhe, Ingabe kufanele abulawe? Ukwenze kuphi?
Wathi uSawule wamshaya ngentambo, ukuze ambulala. Waqonda uYonathani bona ubaba wakhe wabeka isinqumo sokubulala uDavide.
UYonathani wavuka embhedeni, ekhala khulu. Ngosuku lwesithathu lwesikhumbuzo, akayidla ukudla; ngombana wayekhathazekile ngenxa yokuthi ubaba wakhe ubemkhohlisa uDavide.
Kwathi ekuseni kwafika uYonatan, waphuma waya ezweni ukubhekana noDavide, ngesikhathi esibekiwe; wayenendodakazi encane naye.
Wathi kulowo mfundi, Yiya, thola amagobolondo ami; begodu lapho lo mfundi ehamba khona, uYonathani washaya amagobolondo akhe.
Wafika lo mfundi ezweni lapho umcibisholo ka-Yonatan waphuma khona, u-Yonatan wathi ngemuva kwakhe, Uthi, Ingabe umcibisholo awukho eduze kwakho?
Wathi, Yiya ngokushesha! Musa ukuyeka! Wathatha lo mfundi umcibisholo, wabuyela kumnikazi wakhe.
Lo mntwana awazi lutho ngalokhu konke. UJonathan noDavid kuphela abawaziyo.
Wathi uYonathani, wanikela isibhamu sakhe kulowo mfundi, wathi, Yiya, uyithule edolobhaneni.

UDavide wavuka enyakatho-ntshonalanga yodonga, wehla phambi kukaYonathani izikhathi amathathu, ubuso bakhe bubheke phasi. Baphoqeleka ukuba bathandene, balele ndawonye; kodwana uDavide wayelile khulu.

Wathi uYonathani kuDavide, Yiya ngokuthula; thina nawe siphike ngegama likaYehova, sathi, UYehova ube ngumshayeli phakathi kwami nenu, phakathi kwezingane zakho nezingane zami kuze kube sekupheleni. Waphuma uDavide, wabuyela uYonathani edolobhaneni.
Wafika uDavide eNobi ku-Akhimeleki umpristi. U-Akhimeleki, lapho ehlangana naye, wakhathazeka khulu, wathi kuye, Yini na bona uhamba wena kuphela? Ingabe akukho muntu okunye nawe?

Waphendula uDavide, wathi ku-Akhimeleki umpristi: "Umkakhe wathumela ngami, wathi kimi: 'Kungeke umuntu akwazi lutho ngento engikulethela yona, noma ngomsebenzi wami.' Kwathi abantu bami, ngibatshela bona bangangibona lapho.
Begodu manje, yini ongayithola lapha? Nceda ungisize izinkomishi eziyisishiyagalombili zokudla, noma okuthile ongakuthola.
Waphendula umbingeleli uDavide, wathi, Akukho ukudla okujwayelekile lapha kimi; kodwana kukhona ukudla okungcwele, uma nje abantu bengeke bahlangane nabesifazane.

UDavide waphendula wathi, "Yebo, izingane zabesifazane zigcinwe ngaphandle kwethu, njengombana ngihlala njalo lapho ngihamba khona. Izimbambo zabantu zingcwele, ngisho nalapho besebenza khona; begodu namuhla! "
Wathi umbingeleli wamnika ukudla okungcwele; ngombana kwakungekho ukudla khona ngaphandle kokudla okuvela esidlangalaleni, okwenziwe phambi kukaYehova, emini lapho kwafakwa khona ukudla okusha.
Kwabe kukhona khona umuntu owodwa wabakhonzi bakaShawule ngalolu busuku, uhlala khona phambi koYehova, uDoegeki waseEdomu, owayengumphathi wezimvu zikaShawule.
Wathi uDavide ku-Akhimeleki, Ingabe unayo lapha isibhamu noma ikhebula? Ngingakaze ngithathe ikhebula lami noma iyiphi enye into; ngombana umsebenzi wokumkani wawunzima.

Wathi umbingeleli, Ikhebula likaGoliathi umFilisti, owawubulala emfuleni i-Ela, likhona, lingene enkingeni engezansi kwe-ephodi; uma ufuna ukuyithatha, uyithathe; ngombana ayikho enye ikhebula laphaya. UDavide wathi, Akunalutho olufana nalo; ngiyinike.
UDavide wehla ngalolu busuku esuka kuSawule, waya ku-Akishi ukumkani waseGathi.
Bathi ke abakhonzi baka-Akishi kuye, UDavide, ukumkani waleli lizwe, akawubani na lowo okhuluma ngaye emidlalweni sabo, besithi, USawule wabulala amawaka akhe, noDavide amashumi amane amawaka akhe?
Wabeka uDavide la mazwi enhliziyweni yakhe, wakhathazeka khulu ngenxa ka-Akishi ukumkani waseGathi.
Wathi, "Ngalokho-ke, ngicabanga bona uSathane ungumuntu okhohlakeleyo," begodu, lapho uhlala nabo, waqala ukudweba emaphethelweni omgwaqo, begodu, ngaleso sikhathi, imilenze yakhe yaqala ukuphuma.
Wathi u-Akishi kubo bonke abakhonzi bakhe, Babone lo muntu; kubonakala sengathi unengqondo ephindwe kathathu. Kungani na bona nimuveze kuye?
Ingabe bengingeke ngithole abantu abakhohlakelayo, ukuze nifikeni nalowo muntu lapha, ukuba abe ngumuntu okhohlakeleyo phambi kwami? Uzofika yini lo muntu ekhaya lami?"
UDavide waphuma eGathi, waya emgodini ka-Adulam. Bakwazi lokhu abazalwane bakhe, nendlu yobaba wakhe, babuyela kuye khona.
Bahlangana naye bonke labo abasengozini, nalabo abanemali eningi, nalabo abanganeliseki; waba nguMengameli wabo. Kwabe kukhona nabantu abangumakhulu amane naye.
Waphuma khona uDavide waya eMizpa yamaMowabi, wathi ukumkani wamaMowabi, Ngicela ngivumele ubaba wami nomama wami ukuba bahlale nani, kuze ngibone bona uzimu uzongikwenzani.
Wabathumela kuye ukumkani wakwaMowabi; bahlala naye yonke imihla kaDavide esitezi esiphakeme.
Wathi uGadi umprofeti kuDavide, Ungahlalanga kule ndawo ephephile; buyela ezweni laseYuda. UDavide waphuma, waya emfuleni i-Hereth.

USawule wafumana bona uDavide namadodana akhe batholakala. USawule wayehlala phasi ngaphasi kwesihlahla sika-Tamari, eGibeha; umqhele wakhe ubesesandlani sakhe, begodu bonke abakhonzi bakhe babebhekene naye.
Wathi kubo uSawule, "Nikhulume, nimadodana kaBhenjamini! Ingabe yena unyana kaYese uzoninika imifula nemivini? Ingabe uzokwenza ningabaphathi bamakhulu nabangamakhulu?

Ngalokho-ke, yini na le nto eninikele ngayo bonke abaphikisayo ngami? Uma unyana wami eyenza isivumelwano noyise kaYese, angeke kube khona umuntu ongitshela yona. Akukho muntu phakathi kwenu ozongitshela bona unyana wami ukhiphe umkhonzi wami, ukuze abambe iqhaza kum, njengamanje.
Waphendula uDogeki, umEdomi, ohlala emehlweni amaphoyisa kaSawule, wathi, Ngibone indodana kaYese ifika eNobi ku-Ahileleki unyana ka-Ahitubhi.
U-Akhimeleki wabuza ikosi bona angakwenzani uDavide; begodu u-Akhimeleki wamnika ukudla, nokhephe likaGoliyati umFilisti.
Wathumela ukumkani, wabiza u-Akhimeleki unyana ka-Ahitubhi, umpristi, nomndeni wakhe wonke, ababingeleli baseNobi. Bafika bonke kubo ukumkani;
Wathi uSawule, Ngisho namuhla, wena unyana ka-Ahitubhi. Waphendula wathi, Kulungile, mphathi wami.

Wathi uSawule kuye, Kungani nakuthi niphike ngami, wena noyise kaYeshaya, bona unikeze ukudla nekhebula, begodu unqume uzimu ukuba amsize, ukuze ashintshe ngimi, abe ngumbukeli wami, njengokuba namuhla?
Waphendula u-Akhimeleki ukumkani, wathi, Ngabo bonke abakhonzi bakho, ngubani othembekile njengaye uDavide? Uyinkosikazi yokumkani, nomkhuluwa wakho, nodume khulu ekhaya lakho.
Ngabe ngaqala ngicela usizo kuThixo ngenxa yakhe? Akunjalo, ngiyakucela, ungabi necala kumkhonzi wakho, noma kinanyana ubani emndenini wami; ngombana umkhonzi wakho awazi lutho ngalolu daba lonke.
Wathi ukumkani, Uzofa ngokuqinisekile, u-Ahileleki, wena nomndeni wonke kababa wakho.

Wathi ukumkani kilabo ababhekene naye, "Bukelani, bulala ababhishobhi bakaYehova; ngombana nabo bathathe isandla sikaDavide. Bathe bazi bona uDavidu uyahamba, kodwana bengingabatshelanga." Kodwana abakhonzi bakakumkani abazange baphakamise izandla zabo ukuwahlasela amabhishobhi kaYehova.
Wathi ukumkani kuDoge, Ubuye, uhlasele abapristi. Wabuya ke uDoge, umEdomu, wahlasela, wababulala abantu abangumashumi asibhozo anesihlanu abagqoka i-ephod yelinen ngalolusuku.
Wahlasela begodu iNobe, umzi wamabhishobhi, ngeqhwa, wabulala amadoda namadodakazi, namantombazane nabantwana abancane, namabhokhwe, namabhubesi, namakhowe.
Nokho uAbhiyathari, indodana ka-Ahileleki, intombi ka-Ahitubhi, waphuma, waya kuDavide.
Watshela uDavide bona uSawule wabulala ababhishobhi bakaYehova.
Wathi uDavide ku-Abhiyathari, Ngazi ngalolu busuku, lapho uDogeki umEdomu ekhona khona, bona ngokuqinisekile uzotshela uSawule; ngiyingozi yomndeni wonke kababa wakho.
Uzohlala nami, begodu ungakhathazeki; umuntu ofuna ukukubulala ufuna nokufa kwami, ngalokho uzobe uphephile ngami.
Batshela uDavide, bathi, Bheka, abaFilisti bahlasela iKeyila, bese bethatha izithelo ezindaweni zokudlidliza.
UDavide wabuza ikosi, esithi, Ngizoya ngihlasela labo Bafilisti? Waphendula ikosi wathi kuye, Iya, uhlasele labo Bafilisti, usindise iKehila.
Bathi abantu bakaDavide kuye, Siyaxolisa lapha eYuda; kuphi na uma siye eKeyila ukubhekana nomndeni wamaFilisti?
UDavide wabuza ikosi begodu. Waphendula ikosi wathi kuye, Yiya eKeyila; ngombana ngizobeka amaFilisti esandleni sakho.
Wahamba uDavide namadodana akhe waya eKeyila, wabhekana nabaFilisti, wathatha izilwane zabo, wababulala ngokubulala okukhulu. UDavide wakhulula abantu baseKeyila.
UAbhiyathari unyana ka-Ahileleki waya kuDavide eKeyila, wathatha i-ephodi emlenzeni wakhe.
Batshela uSawule bona uDavide waya eKeyila, wathi, uzimu unginikela enhliziyweni yami; ngombana uDavide wabeka isandla sakhe emlonyeni wakhe, afike emzini onezindonga nezintambo.
USawule waqoqa wonke amakhosi akhe emdlalweni, ukuba afike eKeyila, abambe uDavide namadodana akhe.
UDavide, ekwazi bona uSawule unquma okumbi kuye, wathi kuAbhiyathari ukumkani, Thola le-ephodi.
Wathi uDavide, Kosi, uzimu kaSirayeli, umkhonzi wakho ubone ngokucacile bona uSawule unquma ukuya eKeyila, ukuze asuse lo mzi ngenxa yami.
Ingabe abaphathi baseKeyila bazonginikela kuye? Ingabe uSawule uzowela, njengombana ngikutshele umkhonzi wakho? uzimu kaSirayeli, Kosi, sicela usixhumane nomkhonzi wakho. Wathi ikosi, Uzowela.
Wathi uDavide, Ingabe abaphathi baseKeyila bazongidlulisa mina namadodana ami kuSawule? UYehova wathi, Bazo.
UDavide waphuma eKeyila, yena namadodana akhe, angaphezu kwamakhulu amane; bahamba besuka endaweni kuye endaweni. Batshela uSawule bona uDavide usanda kuphuma eKeyila, kodwana akayeki ukuya khona.
Wahlala uDavide ezindaweni eziqinile zesihlabathi, nasezintaba-mlilo zesihlabathi saseZiphu. USawule wafuna uDavide ngosuku ngalunye; kodwana uzimu akhenge amnike uDavide esandleni sakhe.
UDavide wafunda bona uSawule waya eHoreshi, emfuleni i-Zipho, ukuze agweme ukumbulala.
UYonatan unyana kaSawule waya kuDavide e-Horesh, wamsiza bona athole amandla kuThixo.

Wathi kuye, Musa ukukhathazeka; ngombana uSawule ubaba wami ngeke abeke isandla sakhe phezu kwakho; wena uzobe ungummelwane wakwaSirayeli, nami ngizoba wesithathu kuwe; begodu noSawule ubaba wami naye uyazi.
Bakwenza umnikelo wokudla bobabili phambi koYehova. UYonathan wabuyela ekhaya lakhe, kodwana uDavide wayehlala eHoresh.
Baya kuSawule eGibeha abantu baseZifi, bathi, UDavide akasekho lapha nathi, ezindaweni eziqinile, eHoresh, emfuleni iHakila, osentshonalanga yeJeshimoni?
Manje, Kosi yakho, zulazula lapho uthanda khona, begodu sizokwazi ukumnika kumkakhe."
Wathi uSawule, UYehova akubabale wena ngenxa yobulungisa obungibonisile.
Iya thola ulwazi oluningi. Thola lapho uDavid ehamba khona begodu ngubani owamubona khona. Kuthelelwe bona unenkani khulu.

Ngizohamba nawe. Uma ekhona kulo mhlaba, ngizomuthola phakathi kwezizwe zonke zakwaYuda; begodu uma ekhona lapho, ngizohamba naye. Uma ekhona kulo mhlaba, ngizomuthola phakathi kwezizwe zonke zakwaYuda.
Basuka ke, bafika eZifi phambi kukaSawule; uDavide namadodana akhe babe esiqhingini sama-Mahoni, ezindaweni ezibandayo ezisenyakatho yeJeshimon.
USawule namadodana akhe baqala ukubuza. Bathi kubo uDavide, waphuma waya eqhingini, wahlala esiqhingini iMahoni. USawule akubona lokhu, wafika esiqhingini iMahoni, efuna uDavide.

USawule wayehamba ngaphesheya komfula, uDavide namadodana akhe behamba ngaphesheya komfula, behamba ngejubane, befuna ukuyeka uSawule. Nokho uSawule nendodana yakhe babebhekene noDavide namadodana akhe, befuna ukubabamba.
Kwafika umthunywa kuSawule, ethi, Yiya ngokushesha; ngombana amaFilisti aphikisa izwe.
USawule wayeka ukulandela uDavide, waya ehlasela amaFilisti; ngalokho kwabizwa igama lesi sifundazwe bona iSela-hamahlekhothi.
Waphuma khona uDavide, wahlala ezindaweni eziqinile zase-Engedi.
Kwathi lapho uSawule ebuya enqoleni amaFilisti, kwathunyelwe bona, UDavide usemgwaqweni ka-Engedi.
Wathatha uSawule abantu abangumakhulu amathathu, abakhethiwe phakathi kwamadodana kaSirayeli wonke, waphuma efuna uDavide namadodana akhe ezindaweni eziphakade zezinkomo.
Wafika ezindaweni zokugcina izinkomo ezisendlela, lapho bekukhona khona intaba. USawule waphuma khona ukuze aphumule; kodwana uDavide namadodana akhe babe eduze kwengubo.

Bathi abantu bakaDavide, Lokho wusuku ikosi ekhuluma ngalo kuwe, ethi, Ngizowunikela umnakwabo esandleni sakho, ukwenze konke okubukeka kukuhle engqondweni yakho. UDavidu wehla ngaso soke isikhathi, wamisa isibambo sikaSawule.
Kusukela lapho uDavide wacabanga bona unecala, ngenxa yokuthi wasusa isibambo sebhande likaSawule.
Wathi kubo abantu bakhe, uzimu angeke angivumele bona ngikwenze lokhu kunkosi yami, ukumkani okhethiwe nguYehova, bona ngibeke isandla sami phezu kwakhe; ngombana yena ungumkhonzi kaThixo.
UDavide wavimbela abantu bakhe ngamazwi anjalo, ukuze bangabi nethuba lokulwa noSawule. Waphuma ke uSawule emgodini, waya ezweni lakhe.
UDavide waphuma emgodini, wayalela uSawule, wathi, "Mphathi wami, ukumkani!" USawule ebheka emuva kwakhe, uDavide wehla ngobuso bakhe phasi.
Wathi uDavide kuSawule, Kungani na bona ulalele abantu bekhuluma bona, UDavide ufuna ukukwenza ububi?

Ubone ngamehlo akho ngalolu busuku, bona ikosi wakulethela esandla sami kulo mfula; begodu kwathiwa, Ngizokubulala; kodwana ngikuxosha, ngitjho, Angeke ngibeke isandla sami kunkosi yami, ngombana ungumkhonzi kaYehova.

Ubaba, bheka, ubone lesi sigqoko sakho esandla sami; ngikucishe isibambo sesigqoko sakho, kodwana angikufani wena. Manje ke, qaphela begodu ubone bona asikubi ngami ukukwenza okumbi, noma ukwephula umthetho; angikwenzeli nakanjani iphutha kuwe, kodwana wena ungifuna ukuze uthathe impilo yami.
UYehova agweme phakathi kwami nawe, begodu ikosi akubuyisele wena isono sakho esingikwenzele; kodwana isandla sami ngeke sikuthathe.
Ngokungafani nezwi elidala, lithi: Kilabo abakwenzayo okumbi, kuvela izinto ezibi; ngalokho isandla sami ngeke sikuthathe.
Ngawuphi umuntu ophumayo ukumkani wakwaSirayeli? Ngawuphi umuntu oyilandelayo? Ingabe yinja efile, noma inkomo?
UYehova abe ngummeli wethu, athathe isigqibo phakathi kwethu; abhekane necala lami, anikeze intshisekelo yami, amsindise esandla sakho.
