Waphela uDavide ekhuluma amazwi lawa, wathi uSawule, Yizwi lakho yini leli, udadewethu uDavide? Wavuya ngezwi elikhulu.
Wathi, "Uyimuntu olungile kunami. Ungiphatha kahle, kodwana mina ngikuphatha kabi; begodu bengikwenza okumbi kuwe.
Begodu manje ukhuluma ngalokho okuhle okwenze kimi, bona ikosi unginikela esandla sakho; kodwana wena awungibulala.
Uma umuntu ethola umshayeli wakhe, angawushiya yini ahambe ngaphandle kokulimala? UYehova akukhokhele kahle, njengombana ukwenze kuye namuhla.
Ngiyazi bona uzoba ngukumkani, begodu ukumkani wakwaSirayeli uzobe uqinile esandla sakho.
Manje ke, ngikutshele ngeNkosi bona awuzoyibulala imbewu yami, begodu awuzoyisusa igama lami emndenini wakwababa wami.
USawule wabuyela ekhaya lakhe, uDavide namadodana akhe benyuka bafike ezindaweni eziqinile.
Wafa uSamuweli, bahlangana bonke isiSirayeli, bamlingisa, wabulawa eRama. UDavide wehla ezweni laseParan.
Kwabe kukhona umuntu othile eMaoni, owayenempahla yakhe eKarmeli; waba mkhulu khulu, begodu wayenazo izinkomo ezingu-1, nezimvu ezingu-3. Waqala ke ukusika izingulube zakhe eKarmeli.

Igama lakhe nguNabhali, igama lenkosikazi yakhe uAbhigayeli. Wayewesifazane onolwazi begodu obukeka kahle; kodwana indodana yakhe yayimnyama khulu, ibe yindoda engathandeki ekwenzeni izinto zakhe. Wabe ngumngane kaKhalebe.
UDavide wayesele esiqhingini, lapho wafumana khona bona uNabhali ugeza izimvu zakhe.
Wathumela amadoda amakhulu alishumi, wathi kubo: "Niya kuNabali eKarmeli, nimtshele bona uphile kanjani.
Nithi kuye, Uphile isikhathi eside; ukuthula nokuphila okuhle kuwe, nendlu yakho, nalabo bonke abakho.
Ngikutshele bona manje yisikhathi sokuzisusa izinkomo; begodu labo ababusi bakho babe nathi, asibabi nalutho, begodu akukho lutho lwabo olulahlekile zonke amalanga ababeseKarmeli.

Ngiyacela ubuze abakhonzi bakho, bazokutshela. Ngalokho-ke, ngiyakucela, ube nomhlomulo kilabo abangani bam, ngombana sifike ngesikhathi esimnandi sokudla; ngikucela, uma kukhona okusele kuwe, uyinike abakhonzi bakho, noDavide unyana wakho.
Bafika abantu bakaDavide, bakhuluma kuNabhali ngegama likaDavide, bathi: "Njengombana uNabhali ethandana nathi, sizohlala naye.
Waphendula uNabhali, wathi kubo abakhonzi bakaDavide: Ubani loDavide? Ubani lowo mntwana kaYese? Baningi abakhonzi abaphuma emzini womnikazi wabo namuhla.
Ngizothatha yini ubisi lwami, namanzi ami, nenyama yami engiyisilele labo banganquma izingulube zami, ngiyinike abantu abavela lapho awaziyo?
Basuka abantu bakaDavide, babuyela emuva; bafika, baveza kuye zonke lezi zinto.

Wathi uDavide kubo bonke abantu bakhe, "Ungigqoke wonke umuntu ikhebula lakhe." Bayigqoke, begodu uDavide wagqoka ikhebula lakhe. Kwafika noDavide amadoda angamakhulu amane, kanti amadoda angumakhulu amabili ahlala nempahla.
Wathi omunye wabangani bakhe ku-Abhigayeli, indodana kaNabhali, wathi, UDavide wathumela abathunywa ezweni laseGibhithe, bona baphilele umnikazi wethu; kodwana yena wabaphuca.
Naphezu kwalokho, labo bantu babenabantu abathandekayo khulu kuthi; asikubize ngalutho; begodu ngesikhathi soke esihlala khona ezindaweni eziphakathi kwabo, akukho okulahlekile.
Ubusuku nemini babe njengedonga elibhekena nathi ngesikhathi soke sibheka izinkomo zethu ezindaweni zazo.
Manje ke, cabanga, ubone bona uzokwenza yini; ngombana iphutha lizofika kumnikazi wethu nomndeni wakhe wonke; naye ungumuntu omnyama khulu, angeke kube khona umuntu ongakhuluma naye.

U-Abhigayeli washesha, wathatha amakhowe angumakhulu amabili, namabhodlela amane ewayini, nezimbuzi eziyisishiyagalombili ezilungiselelwe ukudla, nebhokisi elikhulu lezithelo ezithosiwe, namahhashi ayizinkulungwane, namahhashi ayizinkulungwane ezimbili. Wazifaka phezu kwezigubhu.
Wathi kubo abakhonzi bakhe, Yiya ngaphambilini; ngizolandela. Kodwana uNabhali, indodana yakhe, akhenge ayitshele.
Wayehamba, ehamba phezu kwebhuza lakhe, ehla emfuleni womfula, lapho uDavide namadodana akhe bewela khona kuye; wahlangana nabo.

Wathi uDavide, Kwangaba wusizo yini bona ngazigcina zonke izinto zalowo muntu esiqhingini, ukuze kungabikho lutho olulahlekile phakathi kwazo zonke izinto zakhe? Ungibuyisele umonakalo endaweni yempilo.
U-Alla angeke angigweme, uma ekuseni ngishiya nomfazi owodwa ophilayo phakathi kwabo bonke abakhona kuye!
U-Abhigayeli, lapho nakabona khona uDavide, wehlisa isikelemu sakhe ngokushesha, wabhujiswa phambi kwakhe ngobuso bakhe phasi.
Wathi, Ngicela, Kosi yami, ngivumele umkhonzi wakho bona akhulume nawe; ulalele izwi lomkhonzi wakho; ngizobe senginjalo nje kuphela.

Ngicela, kosi yami, ungeke unqume ngoNabhali, lowo muntu ongalungile; ngombana igama lakhe lifana naye. Igama lakhe lisho bona: Ukhohlakeleyo, begodu ukhohlakelelo luhamba naye. Ngami, umkhonzi wakho, angikaze ngibone labo abathunyelwe ngunkosi yami.

Ngokuba manje, kosi yami, njengokuphila kukaYehova uzimu wakho, nokuphila kwakho wena, bona ikosi ukuvimbele bona ungabulalanga, noma ukuba nesandla sakho sokwenza umonakalo; bangabe njengawe-Nabali izitha zakho, nalabo bonke abafuna ukulimala unkosi wami.
Le sipho, engumkhonzi wakho engikulethela umphathi wami, sinikezwe abantu abalandelana nawe.

Ngiyakucela, usindise inkohliso yomkhonzi wakho. uzimu uzonikeza umphathi wami indlu yobukhosi uhlala isikhathi eside, ngombana ubhekana nemibhikisho kaYehova; ngeke kube khona into engalungile kuwe yonke imihla yakho.

Uma umuntu efuna ukukuhlasela, ukuze athathe impilo yakho, inhliziyo yakho izoboshwa ngokuphephile emgodini walabo abaphilayo kuYehova uzimu wakho; kodwana inhliziyo yababi bakho uzoyiphonsa ngaphandle, njengetshe elifihliwe ngebhodlela.
Uma ikosi ekwenzele umnikazi wami konke okumbi akutjhoko, begodu ekwenza ube ngukumkani phezu kwaSirayeli,
ungeke ube nomthwalo onzima engqondweni yakho, uma ubulala ngaphandle kwesizathu, noma uma unquma wena ngokwakho; begodu uma ikosi ekwenza kahle umnikazi wami, khumbula umkhonzi wakho.
Wathi uDavide ku-Abhigayeli, Kuhloswe ikosi, uzimu kaSirayeli, owakuthumelela namuhla ukungihlangana.
Ngiyabonga ngengqondo yakho ehlelekile, begodu ngenxa yokuthi ungenza ngigweme namhlanje ukubulawa nokuthatha inkohliso ngezandla zam.

Ngokuba uphila ikosi, uzimu kaSirayeli, owandisela ukuba ngikwenze lutho olubi kuwe, bona uma ungasekholele ukungibhekana nami, khona-ke kuNabali kwakungeke kube khona umuntu umfazi kuze kube ngusuku.
Wathi uDavide, athathe esandlani sakhe lokho ayekulethelayo, wathi, Yiya ekhaya lakho ngokuthula; ngikutholele amazwi akho, begodu ngikusize.

Wafika u-Abhigayeli kuNabhali, begodu ngabona bona uNabhali usendlini elungiselela isidlo sakusihlwa, njengesidlo sikakumkani; begodu u-Abhigayeli wayesemqoka khulu emlonyeni wakhe, begodu wayesele khulu. U-Abhigayeli akakwazanga ukumtshela lutho kuze kube ngobusuku.
Kwathi safika isihlwa, lapho uNabhali ephuzile khona, indodana yakhe yaveza kuye zonke lezi zinto; begodu inhliziyweni yakhe yaphuma kuye, waba njengetshe.
Ngosuku oluyishumi, ikosi wabulala uNabhali, wayafa.

UDavide waqonda bona uNabhali usefile, wathi, Kuhloswe ikosi, owenza isinqumo sami ngaye uNabhali, lapho engikhohlisa khona; wavimbela umkhonzi wakhe ukuba akwenze lutho olubi, wabuyisela isinqumo sikaNabhali ekhanda lakhe. Wathumela uDavide ku-Abhigayeli, athi: Yiba indodana yami.
Bafika abakhonzi bakhe eKarmeli, bakhuluma ku-Abhigayeli, bathi, UDavide usithumelele kuwe, ukuze akuthathe wena ube ngumkakhe.
Uthe yena, ekhonze ubuso bakhe phasi ezweni, wathi, "Njengombana ngiyindodakazi yakho, ngizosebenza kuwe, ukuze ngihlanze izinyawo zabangani bakho, kosi yami."
U-Abhigayeli wehlisa isikelemu, wahamba namadodakazi akhe amahlanu, walandela abathunywa bakaDavide, waba ngumkakhe.
UDavide washada no-Ahinoamu waseJezreyeli; babe ngababhishobhi bakhe.
USawule wanikela intombi yakhe uMikhayeli, indodana kaDavide, kuPalethiyeli unyana kaLayisi waseGalli.
Bafika amaZiphethi kuSawule eGibeha, besithi, UDavide akasekho enhliziyweni yeHakila, ebhekene neJeshimoni?
Waphuma uSawule, naye namakhulu amathathu amakhosikazi aseSirayeli akhethiwe, waya esiqhingi sase-Ziphu, ukuyofuna uDavide.
USawule wamisa isikhashana engxenyeni yendlela, enhliziyweni yaseHakila, ebhekene neJeshimoni; uDavide ke wayehlala esiqhingini. Wabona bona uSawule usemva kwakhe,
wathumela abaphenyi begodu wafunda bona uSaule wayeqiniseke kufike.

UDavide wavuka, waya endaweni lapho uShawule uhlala khona. Wabona indawo lapho uShawule no-Abneri, unyana kaNeri, umphathi wesibhakabhaka, belala khona; begodu uShawule wayelele esibhedlela, begodu abantu bakhe babehlala phezu kwakhe.
Wathi uDavide ku-Akhimeleki umHeti, no-Abishai unyana kaZeruya, udadewabo uYowabhi, esithi, Ubani ozohamba nami ekamelweni likaSawule? Wathi u-Abishai, Ngiya nawe.

UDavide no-Abhishai bafika emgwaqeni ngobusuku, begodu bebona bona uSawule uhlala embhedeni ekamelweni lakhe lokuphumula; isibhamu sakhe sisemqoka endaweni yakhe yokuphumula. U-Abneri namadoda amakhulu ayelala ngaphesheya kwakhe.
Wathi u-Abhishai kuDavide, uzimu usewunikela namuhla umshayeli wakho esandla sakho; manje ke ngizowushaya phasi ngonyawo olulodwa lwesibhakabhaka, angikwazi ukuwushaya kambili.
Wathi uDavide ku-Abhishai, Musa ukumbulala; ngubani ongeke afake isandla sakhe emthethweni kaYehova, angabi necala?
Wathi yena, Uphila ikosi bona ikosi ngokwakhe uzomushaya; noma amalanga zakhe zizofika, aze aphele, noma uzoya emdlalweni, aze abulawa.
uzimu angeke angivumele bona ngibeke isandla sami kulowo owaphambukile ikosi; thola manje isibhamu, nebhodlela lamanzi elikhona ekhanda lakhe, sihambe.
Wathi uDavide, wathatha isibhamu, nebhodlela lamanzi, embhedeni kaSawule, basuka. Akukho muntu okubonayo, noma owaziyo, noma ovukayo; bonke bephumula, ngombana ikosi wababeka embhedeni omkhulu.
Wadlula uDavide ngaphesheya, wahlala phezulu emfuleni, enyakatho-ntshonalanga; kwaba khona indawo enkulu phakathi kwabo.
Wabiza iqembu, no-Abneri unyana ka-Nere, wathi, "U-Abneri, awaziphenduli yini?" U-Abneri waphendula wathi, "Ngubani wena okhuluma nomkakhe?"
Wathi uDavide, Uwesifazane wena, akunjalo? Ngabe kukhona ofana nawe eSirayeli? Kungani na bona ungagcini umkakhe ukumkani wakho? Kuye kwafika umuntu ukuwubulala umkakhe ukumkani.

Lolu msebenzi owenzayo awulungile. Ngokuba uphila ikosi, wena namadodana akho niyindoda efanele ukufa, ngenxa yokuthi ningagcini umphathi wenu, owaphathwe nguzimu. Khangelani, yini lapho isibhamu sikakumkani, nokuthi yikuphi ibhodlela lamanzi elalingaphansi kwekhanda lakhe?
Wazi uSawule ingoma kaDavide, wathi, Ingabe leyo ingoma yakho, udadewethu uDavide? UDavide waphendula wathi, Yiqiniso, Kosi yami ukumkani.
Wathi, Yini na bona unkosi wami alandele umkhonzi wakhe? Ngikwenzeni kuphi, noma yini engiyenzayo?

Ngiyacela bona umnikazi wami, ukumkani, alalele amazwi womkhonzi wakhe. Uma ikosi esekukhathele wena ngami, khona-ke athathe isiphuzo; kodwana uma abantu bekwenze lokhu, bangalahlwa phambi kukaYehova; ngombana manje bamisusa engxenyeni yami yezwe likaYehova, bathi, Iya, ukhonza izitha zabanye.

Ngokuba namuhla, akufanele igazi lami lihlabele phasi ezindaweni ezingaphandle kobuso bukaYehova; ngombana ukumkani wakwaSirayeli uphuma efuna inkosikazi eyodwa, njengokuthi umuntu efuna isibhakabhaka esincane emadolobheni.
Wathi uSawule, Ngibizile; buyela, udadewethu uDavide. Ngokuba inhliziyo yami namuhla ibiyingozi kuwe, ngeke ngiphinde ngikukhohlise begodu; ngombana ngangikwenze kabi khulu, begodu ngangibekezela.
Wathi uDavide, Bheka lapha isibhamu sokumkani; kufanele afike omunye wamadodakazi akho, ayithathe.
uzimu ukhokhela wonke umuntu ngomsebenzi wakhe olungile, nokholo lwakhe. UYehova wakunika isandla sami namuhla; kodwana angikaze ngibeke izandla zami kulowo owaphambukile ikosi.
Ngokungafani nempilo yakho ngiyibeke namuhla enhliziyweni yami, ngaleyo le ikosi anikeze impilo yami inhliziyweni yakhe, angisindise ekuphileni konke.
Wathi uSawule kuDavide, Ubabaleke wena, udadewethu uDavide; uzokwenza izinto ezinkulu, begodu uzophumelela. Wahamba ke uDavide indlela yakhe, wabuyela uSawule ezweni lakhe.

Wathi uDavide engqondweni yakhe, Ngizobulawa nguSawule ngosuku oluthile lwalezi zinsuku. Kungcono bona ngihambe ngiye ezweni lamaFilisti; khona-ke uSawule uzoyeka ukungifuna ngaso soke isizwe samaSirayeli, begodu ngizophuma enhliziyweni yakhe.
Wahamba uDavide, namadoda angumakhulu amathandathu aye naye, waya ku-Akishi unyana kaMahoki, ukumkani waseGathi.
Wahlala uDavide nomadodana akhe eGathi ku-Akishi, wonke umuntu nabangane bakhe naye; begodu uDavide nabesifazane bakhe ababini: u-Ahinoamu waseJezreyeli, no-Abigayili umfazi kaNabali waseKarmeli.
Bathi kubo uSawule, bona uDavide ukhambe waya eGathi; wayeka ukumdinga.
Wathi uDavide ku-Akishi, Uma ngithole inhlonipho ngamehlo akho, nginikezwe indawo esinye sezindawo zasemadolobheni ukuze ngihlale khona; ngobani bona umkhonzi wakho ahlale nawe emzini wakwabukhosi?
Wathi u-Akishi ngalolu busuku wamnika iSikelagi, ibe ngubukhosi baseYuda kuze kube manje.
Wahlala uDavide ezweni lamaFilisti iminyaka eyishumi nesithupha.
Wayehamba uDavide namadodana akhe, wahlasela amaGeshuri, namaGirizi, nama-Amaleki; (balokhu behlala kulolu mhlaba kusukela ekuqaleni, kuze kube seShure, kuya ezweni laseYiputa.)

Ngaso soke isikhathi lapho uDavide ehlasela khona izwe, akhenge ashiye umuntu ophilayo, indoda noma indodakazi; kodwana wathatha izinkomo, namakhowe, nezingulube, namagquma, nezigqoko, wabuyela ku-Akishi.
Uma u-Akishi ebuza, ethi: "Uyaphi namuhla?" uDavide waphendula wathi: "KuseNtshonalanga kaYuda," noma: "KuseNtshonalanga yama-Yerahmeelithi," noma: "KuseNtshonalanga yama-Kenisi."

UDavide akhenge ashiye umuntu ophilayo, noma indoda, noma indodakazi, ukuba afike eGathi; ngombana wathi, Ngabe bazokhuluma nathi, besithi, Lokho uDavide akwenze. Wakwenza njalo zonke amalanga ezihlala khona ezweni lakwaFilisti;
U-Akishi wakholwa uDavide, wathi engqondweni yakhe, Wakwenza bona abantu bakhe, amadodana aseSirayeli, agweme yena; ngalokho uzobe engumkhonzi wami nsuku zonke.
Kwathi ngaleso sikhathi abaFilisti baqoqa amaqembu abo, ukuba bahlangane namaSirayeli. Wathi uAkishi kuDavide, Uyazi kahle bona uzophuma nami, wena namadodana akho, emkhosini.
Wathi uDavide, Uzobona bona uzokwenza yini umkhonzi wakho. Wathi u-Akishi, Kulungile; ngikubeke wena ukuba ube yindodana yami yonke imihla.
USamuweli wayefile, begodu amaSirayeli wonke ayemqoka, wabulawa eRama, emzini wakhe; uSawule ke wabasusa emazweni abo bonke abamangali nabangani.
Bahlangana amaFilisti, bafika bamisa isikhashana eShunem. USawule wahlanganisa wonke amaSirayeli, wamisa isikhashana eGilboa.
USawule, lapho nakabona amaFilisti emkhosini wakhe, wakhathazeka khulu, begodu inhliziyweni yakhe yaphoqa.
Wabuza ikosi; kodwana ikosi akhenge amphendule ngephupho, noma ngo-Urim, noma ngamaprofeti.
Wathi uSawule kubo bonke abakhonzi bakhe, Nifunani nami indodana engakwazi ukuphupha, ukuze ngiye ngiyibuze. Baphendula bathi, "Ku-Endori kukhona umuntu onjalo."
USawule washintsha iingubo zakhe, wagqoka izitayela ezahlukene, waya kumkakhe ngobusuku, yena nomadodana amabili, wathi: "Njengombana ningibuza uMoya oNgcwele, ninikhuphule lowo ngiwubizayo."
Wathi uwesifazane kuye, Uyazi ukuthini uSawule akwenze, bona wasusa ezweni labo abakhuluma ngezinkanyezi, nalabo abanolwazi lwezinhlamvu; kungani ke wena ubeke inqwaba yokubulala impilo yami?
Wathi uSawule kuye ngesandla sikaYehova, esithi, Uphila ikosi, ngeke ube necala ngalolu daba.
Wathi uwesifazane, Ngawuphi umuntu ongeke ngiwukhuphule kuwe? Wathi, Ukhuphula uSamuweli.
Uma indodakazi yabona uSamuweli, yavuya ngezwi elikhulu, yathi kuSawule, Kungani na ungikhohlisa? Awukho wena uSawule.
Wathi ukumkani kuye, "Ungakhathazeki; yini oyibonayo?" Wathi indodakazi yakhe, "Ngibona umoya uphuma ezweni."
Wathi uSawule, "Ubukeka kanjani?" Yathi yena, "Kuvela umuntu omdala ogqoke izicathulo." USawule waqonda bona nguSamuweli, wathi, "Ngubani na lowo muntu?"

Wathi uSamuweli kuSawule, Uyini lo msebenzi owenzayo, ukungiphakamisa? Wathi uSawule, Nginobuhlungu obukhulu khulu; ngombana amaFilisti aphikisana nami, begodu uzimu ungishiya, angiphenduli, noma ngezwi lamaprofeti, noma ngephupho; ngalokho ngikubiza, ukuze ufundise bona yini okufanele ngiyenze.
Wathi uSamuweli, Kungani na bona ungazibuza ngimi, uma ikosi esuka kuwe, waba ngumfowabo?
Wakwenza ikosi njengombana wathi ngesandla sami; wasusa ubukhosi engqondweni yakho, wamnika umngane wakho, uDavide. USolomoni ke wayemthanda khulu uSawule, begodu wayemthanda uDavide.
Ngokuba awusebenzisi ilizwi likaYehova, ukwenzele ama-Amaleki inkohliso yakhe enamandla, ngalokho ikosi wakwenza lokhu kuwe namuhla.
uzimu uzokunikela wena noSirayeli esandla samaFilisti, begodu kusasa wena nabantwana bakho nizobe nami; begodu uzimu uzonikela isizwe sikaSirayeli esandla samaFilisti."
USawule wehla eqhulwini lakhe phezu komhlaba, wakhathazeka khulu ngenxa yale ncwadi kaSamuweli; begodu amandla akhe awakho, ngombana akhenge aphuze ukudla usuku lonke nobusuku bonke.
Wafika uwesifazane kuSawule, wabona bona ukhathazekile khulu, wathi kuye, Bheka, umkhonzi wakho walalela amazwi akho; ngabeka impilo yami enhliziyweni yami, ngakwenza konke ongangiwisela kuso.
Manje ke, ngiyakucela, lalela umkhonzi wakho; ngizokulethela ukudla okuncane, ukuze nidle, nihlale ninekhono lokuhamba ngendlela yenu.
Wathi, "Angeke ngidle." Amadodana akhe akhuluma naye, athi, "Uzokudla yini?" Uthe waphendula wathi, "Ngizodla," begodu waphuma ezweni, wahlala embhedeni.
Uwesifazane ube nengulube ethosiwe ekhaya, wayibulala ngokushesha. Yathatha inkomishi yobisi, yamisa, yapheka isidlo sakusihlwa esingenasici.
Wabeka phambi kukaSawule namadodana akhe, badla; bavuka ngaleyo busuku, besuka.
Bahlanganisa amaFilisti wonke amaphoyisa abo e-Afeki, begodu isizwe samaSirayeli samisa isikhashana eduze komfula eYizreeli.
Baphuma abaphathi bamaFilisti, ngamakhulu namakhulu; uDavide namadodana akhe behamba kulandelana no-Akishi.

Bathi abaphathi bamaFilisti, "Ubani lo mHebheru?" Waphendula u-Akishi wathi, "Ngabe awukho lowoDavide, umkhonzi kaShawule ukumkani wakwaSirayeli? Uhlala nami iminyaka engaphezu kwengu-12; kusukela ngosuku lapho asuka khona kuShawule kuze kube manje, angitholenga lutho olubi kuye."

Bathi abaphathi bamaFilisti, baphoxeka kuye, bathi: Yandisa lo muntu, abuye ezweni olukunikezile lona; akudingeki bona ahambe nathi emkhosini, ukuze angase abeke isandla sakhe empilweni yethu. Ingabe ngeke aphinde athole inhlonipho phambi konkosi wakhe, ngaphandle kokuthi athathe izinhlangothi zethu?
Lokho akusho bona uDavide, okuthiwa bakhuluma ngaye emidlalweni sabo, bathi: USawule wabulala amawaka akhe, noDavide amashumi amane amakhulu akhe?

Wathi u-Akishi kuDavide, wathi kuye, Uphila ikosi bona wena ungumuntu othembekile, begodu ngikuthandela bona ube nami emkhosini; kusukela ngosuku lapho wafika ngami kuze kube namhlanje, angitholanga lutho olubi kuwe; kodwana phakathi kwabaphathi awufanele.
Ngalokho-ke, buyela ukhambe ngokuthula, ukuze ungabi nomsindo phakathi kwabaphathi bamaFilisti.

Wathi uDavide, Ngabe ngikwenze kuphi? Utholeni yini kumkhonzi wakho kusukela ngosuku lapho ngafika khona kuwe, kuze kube manje? Kungani ke bona angikwazi ukuyobhekana nabaphikisi benkosi yami ukumkani?"
Waphendula u-Akishi, wathi, Ngiyazi bona wena ulungile emehlo ami, njengendodana kaThixo; kodwana abaphathi bamaFilisti bathi, Akufanele afike nathi emdlalweni.
Uzovuka ekuseni, wena nabangani bonkosi wakho abaye bafika nawe; bese uphuma emini, lapho kukhanya khona.
Wavuka uDavide ekuseni, yena namadodana akhe, ukuba abuye ezweni lamaFilisti. AmaFilisti aye eJezreyeli.
Kwafika uDavide namadodana akhe eSikelage ngosuku lwesithathu, lapho ama-Amaleki ahlasela khona iNtshonalanga neSikelage; bahlasele iSikelage, bayishisa.
begodu babethathe amadoda nabafazi, kanye nanoma ubani okhona ngaphakathi kwayo, kusukela encane kuya emdala; babulala noma ngubani kubo, kodwana wathatha nabo lapho behamba indlela.
Kwafika uDavide namadodana akhe eCiklagi, bebona bona iqhume, namabhishobho abo, nabantwana babo, nezingane zabo, zithathwe njengeziboshwa.
Wathi uDavide namadodana akhe, balele ngezwi elikhulu, kuze kube sekuphele amandla abo okulile.
UDavide wathatha izifazane zakhe ezimbili, u-Ahinoamu waseJezreyeli, no-Abigayili umfazi kaNabali waseKarmeli.

UDavide wakhathazeka khulu, ngombana abantu babekhuluma bona bagweme ukubulala uDavide ngetshe; begodu wonke umuntu waba nenhliziyo ebuhlungu ngenxa yamadodana akhe namakhosikazi akhe. Kodwana uDavide waqiniseka kuYehova uzimu wakhe.
Wathi uDavide ku-Abhiyathari, umpristi, unyana ka-Ahileleki, Thola ngithole i-ephodi. U-Abhiyathari wayisa kuye.
UDavide wabuza ikosi, wathi, Ngizolandela yini iqembu labo? Ingabe ngizowathola? Waphendula uDavide, wathi, Yilandele; uzowathola ngokuqinisekile, begodu uzoba nempumelelo ekusindiseni bonke.
Wafika uDavide, namadoda angumakhulu amathandathu ahamba naye, eGoli likaBesoro; kwahlala khona abantu.
Kodwana uDavide namadodana akhe amashumi amane ayeqhubeka nokuzibulala, ngenxa yokuthi abantu abangumakhulu amabini babenzima khulu.
Bathola ezweni umuntu waseMijiphu, bamwisela kuDavide, bamnika amanzi ukuba anywe, nomhluzi ukuba aphile.
Wadla, waphila; ngombana akhenge aphuze ukudla noma utshwala ekuseni nakusihlwa iminyaka emithathu, begodu akhenge aphuze amanzi nsuku zonke.
Wathi uDavide kuye, "Uwubani wena? Uvela kuphi?" Wathi yena, "NgingumMisiriya, umkhonzi womuntu wase-Amaleki; begodu umnikazi wami ungishiya, ngombana ngibulawe ngosuku oludlule.
Sihlasela iNtshonalanga yama-Kerethi, nengxenye kaYuda, kanye neNtshonalanga kaKalebe; begodu sabulala iSiklagi.

Wathi uDavide kuye, Ingabe uzongikhuphula ngiye kulolu daba? Wathi yena, Uthini ngamazwi kaThixo, bona awuzomibulala, begodu awuzominikela emkhondweni womnikazi wami, khona-ke ngizokukhuphula ngiya kubo.
Wahamba naye uDavide, wabona bona baphazamiseka ezweni lonke, bedla, bephuza, bezijabulisa, ngenxa yezinto eziningi ababezithathe ezweni lamaFilisti nasesiJudani.
UDavide wabhekana nabo kusukela emini, kuze kube ekuseni kosuku olulandelayo. Akukho omunye wabo owaphuma, ngaphandle kwamadodakazi angamakhulu amane, athabathela ezingulubeni, abaleka.
Nokho uDavide wafumana konke obekuthathe ama-Amaleki, namadodana akhe amabili.
Akukho lutho olulahlekile: omusha noma omdala, indodakazi noma indodakazi, noma ithonya, noma iyiphi enye into ababeyithathe. UDavide wabuyisela konke.
Wathatha zonke izingulube nezimvu, bahamba ngazo phambi kwezilwane, bathi, Lezi yizimpahla zokulwa zikaDavide.

UDavide wafika kubo amadoda amakhulu amabili, abelokhu enqaba ukulandela uDavide, ayewashiya emfuleni iBesoro; baphuma behlangana noDavide namadodana akhe. Wafika uDavide namadodana akhe, wathi kubo: "Unjani isimo sawo?"
Bathi bonke abantu ababi, nabangani bakaDavide, besithi, Ngokuba abengaphuma nathi, ngeke sibe nabo emgodini esiwubuyisele; kodwana wonke umuntu athathe indodana yakhe nezingane zakhe, ahambe.
Wathi uDavide, Akunjalo, bazalwane bami; akufanele nikwenze njalo ngezinto ebezithunyelwe nguYehova, owawusilondolozile, wanikela phambi kwethu isibhamu esithe safika kuthi.
Ngabe kukhona umuntu ozolalela amazwi akho? Umfazi ohlala nezinto zokudla kufanele abe nengxenye efana naleyo yowesifazane osuka emdlalweni; bonke bazothola inkontileka efanako.
Wakwenza lo mthetho ube ngumthetho kaDavide eSirayeli kusukela ngalolusuku, kuze kube manje.
Wafika uDavide eCiklagi, wathumela okunye kokudla kwazo izikhulu zakwaYuda, abathandekayo bakhe, wathi, Bonani isipho senu kukudla kwazo izidumbu zababi bakaYehova.
Wathumela kubo abahlala eBhetheleli, naseRamothi ezweni laseNtshonalanga, neYatiri;
kilabo base-Aroer, Siphmoth, Eshtemoa
kanye noRakhali; nalabo abasemadolobheni eJerahmeeli, namaKenishi;
kilabo baseHormah, Bor Ashan, Athak
nakwa-Hebroni, nakwazo zonke ezinye izindawo lapho uDavide nomadodana akhe ehamba khona.
Bahlasela amaFilisti amaSirayeli, begodu amaSirayeli asuka phambi kwabo; babulawa abantu abaningi emfuleni iGilboa.
Balandela amaFilisti uSawule nabantwana bakhe, babulala uYonathani noAbinabadi noMalki-shua, izingane zakhe.
Ukulwa kwakhula kwaba buhlungu ngaseSauli, begodu lapho abahlabayo befika kuye, bampofusa khulu.

Wathi uSawule kulowo othwala isibhamu sakhe, Thola ikhebula lakho, zulazula ngami; uma kungenjalo bangafika labo abangenawo ukutholwa, bazulazula ngami, begodu bangene ngami. Kodwana lowo othwala isibhamu sakhe wakhathazeka, akhenge akwenze njalo; ngalokho uSawule wathatha ikhebula lakhe, wesaba kuyo.
Wabona umkhweli wezithuthuthu bona uSawule ufile, wehla naye phezu kweqhwa lakhe, wafa naye.
Wafa uSawule, nabantwana bakhe abathathu, nomuntu ogqoke izikhali zakhe, nabantu bakhe bonke baphela ndawonye ngalolusuku.

Babona bonke amadoda aseSirayeli asendaweni ephansi, nalabo abasenyakatho-ntshonalanga yeJordani, bona abantu baseSirayeli bahambe, begodu bona uSawule nezingane zakhe zifile; bashiya amadolobha abo, babaleka. Bafika amaFilisti, bahlala kiwo.
Kwathi ngosuku olulandelayo, lapho befika khona amaFilisti ukuze bagqoke abafileyo, bathola uSawule nonyana bakhe abathathu bewela emfuleni iGilboa.
Baphuca ikhanda lakhe, basusa izithuthi zakhe; babathumela ezweni lonke labaseFilistini, ukuba babe yizindaba ezinhle ezindlwini zezinhlamvu zabo, naphakathi kwabantu babo.
Babeka izikhali zakhe ethempelini lika-Ashtoreth, begodu baqinisa umzimba wakhe emgodini we-Bet Shan.
Bathe abantu baseYabhesi-Gileyadi beva bona abaFilisti bakwenzani noSawule,
begodu bonke amadoda abo anamandla, bahamba ngesonto lonke eBeth-Shan; begodu bakhuphula izicubu kaSawule namadodana akhe ukusuka emgodini, wafika Jabheshi, begodu babulala.
Bathatha amathambo abo, bawafihla ngezansi komnqumo eYabheshi; begodu baphumula amalanga ezisithupha.
2Sam: UDavide, lapho ebuyela eSikelage ngemuva kokufa kukaShawule, wahlala khona amalanga ezimbili.
Kwathi ngosuku lwesithathu, kwafika umuntu osuka eqenjini likaSawule, enezigqoko zakhe zilahlekile, nenyama phezu kwekhanda lakhe; wafika kuDavide, wehleli phasi emhlabeni.
Wathi uDavide kuye, Uvela phi wena? Wathi yena, Ngasuka eqenjini lakwaSirayeli ngaphuma.
Wathi uDavide, "Kungaba kwenzekani?" Waphendula wathi, "Abantu baphuma emdlalweni, begodu abantu abaningi babulawa; noSawule noYonathani unyana wakhe nabo bafa."
Wathi uDavide kulowo wesifazane oveza izindaba, Uyazi kanjani bona uSawule noYonatan unyana wakhe bafa?
Wathi lo mshado, Ngase ngibe enhliziyweni yeGilboa, begodu ngabona uSawule ekhonjiswe emgodini wakhe; begodu izithuthuthu nabangani bakhe abahamba ngezikebhe bengena kuye.
Wabheka emuva kwakhe, ngangibona, wangisiza. Ngaphendula ngitjho: "Hhayi-ke!"
Wathi kuye, Ubani wena? Ngathi kuye, Ngingu-Amaleki;
Wathi kuye, Ngicela ungene ngami, bulala ngimi; ngombana inhliziyo yami ibuhlungu khulu, kodwana ngiphila.
Ngiye ngangena kuye, ngiwubulala; ngombana ngazi bona ngeke aphile ngemuva kokufa kwakhe. Ngathatha isiqubulo esisuka ekhanda lakhe, nentambo esuka emlenzeni wakhe, ngazisa lapha kuwe, kosi yami.
Wathatha uDavide izigqoko zakhe, wazigqugquzela; nalabo bonke abantu ababenabo bakwenza njalo.
Baze babulawe, belilimala, bezama ukudla kuze kube sebusuku, ngenxa kaSawule noYonatan unyana wakhe, begodu ngenxa yabantu bakaYehova, nabaseSirayeli; ngombana babefile ngeqhwa.
Wathi uDavide kulowo mshayeli, ethi, Uvelaphi wena? Waphendula wathi, Ngiye unyana womuntu ohlala ezweni elisha, umAmaleki.
Wathi uDavide kuye, Kungani na bona ungakhathazeki ukuphakamisa isandla sakho ukubulala ukumkani okhethiwe nguYehova?
Wathi uDavide, ebiza elinye lamadodakazi akhe, wathi, Yiya, hlasela yena. Wayembulala, waza wafa.
Wathi uDavide kuye, Igazi lakho libe phezu kwekhanda lakho; umlomo wakho wakhuluma ngawe, wathi, Ngibulale ukumkani okhethiwe nguYehova.
Wathi uDavide lo mculo obuhlungu, ngoSawule noYonatan unyana wakhe.
Washo bona abantu baseYuda bafundiswe lo mculo, obizwa bona umculo we-Arch. Kubhalwe encwadini kaJashar:
"Isizwe sakwaSirayeli, ubuhle bakho bulele ezindaweni zakho eziphakeme! Ngabe abadumile bawela kanjani?
Musani ukutjela eGathi, noma ukukhuluma emigwaqweni se-Ashkelon; ukuze zingakujabuleli izingane zakwaFilisti, begodu izingane zalabo abangaphandle zijabulise.

Yimi, imifula eGilboa, akufanele imvula noma umswakama udlule phezu kwenu, begodu akufanele iimila zikhiqize amazambane ukunikela. Ngenxa lalokho, isibhamu abanamandlaphelile waphazamiseka khona; isibhamu kaSawule akhenge afakwe nge-oyile.
Umphini ka-Yonatan aluboleki ukubuyela emuva, ngenxa yegazi lalabo abafileyo, begodu ngenxa yezicubu zamadoda amakhulu. Isikebhe sikaSawule asiboleki ukubuyela emuva ngaphandle kokudla.
USawule noYonathani, abathandekayo empilweni sabo, nakufa kwabo bebengahlukaniswa; babehamba ngejubane elikhulu kunama-eagle, babenamandla amakhulu kunama-lion.
Ngitjho kuni, izingane zakwaSirayeli, zinikeleni uSawule; wakuzigqoka izicathulo ezibomvu, wazisa amatshe egolide ezicathulo zenu.
UJonathane ulele ekufaneni kwakho.
Nginenhliziyo ebuhlungu ngenxa yakho, udadewethu Jonathan. Ube khulu kumuntu wami. Uthando lwakho ngami kwakuhle khulu, ngaphezu kothando lwabesifazane.
Ngabe abaholi abakhulu behla, begodu izikhali zabo zempi zilahlekile!
Kusukela ngaleso sikhathi uDavide wabuza ikosi, wathi, Ngizohamba yini esinye sezifundazwe zakwaYuda? Wathi ikosi, Yiya. UDavide wathi, Ngizohamba phi? Wathi ikosi, EHebroni.
Wahamba khona uDavide, naye namadodana akhe amabini, uAhinoamu waseJezreyeli, no-Abigayili umfazi kaNabali waseKarmeli.
UDavide wazisa namadodana akhe, wonke umuntu nomndeni wakhe; bahlala emizini se-Hebroni.
Bafika abantu baseYuda, bamisa uDavide abe ngukumkani phezu kwamadodana aseYuda. Bathi kubo uDavide, besithi: "Abantu baseYabhesi-Gileyadi ababulale uSawule."
Wathumela uDavide abathunywa abantu baseYabhesi-Gileyadi, wathi kubo, UYehova akusindiseni; ngombana nikwenze lo mhlomulo kuSawule, umnikazi wenu, ngokumzingela.
Manje ke ikosi akubonise wena inhlonipho yakhe, neqiniso lakhe; begodu nami ngizokwenza okuhle kuwe, ngenxa yokuthi wenze lokhu.
Manje ke, zinikele, nibe nethando olukhulu; ngombana unkosi wenu uSawule usefile, begodu namadodana eYuda angenza ngibe ngukumkani wabo.
U-Abheri unyana ka-Neri, umphathi wesibhakabhaka sikaSawule, wathatha uIshboshethi, unyana kaSawule, waya eMahanayim.
Wakwenza khona ukumkani eGiliyadi, nase-Ashurini, nase-Jezreyeli, nase-Ephrayim, naseBhenjamini, nakwaSirayeli bonke.
U-Ishboshethi, unyana kaSawule, ubeminyaka imashumi amane eneminyaka, lapho eqala ukumkani phezu kwaSirayeli; waba ngukumkani iminyaka emibini. Abantu baseYuda balandela uDavide.
UDavide waba ngukumkani eHebroni phezu kwamadodana kaYuda iminyaka eyishumi nesishiyagalombili.
UAbheri unyana ka-Neri, nabangani baka-Ishboshethi unyana kaSawule, baphuma eMahanayim, besuka eGibeyon.
Waphuma noYowabhi unyana kaZeruyiya, nabangane bakaDavide, bahlangana nabo eGibehoni emfuleni; iqembu elinye lihlala ngaphesheya komfula, neqembu elinye lihlala ngaphesheya komfula.
Wathi u-Abheri kuYowabhi, "Bazovuka labo madodakazi, banqobe phambi kwethu." UYowabhi wathi, "Bazovuka."
Bavuka ke, bahlukaniswa: abalishumi elinamibini baseBhenjamini, no-Ishboshethi unyana kaSawule, namadodana kaDavide amashumi amabili namahlanu.
Wathatha wonke umuntu umkhonzi wakhe ngekhanda, wabeka ikhebula lakhe emlenzeni womkhonzi wakhe, bawela ndawonye; ngalokho kwabizwa igama lalapho eGibehoni bona yiHelekathi-hazurim.
Kwaba buhlungu khulu ukulwa ngalolusuku, kwabulawa uAbheri namadodakazi kaSirayeli ngabasebenzi bakaDavide.
Bakhona khona oonyana bakaSeruya abathathu: uYowabhi, no-Abhishai, no-Asaheli. U-Asaheli wayehamba ngejubane elifana nejubane lengulube.
U-Asayeli walandela u-Abneri, engaguquki ngakwesokudla noma ngakwesobunxele, elandela yena.
U-Abheri wabheka emuva, wathi, Ingabe wena, Asaheli? Waphendula wathi, Ngaye.
Wathi yena u-Abhineeri kuye, Thola isandla sakho sokudla noma isandla sakho sakwesobunxele; thola omunye wamadodakazi, uze uthathe isigqoko sakhe. Kodwana u-Asaheli akhenge agweme ukumlandela.
Wathi u-Abheri ku-Asaheli, Uzobuya ngami; kungani ngikubulala wena? Ngangikwazi yini ukubhekana noYowabhi umngane wakho?

Kodwana u-Asaheli akhenge ashintshe isandla sakhe. U-Abneri wehlisa umlenze wakhe ngengxenye yangaphambili yesibhakabhaka, begodu isibhakabhaka saphuma emlenzeni wakhe; washona khona lapho. Wonke umuntu ofika endaweni lapho u-Asaheli eshonile khona, wahlala khona.
Kodwana uYowabhi no-Abhishai balandela uAbheri; begodu lapho ilanga liphuma khona, befika esiqhingini saseAmaha, esiseGiyah, enkabeni yolwandle lwaseGiboni.
Bahlangana abantu baseBhenjamini, belandela uAbheri, babe yiqembu elilodwa, bahlala phezulu komfula.

Wathi u-Abheri kuYowabhi, Ingabe ikhebula lizoqhubeka libulala kuze kube sekupheleni? Awazi yini bona lokhu kuzophela ngobuhlungu? Ngabe uzokhuluma kanjani abantu bakho ukuba bayeke ukulandela abazalwane babo?
Wathi uYowabhi, Uphila uzimu, uma ungakhulumanga, khona-ke abantu bami bangase baqhubeke nokulandela abazalwane babo kuze kube ekuseni.
UYowabhi waphuza iphoyinti, bonke abantu bakhe bahlala phasi; abazange baqhubeke nokulandela amaSirayeli, babuyela empilweni.
Bahamba ke uAbheri namadodana akhe yonke leyo busuku, bedlula iJordani, badlula yonke indawo yaseBithroni, bafika eMahanayim.
UYowabhi, lapho ebuyela khona ekulandeleni uAbheri, waqoqa bonke abantu bakhe; kwabasekho amadodana kaDavide amashumi ayisishiyagalolunye, kanye no-Asaheli.
Kodwana abantu bakaDavide babulala amadodana ka-Abneri eBhenjamini, amakhulu amathathu, namashumi ayisishiyagalombili.
Bathatha u-Asaheli, bawu葬la esibhedlela sikababa wakhe eBethelehemu. UYowabu namadodana akhe behamba yonke ibusuku; kwafika kuHebrone ekuseni.
Impi phakathi kwendlu kaSawule nendlu kaDavide yaqhubeka isikhathi eside. UDavide wakhula enamandla, begodu umndeni kaSawule waba mkhulu khulu.
Wazalwa uDavide amadodana eHebroni. Umzali wakhe wokuthoma wayengu-Amnon, owaziwa bona nguAhinoamu waseJezreyeli.
Omunye waba nguKilabhi, owazalwa ngu-Abhigayeli, umfazi kaNabali waseKarmeli; wesithathu uAbsalomu, owayengunyana kaMahaka, intokazi kaTalmai ukumkani wakwaGeshuri.
owesine uAdoniya, unyana kaHagithi; owasihlanu uShefatiya, unyana ka-Abithali.
Owesithandathu uYitreyamu, owazalwa ngu-Egla, indodana kaDavide; laba bazalwa nguDavide eHebron.
Kusukela lapho kwaqala khona umkhosi phakathi kwendlu kaSawule nendlu kaDavide, uAbneri waqhubeka enamandla emndenini kaSawule.
USawule wayenenkosikazi, igama layo nguRispa, intombi ka-Ahiya. Wathi uIshbhoshethi ku-Abner, Kungani na ungene nenkosikazi yoyise?

U-Abneri wakhathazeka khulu ngamazwi ka-Ishboshethi, wathi, Ingabe ngiyinja esebenza kuYuda? Ngiye ngakwenza kahle ekhaya likaSawule ubaba wakho, nabazalwane bakhe, nabangane bakhe, kuze kube namuhla; angikwazanga ukukunikela kuDavide; kodwana manje ungitshela bona ngikwenzele okumbi ngowesifazane.
uzimu akwenze lokhu, begodu anikeze okuningi, uma sengingeke ngikwenzele uDavide njengombana ikosi ephindwe ngawo:
ukuze ngithathe ubukumkani emndenini kaSawule, begodu ngibeke isitulo sikaDavide phezu kwaSirayeli nakwaYuda, kusukela eDani kuya eBheri-sheba.
U-Ishboshethi akakwazanga ukuphendula u-Abneri, ngombana wayemthanda khulu.
Wathumela ke uAbheri abathunywa kuDavide, bathi kuye, Yikuphi izwe elikhona? Yenzana nesivumelwano nami; ngizokusiza bona unqobe wonke amaSirayeli. USawule wathi kuAbheri: "Ubani lo mntu?"
Wathi uDavide, Kulungile, ngizokwenza isiqiniseko nawe; kodwana ngingakucela into eyodwa, bona uma usufika, ungangibona ngamehlo akho, ngaphandle kokuthi uyiveze iMikhayeli intombi kaSawule.
Wathumela uDavide abathunywa ku-Ishbhoshethi, unyana kaSawule, esithi, Ninikele indodana yami iMikhayeli; ngombana ngiyithengise ngezinto ezingenalutho zamaFilisti amakhulu amabili.
Wathumela ke uIshbhoshethi, wamsusa emndenini wakhe, ePaltiyeli unyana kaLaishe.
Wahamba nomfazi wakhe naye, ekhala, elandela yena kuze kube seBahurim. Wathi uAbheri kuye, Yiya ekhaya lakho; wabuyela khona.
Wakhuluma uAbheri namadoda amakhulu aseSirayeli, wathi, Ngaleso sikhathi nifuna bona uDavide abe ngukumkani wenu.
Manje ke nikwenze; ngombana ikosi uthi kuDavide, Ngendlela yomkhonzi wami uDavide, ngizosindisa abantu bam, isiSirayeli, emaFilistini, nakwabo bonke ababi babo.
Wakhuluma uAbheri namadodakazi kaBhenjamin, waya eHebroni ukuba akhulume noDavide konke okwenzekile engqondweni yamaSirayeli nemindeni sabo.
Wafika uAbheri kuDavide eHebron, namadoda amashumi amabili naye. UDavide walungisa isidlo sikaAbheri namadoda akhe.

Wathi uAbhineeri kuDavide, Ngizoya ngikuqoqe wena, Kosi yami ukumkani, wonke amaSirayeli, ukuze benze isivumelwano nawe, begodu ube ngummelwane wakho ngaso soke isifiso senhliziyo yakho. UDavide washiya uAbheneri, waya ekuthula.
Ngabona, abakhonzi bakaDavide noYowabhi bebuya emgwaqeni, beze nempahla eningi; kodwana uAbheneri akhenge ahlale noDavide eHebroni; ngombana uDavide wayemshiye, waphuma enhliziyweni yeNkosi.
Kwafika uYowabhi nomndeni wakhe wonke, kwabikwa kuYowabhi, bathi, UAbneri unyana ka-Nere wafika kumkakhe; umkakhe wamshiya ahambe, waya ekuthula.
Wafika uYowabhi ukumkani, wathi, Ukwenzeni kuphi lokhu? U-Abneri wafika kuwe; kungani ungamvumela bona ahambe? Ngokuba sewuphelile.
Uyazi u-Abneri unyana ka-Nere; wafika ukukukhohlisa wena, ukuze akwazi zonke izimo zakho, ukuba khona kwakho nokuphuma kwakho, begodu ukuze abone konke okwenzayo.
Waphuma uYowabhi kuDavide, wathumela abathunywa emuva kuka-Abneri; bayambuyisela emfuleni iSira; kodwana uDavide akawazi.

UAbheri wabuyela eHebron, uYowabhi wamthatha ngaphesheya komgwaqo, efuna ukukhuluma naye ngokufihlakeleyo; khona-ke wabulala uAbheri emlonyeni wakhe, waza wafa. Wakwenza lokhu uYowabhi ngenxa yokufa kukaAsaheli, umngane wakhe.
Kwathi ngemuva kwalokho, lapho uDavide ekhuluma ngalolu daba, wathi, Ngami nobukhosi bami singekho emthethweni phambi kukaNkulunkulu kuze kube sekupheleni ngegazi lika-Abneri unyana kaNeri.
UYowabhi, nomndeni wonke kababa wakhe, bagwetshwe. Kubekho umfazi emndenini kaYowabhi onesilonda, noma onobuhlungu besikhumba, noma ohamba ngentambo, noma ozofa ngeqhwa, noma o echazwe ukudla.
UYowabhi noAbhishai udadewabo babulala uAbheri, ngenxa yokuthi wabulala udadewabo uAsaheli emdlalweni eGibeyon.
Wathi uDavide kuYowabhi, nakubo bonke abantu ababena naye: "Nqumkani izigqoko zenu, nizigqoke ngendwangu, nize nise phambi kuka-Abneri." UDavide ukumkani wayehamba eduze kwebhedi elithwala igazi.
Wagcwaliswa uAbheri eHebroni; begodu ukumkani wavuya ngezwi elikhulu emgodini ka-Abhereri, nabantu bonke nabo bavuya.
Wathi ukumkani kuAbheri, Uzofa kanjani uAbheri njengokufa komfana omnyama?
Izandla zakho aziboshwenga, begodu izinyawo zakho azigciniwe ngezingcingo; wagwa njengomuntu owela phambi kwabantu ababi. Abantu bonke baphinde bagula phezu kwakhe.

Bafika bonke abantu, becela uDavide bona aphuze ukudla ngesikhathi sesihlwa; kodwana uDavide wathi: uzimu angikwenze lokhu nalokhu, begodu amnikeze okuningi, uma ngidla inyama noma iyiphi into ngaphambi kokuba ilanga liphele.
Abantu bonke bakubona lokhu, kwabe kumnandi kubo; begodu konke okwenze ukumkani kwaba mnandi kubantu bonke.
Bayazi abantu bonke, nabaSirayeli bonke, ngalolu busuku, bona kwakungeke kube ngukumkani ukuba abulawe uAbheri unyana ka-Neri.
Wathi ukumkani kwabakhonzi bakhe, Ingabe ningazi bona namuhla kubulawa umholi omkhulu eSirayeli?
Nakuba ngiyinkosi ekhethiwe, kodwana namuhla sengincane khulu; labo oonyana bakaSeruya banzima kunami. UYehova abuyisele umonakalo owenzayo kulowo owenza ububi.
Uthe uIshboshethi, unyana kaSawule, ekwazi bona uAbneri usefile eHebroni, walahleka umoya wakhe; namadodakazi aseSirayeli wonke akhathazekile.
USawule unyana wakhe wayenendodana eyisithathu, indodakazi kaRimoni waseBherothi, wesizwe sikaBhenjamin; igama lomunye lalinguBaana, elinye linguRehabhi. (Beerothi yabhekwa njengengxenye kaBhenjamin,
ngombana abantu base-Beerothi basuka eGitayini, behlala khona njengezivakashi kuze kube ngalolu suku.

UYonathan, unyana kaSawule, wayenendodakazi encane, eyayingasekho emlenzeni wayo wonke. Wayeneminyaka emihlanu ubudala, lapho izindaba zikaSawule noYonathan zifika khona eYizreyeli. Inkosikazi yakhe yathatha lo mntwana, yahamba naye; kodwana ngesikhathi ihamba ngokushesha, wagwa, waba mkhulu; igama lakhe lalinguMephiboshethi.
Basuka ke uRekabu noBaana, oonyana bakaRimoni waseBherothi, bafika endlwini ka-Ishboshethi ngesikhathi sokushisa kwelanga; yena wayehlala embhedeni ngesikhathi semini.
Bafika endlwini, bathi bafuna ukuthatha imbewu, bampompa emlonyeni wakhe; waphuma ke uRekabu noBaana umzalwana wakhe.

Bafika efulethini lapho uhlala khona embhedeni wakhe egumbini lakhe lokuphumula. Bangamdlwengula, bambulala, bamisa intamo yakhe. Bathatha intamo yakhe begodu bahamba yonke imini eduze kwendlela edlula emigwaqweni yaseArabah.
Bathi, Yabona ikhanda lika-Ishboshethi, unyana kaSawule, umshayeli wakho, ofuna ukukwenza ufile; namuhla ikosi unqobile uSawule nomndeni wakhe kuwe, kosi yami, ukumkani.
Waphendula uDavide, wathi kuRehabhi noBhaana umzalwana wakhe, oonyana bakaRimoni waseBherothi, uzimu ophilayo, owandisela ngazo zonke izimo ezibuhlungu,

Kwathi lapho umuntu engitshela khona, ethi, USawule ufile; wacabanga bona ukhuluma ngezindaba ezinhle; kodwana ngawuthatha, ngawubulala eSikelage. Lowo ngumsebenzi wami owenzayo ngenxa yezindaba zakhe.
Ngabe ngizothi, Ngizothi yini abantu ababi, labo ababulale umuntu ongenacala embhedeni wakhe, ekhaya lakhe? Ingabe ngeke ngikulethe igazi lakhe kuwe, begodu ngikususe phezu komhlaba?"

Wathi uDavide kumadodana akhe, babulala labo bantu, bebopha izandla zabo nemilenze sabo, baphonsa izicubu zabo eduze kolwandle eHebroni; kodwana ikhanda lika-Ishboshethi lafakwa emgodini ka-Abneri eHebroni.
Kwafika zonke izizwe zakwaSirayeli kuDavide eHebroni, zithi, Thola, thina sigazi lakho namafutha akho.
Ngaleso sikhathi, lapho uSawule engumnikazi wethu, ubewuwo lowo ophumayo nobuyelayo amaSirayeli; begodu ikosi wathi kuwe, Uzophatha abantu bam bakaSirayeli, nawe uzobe ngummengameli wabo.
Bafika khona bonke abakhulu bakaSirayeli kukumkani eHebron, uDavide umkwezi-mthetho nabo lapho phambi koYehova; bamisa uDavide waba ngukumkani phezu kwaSirayeli.
UDavide ubeneminyaka engu-30 ubudala lapho eqala ukumkani; waba ngukumkani iminyaka engamashumi amane.
EHebroni waba ngukumkani wakwaYuda iminyaka eyisixhenxe nenyanga yesithupha; begodu eYerusalem waba ngukumkani kwabaSirayeli bonke nakwaYuda iminyaka engamashumi amathathu anethathu.

Waphuma ukumkani, yena namadodana akhe, waya eYerusalem ukubhekana namaJebhusi abahlala khona. Bathi amaJebusi kuDavide, besithi, Awuzofika lapha; uma kungenjalo, abantu abamnyama nalabo abafileyo bazo echofoza wena. Bathi, UDavide ngeke afike apha.
Kodwana uDavide wathatha isikhala esiqinile saseSiyone, begodu sabizwa bona yidolobha likaDavide.

Wathi uDavide ngalolusuku, Wonke umuntu ohlasela amaJebhusi, kufanele afike ezindaweni zokungena kwamanzi, aze afinyelele kilabo abafileyo nababambiqhaza, abathandana nabo uDavide; ngalokho besithi, Angeke afike endlwini umuntu ofileyo nobabambiqhaza.
Wahlala khona uDavide esitezi esiphakeme, wabiza igama lakhe bona idolobha likaDavide. Wakwakha indawo yayo yonke, kusukela eMilo kuya ngaphakathi.
UDavide waqhubeka ekhula, waba mkhulu; begodu ikosi, uzimu wama-Amoni, ube naye.
UHirame, ukumkani waseTire, wathumela abathunywa kuDavide, namatshe aseduzane, nabenzi bamapulangwe, nabenzi bamatshe; bakwakha indlu uDavide.
UDavide waqonda bona ikosi wamenza ukumkani phezu kwaSirayeli, begodu ukuba ubukumkani bakhe bukhulu ngenxa yabantu bakhe baseSirayeli.
Wathatha uDavide amakhosikazi namadodakazi amanengi eYerusalem, ngemuva kokuhamba kwakhe eHebroni waya eYerusalem; kwazalwa uDavide onyana nozina.
Lawona amagama abo abazalwa kuye eYerusalem: uShamua, noShobabu, noNathani, noSolomoni,
u-Ibhare, no-Elishuwa, no-Nefegi, no-Yaphia,
noElishama, noEliyada, noElifelethe.
Kwathi lapho abaFilisti beva bona uDavide wakhonzwa ukuba ngukumkani phezu kwaSirayeli, baphuma bonke abantu baseFilisti bafuna uDavide. UDavide ekwazi lokhu, wehla esitezi esiphakeme.
Kwafika amaFilisti, wasakazeka eGoli lika-Refayi.

UDavide wabuza ikosi, esithi, Ngizohamba ngihlasela amaFilisti? Ingabe uzobanikela emandleni ami? Waphendula ikosi uDavide, wathi, Yiya; ngombana ngizobanikela ngokuqinisekile amaFilisti emandleni akho.
Wafika uDavide eBhaale-perazime, wababulala khona; wathi uDavide, "uzimu uphonsa izitha zami phambi kwami, njengamanzi aphonsa amanzi," ngalokho kwabizwa igama lesi sifundazwe bona iBhaale-perazime.
Bashiya khona amatshe abo, uDavide namadodana akhe bayawathwala.
Baphinde banyuka amaFilisti, baphikisa eGoli lika-Refayi.
UDavide wabuza ikosi. Waphendula ikosi, wathi, Ungawahlaseli ngaphambili; buyela emuva kwabo, uwahlasele phambi kwezintaba-mlilo.
Uma ubona izingqinamba, njengezingqinamba zokuhamba ezindaweni eziphezulu zezintaba-mlilo, khona-ke uzohamba ngokushesha; ngombana ikosi usephuma phambi kwakho, ukuze ahlasele amaFilisti.
Wakwenza uDavide njengokuthi ikosi wamwisela umthetho ngawo; wahlasela amaFilisti kusukela eGibeha kuya eGezeri.
UDavide waqoqa begodu wonke amaSirayeli akhethiwe, amadoda angamakhulu amathathu.

UDavide wasuka eBhaale-Juda, yena namadodana akhe wonke, ukuba akhuphule khona ibhokisi likaThixo, elibizwa ngegama lakhe, igama loYehova wamaSirayeli, ohlala emgodini wakhe phezu kwezilwane eziphilako.
Babeka isibambo sikaThixo esitshalweni esisha, bayisa endlwini ka-Abinabadi, esezindulini; uUza noAhiyo, oonyana baka-Abinabadi, behamba ngesihaweni.
Beyikhipha endlwini ka-Abinabadi, esemfuleni; ibhokisi likaThixo likhona phezu kwalo; uAhiya wayehamba phambi kwebhokisi.
UDavide namadodakazi aseSirayeli wonke bedlala phambi kweNkosi, ngezinto zonke zemithi ye-cypress, nama-harps, nama-lyras, nama-tamburins, nama-rattles, nama-cimbals.
Bafika esitezi sokudla sikaNakhoni, begodu izingulube ziqhekekile; waphakamisa uUza isandla sakhe, wathatha isibambo sikaThixo.
Umlilo wobubi kaYehova wawuncibilika phezu kuka-Uza, begodu uzimu wamshaya khona ngenxa yobugebengu bakhe; wafa khona lapho, eduze kwebhokisi likaThixo.
UDavide wakhathazeka, ngenxa yokuthi ikosi wayephumile ngoUza; wathi igama lesi sifundazwe yiPerezi-Uza, kuze kube manje.
UDavide wakhathazeka ngoYehova ngalolusuku, wathi, Ingabe ibhokisi loNkulunkulu lizofika kimi?
Ngalokho uDavide akhenge afake ibhokisi likaYehova edolobhaneni likaDavide, ukuba libe naye; wayisa endlwini ka-Obedi-edomu waseGathi.
Ibhokisi likaYehova lahlala endlwini ka-Obedi-edomu waseGathi iminyaka emithathu; begodu ikosi wabambisana no-Obedi-edomu nendlu yakhe yonke.

Bathi kuDavide ukumkani, "uzimu usandulela ikhaya lika-Obedi-edomu, nanoma yini ekhona yakhe, ngenxa yesihluthulelo sikaThixo." Wahamba uDavide, waphakamisa isihluthulelo sikaThixo kusuka endlwini ka-Obedi-edomo waya edolobhaneni likaDavide, ngenjabulo enkulu.
Kwathi, lapho labo abathwali ibhokisi likaYehova behamba ngemizuzwana eyisithupha, uDavide wanikela ngenkomo, nengulube enempilo.
UDavide wadansa phambi koYehova ngekhono lakhe lonke, egqoke i-ephodi yelinen, nebhande lenkosi.
Wathi uDavide, naye wonke amakhosi aseSirayeli, waphakamisa isibambo sikaYehova ngezwi lothando, nezwi lezinhlamvu.

Kwathi lapho ibhokisi likaYehova lifika edolobhaneni likaDavide, uMikhayeli intombi kaSawule yabheka ngaphesheya kwefasitela, yabona ukumkani uDavide enqoba, edansa phambi kukaYehova; wagwema yena emlonyeni wakhe.
Bafaka ibhokisi likaYehova, baligqugquzela ezindaweni zayo eziphakathi kwehholo uDavide abelile. UDavide wanikela ngezipho zokushiswa, nezipho zokuthula phambi kukaNkulunkulu.
Kwathi, lapho uDavide eqedile ukunikela ngezipho ezibomvu nezipho zokuthula, wabambisa abantu ngegama likaYehova wemikhosi.

Wanikela ukudla kubo bonke abantu baseSirayeli, amadoda nabesifazane; wonke umuntu wafumana inkomishi Indikimba eyodwa yenkomo, nebhodlela elilodwa lamakhowe, nebhodlela elilodwa lama-raspberries. Bahamba ke bonke abantu ezindaweni zabo.

Kwathi, lapho uDavide ebuyela ekhaya lakhe, uMikhayeli intombi kaSawule waphuma wamthola, wathi, "Kuhle khulu bona ukumkani wakwaSirayeli ubukeka ngayo namhlanje! Wagqugquzela izandla zakhe phambi kwamadodakazi asemkhondweni wakhe, njengendoda engahloniphi!"

Wathi uDavide kuMikhayeli, Ngangikwenza lokhu phambi kweNkosi; ngombana yena angikhethile ngaphezu kukababa wakho, noma ngaphezu komndeni wakhe wonke, ukuba ngibe ngumholi phezu kwamadodana kaYehova amaSirayeli; begodu ngizozijabulisa phambi kweNkosi.
Ngizokwenza ngibonakale ngingenangqondo kunalokhu, begodu ngizoba mkhulu emehlo ami; kodwana lezi zintatheli ozikhuluma ngazo, zizongihlonipha.
UMikhayeli, intombi kaSawule, akhenge abe nengane yonke imihla yakhe.
Wahlala ukumkani endlu yakhe, begodu ikosi wamnika isikhala kilabo bonke abasolwa bakhe ababhekene naye.
Wathi ukumkani kuNathani umprofeti, Thola, ngihlala enkabeni yendlu eyenziwe ngeqhwa, kodwana ibhokisi likaThixo lisesitezi.
Wathi uNathani kukumkani, Yiya, yenza konke okusenhliziyoni yakho; ngombana ikosi unguwe.
Kwathi ngaleyo busuku kwafika umlayezo kaYehova kuNathani, esithi,
Iya, utshele umkhonzi wami uDavide, bona, Uthi ikosi lokhu: Ingabe wena uzongikwakha indlu ngihlale kuyo?

Ngingase ngihlale endlini, kusukela ngosuku lapho ngakhipha khona amadodana aseSirayeli ezweni laseYiputa, kuze kube ngalolusuku; kodwana ngahamba ngendlu, ngasuka efuleni, ngasuka emgwaqweni, ngasuka enkabeni.

Ngapha nangaphi na lapho ngihamba khona, nami bonke abantu bakaSirayeli, ngathi yini kinanyana ubani wabaphathi bami, engiwiselayo ukuba alondoloze izwe lami uSirayeli, ngitjho, Kungani na bona ningangiqambi indlu yesedari?

Ngalokho manje uzokutshela umkhonzi wami uDavide, uthi, Uthi ikosi wamaSirayeli: Ngikuthathe wena ezindaweni zokudla izinkomo, ngakwesokunxele kwezinyoni, ngikwenza ube ngumholi phezu kwabantu bam, kwabaSirayeli.
Ngibe nawe kiwo onke amadolobha owahamba kiwo, ngazibulala zonke izitha zakho phambi kwakho; ngizokwenza igama lakho libe likhulu, njengegama lalabo abakhulu emhlabeni.
Ngizonikeza abantu bam, isiSirayeli, indawo sabo, ngibatshale, bahlale ezindaweni zabo, begodu bangaphazamiseki nhlobo; abantu ababi ngeke babonise ukulimala kwabo, njengombana bekwenze ekuqaleni.

Ngaleso sikhathi ngamisa abavikeli ukuba baqondise abantu bam, isiSirayeli; begodu ngizokulethela ukuthula ezindaweni zakho zokulwa zonke. uzimu uyakutshela bona uzokwakha indlu yakho, ikhaya lamabukhosi.
Uma amalanga zakho ziphelile, begodu uphumule nobaba bakho, ngizomisa omunye ophuma emilenzeni yakho kulandelana kwakho, begodu ngizoqinisa ukumkani wakhe.
Uzokwakha indlu igama lami, begodu ngizomisa isitulo sobukhosi bakhe kuze kube sekuphele isikhathi.
Ngizobe ngubaba wakhe, naye uzobe ngumntwana wami. Uma ekwenza okumbi, ngizomuqeqesha ngentambo, njengokuthi umuntu uqeqesha izingane zakhe, ngokudla izandla zabantu.
Kodwana inhlonipho yami ngeke ithathelwe kude naye, njengombana ngiyithathele kude noShawuli, ongeke ngiwususe ukuze ngikulungiselele indawo.
Umndeni wakho nobukhosi bakho bazohlala phambi kwami kuze kube sekupheleni; isitulo sakho sizohlala isikhathi eside.
Wathi uNathani kuDavide konke amazwi kaYehova, nalokhu okuboniswa kuye.
Waphuma ukumkani uDavide, wahlala phambi koYehova, wathi, Ngibani na mina, Kosi yami uzimu? Ingabe yini ikhaya lami, bona ungenza ngifike lapha?
Begodu, uma lokhu kungakude kuwe, Kosi yami uThixouNkulunkulu, ukhuluma begodu ngendlu yomkhonzi wakho kuze kube yisikhathi eside. Ingabe injalo indlela oyenza ngayo abantu, Kosi yami uThixouThixo?
Ngingakutshela yini wena, uDavide? Uyazi umkhonzi wakho, Kosi yami ikosi.
Ngenxa yezwi lakho, begodu ngenxa yothando lwakho, wenza zonke lezi zinto ezinkulu, ukuze uziveze kumkhonzi wakho.
Ngalokhu umkhulu, Kosi uzimu; akukho ofana nawe, begodu akukho uzimu ngaphandle kwakho. Siyakulalela ngezinzwa zethu.

Ingabe kukhona isizwe esisodwa emhlabeni esifana nabantu bakho baseSirayeli? Uye waphuma, Kosi, ukuwasindisa abe ngabantu bakho, ukuze udale igama lakho; wenze izinto ezinkulu nezimangazayo ezweni lakho phambi kwabantu bakho, owabasindise emazweni aseYiputa, kusukela ezizweni nakumagugu abo.
Wakwenza abantu bakho baseSirayeli babe bantu bakho kuze kube sekupheleni; wena, Kosi, waba nguThixo wabo.
Begodu manje, Kosi yami uzimu, uqinise ngokumilele igama lakho elishoyo ngomkhonzi wakho nomndeni wakhe, wenze njengokuthiwe.
Begodu igama lakho lizokhululwa kuze kube sekupheleni, bathi: UYehova wamaSirayeli nguThixo; begodu indlu yomkhonzi wakho uDavide ihlale iqinile phambi kwakho.
uzimu wamaSirayeli, ikosi wezizwe zonke, wena owaziveza umkhon obsesi wakho, uthi: 'Ngizokwakha indlu kuwe;' ngalokho lowo mkhonzi wakho wafumana inhliziyo yakhe yokuthandaza phambi kwakho.
Begodu manje, Kosi yami ikosi, wena uzimu; amazwi akho yiqiniso, begodu usho lokhu okuhle kumkhonzi wakho.

Ngalokho manje, ngiyakucela, ubambise ikhaya lomkhonzi wakho, ukuze lihlale phambi kwakho kuze kube sekupheleni; ngombana wena, Kosi yami ikosi, ukhuluma, begodu ngosizo lwakho ikhaya lomkhonzi wakho lizobanjwa kuze kube sekupheleni.
Ngemuva kwalokho uDavide wahlasela abaFilisti, wababeka ngaphasi kwesandla sakhe; wathatha iMethegi-amma, umzi wabo omkhulu, ebusweni babo.

Wahlasela begodu amaMowabi, wabeka abafileyo embhedeni emhlabeni, wabalinganisela ngentambo; amacala amabili entambo awabulala, kanti amacala amane ayephila. Baye babe ngabakhonzi bakaDavide, benikeza umnikelo wokudla.
UDavide wahlasela noHadarezere, unyana kaRehobhi, ukumkani waseSobha, lapho ehamba khona uHadarezere ukubuyisela isandla sakhe emfuleni i-Efrayi.
Wathi uDavide, wathatha kuye amaphoyisa ayizigidi ezingu-1, namadoda amakhulu angama-20. UDavidu wehlule wonke amahhashi emoto; kodwana wabagcina amabhasi ayikhulu elilodwa.
Bafika abaArami baseDamasku ukusiza uHadarezere ukumkani waseZoba; uDavide wabulala abantu abangumakhulu mahlanu namashumi amabili.
UDavide wabeka izikhulu ezweni lase-Aram, eDamasko; begodu aba-Aram babe ngabakhonzi bakhe, benikeza umnikelo wokudla. UYehova wamsindisa uDavide lapho aye khona.
UDavide wathatha izigqoko zegolide, abaphathi bakaHadarezere babezithwala, wabazisa eYerusalem.
UDavide ukumkani wathatha isiliva elikhulu khulu eBetha, naseBherothai, emizini kaHadarezere.
UTohi, ukumkani waseHamati, wazi bona uDavide wahlasela wonke umkhosi ka-Adarezere.

Wathumela uThoyi uYoram, unyana wakhe, kuye ukumkani uDavide, bona amhlelele, begodu amhlole ngenxa yokulwa kwakhe noHadarezere; ngombana uHadarezere ube nempi noToyi. UYoram wathumela isipho segolide, nesiliva, negolide, nensimbi.
UDavide ukumkani wanikela kubo ikosi, kanye negolide nesilivere ayezithola emazweni onke ayewanqoba:
Wathi uSolomoni: "Uzothola igolide, nesiliva, negolide elihlanzekile, kanye negolide elingenalutho; uzothola igolide, negolide elihlanzekile, kanye negolide elingenalutho.
UDavide waba mkhulu ngemuva kokuba ebuyela emdlalweni wokubulala abantu abangu-18,000 baseSiriya eValley of Salt.
Wabeka izikhulu ezweni lonke lase-Edom, begodu bonke abantu base-Edom babe ngabakhonzi bakaDavide. UYehova wasiza uDavide ngaso soke isikhathi lapho waya khona.
UDavide waba ngukumkani phezu kwamaSirayeli onke, ewenza umthetho nomthetho kiwo wonke abantu bakhe.
UYowabhi unyana kaZeruhiya ube yisikhulu somkhosi; uJehoshaphatu unyana ka-Ahilodi waba ngumbhali.
USadoko unyana ka-Ahitubhi, no-Akhimeleki unyana ka-Abhiyathari, babe ngabapristi; uSeraya waba ngumbhali wobukhosi.
UBenaya unyana kaYehoyada waba nguMengameli wamaKherethi nawamaPhelethi, ababambe iqhaza emkhosini wobukhosi. Abantwana bakaDavide babe ngabaphathi bakhe.
Wathi uDavide, Ingabe kukhona umuntu osele emndenini kaSawule, ukuze ngikwenzele uthando ngenxa kaYonathani?
Kwabe kukhona umkhonzi emndenini kaSawule, igama lakhe linguZiba; wabizwa kuye uDavide. Wathi ukumkani kuye, UyiSiba na? Waphendula wathi, Ngingumkhonzi wakho.
Wathi ukumkani, Ingabe kukhona umuntu osele emndenini kaSawule, ukuze ngikwenzele ukuthanda kukaThixo? UZiba wathi kukumkakhe: Kusekhona indodana kaYonathani enobuthakathaka emilenzeni.
Wathi ukumkani, Uphi yena? Wathi uTsiba, Bheka, usendlini kaMahiri unyana ka-Amiyeli, eLodebari.
Wathumela ukumkani uDavide, wamthola endlu kaMakhi unyana ka-Amiyeli, eLodebhari.
UMephiboshethi, unyana kaYonathani, umngane kaSawule, wafika kuDavide, wehla ngobuso bakhe phasi ezweni. Wathi uDavide, Mephiboshethi? Waphendula wathi, Ngingumkhonzi wakho.

Wathi uDavide kuye, Ungakhathazeki; ngombana ngizokwenza wena ubulungisa ngenxa kaYonathani ubaba wakho, begodu ngizokubuyisela zonke iimila zikaSawule ubaba wakho, nawe uzokudla ukudla embhedeni wami nsuku zonke.
UMephiboshethi wehla, wathi, Ngabe ngibani mina umkhonzi wakho, bona ubhekane nenja efile, njengami?
Wathi ukumkani wabiza uSiba, umkhonzi kaSawule, wathi kuye, Zonke izinto zikaSawule nezindlu zakhe ngizinikela kumntwana womnikazi wakho.

Uzoyivuna wena, nabangane bakho, nabenzi bakho; nawe uzoyivuna yena, begodu uzoyisusa, ukuze unyana wonkosi wakho abe nenyama yokudla; kodwana uMephiboshethi uzokudla njalo embhedeni wami. Waba uSiba unezingane ezilishumi elinamihlanu neziboshwa eziyishumi nambili.

Wathi uTsiba kukumkani, Ngokwezinto zonke owawuzitshela ngazo umphathi wami ukumkani, ngizozenza mina umkhonzi wakho. UMephiboshethi wadla ngokudla embhedeni kaDavide, njengomunye wabo bonke oonyana bakakumkani;
Wabe uMephiboshethi unendodana encane, igama layo nguMikha; bonke abahlala ekhaya likaSiba babe ngabakhonzi bakaMephiboseth.
Wahlala uMephiboshethi eYerusalem, ngombana wayedla nsuku zonke embhedeni kakumkani; yena ke waba nemilenze emibi.
Wafa ukumkani wakwa-Amoni, waba ngukumkani uHanuni unyana wakhe endaweni yakhe.

Wathi uDavide, Ngizobonisa inhlonipho kuHanuni unyana kaNahashi, njengokuba ubaba wakhe wenza inhlonipho kimi. UDavide wathumela abakhonzi bakhe ukuba bamthokozele uHanuni ngenxa yokufa kukayise. Bafika abakhonzi bakaDavide ezweni lama-Amoni,

Bathi abakhulu baka-Amoni kuHanuni umnikazi wabo, Uthi yini uDavide bona athande ubaba wakho ngokuthumela abantu ukukuthokozisa? Akunjalo, uDavide wathumela abantu ukuba babhekane nedolobha, ukuze lihlolwe, begodu libe yigugu.
Wathi uHanuni, athabathe abakhonzi bakaDavide, wamisa ikhanda labo ngaphesheya komlenze wabo, wamisa izigqoko zabo ngaphesheya komlenze wabo, wabasusa.

Wathi uDavide, lapho kwaziwa ngalolu daba, wathumela abantu ukuwathola; ngombana labo madoda babe necala elikhulu khulu. Wathi ukumkani kubo, Kuhlaleni eJericho kuze kukhule izinwele zenu, bese nibuya.

Babona oonyana baka-Amoni bona uDavide waba yindodana sabo, bathumela, baqasha amaAram asuka eBhethe-rehobothi, abantu abangumakhulu ayisishiyagalombili amawaka abahamba ngezinyawo; noSoba ukumkani waseMahaka, naye wafumana amadoda angukhulu elilodwa, namadoda angumashumi amabili namabili aseTobi.
UDavide, lapho ekhuluma ngalolu daba, wathumela uYowabu nomndeni wakhe wonke, abantu abakhulu.
Baphuma oonyana baka-Amoni, balungiselela ukulwa emgwaqweni wokungena edolobhaneni labo; begodu amaArami aseZobha, namaRehobhi, namadodana aseTobi, namaMaaka, ahlala ezindaweni ezingaphandle.

Wabona uYowabhi bona kukhona isibhamu esibhekene naye phambi kwakhe, kanye nesibhamu esibhekene naye emuva kwakhe; wakhetha abantu abangcono ukudlula bonke baseSirayeli, wabamisa eqenjini elibhekene nabaAram.
Wabeka okunye kwamadoda ngaphasi kwesandla sika-Abhishai, udadewabo; wabamisa ezindaweni zabo ukubhekana nabantu baka-Amoni.
Wathi uYowabha, Uma i-Aram inamandla kunami, wena uzongisiza; kodwana uma izingane zika-Amoni zinamandla kunawe, ngizokusiza.
Uhlale unamandla, begodu sihlale sinamandla ngenxa yezwe lethu, namadolobhana kaThixo wethu; begodu ikosi akwenze konke okumbi ngamehlo akhe.
Wafika uYowabhi namadodana akhe ukubhekana noSirayeli emdlalweni; begodu amaSirayeli ahambe phambi kwakhe.
Babona amadoda ase-Ammon bona ama-Aram ahambe, wabuya nalowo mkhosi phambi kuka-Abishai, waya edolobhaneni lakhe. Wabuyela uYowabhi emazweni ase-Ammon, wabuyela eYerusalem.
Babona amaSirayeli bona bahlaselwe, baphinde bahlangane nabo.
Wathumela uHadarezere, wabiza amaArami asendaweni esenyakatho yeMfula i-Ephrathi; bafika eHelamini; noShobhaki, umphathi womkhosi kaHadarezere, wayehamba phambi kwabo.
Bathi kuDavide, aqoqe wonke amaSirayeli, wadlula iJordani, waya eHelam; begodu abaAram balungiselela ukubhekana noDavide, bamhlasela.

Kwathi ama-Aram aphuma phambi kwaSirayeli. Wabulala uDavide kuma-Aram abantu abangumakhulu asixhenxe abaqhuba izithuthuthu, namaphesenti angamashumi amane amahhashi; wahlasela begodu uShobhaki, umphathi womkhosi wabo, waza wafa khona.
Babona bonke abavikeli bakaHadarezere bona iSirayeli ibanqobile, bamisa ukuthula nabaSirayeli, babe ngabakhonzi babo; begodu ama-Aram akhenge aphinde asize amadodana ka-Amoni.

Ngonyaka olandelayo, ngesikhathi amakhosana ephuma emkhosini, uDavide wathumela uYowabhi nabangane bakhe kanye nomndeni wonke wamaSirayeli; babulala oonyana baka-Amoni, bebhekene neRabha. UDavide wayehlala eYerusalem.
Ngosuku olulodwa uDavide wavuka embhedeni wakhe, wahamba phezu kwesitezi sendlu yasebukhosini. Kulesithezi wabona indodana igijima. Wayebukeka kahle khulu.
UDavide wathumela umuntu ukuba abuze bona ubani yena, wathi: "Ngabe akuyona le Batsheba, intombi kaEliyam, indodana kaUriya umHithi?"
UDavide wathumela abantu, wamthola. Wafika kuye, wahlala naye. Wayeqedile ukuhlanza isikhumba sakhe ngemuva kosuku lwakhe, wabuyela ekhaya lakhe.
Uwesifazane wakhulelwa, wathumela umbiko kuDavide, wathi, Ngikhulelwe.
UDavide wathumela umlayezo kuYowabhi, esithi, Thumela kuye uUriya umHithi. Wathumela uYowabhi uUriya kuDavide.
Wafika uUriya, uDavide wambuza bona uYowabhi usenjani, nokuthi abantu basenjani, nokuthi ikosi isenjani.
Wathi uDavide ku-Uriya, Yiya ekhaya lakho, uhlanze izinyawo zakho, uphumule. Waphuma ke u-Uriya, wathumela ukumkani umklomelo ngemuva kwakhe.
Kodwana uUriya akhenge ahambe, wahlala emnyango wendlu kankosi, nabenzi bonke bendlu yoyise.
Wathi uDavide, UUriya akayeki ekhaya lakhe. Wathi uDavide ku-Uriya, "Ubuyela uhambo; kungani ungayeki ekhaya?"

Wathi uUriya kuDavide, Isikhombi nesizwe sakwaSirayeli nakwaYuda sihlala ezindaweni zokuhlala; begodu umphathi wami uYowabhi, nabangani bakho, bahlale esidlangalaleni emgwaqweni. Ngabe ngizobuyela ekhaya ngidle, ngiphuze, ngiphumule nomfazi wami? Ngokuba uphila, ngeke ngikwenze lokhu.
Wathi uDavide ku-Uriya, Uhlale lapha usuku olulodwa; ngoMsombuluko ngizokususa. Wahlala ke u-Uriya eYerusalem ngalolusuku nosuku olulandelayo.

UDavide wamcela ukuba aphuze, begodu aphuze naye; uDavide wamshaya. Kwathi ngesikhathi sobusuku waphuma uUriya embhedeni wakhe, walala phakathi kwabakhonzi bakankosikazi wakhe, kodwana akhenge afike ekhaya lakhe.
UDavide wabhala incwadi kuYowabhi, wayithumela ngesandla sikaUriya.
Wabhala kulo mbhalo, wathi, Nquma uUriya ukuba abe ngaphambili, lapho kunzima khona ukunqoba; bese ubuyela emuva kuye, ukuze ahlaselwe, aphile.
Wathi uYowabhi, lapho ejikelezisa khona lo mzi, wabeka uUriya endaweni ebeyaziyo bona kukhona abantu abanamandla.
Baphuma abantu bedolobha, babhekana noYowabhi; kwabulawa abantu abaningi bakaDavide; wafa begodu uUriya umHithi.
UYowabhi wathumela uDavide incwadi egcwele yokulwa.
Wathi kumthunywa, "Uma uqedile ukutjela ukumkani konke mayelana nempi,
ukuze ukumkani angeke abe nomsindo, begodu akubuze bona, Kungani na ufike eduze kwedolobha ukunqoba? Ungazi yini bona bazoshaya amabhodlela esitezi?

Ubani owabulala u-Abhimeleki, unyana ka-Yerubheshethi? Akukhona yini bona indodana yakhe ibeke phezu kwakhe umkhonto omkhulu womshini osuka emgodini, ukuze aphile eThebesi? Kungani na ke bona ufike eduze komkhonto? Uma ebuza lokhu, uthi kuye, Umkhonzi wakho uUriya, umHeti, naye washona.
Wahamba umthunywa, watshela uDavide konke okushiwo nguYowabhi.
Wathi umthunywa kuDavide, Amadodana aseSirayeli anamandla kunathi; kwaphuma ezindaweni ezivulekile ukuba abhekane nathi, kodwana sawabuyisela emuva kuze kufike emgwaqeni wesango.
Bathi labo abashaya izibhamu, baphoqa abakhonzi bakho phezulu edonga; kwabulawa abanye abantu bakakumkani; wafa begodu umkhonzi wakho uUriya, umHiti.

Wathi uDavide kumthunywa, Usho lokhu kuYowabhi, sithi: Akufanele ukhathazeke ngalolu daba; ngombana ikhebula libulala umuntu nomuntu; cindezela umzi, uyikhulule. Uzoqinisa inhliziyo kaYowabhi ngalokhu.
Uthe indodana ka-Uriya ikwazi bona u-Uriya, umkakhe, ufile, yathandaza.

UDavide, lapho amalanga zesikhumbuzo zadlula khona, wathumela afike wamthola, wam obseshela ekhaya lakhe; waba nguwesifazane wakhe, wazalelwa yena unyana. Kodwana lokhu okwakwenza uDavide kwakungathandeki kukaNkulunkulu.
Wathumela ikosi uNathani kuDavide. Wafika yena uNathani, wathi kuye, Kwabakhona abantu ababi emzini owodwa; omunye wayemnene, omunye waba mnyama.
Umuntu ocebile wayenezinkomo nezimbuzi eziningi.

Umfazi wesihlwele akhenge abe nento, ngaphandle komngane wakhe omncane umfazi, owathenga, wawukhula naye nabantwana bakhe; wadla emgodini wakhe, waphuza ebhodlela lakhe, walala enhliziyweni yakhe; waba njengomntwana.

Ngosuku olulodwa, kwafika umshayeli evakashela umuntu ocebile. Umuntu ocebile akafuni ukuthatha enye yezinkomo zakhe noma izinkomo zokupheka umshayeli wakhe. Kodwana-ke, wathatha ingulube yowesifazane omdlayo, wayipheka yomntu owafika kuye."
UDavide wehla emlonyeni wakhe, wathi kuNathani, Ngokuba uphila ikosi, lowo muntu owenza lokhu kumele abulawe.
Uzophinde abuyisele izinkomo ezine ngenxa yalo, ngombana wenza into enjalo, begodu akhenge abe nethando!
Wathi uNathani kuDavide, Awukho wena lowo muntu; lokhu kusho ikosi, uzimu kaSirayeli: Ngikunqume ukuba ube ngukumkani phezu kwaSirayeli, begodu ngikusindise esandla sikaSawule.
Ngikulethela indlu yomnikazi wakho, begodu ngazibeka izifazane zomnikazi wakho ezinyaweni zakho; ngikulethela abantu baseSirayeli nabaseYuda. Uma lokhu bekuncane kuwe, ngingakunika okuningi.
Kungani na ke bona ukhohlise ilizwi likaYehova, wenze okumbi emehlo akhe? Wabulala ngeqhwa uUriya umHithi, wathatha indodana yakhe ube nguwesifazane wakho; wawumshaya ngeqhwa lamadodana ka-Amoni.
Ngalokho manje ikhebula alizoshiya indlu yakho, kuze kube yilapho; ngombana ungisizile, wathatha indodana ka-Uriya umHithi, abe ngumfazi wakho.

Uthi ikosi bona, Ngizokulethela izinkinga ezisuka emndenini wakho; begodu ngizozithatha izifazane zakho phambi kwamehlo akho, ngizinikeze umngane wakho, naye uzolala nazo emehlweni elanga. Uzohlala namadodakazi akho, begodu uzowathanda.
Ukwenzele isono sakho efihlakeleni; kodwana ngizokwenza lokhu ngokucacile phambi kwabaSirayeli bonke, emini.
Wathi uDavide kuNathani, "Ngihlulekile phambi koYehova." Waphendula uNathani wathi kuDavide, "uzimu wasusa isono sakho; awuzofa.
Kodwana-ke, ngenxa yokuthi ukwenzele izitha zikaYehova bona zikhulume ngaye ngomsebenzi wakho, lo mwana ozalwa kuwe uzofa.
Wabuyela uNathane ekhaya lakhe. UYehova wabulala umntwana, owazalwa nguwesifazane ka-Uriya kuDavide; waba buhlungu khulu.
UDavide wathandaza kuThixo ngenxa yomntwana, waphuma ehamba engadli ukudla, wafika, waphumula emhlabathini.
Wathi uSolomon, "Ngikutshele," waphendula yena, "uzimu akakwazi ukukwenza lokhu. uzimu akakwazi ukukwenza lokho."

Ngosuku oluyisixhenxe lo mntwana wafa. Baze abakhonzi bakaDavide bakhathazeka ukutjela uDavide bona lo mntwana ufile, bathi: "Sithe sakhuluma noDavide lapho lo mntwana ephila khona, kodwana akhenge asiqonde. Ngabe sizokwazi yini ukumtshela bona lo mntwana ufile? Mhlawumbe uzokwenza okuthile ukuze agweme ingozi."
UDavide, nakabona bona abakhonzi bakhe bekhalana phakathi kwabo, waqonda bona ingane ibifile. Wathi uDavide kubakhonzi bakhe: "Ingane ibifile yini?" Baphendula bathi: "Yakufa."
UDavide wavuka ezweni, wahlamba, wagqoka ukhilimu, washintsha izicathulo zakhe, waya endlwini kaYehova, wathandaza. Wabuyela ekhaya lakhe, wacela ukudla; banikela kuye, yena wadla.
Bathi kuye abakhonzi bakhe, Kungani na ukwenze lokhu? Lapho ingane iphila, wayeka ukudla, wanyamalala ngenxa yayo; kodwana manje lapho ingane ifile, uvuka udle!
Waphendula uDavide, wathi, Uma ingane iphila, ngapheka, ngalile; ngombana ngitjho, Ubani owaziyo? Kungenzeka bona ikosi angaba nenhlonipho kimi, ukuze ingane iphile.
Kodwana manje ufile; kungani ngiya ngaphandle kokudla? Ingabe ngizomubuyisela emuva? Ngosuku olulodwa ngizohamba kuye, kodwana yena ngeke abuye kum.
UDavide waxolisa uBhatshebha indodana yakhe, wahlala naye, waza wazala unyana, wathi uDavide igama lakhe nguSolomoni. UYehova wamthanda lo mntwana.
Wathumela amazwi ngesandla sikaNathani umprofeti, wathi: Kubhekwe igama lakhe bona yiJedidiya; ngombana ikosi wamthanda yena.
UYowabhi wayehlasela iRabha, isixeko sama-Amoni, wathatha indawo eqinile yobukhosi.
UYowabhi wathumela abathunywa kuDavide, esithi, Nginqobe i-Rabha, begodu ngithole amanzi ayo.
Ngokuba namuhla, hlanganisa konke okuseleyo kwamadodana akho, ujikeleze lo mzi, uyithathe; uma kungenjalo, ngiwuthathe, begodu igama lami libhekwe kulo.
UDavide waqoqa wonke amaphoyisa, waya eRabha, wahlasela, wayithatha.
Wathatha isibhamu ekhanda lakhe, wamisa phezu kwakhe; kwakungugolide oluyi kilogramu elilodwa nesishiyagalombili, begodu lalinezingcezu zegolide. UDavide waba nempahla enkulu khulu emzini wakhe.

Wakhipha abantu bayo, wababeka ezindaweni zokusika, nasezikhungweni zensimbi, naseziqhingini zensimbi, begodu wababeka ezindaweni zokwakha amatshe; wakwenza njalo kiwo wonke lamadolobha ka-Amoni. Wabuyela uDavide nomndeni wakhe wonke eYerusalem.
Ngosuku oluthile, u-Amnoni, unyana kaDavide, wathandana noThamari; yena wayeyinkosikazi ebukekayo kaAbsalomu, omunye unyana kaDavide.
U-Amnoni wayemthanda khulu uTamari, indodakazi yakhe, wukuthi wayeyindodana yowesifazane; ngalokho kwabonakala ku-Amnoni sengathi angeke akwenzela into.
U-Amnoni ubenomngane okuthiwa nguJonadabu, unyana kaShimeha, udadewabo kaDavide; yena uJonadabu wayengumntu owaziyo khulu.
Wathi ku-Amnoni, Uye unyana wobukhosi; kungani ubona isikhumba sakho sibuhlungu nsuku zonke? Ingabe awufuni ukungitshela? Wathi u-Amnoni kuye, Ngithanda uThamari, inkosikazi kaAbsalomu umngane wami.

Wathi yena uJonadabu kuye, Thola isibhedlela sakho, uyeke ukuba nesifo; begodu uma ubaba wakho efika ukukubona, uthi kuye, Ngicela, ifike inkosikazi yami uThamari, ingisise ukudla, ilungiselele ukudla phambi kwami, ukuze ngiyibone, ngiyidle ngesandla sayo.

U-Amnhon wehla, wacabanga bona unesifo. Wafika ukumkani ukuwubona, wathi u-Amnhon kunkosikazi yakhe uThamari: "Kuze kufike inkosikazi yami iTamari, ilungiselele amakhowe amabili phambi kwami, ngiyidle ngesandla sayo."
UDavide wathumela uThamari endlu yakhe, esithi, Iya ekhaya lika-Amnoni umngane wakho, ukwenzele ukudla.
Wahamba uThamari waya endlwini ka-Amnhon, indodana yakhe; yena ke wayesembhedeni. Wathatha umhluzi, wawumisa, wakwenza amakhowe phambi kwakhe, wawabhaka.
Wathatha i-pan, wazisa kuye; kodwana yena akakwazi ukudla. Wathi uAmnhon, Ushiye wonke umuntu phandle, begodu bonke abantu baphuma phandle.
Wathi uAmnhon kuThamari, Thola ukudla egumbini lokuphumula, ukuze ngidle ngesandla sakho. Wathatha uThamari amakhowe ayewalungiselele, wazisa ku-Amnhon udadewabo egumbini lokuphumula.
Yathi, uma yazinikela kuye ukuba azidle, wagwema, wathi: "Yaza uphumule nami, inkosikazi yami!"
Wathi yena kuye, Hayi, nkosikazi yami, ungangikhohlisi; ngombana lokhu akufanele kwenzeke eSirayeli; awudingi ukwenza lo msindo.
Ngizoya kuphi ngengcindezi yami, begodu uzoba njengomunye wabakhohlisi ababi khulu eSirayeli? Nceda, ukhulume nokumkani; ngeke akuvimbele bona ungaba indodana yami.
Kodwana-ke, akhenge ayiqonde. Wayenamandla khulu kunaye, ngalokho wamcindezela waza wamgxeka.
Wathi ke uAmnhon, Uyamthanda khulu; wamthanda khulu kunalokho ayemthandela ngawo. Wathi yena uAmnhon kuye, Yiya phuma!
Wathi yena kuye, Akunjalo; uma ungenza lokhu namuhla, kukhulu kunalokho okwenze kimi ngaphambilini. Kodwana yena akhenge ayiqonde.
Wabiza umkhonzi wakhe, wathi: "Thinakele lo mfazi enhliziyweni yami, bese uvala ifasitela ngemuva kwakhe."
Wayegqoka ihembe elinobude obude, elinemilenze emide; ngombana udadewabo wesifazane wokumkani wayegqoka njalo. Wathi umkhonzi wakhe, wamkhipha emgwaqeni, wavala isikhala ngemuva kwakhe.
Wathi uThamari, wabeka inkungu phezu kwekhanda lakhe, waxosha isigqoko sakhe, wabeka isandla sakhe phezu kwekhanda lakhe, waphuma ehamba, ekhala ngokukhulu.

UAbsalome udadewabo wathi kuye, Ingabe u-Amnhon udadewabo wahlala nawe? Ngalokho-ke, nkosikazi yami, uhlale uphumule; yena udadewabo. Ngalokho uThamari wahlala ekhaya likaAbsalom echukuthele, ekhathazekile khulu.
Kwathi lapho ukumkani uDavide ekhuluma ngalolu daba lonke, waxosha khulu.
U-Absalomu akhenge akhulume no-Amnhon, lutho oluhle noma olubi; ngombana u-Absalomu wayemthanda khulu u-Amnhon, ngenxa yokuthi u-Amnhon wamisa inkosikazi yakhe uThamari.
Kwathi ngemuva kweminyaka emibini, kwabe sekuyisikhathi sokuthi uAbsalomu alungise izinkomo zakhe eBhaali-hazori, elinokude noEfrayim; wabiza uAbsalomu bonke oonyana bakakumkani.
Wafika uAbsalomu kuye ukumkani, wathi, Izinyoni zami zinesikhathi sokuzihlanza; ungase ungene nami, ngiyakucela, ukumkani nabangani bakhe?

Wathi ukumkani ku-Absalomu, Akunjalo, unyana wami; ngeke sihambe soke, ngombana singaba wubunzima kuwe. U-Absalomu waqhubeka nokumcindezela, kodwana ukumkani akhenge ahambe, kodwana wabambisana ngu-Absalomu.
Wathi uAbsalomu, Uma ungahambanga, ngikucela bona umngane wami uAmnhon ahambe nathi. Wathi yena ukumkani kuye, Kungani nakuthi ahambe nawe?
U-Absalomu waqhubeka nokumcindezela, wathi ukumkani uvumele u-Amnhon nezingane zakhe zonke zihambe naye.

U-Absalomu wabatjela abakhonzi bakhe, wathi, "Khumbulani uAmnhon; uma ethanda iwayini, begodu ngitjho kuni, 'Phikisa uAmnhon', khona-ke nimwisele. Ungakhathazeki, ngombana ngiyakubuza lokhu; zinikele, nibe nobuhlakani!"
Bathi abakhonzi baka-Absalomu ku-Amnoni, njengokuthi u-Absalomu abewiselayo; bavuka ke bonke oonyana bokumkani, behamba ngazo izingulube zabo, basuka.
Bakhona behamba ngendlela, kwafika udaba kuDavide, bathi, UAbsalomu wabulala bonke oonyana bakakumkani; akhenge ashiye omunye wabo.
Waphuma khona ukumkani, waxosha izigqoko zakhe, wehla phasi ezweni; nabo bonke abakhonzi bakhe babekhona bexosha izigqoko zabo.

Wathi uJonadabu, unyana kaShimeah, umngane kaDavide, uthi: Unkosi wami, akushonga bona babulala bonke abaphathi abancane, oonyana bakakumkani; uAmnhon kuphela owafa; ngombana uAbsalom echukucele lokhu kusukela ngosuku lapho uAmnhon eshaya khona iTamari, indodakazi yakhe.
Ngalokho-ke, kosi yami ukumkani, akusho bona bonke izingane zakho zifile; uAmnhon kuphela obefile.
U-Absalomu ke wabaleka, begodu umshayeli ohlala ebhekene naye waphakamisa amehlo akhe, wabona abantu abaningi bephuma emgwaqeni, besuka enkabeni yedolobha, bevela emuva kwakhe.
Wathi uJonadabu kukumkani, Thola, bafika oonyana bakakumkani; njengombana umkhonzi wakho atjhilo, njalo.
Kwathi lapho eqedile khona ukukhuluma, kwafika oonyana bakakumkani, bekhala ngezwi elikhulu; begodu ukumkani nabangane bakhe bonke bathandaza ngezwi elikhulu.
U-Absalomu wabaleka, waya ku-Talmai, unyana ka-Amihudi, ukumkani waseGeshuri. UDavide wayemsola unyana wakhe ngosuku ngalunye.
UAbsalomu wehla waya eGeshuri, wahlala khona iminyaka emithathu.
Ubukhosi bukaDavide bufuna ukubuya ku-Absalomu, ngombana udadewabo ka-Amnoni washona.
UYowabhi unyana kaZeruhiya wabona bona inhliziyweni yokumkani ifuna uAbsalomu.

Wathumela uYowabhi eTekoa, wafumana khona indodana yomuntu owaziyo, wathi kuye: Ngikucela, yenza bona ukhathazekile; gqoka izicathulo zobuhlungu, ungasebenzisi i-lotion; yenza ukuba sengathi unguwesifazane ohlupheke ngenxa yomshado wakhe.
Hamba ufike kukumkani, ukhulume naye ngalolu daba. Wathi uYowabhi wathi kuye zonke izinto azikhulumayo;
Wafika uwesifazane waseTekoa kuye ukumkani, wehla ngobuso bakhe phasi ezweni, wanikela, wathi, Usizo lwami, kosi yami.
Wathi ukumkani kuye, Yini le nto? Yathi yena, Ngiyindodakazi yowesifazane; indodana yami ifile.
Nginezingane ezimbili, ngingumkhonzi wakho; babhekana ndawonye emhlabathini, kwakungekho muntu ozobahlukanisa phakathi kwabo; omunye wahlasela owodwa, wambulala.

Ngabona bona imindeni sabo yonke ibhekene nami, umkhonzi wakho. Bathi: "Ninikele udadewethu owabulala udadewabo, ukuze sigweme ukubulawa kwakhe ngenxa yokubulala udadewabo; begodu ngaleyo le sigweme nomuntu ozoba ngumzali wakhe." Bafuna ukumsusa lo mphefumulo wami osele, bashiye indodana yami ingabi negama, begodu angeke kube khona umuntu ozoyigcina inkosikazi yakhe ezweni.
Wathi ukumni kuye indodakazi yakhe, "Uya ekhaya lakho, begodu ngizokunikeza umyalo ukuze uvikele."
Wathi uwesifazane waseTekoa kuye ukumkani, Kosi yami, ukumkani, inkohliso ihlale kimi, nendlu yobaba wami; kodwana ukumkani nobukhosi bakhe bangabi.
Wathi ukumni, "Uma kukhona umuntu okhuluma nawe, umveze kimi, begodu ngeke ubuhlungu kuwe nhlobo."

Wathi yena, Ngicela bona ukumkani akhulume noYehova uzimu wakho, ukuze lo ndodana ofuna ukuxosha angaphinde abulala, begodu asuse unyana wami. Wathi ukumkani, Uphila ikosi, ngeke izinwele ezincane zekhanda lengane yakho ziwele ezweni.
Wathi uwesifazane, Ngicela ngivumele umkhonzi wakho bona akhulume lutho kunkosi yami ukumkani. Wathi, Yiya.
Wathi uwesifazane, Kungani na ke bona ucabangele lokhu ebantwini bakaThixo? Uma ukhuluma njalo, wena uqobo lwakho uyagwema; ngombana awukhombisenga unyana wakho owawuwushiyela.

Sizofa soke. Siyafana nendabuko amanzi aqhutshwa ezweni, okuyinto ayikwazi ukuqoqwa kabutjha. Kodwana uzimu akusho kuphela ukususa impilo. Ngezinye izikhathi, yena enza izindlela ukuze umuntu othunyelwe ngaphandle ukuba ahlale ihlukaniswe naye.
Ngiye ngathi, ngizokhuluma nomkakhe ukumkani; ngombana abantu bami banquma ukungikhohlisa. Ngathi ke, ngiyakutjela umkakhe: Ingabe ungenza lokho engikushoyo?
Kungenzeka bona ukumkani uzongilalela, begodu ungisindise kulowo muntu ofuna ukuncipha ngami nonyana wami ezweni uzimu awasinikele.
Ngitjho, Izwi lomphathi wami ukumkani lizongisiza; ngombana umphathi wami ukumkani ufana nensindiso kaThixo, ekwazi ukuhlukanisa okumbi nokuhle; begodu ikosi uzimu wakho abe nawe.
Wathi ukumkani kuye indodakazi yakhe, Ungangifihlanga lutho ngikubuze ngalo. Wathi indodakazi yakhe, Nakhuluma unkosi wami umkakhe.

Wathi ukumkani, UYowabhi yini owakwenza lokhu konke? Waphendula uwesifazane, wathi, Kuphila inhliziyo yakho, kosi yami, bona ngeke kube khona umuntu osuka ngakwesokudla noma ngakwesobunxele kinanyana yini oyikhulumayo; kodwana umkhonzi wakho uYowabhi, yena owayengitshela bona ngikwenze lokhu, wabeka amazwi onke emlonyeni wami.
Ukwenze lokhu umkhonzi wakho uYowabhi, ukuze ashintshe izinto; kodwana unkosi wami unomcabango ofana nomphefumulo kaMoya oNgcwele; nawe uyazi zonke izinto eziphilako emhlabeni.
Wathi ukumkani kuYowabhi, Kulungile, ngizokwenza; uye, ubuyisele lo mshado ka-Absalomu.
UYowabhi wehla ngobuso bakhe phasi ezweni, wahlaba umxhwele, wabambisa ukumkani. Wathi uYowabhi, Namuhla ngiyazi bona unesifiso esihle ngami, kosi yami ukumkani, ngombana ukwenze lokho engikushoyo.
Waphuma uYowabhi, waya eGeshuri, wabuyisela uAbsalomu eYerusalem.
Wathi ukumkani, Uzobuyela ekhaya lakhe; ngeke afike angibone. Wahamba ke uAbsalome endlwini yakhe, kodwana akakubonanga ukumkani.
Ezweni lonke lakwaSirayeli, kwakungekho umuntu onjalo njengo-Absalome, owaziwa ngokubukeka kwakhe okuhle. Kusuka ngezansi kwezinyawo zakhe kuze kube phezulu kwekhanda lakhe, akukho okumbi kuye.

Wathi uSolomon, "Uzothatha izinwele zakhe, begodu uzozigqoka, begodu uzozihlanza." Kwathi lapho ephelile ngonyaka, wamisa izinwele zakhe; ngombana kwakunzima khulu kuye,třidceti amashekeli ayizinkulungwane ezimbili.
UAbsalome ubenonyana abathathu nenkosikazi eyodwa; igama lenkosikazi yakhe lalinguThamari, indodana ebukekayo.
Wahlala uAbsalome eYerusalem iminyaka emibini yonke, engabonanga ukumkani.
Wathumela uAbsalomu, wabiza uYowabhi, ukuba amthumele ukumkani; kodwana uYowabhi akaze afike kuye. Wathumela ke uAbsalomu kathathu, naye akaze afike.

Wathi uAbsalomu kwabakhonzi bakhe, Khabhani, indawo kaYowabhi ingaphansi kwendawo yami; yena unesithelo esikhulayo khona; chofoza, uyifake emlilweni. Bathi abakhonzi baka-Absalomu bafaka emlilweni indawo yomhlaba.
Wafika uYowabhi endlwini ka-Absalomu, wathi kuye, Kungani na bona abakhonzi bakho bafake umlilo ezweni lami?

Wathi uAbsalomu kuYowabha, "Ngikuthumelele umlayezo wokuthi ufike lapha; ngikuthumelele wena ukumkani, ngitjho kuye, 'Ngabe ngibuye ngisuka eGeshure? Kungcono bona ngihlale khona.' Manje ke ngizobona ukumkani; uma kukhona okumbi kimi, angeke angibulala."
