Waphuma uYowabhi, waya kukumkani, wamtshela konke lokhu. Ukumkani wabiza uAbsalomu; wafika uAbsalomu, wehlisa ikhanda lakhe ezweni phambi komkakhe, umkakhe ke wamisa uAbsalomu.
Ngemuva kwalokho, uAbsalomu wafumana imoto, namabhubesi, nabantu abangumashumi amane abahamba phambi kwakhe.

Ube evuka ekuseni, uhlala enhliziyweni yendlela eya emgwaqeni wedolobha; begodu uma umuntu efika nodaba kuye ukumkani ukuba agweme isinqumo, uAbsalomu wayembiza wathi, "Usukaphi lo mzi?" Waphendula lowo muntu wathi, "Ngingumunye wesizwe sakwaSirayeli."
Wathi ke uAbsalomu, Thola bona isinqumo sakho silungile, begodu sifanele; kodwana ukumkani akakho umuntu ozokulalela.
Wathi uAbsalomu, Ngingathanda ukuba ngibe ngummeli kule lizwe, ukuze wonke umuntu onecala noma isinqumo sizofika kimi, begodu ngibona bona kuzoba khona inkohliso.
Kuze kube lapho umuntu efika khona bona athandeke kuye, u-Absalomu wamisa isandla sakhe, wamqamba, wamxola.
Wakwenza njalo uAbsalomo kiwo wonke amaSirayeli afika enkantolo kukumkani; ngale le wafumana inhlonipho yabantu baseSirayeli.
Kwathi sekudlule iminyaka emashumi mane, uAbsalomu wathi kukumkani, Ngicela ngiye eHebroni, ukuze ngikhokhele isipho engiyinikela kuYehova.
Ngibe sengihlala eGeshuru, eAram, ngibulale isibopho umkhonzi wakho, ngitjho, Uma ikosi engibabuyisela eYerusalem, ngizokhonza ikosi.
Wathi ukumkani kuye, Yiya ngokuthula. Wavuka ke, waya eHebroni.
U-Absalomu wathumela abathunywa ezindaweni zonke zakwaSirayeli, esithi, Uma nje nikulalela umsindo wezinkomo, sithi, U-Absalomu ungumnikazi eHebroni.
Kwaya no-Absalomo amadoda amakhulu amabili eYerusalem, ayemenywe ukuba abe ngabangani. Baye bahamba ngeqiniso labo, bengazi bona kwenzekani.

UAbsalomu, lapho enikela khona izinyamazane, wathumela wathi ku-Ahitopheleli waseGilo, umcebisi kaDavide, bona afike eGilo, emzini wakhe. Nokho isinqumo saqhubeka sinamandla, begodu abantu baphinde bakhula besuka ku-Absalomu.
Kwafika umthunywa kuDavide, wathi, Intliziyo yabantu bakaSirayeli idlulile ku-Absalomu.

Wathi uDavide kubo bonke abakhonzi bakhe ababe naye eYerusalem, Yiya, sihambe; uma kungenjalo, ngeke sibe nomuntu ongeke aphume phambi kuka-Absalomu; zinikele; uma kungenjalo, uzosifinyelela ngokushesha, aze asiholele izinkinga, abulala abantu bedolobha ngeqhwa.
Baphendula abakhonzi bakakumkani, bathi kuye, Kuzo zonke izinto ezithethwa ngummelwane wethu ukumkani, bona abakhonzi bakho.
Waphuma ke ukumkani, naye wonke umndeni wakhe umlandela; kodwana washiya amakhosikazi akhe amashumi amabili, ukuba agcine indlu.
Waphuma ukumkani, nabantu bonke abalandelana naye, bahlala efulethini elilodwa.

Nabo bonke abaphathi bakhe badlula ngaphesheya kwakhe, kanye nabo bonke amaKherethi, namaPhelethi, amaphoyisa kabukhosi; nalabo bantu abangumakhulu ayisishiyagalombili baseGiti, ababemlandela eGathi, badlula ngaphesheya kukankosi.
Wathi ukumkani ku-Itai waseGiti, Yini bona ukhambe nathi? Yibuye, uhlale nokumkani omusha; ngombana wena ungumzweli, uphuma ezweni lakho; buyela endaweni yakho.
Ngiyakwenza yini bona ukhambe nathi namhlanje, uma ngingazi lapho ngizohamba khona? Yeka, uze uthathe nabangane bakho nawe; begodu ikosi akubonise wena inhlonipho yakhe neqiniso lakhe.
Waphendula u-Itai ukumkani, wathi, Uphila ikosi, begodu uphila umphathi wami ukumkani; lapho uzobe khona umphathi wami ukumkani, noma kuphila, noma kufa, khona-ke nomsebenzi wakho uzobe khona.
Wathi uDavide ku-Itai, Yiya, dlula. Wadlula ke u-Itai waseGiti, naye wonke amadoda akhe, nabantwana bonke ababenabo.
Kwathi abantu bonke basezweni bashaya ngezwi elikhulu, lapho abantu bonke bedlula khona. Wadlula ukumkani umlambo iKidron, begodu abantu bonke badlula emgwaqeni osuka esiqhingini.

Kwabe khona begodu uTsadoki, nalabo bonke abaLevi naye, bethwala isibambo somthetho kaThixo; bamisa isibambo somthetho kaThixo, noAbhiyathari enikela ngenhlanhla, kuze kube sekuphele abantu bonke ukuphuma emzini.
Wathi ukumkani kuSadoko, Yibuyisele ibhokisi likaThixo edolobhaneni; uma ikosi engithande, uzongibuyisela begodu angibonise ibhokisi nendawo yayo.
Kodwana uma ethi, Ngingakujabuleli wena, khona-ke lapha ngikhona; akwenze ngami lokho okubona bona kulungile.
Wathi ukumkani kuTsadoki umbingeleli, Ingabe ungumfundi owaziyo izinto azenzayo uzimu? Yiya edolobhaneni ngokuthula, wena noAhimahazi unyana wakho, noYonathani unyana ka-Abhiyathar.
Ngizobe ngilinde ezindaweni zokudlula emfuleni ezindleleni kuze kube yilapho ngithola umlayezo kusuka kuwe okhuluma ngalokho okuqhubekayo.
Wathi uTsadoki noAbhiyathari babuyisela ibhokisi likaThixo eYerusalem, bahlala khona.

UDavide wanyuka waya eMfuleni wama-Olivi, ekhala emehlweni lapho ehamba khona. Wagqoka ikhanda lakhe, wahamba ngezandla zakhe zodwa; begodu bonke abantu ababenabo bagqoke ikhanda labo, bathandaza lapho behamba khona.
Wathi uDavide, sithi, U-Ahitofeli ungumunye walezo zikhulu ezifuna ukulwa no-Absalomu. Wathandaza uDavide, wathi, Kosi yami, ngicela ukwenze isinqumo sika-Ahitofeli sibe yingozi.

Kwathi lapho uDavide efike esiphethweni somfula, lapho abantu bethandaza khona kuThixo, ngabona bona uHushayi umArki ufika ukubhekana naye, enezicathulo zakhe zilahlekile, nenyama phezu kwekhanda lakhe.
Wathi uDavide kuye, Uma uhamba nami, uzongibiza umthwalo;
kodwana uma ubuyela edolobhaneni, uthi ku-Absalomu, Ngizoba ngumkhonzi wakho, ukumkani; ngibe umkhonzi wobaba wakho, kodwana manje ngizoba umkhonzi wakho; khona-ke uzongisusa isinqumo sika-Ahitofele.
Bakhona nawe khona lapho uTsadoki noAbhiyathari, abapristi; khuluma kubo konke okubona endlu kabukhosi.
Bheka, izingane zabo ezimbili zikhona nabo: uAhimahazi unyana kaSadoko, noYonathani unyana kaAbhiyathari; thumelani kubo konke okubonayo.
Wafika ke uHushai, umngane kaDavide, edolobhaneni, ngesikhathi uAbsalomu efika eYerusalem.

UDavide wadlula eduze kophahla oluphezulu, khona-ke kwafika uSiba, umkhonzi kaMephiboshethi, wambhekana naye, enezinkomo ezimbili ezishisayo, ezithwale amakhowe angumakhulu amabili, namakhowe ayizinkulungwane, nezithelo zehlobo eziyikhulu, nebhodlela eligcwele iwayini.

Wathi ukumkani kuZiba, Ziyini lezi? Waphendula uZiba, wathi, Izinkomo ziyimpahla yomndeni wakwakumkakhe, ukuze bahambe ngazo; nenyama kanye nezithelo zehlobo ziyimpahla yabangane, ukuze ba echukumise; begodu iwayini liyimpahla yomuntu onqabile esiqhingini, ukuze anywe.
Wathi ukumkani, Uphi unyana kankosi yakho? Waphendula uTsiba ukumkani wathi, Yabona, useJerusalema; ngombana uthe, Namuhla abantu bakaSirayeli bazongibuyisela ibukhosi bukayise.
Wathi umbingeleli ku-Ziba, "Izinto zonke ezithunyelwe nguMephiboshethi manje ziyizinto zakho." Wathi umbingeleli ku-Ziba, "Ngizibophezela kuwe. Ngizokujabulela njalo, umkakhe ukumkani."
Kwafika uDavide ukumkani eBahurim, khona-ke kwaphuma umfazi wesizwe sikaSawule, igama lakhe belinguShimehi unyana kaGera, waya emzini wakhe, wavuma uDavide.
Wakhipha amatshe kuDavide, nakwabo bonke abaphathi bokumkani uDavide; kodwana bonke abantu, namadoda amakhulu, aye ngakwesokudla kwakhe nakwesobunxele kwakhe.
Wathi uShimeyi, lapho enquma khona, phuma, phuma, wena obulalayo, wena umuntu ongalungile!

uzimu ukulethela wena igazi lonke lomndeni kaSawule, wena owawungukumkani endaweni yakhe; begodu manje ikosi unqume ukunika ukumkani uAbsalomu, unyana wakho. Thola sewuphelile ngenxa yobubi bakho, ngombana ungumshoshi!
Wathi u-Abhishai, unyana kaZeruya, kukumkani, Kungani na bona isilwane esifile sibulale umkakhe ukumkani? Ngizohamba ngiyithathe intamo yakhe.

Wathi ukumkani, Ingabe le nto ingumsebenzi wenu yini, nina oonyana baka-Zeruya? Uma efuna ukungibulala; ngombana ikosi wathi kuye, Ubulele uDavide. Ngawuphi umuntu ongeke ambuze bona, Kungani na ukwenza lokhu?

Wathi uDavide ku-Abhishai, nakwabo bonke abakhonzi bakhe: "Lo ndodana wami, igazi lami nenyama yami, ifuna ukungibulala; begodu lo mntu waseBhenjamini usekhona, ukuze akwenze lokhu. Uzohamba naye, begodu uzoma, ngombana ikosi wakhuluma kuye.
Kungenzeka bona ikosi abone ukubi okungenziwa ngami, begodu anikeze lutho oluhle endaweni yokunambitheka kwami namhlanje.
UDavide namadodana akhe baqhubeka behamba ngendlela; uShimeyi ke ehamba ngaphesheya komfula, emgqeni obhekene naye, ephazamisa, ephoqa amatshe kuye, ephoqa umhlabathi entwasahlobo.
Wafika khona ukumkani, naye wonke abantu ababenabo, ephazamiseke khulu; waphumula khona.
Wafika uAbsalome, naye wonke amadoda aseSirayeli, eYerusalem; no-Ahitofeli waye naye.
Wafika uHushai, umngane kaDavide wase-Arkhi, ku-Absalomu, wathi kuye: Ubukhosi buphile! UMbuso buphile!
Wathi uAbsalomu kuHushayi, Ingabe lokhu kungenxa yobuhlobo bakho nomngane wakho? Kungani na ungena nomndeni womngane wakho?
Wathi uHushai ku-Absalomu, Akunjalo; kodwana umuntu okhethiwe nguYehova, nalaba bantu, namadodana wonke aseSirayeli, lowo ngizowuhlala naye.
Ngabe ngizokhonza yini? Ngabe ngeke ngisebenzele unyana? Ngokungafani nalokho engikwenzela ubaba wakho, ngizokwenza nawe.
Wathi uAbsalomu ku-Ahitofeli, Thola isiphakamiso; yini okufanele siyenze?

Wathi u-Ahitofele ku-Absalomu, Yidle namadodakazi kababa wakho, awashiyele ukulondoloza indlu; khona-ke bonke isiSirayeli bazokutshela bona udadewabo unenkani nawe; begodu wonke umuntu osebenza nawe uzobe enamandla khulu.
Bamisa khona itente ku-Absalomu, esitezi sendlu. Wahlala u-Absalomu namadodakazi kayise, phambi kwamehlo eSirayeli bonke.
Ngaleso sikhathi, isinqumo sika-Ahitofeli sathathwa njengegama likaThixo; ngaso soke isikhathi uDavide noAbsalome bacabanga njalo ngesinqumo sika-Ahitofeli.
Wathi u-Ahitofele ku-Absalomu, Ngizokhetha abantu abangumakhulu amabili nanhlanu, ngihambe ekuseni ngilandele uDavide.
Ngizomuhlasela lapho elahlekile, begodu ehloniphekile. Ngizokwenza akhathazeke, begodu bonke abantu bakhe bazohamba; ngizobulala ukumkani kuphela,
begodu ngizobuyisela abantu bonke kuwe; begodu uma umuntu olandela wena efile, khona-ke wonke umuntu uzobuya, begodu abantu bonke bazobe bekhululekile.
Wabona uAbsalome, nabaholi bonke bakaSirayeli, bona lokhu kulungile.
Wathi uAbsalomu, Ngisho noHushayi umArhithi kuthiwani, sibone bona yini akutjhoko.
Wafika uHushayi, wathi uAbsalomu kuye, U-Ahitophelele unqume lokhu; kufanele sikwenze yini lokho akutjhoko? Uma kungenjalo, sithi.
Wathi uHushai ku-Absalomu, Icebiso elinikezwe ngu-Ahitopheleli namuhla alihle.

U-Hushayi wathi, "Uyazi ubaba wakho namadodana akhe. Banamandla amakhulu, begodu bavame ukubizwa bona yi-mother bears, noma i-mother bears whose cubs have been stolen. Plus, your father is experienced in the field.
Ngokuba manje ukhona, mhlawumbe ufihlakele emgodini noma endaweni ethile. Uma abantu bakho bebulawa ekuqaleni kokulwa, umuntu owaziyo lokho uzothi, 'Abakhonzi baka-Absalom babulawa!'

Ngaleyo le umuntu onamandla khulu, onenhliziyo efana nengulube, uzolahleka umoya wakhe; ngombana bonke isiSirayeli bayazi bona ubaba wakho ngumuntu onamandla amakhulu, nalabo abakhona naye bangamadoda anamandla.
Ngikucebisa bona uhlanganise nawe wonke amaSirayeli, kusukela eDan kuze kube eBheri-shebha, njengamatshe eduze kolwandle ngosayizi; wena uzoba nomkhosi.
Sizohlasela uDavide lapho etholakala khona, begodu sizowela phezu kwakhe njengokuthi imvula ikhuphuka phezulu emhlabeni; ngeke kushiyeke umuntu ngamunye kubo, uDavide namadodana akhe.
Uma efika enhliziyweni yedolobha, izwe lonke laseSirayeli lizoletha izibopho kulo dolobha; sizolimaza leli dolobha emfuleni, kuze kungashiwo khona itshe elincane.

Wathi uAbsalomu, namadodana onke aseSirayeli, Incomo kaHushai waseArkhi ingcono kunayo yonke incomo ka-Ahitofele; ngombana kwakuyisinqumo sikaYehova ukulahla isiphakamiso esihle sika-Ahitofele, ukuze uYehovasenze kube nzima ku-Absalomu.
Wathi uHushai kuTsadoki noAbhiyathari abapristi, ethi, U-Ahitofele wacebisa uAbsalomu namadoda amakhulu aseSirayeli bona bakwenze lokhu; kodwana ngibacebise ukuba benze lokhu.

Kusukela manje uthumelele izindaba kuDavide ngokushesha, uthi kuye, Ungase uhlale usuku lonke ezindaweni zokudlula emfuleni esiqhingini; vuka udlule emfuleni, ukuze kungapheleli ukumkani nomphakathi wonke owakhe.
UYonathani no-Ahimaze balinde e-Enrogele; kwathi uma intombazane encane iphuma ifike ibatshele, khona-ke bebuya babetshela uNdunankulu uDavide, ukuze bangabonakali befika emzini.
Kwababona umshado, wabatjela uAbsalomu. Besuka ke labo bobabili ngejubane, befika eBahurim, endlwini yomntu othile, owayenesiqu esincane emgwaqeni wakhe; bahla khona.
Wathatha indodana yakhe isigqoko, yamisa phezu komnyango wefuleyi, yamisa imbewu phezu kwayo, ukuze akukho muntu owaziyo bona bakhona.

Bafika emakhazeni abakhonzi baka-Absalomu, babuza uwesifazane bona: Uphi uAhimahazi noYonathani? Waphendula umbhishobhi wathi, Bedlula emfuleni. Bonke labo madoda awawatholanga, wabuya waya eYerusalem;
Baphuma ebhishi, bafike betshela uDavide ukumkani, bathi kuye: "Qhubeka ukhambe ngejubane phezu komfula; ngombana Ahithophelele wanikeza isiphakamiso mayelana nawe."
Wavuka uDavide, naye wonke umuntu owayenaye, wadlula iYordan. Kwafika isikhathi sokuphuma kwelanga, bonke abantu badlule iYordan.

U-Ahitofele, lapho nakabona bona isinqumo sakhe asikusebenziswe, wamisa isikelemu sakhe, waya ekhaya lakhe, waya edolobhaneni lakhe. Walungisa izinto zakhe, wehlisa ikhanda lakhe, wafa, wabanjwa emgodini kayise.
Wayefika uDavide eMahanayim. UAbsalomu wadlula umlambo iYorodani, naye wonke amadoda aseSirayeli.

U-Absalomu wabeka uAmasa njengomphathi womkhosi endaweni kaYowabhi. (U-Amasa ube ngunyana womuntu okuthiwa yi-Ithra, umSirayeli, owashada no-Abigayili, intombi kaNahashi, inkosikazi kaZeruya, indodana kaYowabhi).
USirayeli no-Absalome bamisa isibhedlela ezweni laseGiliyadi.
Kwafika uDavide eMahanayini, noShobi unyana kaNahashi waseRabha yama-Amoni, noMakhire unyana kaAmiyeli waseLodebari, noBarzilayi owaseRogelemi eGileyadi.
Bathi: "Sizothola izindlu, namabhodwe, nezitsha zeqhwa; begodu sizothola ingulube, noshizi, nomhluzi, nenyama ethosiwe, nezithelo ezithosiwe,
begodu amakhowe, nenyama yomnqumo, nezingulube, nobisi lwezinkomo, uDavide namadodana akhe azowadla; ngombana bathi, Abantu bazokhala khulu, nabo bayaphazamiseka, nabo bayaphuza emanzini esiqhingini.
UDavide wabala amadoda aye naye, wabeka abaphathi phezu kwamakhulu namakhulu, nangaphezulu kwamakhulu.

Wathumela abantu, wabahlukanise ngamaqembu amathathu; uYowabhi wayephethe iqembu lesithathu, no-Abhishai udadewabo uYowabhi, unyana kaZeruya, wayephethe iqembu lesithathu, no-Itai waseGiti wayephethe iqembu lesithathu. Ubukhosi besithi kubo: "Ngizophuma ngihamba nani.

Bathi abantu kuye, Ungaphumanga; ngombana uma sihamba, ngeke babhekene nathi; begodu uma isigamu sethu sifa, ngeke babhekene nathi; kodwana wena ufana namaphesenti ayishumi ethu; ngalokho kungcono kuwe ukuba uhlale edolobhaneni, ube nosizo lwethu.
Wathi kubo ukumkani, Ngizokwenza konke okungekuhle emicabangweni yenu. Wahlala khona ukumkani eduze kwesango ledolobha; begodu wonke umkhosi waphuma, ngamakhulu namakhulu amawaka.
Wathi ukumkani kuYowabu, no-Abhishai, no-Itai, "Njengombana ngikhona, nigweme umfana uAbsalomu." Bakhuluma bonke abantu, balalela bona ukumkani watshela abaphathi bakhe ngo-Absalomu.
Waphuma uDavide ezweni, wahlasela amaSirayeli; kwaba khona umqhudelwano emhlabathini ka-Ephrayim.
Bahlasela khona abantu bakaSirayeli phambi kwamadodana kaDavide, babulala abantu abaningi khulu ngalolusuku, amashumi amabili amawaka amadoda.
Impi yasakazeka ezweni lonke, begodu intaba yabulala abantu abaningi ngalolusuku kunalokho ikhephu lakwenza.

UAbsalomu wahlangana nabanye abantu bakaDavide. U-Absalomu wayehamba ngengulube yakhe, ingulube lafika ngezansi kwezihlahla eziqinile zomthi omkhulu we-oak. Ikhanda lika-Absalomu lalibanjwa emuthini, washiya u-Absalomu ezungeze izulu, ingulube yaqhubeka ihamba.
Wabona omunye umuntu, watshela uYowabhi, wathi, Ngabona uAbsalomu ekhonjiswe emuthini we-oak.
Wathi uYowabhi kulowo mntu owayemtshela, Ukubona yini? Kungani na bona ungawushaya khona phasi ezweni? Ngingeke ngikulethe kuwe amashekeli angama-10 wesilivere nogqozi.

Wathi lo mntu kuYowabha, Nakuba nginikezwe amashekeli ayizigidi ezimbili zegolide, angibeke isandla sami emlonyeni womntwana wobukhosi. Sazi kahle bona ukumkani wayekuwisela umthetho wena noAbhishai na-Itai, esithi: Akukho muntu ongeke agweme umshado kaAbsalomu ngenxa yami.
Uma ngibe sengihlukumeza ukumkani, ngabulala unyana wakhe, khona-ke ukumkani wayezokwazi; ngombana akukho okufihlakele kukumkani, begodu ningeke ningisize.
Wathi uYowabha, "Ngizochitha isikhathi nami." Wathatha amatshe amathathu esandla sakhe, wabeka emlonyeni ka-Absalomu; yena ke wayephila, ehlanganiswe nomnqumo wokhuni.
Amadodana alishumi, abathwali izithuthi zikaYowabhi, babhekene noAbsalomu, bamshaya, wambulala.
UYowabhi wehlise isibhamu, abantu bakhe babuyela emuva belandela amaSirayeli; ngombana uYowabhi wabavimbela.
Bathatha u-Absalomu, bawubeka emfuleni omkhulu embuzweni, bewubeke phezu kwakhe umquba omkhulu wamatshe; begodu bonke abantu baseSirayeli basuka, ngaso soke isikhathi babuyela ezindlini zabo.

U-Absalomu, ngesikhathi ephilayo, wamisa isibonisi segolide esikhona emfuleni wakwakumkani; wathi, "Akukho mntwana ongenza igama lami liphile," ngalokho wabiza lesi sibonisi ngegama lakhe. Lokhu kubizwa bona yiSibonisi sika-Absalomu kuze namuhla.
Wathi u-Ahimahazi unyana kaTsadoki, Ngizohamba ngiveze izindaba ezinhle ukumkani, bona ikosi wamsindise ebusweni bomshado wakhe.
Wathi kuye uYowabha, Usuku lwamanje awukaze ube ngumthunywa wezindaba ezinhle; namuhla ungakhuluma usuku olulodwa; kodwana namuhla awukwazi ukushumayela, ngombana unyana kakumkani usefile.
Wathi uYowabhi kulowo muntu waseKushi, Yiya, uxhumane nobukhosi ngalokho okubonayo. Uthe lowo muntu waseKushi wehla phambi kukaYowabhi, wabaleka.
UAhimahazi unyana kaTsadoki wathi kuYowabha, Kuze kube yikuphi, ngizohamba ngemuva komKushi. Wathi uYowabha, Ingabe ufuna ukuya, umngane wami? Akukho lutho ozoluthola ngalolu lwazi.
Wathi uYowabhi, "Ngalokho-ke ngizogijima." Wathi uYowabhi, "Ugijime!" UAhimahazi wagijima ngendlela yaseGibhithe, wadlula lowo muntu waseKushi.

UDavide wayehlala phakathi kwesango elingaphakathi nesango elingaphandle ledolobha. Wafika umgcini esitezi esiphezulu sesango, esitezi esiseduze nodonga, wabheka phasi, wazi bona kukhona umuntu ohamba ngaye kuphela.
Washo umphathi, watshela ukumkani; wathi ukumkani, "Uma yena kuphela, khona-ke uzoba nezindaba." Umgibeli wafika, wafika, wafika.
Wabona umuntu othile ehamba, wabiza umphathi wesango, wathi, Bheka, kukhona umuntu othile ehamba, yena kuphela. Wathi ukumkani, Kulungile, naye uletha indaba.
Wathi umgcini-mlilo, Ngibona bona lowo wesifazane ophambili uhamba njengoAhimahazi unyana kaTsadoki. Wathi ukumkani, Ngumuntu omhle; usenolwazi oluhle.
Wathi u-Ahimahazi kukumkani, "Kuhle." Wagqugquzela ubuso bakhe ezweni phambi kokumkani, wathi, "Usindise ikosi uzimu wakho, ngombana wanikela abantu ababhikishe phezu kwenkosi yami ukumkani.
Wathi ukumkani, Ingabe umshado ka-Absalome ulungile? Waphendula uAhimahazi, wathi, Ngabona ukungqubuzana okukhulu lapho uYowabhi ethumela khona umkhonzi wakho; kodwana angikwazi bona kwenzekani.
Wathi ukumkani, Thola isikhala, uhlale lapha; wathatha isikhala, wahlala khona.
Wafika lowo muntu waseKushi, wathi, Izindaba ezinhle kumnikazi wami ukumkani; namuhla ikosi ukusindise ebusweni bakho bonke abavukayo wena.

Wathi ukumkani kulowo waseKushi, Ingabe umfundi uAbsalome unempilo? Waphendula lowo waseKushi, Wathi, Ngabe bonke abaphikisi benkosi yami ukumkani, nalabo bonke abavukayo ukukwenza kabi, bangaba njengalo mfundi.

Ubukhosi baphoxeka khulu, wanyuka waya egumbini eliphakathi kwesango, wavuma. Wathi lapho ehamba khona: "Unyana wami uAbsalomu! Unyana wami, unyana wami uAbsalomu! Ngabe ngizofa endaweni yakho! UAbsalomu, unyana wami, unyana wami!"
Batshela uYowabhi, bathi, Ukubonani bona ukumkani unquma, begodu unquma ngenxa ka-Absalomu?
Ngaleyo le, umkhosi wonke, ukunqoba ngalolusuku kwaguquka kwaba buhlungu, ngombana amaphoyisa ezwa abantu bathi, "Ukumkani ukhathazekile ngendodana yakhe."
Ngosuku olulodwa, ama-Amori afike edolobhaneni ngaso soke isikhathi, njengama-Amori akhathazekile ngenxa yokulwa.
Wathi ukumkani, efihla ubuso bakhe, wathi ngezwi elikhulu: Unyana wami uAbsalomu, uAbsalomu, unyana wami, unyana wami!

Waphuma uYowabhi, wafika endlwini kukumkani, wathi, Ushonile namuhla bonke abantu bakho, abasindisele namuhla impilo yakho, nempilo yabantwana bakho, nempilo yamantombazane akho, nempilo yezisebenzi zakho.

Uthanda labo abakuthandela, begodu uthanda labo abakuthandela. Namuhla ubonisa bona abaholi bakho namadodana akho akuyona into ebalulekile kuwe. Ngibona bona uma uAbsalome ephila namuhla, begodu sifile soke, echukuthele khulu.

Ngiyakutjela ngeNkosi, bona uma ungaphumanga, ngeke kube khona umuntu ohlala nawe ekuseni; begodu lokhu kuzokuba nzima kuwe kunazo zonke izinkinga ozibhekene nazo kusukela ekukhuleni kwakho kuze kube manje."
Wavuka ukumkani, wahlala emnyango wedolobha. Bathi kubo bonke abantu: "Ukumkani uhlala emgwaqeni." Bafika kuye bonke amadoda aseSirayeli; kodwana wonke amadoda aseSirayeli aye ezindaweni zawo.
Bathi abantu, ezweni lonke lakwaSirayeli, baxoxa phakathi kwabo, bathi, Unkosi usindisele emathunjini ethu, naye wasindisa emaFilistini; kodwana manje usesuka ezweni ngenxa ka-Absalomu.
begodu uAbsalome, obesihlanganisile ukuba abe ngukumkani phezu kwethu, wafa emdlalweni; kungani khona-ke bona akukho muntu okhuluma ngokubuyisela ukumkani?

UDavide ukumkani wathumela uTsadoki noAbhiyathari ababingeleli, wathi kubo: Buza izikhulu zakwaYuda, nithi, Yini nakuthi nibe bakugcina ekubuyiseleni ukumkani ekhaya lakhe? Ngiye ngazi bona abantu bonke bakaSirayeli bekhuluma bona babuyisele ukumkani ekhaya lakhe.
Niyindodana yami, niyinja yami; kungani ke bona nibe bokugcina ekubuyiseleni ukumkani emuva?
Uzothi ku-Amasa, Uyinyama yami nobisi lwami; uzimu akwenze lokhu begodu anikeze okuningi, uma sengikungakwenza wena ube ngumholi womkhosi wami endaweni kaYowabhi.
UDavide wavusa inhliziyweni sabo bonke abantu baseYuda, bahlangana babe ngumuntu owodwa; bathumela kubo ukumkani, besithi: Buyela wena nabangane bakho bonke.
Wabuya ke ukumkani, wafika eJordani; kwathi abantu baseYuda bafika eGalgali, ukubhekana nokumkani, ukuba athabathe ukumkani eduze kweJordani.
UShimeyi unyana kaGera, waseBhenjamini, owahlala eBahurim, wahamba ngejubane namadodana kaYuda, ukuhlangabezana noDavide ukumkani.

Waba naye amadoda elilodwa eBhenjamini, noZiba umkhonzi wendlu ka obsesa uSawule, namadodana akhe amashumi amabili nanhlanu, namadodana akhe amashumi amabini; bahamba bedlula iJordani ukuhlangabezana nobukhosi.
Kwathi, lapho ubukhosi buzodlula iJordani, uShimeyi unyana kaGera ehla phezulu phambi koMbuso WaseYiputa. USolomoni nomndeni wakhe bavuka, bahamba phambili naphezu kweJordani.
Wathi kuye ukumkani, Kosi yami, ngiyakucela, ungeke ungibeke enhliziyweni yakho iphutha elingenakuphikwa elikwenzelwa umkhonzi wakho ngalolusuku lapho waphuma khona eYerusalem.
Ngiyazi, mkhonzi wakho, bona ngiphule; ngalokho-ke ngafika namhlanje, ngiyindoda yokuqala yazo zonke izizwe zikaYosefu, ukuze ngikhuphuke ngihlangane nonkosi wami ukumkani.
Wathi uAbhishai unyana kaZeruya, Akufanele yini bona kubulawa uShimehi ngenxa yalolu daba, ngombana wabulala ukumkani okhethiwe nguYehova?

Wathi uDavide, "Kunithinta kuphi lokhu, izingane zikaZeruya? Kungani nisebenza njengabahlobo bami namhlanje? Ingabe umuntu ophilayo eSirayeli kufanele abulawe namhlanje? Ngazi yini bona manje ngibuye ngibe ngukumkani phezu kwaSirayeli?"
Wathi ukumkani ku-Shemeyi, Awuzofa ngokuqinisekile. Wathi yena ukumkani kuye ngesandla sakhe esiqinile;

UMephiboshethi, udadewabo kaSawule, wakhuphuka naye ukuba ahlangane nokumkani. Akekho umuntu owenza izinyawo zakhe, noma owenza izinwele zakhe, noma owasha izingubo zakhe, kusukela ngosuku lapho ukumkani ephuma khona, kuze kube yilapho ebuyela khona ngokuzola.
Kwathi lapho efika eJerusalema ukubhekana nokumkani, umbingeleli wathi kuye, Kungani na bona ungahamba nami, uMiphebhoshethi?
Wathi yena, Kosi yami ukumkani, umkhonzi wami ungikhohlisa; ngombana ngitjho, Nciphisa inkomo yami, ukuze ngihambe nokumkani; ngombana lo mkhonzi wakho ufile.
Kodwana-ke uTsiba wakhuluma lutho ngami kuwe, kosi yami ukumkani; kodwana kosi yami ukumkani ufana nendodakazi kaThixo; wenze konke okulungile emehlo akho.
Umndeni wonke wenkosikazi kadadewethu ufanele ukufa phambi komnikazi wami ukumkani, kodwana wena ungibeka phakathi kwalabo abadla emehlweni akho. Ngabe nginomthetho wokuthi ngifune lutho kukumkani?
Wathi ukumkani kuye, Kungani na ukhuluma? Ngisho bona wena noZiba nihlukanise phakathi kwenu izwe.
Wathi uMephiboshethi kukumkani, Ake athathe konke; ngiyenzile kahle khulu, ngombana umkakhe ukumkani wabuyela ekhaya lakhe ephephile.
UBarzilayi waseGileyadi waphuma eRogelimi, waya nokumkani eduze kweYorodani, ukuze abone ubukhosi.
U-Barzilayi ubeneminyaka eyisishiyagalombili ubudala, waba mkhulu khulu; yena wayemhlinzekela ukumkani ukudla ngesikhathi uhlala eMahanayim; ngombana wayengumntu omningi.
Wathi ukumkani ku-Barzilayi, Yiya nami eYerusalem, ngizokukhonza khona.
Waphendula uBarzelayi ukumkani, wathi, Ingabe ngizohlala isikhathi esingakanani empilweni yami, ukuze ngiya nokumkani eYerusalem?

Ngineminyaka eyishumi nesishiyagalombili manje; ngikwazi yini ukuchaza okulungile nokumbi? Ingabe umkhonzi wakho angadla noma aphuze? Ingabe ngingakwazi ukulalela izingcingo zabafazi nabafemi bengoma? Ngabe umkhonzi wakho kufanele abe wubunzima obukhulu kumnikazi wami ukumkani?
Ngizohamba nje umkhonzi wakho uhambo oluncane, ngidlule iJordani nokumkani; kungani ukumkani enginikela ngayo le nto?

Ngiyacela, uvumele umkhonzi wakho ahambe, ukuze ngife edolobhaneni lami, enhliziyweni yobaba wami nomama wami; kodwana lapha umkhonzi wakho uKimhamu; angahamba naye nonkosikazi wami ukumkani; wenze kuye konke okungathi kulungile emehlo akho.
Wathi ukumkani, UKimham uzohamba nami, begodu ngizokwenza kuye konke okulungile engqondweni yakho; nanoma yini oyicelayo ngami, ngizoyenza kuwe.
Badlula bonke abantu iJordani, begodu ukumkani wadlula. Ukumkani wehlalela uBarzilayi, wabambisana naye; uBarzilayi ke waya ekhaya lakhe.
Wahamba ukumkani waya eGalgali, wahamba naye uKimham; nabo bonke abantu baseYuda, nengxenye yabantu baseSirayeli, bahamba nokumkani.

Baye bafika bonke amadoda aseSirayeli kukumkani, bathi kuye: Kungani na bona abazalwane bethu, abantu baseYuda, bathathe ukumkani ngesandla sabo, bewudlulisa eJordani ukumkani nomndeni wakhe, naye wonke umuntu kaDavide?
Baphendula bonke amadoda aseYuda amadoda aseSirayeli, bathi, Ngokuba ukumkani ungumngane wethu; kungani ke nikhala ngenxa yalolu daba? Siye sadla yini ukudla kukakumkani, noma sithole yini isipho?

Amadoda aseSirayeli aphendule amadoda aseYuda, athi: Sinengxenye engu-10 emkhosini, begodu sinelungelo likaDavide ngaphezu kwenu. Kungani na bona nithize? Mhlawumbe asizange siqale ukukhuluma ngokubuyisa ukumkani wethu; kodwana abantu baseYiputa baphendula ngezwi elibi khulu kunamadoda aseSirayeli.

Kwaba khona khona umuntu othile owaziwa bona nguSheba, unyana kaBikri, waseBhenjamini; waphonsa isibhamu, wathi, Asikho isinqumo sethu kuDavide, begodu asikho isinqumo sethu kumntwana kaYese. Yiya ekhaya lakho, Isirayeli!
Basuka bonke amadoda aseSirayeli emzini kaDavide, balandela uSheba unyana kaBikri; kodwana amadoda aseYuda ahlala eduze komkani wabo, kusukela eJordani kuya eYerusalem.

UDavide, efika ekhaya lakhe eYerusalem, wathatha amakhosikazi akhe amashumi amabili, ayewashiyela ukuphatha indlu yakhe, wababeka egumbini lokugqugquzela. Wabanikeza ukudla, kodwana akhenge ahlale nabo; bagcinwa egumbini lokugqugquzela kuze kube yimini yokufa kwabo, behlala njengamabhishi.
Wathi ukumkani ku-Amasa, Zibophe abantu baseYuda emveni kwezinsuku amathathu, nawe uhlale lapha.
Wahamba ke uAmasa ukuba abambe abantu baseYuda, kodwana wathatha isikhathi eside kunaleyo imihla ukumkani ayemwisela.
Wathi uDavide ku-Abhishai, USheba unyana kaBikri uzokwenza nathi okumbi ngaphezu kuka-Absalomu; thola abantu bami, uyilandele, ukuze angangeni emizini enezindlu eziqinile, aphume ebusweni bethu.
Amadodana kaYowabhi, namaKherethi, namaPhelethi, nalabo bonke abasolwa abakhulu, baphuma eYerusalem noAbhishai, belandela uSheba unyana kaBikri.

Bafika emfuleni omkhulu eGibehoni, khona-ke uAmasa wahlangana nabo. UYowabhi wayegqoke isigqoko sakhe sokulwa, begodu umlenze wakhe wawunqunyelwe intambo, nekhebula lakhe lisemqoka; lapho ehamba phambili khona, ikhebula laphuma.
Wathi uYowabhi ku-Amasa, Uphila kanjani, nkosikazi yami? Wathatha uYowabhi ngesandla sakhe sokudla isibambo sika-Amasa, efuna ukuwuxola.

U-Amasa akhenge aqaphele isigwebo esisesandlani sikaYowabhi, ngalokho uYowabhi wamshaya emlonyeni wakhe, ngaleyo le izitho zakhe zaphuma ezweni. U-Yowabhi akakwazi ukumbulala begodu; wafa u-Amasa. U-Yowabhi nonkosikazi wakhe u-Abishai balandela uSheba unyana kaBikri.
Wahlala omunye wamadodakazi kaYowabhi eduze kuka-Amasa, wathi, Wonke umuntu osekelayo uYowabhi, nalowo onguDavide, alandele uYowabhi.

U-Amasa wahlala ephakathi kwendlela, eqhutshwa yigazi lakhe. Wabona lo mntu bona bonke abantu bahamba behlala bebhekana naye; wasusa u-Amasa emgwaqweni waya esiqhingini, wabeka phezu kwakhe isigqoko, ngombana wonke umuntu odlulayo wayehlala.
Kwathi lapho ikhanda lithunyelwe emgwaqeni, bonke abantu basuka belandela uYowabhi, befuna uSheba unyana kaBikri.
Wadlula ngazo zonke izizwe zakwaSirayeli, wafika eHabeli noBeth-maakha, naphezu komhlaba wonke wamaBherithi; bonke bahlangana, balandela.
Bafika abantu bakaYowabhi, babamba uSheba emgwaqeni wase-Abeli, eBeth-maakha; begodu bamisa umgwaqo womhlaba eduze kwedonga ledolobha. Waqala wonke umuntu noYowabhi ukudubula idonga ukuze liphule.
Ke kaloku kwaphuma indodana ehlakaniphile esuka edolobhaneni, yathi, Ngisho, nikhulume noYowabhi, ngizokhuluma naye.
Wafika uYowabhi, wabuza indodana yakhe, ethi, Ingabe wena uYowabhi? Waphendula wathi, Ngimi. Yathi kuye, Lingisa amazwi omkhonzi wakho. Waphendula wathi, Lingisa.
Wathi, "Ezikhathini ezedlule abantu bavame ukusho, 'Hamba uze uthole incazelo ku-Abel,' begodu ngaleyo le baxazulula izinkinga zabo.
Siyizwe elihlanzekile ezweni lakwaSirayeli, begodu siyizwe elithembekile; kodwana nifuna ukubulala idolobhana elingumama ezweni lakwaSirayeli. Kungani na bona nifune ukudlidliza izinto zikaYehova?
Waphendula uYowabhi, wathi, Akunjalo! Akungabazeki bona ngizodla noma ngisuse lutho.

Akunalokho, kodwana umuntu okuthiwa nguSheba, unyana kaBikri, osuka ezindaweni eziphakeme zakwa-Ephrayim, usezibophezele emkhosini kaDavide; thumela yena, ngizophuma kulo mzi. Wathi indodakazi kuYowabha, Ikhanda lakhe lizothunyelwa kuwe phezu kwedonga.

Wahamba uwesifazane, wageza abantu bonke ngolwazi lwakhe. Bathatha ikhanda likaSheba unyana kaBhikri, balifutha kuye uYowabhi; begodu uYowabhi wehlise isibhamu, namadodana akhe aphuma edolobhaneni, aye ekhaya lakhe. UYowabhi waya kukumkani eYerusalem.
UYowabhi wayeyinhloko yomndeni wonke wamaSirayeli; uBhenaya unyana kaYehoyada waba yinhloko yamaKherethi, namaPeleti.
U-Adoniram wayeyisikhulu semisebenzi yomsebenzi; u-Jehoshaphat, unyana ka-Ahilodi, waba ngumbhali.
USheva ube ngumbhali wombuso, uTsadoko noAbhiyathari babe ngabapristi.
U-Ira waseYairi ube ngumbingeleli kaDavide, waba ngumphathi omkhulu.

Kwaba khona indlala eminyakeni emithathu elandelanayo, ngesikhathi uDavide esengumphathi. UDavide wabuza ikosi ngalolu daba. Wathi ikosi, Ngabe ngenxa kaSawule nomndeni wakhe; ngombana uSawule wababulala abantu baseGibeboni.

Wathi ukumkani wababiza abantu baseGibeoni, wathi kubo: "Abantu baseGibeoni abengabaSirayeli. Bayingxenye kuphela yama-Amoreti asele. AbaSirayeli babethembise bona bazowashiya; kodwana uSawule wafuna ukuwasusa, ngombana wayefisa khulu ukubambisana nabantu bakaSirayeli nakwaYuda.
Wathi uDavide kwabaGibeoni, Ngingakwenzani yini kwenu? Ngizolungisa kanjani lokhu okumbi, ukuze nibabarise abantu bakazimu?

Baphendula abantu baseGibeoni, bathi kuye, Asikudingeki bona sifune isiliva noma igolide kuSawule, noma emndenini wakhe; begodu akudingeki bona sisuse umuntu eSirayeli. Wathi uDavide, Ngizokwenza konke okushoyo.
Baphendula ukumkani, bathi, USawule wayefuna ukusibulala; wacabanga bona sizophela, ukuze singabi nendawo ezweni laseSirayeli lonke.
Ngiyacela, nithumelele amadodana akhe ayisithupha, ukuze siwakhonze phambi kukaNkulunkulu eGibeha kaSawule, emzini womntu okhethiwe nguYehova. Ubukhosi besithi, Ngizowanikela.
Nokho ukumkani wagwema uMephiboshethi, unyana kaYonathani, umngane kaSawule, ngenxa yegama likaDavide noYonathani, ababelikhuluma phakathi kwabo phambi koYehova.

Wathi ubukhosi buthatha uArmoni noMephiboshethi, oonyana ababini bakaRispa intombi ka-Ahiya, ababezala kuSawule; nabana besihlanu bakaMerab intombi kaSawule, abezala ku-Adriyeli intombi ka-Barzilayi waseMehola.

Wabanikela ezinyangeni zokuqala zokuvuna, lapho kuqalwa khona ukuvuna imbewu yeshubhu; babulawa bonke labo sishiyagalombili ngasikhathi sinye. Kwathi uma befika eGibheboni, uMosis wabulala wonke amaSirayeli esihlalweni seNkosi.

U-Rispa intombi ka-Ahiya wathatha isigqoko, wamisa phezu kwengcindezi. Wahlala khona kusukela ekuqaleni kokuvuna kuze kube yilapho imvula ikhuphuka phezu kwalabo abafileyo; akhenge azivumele iinhlapi ukuba zihlale phezu kwabo ekuseni, noma izilwane zeganga bona zifike kubo ebusuku.
Kwathi kwathunyelwe uDavide bona uRispa intombi ka-Ahiya, indodakazi yomkhonzi kaSawule, wayekwenze.

Wahamba, wafumana izicubu zikaSawule noJonathane unyana wakhe, kwabesilisa baseYabhesi-Gileyadi. Bezithathe ngokufihlakele emgwaqeni waseBeth-shan, lapho amaFilisti abewakhonze khona, ngemuva kokufa kukaSawule enkabeni yeGilboa.
UDavide wafumana khona amathambo kaSawule, namathambo kaYonathani unyana wakhe; begodu baqoqa amathambo lamadoda ayisishiyagalombili abekezelwa.

Bathi: "Sizozibulala zonke izilwane eziphilako, begodu sizozibulala izinyoni zonke eziphilako." Bafaka amathambo kaSawule nowakhe uYonathani emgodini kaKishi ubaba kaSawule, eZela, ezweni likaBhenjamin.
Kwaba nempi phakathi kwamaFilisti namaSirayeli; waphuma uDavide namadodana akhe, bahlasela amaFilisti. UDavidu waba mkhulu khulu.
U-Ishbi-benob, omunye wabafazi abakhulu, wayenesibhamu segolide esiyishumi nesishiyagalombili samashekeli; wagqoka isigqoko sokulwa esisha, begodu wayefuna ukumbulala uDavide.

UAbhishai, unyana kaZeruhiya, wasiza uDavide, wahlasela lowo Mfilisita, wambulala. Bathi abantu bakaDavide kuye ngezwi elikhulu, besithi: Awuzophuma nathi emdlalweni; ngombana wena ungusikazi lakwaSirayeli; sizogcina usizi lwethu olungafi.
Ngosuku oluthile, kwabe sekuyimpi entsha neFilisti eGobhi; khona-ke uSibhekayi waseHusha wabulala uSafe, omunye wezinkomo ezikhulu.

Esinye isiqephu sempi, uElhanana, unyana kaYare-Oregim waseBethelehemu, wahlasela amaFilisti eGobhe, wabulala ugogo kaGoliathi waseGathi, owesibhakabhaka sakhe: ikhanda lakhe laliba likhulu khulu kunaso isibambo somuntu othunga.

Kwaba nempi eGathi; kwabe khona umuntu omkhulu khulu, onezintamo eziyisishiyagalombili ngesandla ngayinye, nezintamo eziyisishiyagalombili ngenyawo ngalinye, ayizinkulungwane ezimbili namashumi amane nanhlanu. Waye naye waba yindodana yama-rafayeli.
Kwathi, lapho ekhohlisa khona isiSirayeli, uYonathani unyana kaShimehi, umngane kaDavide, wambulala.
Lokho kwakuyindodana kaRafayeli eGathi; wababulala uDavide namadodana akhe.
UDavide wayalela ikosi amazwi alo ingoma, ngesikhathi ikosi emsindisa ezindaweni zobuxoki bakhe bonke, naseSawuleli.
Wathi, uzimu ngudonga lwami, nenkundla yami, nomsindisi wami.
uzimu ngumlilo wami, ngizohamba kuye ngethemba. Nguwo umgqomo wami, nomsindisi wami onamandla, uphahla lwami oluphakeme, nendawo yami ephephile. Umsindisi wami, ungisindise kumuntu onobugebengu.
Ngicela ikosi, owaziwa ngazo zonke izenzo zakhe, begodu ngisindiswe ezimpilweni zami.
Izingqimba zokufa zangijikeleza. Izintaba-mlilo zezinto ezibi zamishaya ngami, zenza ngikhathazeke.
Izibopho zesibhedlela zazingcwatshwa ngami. Izinhlamvu zokufa zazibekwe phambi kwami.
Empilweni yami ebuhlungu, ngicela ikosi, begodu ngakhala kuThixo wami; Wamazwa umsindo wami ethempelini lakhe, Ukholo lwami lwafika ezindlebeni zakhe.
Umhlaba wawugqugquzelwe, waqhuma; izifunda zezulu zagqugquzela, zagqugquzela, ngenxa yobubi bakhe.
Uthuli lwaphuma emlonyeni wakhe, nomlilo oqhumayo waphuma emphinjeni yakhe; amakhowe aqhumayo asuka kuye.
Wavula izulu, wakhuphuka; amafu amnyama abe ngaphasi kwezandla zakhe.
Wahamba phezu komuntu onemilenze begodu wehla. Ukhuphuka phezulu ngemilenze yomoya
Wagqoka ubuso bakhe ubumnyama obufana nesitezi, namafu amnyama emvula, namafu amakhulu omhlaba.
Kuze kube yilapho ekhanya khona, umlilo wokudlidliza waphuma.
uzimu uphonsa inkungu emkhathini, Umsindo Womuntu Ophakeme waphuma.
Washaya izinhlamvu zakhe, wasakaza izidumbu zakhe. Wathumela umlilo, wababeka engqubuzaneni.
Ngaleso sikhathi kwabonakala umlambo ongaphansi kolwandle, begodu izikhululo zehlabathi zavela, lapho ikosi ekhuluma ngamandla, ngomoya ophuma emlonyeni wakhe.
Wamimisa isandla sakhe phezulu, wabamba ngami. Wamimisa ngami emanzini amahle.
Ungisindise emgodini wami onamandla, Kubo bonke labo abangikhohlisayo; ngombana babenamandla khulu kunami.
Bamishe ngami ngosuku lobuhlungu bam, kodwana ikosi ungixhase.
Wamimisa ezindaweni ezibanzi, zavulekile; Wamikhipha ngenxa yothando lwakhe lwami.
uzimu ungikhokhela, ngombana ngikwenzele okulungile; ungangibuyisele, ngenxa yokuthi izandla zami zihlanzekile.

Ngabe sengilungile phambi kwakhe, begodu ngazivikela enhliziyweni yami emthethweni.

Kilabo abakholwayo, ubonisa bona uthembekile. Kilabo abangenacala, ubonisa bona awunacala.

Usindisa abantu abancane, kodwana amehlo akho abhekana nabantu abakhulu, ukuze ubakhuphe.
uzimu, wena uyisibani sami; uzimu ukhanya izulu lami.
Ngosizo lwakho ngizokwazi ukulwa nemikhosi. Nozimu wami ngizokwazi ukuphakama phezu kwedonga.
Indlela kaThixo ilungile; igama likaYehova lihlolwe, libe yiqiniso. Waba ngumbukiso kiwo wonke umuntu ohamba kuye.
Ngabe yini uzimu ngaphandle kukaYehova? Ingabe yini intaba ngaphandle kukaThixo wethu?
uzimu ungumkhonzi wami onamandla, begodu ungenza indlela yami iphelele.
Ungenza izinyawo zami zibe ziqinile njengezinyawo zengulube, begodu ungisiza ukuba ngihlale ngasezindaweni eziphakeme.
Uqeqesha izandla zami zokunqoba, ukuze imicibisholo yami ingadonsa isibhamu segolide.
Unginikeze isibhamu sakho esisindisayo. Usizo lwakho oluhle lungenza ngikhulu.
Wakwenza indlela ebanzi izinyawo zami, ukuze imilenze yami ingagcini.
Ngazilandela izidumbu zami, ngazibulala. Angibuyeli emuva, kuze kube sekuphele ukubulala kwabo.
Ngiwasusa, ngiwashaya phasi, ukuze bangasekho abavukayo; bawela ngaphasi kwezinyawo zami.
Unginikeze amandla emdlalweni. Wakwenza abahlaseli bami babe ngezansi kwami.
Wakwenza izidumbu zami zibuye, zihambe, begodu ngabulala labo ababemthandazela.
Bafuna usizo, kodwana akukho obulalayo; bathandaza kuYehova, kodwana akawaphendulanga.
Ngiwacindezela njengamatshe ehlabathini, ngiwacindezela njengentaba-mlilo, begodu ngiwacindezela njengengcindezi emgwaqweni.
Ungisindise lapho abantu bami bephikisana nami. Ungigcine njengomholi wamazwe. Abantu angeke ngibazi manje basebenza kimi.
Amanye amazwe anquma ukungilalela; Uma nje bekhuluma ngami, bakwenza njalo.
Abangaphandle balahlekelwa ubuhlakani babo, begodu bahlala bephuma ezindaweni zabo zokufihla.
Uphila ikosi, lihlolwe itshe lami! Lihlolwe uzimu, itshe lokubuyisa kwami!
uzimu lowo ongenza ngami ukubuyiswa kwezimpi zami, begodu abeke izizwe ngezansi kwami.
Ungikhulula emgodini wami, Ungiphakamisa phezu kwalabo abangihlaselayo; Ungisindisa enhliziyweni yomuntu omnyama.
Ngizokubonga, Kosi, phakathi kwezizwe zonke; ngizokhuluma igama lakho.

Lawa amazwi adlule kaDavide. Izwi likaDavide, unyana kaYese, indodana kaThixo ephakeme khulu, ukumkani okhethiwe nguThixo kaYakobi, umbhali wengoma emnandi yamaSirayeli:
Umphefumulo kaYehova ukhuluma ngami, Izwi lakhe lingulimi lwami.
uzimu wakwaSirayeli ukhuluma, itshe likaSirayeli lithi kuye: "Kukhona ukumkani olawula abantu ngokuvumelana nomthetho, olawula ngothando lukaThixo.
ufana nokukhanya kwesibhakabhaka lapho ilanga liphuma khona, isibhakabhaka esingenawo amafu. Ufana nokukhanya kwesibhakabhaka ngemuva kwemvula eyenza izimbali ezintsha zikhule emhlabeni.'

Ngabe lokhu akuyona indlela uzimu abhekane ngayo nemindeni yami? Ukwenza inkontileka nami uhlala isikhathi eside, ilungiselelwe ngemininingwane ngayinye begodu iqiniseke. Uzokwenza ukusindisa kwami kuphelele begodu unikeze konke engifunayo. Ingabe akasayi kwenza kube nokukhula?
Kodwana abantu ababi bafana nezinhlamvu ezithunyelwa phambilini; akukho muntu ozozisusa ngezandla zakhe.
Wonke umuntu owuthintayo, kufanele asebenzise intambo yensimbi noma isibhakabhaka; bazoqhutshwa emgodini lapho behlala khona.
Lawa magama amadodana amakhulu kaDavide: uJosheb-bashebhethi, umTakemoni, owayengumphathi wezikhulu, owaziwa nangokuthi uAdino umEznani; wabulala abantu abangumakhulu asibhozo ngesikhathi esisodwa.

begodu esigabeni sakhe, uEleazar, indodana kaDodayi, Ahohite; yena waba phakathi kwabanqobi abathathu kanye noDavide, lapho bebhekene nabaFilisti, uma behlangana ukubhekana nempi, njengombana amaSirayeli wabuyela.

kodwana u-Eleazare wahlala endaweni yakhe, wahlasela amaFilisti, kuze kube yilapho isandla sakhe sikhathaza khulu, sazibeka ekhephuni lakhe. UYehova wabanika ukunqoba okukhulu ngalolu busuku. Baye babuyela kuye kuphela ukuze bathathe izinto ezifileyo.
begodu ekugcineni kwakhe kwaba Shammah, unyana Agee, iHararite; begodu amaFilisti wahlangana ndawonye endaweni lapho bekukhona isitshalo esigcwele izithelo, begodu Isirayeli babaleka phambi kwabo.
Wahlala uShama phakathi kwesihlabathi, wavikela isihlabathi, wahlasela amaFilisti; begodu ikosi wenza ukusindisa okukhulu.
Kwathi ngesikhathi sokuvuna, kwaphuma abantu abathathu phakathi kwabakhulu abangumashumi amathathu, bahlangana noDavide emgodini ka-Adulam; begodu amaFilisti ayesesitezi eGoli likaRefayi.
UDavide wayesesitezi esiphakeme, begodu amaFilisti ayehlala eBethelehemu.
UDavide wafuna khulu amanzi, wathi, Uma ngabe kukhona umuntu ongenza ngiphuze amanzi emfuleni waseBethelehemu, ogwini.

Lawa madoda anamandla amathathu aphuma esiteji samaFilisti, wageza amanzi emgodini waseBethelehemu, ongaphansi kwengubo yedolobha, wayalela uDavide; kodwana yena akakwazanga ukuwudla, wathi, Ngizowukhipha machweqweni kaYehova.

Wathi, "uzimu, angikwazi ukuwudla lo mkhiqizo! Kufana nokudla igazi lalabo bantu ababeke impilo sabo engcupheni ukuze bawuthole." Uthe akakwazanga ukuwudla. Lezi ziyizinto eziningi ezidume khulu zalabaphelisi abathathu.

U-Abhishai, udade kaYowabhi, unyana kaZeruya, waba nguMengameli wabo bonke abathathu. Wasebenzisa isibhamu sakhe, wahlasela abantu abangumakhulu amathathu, wababulala; wafumana igama phakathi kwabo bonke abathathu.
Waba ngumuntu othandekako ukudlula bonke abathathu, waba ngumphathi wabo, kodwana akayena owodwa kubo bobabili.

UBenaya unyana kaYehoyada, owayengumuntu onamandla eKabseyeli, wakwenza izinto ezinkulu. Wabulala amadoda amakhulu amabili aseMowabhi; begodu waya emgodini ngesikhathi sethebhulethi, wahlasela ingulube.
Wabulala umYiputa omkhulu khulu, owayenesibhakabhaka esandlani sakhe. UBenaya waya kuye, wathatha isibhakabhaka esisesandlani somYiputa, wambulala ngesibhakabhaka sakhe.
Lezo yizinto ezidume khulu azenzayo uBhenaya, unyana kaYehoyada; wafumana igama elifana nalabo abakhulu abathathu.
Waba mkhulu ukudlula abamashumi amathathu, kodwana akhenge abe ngumunye wabathathu. UDavide wambeka emholweni wamagwebu akhe.
Ngabo abamashumi amathathu: u-Asaheli, indodana kaYowabhi; no-Elhanani unyana kaDodo waseBethelehemu;

uHelebhi unyana kaBaana waseNetofa, noItai unyana kaRibhai waseGibeha eBhenjamin;
uBhenaya wasePirathoni, noHidayai osuka ezindongeni zeGaash;
u-Abi-alboni wase-Arbati, no-Azmavethi wase-Barhumi,

uShama waseHara, noAhiyamu umfazi waseSharari waseHara;
UElifelethe unyana ka-Ahashabhi waseMaakathi, noEliyam unyana ka-Ahitopheleli waseGilo;
uHezro waseKarmeli, noPaarai omusha,

uIra umYithrithi, noGarebhi umYithrithi,
no-Uriya umHithi. Bebengamashumi amathathu anesixhenxe.
UYehova waqhubeka egwema amaSirayeli, wathi kuDavide: "Hamba ubala abantu baseSirayeli nabaseYuda." Wathi uDavide kuye: "Hayi!
Wathi ukumkani kuYowabhi, umphathi wenkosi yakhe, ethi, Yiya ukhambe ngazo zonke izizwe zakwaSirayeli, kusukela eDani kuya eBheri-shebha, ubala abantu, ukuze ngibone inani labo.

Wathi uYowabhi kukumkani, UYehova uzimu wakho akwenze abantu babe ngamaphesenti angamashumi amane ukudlula bakhona manje; begodu umphathi wami ukumkani ahlale ephila; kodwana kungani umphathi wami ukumkani efuna ukwenza lokhu?
Nokho isinqumo sokumkani sinamandla kunaye uYowabhi, nakwabaphathi bomndeni wakwaSirayeli. Waphuma ke uYowabhi, namaphethelo enkosi, azame ukubala abantu bakaSirayeli.
Badlula iJordani, bamisa isikhashana e-Aroeri, enyakatho yedolobhana eliphakathi kwegqaba likaGadi; bese befika eYazeri.
Bafika eGileyadi, nasezweni lamaTathimi-Hodshi, badlula eDani-Yaani, besuka eSidoni.
Bafika ezindaweni eziqinile zeTire, nakwazo zonke izifunda zaseHivi, namaKanana; bafika eBeer-shebha, enyakatho yezwe laseYuda.
Bafika eJerusalema, ngemuva kwezinyanga eziyisishiyagalombili nezinsuku ezingu-20; badlula khona izwe lonke.
Wathi uYowabhi kuyise ukumkani inani labantu: Kwaba ngumakhulu asibhozo amaphesenti eSirayeli, amadoda anamandla okulwa ngeqhwa; begodu kwaba ngumakhulu amane amaphesenti aseYuda.
Wathi uDavide kuYehova, ethi, Ngibe nesono esikhulu ngalokhu engikwenzayo; begodu manje, Kosi yami, ngicela, ngisuse ubugebengu bomkhonzi wakho; ngombana ngikwenzele into engalungile khulu.
Kwathi ngesikhathi uDavide evuka ekuseni, kwafika igama likaYehova kuGadi umprofeti, okubonayo uDavide, lithi:
Chofoza lapha, ukhulume noDavide, uthi: Uthi ikosi bona: Ngikubeke phambi kwakho izinto amathathu; khethe enye yazo, ngikwenze kuwe.

Wafika uGadi kuDavide, wathi kuye, Ingabe kumele kube nendlala iminyaka eyisixhenxe ezweni lakho? Ingabe kufanele ukhambe izinyanga amathathu phambi kwabanye abaphikisi bakho, bese bekulandela wena? Ingabe kufanele kube negciwane amalanga amathathu ezweni lakho? Uzocabanga manje, begodu uzobona bona ngiwuphendule kanjani lowo wamthumela.
Wathi uDavide kuGadi, Ngisengozini enkulu; sithi, sihlale esandlani sikaYehova, ngombana izimilo zakhe zikhulu; kodwana angeke ngihlale esandlani komuntu.
Wathumela ikosi isifo esibulalayo eSirayeli, kusukela ngaleso sikhathi sakusihlwa kuze kube yilapho wabeka khona isikhathi; kwashona abantu abangumakhulu asixhenxe, kusukela eDani kuya eBhe-sheba.

Kwathi lapho isithunywa saphakamisa isandla sakhe ukuba sibulala eYerusalem, ikosi wakhathazeka ngenxa yalolu daba. Wathi kulesi sithunywa esibulala abantu, "Kunembile! Nciphisa isandla sakho!" Sakuba isithunywa soMoya oNgcwele enhliziyweni ka-Aronah umJebusi.

Wathi uDavide kuYehova, lapho nakabona khona isithunywa esibulala abantu, ethi, Ngimi owenza isono, ngimi owenza ububi; kodwana labo bantu bafana nengulube. Bakwenzeni kuphi? Nceda, ugweme mina nomndeni wami.
Wafika uGadi kuDavide ngalolusuku, wathi kuye, Yiya phezulu, wenze isibingelelo kuYehova esitezi sokudla sika-Aronah umJebusi.
Waphuma uDavide, njengombana kwathiwa nguGadi, ngokusho komthetho kaYehova.
U-Aronah wabheka, wabona ukumkani nabangane bakhe befika kuye. Waphuma u-Aronah, wehla phambi kukakumkani ngobuso bakhe phasi ezweni.

Wathi u-Aronah, Kungani na umengameli umnikazi wami efika ukuvakashela umkhonzi wakhe? UDavide wathi, Ukuthenga isikhala sakho sokudla, ukuze ngikhiphe isibingelelo kuYehova, begodu ngigweme isifo esibulala abantu.

Wathi u-Aronah kuDavide, Unkosi wami ukumkani, uthathe konke okuthandekayo engqondweni yakho, uyinikeze; bona izinkomo zomnikelo wokushiswa, begodu bona izihlalo zokugqugquzela inkomo, nezintambo zezinkomo, ukuze zibe yizihlahla.
Unkosi wami, mina u-Aronah, nginika konke lokhu ukumkani. Wathi u-Aronah kukumkani, uzimu wakho, ikosi, athande isipho sakho.

Wathi ukumkani ku-Aronah, Ngizokulethela; kodwana ngeke nginikeze umnikelo wokushiswa kuYehova uzimu wami ungenamkhawulo. UDavide wathenga igumbi lokudla kanye nezingulube ngeshekeli zegolide ezimashumi mahlanu, ayizinkulungwane ezine.
Wakha khona uDavide isibingelelo kuYehova, wanikela khona izipho zokudlwengula nezipho zokuthula. uzimu wamphendula ngezwe lakhe, begodu isifo sayeka ukuhlasela abantu bakaSirayeli.

U-Adoniya wanikela ngenkomo, nengulube, nezimbuzi ezinamafutha, ethempelini likaZohelethe, elingaphansi kuka-Enrogeli; wabiza bonke abazalwane bakhe, oonyana bakakumkani, nabenzi bonke bobukhosi baseYuda.
Kodwana uNathane umprofeti, noBhenaya, namadoda amakhulu, noSolomoni inkosikazi yakhe, akhenge awameme.
Wathi uNathani kuBathesheba, indodana kaSolomoni, ethi, Awazi yini bona uAdoniya, unyana kaHagithi, wenza yena ngokwakhe ukumkani? Unkosi wethu uDavide akakwazi.
Manje ke, ngizokulethela isiphakamiso, ukuze usindise impilo yakho, nempilo kaSolomoni unyana wakho.

Izinkanyezi zethize nezingcezu zomhlaba (i-Twilight Strangers) zithe: "Izindaba eziyetesana" badla ngokuba yizinkanyezi, kanti izidumbu zabantu (i-Djnass) zibe ngazo isizwe sabantu РСФСР uSolomon uya kuba ngukumkani ngemuva kwami; yena uzohlala ebukhosini bam.
Uma usukhona ukhuluma khona nomkakhe, ngizofika ngemuva kwakho, begodu ngizokutshela bona konke okushoyo kulungile.
Waphuma uBhatshebha, wafika ekamelweni likakumkani; begodu ukumkani wayeneminyaka emikhulu khulu. UAbhisage waseShunemi wayemsiza.
UBathesheba wehlise ikhanda lakhe, wavuma ukumkani. Wathi ukumkani kuye, "Ufunani?"
Wathi kuye, Kosi yami, wena wawunqume ngami ngoYehova uzimu wakho, wathi, USolomoni unyana wakho uzobe ngukumkani ngemuva kwami, yena ozohlala ebukhosini bam.
Begodu manje, bona, uAdoniya ube ngukumkani; begodu wena, kosi yami ukumkani, awazi.

Wanikela ngezinkomo, nezingulube ezinamafutha, nezimvu eziningi khulu; wamemezela bonke oonyana bakakumkani, noAbhiyathari ukumkani, noYowabu umphathi wesibhakabhaka; kodwana angimemezeli mkhonzi wakho uSolomon.
Kosi yami ukumkani, izandla zakwaSirayeli zonke zibheke kuwe, ukuze ubaδροle bona ubani ozoba eseyinhloko yakho ngemuva kwakho.产
Uma ungakwenza lokhu, khona-ke uma convi taha جنس kumuntu wami ukumkani, bese uhlala emndenini wakwababamostabi bakhe, ngizobe ngangibona kimina noSolomoni ndodakazi yami sengathi siyingozi.
Ngesikhathi wayekhuluma nobukhosi, uNathan umprofeti wafika.
Ikosi yathiwa, "Nathanmoth this Prophet is here." Sgway yena wafika opened begodu bowed pisanisa phambi kwe mene ngowesifazane nobuso bakhe.
Wathi uNathane, Kosi yami ukumkani, uthi yini wena, U-Adoniya uzobe ngukumkani ngemuva kwami, yena ozohlala esibhedlela sami?

Uthe lo mhla, esuka ebhishi, wabulala izingulube, nezimvu, nezimbuzi eziningi khulu, wabiza bonke oonyana bakakumkani, nabaphathi bebutho, noAbhiyathari umpristi; begodu bona, badla bese besela phambi kwakhe, bathi: Kuhlale kude ukumkani uAdoniya!
Kodwana mina umkhonzi wakho, noTsadoki umbingeleli, noBhenaya unyana kaYehoyada, noSolomoni umkhonzi wakho, angikhombise.
Ingabe unkosi wami ukumkani wakwenza lokhu, engabonisi umkhonzi wakho bona ubani ozohlala ebukhosini ngemuva kwakhe?
Wathi ukumkani uDavide, Wisela lapha iBhatshebha. Wayefika, wahlala phambi kukakumkani;
Wathi ukumkani, Uphila ikosi, osindisele ezindaweni ezibuhlungu zonke;

Ngizokwenza namuhla, njengombana ngikubhiyozele ngoYehova uzimu kaSirayeli, esithi, USolomoni unyana wakho uzobe ngukumkani ngemuva kwami; yena uzohlala endaweni yami. Ngokuqinisekile ngizokwenza namuhla.
Wathiošanasa uBhatshebhi ngobuso bakhe phasi ezweni, wehla emzinikele kumkanikazi, wathi: Unkosi wami ukumkani uDavide aphile kuze kube sekupheleni.
Wathi ukumkani uDavide, Nciphisani uTsadoko umιεςi, noNathani umprofeti, noBhenaya unyana kaYehoyada. Bafika phambi kukakumkakhe;
Wathi kubo, Nizithathe abazalwane bam nabo, niyibeke uSolomoni unyana wami phezu kwengulube yami, ni claroke eGihoni.
Kukhona Zadok umntakwabo noNathan umprofeti akufanele enze ukumkani phezu kwe-Isra. Intetho yetromba begodu utshoza, 'Kube King Solomon!'
Baye babuyela emuva kwakhe, afike ahlale esibhedlela sami, abe ngukumkani endaweni yami; ngombana yena ngiwukhethele ukuba abe ngumholi phezu kwaSirayeli nakwaYuda.
Waphendula uBhenaya unyana kaYehoyada ukumkani, wathi, Ameni! UYehova, uzimu kankosi yami ukumkani, asho njalo.
Ngokuba ikosi ube nonkosikazi wami ukumkani, abe noSolomoni begodu; akwenze isitulo sikaSolomoni sibe sikhulu kunaso isitulo sonkosikazi yami ukumkani uDavide.
Waphuma ke uSadoko umpristi, noNathani umprofeti, noBhenaya unyana kaYehoyada, namaKherethi, namaPhelethi; bamisa uSolomoni embuzweni kaDavide ukumkani, bamthwala eGihoni.
UTsadoki umbingeleli wathatha isibhamu se-oyile esitezi esingcwele, wamisa uSolomoni; baphuza ibhubesi, abantu bonke bathi, Kuhlale kuphila ukumkani uSolomoni.
Baye bonke abantu babuyela emuva kwakhe, bedlala ama-flautas, bezijabulisa ngothando olukhulu; babe nomsindo omkhulu khulu, kuze kube khona umhlabathi oqhumayo.
U-Adoniya nomndeni wakhe wonke bakubona lokhu, lapho beqedile ukudla; begodu uYowabhi, ezwa umsindo wezinkomo, wathi, Yini le nto yokuthula enkabeni yedolobha?
Ube ekhuluma, kwafika uYonathani unyana ka-Abhiyathari ukumkani. Wathi uAdoniya, Ngena; ngombana wena ungumuntu olungile, begodu usenolwazi oluhle.
Waphendula uYonathani, wathi ku-Adoniya, Akunjalo; kodwana ikosi yethu ukumkani uDavide wenza uSolomoni ukumkani.
Wathumela naye ukumkani uTsadoki umpristi, noNathani umprofeti, noBhenaya unyana kaYehoyada, namaKherethi, namaPhelethi; bamisa yena phezu kwengulube yomkakhe.

Nakuba uSolomoni wayehlala eJerusalema, begodu, utilisi bobukhosi basuka eJerusalema, bathi: "Sicela uzimu wakho akwenze igama likaSolomoni libe likhulu kunegama lakho, begodu isiqhingi sakhe sikhulu kunesiqhingi sakho.
Wathi begodu ukumkani, Kukhululwe ikosi uzimu kaSirayeli, owenza bona җаle namuhla tamehlo ami žala-ke;toodile isikhala sami nakanjani Hafi.

kuthe kwafunwa uSolomoni, besithi, kubonakala sengathi uAdoniya ukhathazekile ngenxa yombuso kaSolomoni; kodwana-ke, bona, uthathe isinambuzane sesibhedlela, esithi, UMbuso waseSolomoni kufanele aphike sáto,, ngeke abulala umkhonzi wakhe ngekhefu.
Wathi uSolomoni, Uma nakabona bona ungumuntu olungile, angeke izinwele zakhe zibe khona emhlabeni; kodwana uma kutholakale okumbi kuye, uzofa.

Kwafika isikhathi sokufa kukaDavide, wathi kuSolomoni unyana wakhe:
"Ngizohamba ngendlela abantu bonke emhlabeni abafanele bahambe ngayo, ngalokho ube ngumuntu onamandla begodu usebenze njengomuntu.

Uzokwenza konke ikosi uzimu wakho akutjhoko kuwe; uzohamba ngezinova zakhe, uzigcine izimiso zakhe, nemiyalo yakhe, nezibopho zakhe, nezinqumo zakhe, njengombana kubhalwe emthethweni kaMoses: khona-ke uzophumelela.

ukuze ikosi agcine isinqumo sakhe, ebesikhuluma ngami esithi: Uma izingane zakho zigcina ukuhamba phambi kwami ngokuyiqiniso ngenhliziyweni sabo yonke nomoya wabo wonke, khona-ke ngeke kube nendoda uhlala phezu komušwana waseSirayeli.

Uyazi begodu bona uYowabhi, unyana kaZeruhiya, wenzani ngami, lapho ebulala khona abaphathi ababi bomndeni wakwaSirayeli, uAbheri, unyana kaNeri ngaphambili, noAmasa, unyana kaYetere, ngesikhathi sokuthula;ababulala, njengombana kwenzeka emdlalweni, ukuze igazi labo liphuze umlenze wakhe, kanye nezicathulo zakhe.
Uzokwenza kuye ngokuzimela kwakho, ukuze angabi mkhulu, begodu ahambe ezweni lokufa ngokuthula.
Kodwana udade "wedwa" izingane ka-Barzilayi, eGiliyadi, ukuze bakwazi ukudla embhedeni wakho; ngombana nabo bamisiza, lapho ngihamba phambi kukaAbsalome, umngane wakho.

Begodu khumbula uShimeyi, indodana kaGera, umBhenjamini osuka eBahurim, obekhona nawe; yena wamangalisa khulu ngami ngosuku lapho ngiya khona kuMahanayim. Kodwana-ke, ngesikhathi esenyuka ahlangana nami enhliziyweni yeYorodani, ngathi kuye ngoNkulunkulu: Ngizokubulala ngeqhwa.
Ngalokho-ke edhena, ungagwema ukumbulala; ngombana wena unenhlonipho begodu uzozi bona yini okufanele unetolwe kuye. Uzokwazi senzela umonakalo brutwo wonke uma eneminyaka yakhe yobudala.

Wathi ukumkani ku-Abhiyathari umbingeleli, Yiya eAnathothi, ezweni lakho; ngombana wena ungumuntu ofanele ukufa; kodwana namuhla ngeke ngikufane nawe, ngenxa yokuthi wathabatha isikhokelo sikaYehova uThixoubaba wami uDavide, begodu waba nesibopho ngazo zonke izinkinga abe nazo ubaba wami agubha.
USolomoni wasusa uAbhiyathari, ukuze angabi ngumbhishobhi kaYehova, ukufeza amagama kaYehova, ayekhuluma ngawo ngendlu kaEli eShilo.
Wafika uYowabhi, wabaleka waya ekhempini kaYehova, washikama izingulube zesibingelelo; ngombana uYowabhi wayeyilungu lika-Adoniya, kodwana akhenge abe yilungu lika-Absalomu.
Batshela uSolomoni ukumkani, bathi, UYowabhi ukhambe ekhempini kaYehova, begodu, bona, uhlala eduze kwesibingelelo. Wathumela ke uSolomoni uBhenaya unyana kaYehoyada, esithi, Yiya ugweme.
Wafika uBhenaya esitezi sikaYehova, wathi kuYowabhi: "Kuthe ukumkani, 'Thinakela!'" UYehobha waphendula wathi: "Akekho; ngizofa lapha." Ke yena uBenayahi waya kum DAVID (Full Version)
Wathi ukumkani kuBhenaya, Yenza njengombana atjhilo; ugweme, uyigcine, ukuze kungabikho lutho phakathi kwami nomndeni wakwababa wami ngenxa yegazi elingenacala elibiwe nguYowabha.

uzimu uzokwenza bona igazi lakhe libuyiselwe kuye; ngombana wahlasela abantu ababi, abangcono kunaye, nabagqugquzeleka khulu, wabulala labo bantu ababi, uAbheri unyana kaNeri, umphathi wesizwe samaSirayeli, noAmasa unyana kaYetere, umphathi wesizwe samaYuda, agubha uDavide, ubaba wami.
Igazi labo lihlale kuYowabhi nomndeni wakhe kuze kube sekupheleni; kodwana uDavide, nomndeni wakhe, nendlu yakhe, nesihlalo sakhe, ikosi unikeze ukuthula kuze kube sekupheleni.
Waphuma uBhenaya, unyanadzi ka-Yehoyada, waivimba uYowabhi, wambulala; wabanjwa ekhaya lakhe, ezweni elimnyama.
Wabeka uBhenaya, unyana kaYehoyada, emkhosini endaweni kaYowabhi; wabeka noTsadoki ukumkani endaweni ka-ebiyathari.

Ngonyaka owodwa namashumi amathathu, kwasuka tahalavi ababili eShimeзынга ku-Akishi unyana kaMa snaka, ukumkani waseGathi; begodu babikezela izindaba zakhe, besithi: Akubonakali yini abakhonzi bakho baseGati?

Wavuka ephakathi kwemini, wathatha unyana wami enhliziyweni yami, ngangihlala ngifile; wabeka emlenzeni wakhe, wabeka unyana wayo ofile emlenzeni wami.

uSolomoni wathumela lo myalezo emuva kuHiram:

Uyazi bona uDavide, ubaba wami, akakwazanga ukukwakha indlu igama likaYehova uzimu wakhe, ngenxa yokulwa kwakhe nezitha zakhe ezingokwesobunxele, kuze kube yilapho ikosi ewazibeka ngaphasi kwezinyawo zakhe.

Wahlala uSolomoni phambi kwesihlalo somlilo sikaYehova, ebhekene nabo bonke abantu bakaSirayeli, waphakamisa izandla claroba.

Wathi, Kosi, uzimu kaSirayeli, akukho uzimu ofana nawe esibhakabhakeni phezulu, noma ezweni ngezansi; wena ogcina isivumelwano nethando kubakhonzi bakho abalandela wenaseduze kwakho ngenhliziyo sabo yonke.
Owugcinele umkhonzi wakho uDavide, ubaba wami, amazwi akho; njengombana wakhuluma ngomlomo wakho, begodu ukwenze ngesandla sakho, njengokuba namuhla.

Manje ke, ikosi, uzimu kaSirayeli, gcina lokho okusho kumkhonzi wakho uDavide, ubaba wami, esithi, Akuzosihlwayela indodana yakho phambi kwami uhlala esibhedlela sakwaSirayeli, uma nje izingane zakho ziyigcina imithetho yami, zihamba phambi kwami, njengokuba ukhambe phambi kwami.
Ngokuba manje, Kosi uzimu kaSirayeli, liqiniseke ilizwi lakho olifumene umkhonzi wakho uDavide, ubaba wami.
Ingabe uzimu uzohlala emhlabeni? Izulu eliphakeme lingeke likwazi ukukuthwala wena. Ngabe kuphi indlu yami engiyinile?
Ngalokho-ke, ngiyakucela bona ulalele ukuthandaza komkhonzi wakho nokwesaba kwakhe, Kosi uzimu wami; wrote for the cry and prayer aentray of my brute.
Amehlo akho ahlale ebheke le ndlu ekuseni nakusihlwa, indawo lapho uthe khona bona igama lami lizohlala khona, ukuze uphendule umthandazo obewuthandaza umkhonzi wakho ngalendawo.

Uthi, "Kulungile, uNkosi, ngikucela bona uphendule izithandazo zomkhonzi wakho nomphakathi wakho waseSirayeli, lapho bethandaza kulesi siqhingi; uphendule ezulu, endaweni yokuhlala kwakho, uphendule, ukhulule.
Uma umuntu ekhohlisa umngane wakhe, begodu ephoqwa ukuba aphe Bakucela bona aphike, bese efika ephuza isipho phambi kwesiqokobhe sakho kulo ndlu;
khona-ke, lalela ezulu, ukwenze, ugweme phakathi kwabakhonzi bakho; ugweme owinile ngokufanele kwakhe, begodu ugweme ongawinili ngokufanele kwakhe.
Uma abantu bakho isiSirayeli behlaselwa phambi komshado wabo, ngenxa yobubi babo kuwe, bese bebuyela kuwe, beveza igama lakho, bethandaza, becela usizo kulowo ndlu;
usazise emazulu, ukhulule isono sabantu bakho baseSirayeli, ubabuyisele ezweni olinikeze abababa babo.
Uma isibhakabhaka sivalwe, kungasekho imvula, ngenxa yokuthi abantu bakho babusile kuwe; uma bethandaza ngaleso sifundazweni, beveza igama lakho, bese bebuyela emthethweni wabo, sithi, uma ubababula,

usazise emazulwini, ukhulule isono samakhonzi akho nabantu bakho baseSirayeli, ubafundise indlela efanele yokuyihamba, begodu unciphise umswakama phezu kwezwe olinikeze abantu bakho ukuba libe yindawo sabo.
Detaljerne er en kort oversigt over de vigtigste seværdigheder og højdepunkter, så skal du gå videre til næste trin. Derefter følger den korte vejledningen, som fører dig direkte til dit hotel.
noma ngimuphi umuntu, wonke abantu bakho isiSirayeli, uma ethandaza, uma ecela usizo, ngaso soke isikhathi lapho eqonda khona inkanuko yenhliziyo yakhe, begodu efaka izandla zakhe kule ndlu;

khona-ke ulalele emazulwini, endawo yakho yokuhlala, ukhulule begodu wenze; enze wonke umuntu ngokuya ngalokho akwenzayo, njengombana uyazi inhliziyo yakhe; ngombana wena kuphela owazi inhliziyo yabantu bonke.
Bazokuhlonipha wena yonke imihla abaphila ngayo phezu kwezwe olibanikileyo ababa bethu.
Naphezu kwalokho, noma ngabe isizwe esingaphandle, esingasekho ezweni lakho iSirayeli, sizofika eduze ngenxa yegama lakho.
Bazokhuluma ngegama lakho elikhulu, nesandla sakho esinamandla, nomlenze wakho oqinile; uma befika bathandaza kulesi ndlu:

khona-ke ulalele ezulu, endaweni yokuhlala kwakho, wenze konke okuzokubiza ngawo lo mngane wakho; ukuze zonke izizwe zezulu zikwazi igama lakho, zibe nokuthula nawe, njengabantu bakho isiSirayeli; begodu bayazi bona igama lakho libizwa ngalo indlu yami engiyenze.
Uma abantu bakho bephuma emkhosini babhekane nabaphikisi babo, ngaso soke isikhathi lapho uwathumela khona, bese bethandaza kuYehova bebheke lo mzi owazikhethele wona, nendlu engiyise igama lakho;
khona-ke ulalele umthandazo wabo kanye nezingcezu zabo ezulu, begodu ubasize banqobe icala labo.
Uma bekwenza isono kuwe, (njengombana akukho muntu ongeke akwenzele isono), begodu uphoxeke kubo, wabanikela ebusweni bezi televizoru zabo, ukuze bathathe abacwaningi babo babe yimindeni sabo;
bese bebuyela ezandleni zabo ezweni lapho bathunyelwe khona, bese bebuya becela usizo kuwe khona, bathi, Sithole isono, sakwenza okumbi, sasebenza ngokungemthetho;

uma bebuyela kuwe ngenhliziyo sabo yonke, nangomphefumulo wabo wonke, ezweni lalabo ababoshwa kulo, bese bethandaza kulowo hlangothi lwezwe lakho, owalinika ababuphikisi babo, nedolobha elikhethiwe, nendlu engiyinile igama lakho;
khona-ke ulalele ukuthandaza kwabo nokucela kwabo ezulu, lapho uhlala khona, begodu ubasize banqobe icala labo.
Uzoyisabalalisa abantu bakho abaye bakwenza okumbi kuwe, uzobasusa bonke ubugebengu babo. Uzoyisabalalisa labo abawathathayo, ukuze babe nenhlonipho kuwe.
Bakho abantu bakho na bieni lakho, owabakhipha eYiputa, phakathi kwe aplikacij SABI..
Lapha amehlo akho azobe evulekile emithandazelweni yomkhonzi wakho, nasen nadumeni lwakho laseSirayeli, ukuwalalela ngaso soke isikhathi lapho bekhuluma kuwe.

ngombana wena uwazikhethela ukuba babe impahla yakho, phakathi kwazo zonke izizwe zomhlaba, njengombana uthe ngesandla sakho umkhonzi wakho uMoses, lapho wakhipha khona obaba bethu eYiputa, Kosi yethu ikosi.

Kwathi lapho uSolomone eqedile ukuthandaza lo mthandazo wonke, nokwenza lezi zicelo kuYehova, wahlala phambi kwesihlalo somlilo sikaYehova, lapho wayekade ehleli khona emgodini wakhe, ngezandla zakhe ezingcolisa phezu kwesibhakabhaka.
Wahlala khona, wabasabisa bonke ibandla lakwaSirayeli, wathi ngezwi elikhulu:

Ngiyabonga ikosi, ngenxa yokuthi wanikeza isikhala abantu bakhe baseSirayeli, njengombana atjhilo; akukho igama elilodwa elaliphazamiseka phakathi kwazo zonke izindaba ezinhle awazenzile ngoMosesi umkhonzi wakhe.
UYehova, uzimu wethu, abe nathi, njengokuba ube nabantu bethu bokuqala; asikushiyenga, asikushiye.
Uphinde alungise inhliziyo yethu kuye, ukuze sihambe zonke izindlela zakhe, Bakugcine izimiso zakhe, namalungiselelo akhe, nezibopho zakhe, awawisela amadodana ethu.
Lezo zinto ngizibiza ngazo kukaNkulunkulu, zihlale eduze kukaYehova uzimu wethu ekuseni nakusihlwa, ukuze asize umkhonzi wakhe nomphakathi wakhe waseSirayeli, ngokwezidingo zansuku zonke.
Begodu kuzozi zonke izizwe zezulu bona ikosi nguye uzimu, akukho omunye.
Ngiyakucela ke, bona nihlaledzile ikosi uzimu wethu, nihambe ngezimiso zakhe, nigcine amalungiselelo akhe, njengamanje.
Wathi ukumkani, naye wonke amaSirayeli naye, wanikela ngenhlanhla kuYehova.
USolomoni wanikela izipho zokuthula kuYehova, izinkomo ezingu-22, nezimvu eziyinkulungwane neshumi nambili. Ngaleyo le ukumkani kanye nabo bonke abantu bakaSirayeli bamisa indlu kazimu.

Ngomhla owodwa lowo ukumkani wamisa indawo ephakathi kwendlu yangasese, eyayingaphambili kwendlu kaYehova; ngombana khona lapho wanikela khona ngezipho ezibomvu, nezipho zokudla, nenyama yezi iminikelo yokuthula; ngombana isibingelelo sesiliva esibhekene nozimu sabancane ngokwanele bona sikwazi ukuzifaka.

Wakwenza njalo uSolomoni, naye wonke amaSirayeli naye, ibandla elikhulu khulu, lavela lapho kufike khona iHamati enyakatho, nalapho kufike khona umlambo waseMisri entshonalanga; bakwenza njalo phambi koYehova uzimu wethu izinyanga ezisixhenxe, nezinsuku eziyisixhenxe, nsuku ezilishumi elinane.

Ngosuku olulandelayo, uSolomoni washiya abantu besuka ezindaweni zabo. Babhikelela ukumkani, babuyela ezindlini zabo, bevumile, bevumile ngenhliziyo sabo, ngenxa yobulungisa bonke obewenzayo ikosi kumkhonzi wakhe uDavide, nakwaSirayeli abantu bakhe.
USolomoni ke waqedela ukwakha indlu kaYehova, nendlu yobukhosi; begodu konke okuzofuna ukukwenza uSolomoni, akwenzela.
Wabonakala ikosi kuSolomoni kathathu, njengokuba wabonakala kuye eGibheyoni.

Wathi ikosi kuye, Ngikuphendulile ukuthandaza kwakho, nokucela kwakho ngami; ngiyingcwelele le ndlu oyenzayo, ukuze ngibeke khona igama lami kuze kube sekupheleni; amehlo ami nezinhliziyo zami zizohlala khona njalo.
Begodu wena, uma uhamba phambi kwami, njengokuba wahamba ngawo uDavide, ubaba wakho, ngenhliziyo ecacile, wenze okulungile, wenze konke engikushoyo, ugcine izimiso zami nemithetho yami;
ngizoqinisa isikhala sakho sobukhosi phezu kwaSirayeli kuze kube sekupheleni, njengokuthi ngasho kuDavide ubaba wakho, esithi, Uzoba nendodana uhlala esihlalweni sobukhosi sakwaSirayeli.
Uma ke, wena noma izingane zakho, nisuka engangilandelani, ningagcinanga imiyalo yami nemithetho yami engibeka phambi kwenu, kodwana niya kukhonza izitha zakwamanye amazwe, nizibophezele kuzo;
ngizowususa uSirayeli ezweni enihlelwe lona; begodu indlu le, engiyingcwelele igama lami, ngiyoyishiya. USirayeli uzoba yizinkolelo-binkolelo nezimanga phakathi kwamazwe onke.
Ngokuba le ndlu ikhulu khulu, wonke umuntu odlula kuyo uzokhathazeka, begodu uzophuza utshwala; begodu bazothi, Kungani na bona ikosi akwenze lokhu kule ndawo nele ndlu?

Bazophendula bathi, Ngenxa yokuthi bashiye ikosi uzimu wabo, owakhipha obaba babo ezweni laseYiputa, bethwala izitha zakwamanye amazwe, babezibophezela kuzo, bezikhonza; yingalokho ikosi wazisa phezu kwabo konke okumbi.
Wathatha uSolomoni iminyaka eyishumi nesishiyagalombili ukukwakha lezi zindawo ezimbili, indlu kaYehova nendlu yobukhosi.

UHiramu ukumkani waseTire wayemnika uSolomoni izihlahla zesiqalo, nezihlahla zezinkomo, negolide, njengombana efuna. Wathi uSolomoni ukumkani wamnika uHiramu izindawo eziyishumi nambili ezweni laseGaliliya.
UHirame waphuma eTire, ukuze abone amadolobhana aSolomoni ayemnikezile; kodwana awathandanga.
Wathi, "Udade wami, yini uhlobo izifunda bona usinikele?" Ngalokho wabiza leyo ndawo Land of Kabul, okungukuthi, enhle ngalutho, begodu kulokhu ibizwa bona namuhla.
UHirame wathumela ukumkani italente elilodwa neshumi nambili legolide, elingamashumi amabili namathani.
Lokho wumlando womsebenzi owenziwe nguSolomoni ukumkani, lapho ekwakha khona indlu kaYehova, nendlu yakhe, neMilo, nodonga lweYerusalem, namadolobhana aseHazori, neMegido, neGezeri.
UFaro, ukumkani waseYiputa, wahlasela uGezere, wawuthatha, wawucima, wabulala abaKanani abahlala khona, wanikela lo mzi njengesipho somtshali-zimali kunkosikazi kaSolomoni, intombi yakhe.
USolomoni wakwakha iGezere, begodu wakwakha iBetho-horoni ephansi,
noBahalathi, noThamari, ezweni lakhe elisha.

Wakwakha namadolobha onke amagatsha akhe, namadolobhane emoto yakhe, namadolobhana ebhayisikili lakhe; begodu konke okwenze wafuna ukukwenza eYerusalem, naseLibanoni, kanye nezwe lonke elingaphansi kombuso wakhe.
Kwabe sekusele abantu abase-A Indikwi, namaHethi, namaPerizi apparte,somisiwe, namaJebhusi; kodwana labo bantumalienga kwabaSijuša.
Babe yimindeni yamazwe amaSirayeli angeke akwazi ukuwabulala ngokuphelele. USolomoni wabacindezela ukuba basebenze njengezihlwele, begodu namanje namuhla.

KwabeSirayeli ke, uSolomoni akhenge abeke wonke umuntu emkhondweni wakhe; bebengamadodana akhe, nabaphathi bakhe, nabangane bakhe, nabahlengikazi bakhe, nabagqugquzeli bezimoto zakhe, namabhayisikili.
Kwabaošanasi bomsebenzi kaSolomoni, abangamakhulu amahlanu namashumi mahlanu, abaqondisa abantu abasebenza nemisebenzi.
USolomoni wakwakha iMilo, ngemuva kokuba inkosikazi kaFaro yasuka edolobhaneni likaDavide iye emzini owawuyindlu yakhe.

USolomoni wanikela ngamadini omlilo, namaallum ONUKA, izikhathi sobiethathu ngonyaka, esitezi esi qoz Quran tänko, ebesiwukwakha ikosi; wakhipha begodu umnqumo phambi kukaNkulunkulu. Waqedela ke indlu definitely.
USolomoni ukumkani wenza begodu izinqanawa e-Eziongebere, eduze kwe-Elath, enkabeni ye Produk, endaweni yaseEdom.
UHirame wathumela abantu bakhe, abahamba ngezinqanawa, abakwaziyo ilwandle, ukuba basebenze ezindaweni zokuhamba ngesikebhe nabangani bakaSolomoni.
Bahambaošanasa e-Ofiri, babuya bethwala uSolomoni italente zegolide ezingumakhulu mahlanu namashumi amabini.
Wathi unkosikazi waseShebha, lapho ezwa bona uSolomoni use Bakube mkhulu ngenxa yegama likaYehova, wafika waya kumhlola ngezinto ezinzima.

ke wafika eYerusalem, nomphakathi omkhulu khulu, nama-apile aphathe izithako eziphuzayo, negolide eliningi khulu, namatshe abalulekile. Wa isina uSolomoni, wakhuluma naye ngazo zonke izinto ezikhona engqondweni sáto.
USolomoni waphendula yonke imibuzo yakhe; akukho lutho olukude khulu emkhosini, angeke amcacise.
Unkosikazi waseShebha, lapho nakabona bona uSolomoni unengqondo, wabheka indlu yakhe ayenze,

begodu ukudla kwetafula lakhe, nokuhlala kwabaphathi bakhe, nabangane bakhe abagqoke izicathulo zabo, nabagibeli bakhe, nezipho zakhe ezibomvu azenzayo ethempelini likaYehova; walahlekelwa yinhliziyo yakhe.
Wathi kuye ukumkani, Kulungile konke ongingakutshela ngaye ezweni lami ngezinto zakho, nekhono lakho.

Angikaze ngiyikholwa le nto, kuze ngifike ngiyibone ngamehlo ami; begodu ngabona bona iningi layo alikabikho lithiwe kimi; kodwana ubuhlakani bakho nezimali zakho zikhulu khulu kunazo zonke izindaba engizazi.
Kuhle khulu abantu bakho! Kuhle khulu labo abaphathi, abahlala njalo phambi kwakho, belalela ubuhlakani bakho!

Ngiyabonga kuYehova uzimu wakho, ngombana ethandana nawe, bona akubeke phezu kwesitulo sakwaSirayeli; ngenxa yokuthi ikosi uthanda amaSirayeli kuze kube sekuphele isikhathi eside, wakwenza wena ukumkani, ukuze wenze isinqumo nomthetho.

Wanikeza ukumkani italente elilodwa neshumi nambili zegolide, namalitha ayisikhombisa amafutha omnqumo, nezinye izinto eziwusizo eziningi khulu, namatshe amahle. Akukho othile owanikela ngezinto eziwusizo ezifana nalezo urapekazi waseSheba awanikeze ukumkani uSolomoni.
Iinqanawa zikaHirame, ezithwala igolide kusuka e-Ofiri, zazithwala neemithi ye-almug claro, namatshe amahle khulu kusuka e-Ofiri.
Le ntokazi yasebenzisa i-almug wood ukwenza ama-railinges ethempelini lenkosi kanye nepalazi elisemthethweni, kanye nokwenza ama-harps nama-lyres ahlotshaniswa nomculo.
USolomoni ukumkani wamnika unkosikazi wase-Shebha konke okufunayo, yonke into ayeyifunayo, ngaphandle kwazo zonke izinto akhenge azinikeze; wabuyela ezweni lakhe yena nomndeni wakhe.
Wonke unyaka kwafika kuSolomoni italente legolide elinamakhulu ayisishiyagalolunye, namashumi amathandathu anesithandathu.
dan, - ser ni umo...rettento de cada um!- esquema a seguir na sua vida.
U Thyošanase wakwenza amagilavu amakhulu ayizinkulungwane ezimbili, egolide elitsheni elihlanganisiwe; amashekeli ayikhulu nesishiyagalombili wegolide kwafakwa kumagilavu asinawo.

Wakwenza begodu izigqoko ezincane ezingumakhulu amathathu, ezenziwe ngegolide elihlanganisiwe; ngayinye yazo isisindo sayo saba ngama-mines amathathu egolide, amashumi amahlanu amakhilogremu. Wazibeka emzini wemithi yaseLibanoni.
Wakwenza ukumkani isibhedlela esikhulu segolide, wasiza ngegolide elihle.

Isikhundla sayo sinezinhlangothi eziyisishiyagalombili, begodu icala laso linezingxenye ezimbili ezijikelezayo. Kwaba khona izinyawo ezihuquzela ngakwesobunxele nakwesokudla kwesihlalo; kwabe kukhona ingulube uhlala eduze kwezinyawo zonke.
Kwabekho izimvu ezingu-12 zahlala emadolobhe maxime, ngayinye engxenyeni yazo zonke izinyathelo. Akukho lutho olufana nalo lwakhiwa kulo lonke elaseMpumalanga.

Wonke umbhoshongo wokudla kaSolomoni waba ngugolide, begodu zonke izitsha zendlu yomlilo waseLibanone zaba ngugolide oluhlanzekile; akukho lutho okwenziwa ngesiliva, ngombana isiliva lathathwa njengento encane ngesikhathi sikaSolomoni.
Kwabekho izikebhe zokuhweba zakumkakhe elwandle, nazo zonke izikebhe zikaHirame; ngonyaka owodwa-ke kwabuya izikebhe, zithwale igolide, nesilivere, nezinkomo, nezingulube, namapheya.
USolomoni ukumkani waba mkhulu ukudlula bonke abaphathi bomhlaba, ngemali nolwazi.
Abantu abavela kiwo wonke umhlaba bafuna ukuvakashela uSolomoni ukuze babone ubuhlakani obubeka uzimu enhliziyweni yakhe.
Kusukela ngonyaka kuya kunyaka, bonke abafikayo beletha izipho zabo: izinto zesiliva ne阐金, nama strove, žale khulu; futhitoodwe, nezikhali nakanjani Hafi.
USolomoni waqoqa izimoto zokugibela, namabhayisikili; waba nezigidi ezingu-1 zezimoto zogibela, namahhashi ayishumi nanhlanu amawaka. Wabeka abanye emizini yezimoto zakhe, nabanye naye eYerusalem.
Wakwenza bona isiliva libe likhulu eYerusalem njengamatshe, begodu izikebhe zibe likhulu njengezihlahla zezinkomo ezisenyakatho.
Namahhashi kaSolomoni ayethuthwa eYiputa; abahwebi bakakumkani babewathenga ngamakhowe, amakhowe ngamanani.

begodu imoto ngayinye esuka eYiputa yathengwa ngeshekeli elinamakhulu ayisishiyagalombili, nenja ngayinye ngeshekeli elinamakhulu amane namashumi amahlanu. Nabo bonke abanikazi bamaHithi, nabanikazi base-Aram, bathenga kubo.
USolomoni ukumkani wathanda izifazane eziningi zakwamanye amazwe, ngaphandle kwendodana kaFaro; kwabekho nabesifazane baseMowabhi, nama-Ammonita, nama-Edomita, namaSidonita, namaHethiti.

Bavela emazweni amanye, lapho ikosi abewisela khona amaSirayeli, wathi, "Ungaba nomfazi phakathi kwabo, begodu bangaba nomfazi phakathi kwenu; ngombana uma bekwenza njalo, inhliziyo yenu izoguquka ibe yimithandazo sabo." USolomoni, ke, waba nezingane ezinjalo.
Wabe namadodakazi angamakhulu asixhenxe, abezinkosikazi, namabhishobhi angamakhulu amathathu; amakhosikazi akhe awashintshile intamo yakhe.

Kwathi lapho uSolomone eneminyaka emikhulu, izifazane zakhe zashintsha inhliziyweni yakhe ilandele amanye amadini; begodu inhliziyweni yakhe ayizange iphele ngokupheleleko kuYehova uzimu wakhe, njengokuba inhliziyweni kaDavide ubaba wakhe.
USolomoni walandela i-Ashtoreth, indodana kaThixo yamaSidoni, noMilkom, isidalwa esibi sama-Amoni.
Wakwenza uSolomoni okumbi emehloni kaYehova, akawutholanga ngokuphelele umsebenzi kaYehova, njengokuthi uDavide, ubaba wakhe, wawutholele.
Ngaleso sikhathi uSolomoni wakwakha indawo ephakeme kaKemoshi, igugu lakwaMowabi, emfuleni obhekene neYerusalem; walungisa begodu uMoloki, igugu lakwaAmoni.
Wakwenza njalo namadodakazi akhe wonke angaphandle, abephuza uvumba, abenikela izipho ezingcwele zabo.
UYehova wagwema uSolomoni, ngenxa yokuthi intliziyo yakhe yasuka Bakubonile ikosi, uzimu kaSirayeli, owabonakala kuye izikhathi ezimbili.

Hamba ufike ku-Ahabhi ukumkani wakwaSirayeli, ahlala eSamari; bona, usesitezi sewayini sikaNabhothi; waphuma waya kuyo ukuze ayithathe.

Uzothi kuye, Usho ukuthini ikosi? Wabulala yini umuntu, wathatha imbewu yakhe? Uzothi kuye begodu, Usho ukuthini ikosi? Ezweni lapho izinja zidlale khona igazi likaNabhothi, izinja zizodlala khona negazi lakho.
Wathi uAhabhi kuEliya, "Ungithola kanjani, nkosikazi yami?" UEliya waphendula wathi, "Ngikuthola; ngombana sewuthengise umzimba wakho ukuze wenze okumbi emehloni kaYehova.
Uthi ikosi: "Njengombana ngi taha جنس, ngazo zonke iziilibhi zomndeni kaAhabhi ezweni isoka kanye nomuntu ophilayo emhlabeni wonke,
begodu ngizokwenza indlu yakho ibe njengendlu kaYarobhoamu unyana kaNabati, nendlu kaBhasha unyana ka-Ahiya; ngenxa yokuthi ungisizise, wakwenza isiSirayeli sigweme.
Begodu nge-Yezebeli, kusho ikosi, Izinyoni zizodla i-Yezebeli esitezi se-Jezreeli.
Okufa edolobhaneni lakwa-Ahabhi uzokudla izinja, begodu okufa emhlabathini uzokudla iinhlapi."
Akubekho umuntu ofana noAhabhidzi, owathengisa yena ukuba akwenzeivimbi emehlo kaYehova, ngenxa yowesifazane wakhe uYezebeli.
Wakwenza izinto ezibuhlungu, wakhonza amatshe, ngokufana nalokho ababekwenza Kurti, abantu ikosi abewasusa phambi kwabaSirayeli.
Kwathi lapho uAhabhi ekhuluma ngalolu cingo, waxosha izigqoko zakhe, wagqoka igxathu negxathu, wahamba engadli ukudla; wahlala egxathu negxathu, wahamba ngesandla sakhe.
Ke kaloku kwafika igama likaYehova kuEliya waseTishbi, lithi,

Ubone bona uAhabhi wanyamalala phambi kwami? Ngenxa yokuthi wanyamalala, ngeke ngikulethe lesi simo esibi ngesikhathi sakhe sokuphila; ezikhathini zowesifazane wakhe ngizolilethela phezu kwendlu yakhe.
Ngeminyaka emithathu kwakungekho umkhosi phakathi kweSyria ne-Israel.
Ngonyaka wesithathu, uJehoshaphat, ukumkani wakwaYuda, wehla ebhekane nokumkani wakwaSirayeli.
Wathi ukumkani wakwaSirayeli kwabakhonzi bakhe, Niyazi bona iRamoti-gileyadi yiyo yethu; kungani ke sihlala singenalutho ukuze siyibuyisele emkhosini waseSiriya?

Wathi kuJehoshaphat: Uzohamba nami ukubhekana no Ramoth-gileyadi? Waphendula uJehoshaphat ukumkani wakwaSirayeli, wathi: Ngizohlala nawe yonke indlela; abantu bami njengasabantu bakho, namabhayisikili ami ngamabhayisikili akho;
Wathi begodu uJehoshaphat kukumkani wakwaSirayeli, Ngisho manje, ngicela, buza ikosi.

Wathi ukumkani wakwaSirayeli, eqoqa abaprofeti, abantu abangamakhulu amane, wathi kubo, Ngiya emkhosini eRamoti-gileyadi, noma ngiyibeke phasi? Baphendula bathi, Yiya; ngombana ikosi uzowanikela engcupheni yobukhosi.
Wathi ke uJehoshafati, Ingabe akukho lapha umprofeti kaYehova ukuze siwubuze?

Waphendula ukumkani wakwaSirayeli, wathi ku-Jehoshaphat: "Kukhona umuntu owodwa ongeke siwubuze ikosi ngaye; kodwana ngimthanda, ngombana akusho lutho oluhle ngami, kodwana lutho olubi: nguMikaya unyana ka-Imla." U-Jehoshaphat wathi: "Akufanele umkakhe akhulume njalo."
Wathi ukumkani wakwaSirayeli, ebiza omunye wabaphathi bakhe, wathi, Thola ngokushesha uMikaye unyana ka-Imla.

Ubukhosi baseSirayeli, noJehoshaphatsi ukumkani wakwaYuda, begqoke izicathulo zabo zobukhosi, behlala ezindaweni zabo eziphakeme, ngaphesheya komgwaqo wesamariya; begodu bonke abaprofeti bekhuluma ngezulu phambi kwabo.
UZedekiya, unyana kaKenanaha, ubewenza amabhodlela ensimbi, wathi, Uthi lokho ikosi: Ngawo la mabhodlela uzodlidliza aSirayeli, kuze baphele.
Bathi nabo bonke abaprofeti ngalolu lutholo, besithi: "ENgwayelele eRasethi-gileadi pisanisa; ngobamedu ikosi uzoyinikela emkhonweni woiye."
Wathi kuye umthunywa odlule ukubiza uMikhaya, Thola bona bonke abaprofeti bakhuluma ngezwi elilodwa, besho okumbi ukumkani; ngikucela, sithi ilizwi lakho lifanane nabo, bese ukhuluma ngokubi.
Wathi uMikaya, Uphila ikosi bona ngizokhuluma lokho okushoyo ikosi.
