Wafika kuye ukumkani, wambuza ukumkani wathi: "Mikhaya, kufanele sihambe eRamoti-gileyadi ukubhekana nokulwa, noma televizora?" UMika waphendula wathi: "Hamba uphumelele; ngombana uzimu uzoyišola emkhosini."
Wathi ukumkani kuye, Ingabe ngizokubiza ngamazwi aphikisayo, bona ungamitshela lutho ngaphandle kweqiniso ngegama likaYehova?

Wathi uMika, Ngabona bonke isiSirayeli besakazeka emadolobheni amakhulu, njengamakhoboka angeke abe nomnikazi; begodu ikosi wathi, Leyo ndoda ayinakho umphathi; ahambe wonke umuntu ekhaya lakhe ngoxolo.
Wathi ukumkani wakwaSirayeli kuYehoshafati, Angikushonga yini kuwe bona akakhuluma ngami lutho oluhle, kodwana okumbi?
Wathi uMika, Yiqiniso, lalela ilizwi likaYehova: Ngibona ikosi uhlala esihlalweni sakhe sobukhosi, namadodana onke omhlaba abhekene naye ngakwesokudla kwakhe nokwesobunxele kwakhe.
Wathi ikosi, Nguwubani ozoba nomsindo kuAhabhi ukuba ahambe eRamoti-Gileyadi, ukuze afe khona? Omunye wathi luthosziki, omunye wathi olunye.
Ke kaloku kwaphuma umphefumulo, wahlala phambi koYehova, wathi, Ngizowukhohlisa.
Wathi ikosi, Ngabe yini? UMoya wathi, Ngizophuma ngibe ngumphefumulo weqiniso emlonyeni wabaprofeti bakhe bonke. Wathi ikosi, Uzowukhohlisa, begodu uzophumelela; iya, yenza.
Ngalokho-ke manje, ikosi wabeka umphefumulo okhohlisayo phakathi kwalabo bonke aba Rusizi bakho. Untetho kaMoya oyiNgcwele ithi: "ikosi ifuna ukubazva."
UZedekiya unyana ka-Kenanaha wafika, wehlisa umlomo wakhe emlonyeni kaMikhaya, wathi: Ngayiphi indlela edlula ngayo umoya woNkulunkulu ngami ukukhuluma nawe?
Wathi uMikaye, Uzokwazi ngalolu busuku lapho uzama ukufihla egumbini elingaphakathi.
Wathi ukumkani wakwaSirayeli, Thola uMikaya, uyithumelele kuAmoni umphathi wedolobha, noYo Produkгесo umfazi.
Nithi, Lokho kusho ukumkani: Beka lo muntu ezindaweni zokugcina izinto Bakunikeze ukudla okuncane namanzi ambalwa kuze ngibuye ngempilo.
Wathi uMikhaya, "Uma usubuya ngokunewirirana, khona-ke scart: uzimu akakhuluma * ngami." Aphinde wathi, "Hlathini lokhu, bonke abantu!
Baye ke ukumkani wakwaSirayeli, noJehoshafati ukumkani wakwaYuda, beya eRamoti-gileadi.

Wathi ukumkani wakwaSirayeli kuYehoshafati, Ngizoshintsha isithombe sami, ngiye emidlalweni; kodwana wena ugqoke izicathulo zakho. Uthe ke ukumkani wakwaSirayeli washintsha isithombe sakhe, waya emdlalweni.
U Thyošanas, ukumkani waseSiriya, wabatjela abaphathi bezimoto zakhe, bona: Ungadlalwa nomuntu oncane noma omkhulu, ngaphandle kukakumkani wakwaSirayeli.
Bathe abaphathi bezimoto bebona uJehoshafati, bathi, "Kuyinto yena ukumkani wakwaSirayeli!" Baphinde babhekana naye; kodwana uJehoshafati wavuma.
Kwathi lapho abaphathi bezimoto bebona bona akayena ukumkani wakwaSirayeli, babuyela emuva.

Nokho omunye umuntu washaya umcibisholo ngaphandle kokusukela, wehlisa ukumkani waseSirayeli phakathi kwempahla yakhe yokulwa. Wathi uūri kulowo ophethe isithunywa sakhe: "Buyisela emuva, ngisuse em zaini; ngombana sengilahlekile."
Impi yaqhubeka yonke imihla. Ubukhosi babeka isibhamu sawo esibhekene nabase-Aram, wafa ngaleso sikhathi; begodu ugazi olusuka emlonyeni wakhe lwawela phezu komhlaba wesibhamu.
Uma ilanga liphuma, kwafika umdzibaniso phakathi komkhosi, beiasondeza bona: "Umuntu ngamnye abuye edolobhaneni lakhe; umuntu ngamnye abuye ezweni lakhe!"
Wafa ke ukumkani, wathunyelwa eSamariya, wazalelwa khona.
Bahlanza imoto yakhe eභාවni laseSamari,wirirake amakati اماتлежа ubisi lwakhe; begodu Amadodakazi ageza khona, njengokuthi kaYehova.
Okunye konke okwenze uAhabhi, nezinto zonke azenzayo, kanye nendlu yezinkomo ayeyenzayo, namadolobha akhe onke ayewenzayo, akubona bonke babhalwe encwadini yamaqiniso wamabukhosi bamaSirayeli?
Wafa uAhabhi, waba ngukumkani uAhaziya unyana wakhe.
UJehoshaphat, unyana ka-Asa, waba ngukumkani wakwaYuda ngonyaka wesine kaAhabhi ukumkani wakwaSirayeli.

UJehoshafati ubeminyaka imashumi amathathu anesihlanu ezelwe, lapho eqala ukumkani; waba neminyaka eyishumi nambili nesishiyagalombili engukumkani eYerusalem. Ubaba wakhe wayenguAzuba intombi kaShilhi.
Wahamba yonke indlela ka-Asa ubaba wakhe, akhenge ayishintshe; wakwenza okulungile emehlo kaYehova; kodwana izindawo eziphakeme azisuswa; abantu baqhubeka benikela khona, befutha khona inkungu.
UJehoshaphat wakwenza nokuthula nomphathi waseSirayeli.
Okunye konke okwenze uJehoshafati, nemisebenzi yakhe enamandla, nezimpi zakheописано ли в книге летописей царей Иуды?
Wakhipha ezweni labo abase-Israeli, ababehlala khona ngesikhathi sikaAsa ubaba wakhe, laba madodana asendaweni yo claro.
Ngaleso sikhathi kwakungekho ukumkani e-Edom; kwaba khona umphathi.
U olduk فضای Hele彼 انحصارe e-Ophire ukuthenga igolide massimathizo, kodwana akhenge azi mô Умdabukazi; ngombana izikhephe zalahleka e-Ezion-Geber.
U-Achani tsime, uyaxosha. U-U-U-U-činka-U-U-U-U-U-U-U-U-U-U kakala u-U- dojsta-u-U-U-U-U-U-U-U-U förståsССРI)
Waphumula uJehoshafati, washiswa nababa bakhe edolobha maximeni likaDavide umzali wakhe. UYoram unyana wakhe waba ngukumkani esikhundleni sakhe.
UAhaziya, unyana ka-stehen "ubukhosi baseSirayeli" eSamariya ngonyaka oyisixhenxe yeshumi nesishiyagalombili kaJehoshafati ukumkani waseYuda; waba ngukumkani wakwaSirayeli iminyaka emibini.
Wakwenza okumbi emehloni kaYehova; walandela indlela yobaba wakhe noyise, nendlela kaYarobohami unyana kaNabati, owakwenza isiSirayeli siphele.
Wakhonza uBhaali, wathandaza kuye; wehlaza inhliziyo kaYehova, uzimu wakwaSirayeli, ngazo zonke izinto azenzayo ubaba wakhe.
2Kgs: Ngemuva kokufa kuka-Ahabhi, izwe likaMowabi lahlasela amaSirayeli.
UAhaziya wehla ngefenisha yegumbi lakhe eliphakeme eSamariya, wavuvuka khulu. Wathumela abantu, wathi kubo, Yeni nibuze uBaale-zebhubu, ikosi se-Ekron, bona ngizophiliswa yini ngalesi sifo sami.

Wathi umbingeleli kaYehova kuEliya waseTishbi, Yikhuphule, uye ukuhlangabezana nabathunywa bakakumkani wesamariya, uthi kubo, Ingabe akukho uzimu eSirayeli, bona niye nibuze uBaale-zebhubu, ikosi yaseAkron?
Ngako oko, kusho ikosi bona: Uzophuma ebhedini ohlala kulo, awukwazi ukubuyela emuva; kodwana uzofa ngokuqinisekile. Wahamba ke uEliya.
Kwathi lapho abathunywa bebuyela kuye, wathi kubo: "Yintoni ekwenzeni nibuye?"

Bathi kubo, Umuntu ufike ukubhekana nathi, wathi kuthi: "Yeni nibuye kukumkani owasithumelayo, nithi kuye, uzimu uthi lokhu: Ingabe akukho uzimu eSirayeli, bona uthumelele abantu ukuba babuze uBaale-zebhubu, uzimu ka-Ekron? Ngalokho ngeke ukhuphuke esibhedlela lapho uhlala khona; uzofa ngokuqinisekile."
Wathi kubo ukumkani, Kubukeka kanjani lowo muntu owafika ukubhekana nani, wakhuluma nalowo mbhalo?
Baphendula bathi, Wabe ngumntu onezinwele, nogqozi lwesikhumba ekhanda lakhe. Wathi ukumkani, Lowo nguEliya waseTishbi.

Wathumela kuye ukumkani umphathi wesibhakabhaka, namadoda akhe amashumi mahlanu; waphuma waya kuEliya, begodu yena wayesesitezi esiphezulu somfula, wathi kuye, Umuntu kaThixo, ukumkani uthi, Thola phasi.

UEliya waphendula wathi kulowo mphathi: "Uma ngimuntu kaThixo, khona-ke umlilo ukhuphuke esibhakabhakeni, uwudle wena namadoda akho amashumi amahlanu." Umlilo wehla esibhakabhakeni, wawudla lowo mphathi namadoda akhe amashumi mahlanu.
Wathumela ke ukumkani omunye umphathi weshumi nambili, nomadodana akhe amashumi amahlanu. Wathi kuye uEliya, Umuntu kaThixo, ukumkani uthi, Thola phezulu!

UEliya waphendula wathi, "Uma ngingumuntu kaThixo, khona-ke umlilo kufanele usetshenziswe phezulu ezulu, ube yiwo wena kanye nabantu bakho abangumashumi mahlanu." Umlilo kaThixo wehla phezulu ezulu, waba ngumlilo kulowo owayengumphathi wezikhulu eziyishumi nambili kanye nabantu bakhe abangumashumi mahlanu.

Wathumela ke ukumkani umphathi wesithathu wezikhulu eziyisishiyagalombili, naye namadoda akhe ayisishiyagalolunye; waphuma lowo mphathi wesithathu, wavuka, wajika imilenze yakhe phambi kukaEliya, wamcela, wathi kuye, Umuntu kaThixo, ngicela, ubone bona impilo yami, nokuphila kwalabo bantu abangumashumi mahlanu abasebenza kuwe, kuyinto ebaluleke.
Umlilo wehla esibhakabhakeni, wabulala abaphathi abathathu bokuqala namadoda abo; kodwana manje, ngicela, usize impilo yami.
Wathi umbingeleli kaYehova kuEliya, Thola ngezansi naye; ungamkholeli. UEliya ke wavuka, waphuma naye kuye ukumkani.

Wathi uEliya kuye ukumkani, uzimu uthi lokhu: "Uthumelele abathunywa ukubuza uBaale-zebhubu, ikosi se-Ekron? Ingabe kukhona uzimu eSirayeli ongawubuza lowo mbuzo? Ngokuba wenze lokhu, awuzokhuphuka esibhedlela ohlala kuso; uzofa."

Wafa ke uAhaziya, ngokusho kwamazwi kaYehova ayewatshela uEliya. UYoram waba ngukumkani endaweni yakhe, ngenxa yokuthi akhenge abe nendodana; kwaba ngomnyaka wesithathu kaYoram, unyana kaJehoshafati, ukumkani wakwaYuda.
Okunye okushiwo nguAhaziya, konke okwenze, akubonakali kubhalwe encwadini yezindaba zamakumkani baseSirayeli?
Kuze kube yilapho ikosi engeke athathe khona uEliya esibhakabhakeni, uEliya noElisha besuka eGalgali.
Wathi uEliya ku-Elisha, Uhlale lapha, ngiyakucela; ngombana ikosi ungithumelele eBheteli. Wathi uElisha, Uphila ikosi nokuphila kwakho, ngeke ngikushiye. Baye behla bahamba ndawonye eBheteli.
Baphuma ke abafundi bamaprofeti eBhabheli, bafika ku-Elisha, bathi kuye, Uyazi bona ikosi uzowuthatha umphathi wakho namuhla phezu kobuso bakho? Wathi uElisha, Ngiyazi; ungakhuluma ngalokho.
UEliya wathi kuye, Elisha, hlala lapha, ngiyakucela; ngombana ikosi ungithumela eJericho. Wathi uElisha, Kuphila ikosi nokuphila kwakho, ngeke ngikushiye. Baye befika eJericho,
Bafika khona abaprofeti eJericho, bakhuluma noElisa, bathi kuye, Uyazi yini bona ikosi uzowuthatha namuhla umphathi wakho phezu kwakho? Wathi yena, Ngiyazi; ungakhuluma ngalokho.
Wathi uEliya kuye, Nceda uhlale lapha; ngombana ikosi ungithumelele eYordan. Wathi uElisha, Uphila ikosi nokuphila kwakho, ngeke ngikushiye. Bahamba ke labo bobabili.
Bahamba abantu abangumashumi mahlanu emindenini yamaprofeti, behlala eduze kwabo; uEliya noElisa ke bahlala emfuleni iYorodani.
Wathatha uEliya isigqoko sakhe, wasigqugquzela, wehlisa amanzi; begodu amanzi ahlukaniswa ngakwesokudla nakwesobunxele, badlula bonke bemi phezu komhlaba omnyama.
Badlula, wathi uEliya ku-Elisha, Uthi yini bona ngikwenze wena ngaphambi kokuba ngithathelwe kude nawe? Waphendula u-Elisha wathi, Ngicela, ngithole ingxenye emibili yomoya wakho.
Wathi uEliya, Ucela lutho olunzima; kodwana uma ungibona lapho ngithathwa kude nawe, uzowuthola; kodwana uma ungangibonanga, awukwazi ukuwuthola.
Behamba bekhuluma, kwafika phakathi kwabo imoto yomlilo namabhayisikili omlilo; uEliya wanyuka ezulu emfushaneni wezulu.
UElisha wakubona, wathi, "Ubaba wami, ubaba wami, izimoto zakwaSirayeli, namabhayisikili kaSirayeli!" Akekho okwazi ukuwubona. Wathatha uElisha izingubo zakhe, wazazixosha zibe yizimbili.
Wathatha isigqoko, esiwela emlenzeni kaEliya, wabuyela, wahlala enkabeni yoMfula iJordani.
Wathatha isigqoko esiboshwe nguEliya, washaya amanzi, wathi, Ukhona yini ikosi, uzimu kaEliya? Washaya amanzi, ahlukaniswa ngakwesokudla nakwesobunxele; uElisha wadlula.
Kwathi lapho ibandla lamaprofeti eJericho, elibhekene naye, likubona, lathi, Umoya kaEliya ukhona phezu kuka-Elisha. Bafika bewuhlangana naye, babhujiswa phasi phambi kwakhe;

Bathi kuye, Thola, thina abakhonzi bakho sinabantu abangumashumi amahlanu abanothando; ngicela bahambe bafune unkosi wakho; kungase kube bona umphefumulo kaYehova uwuthathe, wawubeka emfuleni othile, noma emgodini othile. Wathi uElisha, Akunjalo, ungabathumeli.
Wathi, "Thumelani." Bathumela abantu abangu-50; bafuna iminyaka emithathu, kodwana abakwazi ukuwuthola uEliya. Uthe ke yena kubo: "Ngubani na lowo umuntu?
Babuyela kuye, begodu yena wayehlala eJericho. Wathi kubo, Ngabe angikutsheleni bona ningayihamba?
Bathi abantu baseJericho ku-Elisheha, Thola, kosi yami, indawo yalo mzi iyindawo enhle, njengombana ubona; kodwana amanzi angcolile, begodu izwe alikwazi ukuvuna.
Wathi uElisha, Ninikele isitsha esisha, nibeke khona umhluzi. Bamwilela ke.
Waphuma waya emfuleni, wabeka khona ukhilimu, wathi, uzimu uthi lokhu: "Ngiwuphilise lo lwandle; ngeke liphinde libe yingozi yokufa, noma kube yingozi yokulimala kwezwe."
Wathi uElisha, "Kulungile," begodu amanzi ahlala ehlanzekile kuze kube manje.

Kwathi lapho, uElisha wanyuka waya eBhethiyeli; begodu ngesikhathi esehamba ngendlela, kwaphuma abantu abancane emzini wakhe, bemxwayisa, bathi, Yiya phezulu, wena omnyama! Yiya phezulu, wena omnyama!
Wabheka emuva, wababona, wathi kubo ngegama lika-Yehova: kwaphuma khona izinyoni ezimbili zezilwanyana zeganga ezisuka emfuleni, zabulala abantu abangumashumi amane nabini.
Wasuka khona khona uElisha, waya emfuleni iKarmeli, wabuyela khona eSamari.
UYoram, unyana ka-Ahabhi, waba ngukumkani wakwaSirayeli eSamari, ngonyaka weshumi nambili nesishiyagalombili kaJehoshafati ukumkani wakwaYuda; waba neminyaka eyisithupha.
Wakwenza okumbi emehloni kaYehova, kodwana hhayi njengokuthi ubaba wakhe nodadewabo babekwenzela; wasusa isibonisi-mlilo sikaBahali, ebesenziwe ngubaba wakhe.
Kodwana-ke, waqhubeka nokwenza izigebengu zikaYarobhoamu unyana kaNabati, owenza amaSirayeli azinikele; akaze ahambe kuzo.
UMesha ukumkani wakwaMowabi wayenezinkomo eziningi, wanikela kukumkani waseSirayeli ngomnyaka owodwa izingulube ezingu-100, nezingwevu zezinkomo eziyi-100.
Kwathi, ngemuva kokufa kuka-Ahabhi, ukumkani wakwaMowabi wehlisa isandla sakhe emkhosini wamaSirayeli.
Ngaleso sikhathi ukumkani uYoram waphuma eSamariya, waqoqa wonke amakhosi aseSirayeli ukuba abe yimpi.

Wathumela uJehoshafati ukumkani wakwaYuda, esithi, Ubukhosi baseMowabhi buphumile ngami; ungahamba nami yini ukubhekana noMowabhi? Wathi yena uJehoshafati, Ngizohamba; ngizoba nawe yonke indlela; abantu bami njengabantu bakho, izimvu zami njengezimvu zakho.
Wathi uYoram, Ngayiphi indlela sizohlasela? Waphendula uYoram wathi, Ngosihlabathi seEdom.
Waphuma ke ukumkani wakwaSirayeli, nokumkani wakwaYuda, nokumkani wakwaEdom; bahamba nsuku ezisixhenxe, begodu kwakungekho amanzi emkhosini, nakwizinto eziphilako eziya nabo.
Wathi ukumkani wakwaSirayeli, Akunjalo! UYehova uhlanganise phakathi kwethu abaphathi abathathu, ukuze asize eMowabi.

Wathi uJehoshafati, Ingabe akukhona lapha umprofeti kaYehova, ukuze sibuze ikosi ngaye? Waphendula omunye wabaphathi bakakumkani wakwaSirayeli, wathi, Kukhona lapha uElisha unyana kaShafati, owenza amanzi ezandlani zikaEliya.
Wathi uJehoshafati, Izwi likaYehova likhona naye. Baphuma khona ukumkani wakwaSirayeli, noJehoshafati, nokumkani waseEdom, ukuba babone.

Wathi uElisha kukumkani wakwaSirayeli, Ingabe kunento engiyenzayo nawe? Iya kumaprofeti kababa wakho nomama wakho. Waphendula ukumkani wakwaSirayeli wathi, Akunjalo; ngombana nguYehova owenza ukuba kube khona phakathi kwethu abaphathi abathathu, ukuze asize amaMowabi.
Wathi uElisha, Uphila ikosi wemikhosi, uzimu obengisebenzela yena, bona uma sengingeke ngicabangele uJehoshafati ukumkani wakwaYuda, angikwazanga ukubheka wena, begodu angikuboni.
Kodwana manje, ngithole umuntu odlala i-harp. Nokho, lapho edlala khona i-harp, kwafika amandla kaYehova kuElisha;
Wathi, Lokho kusho ikosi: Nciphisa izintaba-mlilo kulo mfula wonke.
Uthi ikosi, Awubonanga umoya, awubonanga imvula; kodwana lo mfula uzogcwele amanzi; nizodla, nize nezilwane zenu, nenyama yenu yonke.
Le nto ilula khulu kuYehova; begodu uzobanikela phambi kwenu noMowabi.
Uzonqoba yonke idolobhana elihlanganisiwe, nanoma iyiphi inqaba eqinile; begodu uzophula wonke umnqumo omuhle, begodu uzovala zonke izimpophoma, begodu uzolimaza yonke indawo enhle ngemigodi.
Kwathi ekuseni, ngesikhathi sokudla isiphuzo sakusihlwa, kwafika amanzi asuka enkabeni yeEdomu; izwe lonke lagcwele amanzi.

Kwathi lapho abantu bonke baseMowabhi beva bona abakumkani bafika ukubhekana nabo emdlalweni, babizwa wonke umuntu okwaziyo ukugqoka isibhamu, kusukela engumntwana kuze kube ngumdala, begodu babekwa emigwaqweni.
Bavuka ekuseni, babona bona ilanga likhanya phezu kwamanzi. Amadodana kaMowabi asentshonalanga yalesi siqhingi nakabona amanzi emnyama njengegazi.
Bathi, Igazi likhona; kungenxa yokuthi abaphathi baphikisane, babulalana. Ngalokho-ke, wena uMowabi, sihambe sithathe konke okusele kubo.
Kwafika amaMowabi esibhedlela samaSirayeli, begodu amaSirayeli aqala ukunqoba amaMowabi; abaSirayeli bahlasela izwe, babulala amaMowabi.

Babulala amadolobhana. Wonke umuntu wakhipha itshe ezindaweni ezingcono zonke kuze kube yilapho zihlotshiswe khona. Bavala yonke imifula, basusa yonke imihlahla emihle. I-Kir Hareseth kuphela eyashiywa namagquma ayo aqinile, kodwana abantu abane-slings babhekene nayo begodu bahlasela.
Uma ukumkani wakwaMowabi nakabona bona ukulwa luyaqhubeka, wathatha abantu abangumakhulu asixhenxe abasebenza ngeqhwa, afuna ukudlula kuye ukumkani wase-Edom; kodwana bekungaphumelelanga.

Wathatha unyana wakhe omdala, ongeke abe ngukumkani esikhundleni sakhe, wamnikela njengomnikelo wokushiswa phezu kwedonga ledolobha. Kwaba khona inkohliso enkulu ezweni lakwaSirayeli; babuyela ezweni labo.

Kwathi lapho, indodakazi yomuntu oyedwa emndenini wamaprofeti yashaya uElisha, yathi kuye, Umkhonzi wakho, indodana yami, wafa; begodu uyazi bona wayemthanda ikosi; kodwana manje yena okhokhela imali yakhe uyafika athathe izingane zami ezimbili abe ngabangani bakhe.
Wathi kuye uElisha, Ingabe ngikwazi ukukwenza yini? Yazise bona uneni ekhaya lakho. Wathi yena, Asikho lutho enhliziyweni yakho, ngaphandle kwebhodlela elincane le-oyile.
Wathi uElisha, Yiya, thola iziqhingi ezingenalutho kilabo bonke abangani bakho; thola konke okwaziyo.
bese uya kungena, uvale umbhede ngemuva kwakho wena nezingane zakho, uthele i-oyile kiwo onke amabhodlela; uma egcwele ngalinye lawo, uyibeke endaweni.
Ingabe wayeyindodana yakhe noma indodakazi yakhe, kuxhomekeke kuye. Baye banikela ngezinto eziningi kuye, begodu yena wageza.
Wathi kuyise, "Ninikele ibhodlela elinye." Wathi yena, "Akunabo amabhodlela angaphezu kwalokho," begodu uphethiloli wayeka ukudlula.
Waye waya, watshela umuntu kaThixo. Wathi yena, Iya, thengisa i-oyile, ukhokhele inkontileka yakho; wena nezingane zakho niphile ngalokho okusele.

Kwathi ngosuku olulodwa, uElisha waya eShunem; kwabekho khona indodana enkulukazi, yamangalisa uElisha bona ahlale khona, aphuze ukudla. Ngaleso sikhathi, lapho ehamba khona, wahlala khona ephuza ukudla.
Wathi kumfazi wakhe, Ngiyazi bona lo mntu ohlala esiya nathi, ngumuntu ongcwele kaThixo.
Sivule igumbi elincane esitezi, sibeke khona isibhedlela, nethebulethi, nesihlalo, nesibani, ukuze ahlale khona lapho efika kuthi.
Ngosuku oluthile uElisha wafika, wehla egumbini lakhe eliphakeme, wahlala khona.
Wathi kuGehazi, umkhonzi wakhe, Wisela lo mfazi waseShunemi. Wamwisela uGehazi; waya, wahlala phambi kwakhe.

Wathi uElisha kuGehazi, Uthi kuye: "Uya ezweni elinzima khulu ngenxa yethu; yini okufanele sikwenze kuwe? Ingabe singakhuluma ngowenkosi, noma ngomphathi wezwe?" Wayephendula wathi, "Ngihlala phakathi kwabantu bam."
Wathi uElisha, Ingabe singakwenza yini kuye? Waphendula uGehazi wathi, Yabona, ayikho indodana yakhe, nomfazi wakhe udala.
Wathi uElisha, Wisela yena. Wamwilela uGehazi, wahlala emgwaqweni.
Wathi uElisha, Ngonyaka ozayo ngaleso sikhathi, uzobe unendodana emlenzeni wakho. Yathi yena, Hayi, kosi yami, umuntu kaThixo, ungamkhohlisi umkhonzi wakho.
Uwesifazane wakhulelwa, wazalelwa unyana ngonyaka olandelayo ngaleso sikhathi, njengombana uElisha abemtshele.
Wakhula lo mntwana, kwathi ngosuku oluthile waphuma waya kubaba wakhe, owabe esebenza nabahlengikazi abavuna inkomo.
Wathi ubaba wakhe, Intamo yami, intamo yami ibuhlungu. Wathi ubaba wakhe kulowo osebenza naye, Yazisa umkakhe.
Wathi umkhonzi wakhe, "Njengombana udadewabo ufile," wathatha udadewabo, waya kumkakhe. Udadewabo wahlala embhedeni wakhe kuze kube yisikhathi sokudla.
Wayemthwala, wabeka phezu kombhede womntu kaThixo, wavala umngcele, waya ngaphandle.
Wayibiza indodana yakhe, wathi, Ngicela, ngithumelele omunye wabakhonzi, nomfazi, ukuze ngihambe ngejubane kuye umuntu kaThixo, ngibuye.
Wabuza, "Yini ukhambe kuye namhlanje? Ayikho inyanga entsha noma iSabbath." Yathi, "Kuzolungile konke."
Wathi, Uzohamba, ukhambe ngokushesha; ungenzi lutho ngaphandle kokuthi ngikutshele.
Waphuma ke, wafika kumuntu kaThixo emfuleni iKarmeli; begodu lapho umuntu kaThixo nakabona khona ngasenyakatho, wathi kuGehazi umkhonzi wakhe, Thola lo mfazi waseShunemi!
Uzohamba ubhekane naye bese ubuza yena, 'Ulungile yini? Umama wakho ulungile yini? Ingane yakho ilungile yini?'" Waphendula wathi, "Konke kulungile."

Kwathi lapho efika emfuleni kulowo muntu kaThixo, wathatha izinyawo zakhe. Wafika uGehazi ukuba ayise; kodwana lowo muntu kaThixo wathi, Ushiyeke; ngombana inhliziyo yakhe ibuhlungu khulu, begodu ikosi ungifihla, angibonisi bona kungani.
Wathi yena, "Ngabe ngikucela indodana, kosi yami? Angikushonga yini kuwe: 'Ungaba nethemba'?"

Wathi uElisha ku-Ghehazi, Nciphisa izicathulo zakho emlenzeni wakho, uze uthathe isandla sami esihambayo, uyeke; uma uhlangana nomuntu, ungawubonga; begodu uma umuntu ekubonga wena, ungawuphendulanga; ubeke isandla sami esihambayo phezu kobuso bomntwana.
Wathi udadewabo, Uphila ikosi nokuphila kwakho, bona ngeke ngikushiye. Wavuka ke uElisha, walandela yena.
Wahamba uGehazi phambi kwakhe, wabeka intambo phezu kobuso bakhe; kodwana kwakungekho msindo, begodu kwakungekho lutho oluphilayo. Wabuyela ebhekana noElisa, wathi kuye, "Umuntu akavumi."
Uthe uElisha efika ekhaya, ngabona umfana esefile phezu kombhede wakhe.
Waphuma uElisha, wavala umlango ngemuva kwabo bobabili, wathandaza kuYehova.
Uthe wafika embhedeni, wehla phezu komntwana, umlomo nomlomo, amehlo ngamehlo, nezandla ngezandla. Ube esemqoka kuye, umzimba womntwana wawuqala ukufudumeza.
UElisha wavuka, wahamba eduze kwendlu kathathu. Wabuyela emuva, wehlisa izandla zakhe phezu komntwana. Umntwana wehlaza izikhathi ezisixhenxe, wavula amehlo akhe.
UElisha wabiza uGehazi, wathi, Vimbela lo mfazi waseShunemi. Wamwisela ke; kwathi lapho efika khona, uElisha wathi, Thola unyana wakho.
Wayefika, wawela emadolo akhe, wehla phasi ezweni; wathatha unyana wakhe, waya ngaphandle.

UElisha wabuyela eGalgali. Kwabe sekuyindlala ezweni, begodu ibandla lamaprofeti lihlala phambi kwakhe. Wathi kulowo mkhonzi wakhe, Thola isiqalo esikhulu emlilweni, ulungiselele ukudla kwalabo bamaprofeta.

Omunye wabo waphuma ezindaweni zokuqoqa iimila. Wafumana i-vine yasendle begodu waqoqa ama-currants asendle amanengi njengombana izigqoko zakhe zazikwazi ukuwagcina. Wabuyela emuva waza wawamisa emgodini we-stew, engawazi bona ziyini.
Bathi, "Umuntu kaThixo," waphendula uMosis, "ukufa kukhona esiqandisini;" begodu akhenge akwazi ukuwadla.
Wathi uElisha, Ninikele inkomishi yenkukhu. Wayibeka esiqandisini, wathi, Nciphisa kubo abantu, ukuze baphuze. Nokho kwakungekho lutho olubi esiqandisini;
Kwafika umuntu osuka eBhaali-shalisa, ethwala umnqumo woshizi wama-20 emlonyeni womntu kaThixo, kanye nezithelo ezitshalwe kuqala; wathi uElisheha, Nciphisa kubo abantu bona baphile.
Wathi umkhonzi wakhe, Ingabe ngizobeka lokhu phambi kwamadoda amakhulu? UElisha wathi, Nciphisa abantu bona baphile; ngombana ikosi uthi, Bazodla, begodu bazogcina.
Wabeka ke phambi kwabo; badla, begodu kwashiywa, njengokuthi ikosi wathi.

UNaamani wayengumphathi wemikhosi kakumkani wase-Aram, begodu umnikazi wakhe wayemhlonipha khulu, ngombana ikosi wabanika isivivinyo i-Aram ngesandla sikaNaamani. Wabe ngumuntu onamandla, kodwana ube nesifo sesikhumba esibizwa bona yi-leprosy.
Bafika eSirayeli abahlaseli baseSiriya, bathathe indodakazi encane yaba yindodana yowesifazane kaNaamani.
Wathi kunkosikazi yakhe, Uma ngabe umnikazi wami efika kulowo mprofeti wesamariya, angawuphilisa ukoma kwakhe.
Wahamba uNamane, watshela ukumkani umnikazi wakhe, wathi, Uthi yini lo mfana waseSirayeli?

Wathi ukumkani wakwa-Aram, Yiya, ngizothumela incwadi kumkakhe waseSirayeli. UNaamani ke waya, wathabatha emlonyeni wakhe amakhilogremu ayishumi nesishiyagalombili zesiliva, namashekeli ayisithupha egolide, nezigqoko eziyisixhenxe zokushintshana izicathulo;
Wathumela umbiko ukumkani wakwaSirayeli, lathi: "Ngalokho-ke ngithumelele wena umkhonzi wami uNaamani, bona unciphise isifo sakhe sokuwa."

Uma ukumkani wakwaSirayeli efunde lo mbhalo, waxosha izigqoko zakhe, wathi, Ngami yini uzimu? Ingabe ngizobulala, begodu ngizosindisa? Kungani na le nto ithumela kuye umuntu ukuba aphiliswe umkhuhlane wakhe? Ubona bona ufuna ukungishaya ngesandla.

Kwathi lapho uElisha, indodana kaThixo, ekwazi bona ukumkani wakwaSirayeli ukhiphe izigqoko zakhe, wathumela kuye, esithi, Kungani na ukhiphe izigqoko zakho? Thumela lo muntu kum, ukuze wazi bona kukhona umprofeti eSirayeli.
Wafika uNamane, namahhashi akhe, nemoto yakhe, wahlala emgwaqeni wendlu kaElisha.
UElisha wathumela umthunywa kuye, wathi kuye, Iya, uhlanzeke izikhathi ezisixhenxe emfuleni iJordani; isikhumba sakho sizobuya sihle, begodu uzohlanzeka.

UNaamani wagwema, wasuka, wathi, Ngicabanga bona uzophuma ngami, begodu uzohlala khona, begodu uzobiza igama likaYehova uzimu wakhe, begodu uzophakamisa isandla sakhe phezu kwalo mhlaba, begodu uzowuphilisa umkhuhlane wami.
Ingabe imifula yaseDamaskus, i-Abana ne-Farfar, ayikho engcono kunawo wonke amanzi aseSirayeli? Ngangikwazi yini ukugeza khona, ukuze ngihlanzeke? Uthe ke wabuyela emuva, wehla emlonyeni.
Bafike ke abakhonzi bakhe, bakhuluma kuye, bathi, Ubaba, uma umprofeti ekusho kuwe lutho olukhulu, awuzange ukwenze yini? Ngalokho-ke, kungani ungakwenza, uma kusho kuwe nje, Hlala uhlanzeke?

Wathi uNaamani, waphuma, wehlisa izandla zakhe emfuleni iJordani izikhathi ezisixhenxe, ngokusho komthetho womntu kaThixo; begodu isikhumba sakhe sabuya sihlanzekile, safana nesikhumba somntwana omncane, wahlanzwa.

Wabuya uNaamani, yena nendodana yakhe yonke, waya kulowo muntu kaThixo, wahlala phambi kwakhe, wathi, Namuhla ngiyazi bona akukho uzimu emhlabeni wonke, ngaphandle kwaSirayeli; manje ke, ngiyakucela, thola isipho kumkhonzi wakho.
Wathi uElisha, Uphila ikosi, uzimu wami, bona ngeke ngiyithathe. Wathi yena uNamane, "Uzoyithatha yini?" Wathi, "Ngizoyithatha."

Wathi uNaamani, Uma kungenjalo, ngicela, gramatiza umkhonzi wakho ukuba athathe imbewu eyanele ukuthwala amabhungane amabili; ngombana namuhla namanje umkhonzi wakho akazonikela ngomnikelo wokushiswa, noma ngesonka, kinanyana ngimuphi uzimu, ngaphandle kukaYehova.

Ngalokhu nje, ikosi alungise umkhonzi wakho; ngombana uma umphathi wami ephuma ethempelini lika-Rimon ukuba abukele, uhlala enhliziyweni yami, khona-ke nami ngibukele khona. Uma ngibukela ethempelini ka-Rimon, ikosi alungise umkhonzi wakho ngalesi sizathu.
Wathi kuye uElisha, Iya ngoxolo. Waphuma ke uNaamani, wahamba uhambo oluncane.

Wathi uGehazi, umkhonzi ka-Elisha, indodana kaThixo, engqondweni yakhe, Ikosi yami ishiye lo Naamani waseSiriya ahambe ngokulula khulu, engathathenga okuthunyelwe kuye; ngiphila uzimu, ngizohamba ngemuva kwakhe, ngithole lutho kuye.
UNaamani, lapho nakabona umuntu ehamba ngemuva kwakhe, waphuma esihlalweni sakhe, wahlangana naye, wathi, "Kulungile yini konke?"

Wathi uGehazi, Kulungile; umnikazi wami ungithumelele bona ngitjho, Amehlo ami abona amantombazane amabili asuka ezindaweni eziphakeme zakwaEfraim afika kum; ngiyakucela, ngibanike isiliva lama-shekeli ayishumi nambili, nezigqoko ezimbili.

Wathi uNaamani, Ngisho, ngikucela, thola ama-shekeli ayishumi nesishiyagalombili. Wathi kuGehazi, Ngubani na lowo? Uthe wabeka imali emigodini emibili, kanye nezigqoko ezimbili zokudla, wabanika abakhonzi bakhe ababini; bathwala phambi kwakhe.
Ke kaloku, lapho efika khona uGehazi, wazithola ezinyaweni zabangane bakhe, wazifihla ekhaya; wabasusa abantu, basuka.
Wafika uGehazi, wahlala phambi komnikazi wakhe. Uthe uElisha kuye, "Uyaphi, uGehazi?" Waphendula wathi, "Umkhonzi wakho akhenge ahambe kuphi naphi."

Wathi kuye uElisha, Ingabe umphefumulo wami awukho nawe, lapho lo mntu ekhuphuka emgodini wakhe ukubhekana nawe? Ingabe manje yisikhathi sokuthatha imali, nokugqoka, nezihlahla zezithelo ze-olive, nezivini, namaqanda, nengulube, nabakhonzi, nabangani?
Ngalokho-ke isifo sikaNaamani sizothiwa kuwe, nomndeni wakho, kuze kube sekupheleni kosuku. Kwathi lapho uGehazi ephuma emzini kaElisheha, wafumana bona isikhumba sakhe simhlophe njengethebhu.
Wathi umndeni wamaprofeti ku-Elisha, Thola, indawo lapho sihlala khona eduze kwakho incane khulu kuthi.
Sihambe sifike emfuleni iJordani, sithole khona wonke umuntu umnqumo wokhuni, sivule khona indawo yokuhlala. Wathi uElisha, Yiya!
Wathi omunye kubo, Sicela ukhambe nathi, thina abakhonzi bakho. Waphendula uElisha, Ngizohamba.
Wahamba ke nabo. Bafika eJordani, baqala ukuvuna izihlahla.
Uma omunye wabo eshaya umnqumo, ikhanda lensimbi le-axe liwela emanzini. Wavuya wathi, "Oh, akunjalo, umphathi! Yathathwe!"
Wathi lowo muntu kaThixo, "Yawela kuphi?" Wamukhombisa khona indawo. UElisha wamisa inkomishi, wayifaka emanzini, yakwenza insimbi ihambe.
Wathi, "Yithathe." Uthe lowo mntu waphakamisa isandla sakhe, wathatha.
Kwathi lapho ukumkani wakwa-Aram ehlasela amaSirayeli, wakhuluma nabantu bakhe, wathi, Ngizomisa isibhedlela lapha nalaphaya.
Umuntu kaThixo wathumela ukumkani wakwaSirayeli, esithi, Khumbula bona ungadlulanga endaweni leyo; ngombana ama-Aram asuke ehla khona.
Wathumela khona ukumkani wakwaSirayeli ezweni, lapho umuntu kaThixo abemxwayisa ngawo; begodu uElisha wayemxwayisa njalo; wahlala khona ukumkani, angeke ahlale isikhathi eside.
Umkhuluwa waseSirayeli wakhathazeka khulu ngalolu daba, wabiza abaphathi bakhe, wathi kubo: "Ngubani phakathi kwethu osuka emkhosini wakwaSirayeli?"
Wathi omunye wabaphathi bakhe, Akukho muntu, kosi yami ukumkani; kodwana uElisha, umprofeti eSirayeli, yena oveza ukumkani waseSirayeli amazwi akhuluma ngawo ekamelweni lakho.
Wathi ukumkani, Yeni nibone bona ukhonaphi, ukuze ngithumelele abantu ngiwuthathe. Bathi kuye, Yabona, useDothani;
Wathumela khona amabhayisikili, nama-carriages, nemikhosi eminingi; befika ekuseni, bajikelezisa umzi.
Kwathi lapho umkhonzi womntu kaThixo wavuka emini, waphuma, wabona isibhamu, namabhubesi nezithuthi zokulwa zijikeleze idolobha. Wathi, "Akekho, uMengameli, yini okufanele siyenze?"
Wathi uElisha, Musa ukukhathazeka; ngombana labo abakhona nathi baningi kunalabo abakhona nabo.
Wathandaza uElisha, wathi, Kosi, ngiyakucela, uvule amehlo akhe, ukuze abone. Wavula ikosi amehlo umfazi; wabheka, wabona amatshe egcwele izinja nezimoto zomlilo ezijikeleze uElisha.
Kwathi lapho behla kuye, uElisha wathandaza kukaNkulunkulu, wathi: "Nceda, cindezela labo bantu ngamehlo amnyama." UYehova wababulala ngamehlo amnyama, njengombana uElisha atjhilo.
Wathi kubo uElisha, Ayikho le le, nalowo mzi; landelani ngami, ngizokulethela kulowo muntu ofuna wona. Wabaholela eSamariya.
Bafika eSamari, wathi uElisha, Kosi, vula amehlo labo bona babone. Wavula ikosi amehlo abo, bebona, bona, bephakathi kweSamari..
Kwathi lapho ukumkani wakwaSirayeli nakabona khona labo, wathi ku-Elisheha, Ubaba wami, ngabe ngiwabulala?

Wathi uElisha, Ungawabulalanga; ngabe uzowabulala yini abantu obabambisene nabo ngeqhwa lakho, noma ngempucuko yakho? Nciphisa ukudla kwabo nokudla kwamanzi, ukuze baphile begodu baphuze, bese ubavumela bona bahambe beya kunkosi sabo.
Wabalungiselela khona ukumkani isidlo esikhulu, badla begodu baphuze; wavumela bona bahambe beya kumnikazi wabo. Kwathi ngemuva kwalokho, amabutho aseSirayeli awazange afike ezweni likaSirayeli.
Ngaleso sikhathi, uBhe-hadadi ukumkani wakwaSirayeli waqoqa wonke umkhosi wakhe, waya eSamariya, waba yimiphakathi.

Kwaba khona ашezi elingenakulinganiswa kulo mzi, kuze kube yilapho ikhanda lengulube lithengwa ngegolide eliyisishiyagalombili, begodu isipuni esincane senyama yenganekwane lithengiswa ngesiliva elilodwa.
Kwathi lapho ukumkani wakwaSirayeli ehamba phezu kwedonga, kwaphuma indodakazi eyodwa ikhala kuye, isithi, Usizo lwami, kosi yami ukumkani.
Wathi yena, Uma ikosi engakusizalanga wena, ngizokusiza kanjani? Ingabe nginenyama esuka emgodini, noma iwayini elivela emgodini?
Wathi ukumkani kuye, Yini le nto? Yathi yena, Uwesifazane lowo wathi kimi, Ninikele unyana wakho bona siwudle namuhla; kodwana ngoLwesihlanu sizodla unyana wami.
Sawubhaka unyana wami, sawudla. Kwafika usuku olulandelayo, ngathi kuye, Ninikele unyana wakho siwudle; kodwana yena wafihla unyana wakhe."
Kwathi lapho ukumkani ekhuluma ngalolu cingo lomkakhe, waxosha izigqoko zakhe; begodu ngesikhathi ehamba phezu kwedonga, abantu babheka, babona bona unezigqoko ezingwevu ngaphasi kwezigqoko zakhe.
Wathi, uzimu angikwenze lokhu begodu amnike okuningi, uma uElisha unyana ka-Shafati egcina ikhanda lakhe emlenzeni wakhe namuhla.

UElisha wayehlala ekhaya lakhe, begodu abakhulu bedolobha babehlala naye. Wathumela umthunywa phambi kwakhe; kodwana ngaphambi kokuba umthunywa afike, uElisha wathi kubo: "Ubonani bona lo mfowabo uthumela umuntu ukuba athathe ikhanda lami? Bheka, uma umthunywa efika, vulani ifasitela, niyivalwe ngaye. Ingabe akuyona inkulumo yokuhamba kwenyawo lomnikazi wakhe enhliziyweni yakhe?"
Wayekhuluma nabo uElisha, lapho umthunywa efika kuye. Wathi ukumkani, Kusuka kukaNkulunkulu lokhu okumbi; kungani ngilinde ikosi namuhla?

Wathi uElisha, "Dlulisa ilizwi likaYehova; kusho ikosi bona: Ngosuku olulandelayo ngalolu sikhathi, emnyango wesamariya, ilitha elilodwa lomhluzi lizothengwa ngeshekeli elilodwa lemali, begodu ilitha elilodwa loshizi lizothengwa ngeshekeli elilodwa lemali."

Waphendula lo mphathi, umfazi owawusesandlani sokumkani, wathi kulowo muntu kaThixo: Uma ikosi evula amafasitela esibhakabhakeni, ngabe kungaba khona lokhu? UElisha waphendula wathi: "Uzokubona ngamehlo akho, kodwana awukwazi ukuwadla."
Kwabe kukhona abantu abangu-ne abanesifo sokoma, behlala emgwaqweni wokungena edolobhaneni. Bathi phakathi kwabo: "Ngabe kufanele sihlale lapha kuze sife?

Uma sithi, Siyaye edolobhaneni, sizofa khona; ngombana kukhona indlala kulo dolobha. Uma sihlala lapha, sizofa nathi; ngalokho-ke, siyaye emkhosini wamaSirayeli, begodu sizophuma; uma besisishiya, sizophila; kodwana uma besisibulala, sizofa ngale le.
Bavuka besuka emini, bafika emgwaqeni wamaSirayeli. Bafike esiphethweni somgwaqeni, begodu kwakungekho muntu lapho.

Ngokuba ikosi wakwenza isizwe sama-Aram sibone isibhakabhaka semoto, nesibhakabhaka samahhashi, isibhakabhaka somkhosi omkhulu. Bathi phakathi kwabo: "Njengombana ukumkani wakwaSirayeli ekhokhele amakhosi aseHiti, namadodana aseMiziphu, ukuba abe phezu kwethu."
Besuka ke, baphuma emini, beshiya amatende abo, namabhayisikili abo, namahhashi abo; beshiya isibhedlela njengombana sakhona, besuka ukuze bagcine impilo sabo.

Bafika labo abafileyo emgwaqeni, baphuma esitezi esisodwa setente, badla baphuza; bathatha khona isiliva negolide, nezigqoko, baye bazifihla. Babuya befika ethebeni elilodwa, bathatha khona begodu, bazifihla.

Bathi phakathi kwabo, Akulungile lokhu esikwenzayo; ngombana namuhla ngusuku lwezindaba ezinhle, begodu siyazigcina. Uma silinde kuze kube ekuseni, sizoba necala; ngalokho-ke thina sizohamba senze izindaba endlu kakumkani.

Baye ke, baphoqa abaphathi bamasango edolobhaneni, bathi kubo, Safika esibhedlela samaSirayeli, begodu ngabona bona kungekho muntu khona, begodu akukho msindo womuntu; bekukhona kuphela izimvu nezingulube eziboshwe, nezindawo zokuhlala zahlala njengezikhona.
Abagcini beminyango baphoqa bona kuthunyelwe izindaba, kwathi kwathunyelwe ngaphakathi kwepalati kabukhosi.

Wavuka ukumkani ekuseni, wathi kwabaphathi bakhe, Ngizokutshela bona abaSirayeli bakwenzani. Bayazi bona sifile indlala; ngalokho besuka eqenjini, bafihlakele emazweni, bathi, Uma abantu bakaSirayeli bephuma emzini, siyawathatha aphile, siyofika emzini."

Waphendula omunye wabaphathi bakhe, wathi: Kuzothatha abantu abahlanu ezinyathelweni eziboshwe kulo mzi; ngombana uma befa, ngeke kube nzima kubo phakathi kwabaSirayeli bonke ababoshiwe, noma phakathi kwabo bonke abafileyo; begodu siyabathumela sibone bona kwenzekani.
Bathatha khona izithuthi ezimbili ezinezimvu, ukumkani wabathumela kulandela isizwe sama-Aram, wathi, Yeni nibone.
Balandela amaSirayeli, bafika emfuleni iJordani. Indlela yonke yagqokwa izicathulo namathuluzi amasha, abewakhipha amaSirayeli lapho behamba ngejubane. Babuya abathunywa, batshela ukumkani.

Baphuma ke abantu, bathatha yonke into esiteshini sama-Aram; begodu imitha elilodwa lomhluzi yathengwa ngeshekeli elilodwa lemali, nemitha elilodwa loshizi lathengwa ngeshekeli elilodwa lemali, njengokuthi ikosi abesho.
Ubukhosi bubeke umphathi, ohlangothini lwakhe belubhekene naye, ukuba abambe isango; kodwana abantu bamphikisa emnyango, wafa, njengokuthi umuntu kaThixo, lapho ukumkani enqoba ukuwubona.

Kwathi, njengombana umuntu kaThixo atjhilo kuye ukumkani, esithi, Ngosuku olulodwa ngaleso sikhathi, imitha eyodwa yoshizi izothengwa ngeshekeli elilodwa lemali, nemitha eyodwa yobisi elihlanzekile lizothengwa ngeshekeli elilodwa lemali emgwaqeni waseSamari.
Waphendula lo mphathi, wathi kulowo muntu kaThixo: Uma ikosi evula amafasitela esibhakabhakeni, ngabe kungase kwenzeke lokhu? Wathi uElisha, "Uzokubona ngamehlo akho, kodwana awukwazi ukudla."
Lokhu kungenxa yokuthi kwaba njalo kuye. Abantu bampompa emgwaqeni, begodu wafa.

UElisha wayekhuluma nomkakhe, umfazi owayemsindisile unyana wakhe, wathi kuye, Yiya, wena nomndeni wakho, uyeke ukuhlala lapho ungathola khona indawo yokuhlala; ngombana ikosi unqume ukuba kube nendlala iminyaka eyisixhenxe, begodu iyafika kule lizwe.
Wavuka uwesifazane, wakwenza ngokusho kwelizwi lomntu kaThixo; waya, yena nomndeni wakhe, wahlala ezweni lamaFilisti iminyaka eyisixhenxe.
Kwathi, lapho iminyaka eyisikhombisa iphele, wabuyela ezweni lakwaFilisti; waya kukumkani, wathi kuye, Ngikubuyisele indlu yami nephasi wami.
Kwathi lapho ukumkani ekhuluma noGehazi, umkhonzi womntu kaThixo, wathi, "Ngubani na ongazitshela zonke izinto ezinkulu azenzayo uElisha?"

Kwathi, lapho ekhuluma ukumkani bona uElisha wavusa umntwana ofile, yafika indodana yakhe, icela ukumkani indlu yayo, nembewu yayo. Wathi uGehazi, "Unkosikazi wami umkakhe, lo ngumkakhe, begodu lo ngumntwana wakhe, owasindisa yena uElisha."

Wabuza ukumkani indodana yakhe, yathi kuye: "Ubani lo muntu?" Wathi ukumkani kuye: "Nceda ubuyisele zonke izinto zakhe, kanye nezithelo zesizwe sakhe, kusukela ngosuku lapho ephuma khona kuze kube manje."
UElisha waya eDamaseka, uBhe-hadadi ukumkani waseSiriya ubenesifo. Batshela ukumkani bathi, "Umuntu kaThixo ufike lapha."
Wathi kuHazayeli, Thola isipho esandla sakho, uye ukubhekana nomuntu kaThixo, ubuze ikosi ngaye, uthi: Ngizophiliswa yini ngalolu hlobo lwesifo?

Wahamba uHazayeli ukuhlangabezana noElisa, wathatha umklomelo ovela eDamaseki, impahla engcono yonke, yafakwa ezimvu ezingamashumi amane; wafika wahlala phambi kwakhe, wathi, Unyana wakho uBhe-hadadi, ukumkani waseSiriya, ungithumela bona ngibuze, Ngizophiliswa yini ngalesi sifo?
Wathi uElisha kuye, Iya, sithi kuye, Uzophiliswa ngokuqinisekile; kodwana ikosi ungibonisa bona uzofa ngokuqinisekile.
UElisha wabhekana noHazayeli, kuze kube sengathi uHazayeli akakhululeki; khona-ke umuntu kaThixo waqala ukulele.

Wathi uHazayeli, "Iyini le nto oyikhala ngayo, kosi yami?" UElisha waphendula wathi, "Ngabe ngiyazi bona uzokwenza kanjani abantu bakaSirayeli? Uzobeka izindlu zabo eziqinile emlilweni, begodu uzowabulala abancane babo ngeqhwa, begodu uzama ukubopha izingane zabo, begodu uzozivula izibeleko zabo."
Wathi uHazayeli, Ingabe umkhonzi wakho angakwenza lutho olukhulu lokhu, yena ongeke abe yinja? Wathi uElisha, uzimu ungibonisa bona uzoba ngukumkani waseSira.
UHazayeli washiya uElisha, waya kunkosi wakhe. Wathi yena uBhe-hadadi kuye, "Uthi yini wena uElisha?" Waphendula uHazayeli, "Wathi bona uzophilile."
Kwathi ngosuku olulandelayo, uHazayeli wathatha isigqoko, wamisa emanzini, wamgoqa phezu kobuso bakhe, waya ekufa; waba ngukumkani endaweni yakhe.
Ngonyaka wesishiyagalombili kaYoram, unyana ka-Ahabhi, ukumkani wakwaSirayeli, kwaba nguYoram, unyana ka-Jehoshaphat, ukumkani wakwaYuda, waba ngukumkani wakwaYuda.
Ubeminyaka imashumi mathathu nambili ezelwe, lapho eqala ukumkani; waba neminyaka esibhozo engukumkani eYerusalem.
Wahamba ngendlela yamabukhosi baseSirayeli, njengokuthi umndeni ka-Ahabhi wawuhambe ngayo; ngombana washada nenkosikazi ka-Ahabhi; wakwenza okumbi ebusweni bukaYehova.
Kodwana-ke, ikosi akafuni ukucima iYuda, ngenxa kaDavide umkhonzi wakhe; ngombana wayethi bona uzonika uDavide nezingane zakhe isibani kuze kube sekupheleni.
Kwathi lapho uYoram engumnikazi, iEdom yabuya yaphikisana nombuso kaYuda, yakhetha ukumkani wayo.
Wahamba uYoramu, naye nemoto yakhe yonke, waya eZairi; begodu amaEdomi ayemjikeleza yena namadoda amakhulu emoto yakhe. Wavuka ngobusuku, wahlasela labo bantu, wabuyela ehholo lakhe.
Ngaleyo le iEdom yaphuma ngaphasi kwesandla sikaYuda, kuze kube ngalolu suku; begodu neLibna yabuya ngaleso sikhathi.
Okunye okushiwo nguYoramu, konke okwenze, akubonakali kubhalwe encwadini yamaqiniso kakumkani wakwaYuda?
Waphumula uYoramu, wabanjwa nababa bakhe edolobhaneni likaDavide. UAhaziya unyana wakhe waba ngukumkani esikhundleni sakhe.
Ngomnyaka weshumi nambili kaYoram, unyana ka-Ahabhi, ukumkani wakwaSirayeli, waba ngukumkani ezweni laseYuda uAhaziya, unyana kaYoram.
UAhaziya ubeneminyaka eyishumi nambili ubudala lapho eqala ukumkani; waba ngukumkani ngonyaka owodwa eYerusalem. Umzali wakhe wayengu-Ataliya, intombi kaOmri ukumkani wakwaSirayeli.
Wahamba ngendlela yomndeni ka-Ahabhi, wakwenza okumbi emehloni kaYehova, njengombana bekwenze umndeni ka-Ahabhi; ngombana wayeyindodana yomndeni ka-Ahabhi.
Wahamba noYoram, unyana ka-Ahabhi, ukubhekana noHazayeli ukumkani wakwaSira, eRamoti-gileyadi; begodu amaSira abulala uYoram.

Wabuyela ukumkani uYoram eJezreyeli, ukuze aphilise izicubu zakhe, abaAram babembezele kuye eRama, lapho ehlasela khona uHazayeli ukumkani wakwaAram. UAhaziya unyana kaYoram, ukumkani wakwaYuda, wehla waya eJezreyeli ukuvakashela uYoram, unyana ka-Ahabhi, ngombana wayesele ebuhlungu.
UElisha umprofeti wabiza umuntu othile emndenini wamaprofeta, wathi kuye, Yibeke iingubo zakho emgodini wakho, uze uthathe lesi sitsha esincane se-oyile, uye eRamoti-gileyadi.
Uma ufika khona, thola uYehu unyana ka-Jehoshaphathi, unyana ka-Nimshi; uye kuye, uyisuse phakathi kwabangane bakhe, uyifake egumbini elingaphakathi.
bese uthatha ibhodlela le-oyile, uyiphuze phezu kwekhanda lakhe, uthi: Uthi ikosi bona: Ngikukhiphe wena ukumkani phezu kwaSirayeli; khona-ke uvule umbhede, ukhambe, ungaseki.
Wahamba ke lo mntwana, umprofeti omncane, waya eRamoti-gileyadi.
Kwathi lapho efika khona, wabona abakhulu bezwe behlala ndawonye. Wathi, "Nginento engifuna ukukusho kuwe, umphathi." UYehu wathi, "Ubani phakathi kwethu?" Waphendula wathi, "Uwe, umphathi."
Wavuka ke uYehu, waya endlwini; wageza i-oyile phezu kwekhanda lakhe, wathi, Uthi lokhu ikosi, uzimu kaSirayeli: Ngikusindisile ube ngukumkani phezu kwabantu bakaYehova baseSirayeli.
Uzobulala indlu kaAhabhi umnikazi wakho, ukuze ngibuyele ku-Yezebeli igazi labakhonzi bami abaprofeti, negazi lalabo bonke abakhonzi bakaYehova, ayewabulalayo.
Umndeni wonke ka-Ahabhi uzofa, begodu ngizocima bonke amadodana ka-Ahabhi ezweni laseSirayeli, umfazi nomfazi.
Ngizoyenza indlu ka-Ahabhi ibe njengendlu kaYarobohamu unyana kaNabati, nendlu kaBhasha unyana ka-Ahiya.
Izinyoni zizodla uJezebeli ezindaweni zaseYizreyeli, begodu ngeke kubekho umuntu ozoyibulala. Wavula khona umbhede, wabaleka.

Waphuma ke uYehu, wafika kwabezindaba benkosi yakhe. Wathi omunye wabo kuye, Ingabe konke kulungile? Kungani na le ndoda ephazamisayo ifike kuwe? Waphendula uYehu wathi, Uyazi lowo muntu nohlobo lwezinto akhuluma ngazo.
Wathi uYehu, Ukhuluma kimi, esithi, Usho lokhu uzimu kaYehova: "Ngikupheka wena ube ngukumkani phezu kwaSirayeli."
Baphoqeleka ukuba baphuze, ngaso soke isikhathi, wonke umuntu ugqoko lwakhe, wamisa ngezansi kukaYehu esitezi esiphansi; baphonsa isibhamu, bathi, UYehu ungumnikazi.
UYehu unyana ka-Jehoshaphat, unyana ka-Nimshi, wakwenza inkohlakalo ngoYoram; (uYoram ke wayeseRamoti-gileyadi, yena noSirayeli bonke, ngenxa yoHazayeli ukumkani wakwa-Aram.

Ke kaloku ukumkani uYoram wabuyela eJezreyeli, ukuze aphilise izicubu zakhe, ababembulala ngazo abantu baseSiriya emdlalweni noHazayeli ukumkani waseSiriya. Wathi uYehu kuye, Uma ungumngani wami, ngeke kube khona umuntu ophuma enhliziyweni yedolobha, afike eJezreyeli.
UYehu wehla ekhemisi lakhe, waya eJezreeli; ngombana uYoramu ubelele khona lapho, ehlukumezeke. UAhaziya ukumkani wakwaYuda wayesele evakashele uYoramu.
Wathi uYoram, "Thumela umuntu ohamba ngebhayisikili ukubhekana nabo, begodu uthi, 'Kuphephile yini bona nifika?'"

Waphuma umuntu ohamba ngebhayisikili, wabhekana noYehu, wathi, "Ubukhosi buthi, 'Kuphephile yini ukubuya kwakho?'" UYehu wathi, "Iyini inkinga yakho ngokuthula? Yiya ngasenyameni yami!" Waphendula umphathi wendawo, esithi, "Umthunywa ufike kubo, kodwana akabuyeli."
Wathumela ke ukumkani umshayeli wesithathu, wafika kubo, wathi, "Ukumkani uthi, 'Kuphephile yini bona nifike?'" UYehu wathi, "Ngabe kuphephile bona nifike? Yiba ngezansi kwami!"
Wathi umgcini, "Ufike kubo, kodwana akabuyanga. Ukuhamba kwakhe kufana nokuhamba kuka-Yehu unyana kaNimshi; uhamba njengomuntu okhohlakelayo."

Wathi uYoramu, "Nciphisa imoto yami." Yaphuma khona imoto kaYoramu ukumkani wakwaSirayeli, noAhaziya ukumkani wakwaYuda, wonke umuntu ebhasini lakhe, ukubhekana noYehu; bahlangana naye ezweni likaNabhothi waseJezreeli.

UYoram, lapho nakabona uYehu, wathi kuye: "Ufika kanjani ngokuthula, Yehu?" Wathi uYehu, "Ngabe kukhona ukuthula, uma i-Izebeli, umyeni wakho, enezinhlamvu zakhe zobuhlakani, nezinhlamvu zayo zokuzibulala?
UYoram washintsha isithuthi sakhe, wehla, wathi kuAhaziya, Kuyingozi, uAhaziya.
Ke kaloku uYehu wehlise isibhamu sakhe, washaya uYoram phakathi kwekhanda lakhe; ibhodlela ladlula enhliziyweni yakhe, waba mnyama ebhasini lakhe.

Wathi uYehu ku-Bidkari, umphathi wezimoto zakhe, Yithathe, uyithule ezweni likaNabhoti waseJezreyeli; khumbula bona ngihamba wena nami ngemuva kukaAhabhi ubaba wakhe, begodu ikosi wakhuluma ngalolu daba kuye, esithi:

Ngabona igazi likaNabhothi, negazi labantwana bakhe, ngoLwesibili odlule, kusho ikosi; begodu ngizokukhokhela ngalesi siqhingi, kusho ikosi; ngalokho-ke uthathe, uwuthule kule mhlaba, njengokuthi ikosi wathi.

UAhaziya, ukumkani wakwaYuda, lapho nakabona khona lokhu, wehla waya emgwaqeni wase-Beth-hagana; uYehu ke wamlandela, wathi: "Lola naye!" Bamushaya emgwaqweni wakhe wokuhamba ngemoto, lapho bephuma khona eGuri, enhliziyweni ka-Ibleyam. Wahamba waya eMegido, wafa khona.
Abaphathi bakhe bamthwala eJerusaleme, bayamzingela nobaba bakhe emgodini wakhe, edolobhaneni likaDavide..
UAhaziya waba ngukumkani wakwaYuda ngonyaka wesishiyagalombili kaYoram, unyana ka-Ahabhi, ukumkani kwabaSirayeli.
Wafika uYehu eJizreyeli. Kwathi lapho iJezebele ikubona lokhu, yabeka amazinyo ayo, yamisa inwele zayo, yabheka ngaphandle kwefasitela.
Kwathi lapho uYehu efika ngesango, wabiza wathi, Ufika kanjani ngokuthula, uZimri, obulala umnikazi wakho?
UYehu wabheka phezu kwethenda, wathi, "Ngabe kukhona ongisekelayo? Ngabe kukhona ongangixhasa?" Bathi abaphathi bendlu ka-Ahabhi, ababili noma abathathu, babheke phasi kuye.
Wathi uYehu, Nciphisaneni naye. Bawukhuphula, waphuma umfutho wegazi lwakhe edonga, nakwibhayisikili; ibhayisikili lalimaza ngaye.
Wafika uYehu, wadla, waphuza; wathi ke, Yeni nizibonele le ndoda elahlekile, niyibulale; ngombana ube yinkosikazi yakhe.
Kwathi lapho behamba ukumfihla khona, bathola bona akukho okushiwo ngaphandle kwekhanda lakhe, nezinyawo zakhe, nezandla zakhe.
Babuyela, batshela uYehu. Wathi yena, Lokho wukuthi ilizwi likaYehova elinikezwe umkhonzi wakhe uEliya waseTishbi, esithi, Ezindaweni zaseJezreyeli izinja zizodla inyama kaJezebeli.
begodu isidumbu sikaJezebeli sizoba sengathi udoti ezindaweni zomhlaba, ezweni lika-Yezreyeli; kuze kube khona umuntu ongathi, Lokho nguJezebeli.
UAhabhi wayenezingane eziyisixhenxe eSamari. Wabhala uYehu incwadi, wabathumela eSamari, kwabaphathi baseJezreyeli, nabakhulu, nabangani baka-Ahabhi, wathi:
Begodu, uma lo mbhalo ufika kuwe, bese ubona bona izingane umnikazi wakho zikhona nawe, begodu imoto yakho, kanye izikebhe, kanye nedolobha elinezinqaba, kanye nezikhali.
Bakhethe lowo ongcono, onobuhlakani phakathi kwabantwana bakankosi yenu; banikeze isikhundla sikababa wakhe, ninqobe umndeni kankosi yenu.
Baze bakhathazeka, bathi, Amakhosi amabini awakwazi ukubhekana naye; sizokwazi kanjani?

Wathumela ke umphathi wendlu, nomphathi wedolobha, nabakhulu, nabangani bakhe, kuYehu, bathi, Siyabe abakhonzi bakho; sizokwenza konke okushoyo kuthi. Sizokwenza umuntu abe ngukumkani; yenza konke okubukeka kukuhle emehlo akho.

UYehu wababhalela incwadi yesithathu, wathi kubo, Uma ningami, begodu uma nikhuluma ngamazwi ami, nizongiletha ikhanda lamadodana omnikazi wenu eJezreyeli ngoMsombuluko ngalolu sikhathi. Abantwana bakakumkani abangumashumi asixhenxe bakhulelwa ngabantu abakhulu bedolobha.
Wafika lo mbhalo kubo, bathatha oonyana bakakumkani abamashumi asixhenxe, babulala bonke, babeka izindlebe zabo ezitsheni, bamthumela kuye eJezreyeli.
Kwafika umthunywa, watshela uYehu, wathi, Bathole izinhlangothi zabantwana bakakumkani. Wathi uYehu, Nizibeke emgodini wedolobha ezindaweni ezimbili, kuze kube ekuseni.

Kwathi safika isihlwa, waphuma uYehu, wahlala phambi kwalabo bonke abantu, wathi, Akunalutho kuweni; ngiyakutjela bona ngibeke isandla sami phezu komnikazi wami, ngawubulala; kodwana ngabaphi labo bonke abawubulalayo?
Uzokwazi lokhu, bona akukho lutho elingenayo ikosi elikhuluma ngalo phezu kwendlu ka-Ahabhi; ikosi wenza lokho akutjhoko ngomlomo womkhonzi wakhe uEliya.
Wabulala uYehu bonke abaseJezreyeli abasele kuAhabhi, nabenzi bakhe bonke, nabangane bakhe, nababapheki bakhe; akhenge ashiye umuntu ophila.
Waphuma uYehu waya eSamariya, wafika eBhethe-ekedi, lapho ababusi bemisa khona izinkomo zabo.
Wafumana abazalwane baka-Ahaziya ukumkani wakwaYuda, wathi kubo, Nibani na? Baphendula bathi, Siyindodana ka-Ahaziya; safika ukuvakashela oonyana bakakumkakhe, namantombazane umfazi.
Wathi uYehu, "Bathabathe bahlala!" Bathabathe bahlala, babulala abantu abangumashumi amane nabini efulethini laseBethe-ekhedi; akhenge ashiye omunye wabo.

UYehu, lapho ephuma khona, wahlangana no-Yonadabu unyana ka-Rekabhi, ehamba ukubhekana naye. Wakubonga yena uYehu, wathi kuye, "Ungithandela kanjani, njengombana ngikuthandela wena?" Waphendula uYonadabu wathi, "Ngangithandela." Wathi uYehu, "Uma ungumthandeli wami, nginike isandla sakho." Wayinika isandla sakhe, begodu uYehu wamphakamisa ebhasini.
Wathi uYehu kuye, Yiya nami, ubone bona ngiyithanda kanjani ikosi. UJonadabu wahamba naye ekheshi lakhe.
Wafika ke uYehu eSamariya, wabulala bonke abashiwo nguAhabhi eSamariya, wabasusa ngaso soke isikhathi, njengokuthi ikosi wathi kuEliya.
UYehu waqoqa bonke abantu, wathi, UAhabhi wakhonza uBahali kancane; uYehu uzowukhonza khulu.

Ngokuba, namuhla, hlanganisa bonke abaprofeti baka-Baali, nabenzi bakhe bonke, nababingeleli bakhe bonke; uqiniseke bona akukho muntu ongekho, ngombana ngizonikela isiphuzo esikhulu ku-Baali. Nalowo ongafikanga, uzofa. "Akekho, kodwana uYehu wazama ukuwakhohlisa, ukuze asuse bonke abanikeli ka-Baali.
Wathi uYehu, Bukelani isibingelelo esingcwele kuBahali. Bathi ke, Bukelani.

UYehu wathumela ezweni lonke laseSirayeli, bafika bonke abakhonzi bakaBhaali; akukho muntu oshiyekile kubo. Basuka bengena endlini kaBhaali, kuze kube gcwele kusukela esiphethweni esisodwa kuya kwesiphequluli esisodwa.
Wathi uYehu kulowo ophethe izigqoko, Thola izigqoko kubo bonke abakhonzi bakaBhaali; wafumana begodu izigqoko kubo.

Wathi uYehu, noYonadabu unyana ka-Rekabu, befika ethempelini likaBhaali; wathi uYehu kubo bonke abakhonzi bakaBhaali, Khumbulani begodu nibonane bona akukhona lapha phakathi kwenu nanoma ngubani okhonzayo ikosi, ngaphandle kwabakhonzi bakaBahali.

Baphuma ke, bangenisa amadini namadini okushiswayo; begodu uYehu ubebeka abantu abamashumi asibhozo ngaphandle, wathi kubo, Uma umuntu eshiya omunye walabo abantu engikulethelani bona ahambe, uzofa ngempilo yakhe.

Ke kaloku, lapho uYehu eqedile ukunikela ngenhlanhla yokusindisa, wathi abaphathi bakhe nabasebenzi bakhe: "Ngena, babulala labo; angeke kube khona umuntu ophumayo." Bawabulala ngeqhwa. Bakhipha izicubu zabo, bafika egumbini elingaphakathi lendlu kaBaali.
Bakhipha amatshe angcwele ethempelini likaBaali, bawuthutha umlilo kiwo.
Baphula itshe elingcwele likaBaali, bavala isibhedlela sikaBaali, bayiguqula ibe yindawo yokugeza abantu, begodu iyikhona namanje.
Ngalokho uYehu wasusa uBhaali eSirayeli.
Kodwana-ke, uYehu akasukanga ezimpini zikaYarobhoamu, unyana kaNabati, awenza izizwe zaseSirayeli zihlupheke; waba nezinkomo zegolide eBhabheli naseDani.

Wathi ikosi kuYehu, Ukwenze kahle bona wenze okulungile emehlo ami; ngazo zonke izinto ezisenhliziyoni zami ungenzele indlu ka-Ahabhi; ngalokho isizukulwane sakho sizohlala esibhedlela sakwaSirayeli kuze kube yiminyaka emihlanu.
Kodwana-ke, uYehu akhenge acabangele ukuba ahambe ngenhliziyo yakhe yonke emthethweni kaYehova, uzimu wakwaSirayeli; akasukanga ezinkingeni zikaYarobhohamu, owenza amaSirayeli abe nezinkinga.
Ngalezi zinsuku ikosi waqala ukuncipha amaSirayeli, begodu uHazayeli wabahlasela emazweni abo onke.
Wathatha izwe elasenyakatho-mpumalanga yeJordani, lonke izwe likaGiliyadi, lakwaGadi, nakwaRubheni, nakwaManase, kusukela eAroeri, enhliziyweni kaArnon, kuze kube yiGiliyadi noBashana.
Okunye okushiwo nguYehu, konke okwenze, nemisebenzi yakhe yonke, akubona bonke kubhalwe encwadini yamaqiniso kamakhosi aseSirayeli?
UYehu waphumula, wabanjwa eSamari; uYohahazi unyana wakhe waba ngukumkani endaweni yakhe.
UYehu waba ngukumkani phezu kwaSirayeli eSamari, iminyaka eyishumi nambili nesibhozo.
U-Athaliya, ubaba kaAhaziya, lapho nakabona bona unyana wakhe ufile, wavuka, wabulala wonke amalungu omndeni wakwabukhosini.

Kodwana uYoshuwa, intombi yokumkani uYoramu, inkosikazi kaAhahazi, wathatha uYohashi, unyana kaAhahazi, wamfihla phakathi kwabaphathi abazobulawa, wamfihla yena nomfazi wakhe ekamelweni lokuphumula; akhenge amthole uAthaliya, begodu akafanga.
Wahlala uYoashi nenkosikazi yakhe, efihlakele endlwini kaYehova iminyaka emihlanu; kodwana i-Athaliya yaba ngukumkani wezwe.

Kwathi ngonyaka wesixhenxe, uYehoyada ukumkani wathumela abambe abaphathi bezikhulu ezingu-makhulu, namaKareti, nabahlengikazi; wabangenisa endlwini kaYehova, wakwenza khona umshado nabo, wababeka emkhondweni endlwini kaYehova, wabonisana nabo unyana wokumkani.
Wathi kubo, Kulokhu okufanele nikwenze: isithathu senu esiphumayo ngeSabhati kufanele sigcine indlu kakumkani; kanti isithathu senu esiphumayo ngoMsombuluko kumele sigcine indlu kakumkani.
Omunye wesithathu uzobe esitezi se-Sur Gate, begodu owesibili wesithathu uzobe esitezi se-gate ngasemva kwamagwebu. Uzoshintshana ukuvikela ithempeli.
Lawa maqembu amabili phakathi kwenu, aphumayo ngeSabhati, azogcina indlu kaYehova emkhondweni wobukhosi.
begodu, uhlale phezu kwakhe, ngaso soke isikhathi; begodu, uma kukhona umuntu ohamba phambi kwakho, kufanele abulawe; begodu, uma kukhona umuntu ohamba phambi kwakhe, kumele abulawe.

Bakwenza njalo abaphathi bezikhulu ezingu-makhulu, ngokuya ngawo wonke amalungiselelo kaYehoyada umbingeleli. Bathatha bonke abantu babo, labo abaphumayo eSabhati nalabo abasukayo, bafika kuYehoyada umbingeleli.
Wathi umbingeleli wabanika abaphathi amabhomu, namabhande, ayewo ukumkani uDavide, akhona ethempelini likaYehova.

Bathi abaphathi, ngaso soke isikhathi wonke umuntu enesibhamu sakhe esandlani sakhe, bahlala phezu komkakhe, kusukela engxenyeni esenyakatho yendlu kuya engxenyeni esentshonalanga, phambi kwesibingelelo nendlu.
Wakhipha uYehoyada unyana kakumkani, wabeka phezu kwakhe isibhakabhaka, wamnika nencwadi yesivumelwano; bakwenza ube ngukumkani, bampompa ukhilimu. Baphoqa izandla zabo, bathi, Uphile ukumkani!
U-Athaliya, lapho ezwa khona izingcingo zezinkomo nezingcingo zabantu, waphuma waya esihlalweni sobukhosi sikaNkulunkulu.

Wabheka, wabona ukumkani uhlala eduze kombhoshongo, ngokwesiqalo; begodu amakhomishini namaphoyinti akhona eduze kukakumkani; nabantu bonke bezwe babezijabulisa, bephuza amaphoyinti. U-Athaliya wehlisa izigqoko zakhe, wathi, Kuyingozi! Kuyingozi!

Wathi uYehoyada, umbingeleli, kwabaphathi bamakhulu, abaphethe isibhakabhaka, esithi, Yikhuphele phandle phakathi kwezinqwaba zempi; nanoma ubani olandela yena, abulalane naye. (Ngenakho umbingeleli wathi, Akufanele abulawa endlwini kaYehova.)
Ngaleyo le bathathela isandla sayo, yadlula emgwaqweni wokungenisa izikebhe ezindaweni zepalace, wabulawa khona.
Wakwenza uYehoyada isivumelwano phakathi kweNkosi, nokumkani, nabantu, bona bazobe abantu bakaYehova; wakwenza begodu isivumelwano phakathi kukakumkani nabantu.

Kwathi abantu bonke belizwe bafika ethempelini likaBhaali, balimaza ithempeli lakhe, namathafa alo, nama-altare akhe, babulala uMathan, umbhishobhi kaBhaali, phambi kwamathafa. UYehoyada ukumkani wabeka izigwegwe endlwini kaYehova.

Wathatha abaphathi bezikhulu ezingu-makhulu, nama-karethi, nabahlengikazi, nabo bonke abantu basezweni, bakhuphula ukumkani ethempelini likaYehova; baphuma ngesango labahlengikazi befika endlwini yobukhosi. UMbuso wakwaSirayeli wahlala esihlalweni sobukhosi.
Abantu bonke bezwe baphumula, begodu umzi wawuhlanzekile; ngombana u-Athaliya wabulawa ngeqhwa endlwini kabukhosi.
UYowashe ubeneminyaka eyisikhombisa ubudala lapho eqala ukumkani.
Ngomnyaka wesixhenxe kaYehu ukumkani wakwaSirayeli, uYowashe waba ngukumkani; walawula iminyaka emashumi mane eYerusalem. Ubaba wakhe wayengu-Zibiya waseBeersheba.
UYowashe wakwenza okulungile ebusweni bukaYehova yonke leminyaka uYehoyada, umbingeleli, abemfundisa yona.
Kodwana-ke, izindawo eziphakeme azisuswa; abantu baqhubeka benikela khona, begodu befutha khona.

Wathi uYoashi kwababhishobhi, Nciphisani zonke izikweletu zezimali ezithunyelwa endlwini kaYehova, izimali zokubalwa kwabantu, nezimali zezibopho, nazo zonke izikweletu zezimali ezithunyelwa ethempelini likaThixo.
Kuzothathwa izimali ngaye wonke umpristi, kilabo abantu asebenza nabo; begodu uma uthola iyiphi inhlekelele endlwini yakho, uyilungise ngayo.
Kwathi ngonyaka ombili nesithathu wokubusa kukakumkani uYoashi, ababhishobhi abazange balungise indlu.

Wathi ukumkani uYowashi, wabiza uYehoyada umpristi, namanye amabhishobhi, wathi kubo, Yini bona ningawulungisanga lo monakalo wendlu? Ngalokho-ke, akufanele nithathe imali kilabo abasebenza kwenu; zinikele ukuwulungisa indlu.
Ababhishobhi bavuma ukuba bangaqoqi imali eningi kubantu, begodu bona bangaba nesibopho sokulungisa ithempeli labo.

Wathi uYehoyada, umpristi, wathatha ibhokisi elilodwa, wakwenza ukuvuza emlonyeni walo, wayibeka ecaleni lesibingelelo, ngakwesokudla lapho bephuma khona endlwini kaYehova. Babeka kulolu bhokisi zonke izikweletu ezithunyelwa endlwini kaYehova, ababhishobhi abagcina isingeniso.
Uma bebona bona izimali ziningi ebhokisini, khona-ke kwafika umbhali wokumkani nombingeleli omkhulu, babala izimali ezithunyelwe endlwini kaYehova, bazibeka emigodini sabo.
Baye banikela imali elinganiselwe ezinyaweni zalabo abaphatha umsebenzi wendlu kaYehova, begodu laba bantu bakhokhela abaholi bezindlu, nabakhi, ababesebenza emsebenzini wendlu kaYehova,
begodu bathenga imithi, namatshe aqoshiwe, ukuze balungise indlu kaYehova, kanye nanoma yini edingekayo ukuwulungisa.

Ngalemali eyafakwa ethempelini likaYehova, akufanele kwenziwe amabhodlela esiliva, noma izitsha zokudla, noma izinkomishi, noma amabhungane, noma nanoma yiziphi izinto zegolide noma zesilivere ezisetshenziswa endlwini.
Kuye kwakhokhelwa labo abasebenza, basebenzisana nabo ukulungisa indlu kaYehova.
Abazange babuze abantu abalawulayo bona benze i-accounting yemali enikezelwe kubo ukukhokhela abasebenzi, ngombana babe nobuhlakani obuphelele.
Imali yomnikelo wesono, nemali yomnikelo wokudla, ayikho eyafakwa endlwini kaYehova; yaba yiyo yamabhishobhi.
Ngaleso sikhathi uHazayeli ukumkani wakwa-Aram wahlasela iGathi, wayithatha. Wacabanga ukuhlasela iYerusalem.

Wathi uYoashi, ukumkani wakwaYuda, wathatha zonke izinto ezingcwele, abazukulu bakhe, uJehoshafati noYoramu noAhaziya, abakumkani bakaYuda, babezinikela ngazo, kanye nezipho zakhe, negolide lonke elalitholakala ezindaweni zokugcina zendlu kaYehova, nasezikhungweni zendlu yakhe, wayalela kuHazayeli, ukumkani waseAram. UHazayeli ke wehla eYerusalem.
Okunye okushiwo nguYohashi, konke okwenze, akubonakali kubhalwe encwadini yamaqiniso wamabukhosi bakwaYuda?
Abaphathi bakhe baphikisana naye, babulala uYoashi eBeth-Milo, enhliziyweni yendlela eya eSila.
Amadodana akhe abulala uYozabadi unyana kaShimeathi, noYozabadi unyana kaShomeri. Waphumula, wabulawa, washiswa nababa bakhe edolobhaneni likaDavide; waza waba ngukumkani uAmasiya unyana wakhe.
Ngomnyaka weshumi nambili nesithathu kaYowashi unyana kaAhaziya ukumkani wakwaYuda, uYehohazasi unyana kaYehu waba ngukumkani phezu kwaSirayeli eSamari; waba neminyaka eyisixhenxe nesikhombisa.
Wakwenza okumbi emehloni kaYehova; walandela izinkinga zikaYarobhoamu, unyana kaNabati, owazenza izizwe zakwaSirayeli zihlupheke; akhenge azihambe.
UYehova wagwema amaSirayeli, wabashiya emkhosini kaHazayeli ukumkani wakwa-Aram, noBhehadadi unyana wakhe, iminyaka eminingi.
UYehohaza wathandaza kukaNkulunkulu, begodu ikosi wamphendula; ngombana wayebona bona ukumkani waseSirayeli ubewenza abantu bakaSirayeli.
UYehova wabanika amaSirayeli umsindisi; baphuma ngaphasi kwesandla sama-Aram, begodu amaSirayeli ahlala ezindaweni zawo ngokuphephile, njengangaphambili.
Kodwana-ke, abasukanga emibiweni yomndeni kaYarobhoamu, owakwenza amaSirayeli ahlupheke; baqhubeka beyenza; begodu itshe lika-Ashere lahlala liseSamariya.

Umkhosi kaYehohahazi wawumisiwe, waba ngamabhayisikili amashumi amahlanu, namabhasi ayisithupha, namadoda angamakhulu amabili; ngombana ukumkani waseSirayeli wayewabulala labo abaseleyo, wabeka phezulu njengamatshe esikhathi sokudla.
Okunye okushiwo nguYehohahazi, konke okwenze, kanye nempumelelo yakhe, akubonakali kubhalwe encwadini yamaqiniso kakumkani bakaSirayeli?
Waphumula uYowahazi, washiswa eSamari; waba ngukumkani esikhundleni sakhe uYowashi unyana wakhe.
Ngomnyaka weshumi nambili nesishiyagalolunye kaYoashi ukumkani wakwaYuda, uYoashi unyana kaYehohahazi waba ngukumkani phezu kwaSirayeli eSamari; waba neminyaka eyishumi nanye nesikhombisa.
Wakwenza okumbi emehloni kaYehova; akasukanga kuzo zonke izinkinga zikaYarobhoamu, unyana kaNabati, owenza amaSirayeli ahlupheke; waqhubeka ezithela.
Okunye okushiwo uYoashi, konke okwenze, kanye nobukhulu bakhe, nokuthi wabhekana kanjani noAmasiya ukumkani wakwaYuda, akubonakali kubhalwe encwadini yamaqiniso kakumkani bakaSirayeli?
Wafa u Rephaki, waba nguyise kaYoashi. UYerobohabhi wathatha indawo yakhe; begodu uYoashi wa葬wa eSamariya namakhosi aseSirayeli.
UElisha waba nesifo esibulalayo. UYowashe ukumkani wakwaSirayeli wehla waya kuye, wavuya phezu kwakhe, wathi, "Ubaba wami! Ubaba wami!" Wathi, "Izimoto zakwaSirayeli, namabhayisikili awo!"
Wathi uElisha kuye, Thola isibhamu namabhodlela; wafumana ukumkani isibhamu namabhodlela.
Wathi uElisheha kukumkani wakwaSirayeli, Thola umcibisholo esandla sakho; wabeka izandla zakhe phezu kwezandla zomkani.

Wathi uElisha, Vula ifasitela elibheke enyakatho; wavula. Wathi uElisha, Thola, wafumana. Wathi uElisha, Lokho wumphikisi wokuthula kaYehova, umphikisi wokuthula waseSirayeli! Uzobulala amaSirayeli e-Afeki, kuze kube yilapho.
Wathi uElisha, Thola amabhodlela. Kwathi lapho athola khona amabhodlela, uElisha wathi kuye, Ugweme izwe ngazo; wagwema izwe izikhathi amathathu, wehle.

Umuntu kaThixo wehlulekile kuye, wathi: Kufanele uhlasele izwe izikhathi eziyisithupha noma eziyisishiyagalombili; khona-ke ubewunqoba wonke amaSirayeli; kodwana manje uzowahlasela amaSirayeli izikhathi amathathu.
Wafa uElisha, washiswa. Kwaba khona amaqembu eMowabi ahlasela izwe ngaso soke isikhathi sonyaka.

Kwathi, lapho abantu baseSirayeli bebulale umuntu, babone iqembu lamadoda ahlaselayo. Babeka isidumbu salowo muntu emgodini ka-Elisha, begodu lapho isidumbu salowo muntu sifinyelela emathunjini ka-Elisha, lo muntu waphila, wahlala emehlweni akhe.
UHazayeli ukumkani waseSirayeli wacindezela amaSirayeli zonke amalanga zokubusa kukaYehohaza.

Kodwana ikosi waba nenhlanhla nabantu bakaSirayeli, gramatisa kubo; wabhekana nabo ngenxa yomnqophiso wakhe noAbrahama, noIsake, noYakobi; akhenge afune ukuwabulala, begodu akhenge awasuse phambi kwakhe kuze kube yilapho.
Wafa uHazayeli ukumkani wakwa-Aram; waba ngukumkani esikhundleni sakhe uBenhadadi, unyana wakhe.

UYowashe unyana kaYehohazazi wabuyisela kuBhe-hadadi, unyana kaHazayeli, izidolobhana, abezithathele uHazayeli empilweni yakhe, ezisuka kuYehohazazi ubaba wakhe. Wahlasela uBhe-hadadi izikhathi amathathu, wafumana kabutjha izidolobhana zikaSirayeli.
Ngomnyaka wesibili kaYowashi unyana kaYehohaza, ukumkani wakwaSirayeli, waba ngukumkani waseYuda uAmasiya unyana kaYowashi.
Ubeminyaka imashumi amabili anesihlanu ezelwe, lapho eqala ukumkani; waba neminyaka eyishumi nambili nesishiyagalolunye engukumkani eYerusalem. Umkakhe wayenguYehohadini waseJerusalema.
Wakwenza okulungile emehlo kaYehova, kodwana hhayi njengokuthi uDavide, ubaba wakhe, akwenze; wenza konke okwenze uYowashi, udadewabo.
Kodwana-ke, izindawo eziphakeme azisuswa; abantu baqhubeka benikela khona, begodu befutha khona.
Uma nje ethola ukulawula okuqinile kombuso, wakhipha abaphathi ababulale ubaba wakhe umkweluleki.

Kodwana izingane zalabo ababulalayo, awazibulala; njengombana kubhalwe encwadini yomthetho kaMoses, lapho ikosi ewiselayo, esithi, Abazali bangafa ngenxa yabantwana babo, nabantwana bangafa ngenxa yabazali babo; wonke umuntu azofa ngenxa yomonakalo wakhe.
UAmasiya wabulala abantu abangumakhulu ayisishiyagalombili base-Edom eGoli leNhlanzi, wathatha iShela ngempi, washintsha igama layo libe yiYokteyeli, kuze kube namuhla.
UAmasiya wathumela abathunywa kuYoashi, unyana kaYehohazazi, unyana kaYehu, ukumkani wakwaSirayeli, esithi, Thola, sibhekene ngobuso nobuso.

UYowashe ukumkani wakwaSirayeli waphendula uAmasiya ukumkani wakwaYuda, wathi, Inkomo eLibanoni yathumela inkosikazi eLibanoni, isithi, Nciphisa indodana yakho kumntwana wami ukuba abe ngumkakhe. Kwafika khona inkomo yasendle eLibanoni, yaphula inkomo,
Uthi, "Kulungile bona uhlasele iEdomu, begodu manje ufisa ukudubula; jabulela igama lakho, kodwana uhlale ekhaya lakho. Kungani na ucela isivivinyo, ukuze ugweme wena noYuda?"
UYoashi ukumkani wakwaSirayeli waya, wabhekana naye noAmasiya ukumkani wakwaYuda emdlalweni eBhethe-shemesi, elizweni laseYuda.
USirayeli wahlasela uYuda, begodu amadoda aseYuda ahambe, wonke umuntu ekhempini yakhe.

UYoashi ukumkani wakwaSirayeli wathatha uAmasiya ukumkani wakwaYuda, indodana kaYoashi, intombi kaAhahazi, eBhethe-shemesi. Wafika eYerusalem, wehlisa idonga layo kusukela emgwaqeni kaEfrayim kuya emgwaqweni wesikhunta, ingxenye eyinkulungwane nesishiyagalombili yamakomidi.
Wathatha yonke igolide nesilivere, nazo zonke izinto ezifunwa endlwini kaYehova, nasezinkundla zendlu yobukhosi; wafumana begodu abasolwa, wabuyela eSamariya.
Okunye konke okwenze uYowashe, nemisebenzi yakhe, nendlela ayezama ngayo noAmasiya ukumkani wakwaYuda, akubona bonke babhalwe encwadini yamaqiniso kakumkani bakaSirayeli?
Waphumula uYoashi, wabanjwa eSamari, phakathi kwabavikeli bakaSirayeli; waza kwaba nguYerobohabhi unyana wakhe ukumkani endaweni yakhe.
UAmasiya unyana kaYowashi, ukumkani wakwaYuda, waphila iminyaka eyisishiyagalombili ngemuva kokufa kukaYowashi unyana kaYehohazazi ukumkani wakwaSirayeli.
Okunye okushiwo nguAmasiya, konke okwenze, akubonakali kubhalwe encwadini yezindaba zamakumkani baseYuda?
Bakwenza isinqumo kuye eYerusalem, waphuma waya eLakhishi; bathumela abantu emuva kwakhe eLakhishi, babulala khona.
Wathunyelwa ngebhayisikili, wabulawa eYerusalem, edolobhaneni likaDavide, nomndeni wakhe wonke.
Abantu bonke baseYuda bathatha uAzariya, owayeneminyaka eyisishiyagalombili ubudala, bamenza ukumkani endaweni kaAmaziya ubaba wakhe.
UAzariya wakwakha i-Elathi, wayibuyisela ezweni lakwaYuda, ngemuva kokufa kukayise ukumkani.
Ngonyaka oyisishiyagalombili kaAmasiya, unyana kaYowashi, ukumkani wakwaYuda, uYarobohami, unyana kaYowashi, waba ngukumkani phezu kwaSirayeli eSamari; waba neminyaka emashumi amane nanye.
Wakwenza okumbi emehloni kaYehova; akasukanga kuzo zonke izinkinga zikaYarobhoamu, unyana kaNabati, azenzayo izizwe zakwaSirayeli.

Wabuyisela umkhawulo wamaSirayeli, kusukela lapho kungena khona iHamati enyakatho, kuze kube ulwandle olufihliwe enyakatho; ngokwelizwi likaYehova, uzimu wakwaSirayeli, elalishumayelwa ngumkhonzi wakhe uYona umprofeti, unyana kaAmithai, waseGathi-heferi.
Wayebona ikosi bona bonke abantu baseSirayeli bahlupheka khulu, nalabo abamnyama nalabo abamhlophe; kwakungekho umuntu osiza amaSirayeli.
uzimu akhenge akhulume bona uzosusa igama lakwaSirayeli ezweni; ngalokho wabasindisa ngesandla sikaYarobhoamu unyana kaYowashi.

Okunye konke okwenze uYarobhoamu, zonke izinto zakhe, nekhono lakhe, nokuthi wahlasela kanjani, nokuthi wabuyisela kanjani eDamaseki noHamati kwaSirayeli, akukhona yini lokhu okubhalwe encwadini yamaqiniso kamakhosi aseSirayeli?
Waphumula uYarobhoamu, wagcwaliswa namakhosi aseSirayeli; waba ngukumkani esikhundleni sakhe uZekariya unyana wakhe.
Ngomnyaka weshumi nambili nesishiyagalolunye kaYerobohabhi ukumkani wakwaSirayeli, uAzariya unyana kaAmasiya waba ngukumkani ezweni laseYuda.
Ubeminyaka ilishumi elinamihlanu ezelwe, lapho eqala ukumkani; waba neminyaka eyishumi nambili nesishiyagalombili engukumkani eYerusalem. Ubaba wakhe wayenguJekoliya waseYerusalem.
Wakwenza okulungile emehlo kaYehova, ngokwezinto zonke azenzayo uAmasiya ubaba wakhe.
Kodwana-ke, izindawo eziphakeme azisuswa; abantu baqhubeka benikela khona, begodu befutha khona.
UYehova wabulala ukumkani ngendlala kuze kube ngusuku lwakhe lokufa; wahlala ekhaya elilodwa, begodu uYothamu unyana wakhe waba ngumphathi wendlu yakhe, elawula abantu bezwe.
Okunye okushiwo ngu-Uzariya, konke okwenze, akubonakali kubhalwe encwadini yamaqiniso wamabukhosi baseYuda?
U-Azariya waphumula, wabanjwa nababa bakhe edolobhaneni likaDavide; uYothamu unyana wakhe waba ngukumkani esikhundleni sakhe.
Ngomnyaka weshumi nambili nesishiyagalombili ka-Uzariya ukumkani wakwaYuda, uZekariya unyana kaYarobhoamu waba ngukumkani kwabaSirayeli eSamari; wahlala iminyaka emihlanu.
Wakwenza okumbi ngamehlo kaYehova, njengokuthi kwakwenzela obaba bakhe; akasukanga ezimpini zikaYarobhoamu unyana kaNabati, azenzayo izizwe zaseSirayeli.
UShalumu unyana ka-Yabheshi wenza isizwe noZekhariya, wamshaya phambi kwabantu, wambulala, waba ngukumkani endaweni yakhe.
Okunye konke okwenze uZekariya, akubonakali kubhalwe encwadini yamaqiniso kamakhosi aseSirayeli?
Wathi ikosi kuYehu, "Izingane zakho zizohlala ebukhosini bamaSirayeli kuze kube yiminyaka emihlanu."
Ngomnyaka weshumi nambili nesishiyagalombili ka-Uziya ukumkani wakwaYuda, uShalumu unyana kaYabheshi waba ngukumkani eSamari; waba ngukumkani enyanga eyodwa.
UManaheme unyana kaGadi wehla eThirsa waya eSamariya, wahlasela khona uShalumu unyana kaYabheshi, wambulala, waba ngukumkani endaweni yakhe.
Okunye okushiwo nguShalumu, nokuthi ukwenze kanjani, akubonakali kubhalwe encwadini yamaqiniso kaMasipala wamaNdiya?

Ngaleso sikhathi, uManaheme waphuma eTirsa, wahlasela iTipsa, nalabo bonke abakhona kuyo, kanye nezindawo ezingaphansi kwayo. Wahlasela iTifsa, ngombana abantu bayo bengeke bavule amasango abo kuye; wavula zonke izifazane ezikhulelwe kuzo.
Ngomnyaka weshumi nambili nesishiyagalombili ka-Uzariya ukumkani wakwaYuda, uManahemu unyana kaGadi waba ngukumkani phezu kwaSirayeli eSamari; waba neminyaka elishumi.
Wakwenza okumbi emehloni kaYehova; akhenge ahambe kuzo zonke amalanga zakhe eziphilako, ezindaweni zobubi zikaYarobhoamu unyana kaNebhati, owenza amaSirayeli abe nesono.
Wafika khona uPul, ukumkani wase-Ashuri, wahlasela izwe. UManaheme wamnika uPul amalitha ayishumi nesishiyagalombili esiliva, ukuze asize uPul, begodu agcine umkhosi wakhe.
UManaheme wathatha imali ezweni laseSirayeli, wabeka wonke umuntu ocebile ngeshekeli elilodwa legolide. Wayinikeza ukumkani wase-Ashuri; ngalokho ukumkani wase-Ashuri wehla, akahlalanga ezweni.
Okunye okushiwo nguManaheme, konke okwenze, akubonakali kubhalwe encwadini yamavesi wamabukhosi baseSirayeli?
UManaheme wafa, uPekahiya unyana wakhe waba ngukumkani esikhundleni sakhe.
Ngomnyaka weshumi elinesihlanu ka-Uzariya ukumkani wakwaYuda, uPekahiya unyana kaManahemu waba ngukumkani phezu kwaSirayeli eSamari; wahlala iminyaka emibini.
Wakwenza okumbi emehloni kaYehova; akasukanga ezindlwaneni zikaYarobhoamu unyana kaNabati, azenzayo izizwe zakwaSirayeli.

UPekahiya unyana kaRemaliya, omunye wabaphathi bakhe, wakwenza inkohlakalo kuye. Wahlasela uPekahiya eSamari, esitezi esiphakeme sendlu yakhe, namadodana akhe amashumi amahlanu aseGiliyadi; wambulala yena no-Argobhe no-Ariye, waba ngukumkani endaweni yakhe.
Okunye okushiwo nguPekahiya, konke okwenze, akubonakali kubhalwe encwadini yamaqiniso kamakhosi aseSirayeli?
Ngonyaka oyisishiyagalombili kaUzariya ukumkani wakwaYuda, uPekahi unyana kaRemaliya waba ngukumkani phezu kwaSirayeli eSamari; waba neminyaka eyishumi nambili.
Wakwenza okumbi emehloni kaYehova; akasukanga ezindlwaneni zikaYarobhoamu unyana kaNabati, azenzayo izizwe zakwaSirayeli.

Ngosuku lukaPeka ukumkani wakwaSirayeli, kwafika uTiglatha-pilesere ukumkani waseAshuri, wahlasela iIyon, noAbeli-beth-maakha, neYanoa, neKedesh, neHazori, neGileyadi, neGalili, lonke izwe likaNaphtali; wabathwala ezweni laseAshuri.
UHosheya, unyana ka-Ela, wenza inkohlakalo noPekahi, unyana ka-Remaliya; wahlasela naye, wambulala, waba ngukumkani endaweni yakhe, ngonyaka weshumi nambili kaYothamu, unyana kaUziya.
Okunye okushiwo nguPekahi, konke okwenze, akubonakali kubhalwe encwadini yamaqiniso wamabukhosi baseSirayeli?
Ngomnyaka wesibili kaPeka unyana kaRemaliya waba ngukumkani wakwaSirayeli, uYothamu unyana kaUziya waba ngukumkani waseYuda.
Ubeminyaka imashumi amabili anesihlanu ezelwe, lapho eqala ukumkani; waba neminyaka eyishumi nanye nesishiyagalombili engukumkani eYerusalem. Umzali wakhe wayenguYerusha intombi kaTsadoki.
Wakwenza okulungile emehlo kaYehova, ngokwezinto zonke azenzayo uUziya ubaba wakhe.
Kodwana izindawo eziphakeme azisuswa; abantu baqhubeka benikela khona, befutha khona. UYothamu wakwakha isango eliphezulu ethempelini likaYehova.
Okunye okushiwo nguYothama, konke okwenze, akubonakali kubhalwe encwadini yamaqiniso kakumkani wakwaYuda?
Ngalezi zinsuku ikosi waqala ukuthutha uResini ukumkani wakwa-Aram, noPekahi unyana kaRemaliya, ukuba bahlasele iYuda.
Waphumula uYothamu, wabanjwa nababa bakhe edolobhaneni likaDavide ubaba wakhe. UAhazi unyana wakhe waba ngukumkani esikhundleni sakhe.
Ngomnyaka weshumi nesishiyagalombili kaPekahi unyana kaRemaliya, ukumkani wakwaSirayeli, waba ngukumkani ezweni laseYuda uAhahazi unyana kaYothamu.

UAhazi ubeminyaka imashumi amabili ezelwe, lapho eqala ukumkani; waba neminyaka eyishumi nanye nesishiyagalombili engukumkani eYerusalem. Akakwenzanga okulungile phambi kwamehlo kaYehova uzimu wakhe, njengokuthi wayekwenze uDavide, umzali wakhe.
Wahamba ngezinqumo zamakhosi aseSirayeli, wabeka unyana wakhe emgodini, ngazo zonke izinto ezingcolile zomhlaba, azenzayo izizwe ebezithunyelwe nguYehova phambi kwamadodana kaSirayeli.
Wanikela, wamisa uvumba ezindlini eziphakeme, nasezintaba-mlilo, nangaphansi kwanoma ngimuphi umnqumo oluhlaza.
Ngaleso sikhathi wafika uResini ukumkani wakwa-Aram, noPeka unyana kaRemaliya ukumkani wakwaSirayeli, ukuhlasela iJerusalema; bahlaba umxhwele uAhashe, kodwana abakwazi ukumnqoba.
Ngaleso sikhathi uRezin, ukumkani wase-Aram, wabuyisela i-Elathi ezweni lase-Aram, wakhipha khona abantu baseYuda; begodu abaEdomu basuka e-Elathi, behlala khona kuze kube manje.

U-Ahahazi wathumela abathunywa kuTiglathi-pilesere ukumkani wakwa-Ashuri, esithi, Ngiye umkhonzi wakho nonyana wakho; phuma usindise ebusweni bukakumkani baseSirayeli, nakwakumkani bamaSirayeli, abangihlasela.
U-Ahazi wathatha isiliva negolide elitholakala ethempelini likaYehova, nasezikhungweni zendlu ka-Ahazi, wayalela ukumkani wakwa-Asiriya njengesipho.
Wathi ukumkani wase-Ashuri, Uzohlasela iDamaseki, uzoyinqoba, uthathe abantu bayo abafileyo eKire, wabulala noRezini.
Ukumkani uAhazi waya eDamaseki ukubhekana noTiglatha-pilesere ukumkani wakwa-Ashuri, wabona khona isibingelelo; wathumela kuUriya umpristi isithombe sesibingelelo, nezithombe zayo zonke.
UUriya, umbingeleli, wakwakha isibingelelo, ngokusho kwazo zonke izifanekiso zokumkani Ahazi owawuzithumelele kusuka eDamasku; wawuqedile ngaphambi kokufika kukakumkani Ahazi eDamasku.
Kwathi lapho ukumkani ebuya eDamaskus, nakabona isibingelelo, wenyuka waya kuso, wanikela phezu kwayo.
Washisa isonka sakhe esiqhumayo, nomnikelo wakhe wokudla, wageza umnikelo wakhe wokudla, wafafaza emgodini igazi lezinto zakhe zokuthula.
Wakhipha isibingelelo sesiliva esibe phambi koYehova, wayisa ebusweni bendlu, phakathi kwesibingelelo esisha nesibingelelo soNkulunkulu, wayibeka ngasenyakatho yesibingelelo esisha.

Wathi ukumkani uAhazi ku-Uriya umpristi, ethi, Kulesi sibhedlela esikhulu esitshalwe kabutjha, usindise isiphuzo sokudla sakusihlwa, nesiphuzo sokudla sakusihlwa, kanye nesiphuzo sokudla sikakumkani, nesiphuzo sokudla sakhe, neziphuzo zokudla kwabantu bonke basezweni; begodu ufafaze phezu kwayo igazi lonke lesiphuzo sokudla, neziphuzo zokudla, neziphuzo zeziphuzo zabantu bonke baselizwe; kodwana isibhedlela sesiliva singami uma ngicela.
UUriya umbingeleli wenza konke okumwise ngawo ukumkani uAhazi.

UMbuso Wase-Ahazi wasusa amapaneli engxenyeni yezinhlamvu zegolide, wasusa amabhodlela azo. Wathatha ibhodlela elikhulu legolide elibizwa bona yiMfula, lalimaza izingulube zegolide ezilibambe, waligqugquzela phezu kwesisekelo setshe.
Wakhipha begodu umgwaqo wosuku lokuphumula, owakhiwa ethempelini, kanye nomnyango wangaphandle wobukhosi ethempelini likaYehova, ukuze athande ukumkani wase-Ashuri.
Okunye okushiwo ngu-Ahahazi, konke okwenze, akubonakali kubhalwe encwadini yamaqiniso kabukhosi baseYuda?
Waphumula uAhazi, washiswa nababa bakhe edolobhaneni likaDavide; uHezekiya unyana wakhe waba ngukumkani endaweni yakhe.
Ngomnyaka weshumi nambili ka-Ahazi ukumkani wakwaYuda, uHoshea unyana ka-Ela waba ngukumkani phezu kwaSirayeli eSamari; waba neminyaka eyithoba.
Wakwenza okumbi emehloni kaYehova, kodwana akhenge akwenze ngokufana namadodana aseSirayeli angaphambili kwakhe.
UShalmanesera ukumkani wakwa-Ashuri wahlasela uHoshea; uHoshea waba ngumkhonzi wakhe, wamnika imali ngonyaka wonke.

Kodwana ukumkani wakwa-Ashuri waqonda bona uHoshea ekwenza isinqumo kuye. UHoshea wathumela abathunywa kuSo, ukumkani waseYiputa, wathi: "Uzoyeka ukunika umkhonyovu ukumkani wakwa-Ashuri, njengombana wenza ngonyaka nonyaka;" ngalokho ukumkani wakwa-Ashuri wathatha uHoshea, wambeka emgodini.
Ke kaloku ukumkani wase-Ashuri waya ezweni lonke, wafika eSamariya, wayibamba iminyaka emithathu.
Ngomnyaka wesithoba wokubusa kukaHoshea, ukumkani wakwa-Ashuri wahlasela iSamariya, wabathwalisa amaSirayeli e-Ashuri, wababeka eHala, naseHabhori emfuleni waseGozani, namadolobhana aseMedi.
Lokhu kwakwenzeka ngenxa yokuthi abafundisi bakaSirayeli babephumile kuYehova, uzimu wabo, owabasusa ezweni laseYiputa, ngaphasi kwesandla sikaFaro, ukumkani waseYiputa, bakhonza amadini amanye.
Bahamba ngezimiso zezizwe, azenzayo ikosi phambi kwabo, kanye nezimiso zabakumkani bakaSirayeli, ababeziqala ukwenza.
Bathi, "Sizokwenza konke lokhu; sizokwakha izindlu eziphakeme ezindaweni zabo zonke, kusukela enkabeni yedolobhana elincinane, kuze kube emzini omkhulu onezindonga."
Bamisa amatshe angcwele, namatshe e-Ashere, ngaso soke isiqhingi esiphezulu, nangaphansi komhlaba wonke omnyama.
Bashisa umlilo emadolobheni aphezulu onke, njengokuthi izizwe ebezizikhuphe phambi kwabo ikosi, bakwenza izinto ezibi, bephula inhliziyo kaYehova.
Bakhonza amathoyizi, okuthi ikosi abewatshela bona: "Ungakwenza lokhu."
