Wathi ikosi wabatjela amaSirayeli namadodana kaYuda, ngesandla samaprofeti bakhe bonke, ngalabo ababonayo, esithi, Buyele ezindaweni zenu ezibi, nigcine imiyalo yami, nezimiso zami, ngokupheleleko umthetho engiwiselayo kubazali benu, nomthetho ongithumelele wena ngomsebenzi wami wamaprofeta.
Bathi ke, bangakutholi ukulalela; bakwenza ikhanda labo libe liqinile, njengamababa abo, ababengakholwa kuYehova uzimu wabo.

Bakhohlisa izimiso zakhe, namalungiselelo akhe, ayewamisa nababa babo, nezivivinyo zakhe awazibophezele kuzo; balandela izinto ezingenalutho, babe yizinto ezingenalutho; bakwenza ngokwezinto zakwamanye amazwe asendaweni sabo, okuthi ikosi wabawisela umthetho ngazo, bona bangazisebenzisi.
Basuka emibalweni yonke kaYehova uzimu wabo; bakwenza izinkomo ezimbili ezenziwe ngodonga, ne-ashere; basola zonke izinkanyezi zezulu, bakhonza uBhaali.
Babeka oonyana babo nezingane zabo emlilweni, basebenzisa amaphupho, namagqugquzeli, bathengisa izandla zabo ukuba benze okumbi emehloni kaYehova, ukuze bamkhulise.
UYehova wehluleke khulu ngabaseSirayeli, wabasusa phambi kwakhe; kwashiwo nje isizwe sikaYuda kuphela.
Kodwana-ke, iYuda nayo ayigcinenga imiyalo kaYehova uzimu wabo; bahamba ngezimiso zakwaSirayeli.
Ngalokho, ikosi wabasusa bonke abazalwane bakaSirayeli, wababulala, wabanikela esidlangalaleni, kuze kube yilapho awakhupha ebusweni bakhe.

Kwathi lapho ikosi emisa amaSirayeli emndenini kaDavide, bakwenza uYarobohabhi unyana kaNabati waba ngukumkani wabo. UYarobohabhi wasusa amaSirayeli ekutholeni ikosi, wababangela ukuba benze isono esikhulu.
AbaSirayeli baqhubeka behamba ngazo zonke izigebengu zikaYarobhoamu azenzayo; abasukanga kuzo.

kuze kube yilapho ikosi esusa amaSirayeli phambi kwakhe, njengokuthi washo ngaso isandla sabo bonke abakhonzi bakhe abaprofeti. Bathunyelwe amaSirayeli emazweni abo, bathunyelwe eAshure, kuze kube namuhla.
Ubukhosi base-Ashuri bakhipha abantu eBhabheli, naseKutha, naseAvwa, naseHamati, naseSefarwayim, babeka emazweni aseSamariya endaweni yamaSirayeli; bathatha iSamariya, bahlala emizini yayo.
Esikhathini sokuqala lapho behlala khona, bangeke babe nokuthula kukaNkulunkulu; ngalokho ikosi wathumela phakathi kwabo izingulube, zababulala.

Bathi ke kubo ukumkani wase-Ashuri, besithi, Abantu abawuthukile owababeka ezindaweni zaseSamariya awazi imithetho kaThixo waleli lizwe; ngalokho wathumela phakathi kwabo amakhoboka, begodu bona, ayawabulala, ngombana bangawazi imithetho kaThixo.
Wathi ukumkani wase-Ashuri, Yazisa omunye wabapristi abathunyelwe khona; ahambe ahlale khona, afundise abantu umthetho kaThixo waleli lizwe.
Wabuya ke omunye wababingeleli, abathunyelwe eSamariya, wahlala eBhetheleli, wafundisa abantu bona bangabe bathandaza kuYehova.
Kodwana izwe ngalinye lakwenza izitha zayo, zazibeka ezindaweni eziphakeme, ababezenza abantu baseSamariya, izwe ngalinye emizini yawo lapho behlala khona.
Abantu baseBhabheli bakwenza iSukhothi-benothi; abantu baseKutha bakwenza uNergal; abantu baseHamati bayenza iAshima.
Aba-Avithi bakwenza iNibhazi neTarthaki, begodu aba-Sepharvithi bakhipha izingane zabo emlilweni, zibe ngumnikelo ku-Adrammelekhe no-Anamelekhe, amasiko ase-Sefarvayim.
Bathi, "Sizobhekana nawe," begodu bathathe abapristi eziphakeme, kusukela phakathi kwabo bonke abantu, begodu wanikela kubo ezindaweni eziphakeme.
Bakhonza ikosi, kodwana bakhonza begodu amasiko abo, ngokwezimiso zazo zonke izizwe, lapho besuka khona.

Bahamba ngemithetho sabo yangaphambilini, kuze kube ngalolusuku; bangeke babe nenhliziyo engcwele kukaNkulunkulu, begodu bangazi imibandela yakhe, noma izimiso zakhe, noma imfundiso yakhe, noma umyalo wakhe, awawuthi kubo uYakobi, owabiza igama lakhe bona uSirayeli.
Wakwenza ikosi umhlangano nabantwana bakaSirayeli, wathi kubo, Musani ukukhonza amadini amanye, noma niwukhonze, noma niwusebenzele, noma niwunikela kiwo.
uzimu kuphela owazibophezela kuye, owenza bona nikhuphuke ezweni laseYiputa ngesandla esinamandla, nesandla esiqinile; yena kuphela ozowukhonza; yena kuphela ozowusola, uzowunikela.
Uzobhekana nomthetho wakhe, nemithetho yakhe, nezimiso zakhe, nemiyalo yakhe, awabhalela wena, ukuze uyigcine yonke imihla.
Umthetho wami engiwenza nani, ningawukhohlwa; begodu ningazibophezela emikhosini yabanye.
Uzokhonza ikosi uzimu wenu; yena uzokusindisa ebusweni bomshayeli wakho wonke.
Kodwana abazange balalele. Baqhubeka belandela imikhuba sabo yakudala.
Ngalokho-ke lezi zintokazi zathandaza kuYehova, begodu zakhonza izigodlo zabo; nabantwana babo, nabantwana bezindodana zabo, bakwenza njalo, njengabababa babo, kuze kube ngalolusuku.
Ngomnyaka wesithathu kaHoshea unyana ka-Ela, ukumkani wakwaSirayeli, kwaba nguHezekiya unyana ka-Ahazi ukumkani wakwaYuda.
Ubeminyaka imashumi amabili anesihlanu ezelwe, lapho eqala ukumkani; waba neminyaka engama-29 engukumkani eYerusalem. Umkakhe ubizwa bona nguAbi, indodana kaZekariya.
Wakwenza okulungile emehlo kaYehova, ngokwezinto zonke azenzayo uDavide, ubaba wakhe.

Wasusa izindawo eziphakeme, waphonsa amatshe angcwele, waphula izihlahla ze-Ashera; waphonsa begodu ibhodlela legolide, uMoses ayelile; ngombana kuze kube ngalolu sikhathi abantu baseSirayeli babewuthutha umnqumo kiwo; kwabizwa bona yiNehushtani.
UHezekiya ubeke ithemba lakhe kuYehova, uzimu kaSirayeli; kwaba khona othile ongafana naye phakathi kwamakhosi onke eYiputa, angaphambili kwakhe, namuva kwakhe.
Wazibophezela eNkosini, akhenge ashintshe ukulandela kwakhe; wagcina imiyalo kaYehova, abewisela yona kuMoses.
Waye naye ikosi, waphumelela kiwo wonke umsebenzi wakhe. Wayeka ukumkani wakwa-Ashuri, akhenge amkhonze.
Wahlasela amaFilisti kuya eGaza nasezindaweni zayo, kusukela esitezi esincane sokubuka kuze kube yidolobha elikhulu elinabantu.
Ngomnyaka wesine wokumkani uHizekiya, (lokhu kwaba wunyaka wesixhenxe kaHoshea, unyana kaEla, ukumkani wakwaSirayeli), wafika uShalmanesera, ukumkani wakwa-Ashuri, waya eSamariya, wayibamba.
Ngonyaka wesishiyagalombili kaHizekiya, wunyaka wesithoba kaHoshea ukumkani wakwaSirayeli, iSamari yathathwa yi-Ashuri; kwathi lapho kudlule iminyaka emithathu, iSamari yathathwa.
Ubukhosi base-Ashuri bathwala amaSirayeli baya e-Ashuri, babebeka eHala, naseHabori, emfuleni waseGozani, namadolobhana aseMediya.

Lokhu kwakwenzeka ngenxa yokuthi abazange balalela izwi likaYehova uzimu wabo, kodwana baphula umhlangano wakhe, ngazo zonke izinto awisenzileyo uMoses, umkhonzi kaYehova; abangakutholi ukulalela, bangakutholanga.
Ngonyaka oyisishiyagalombili kaHezekiya ukumkani, wafika uSenhakeribhi ukumkani wakwa-Ashuri, waya kiwo wonke lamadolobha aseYuda anezindlu eziqinile, wawathatha.

UHezekiya, ukumkani wakwaYuda, wathumela kukumkani wase-Ashuri eLakishi, esithi, Ngiphumile; shiya ngami, ngizokulethela konke okushoyo. Wathi ukumkani wakwa-Ashuri kuHezekiya, ukumkani wakwa-Israyeli, bona akulethe igolide elinamathani ayishumi nambili, nesiliva elinamathani ayisishiyagalombili.
Wathi uHizekiya wanikela ngegolide lonke elitholakala endlwini kaYehova, nasezikhungweni zendlu kayise.
Ngaleso sikhathi uHizekiya wasusa igolide elisuka emafasiteleni ethempelini likaYehova, nemilenze yawo, igolide ebelihlanganisiwe nguHizekiya, wamnika ukumkani wakwa-Ashuri.

Wathumela ukumkani wakwa-Ashuri uRahabhi, noRahabhethi, nomphathi wakhe, esuka eLakhishi waya kuHezekiya ukumkani waseYerusalem, namadoda amakhulu amanengi; bafika eJerusalema, bahlala emgodini wamanzi ophezulu wolwandle, enkabeni yomhlaba wokuhlanza.
Babiza ukumkani, waphuma uEliyakabhi unyana ka-Hilkiya, umphathi wendlu, noShebna umbhali, noYowahi unyana ka-Asaphe, umbhali, ukubabona.
Wathi kubo uRafeki, Nithi kuHezekiya: Usho lokhu ukumkani omkhulu, ukumkani wakwa-Ashuri, uthi: Yini le nto oyithembela ngayo?
Uthi unesiqiniseko begodu unamandla okulwa, kodwana la mazwi awukho lutho. Ubani ongathembela kuye, bona unentshisekelo yokungcolisa?
Bheka, uthembela eYiputa, emgodini ophukile wokuhamba; uma umuntu ehleli phezu kwalo, lizoluka isandla sakhe. Ufana noFarawo ukumkani waseYiputa kiwo wonke umuntu onethemba kuye.

Kodwana uma ngitjho kuwe, Sithembele kuYehova uzimu wethu? Akuyena yini lowo owakhipha amathempeli akhe aphezulu nama-altare akhe, uHizekiya? UHizekiya akabi wathi ezweni laseYuda naseYerusalem, Nizibophezele esihlahleni esinjalo eJerusalema?
Manje ke, ngitjho kuwe, bhekana nonkosi wami, ukumkani wase-Ashuri; ngizokunika izimvu ezingu-elilodwa, uma ungakwazi ukuletha abahamba ngazo.
Ingabe ungakwazi ukubuyisela emuva umphathi oncane phakathi kwabakhonzi bakankosi yami? Kodwana-ke, ubeke isandla sakho eYiputa ngenxa yezimoto namabhayisikili!
Begodu, ngabe ngafika ngihlasela le ndawo, ukuze ngiyibhubhise, ngaphandle kukaYehova? uzimu wathi kuye, Yiya phezu kwalolu lizwe, uyibulala.

Wathi uEliyakimu, unyana kaHilkiya, noShebna, noYoha, ku-Arphaxadi, Ngiyakucela, ukhulume nabangani bakho ngesiArami, ngombana siyazi; begodu ungakhuluma nathi ngesiHebhere, abantu abasesitezi esiphezulu bezwa.

Waphendula uRafeki, wathi, Ingabe umnikazi wami ungithumelele kumphathi wakho, nawe kuphela, bona ngikhulume la mazwi? Okusho bona, wathumela kilabo abantu abasesitezi esiphezulu; bona nabo bazodla izinyama zabo, begodu bazodla isisu sabo, njengawe.
Wathi uRafeki, uhlala khona, wathi ngesiHebhere, Yizani igama lomphathi omkhulu, umphathi wase-Ashuri!
Uthi lo mfana, Musani ukuxoshwa nguHezekiya, ngombana akakwazanga ukuxosha nisuka emandleni am.
Akufanele uHizekiya akwenzeni nithembe kuYehova, athi, uzimu uzosikhulula; lo mzi awuzothunyelwa emkhosini kakumkani wase-Ashuri.

Ungamtholi uHizekiya; ngombana lokhu kusho ukumkani wakwa-Ashuri, uthi: Ukwenzeni isivumelwano nami, nizophuma nimi, nidla wonke umuntu izimbali zakhe zewayini, neemithi yakhe yesivinini, niphuze amanzi emgodini wakhe,

kuze ngifike, ngikuthatheni izwe elifana nezwe lenu, izwe lembewu newayini elisha, izwe lenyama nezihlahla zezinkomo, izwe lezithelo ze-olive nengulube. Khetha ukuphila, hhayi ukufa; begodu ningawutholi umsindo kaHizkiyahi, uma ekhohlisa nithi, uzimu uzosisindisa.
Ingabe kukhona ikosi yezwe elishalile izwe layo ngaphasi kwesandla sikakumkani wase-Ashuri?
Ngawaphi amasiko aseHamati, ne-Arpadi? Ngawaphi amasiko aseSepharvayim, neHena, ne-Iva? Basindise yini iSamariya esandla sami?
Yikuphi phakathi kwazo zonke izitha zalezi zindawo, okwaziyo ukusindisa izwe lakhe ngami? Ngabe ikosi angasindisa kanjani iJerusalema ngami?"
Abantu ke banyamalala, bangaphendulanga lutho; ngombana ukumkani ubewisela umyalo, esithi, Ungawuphenduli.

UEliyakamu unyana ka-Hilkiya, umphathi wendlu yasebukhosini, noShebna umbhali, noYowa unyana ka-Asaphu, umbhali wezincwadi, bafika kuHezekiya, begqoke izicathulo zabo zilahlekile, baveza kuye amazwi ka-Arpaksade.
Kwathi lapho uHezekiya ukumkani ekubona khona lokhu, waxosha izigqoko zakhe, wagqoka igxathu negxathu, waya endlwini kaYehova.
Wathumela uEliyakamu, ophethe indlu, noShebna umbhali, namadoda amakhulu ebandla lamaBhenjamini, bonke begqoke izingwegwe, kuIsaya umprofeti unyana kaAmozi.
Bathi kuye, UHizekiya usho lokhu: Namuhla usuku lobuhlungu, nokuhlukunyezwa, nokugxekwa; thina sifana nomkakhe ongeke akwazi ukubeletha, kodwana asinamandla okubeletha.

Kungenzeka bona ikosi, uzimu wakho, alalele amazwi kaRafeki wonke, owawuthunyelwe ngunkosi wakhe, ukumkani wakwa-Ashuri, ukuba abusise uzimu ophilayo; kungabonakala bona ikosi, uzimu wakho, agweme amazwi akhe, awavamile; ngalokho ke thandaza ngenxa yethu encane esihlala yona.
Bafika abaphathi bakakumkani uHezekiya kuIsaya,
Wathi uIsaya kubo, Nithi kunkosi wenu, Usho lokhu ikosi: Musa ukukhathazeka ngezinhlamvu ozibonayo, ngazo zonke izinkolelo abakhonzi bakakumkani wase-Ashuri bakhuluma ngami.
Ngalokho, ngizobeka umphefumulo kuye; begodu uma ethola izindaba, uzobuya ezweni lakhe; begodu lapho, ezweni lakhe, ngizobulala yena ngekhebula. "
U-Arpaksade, lapho ezwa bona ukumkani wakwa-Ashuri ushiye iLakishi, wabuyela, wafumana ukumkani ehlasela iLibna.
Kwathi lapho ukumkani wakwa-Ashuri ekubona bona uTirhakha, ukumkani wakwa-Ethiopia, usephuma ekulwa naye, wathumela abathunywa kuHezekiya, esithi,
Nithi kuHezekiya ukumkani wakwaYuda, Nithi: uzimu wakho, okholwa kuye, angakukhohlisa, ekhuluma bona, IYerusalem ngeke inikezelwe emkhosini kakumkani wase Ashuri.
Ngiyabona bona ufunde lokho abakwenzayo amakhosi ase-Ashuri ngazo zonke izizwe, bezibulala ngokupheleleko. Ingabe wena uzosindiswa?
Ingabe ama-Amori, namaGozi, namaHarani, namaRezephi, nalabo base-Eden abahlala eTelasare, basindiswe yimimoya yamazwe amakhosikazi ami ayewabulala?
Ukhona yini ukumkani waseHamati? Ukhona yini ukumkani waseArpadi? Ukhona yini ukumkani waseSepharvayim, neHena, ne-Iva?"
Wathatha uHizekiya incwadi enhliziyweni yabathunywa, wayifunda; wanyuka waya endlwini kaYehova, wayivulela phambi koYehova.
Wathandaza uHizekiya kuYehova, wathi: UHulumeni, uzimu wakwaSirayeli, ohlala phezu kwamakherubi, wena kuphela uzimu wazo zonke izizwe zezulu; wena owenza izulu nezulu.
uzimu, uvule amehlo akho, ubone; lalela amazwi ka-Senhakeribi, owawuthumelele ukucasuka kukaNkulunkulu ophilayo.
Kulungile, Kosi yami, bona ubukhosi base-Ashuri babulala zonke lezi zizwe nezindawo zabo.
Babeka amatshe abo emlilweni, ngombana angeke abe ngamatshe, kodwana ukhuni nomlilo owenziwe ngezandla zabantu; ngalokho-ke izwe laseAsiriya likwazile ukuwabulala.
Ngalokho manje, Kosi yethu uzimu wethu, sisindise esandla sakhe; ukuze zonke izizwe zezulu zikwazi bona wena kuphela, Kosi yethu, uzimu.
UIsaya unyana ka-Amozi wathumela kuHizekiya, esithi, Uthi lokhu ikosi, uzimu kaSirayeli: Ngokuba ubulawe ngami mayelana noSanheribi ukumkani wakwa-Ashuri, ngikulalela.
Lakho igama ikosi awakhuluma ngalo, ethi: Indodakazi yaseSiyone iyakuxosha, idlala nawe; idolobha laseJerusalema lishaya ikhanda lakhe phezu kwakho, uma usuhamba.
Ubani owenza ubuhlungu, nokwenqaba? Ubani owenza izingcezu, nokubona phasi ngothando olukhulu? Wabe nguMngcwele kaSirayeli!

Uthi, Ngezimoto zami eziningi, ngifike emifuleni ephakeme khulu, ezindaweni eziphezulu zeLibanoni; ngawususa umnqumo wayo ophakade, namaqabunga akhe angcono; ngafika emaphethelweni ayo, ezindaweni zayo ezibomvu.
Ngithole izimpophoma, ngadla amanzi azo; ngizitshisa zonke izintaba zaseYiputa ngezinyawo zami. uzimu wathi:
Awazi yini? Kudlule isikhathi eside ngiyilungiselele. Ezikhathini zakudala ngiyihlela, begodu manje ngiyenza ikwenzeke. Ngikuvumele bona uguqule imiphakathi ethengwe ngamatshe ibe yizintaba-mlilo.

Ngalokho abantu babo balahlekile amandla abo, bakhathazekile, bakhohlwa. Babe njengamaqabunga ezindaweni zomhlaba, njengezitshalo eziluhlaza, njengezihlahla zendlu yasemadolobheni, ezishisayo ngaphambi kokuba zikhule.
Ngiyazi lapho uhlala khona, begodu lapho uphuma khona, begodu lapho ufika khona; ngizi bona ukhathazekile kimi.

Ngenxa yobugebengu bakho ngami, begodu ngenxa yokuthi ngikuvile ukukhuluma kwakho okudumile, ngalokho-ke ngizobeka isibhamu sami emlonyeni wakho, nentambo yami emphinjeni yakho, begodu ngizokubuyisela emuva ngendlela osuka kuyo.

Nalokhu kuzoba yisibonakaliso kuwe, wena uHizekiya: Lo nyaka uzokudla okuvela ngaso; nonyaka olandelayo uzokudla okuvela kuso; kodwana ngonyaka wesithathu uzotshala, uzovuna, uzotshala izivini, uzokudla imbewu yazo.
Nabo abasolwa, nalabo abashiywe ezweni likaYuda, bazophinde babeke iimila zabo eduze komhlaba, begodu bazokhiqiza imbewu phezulu.
Bazophuma eJerusalema abantu abafileyo, nalabo abaphilile bazovela emfuleni iSiyone. Uthando lweNkosi luzokwenza lokhu.
Ngako oko ikosi uthi ngalolu daba lokumkani wase-Ashuri: Akuzofika kulo mzi, akawuthuli khona umcibisholo wakhe; ngeke afike kiwo ngendwangu, begodu ngeke akhiphe izingcezu zodonga phezu kwalo.
Uzobuyela ngendlela asuka ngayo; ngeke afike kulo dolobha, kusho ikosi.
Ngizovikela lo mzi, ngiwusindise, ngenxa yami, begodu ngenxa yomkhonzi wami uDavide.'

Ngaleyo busuku waphuma umprofeti kaYehova, wabulala esiteshini sama-Ashurini abantu abangamakhulu amathathu anamashumi asibhozo anesihlanu amawaka. Bavuka basuka emveni kwemini, begodu bona, bekukhona izicubu ezifile kiwo wonke indawo.
USanheribi ukumkani wakwa-Ashuri wehla, wabuyela ekhaya lakhe, waya eNineve.

Kwathi, ngesikhathi ekhonza ethempelini likaNisroki uzimu wakhe, uAdrammeleki noSharezere, oonyana bakhe, bambulala ngeqhwa, baphuma besuka ezweni lase-Ararati. UEsarhadoni, unyana wakhe, waba ngukumkani endaweni yakhe.
Ngaleso sikhathi uHizekiya waba nesifo sokufa. Wafika kuye uIsaya umprofeti, unyana ka-Amozi, wathi kuye, Uthi lokho ikosi: Nquma izinto zakho, ngombana uzofa; ngeke uzizwe ungcono.
UHezekiya wabheka ubuso bakhe edonga, wathandaza kuYehova,
Ngicela, Kosi yami, khumbula manje bona ngihamba phambi kwakho ngeqiniso ngenhliziyweni yami yonke, begodu ngakwenza okulungile ebusweni bakho.
Ngaphambi kokuba uIsaya ahambe esitezi esiphakathi, kwafika igama likaYehova kuye, lithi:

Uzobuyela, ukhulume noHezekiya, uthi: uzimu, uzimu kaDavide umzali wakho, usho lokhu: Ngiye ngakulalela ukuthandaza kwakho, ngakubona inkanuko yakho; ngiza kukuphilisa. Ngosuku olulandelayo uzoya ethempelini likaYehova.

begodu ngizongeza ezinsukwini zakho iminyaka eyisishiyagalombili; begodu ngizokusindisa wena nalesi sixeko emkhosini kakumkani wase-Ashuri. Ngizovikela lesi sixeko ngenxa yami, ngenxa yomkhonzi wami uDavide.
Wathi uIsaya, Nciphisa isiphuzo sezinkomo. Bayithatha, bayibeka phezu kobuhlungu; begodu uHezekiya waphiliswa.
Wathi uHizekiya kuIsaya, Ingabe yini inkomba yokuthi ikosi uzongiphilisa, nokuthi ngizokwehla ethempelini likaYehova ngosuku olulandelayo?
Wathi uIsaya, Lolu phawu oluvela kuYehova, bona uzimu uzokwenza lokhu akutjhoko: Ingabe isithunzi sizohamba phambili izinyawo eziyishumi, noma sizobuyela emuva izinyawo eziyishumi?
Wathi uHizekiya, Kuhle khulu bona isithunzi sihambe izingcezu ezingu-10 phambili; kodwana ngizoyibuyisela emuva izingcezu ezingu-10.
UIsaya umprofeti wayalela ikosi, wakwenza isithunzi sibuyela emuva izinyawo eziyishumi eziphezulu esitezi sika-Ahaze.
Ngaleso sikhathi uMerodakhi Baladani, unyana kaBaladani, ukumkani waseBhabheli, wathumela umbiko nomnikelo kuHezekiya; ngombana wayefundile bona uHezekiya ubefile.

UHizekiya wamukela labo, wababonisa konke okukhona ezindaweni zakhe zokugcina izinto, isiliva, negolide, nezithako, nophethiloli oluhle, namathuluzi akhe, nanoma yini ekhona ezindaweni zakhe zokugcina izinto; kwakungekho lutho enkundleni yakhe, noma emlandweni wakhe wonke, uHizekiya engababonile.
Wafika uIsaya umprofeti kuHezekiya ukumkani, wathi kuye, Bathi yini labo bantu? Bavela kuphi? UHezekiya waphendula wathi, Bavela ezweni elisendaweni enkulu, eBhabheli.
Wathi uIsaya, Babonani endlu yakho? UHezekiya wathi, Babone konke okusendlini yami; akukho lutho ezindleleni zami engingeke ngibabonisele.
Wathi uIsaya kuHizekiya, Ngisho ilizwi likaYehova:
Ngiyabona bona amalanga zizofika, lapho konke okukhona endlu yakho, nalokho obaba bakho abawuqoqe kuze kube ngalolusuku, kuzothunyelwa eBhabheli; ngeke kushiyeke lutho, kusho ikosi.
Bazothathwa nabangani bakho, abazaliswe emndenini wakho; begodu bazobe ngabaphathi endlu kakumkani waseBhabheli.
Wathi uHizekiya kuIsaya, Lilungile ilizwi likaYehova olikhulumayo. Wathi ke uHizekiya, Ingabe ngeke kube khona isiqiniseko nokuthula emini yami?
Konke okushiwo nguHizekiya, namandla akhe wonke, nokuthi wenza kanjani i-aquarium, nodonga oluletha amanzi edolobhaneni, akukabhalweni ekhishini lezindaba zamakumkani baseYuda?
UHezekiya wafa, uManase unyana wakhe waba ngukumkani endaweni yakhe.
UManase ubeneminyaka engu-12 ubudala lapho eqala ukumkani; waba ngukumkani eYerusalem iminyaka eyishumi nambili nesishiyagalombili.
Wakwenza okumbi emehloni kaYehova, walandela izinto ezingathandeki zazo zonke izizwe, azenzayo ikosi phambi kwabantwana bakaSirayeli.

Wakwakha kabutjha izindawo eziphakeme, ayise uHizekiya ayezisusa, wamisa izibingelelo kuBahali, wakwenza i-ashere, njengombana wayeyenze uAhabhi ukumkani wakwaSirayeli; wabheka phasi, wakhonza zonke izinkanyezi zezulu.
Wakha izibhedlela endlwini kaYehova, lapho ikosi ebethi khona, EYerusalem ngizobeka igama lami.
Ezindaweni ezimbili zangaphakathi zendlu kaYehova, wakha izibingelelo ezibomvu zonke ezingcezu zomhlaba.

Wabeka unyana wakhe emgodini, wasebenzisa amaphupho, wazama ukucabanga ngezinkanyezi, wabhekana nalabo abanezinhlamvu zomoya, nalabo abanezinhlamvu zezulu. Wakwenza okumbi khulu emehlo kaYehova, wamangalisa uzimu.

Wathatha i-ashere eyingqayizivele, ayenze yona, wayibeka ethempelini, lapho ikosi ebemtshela khona uDavide noSolomoni unyana wakhe, esithi, Endlwini lendlu, naseJerusalema, engikhethele kuyo zonke izizwe zakwaSirayeli, ngizobeka igama lami kuze kube sekupheleni.

begodu ngeke ngiphinde ngishiye izandla zakwaSirayeli zihamba ngasohlangothini oluthile ezweni engilile kubaba babo, uma nje begcina ukukwenza konke okungiwisela umthetho ngalo, njengombana umkhonzi wami uMosis awisenzile.
Kodwana abantu abazange baphendule, ngombana uManase wabakhohlisa ukuba benze okumbi khulu kunazo zonke izizwe, azenzayo ikosi phambi kwamadodana kaSirayeli.
Wathi ikosi ngezandla zabangane bakhe abaprofeti, wathi,

UManase ukumkani wakwaYuda wenza lezi zinto ezingathandeki, wakwenza okumbi khulu ukudlula bonke ama-Amori abahlala lapha phambi kwakhe; begodu wabangela ukuba izwe laseYuda lizinikele ngezinhlamvu zakhe.
Ngako oko utsho ikosi, uzimu kaSirayeli, esithi, Khayi, ngizoletha indlala eYerusalem naseYuda, kuze kube yilapho wonke umuntu okubonayo, izindlebe zakhe zibe zinde.

Ngizoyilinganisela iYerusalem ngentambo yami yokulinganisa, eniyibeke eSamariya, nentambo yami yokulinganisa, eniyibeke emndenini ka-Ahabhi; begodu ngizoyihlanza iJerusalema, njengokuthi umuntu ahlanze isidlo, ayihlanze, ayishintshele phasi.
Ngizoshiya isibopho sabantu bam, labo abasele, ngibamise ezinyaweni zababi babo; nabo bonke ababi babo bazowabulala, begodu bathathe izinto zabo.
ngenxa yokuthi bakwenze lokho okumbi ngamehlo ami, begodu bemicindezela kusukela kuleso sikhathi abangababa babo baphuma eYiputa kuze kube manje.

UManase wabulala begodu abantu abangenacala, kuze kube yilapho egcwele khona iYerusalem ngegazi labo, kusukela esiphethweni esisodwa kuya kwesiphequluli esisodwa; ngaphandle kwedhambi lakhe eliwenza amaYuda aphume kulo, ukwenza okumbi ngamehlo kaYehova.
Uma kukhulunywa ngezinye zezinto azenzayo uManase, nezenzo zakhe zonke, kanye nobubi bakhe, kubonakala sengathi konke lokhu kubhalwe encwadini yamaqiniso kakumkani wakwaYuda.
Wafa uManase, wabanjwa efulethini lakhe, efulethini likaUza. UAmoni unyana wakhe waba ngukumkani esikhundleni sakhe.
UAmoni ubeneminyaka eyishumi nambili ubudala lapho eqala ukumkani; waba ngukumkani iminyaka emibini eYerusalem. Ubaba wakhe wayenguMeshulemeti, intombi kaHaruzi waseYotbha.
Wakwenza okumbi ngamehlo kaYehova, njengokuthi uManase ubaba wakhe abewenza.
Wahamba yonke indlela owawuhamba ngayo ubaba wakhe, wakhonza amatshe afana nalawo abewakhonza ubaba wakhe, wayazinikela kiwo.
Wasuka elandela ikosi, uzimu wakwababa bakhe, akahamba ngezindlela zikaYehova.
Abaphathi baka-Amoni bahlela ukulwa naye, babulala ukumkani endlu yakhe.
Kodwana abantu basezweni babulala bonke labo abaphikisayo ukumkani uAmoni; begodu abantu baselizwe bakwenza uYosiya, unyana wakhe, waba ngukumkani endaweni yakhe.
Okunye okushiwo nguAmoni, konke okwenze, akubonakali kubhalwe encwadini yezindaba zamakumkani baseYuda?
Wagcwaliswa emgodini wakhe, efulethini lika-Uza. UYosiya unyana wakhe waba ngubukhosi esikhundleni sakhe.
UYosiya ubeneminyaka eyisishiyagalombili ubudala lapho eqala ukumkani; waba ngukumkani iminyaka engu-31 eYerusalem. Umzali wakhe wayenguYedida, indodana kaAdaya waseBozkhathi.
Wakwenza okulungile emehlo kaYehova, wahamba yonke indlela kaDavide, ubaba wakhe; akashintshi ngakwesokudla noma ngasekhohlo.
Ngonyaka oyisishiyagalombili wombuso kaYosiya, uYosiya wathumela uShafani, indodana ka-Azaliya, indodana kaMeshulamu, umbhali, endlwini kaYehova, wathi,
Hamba ufike ku-Hilkiya, umpristi omkhulu, uyeke ukulinganisa imali eyafakwa endlwini kaYehova, leyo abaphathi bezindonga ababeyiqoqe kubo bonke abantu.
Bazobeka kiwo amehlo labo labo abaphatha umsebenzi wendlu kaYehova, babeke kiwo amehlo abo labo abalungisa umsebenzi wendlu kaYehova.
labo abasebenza ngokhuni, nalabo abaqambi, nalabo abakhi izindonga; bathenge begodu imithi nodonga olucwebezelayo, ukuze balungise indlu.
Akudingeki bona bacabange ngemali abayitholayo, ngombana bahlala bethembekile."
Wathi uHilkiya, umbingeleli omkhulu, kuShafani umbhali, esithi, Ngithole incwadi yomthetho endlwini kaYehova. Wanikela incwadi kuShafani, wafunda yona.
Waphuma uShafani umbhali, waya kukumkani, wathi, Abaphathi bakho bakhiphe imali etholakalayo endlwini kaYehova, bayidlulise ezinyaweni zalabo abaphatha umsebenzi wendlu kaYehova.
Wathi uShafani umbhali kuye ukumkani, ethi, UHilkiya umbingeleli wanikeza incwadi. Wafunda yona uShafani phambi kokumkani.
Kwathi lapho ukumkani ekhuluma ngamazwi encwadini yomthetho, waxosha izigqoko zakhe.
Wathi uSolomoni kuHilkiya ukumkani, no-Ahikamu unyana kaShafani, no-Akhobore unyana kaMikaya, no-Shafani umbhali, no-Asaya umkhonzi wobukhosi:

Hamba nibuze ikosi ngami, nalabo bantu, namaYuda onke, ngezinto ezibhalwe kulolu ncwadi oluthunyelwe; ngombana indlala kaYehova ikhulu khulu, begodu ihlukumele phezu kwethu, ngenxa yokuthi ababa bethu abazange balalele amazwi alo ncwadi, besenza konke okubhalwa kulo.

UHilkiya umbingeleli, no-Ahikamu, no-Akhobore, no-Shafane, no-Asaya, baya ku-Hulda umprofeti, indodana ka-Salumu, unyana ka-Tikwa, unyana ka-Harhasha, ophethe izigqoko zobukhosi; wahlala eJerusalema, ezindaweni ezintsha.
Wathi kubo, Usho lokhu ikosi, uzimu kaSirayeli: Nithi kulowo muntu owabathumelela kuye:
Uthi ikosi bona, Bheka, ngizoletha umonakalo phezu kwalo mhlaba nomphakathi walo, ngokwezinto ezibhalwe encwadini ebeyifunda ukumkani wakwaYuda.
Bamishe ngami, bamisa umlilo emadini amanye, ukuze bandise inkanuko yami ngezinto zabo zonke ezenziwe ngamazandla abo; ngalokho indlala yami izoqhuma phezu kwalo mhlaba, begodu ngeke iphele.
Kodwana kukumkani wakwaYuda, owabathumela bona nibuze ikosi, nithi kuye, uzimu kaSirayeli uthi lokhu mayelana namazwi awaziyo:

Ngokuba inhliziyweni yakho yanyamalala, begodu ukhohlakele phambi koYehova, lapho ukuzwa khona lokho engikushoyo ngalolu dolobhana nalabo abahlala kulo, bona bazoba yindawo yokuhlukunyezwa, nendawo yokulaliswa; nawe waxosha izigqoko zakho, wakhala phambi kwami; ngalokho ngikuphendule, kusho ikosi.
Ngalokhu, bheka, ngizokususa uhlale nababa bakho, uzogqugquzelwa ngokuthula; begodu ngeke ubone izinkinga zonke, engizozisa ngazo kule ndawo. Bathi ke kubo ukumkani.
Wathumela ukumkani, wabiza bonke abakhulu baseYuda nabaseYerusalem; bafika behlangana naye.

Waphuma ukumkani waya endlwini kaYehova, naye wonke amadoda aseYuda, nalabo bonke abahlali baseYerusalem, namabhishobhi, namaprofeti, nabo bonke abantu, kusukela kulowo oncane kuye kulowo omkhulu; wafunda emlonyeni wabo zonke izindaba zencwadi yesivumelwano esithunyelwe ethempelini likaYehova.

Wahlala ukumkani eduze kombhoshongo, wakwenza isivumelwano phambi kweNkosi, bona uzolandela ikosi, begodu uzogcina izimiso zakhe, nezibopho zakhe, namalungiselelo akhe, intliziyo yakhe yonke, nomoya wakhe wonke, ukuze aphumeze amazwi lesivumelwano esibhalwe kulolu ncwadi. Abantu bonke bavuma ukuba bagcine lesi simo.

Wathi ukumkani kuHilkiya, umbingeleli omkhulu, nakubabhishobhi abathathu, nabenzi bomnyango, ukuba basuse ethempelini likaYehova zonke izinto ezihlelwe uBahali, ne-Ashere, nezinkanyezi zonke zezulu; wazibonela ngaphandle kweJerusalema, emadolobheni aseKidrone, wazisa inkungu yazo eBhethiyeli.

Wasusa ababhishobhi basezizwe zakwamanye amazwe, abaholi bezizwe zakwaYuda ababebamise ukudlidliza uvumba emadolobheni aseYiputa naseJerusalema; wasusa nalabo abadlidliza uvumba kuBaali, nelanga, nenyanga, namaplanethi, nezinkanyezi zonke zezulu.

Wathatha i-ashere, yaphuma ethempelini likaNdikhoyo, waya emfuleni uKidron, ngaphandle kweYerusalem; wayishiya khona, wayithambisa ibe yimpuphu, wakhipha umhlabathi wayo phezu kwezidumbu zamadodana asekhaya.
Waphula begodu izindlu zamadodakazi, ezikhona ethempelini likaYehova, lapho abesifazane bezigqoka khona izingubo ze-Ashera.

UYosiya wakhipha bonke ababhishobhi emadolobheni aseYiputa waya eYerusalem, wasusa izindawo eziphakeme lapho bephuza khona insindiso, kusukela eGibeha kuya eBheri-shebha. Waphula izindonga zezingqimba zokungena emgwaqeni kaJoshua, umphathi wedolobha, okungukwesobunxele uma uphuma emgwaqeni womzi.
Abaphazamisi bezindawo eziphakeme abakwazi ukukhonza emgodini kaYehova eYerusalem, kodwana badla ubisi olungaphekiwe phakathi nabangani babo abaphazamisi.
Wakwenza iTophethi, eGoli lika-Ben Hinnom, ibe yindawo engafanele ukukhonza kuyo, ukuze akukho muntu ongakwaziyo ukunikela khona unyana wakhe noma intombi yakhe emlilweni kuMoleki.

Wasusa amabhayisikili, amakhosi aseYiputa ayewalungiselela ilanga, awabeka emgwaqweni wokungena ethempelini likaYehova, eduze kwendlu yomphathi okuthiwa nguNathani-meleki, enhliziyweni. UYosiya wavala izithuthi zomlilo ezilungiselelwe ilanga.

Izindawo zokubopha ezingcwele, ababezilungisa abavikeli baseYuda phezu kwendlu yangasese ka-Ahashe, uMbuso Wasendulo wawuzikhuphula phasi; begodu izindawo zokubopha ezingcwele, azenzayo uManase ezindaweni ezimbili zangaphakathi zendlu kaYehova, wazigqugquzela khona, waza wazisa emfuleni iKidron.

Nasezindaweni eziphakeme ezibhekene neYerusalem, ezisenyakatho-mpumalanga yeNtaba Yokufa, uMbuso WaseSolomoni wakwaSirayeli wawuzisusa; wazenza iAshtorethi, into engathandeki yamaSidoni, noKemoshi, into engathandeki yamaMowabi, noMilkom, into engathandeki yamaAmmoniti.
UYosiya waphula izikhonkwane ezingcwele zegolide, wasusa amatshe e-Ashere, wagqoka izinso zabantu phezu kwazo zonke izindawo zazo.

Waphula begodu isibingelelo esiseBetheleli, nendawo ephakeme ayenze ngayo uYarobhoamu, unyana kaNabati, lowo wabangela amaSirayeli ukuba abe ngudlame; wabulala indawo ephakeme, wayisusa ibe yimpuphu, wayala i-Ashera.

UYosiya wabheka, wabona amagobho asesitezi esiphakeme; wakhipha amathambo emagobhoni, wawushisa phezu kwesibingelelo, ukuze angeke kube khona umuntu okhuluma ngalo, njengombana ikosi atjhilo ngomlomo womntu kaThixo, owaveza lezi zinto zangaphambili.
Wathi uYosiya, Iyini le nhloko yomlilo engiyibonayo? Bathi kuye abantu bedolobha, Liyithambo lomntu kaThixo osuka eYuda, owakhuluma ngalezo zinto ozikwenzela isibingelelo esikhona eBheteli.
Wathi uYosiya, Yishiyeni; akukho muntu ozoba nenyama yakhe. Bagcina khona inyama yakhe, kanye nenyama yomprofeti owafika eSamariya.
Wasusa begodu uYosiya zonke izakhiwo zezindawo eziphakeme ezindaweni zakwaSamariya, azenza iziphathimandla zakwaSirayeli, ukuze ziphazamise inhliziyo kaYehova; wenza kuzo konke okwenze eBheteli.
Wabulala bonke ababhishobhi bezindawo eziphakeme zalezo phezu kwama-altari abo, washiswa amathambo abantu phezu kwama-altari abo; wabuyela eYerusalem.
Wathi ukumkani kubo bonke abantu, Nigcine iPasha kuYehova uzimu wenu, njengombana kuchaziwe kulolu ncwadi lwesivumelwano.
Akuzange kube khona iPasha enjalo, kusukela kulezi zinsuku abavikeli bephatha isiSirayeli, kuze kube yizo zonke amalanga zamakhosi aseSirayeli, namasiko aseYuda.
Ngonyaka oyisishiyagalombili wokumkani uYosiya, kwadlalwa iPasha leyo kuYehova eYerusalem.

UYosiya wasusa nalabo abakhuluma ngezinkanyezi, nabamangali, nabangani bezindlu, nezinhlamvu zegolide, nazo zonke izinto ezibi ezabonakala eYiputa naseYerusalem, ukuze agcine amazwi omthetho abhalwe encwadini kaHilkiya umbingeleli, owathola ethempelini likaYehova.
Akubekho ukumkani ofana noYosiya, phambi kwakhe, noma ngemuva kwakhe, owamukele ikosi inhliziyweni yakhe yonke, nomphefumulo wakhe wonke, namandla akhe wonke, ekwenzeni konke umthetho kaMoses.
Naphezu kwalokho, ikosi akhenge abuyisele emuva inkohliso yakhe enkulu, inkohliso yakhe eyandayo ezweni laseYuda, ngenxa yazo zonke izinto azenzayo uManase zokumkhaza.
Wathi ikosi, Ngizowususa noYuda phambi kwami, njengokuba ngiwasuse amaSirayeli; begodu ngizowususa lo mzi engiwukhethele iYerusalem, nendlu leyo, indawo lapho ngathi khona: Lizoba khona igama lami.
Okunye okushiwo nguYosiya, konke okwenze, yini na, akubhalweni encwadini yamaqiniso wamabukhosi baseYuda?

Ngosuku lokubusa kukaYosiya, uFaro-nekho, ukumkani waseYiputa, wafika eMfuleni i-Ephratha, ukuze asize ukumkani wakwa-Ashuri. UMosis uJosiya waphuma ukubhekana naye; kodwana lapho ehlangana naye eMegido, wambulala.
Amakhosi akhe ayemthwala emoto yakhe, asuka eMegido waya eYerusalem, washiswa emgodini wakhe. Abantu bezwe bathatha uYehohazazi unyana kaYosiya, bamenza ukumkani endaweni yobaba wakhe.
UYohahazi ubeneminyaka eyishumi nambili nesithathu ubudala lapho eqala ukumkani; waba ngukumkani eminyakeni emithathu eYerusalem. Ubaba wakhe wayenguHamutali intombi kaYeremiya waseLibna.
Wakwenza okumbi emehloni kaYehova, ngokwezinto zonke ababezenza abazali bakhe.

UFaro-nekho wamveza emgodini eRibla, ezweni laseHamati, ukuze angeke abe ngukumkani eYerusalem; wabeka phezu kwaYuda imali yegolide eyishumi nesishiyagalombili sekhilogramu, negolide elilingana nekhilogremu.
UFaro-nekho wenza uEliyakamu, unyana kaYosiya, ukumkani endaweni kaYosiya ubaba wakhe, washintsha igama lakhe abe nguYehoyakimu. Wathatha uYohahazi waya eYiputa, wafa khona.

UYehoyakim wanikeza uFaro imali yesiliva negolide, njengombana efuna; ukuze akwenze lokhu, waqoqa izimali zezwe. Wakhipha wonke umuntu imali yesiliva negolide, ngokuya ngezinto zakhe, ukuba azinike uFaro Nekho.
UYoyakimu ubeminyaka imashumi mahlanu nesihlanu ezelwe, lapho eqala ukumkani; waba neminyaka eyishumi nanye engukumkani eYerusalem. Ubaba wakhe wayenguZebida intombi kaPedaya waseRuma.
Wakwenza okumbi emehloni kaYehova, ngokwezinto zonke ababezenza abazali bakhe.
Ngosuku lokubusa kukaYehoyakimu, uNebhukadnezare ukumkani waseBhabheli wahlasela izwe; waba ngumkhonzi wakhe iminyaka emithathu, wabuyela emuva, wehla phezu kwakhe.

UYehova wathumela phezu kwakhe amaqembu eBhabheli, namaqembu aseAram, namaqembu aseMowabi, namaqembu aseAmoni; wabathumela ukuba babhubhise izwe laseYuda, njengokuthi ikosi abewisela umthetho ngamehlo abakhonzi bakhe abaprofeti.
Lezo zinto zafika kuYuda ngenxa yomthetho kaYehova, ukuze azisuse phambi kwakhe, ngenxa yamaphutha kaManase, ngazo zonke izinto awazenzayo;
begodu ngenxa yegazi elingekho emthethweni alifuthayo; uManase wagcwalisa iJerusalema ngegazi elingekho emthethweni, begodu ikosi akafuni ukulixolisa.
Okunye okushiwo nguYehoyakim, konke okwenze, akubonakali kubhalwe encwadini yamaqiniso kakumkani wakwaYuda?
Wafa uYehoyakimi, waza waba ngukumkani uYoyakini unyana wakhe.
Nokho ukumkani waseMisri akabuyanga ezweni lakhe; ngombana ukumkani waseBhabheli wathatha izwe lakhe lonke, kusukela emfuleni waseMisri kuya emfuleni u-Efrayi.
UYoyakimu ubeneminyaka eyisishiyagalombili ubudala lapho eqala ukumkani, waba ngukumkani eminyakeni emithathu eYerusalem; indodana ka-Elnathani yaseJerusalema yaba ngumzali wakhe.
Wakwenza okumbi ngamehlo kaYehova, ngokwezinto zonke azenzayo ubaba wakhe.
Ngaleso sikhathi abaphathi bakaNebhukadnezare, ukumkani waseBhabheli, bahlasela iYerusalem, babambe umzi.
UNebhukhadnezare, ukumkani waseBabiloni, waya kulo mzi yena ngokwakhe, kanti abaphathi bakhe beyibhekene nayo.

Waphuma uYehoyakimu, ukumkani wakwaYuda, waya kukumkani waseBhabheli, yena nenkosi yakhe, nabangani bakhe, nabaphathi bakhe, nabaholi bakhe. Ngomnyaka wesishiyagalombili wokubusa kwakhe, uthethwe uYehoyakimu ngukumkani waseBhabheli.
UNebhukadnezare wathatha zonke izimpahla zendlu kaYehova, nendlu yobukhosi; waphula zonke izinto zegolide, azenzayo uSolomoni ukumkani wakwaSirayeli ethempelini likaYehova, njengokuthi ikosi, wathi.

Wabathatha bonke abantu baseYerusalem, nabaholi bonke, na gramatisi bonke, namadoda amakhulu onke, amashumi amabili amawaka, nalabo bonke abasebenza ngesandla, nabakhiqizi bensimbi; washiya kuphela abantu abancane ezweni.
UNebhukadnezare wathatha uYehoyakini waya eBhabheli, nabazali bakakumkani, namabhishobhi kakumkani, nabaphathi bakhe, nabantu abakhulu bezwe; wabathwala bonke emaJerusalema waya eBhabheli.

Wathatha ukumkani waseBhabheli abantu abangumakhulu asixhenxe abanamandla amakhulu, namaphesenti ayisishiyagalombili ochwepheshe bezinsimbi nabahlengikazi; bonke labo babe ngabomvu khulu, bekulungele ukulwa.
Ubukhosi baseBhabheli bakwenza uMatania, umngane wakhe, abe ngukumkani endaweni yakhe, bashintsha igama lakhe libe yiZedekiya.
UZedekiya ubeminyaka imashumi mahlanu nanye ezelwe, lapho eqala ukumkani; waba neminyaka eyishumi nanhlanu engukumkani eYerusalem. Ubaba wakhe wayenguHamutali intombi kaYeremiya waseLibna.
Wakwenza okumbi ngamehlo kaYehova, ngokwezinto zonke azenzayo uYehoyakim.
Lokhu konke kwakwenzeka eYerusalem naseYuda, ngenxa yengcindezi kaYehova, kuze kube yilapho awazikhipha khona phambi kwakhe; begodu uZedekiya wakhohlisa ukumkani waseBhabheli.

Ngomnyaka wesithoba wokubusa kwakhe, ngomhla wama-10 wenyanga, ngosuku lweshumi lonyaka, uNebhukadnezare ukumkani waseBhabheli waya eYerusalem, yena nomkhosi wakhe wonke; bamisa isibhedlela phezu kwalo mzi, babenza amatshe okulwa ngaso lonke.
Lo mzi ugcinwe ngaphasi kwengcindezi kuze kube yiminyaka eyishumi nanye yombuso kaSidekiya.
Ngomhla wesishiyagalombili wenyanga yesine, indlala yaba namandla khulu emizini; kwaba sengathi akukho ukudla okusele abantu.

Wathi uHezekiya, "Uzothatha isandla sakho," begodu wavala umgwaqo phakathi kwengqalasizinda ezimbili, lapho etholakala khona igadi lobukhosi. (Naphezu kwalokho, amaBhenjamini bekukhona phezu komgwaqo) begodu wathatha isandla sakhe, begodu wavala umgwaqo phakathi kwengqalasizinda ezimbili, lapho etholakala khona igadi loMbuso.
Kodwana ibutho laseBhabheli lalandela ukumkani uZedekiya, wafika kuye ezindaweni eziseduze neJericho; begodu wonke amaphoyisa akhe washiya yena, wahlukaniswa.
Bathatha ukumkani, bamthwala kukumkani waseBhabheli eRiblah; khona-ke wagwetywa icala.
Babulala oonyana baka-Zedekiya phambi kwakhe, baphuca amazinyo ka-Zedekiya, bagwema imilenze yakhe izintambo zegolide, bamthwala eBhabheli.

Ngonyaka oyisishiyagalombili kaNabukodonozoro ukumkani waseBhabheli, ngomhla wesixhenxe wenyanga yesithupha, kwafika eYerusalem uNebuzaradani, umphathi wezigwegwe, owayengumholi womkakhe waseBhabheli.
Wamisa umlilo ethempelini likaYehova, nendlu kaNdikhoyo, namakhaya onke aseYerusalem; nanoma iyiphi isakhiwo esibalulekile wamisa umlilo.
Wonke umkhosi waseBabiloni ngaphasi komphathi wendawo yokugqugquzela waphonsa phasi amadonga ajikeleze iYerusalem.
UNebuzaradani, umphathi wezigwegwe, wathatha amanye amalungu omphakathi asele edolobhaneni, nalabo abathuthukile kuye ukumkani waseBhabheli, kanye neminye imindeni sabo, waya ejele.
Nokho uMengameli wezokuphepha washiya abanye abantu abancane ezweni, ukuba basebenze emavinini nasezikhungweni.
Izingqoba zesiliva, nezisekelo zegolide, nebhodlela elikhulu legolide elibizwa bona yilwandle, elikhona ethempelini likaYehova, abaBabiloniyi bazibhoboza zonke izinsimbi zazo, bazisa eBhabheli.
Bathathe begodu amabhodwe, nama-shavels, nama-wick trimmers, nama-spoons, kanye nazo zonke izinto zegolide ezisetshenziswa emisebenzini yethempelini.
Wathatha umphathi wezigwegwe amabhodwe omlilo, namabhodlela okubhaka, konke kwenziwa ngegolide elihlanzekile noma ngesilivere elihlanzekile.
Insimbi yezinhlamvu ezimbili, nolwandle olulodwa, nezisekelo, azenzayo uSolomoni ethempelini likaYehova, yayinzima khulu ukuba ilinganiswe.

Intambo ngayinye yamamitha ayisishiyagalombili ubude. Intambo ngayinye imitha elilodwa nesithupha ubude, begodu yahlobisa ngazo zonke izinhlangothi ngenethiwekhi yama-granate egolide. Intambo yesithathu nenethiwekhi yayo yayifana neyesibili.
Wathatha umphathi wezigwegwe uSeraya, owayengumbingeleli omkhulu, noZefaniya, owayengumbingeleli wesithathu, nalabo abathathu abagcina isango.

Wathatha, phakathi kwabantu abasele edolobhaneni, umphathi ophethe imindeni yezokulwa, namadoda amahlanu abhekene nobukhosi, nombhali wesikhulu somkhosi, owabamba abantu belizwe emdlalweni, namantombazane angamashumi ayisishiyagalombili phakathi kwabantu belizwe, ababekhona edolobhaneni.
U-Nebuzaradani, umphathi wezigwegwe, wabathatha bonke, wabathumela kukumkani waseBhabheli, eRibla.
Wababulala khona eRibla, ezweni laseHamati, ukumkani waseBhabheli; begodu abantu baseYuda bathunyelwe ezindaweni ezingaphandle kwezwe.
UNebhukhadnezare ukumkani waseBhabheli wabeka uGedaliya, unyana ka-Ahikamu, unyana kaShafani, ukuba ngumphathi wabo bonke abantu abewashiya ezweni laseYuda.

Bafika ke kuGedaliya eMizpa, bonke abaphathi bamabutho, namadoda abo, bona ukumkani waseBhabheli wamisa uGedaliya ukuba nguMengameli; kwaba khona uIshmayeli unyana kaNethaniya, noYohananu unyana kaKareha, noSeraya unyana kaTanhumethi waseNetofa, noYazaniya unyana kaMaakathi, nabo amadoda abo.
Wathi uGedaliya kubo, namadodana abo: "Ungabakhombi abaphathi baseBhabheli; hlalani kulolu lizwe, nisebenzele ukumkani waseBhabheli, begodu kuzobe sekuhle kuwe."

Kwathi ngonyaka wesixhenxe, kwafika uIshmayeli unyana kaNethaniya, unyana kaElishama, umfazi wendlu yasebukhosini, namadoda alishumi naye, wahlasela noGedaliya, wababulala yena nemindeni sabo, kanye nabantu baseYuda nabaseBhabheli ababenaye eMizpa.
Wathi wonke umuntu, oncane nomkhulu, kanye nabaphathi bemikhosi sabo, basuka ezweni laseMisiya; ngombana babekhathazekile ngenxa yamaBhabheli.

Ngomnyaka weshumi nambili nesishiyagalolunye wokuboshwa kukaYehoyakimu ukumkani wakwaYuda, ngomhla wama-27 wonyaka oyisithupha uMerodaki waba ngukumkanikazi waseBhabheli; ngaleso sikhathi wasusa isandla sikaYehoyakimu ukumkani wakwaYuda emgodini.
Wakhuluma naye ngobuqotho, wabeka isikhala sakhe esiphakeme kunaso soke sabaphathi abakhona naye eBhabheli.
UYehoyakimu wasusa izigqoko zakhe zokuhlukunyezwa, wadla ukudla efulethini likakumkani zonke amalanga zakhe.
Umbuso wamnika umnikelo wokudla nsuku zonke, kuze kube yilapho uhlala khona.
1Chr: uAdama, noSethe, noEnoshe,
uKenani, noMahalaleli, noYaredi,
uEnoki, noMethusela, noLamekhi,
UNowa, noShem, noHami, noYafeti, oonyana bakaNowa.
Oonyana bakaYafeti: uGomer, noMagoge, noMadai, noYavane, noThubali, noMesheki, noTira.
Oonyana bakaGomer: uAshkenazi, noDiphathi, noTogarma.
Oonyana bakaJavane: uElisha, noTarshishi, namaKithimi, neRodani.
Oonyana bakaHami: uKushi, noMizrayimu, noPhuti, noKanana.
Oonyana bakaKushi: uSheba, noHawila, noShabtha, noRaama, noShabteka; oonyana bakaRama: uSheba noDedani.
UKushi ube ngubaba kaNimrode, owakhula waba ngumnqobi onamandla emhlabeni.
UMizrayimu waba ngumzali wamaLudi, namaAnami, namaLehabi, namaNaftukhi,
AmaPathusi, namaKasluhhi (abaFilisti basuka kubo), namaKaftorithi.
UKanana waba ngumzali kaSidon, umzali wakhe omkhulu, noHeti.
Waba ubaba wamaJebhusi, nama-Amori, namaGigegashi,
amaHivithi, namaArkhithi, namaSinithi,
nama-Arvadite, nama-Zemarite, nama-Hamatite.
Oonyana bakaShem: u-Elam, no-Ashuri, no-Arfaxadi, no-Ludi, no-Aram, no-Uzi, no-Huli, no-Getheri, no-Mesheki.
U-Arfaxadi waba ngumzali kaShela, no-Shela waba ngumzali ka-Ebheri.
Kwaba nguHebhere izingane ezimbili: igama elilodwa lalinguPelege, ngombana ngesikhathi sakhe sahlukaniswa umhlaba; igama lodadewabo linguJoktan.
UYoktan wayeyindodana ka-Almodad, i-Sheleph, i-Hasarmaveth, ne-Jerah,
uHadoram, noUzale, noDikla,
u-Ebhali, no-Abhimeleki, no-Sheba,
U-Ofiri, no-Hawila, no-Yobhab; labo bonke babe yindodana kaJoktan.
Imindeni kaShem: uShem, no-Arfashade, no-Shela,
no-Ebheri, no-Pelege, no-Rehu,
uSerugi, noNakhore, noTera,
begodu Abram, obizwa bona Abraham.
Oonyana baka-Abrahama babengu-Isakha no-Ishmayeli.
Lokho kwakuyiminyaka sabo. Uyise ka-Ishmayeli wayenguNebayothi, noKedari, noAdbeeli, noMibsham,
neMishma, neDuma, neMasha, neHadadi, neThema,
Babo oonyana baka-Ishmayeli: uJeturu, noNafishi, noKedema.
UKetura, indodakazi ka-Abrahamu, wazala uZimrani, no-Yokshani, no-Medan, no-Midiyani, no-Ishbhaki, no-Shua. Oonyana baka-Jokshani: uSheba no-Dedani.
Oonyana bakaMidiyani: u-Epha, no-Epher, no-Hanoch, no-Abida, no-Eldaa; labo bonke babe yizingane zikaKetura.
UAbrahamu wazala uIsake. Oonyana bakaIsake: uEsau no-Isirayeli.
Oonyana baka-Esau: uEliphazi, noRehuweli, noJeushi, noYalamu, noKora.
Oonyana baka-Eliphazi: uTeman, noOmar, noZephi, noGatham, noKenaz, noTimna, noAmaleki.
Oonyana bakaRehuyeli: uNahati, noZeraha, noShama, noMiza.
Oonyana bakaSeiri: uLothane, noShobhali, noSibeoni, noAna, noDishon, noEzer, noDishan.
Oonyana baka-Lothani: uHori noHomam; indodakazi ka-Lothani: iThimna.
Oonyana bakaShobhali: uAliyani, noManahati, noEbali, noShefi, noOnam; oonyana bakaSibeoni: uAhiya noAna.
Unyana ka-Ana uDishon. Unyana ka-Dishon nguHamran, no-Eshban, no-Ithran, no-Keran.
Oonyana baka-Ezer: uBhilehan, noZawan, noYaakan; oonyana baka-Dishan: uUz noAran.
Nalaba bamakhosi abalawula ezweni lase-Edom, ngaphambi kokuba kubekho ubukhosi phakathi kwabantwana bakaSirayeli: uBela unyana kaBheori; igama ledolobha lakhe lalinguDinhaba.
Wafa uBela, waba ngukumkani bayramaila uYobhab unyana kaZeraha waseBozra.
UYobhab wafa, waba ngukumkani esikhundleni sakhe uHusam wasezweni zari-Temani.
Wafa uHusham, waba ngukumkani esikhundleni sakhe uHadade unyana kaBedade. UHadade wahlasela amaMidiyani emazweni aseMowabi; igama ledolobha lakhe lakunguAviti.
Wafa uHadade, waba ngukumkani esikhundleni sakhe uSamla waseMasreka.
Wafa uSamla, waba ngukumkani esikhundleni sakhe uSawule waseRehobothi eMfula.
Wafa uShawule, waba ngukumkani esikhundleni sakhe uBaale-hanana, unyana ka-Akhobori.
Wafa uBhala-hanana, waba ngukumkani esikhundleni sakhe uHadade; igama ledolobha lakhe lakunguPahi; indodakazi kaMatredi, inkosikazi kaMezahabi, yaba ngumkakhe.
Wafa uHadade. Abaphathi bezindlu zakwaEdom: uTimna, noAliya, noJethethi,
ne-Aholibhama, ne-Ela, ne-Pinoni,
uKenazi, neTemani, neMibsari,
Ama-Magdiyeli, nama-Iram; labo babe ngabaphathi baseEdom.
Bami oonyana bakaSirayeli: uRubhen, noShimeoni, noLevi, noYuda, noIssakhar, noZebuloni,
uDani, noYosefu, noBhenjamini, noNaphtali, noGadi, noAsere.
Oonyana bakaYuda: uEr, noOnan, noShela; labo bathathu bazalwa nguwesifazane waseKanana, intombi ka-Shua. UEr, umzali omkhulu kaYuda, wayebi emehloni kaYehova; ngalokho wabulala ikosi.
UTamari, indodakazi kaYuda, wazala uPerezi noZeraha kuye; bonke oonyana bakaJuda babehlanu.
Oonyana bakaPerezi: uHezron noHamuli.
Oonyana bakaZera: uZimri, noEthan, noHeman, noKalkoli, noDara, bonke abahlanu.
Unyana kaKarmi ngu-Ahara, owabangela ubuhlungu kumaSirayeli, ngokudlwengula izinto eziboshwe kuThixo.
Unyana ka-Ethan nguAzariya.
Abantwana abazalwa nguHeshron: uYerahmeel, noRam, noKhalebe.
URam waba ubaba ka-Aminadabhi; u-Aminadabhi waba ubaba ka-Nahshon, owayengumholi kwabaseYuda.
UNahshon ube ngubaba kaSalma, begodu uSalma ube ngubaba kaBowazi.
UBowazi waba ngumzali ka-Obedi, no-Obedi waba ngumzali ka-Yese.
Uyise kaYese, umzali wakhe uElibham; owesibili uAbinabahu; wesithathu uShimea;
owakwesine uNathaniyeli, owasihlanu uRadai,
u-Ozem owamashumi amabili, noDavide owamashumi ayisithupha.
Nabo abazalwane babo: uSeruya no-Abihayeli; nabenabathathu oonyana bakaSeruya: uAbhishai, noYowabha, no-Asaheli.
U-Abhigayeli wayeyinkosikazi ka-Amasa; ubaba ka-Amasa waba nguJether, umIsrayeli.
UKalebe unyana ka-Heshron wazalwa izingane ngu-Azuba indodana yakhe, no-Jeriothi; begodu oonyana baka-Azuba: uYeshere, noShobabu, noArdon.
Wafa uAzuba, uKalebe washada noEphratha; yena wazala uHure.
UHure waba ngumzali ka-Uri, no-Uri waba ngumzali ka-Bezalele.
UHeshron ubeneminyaka engu-60 ubudala, washada nenkosikazi kaMakhire, indodana kaGileyadi; yena wamzala uSegub.
Wazalelwa nguSegub uYahiri, owayengumphathi wezifunda ezingu-23 ezweni laseGileyadi.
Kodwana amaGeshuri nama-Aram athathe izifundazwe zikaYahiri, neKenathi nezifundela zayo; ziyizindawo eziyisishiyagalombili. Lokho konke kwaba yizingane zaMakhire, ubaba kaGiliyadi.
UHezron wafa eKalebe-ephratha; indodana yakhe, uAbiha, yazala uAshure, owayengumzali kaTekoa.
Oonyana bakaJerahmeel, umzali wokuthoma kaHeshron: uRam, umzali wakhe wokuthoma, noBuna, noOren, noOzem, noAhiya.
UJerahmeel wayenenkosikazi eyesibili, igama layo nguAtara; yena ubaba ka-Onam.
Oonyana baka-Ram, umzali ka-Yerahmeel: uMaazi, noYamini, noEkeri.
Oonyana baka-Onam: uShamai noYada; oonyana ka-Shamai: uNadab noAbishuri.
Uwesifazane ka-Abishure wabizwa bona u-Abihail, wazala uAhban noMolid.
Oonyana bakaNadabhi: uSheledi no-Aphayami. Wafa uSheledi, engeke abe nendodana.
Unyana ka-Apayim ngu-Ishi, unyana ka-Ishi ngu-Sheshan, unyana ka-Sheshan ngu-Ahlai.
Oonyana bakaYada, udade ka-Shamai: uYetere noYonathani. Wafa uYetere, engazali izingane.
Oonyana bakaYonathani: uPelethe, noZaza; labo bamadodakazi kaYerahmeel.
USheshan akhenge abe namadodakazi, kodwana ube nezingane. Kwabe kukhona umkhonzi waseMisri okuthiwa uJarha.
USheshan wamnika uJarha, umkhonzi wakhe, intombi yakhe ukuba ibe nguwesifazane; wazala uAtayi.
U-Attai ube ngubaba kaNathani. U-Nathani ube ngubaba kaZabadi.
UZabadi waba ngumzali ka-Eflale, begodu u-Eflale waba ngumzali ka-Obedi.
U-Obedi waba ubaba ka-Yehu, no-Yehu waba ubaba ka-Azaria.
UAzariya waba ubaba kaHelezi, noHelezi waba ubaba kaEleasa.
UEleasa waba ngumzali kaShishmai; uShishmai waba ngumzali kaShalum.
UShalumu waba ngumzali kaJekamiya; uJekamiya waba ngumzali kaElishama.
Oonyana bakaKalebe, udadewabo kaYerameyeli: uMesha umzali wakhe wokuthoma, owayengubaba kaZipho; noMaresha uyise, owayengubaba kaHebron.
Oonyana bakaHebroni: uKora, noTaphuwa, noRekemu, noShema.
UShema waba ubaba kaRahamu, ubaba kaYorekhamu; uRekemi waba ubaba kaShamai.
Unyana kaShamai nguMahoni. UMahoni ube ngubaba kaBeth-zur.
U-Epha, indodakazi kaKalebe, wazala uHaran, noMoza, noGazeze; uHaran ube ngubaba kaGazeze.
Oonyana bakaJahadi: uRegem, noYothani, noGeshani, noPeleti, noEfa, noShafa.
UMahaka, indodakazi kaKalebe, wazala uShebere noThirhana.
Wazala begodu uShafa, indodana kaMadmana, noSheva, indodana kaMakbena neGibeha; indodana kaKalebe yayingu-Aksha.
Lokho kwakuyindodana kaKalebe. Oonyana bakaHure, umzali wesifazane sikaEfrata: uShobhali, ubaba kaKiriyati-yearimi;
noSalma, ubaba kaBethelehemu; noHarephu, ubaba kaBhethe-gaderi.
UShobhali, ubaba kaKirihati-yearimi, waba nezingane ezinguHarohe naphezu kwamadodana kaMenuhothi.
Namadodakazi kaKirihati-yearimi: ama-Ithrithi, nama-Puthi, nama-Shumati, nama-Mishrai; namadodakazi kaZora, namadodakazi ka-Eshtaoli.
Amadodana kaSalma: abantu baseBethelehemu, nabaseNetofathi, nabaseAtrothi-bethe-Yowabhi, nengxenye yamaManahati, namaZori.
Nabo ababhali, abahlala eJabhesi, ngomndeni wabo: amaTirathi, namaShimeati, namaSukati; labo abaKenisi abavela kuHamathi, ubaba wemindeni yamaRehabhi.
Lawa ke amadodana kaDavide azalwa kuye eHebroni. Omkhulu wakhe uAmron, owaziwa bona uAhinoamu waseJezreeli; owesibili uDaniyeli, owaziwa bona uAbihayeli waseKarmeli.
owesithathu uAbsalomu, owazalwa nguMahaka, intombi kaTalmai ukumkani waseGeshuri; nowesine uAdoniya, owazalwa nguHagithi.
usihlanu nguShefatiya, owaziwa bona yi-Abital; osithandathu nguYitreyamu, owaziwa bona yi-Egla, indodana kaDavide.
Lawa mahlanu azalwa nguDavide eHebron, lapho waba khona iminyaka eyishumi nesishiyagalombili namasonto ayisishiyagalombili; begodu eYerusalem waba neminyaka engamashumi amathathu anesihlanu.
Bazalwa kuye eYerusalem: uShimea, noShobhab, noNathane, noSolomoni. Ubaba wabo wayenguBatshua, intombi ka-Amiyeli; bona babehlanu.
Kwabekho begodu uIbhari, noElishama, noElifelethe,
uNoga, noNefegi, noYaphia,
uElishama, noEliyada, noElifelethe; labo abathoba.
Lawo wonke amadodana kaDavide, ngaphandle kwamadodakazi akhe. Udadewabo uThamari.
Unyana kaSolomoni waba nguRehoboam, unyana kaRehoboam waba nguAbiha, unyana kaAbiha waba nguAsa, unyana kaAsa waba nguJehoshafati.
Unyana kaJehoshafati nguYoramu, unyana kaYoramu nguAhaziya, unyana kaAhaziya nguYoashi.
Unyana kaYoashi nguAmasiya, unyana kaAmasiya nguAzariya, unyana kaAzariya nguYothamu.
Unyana kaYothamu ngu-Ahazi, unyana kaAhazi ngu-Hizekiya, unyana kaHizekiya ngu-Manase.
Unyana kaManase nguAmoni, unyana kaAmoni nguYosiya.
Oonyana bakaYosiya: uJohanane owayengumzali, noYehoyakime owesithathu, noZedekiya wesithathu, noShalumu wesithupha.
UYehoyakime: uJekoniya unyana wakhe, noShedekiya unyana wakhe.
Oonyana bakaJekoniya, owathathwa ejele: uShealtiyeli indodana yakhe;
noMalkiram, noPedaya, noShenazare, noJekamiya, noHoshama, noNedabiya.
Oonyana bakaPedaya: uZerubabele, noShimeyi; oonyana bakaZerubabele: uMeshulamu, noHananiya; nonkosikazi wabo, uShelomitha.
Waba noZerubabele oonyana abahlanu: uHashubha, noOhele, noBerekiya, noHasadiya, noJushabhe-heshedi.
Abantwana bakaHananiya: uPelatiya, noYeshaya, nabangane bakaRefaya, nabangane ba-Arnan, nabangane ba-Obadiya, nabangane ba-Shekaniya.
Unyana ka-Shekaniyahu ngu-Shemahiya; u-Shemahiya waba nezingane eziyisishiyagalombili: uHatushi, no-Igale, no-Bariya, no-Nearya, no-Shafati.
Oonyana bakaNearya abathathu: uEliyonani, noHizekiya, noAzrikam.
Oonyana bakaEliyonai babeyisixhenxe: uHodaviya, noEliyasibhi, noPelaya, noAkubu, noYohanani, noDelaya, noAnani.
Amadodana kaYuda: uPerezi, noHeshroni, noKarmi, noHuri, noShobali.
URehaya unyana kaShobale waba ngumzali kaJahati, noJahati waba ngumzali ka-Ahumai noLahadi; lezi ziyimindeni yamaSorathi.
Nalaba bazalwa nguyise ka-Etham: uJezreyeli, noIshma, noIdbash; igama lowesifazane wabo lalinguHazelelponi.
Wazalwa nguPhenuyeli uGedori, wazalwa nguEzeri uHusha; labo babe yizingane zikaHhure, umzali wokuthoma kaEfrata, owayengumzali kaBethelehemu.
U-Ashure, ubaba kaTekoa, wayenezingane ezimbili: uHela noNaara.
UNahara wazala uAhuzam, noHepher, noTemeni, noHahashtari. Babo oonyana bakaNahara.
Oonyana bakaHela: uZerethi, no-Izhar, no-Ethan.
UHakhozi ube ngubaba ka-Anubhi noZobhebha, begodu waba ngumzali wezizwe zika-Aharheli unyana kaHarum.
UYabheze waziwa ngaphezu kwabazalwane bakhe; indodana yakhe yabiza igama lakhe bona uYabheze, isithi, Ngimzalile ngebuhlungu.

UYabhezi wathandaza kuThixo wakwaSirayeli, wathi, Ngicela, ngikuthande, usize izwe lami likhule; isandla sakho sihlale sinye nami, begodu ugcine umonakalo ngami, ukuze angabi nobuhlungu. Wathi uzimu wamnika owawufunayo.
U-Chelub, udade ka-Shuhah, ube ngubaba kaMehir, owayengubaba ka-Eshton.
U-Eshton waba ngumzali ka-Beth-rapha, no-Paseha, no-Tehina, owayengumzali ka-Ir-nahashe; labo bamadodana kaReka.
Oonyana bakaKenazi: uOthniyeli noSeraya; unyana kaOthniyeli nguHathathi.
UMeonothai waba ubaba ka-Ofra; uSeraya waba ubaba kaYowabhi, owasungula iGeharashimu, eGoli lalabo abasebenza ngezandla; ngombana abantu bayo babezimele.
Oonyana bakaKalebe, unyana kaJefune: ngu-Iru, no-Elah, no-Naham; unyana ka-Elah ngu-Kenaz.
Oonyana bakaJehaleleli: uZipho, noZifa, noTiriya, noAsareyeli.
Oonyana bakaEzra: uYetere, noMerede, noEfere, noJaloni; begodu indodana kaMerede yazala uMiriam, noShamai, noIshbha, owayengubaba ka-Eshtemoa.
Wazala uYaredi, indodana kaGedori, no-Ebheri, indodana kaSokho, no-Yekutiyeli, indodana kaZanoa; labo babe yizingane zikaBitiya, intombi kaFaro, owayeyindodakazi kaMerede.
Namadodakazi kaHodiya, inkosikazi kaNahhamu, abe yindodana kaKehila waseGarmi, no-Eshtemoa waseMaakathi.
Oonyana bakaShimoni: u-Amnoni, no-Rina, no-Benhanani, no-Tiloni; oonyana baka-Ishi: uZohete, no-Benzohete.
Oonyana bakaShela, unyana kaYuda: uEr, ubaba kaLekha, noLadeha, ubaba kaMaresha, kanye nemindeni yalabo abasebenza ngendwangu eBetha-ashbha.
Kwabekho noYokim, namadodana kaKozeba, noYoashi, noSaraphi, abaphathi baseMowabhi, kanye noYashubi-Lehem. Lezo zinto zivela ezinyangeni zakudala khulu.
Balokhu behlala eNethaim, neGedera; babehlala khona, basebenzela ukumkani.
Oonyana bakaSimeoni: uNemuyeli, noYamini, noJaribi, noZeraha, noShawuli.
USawule unyana kaShalumu, noShalumu unyana kaMibsham, noMibsham unyana kaMisma.
Abantwana bakaMishma: uHamuyeli unyana wakhe, noZakhuri unyana kaHamuele, noShimehi unyana kaZakhuri.

Kwaba nguShimeyi oonyana abalishumi elinamihlanu, nezingane eziyisithupha; kodwana abazalwane bakhe abazange babe nabantwana abaningi, begodu umndeni wabo wonke wawungenakuba mkhulu njengezwe likaYuda.
Bahlala eBhe-shebha, eMolada, eHazari-shuali,
noBhila, noEzem, noTholadi,
noBethuyeli, noHorma, noZiklagi,
I-Beth-markabhothi, ne-Hazari-shushimi, ne-Beth-biri, ne-Shaaraim; lezi ziyizindawo zabo kuze kube uDavide waba ngukumkani.
Izifundela zabo zaziyi-Etham, ne-Ayin, ne-Rimon, ne-Token, ne-Ashan; izifundazwe ezihlanu.
kanye nezifundela zonke ezibhekene nalawo madolobhana, kuze kube yiBaali. Lawa amakhaya abo, begodu bagcina incwadi yomndeni wabo.
noMeshobhab, noYamelekh, noYosha unyana kaAmasiya,
uYoweli, noYehu intombi ka-Yoshibiya, intombi kaSeraya, intombi ka-Asiyeli;
uEliyonani, noYakhobha, noYeshohaya, noAsaya, noAdiyeli, noYesimiyeli, noBenayai,
noZiza unyana kaShiphi, unyana kaAloni, unyana kaJedaya, unyana kaShimri, unyana kaShemaya.
Lawa madoda abizwa ngamagama lapha babe ngabaphathi bezizwe zabo. Imindeni sabo yakhula yaba enkulu.
Baye behamba kuze kube yilapho kungena khona iGedori, enyakatho-ntshonalanga yelali, befuna indawo yokudla izimvu zabo.
Bathola khona ubisi oluningi, oluhle khulu. Izwe livulekile, lihlanzekile, liphephile. Abantu abathile baseHami babehlala khona ngaphambilini.

Bafika ke labo abagqugquzelwe ngegama, ezikhathini zikaHizekiya ukumkani wakwaYuda, bahlasela amaHamithi, namaMeunithi ahlala khona, babulala wonke umuntu ohlala khona, kuze kube namhlanje; bahlala endaweni sabo, ngombana bekukhona khona indawo yokudlelisa izimvu zabo.
Basuka kubo eSimeoni, abantu abangumakhulu ayisishiyagalombili basuka ezweni eliphakeme laseSeiri; abaphathi babo bekunguPelatiya, noNearya, noRefaya, noUziyele, oonyana baka-Ishi.
Babulala bonke amanye ama-Amaleki, labo abafileyo; bahlala khona kuze kube ngalolusuku.

Lokho kwakunguRubhen, umzali wesifazane sikaSirayeli. Ube ngumzali wesifazane, kodwana ngenxa yokuthi wahlangana nomfazi wesifazane kayise, ilungelo lakhe lokuzalwa komzali wesifazane lanikezwa izingane zikaYosefu, unyana kaSirayeli; ngalokho-ke uRubhen akabhaliswa encwadini yomndeni njengomzali wesifazane.
UYuda waba mkhulu ukudlula bonke abazalwane bakhe, waphuma kuye umphathi; kodwana uYusufu wayeyindodana yokuqala.
Oonyana bakaRubhen, umzali wesifazane sikaSirayeli: uHanok, noPalu, noHezron, noKarmi.
Abantwana bakaYoweli: uShemaya unyana wakhe, noGoge unyana kaShemaya, noShimeyi unyana kaGoge,
uMika unyana kaShimeyi, noRehaya unyana kaMikha, noBhaali unyana kaRehaya,
noBhera unyana kaBahali. UTiglathi-pilesere ukumkani waseAshuri wathatha uBhera, waba ngumholi wesizwe sikaRubhen.
Abazalwane bakhe, ngokwemindeni sabo, ngokusho komlando womndeni wabo: uJeyeli umholi, noZekariya,
noBela unyana ka-Aza, unyana ka-Shema, unyana ka-Yoweli; bahlala ezweni elisuka e-Aroere kuya eNebo, naBaale-meoni.
Enyakatho-mpumalanga, bahlala kuze kube yilapho isiqhingi sifinyelela khona emfuleni i-Euphrates; ngombana izingulube zabo zazikhulu khulu kunaleli lizwe laseGiliyadi.
Kwathi lapho uSawule engumkani, baphuma behlasela amaHagirithi, bababulala, bahlala ezitezi zabo, ngaso soke isiqhingi saseGiliyadi esisempumalanga.
Bahlala ezweni laseBhashani, kuze kube yiSalekha, isizwe sikaGadi.
UYoweli wayeyinhloko, noShafamu ube yisibili, noJanani noShafati eBhashani.
Abazalwane babo, ngomndeni wabo: uMikayeli, noMeshulamu, noShebha, noYorai, noYahan, noZiha, noHebhere; bonke babeyisithupha.
Babo oonyana baka-Abhihayeli, indodana kaHuri, indodana kaJaroa, indodana kaGileyadi, indodana kaMikayeli, indodana kaYeshishayi, indodana kaYaho, indodana kaBuzi.
U-Ahi unyana ka-Abdiyeli, unyana ka-Guni, waba nguMengameli wemindeni sabo.
Bahlala eGiliyadi, naseBhashani, namadolobhana ayo, nakwazo zonke izifunda zaseSharon, kuze kube yilapho befika khona.
Bonke labo babhalwa encwadini yomndeni kaJothamu ukumkani wakwaYuda, noYarobhoamu ukumkani wakwaSirayeli.

NaseRubheni, naseGadi, nengxenye yesifundazwe sikaManase, kwaba ngamaphesenti angama-44 amakhulu mane, anamakhulu ayisishiyagalombili namashumi amathandathu, abantu abanobukhazikhazi obukhulu, abathwala isibhakabhaka nesikhefu, nabashaya umcibisholo; bonke baqeqeshiwe empilweni.
Baye bahlasela amaHagirithi, namaJethuri, namaNafishi, namaNodabi.
uzimu wabasiza empilweni sabo, wabeka esidlangalaleni amaHagirithi nalabo bonke abaye basebenza nabo; ngenxa yokuthi bekhala kuThixo emdlalweni, begodu ikosi wabaphendula, ngombana babethembele kuye.
Bathatha izilwane zakwaHagari, izinkomo ezingu-50, nezimbuzi eziyinkulungwane ezimbili namashumi amahlanu, namabhungane angama-2; begodu bathathe abantu abangaphezu kukakhulu elilodwa lamakhulu.
Abazobi abaningi babulawa, ngombana ukulwa kwakuwuNkulunkulu. Bahlala kulolu mhlaba kuze kube sekuphele ukuboshwa kwabo.
Ingxenye yesizwe sikaManase yahlala kulolu mhlaba, yakhula ikhule, yasuka eBhashani iye eBaale-Hermon, neSenire, nasentaba iHermon.
Lawa abaholi bemindeni sabo: u-Epher, no-Ishi, no-Eliyeli, no-Azriyeli, no-Yeremiya, no-Hodaviya, no-Yahediyeli; labo babemadodana amakhulu, abantu abadumile, abehluleli bezindlu zabo.
Baye bakwenza okumbi kuThixo wabababa babo, belandela izitha zezizwe zezwe, labo ikosi abewabulala phambi kwabo.

uzimu wakwaSirayeli wavusa uPul, ukumkani wase-Ashuri, okuthiwa nguTiglatha-pilesere, ukumkani wase-Ashuri. Wathatha amakhosikazi kaRubhen, namadodakazi kaGadi, kanye nengxenye yomkhosi kaManase, waya eHala, noHabori, noHara, noMfula iGozani, kuze kube namuhla.
Oonyana bakaLevi: uGershoni, noKohati, noMerari.
Oonyana bakaKohati: uAmram, no-Izhar, no-Hebron, no-Uziyeli.
Oonyana baka-Amram: u-Aron, noMoses, noMiriam; oonyana ka-Aron: uNadabhi, no-Abihu, no-Eleazar, no-Ithamari.
U-Eleazare waba ubaba kaPhinehasi, begodu Phinehasi waba ubaba kaAbishuwa.
U-Abishua ube ngubaba ka-Bukki. U-Bukki ube ngubaba ka-Uzzi.
U-Uzi waba ngumzali kaZerahiya, no-Zerahiya waba ngumzali kaMeraiothi.
UMeraiothi waba ubaba ka-Amariya; u-Amariya waba ubaba ka-Ahitubhi.
U-Ahitubhu waba ubaba kaSadoko, no-Sadoko waba ubaba ka-Ahimaase.
U-Ahimaas waba ubaba ka-Azariya, no-Azariya waba ubaba ka-Yohanan.
UJohhanan ube ngubaba ka-Azariya, owayesebenza njengombhishobhi ethempelini likaSolomoni eYerusalem.
UAzariya waba ngumzali ka-Amariya, u-Amariya waba ngumzali ka-Ahitubhu.
U-Ahitubhu waba ubaba kaSadoki, no-Sadoki waba ubaba kaShalumu.
UShalumu waba ubaba kaHilkiya; uHilkiya waba ubaba kaAzariya.
UAzariya waba ubaba kaSeraya, noSeraya waba ubaba kaYozadaka.
Uthethwe uYosadaki waba ngumuntu oqashiwe, lapho ikosi ethumela khona abantu baseYuda nabaseJerusalema emgodini kaNabukodonozor.
Oonyana bakaLawi: uGershoni, noKohati, noMerari.
Lawona amagama oonyana bakaGershoni: uLibni noShimehi.
Oonyana bakaKohati: uAmram, no-Izhar, no-Hebron, no-Uziyeli.
Oonyana bakaMerariya: uMahli noMushi. Lokho kungenxa yezindlu zakwaLevi, ngokuya ngemindeni sabo.
Abantwana bakaGershoni: uLibni unyana wakhe, noYahati unyana kaLibni, noZima unyana kaYahati,
noYowa unyana kaZima, noIdo unyana kaYowa, noZeraha unyana kaZeraha, noYeterai unyana kaZeraha.
Abantwana bakaKohati: u-Aminadabhi unyana wakhe, no-Kora unyana ka-Aminadabhi, no-Asiri unyana ka-Kora,
uElkana ikosi ka-Asire, noEbyasaphe ikosi ka-Elkana, noAsiri ikosi ka-Ebyasaphe,
UTahati unyana ka-Asiri, noUriyeli unyana ka-Tahati, noUziya unyana ka-Uriya, noShawuli unyana ka-Uziya.
Oonyana baka-Elkana: uAmasai noAhimothi.
Abantwana baka-Elkana: uZofai unyana wakhe, noNahati unyana kaZofai,
UElibha unyana kaNahati, noYerohamu unyana kaElibham, noElkana unyana kaYerohamu.
Oonyana baka-Samuweli: uJoyele, owayengumzali wakhe, noAbiha, owayengumunye.
Oonyana bakaMerari: uMahli, noLibni unyana kaMahli, noShimehi unyana kaShimehi, noUza unyana kaShimehi,
noShimea unyana kaUza, noHagiya unyana kaShimea, noAsaya unyana kaHagiya.
Baye labo abeka uDavide abaphathi bezingoma ethempelini likaYehova, ngemuva kokuba ibhokisi lithole indawo yokuphumula.
Basebenza bahlala phambi kwendlu kaYehova, esitezi sokubambisana, kuze kube wusuku lapho uSolomone ekwakha khona indlu kaYehova eYerusalem; basebenzela umsebenzi wabo ngokuhlukana kwabo.
Lawa amadoda asebenzela, nabangane babo. Emndenini wakwaKohati kwaba nguHeman umculi, unyana kaYoweli, unyana kaSamuweli,
indodana kaElkana, indodana kaYerohamu, indodana kaEliyeli, indodana kaToha,
unyana ka-Zuphi, unyana ka-Elkana, unyana ka-Mahati, unyana ka-Amasai,
indodana ka-Elkana, indodana ka-Yoweli, indodana ka-Azariya, indodana ka-Zefaniya,
unyana kaTahathi, unyana ka-Asiri, unyana ka-Ebyashafi, unyana kaKora,
indodana ka-Izhar, indodana ka-Kohati, indodana kaLevi, indodana kaSirayeli.
Wahlala ngakwesokudla kwakhe uAsaphe, umngane kaHeman; uAsaphe ube ngunyana kaBerekiya, unyana kaShimea,
unyana ka-Mikayeli, unyana ka-Baaseya, unyana ka-Malkiya,
unyana ka-Ethni, unyana ka-Zerah, unyana ka-Adaiah,
unyana kaEthane, unyana kaZima, unyana kaShimeyi,
unyana kaJahati, unyana kaGershoni, unyana kaLevi.
Ngakwesobunxele kukaHeman, kwabekhona abazalwane babo abasuka emndenini wakwaMerari; umholi wabo uEthan, indodana kaKishi, indodana kaAbdi, indodana kaMaluku;
unyana kaHashabiya, unyana kaAmasiya, unyana kaHilkiya,
indodana ka-Amzi, indodana ka-Bani, indodana ka-Shemer,
indodana kaMahli, indodana kaMushi, indodana kaMerari, indodana kaLevi.
Abazalwane babo, amaLevi, babe nemisebenzi yonke yendlu kaThixo, esitezi esiphezulu.

U-Aron nonyana bakhe banikela emgodini womnikelo wokushiswa, begodu basindisa uvumba emgodini womlilo, besenza yonke imisebenzi yendawo engcwele khulu, enza ukuxoshwa kwabaSirayeli, ngokwemithetho kaMoses umkhonzi kaThixo.
Lokho umndeni ka-Aron: uEleyazare unyana wakhe, noPhinehase unyana ka-Eleyazare, noAbishuwa unyana ka-Phinehase,
uBukhi unyana ka-Abishuwa, noUzi unyana ka-Buki, noZerahiya unyana ka-Uzi,
uMeraiothi unyana kaZerahiya, noAmariya unyana kaMeraiothi, noAhitubhu unyana kaAmariya,
noSadoko unyana ka-Ahitubhi, noAhimahazi unyana ka-Ahitubi.
Lezi ziyizindawo ezihlala kuzo izingane zika-Aron, ezindaweni zokuhlala zezwe labo. Izingane zika-Aron, ezisuka kumndeni wakwa-Kehati, zathola inkontileka yazo ngesinqumo.
Wabanika iHebroni, ezweni likaYuda, nezindawo zayo zokudlela ezijikeleze.
Izindawo ezisendaweni zomhlaba kanye nezifundela ezijikeleze lo dolobhana, zanikezwa uKalebe unyana kaJefune.
Wabanika oonyana baka-Aron iHebroni, isixeko sokuzivikela, neLibna, neYatiri, ne-Eshtemoa, ngazo zonke izifunda zayo,
iHilen neDebiri, ngayinye namagatsha ayo;
ne-Ashan, ne-Beth-shemesh, ngayinye inendawo yayo yokudla.
Ezweni likaBhenjamin, iGebha nezindawo zayo zokudlela, ne-Alemethi ne-Anathothi; zonke izizwe zesiKahati zathola izidolobhana ezilishumi elinamithathu.
Okunye kwamadodana kaKahati kwaba yizindawo ezingu-10, ezakhiwe ngezinhlanga zengxenye yesizwe sikaManase.
Namadodana kaGershoni, ngokwemindeni sabo, athola ezweni lika-Issakare, nezwe lika-Asere, nezwe likaNaphtali, kanye nengxenye yezwe likaManase eBhashani, idolobhana elilodwa nesithathu.
Namadodana kaMerari, ngokwenkundla sabo, athola izizwe ezilishumi elinambini, ezweni likaRubhen, nasezweni likaGadi, nasezweni likaZebulun.
Bathi ke abazalwane bakaSirayeli banikeza amaLevi la madolobhana kanye nezifunda zawo.
Babanikela ngazo izizwe zakwaYuda, nakwaSimeoni, nakwaBhenjamin, izidolobhana ezishiwo ngegama labo.
Ezinye izizwe zesiKahati zathola imiphakathi esuka ezindleleni zikaEphrayimi.
Wabanikeza iShekhem, idolobhana losizo, ezindaweni eziphakeme zakwaEphrayim, neGezeri, ngalinye linezindawo zayo zokuhlala;
ne-Yokmeam, ne-Beth-horon, ngazo zonke izihlahla zayo;
ne-Ayaloni, neGathi-rimoni; ngayinye inendawo yayo yokudlela.
Engxenyeni yesizwe sikaManase, kwabe sekusele imindeni yamaKahati: uAner noBhileham, ngaye ngamunye nezindawo zakhe zokudla.
Nakwabenzi-Gershoni, kwaba yimiphakathi elandelayo: Emndenini wengxenye yesizwe sikaManase, iGolani eBhashani, neAshtarothi, ngazo zonke izifunda zayo.
Esifundazweni sika-Issakha, iKedesh neDaberathi, ngazo zonke izifunda zayo;
neRamothi, ne-Anem, ngayinye nezindawo zayo zokudlela.
Ezweni lika-Asere: iMashale noAbdon, ngalinye nezindawo zayo zokudlela;
neHukok, neRehobho, ngayinye inendawo yayo yokudla.
Esifundazweni sakwaNaphtali: iKedesh eGalilile, neHamoni, neKiriyatayim; ngayinye yazo izifunda zayo.
Amanye amaLevi, oonyana bakaMerariya, bathola ezweni likaZebulun: iRimono neTabhori, ngazo zonke izifunda zayo.
Ezweni lakwaRubheni, ngasenyakatho yeJordani ebhekene neJericho: iBeseri esiqhingini, neYahaza; ngaso soke isizwe izintaba zayo;
kanye neKedemothi, neMefaathi, ngayinye inendawo yayo yokudla.
Esifundazweni sikaGadi: iRamothi eGileyadi, neMahanayim; ngayinye sazo sinemifula yayo;
neHeshboni, neYazeri, ngayinye nezindawo zayo zokudla.
Waba nguIssakhar oonyana abangu-ne: uThola, noPua, noYashubu, noShimron.

Oonyana baka-Tola: uUzi, noRefaya, noYeriyeli, noYamai, noIbsham, noShemuweli; labo babe yinhloko yamakhaya abo emndenini ka-Tola, abantu abanothando olukhulu. Ezikhathini zikaDavide imindeni sabo yaba ngamaphesenti angamashumi amabili nambili anamakhulu ayisishiyagalombili.
Unyana ka-Uzi ngu-Izrahiya; unyana ka-Izrahiya ngu-Mikayeli, no-Obadiya, no-Yoweli, no-Ishiyaha; bonke abahlanu babe ngabakhulu.
Umlando wabo womndeni ubonisa bona babe namadoda angama-36 alungiselelwe umkhosi, ngombana babenezifazane nezingane eziningi.
Abazalwane babo, phakathi kwezizwe zonke zakwa-Issakhar, abantu abanamandla okulwa; bonke labo ababhaliswe ngomndeni wabo babe ngamaphesenti ayishumi nesishiyagalombili namakhulu asithoba.
UBhenjamin wayenezingane amathathu: uBela, noBekhere, noJediayeli.
UBela wayenezingane eziyisishiyagalombili: u-Ezbon, noUzi, noUzieli, noJerimothi, noIri; babe yibo abakhulu bemindeni sabo, abantu abanobukhazikhazi obukhulu.
Oonyana bakaBekheri: uZemira, noYoashi, noEliyezeri, noEliyonani, noOmri, noYeremote, noAbiha, noAnathothi, noAlemethe; labo bonke babe oonyana bakaBekheri.
Izinkontileka zabo zomndeni zidlulisa izikhulu zemindeni sabo kanye namaphesenti angama-20, amawaka angu-200 okulwa.
Unyana kaJediyayeli nguBhilahan; unyana kaBhilahan nguJeush, noBenjamin, noEhud, noKenana, noZethan, noTarshish, noAhisahar.
Ngabo bonke oonyana bakaJediayeli, abaphathi bezindlu zabazali babo, kwaba ngumakhulu asixhenxe aneshumi nesishiyagalombili amawaka namakhulu amabili anamandla amakhulu angaphuma emkhosini.
U-Shuphim no-Huppim babe yizingane zika-Ir; u-Hushim ube yindodana ka-Aher.
Oonyana bakaNaphethali: uJahaziyeli, noGuni, noJezeri, noShalumu; laba bazalwa nguBhila.
UManase wazalwa ngu-Asriyeli, umfazi wase-Aram; naye wazala uMakhire, owayengubaba kaGileyadi.
UMakhire wathatha indodakazi emndenini wamaHuphimi, nomndenini wamaShupimi; igama lenkosikazi yakhe lakunguMahaka; begodu igama lowesifazane wakhe lalinguZelofehadi.
UMahara indodana kaMakhire wazala unyana, wathi igama lakhe nguPereshe. Igama lomyeni wakhe bekunguSheresh; oonyana bakhe babe nguUlam noRakemu.
Unyana ka-Ulam, uBedan. Lokho kwakuyindodana kaGileyadi, indodana kaMahiri, indodana kaManase.
UHamolekhethi, udadewabo kaGileyadi, wazala uIshodi, noAbiezer, noMahla.
Oonyana baka-Shemida: uAhiya, noShekem, noLikhi, noAniyam.
Amadodana kaEphrayimi: uShutela unyana wakhe, noBerede unyana kaShutela, noTahata unyana kaBerede, noEleada unyana kaTahata, noTahata unyana kaEleada;
UZabadi unyana kaTahathi, noShutela unyana kaZabadi; no-Ezeri no-Elehadi, oonyana bakaEfraim, babulawa ngabantu baseGathi abazalwa kulolu lizwe, lapho bekhuphuka bezibulala izinkomo zabantu.
UEfrayim, ubaba wabo, waba nomsindo ngenxa sabo iminyaka eminingi; kwafika nabangane bakhe bona bamphikisise.
Wahlangana nomfazi wakhe begodu, wakhulelwa, wazalelwa unyana; wathi igama lakhe nguBeriya, ngenxa yobuhlungu obukhona emndenini wakhe.
Unkosikazi ka-Ephrayi uShera; yena wakwakha iBethe-horon ephansi nephezulu, noUzen-Shera.
Amadodana kaBeriya: uRefa ikosi yakhe, noReshefi ikosi yakhe, noTela ikosi yakhe, noTahani ikosi yakhe,
uLadani unyana kaTahani, noAmihudi unyana kaLadani, noElishama unyana kaAmihudi,
UNun unyana kaElishama, noYoshuwa unyana kaNun.

Umhlaba wabo, izindlu zabo, waba nguBhethele nezindawo zayo ezincane, noNaaran enyakatho, noGezere enyakatho nezindawo zayo ezincane, noShekheme nezindawo zakhe ezincane, kuze kube yi-Aza nezindawo zake.
Nasezindaweni zakwaManase: iBhethe-shean, neTaanakhi, neMegido, neDore, nezifundela zawo; izingane zikaYosefu, unyana kaSirayeli, zazihlala ezifundazweni zalo.
Oonyana baka-Ashere: u-Imna, no-Ishwa, no-Ishivi, no-Beriya; umngane wabo nguSera.
Oonyana bakaBeriya: uHebhere, noMalkhiyeli, owayengubaba kaBirsayi.
UHebhere waba ngumzali kaYaflethi, noShomeri, noHothami, noShua umkakhe.
Oonyana bakaJaflethi: uPasha, noBimhali, noAshwathi; labo bayizindodana kaJaflethi.
Oonyana bakaShomer: uAhi, noRoha, noHubha, noAram.
Oonyana bakaHelemu, udadewabo: uZofa, no-Imna, no-Sheleshe, no-Amali.
Oonyana bakaSofa: uSuha, noHarnefere, noShuhali, noBeri, noImra,
iBezer, neHod, neShama, neShilshah, neIthran, neBhera.
Oonyana bakaJethere: uJefune, noPispa, noAhara.
Abantwana baka-Ulla babe nguArah, uHanniel, noRizia.

Lawa madodana ka-Asheri, abaholi bezindlu zababa babo, abezinja ezinamandla zokulwa, abaqondisi abanekhono. Amanani abo emindenini sabo ayeyizigidi eziyisishiyagalombili nesishiyagalolunye, abantu abakwaziyo ukungena emkhosini.
Unyana kaBhenjamin omkhulu kwaba nguBela. Owesibili waba nguAshbele, wesithathu waba nguAhara,
uNoha owakwesine, noRafa owamashumi amane.
Oonyana bakaBela: uAdare, noGera, noAbihude,
u-Abishuwa, noNaamani, no-Ahoha,
uGera, noShefufan, noHiram.
Lawa madodana ka-Ehud, abe yibo abakhulu bemindeni uhlala eGibeha, abathunyelwe eManahati.
UNamane, no-Ahiya, no-Gera; u-Gera waba ngumzali ka-Uza no-Ahihud.
UShaharayime waba nezingane ezweni lakwaMowabi, ngemuva kokuthi ashiye izifazane zakhe, uHushimu noBaara.
NgoHodeshe indodana yakhe, wazala uYobhab, noSibiya, noMesha, noMalkham,
UJehuzi, noShakiya, noMirma; labo babe yindodana yakhe, bebengabakhulu bezindlu zakwababa.
Ngo-Hushime waba no-Abitub no-Elpaali.
Oonyana baka-Elpaali: uHebhere, noMisham, noShemede. UShemede wakwakha iOno, neLodi, nezifunda zawo.
UBeriya noShema babe yinhloko yamakhaya abahlala e-Ayaloni; bona bakhipha abantu baseGathi.
no-Ahiya, no-Shashaki, no-Yeremota,
uZebadia, noAradi, noEdere,
UMikayeli, no-Ishpa, no-Yoha, babe yizingane zikaBeriya.
uZebadia, noMeshulamu, noHizekiya, noHebhere,
U-Ishmerai, no-Izliya, no-Yobhab, babe yizingane zika-Elpaali.
noYakhimu, noZikri, noZabdi,
uEliyeni, noZilethai, noEliyeli,
U-Adaiah, no-Beraiah, no-Shimrath; labo bamadodana kaShimeyi.
u-Ishan, no-Ebheri, no-Eliyeli,
no-Abdon, no-Zikri, no-Hanani,
uHananiya, noElam, noAnothiya,
U-Ifediya no-Penuyeli babe yizingane zikaShashaki.
uShamsherai, noShehariya, noAthaliya,
UYareshiya, noEliya, noZikri, babe yizingane zikaYerohamu.
Bonke labo babe ngabaholi bezindlu zakwababa babo, ngokusho komlando wabo wemindeni sabo; bebengabaphathi; bahlala eYerusalem.
EGibeboni kwahlala uJeyeli, ubaba kaGibeboni; igama lesifazane sakhe lalinguMahaka.
Umzali wakhe wayenguAbdon. Okunye kwabantwana bakhe kwaba nguZure, noKishe, noBhaali, noNadabhi,
uGedori, noAhiya, noZekeri,
noMiklothi, ubaba kaShimea; bona nabo bahlala eduze kwabangane babo eYerusalem.
UNeri waba ubaba kaKishi; uKishi waba ubaba kaSawule; uSaule waba ubaba kaYonathani, noMalkishuha, noAbinabadi, no-Eshbhaali.
Unyana kaYonathani waba nguMeribi-bhaali; uMeribi-bhaali ube ngumzali kaMika.
Oonyana bakaMikha: uPithoni, noMeleki, noTareya, noAhaza.
UAhazi waba ubaba kaYehodada; uYehodada waba ubaba kaAlemethe, noAzmawethe, noZimri; uZimri waba ubaba kaMoza.
UMoza waba ubaba kaBineya; unyana kaBineya ube nguRafa, unyana kaRafa ube nguEleasa, unyana kaEleasa ube nguAseli.
Waba ngu-Aseli oonyana abangusithandathu; amagama abo wu-Azrikam, noBoheru, no-Ishmayeli, no-Shearya, no-Obadia, no-Hanan; labo bonke babe yizingane zika-Aseli.
Oonyana baka-Esheki, udadewabo, ngu-Ulam owayengumzali wakhe, no-Jeushi owesibili, no-Elifelethe wesithathu.
Amadodana ka-Ulam abe yimikhosi enamandla, akwazi ukubopha amabhubesi; babe nezingane eziningi nabangane abakhulu, abantu abangamakhulu amabili namahlanu. Lawo wonke amadodana kaBhenjamin.

Begodu bonke isizwe samaSirayeli bahlukaniswa ngezinhlanga zabo, begodu bona, lokhu kubhalwe encwadini yamaNdiya amaSirayeli. Namadodakazi kaYuda athathwe ezweni laseBhabheli, ngenxa yobugebengu babo.
Abantu bokuqala ababuyela ezweni labo, nasezindaweni zabo, babe yimiSirayeli ejwayelekile, nababhishobhi, nalabaLevi, nalabo abasebenza ethempelini.
Bakhona abantu abavela ezifundweni zakwaYuda, noBhenjamini, noEfraim, noManase, bahlala eYerusalem.
KwaYuda kwakunguUthai unyana ka-Amihude, unyana ka-Omri, unyana ka-Imri, unyana ka-Bani; waba yindodana kaPerezi, unyana kaJuda.
KwabeSiloni kwaba ngu-Asaya, umzali wakhe, naye nonyana bakhe.
Ngabo oonyana bakaZera, uYehuyeli; ngabo bonke abazalwane bakaYuda, kwaba ngumakhulu mane anamashumi asithoba.
Ezweni likaBhenjamin, uSalu unyana kaMeshulam, unyana kaHodaviya, unyana kaHasenuaha.
begodu u-Ibneya unyana kaYerohamu, no-Ela unyana kaUzi, unyana kaMikri, no-Meshulam unyana kaShefatiya, unyana kaRehuweli, unyana ka-Ibneya.
Nabangane babo, ngokubhaliswa kwemindeni sabo, kwaba ngumakhulu ayisishiyagalolunye, anamahlanu nesithupha; labo bonke babe yinhloko yamamndeni wabo.
Ngabo ababingeleli: uJedaya, noYoharibi, noYakini.
begodu uAzariya, indodana kaHilkiya, indodana kaMeshulamu, indodana kaTsadoki, indodana kaMerayothi, indodana ka-Ahitubhu; uAzariya wayengumphathi wendlu kaThixo.

Kwabekhona uAdaiah, indodana kaYerohamu, indodana kaPashure, indodana kaMalkiya; kwabekhona uMaasai, indodana kaAdiyeli, indodana kaJazera, indodana kaMeshulam, indodana kaMeshilemith, indodana kaImer.

Ngabo bonke ababhishobhi, abe yikhulu elilodwa nenkulungwane nesishiyagalolunye namashumi ayisithupha; babe ngabaholi bezindlu zababa babo, abantu abanolwazi oluhle khulu emisebenzini yokuphatha indlu kaThixo.
KwabeLevi kwakunguShemaya unyana kaHashubu, unyana kaAzrikam, unyana kaHashabhiya, umfazi waseMerariya.
begodu uBakbakar, noHeresh, noGalal, noMatania unyana kaMikha, unyana kaZikhri, unyana kaAsaphe.
Kwabekhona noObadiya unyana kaShemaya, unyana kaGalalu, unyana kaJeduthuni; kwabekhona noBerekiya unyana kaAsa, unyana kaElkana, owahlala ezindaweni zakwaNetophathi.
Abaphathi bezingcingo: uShalumu, no-Akubu, no-Talmoni, no-Ahimani, nabangane babo; uShalumu wayengumholi wabo.
Kusukela ngaleso sikhathi bahlala emgwaqweni wobukhosi osuka enyakatho, babe ngabaphathi bezindonga zesibhedlela samaLevi.

UShalumu unyana ka-Kore, unyana ka-Ebyashaphe, unyana ka-Kora; nabangani bakhe, omndeni wakhe, abakwa-Korahi, babe ngabaphathi beminyango yendlu yokuphumula; njengombana uyise wabo abephethe isikhundla sokuba ngabaphathi bokungena emgodini kaYehova.
Ngaleso sikhathi uPhinehasi, unyana ka-Eleazaru, wayeyisikhulu salabo abagcina isango; begodu ikosi waba naye.
UZekariya, unyana kaMeshelemiya, waba ngumphathi wesango emnyango wesitezi sokuhlangana.

Kwaba khona amadoda amashumi amabili aneshumi nambili, abakhethiwe ukuba abe ngamagoli emaphethelweni, begodu babhaliswa ngomndeni wabo ezindaweni zabo. UDavide noSamuweli okubonayo wabeka kubo izikhundla zabo.
Bathi ke, bona nabangane babo, babe abaphathi bezindonga zendlu kaYehova, ikhaya lesitezi.
Abagwebi babe ngakwesobunxele, ngakwesokudla, ngakwesokunxele, ngasentshonalanga, nasentshonalanga.
Abahlobo babo ezindaweni zabo babezofika ngasikhathi sinye begodu bahlukanise umsebenzi wabo ngezinsuku ezisixhenxe ngosuku.
Nabo abakhulu abangu-ne abaphathi bezindonga, labo abaLevi, babekwa phezu kwazo zonke izibhedlela nezindawo zokugcina izinto endlwini kaThixo.
Bahlala busuku bonke ethempelini likaThixo, ngombana bekufanele bayigcine, begodu bekufanele bayivule ekuseni.
Baningi kubo abebephethe izinto ezisetshenziswayo emkhondweni, bezibala lapho zifakwa khona, begodu lapho zikhishwa khona.
Abanye babekwa ngaphasi kwempahla, nakwezinye izinto ezingcwele zonke, nenyama ehlanzekile, newayini, nophethiloli we-olive, nofuzo, nezithako.
Kodwana abanye ababhishobhi babe yilabo abaxhuma izithelo.
Kwabe kukhona uLevi okuthiwa nguMatithiya, umzali kaShalumu waseKora, owabekwa ukubhaka inkomishi yomnikelo wokudla.
Ezinye zazo izihlobo zabo, ezisuka emndenini wakwa-Kehati, zaziphethe ukulungiselela ubisi olungcwele ngeSabhati ngalinye.
Bakhona abaculi, abaholi bezindlu zakwaLevi; bahlala ezindlini zendlu kaThixo, bengenamsebenzi othile, ngombana babe nemisebenzi sabo ekuseni nasebusuku.
