Bonke labo babe ngabaholi bezindlu zakwaLevi, ngokusho komlando wabo wemindeni sabo; bebengabaphathi; bahlala eYerusalem.
EGibeboni kwahlala uJeyeli, ubaba kaGibeboni; igama lesifazane sakhe lalinguMahaka.
Umfazi wakhe uAbdon, nabangane bakhe nguZuri, noKishi, noBahali, noNeri, noNadab,
noGedori, noAhiyo, noZekariya, noMiklothi.
UMiklothi waba ubaba kaShimeam; nabo bahlala ndawonye nabangane babo eYerusalem.
UNeri waba ubaba kaKishi; uKishi waba ubaba kaSawule; uSaule waba ubaba kaYonathani, noMalkishuha, noAbinabadi, no-Eshbhaali.
Unyana kaYonathani waba nguMeribi-bhaali; uMeribi-bhaali ube ngumzali kaMika.
Oonyana bakaMikha: uPithoni, noMeleki, noTareha, noAhazi.
UAhazi waba ubaba kaJara; uJara waba ubaba kaAlemethe, no-Azmavethe, noZimri; uZimri waba ubaba kaMoza.
UMoza waba ngumzali kaBineya; uBineya ubengumntwana kaRefaya, uRefaya ubengumntwana kaEleasa, uEleasa ubengumntwana kaAseli.
Waba ngu-Aseli oonyana abangusithandathu; amagama abo wu-Azrikam, no-Bokheru, no-Ishmayeli, no-Shearya, no-Obadiya, no-Hanan. Babo oonyana ka-Aseli.
Bahlasela amaFilisti amadoda aseSirayeli; amadoda aseSirayeli esuka phambi kwabo, babulawa abantu abaningi emfuleni iGilboa.
Balandela amaFilisti uSawule nezingane zakhe, babulala uYonathani no-Abinabadi no-Malkishuha, izingane zikaSawule.
Ukulwa kwabe kunzima khulu ngaseSauli. Amadodana ka-Abhisalome ayemthola, wagwema.

Wathi uSawule kulowo wesifazane ogqoke isibhamu sakhe, Nciphisa isandla sakho, bulala ngaso; ngombana uma ungakwenza lokhu, bangafika labo abangenakutholwa ikhanda, bangisindise; kodwana lowo wesifazane wakhathazeka khulu ukuba akwenze njalo. Wathatha uSawule isandla sakhe, wehla kuso.
Wabona umthwali wezikhali bona uSawule usefile, wavuka waya ekhephuni lakhe, wafa.
Wafa uSawule, nabantwana bakhe abathathu; nomndeni wakhe wonke waba mnyama.
Babona bonke amadoda aseSirayeli asendaweni yaseGileyadi bona abantu baphuma, begodu bona uSawule nezingane zakhe zifile, bashiya amadolobhana abo, babaleka; kwafika amaFilisti, bahlala kiwo.
Kwathi ngosuku olulandelayo, lapho befika khona amaFilisti ukuze bagqoke abafileyo, bathola uSawule nezingane zakhe zilele emfuleni iGilboa.
Bathatha ikhanda lakhe, nempahla yakhe yokuzivikela; bathumela abantu ezweni lonke labaseFilisti, bona bathuthuzele amatshe abo, nomphakathi wabo.
Babeka izikhali zakhe ethempelini likaThixo wabo, bamisa ikhanda lakhe ethempelini likaDagon.
Bathe bonke abantu baseYabhesi-Gileyadi beva bona abaFilisti bakwenzani noSawule,

Bahamba bonke abantu abanamandla, bathatha isidumbu sikaSawule nesibindi samadodana akhe, bazisa eYabheshi; bafihla amathambo abo ngezansi kwe-tabernakulum eYabheshi, bachitha amalanga ezisixhenxe bengenakudla.
Wafa uSawule, ngenxa yokuthi wakhohlisa ikosi; ngombana akhenge alalele ilizwi likaNkulunkulu, kodwana wabuza indodana yowesifazane okhuluma ngezinkanyezi.
Ngalokho ikosi wambulala, wabeka ukumkani kuDavide, unyana kaYese.
Bahlangana bonke isiSirayeli kuDavide eHebroni, bathi, Thola, thina sigazi lakho nonyama wakho.

Ngaleso sikhathi, nalapho uSawule engumnikazi khona, wena ubewukhiphayo uSirayeli, wababuyiselayo; begodu ikosi uzimu wakho wathi kuwe, Uzophatha abantu bami baseSirayeli; nawe uzobe ngummengameli phezu kwabantu bam baseSirayeli.

Bafika khona bonke abakhulu bakaSirayeli kukumkani uDavide eHebroni, wakwenza khona uDavide umhlangano nabo phambi koYehova; bamwisa waba ngukumkani phezu kwaSirayeli, njengokuthi ikosi wathi ngamazwi kaSamuweli.
Wahamba uDavide, naye wonke amaSirayeli, waya eYerusalem (iJerusalema libizwa bona yi-Yebush), lapho behlala khona abaJebhusi.
Bathi abantu baseJebhusi kuDavide, Uzongena lapha kangako; kodwana uDavide wathatha isakhiwo esiqinile saseSiyone, begodu sabizwa bona yidolobha likaDavide.
UDavide wathi, "Uma umuntu ehlasela amaJebhusi, kufanele abe nguMengameli weqembu." UYowabhi unyana kaZeruhiya waphuma kuqala, waba nguMengameli.
UDavide wahamba waya esitezi esiphakeme, sabizwa bona yidolobha likaDavide.
Wakwakha idolobha ngaso soke isikhathi, kusukela eMilo kuya kuyo yonke indawo; begodu uYowabhi walungisa isibopho sedolobha.
UDavide waqhubeka ekhula, waba mkhulu; begodu ikosi wemikhosi waye naye.
Baye labo abakhulu phakathi kwamadoda amakhulu anamandla, ayenawo uDavide; nabo bonke amaSirayeli babe nesandla esiqinile kuye, ukuba abe ngukumkani wakhe, njengokuthi ikosi wathi kuSirayela.
Lokho wuhlu lwamabhishobhi anamandla kaDavide: uYashubham, owaseHakmoni, owayengumholi wabathathu. Wasebenzisa isithunywa sakhe, wabulala abantu abangumakhulu amathathu emdlalweni owodwa.
Walandela ngawo uEleazaru, unyana kaDodo wase-Ahohi, owayengumunye wabanqobi abakhulu abathathu.
Waye noDavide ePasdamini, lapho abaFilisti behlangana khona ukubhekana nempi; bekukhona khona indawo egcwele imbewu yeshubhu; begodu isizwe samaSirayeli sahamba phambi kwabaFilisti.
U-Elazare noDavide bahlala phakathi kwendawo, beyivikela, babulala amaFilisti; begodu ikosi wabanika ukusindisa okukhulu.
Baphuma abathathu kubo bonke abaholi abamashumi amathathu, bafika kuDavide esihlalweni esigabeni sase-Adulam; begodu amaFilisti ayesesitezi esiseNtaba yamaRefayi.
Wayekhona uDavide esitezi esiphakeme, begodu amaFilisti ayeseBethelehemu.
UDavide wafuna amanzi, wathi, Uma ngabe kukhona umuntu ongenza ngiphuze amanzi emfuleni waseBethelehemu, ogwini lwesango.

Lawa madoda amathathu ahlasela amaFilisti, wageza amanzi emgodini waseBethelehemu, wayalela uDavide; kodwana uDavide akakwazanga ukuwudla, wathi: "Uzowudonsa kukaNkulunkulu." Wathi uSawule: "Kulungile, ngikubonile, begodu ngikubone.

Wathi uDavide, "Ungilungise uzimu bona ngikwenze lokhu! Ngizodla yini igazi lalabo bantu abathathele impilo sabo engozini?" Ngokuba bathatha impilo sabo engozini ukulithola, uDavide akhenge alidle. Lokhu kwakungumsebenzi onamandla wale mikhosi emithathu.
U-Abhishai, udade kaYowabhi, waba nguMengameli wabo bonke abathathu. Wasebenzisa isibhamu sakhe wabulala abantu abangumakhulu amathathu; waba negama phakathi kwabo bobabili.
Wabe uhlonishwa khulu kunabanye ababini abathathu, waba ngumphathi wabo, kodwana akayena owodwa kubo bobabili.

U-Benaya, unyana ka-Yehodaya, owayengumuntu onamandla khulu, wakwenza imisebenzi emikhulu eKabtseeli. Wabulala amadoda amakhulu amabini aseMowabhi, waphuma emgodini ngesikhathi sekhephu, wabulala ingulube.

Wabulala umYiputa, owayemde khulu, amamitha ayisishiyagalombili namashumi amane. UmYiputa wayenesihluku esiqinile njengenkomishi yombukiso; kodwana uBhenaya waya kuye enesibhakabhaka kuphela, wathatha ihluku esandla somYiputa, wambulala ngalo.
Lezo zizinto ezidume khulu zikaBhenaya, unyana kaYehoyada; wafumana igama phakathi kwalabo abakhulu abathathu.
Waba mkhulu ukudlula abamashumi amathathu, kodwana akhenge abe ngumunye wabathathu. UDavide wambeka engqondweni sabo bonke abantu bakhe.
Kwabekho namadoda amakhulu, afana no-Asaheli udade kaYowabhi; no-Elhanani unyana kaDodo waseBethelehemu;
uShamothi umHarori, noHelezi umPeloni;
u-Ira unyana ka-Ikeshe waseTekoa, no-Abiezer waseAnathothi;
uSibhekai waseHushathi, noElai waseAhohi;
uMaharayi waseNetofa, noHeledi unyana kaBaana waseNetofa;
UIthai unyana kaRibhayi, waseGibeha eBhenjamini; noBenaya wasePirathoni;
uHurai, osuka ezindongeni zeGaashe; uAbiyeli umArbati;
uAzmavethi waseBaharumi, noEliabha waseShaalboni;
Oonyana bakaHashemi umGizoni; uYonathani indodana kaShagi, umHarani;
u-Ahiyamu, indodana ka-Sakare waseHara; u-Eliphali, indodana ka-Ure;
uHepher waseMekerathi, noAhiya wasePeloni;
uHezero waseKarmeli, noAyarayeli unyana ka-Ezbai;
uJoyele, umngane kaNathani; noMibhare, unyana kaHagri;
uZeleki umAmoni, noNaharayi waseBherothi, ophethe izikhali zikaYowabhi unyana kaZeruhiya;
uIra umYithrithi; uGarebhi umYithrithi;
uUriya umHithi, noZabadi unyana ka-Ahali;
U-Adina unyana kaShisha, waseRubheni, owayengumholi wamaRubheni; naye wayenendodana emashumi amathathu.
uHanani unyana kaMahaka, noYoshafati umMithini;
UUziya wase-Ashtarothi, noShama noJeyeli, oonyana bakaHothamu base-Aroeri;
uJediyayeli unyana kaShimri, noJoha umngane wakhe waseTizi;
uEliyeli waseMahabhi, noYeribayi noYoshaviya, oonyana baka-Elnaamu, noIthama waseMoabi;
uEliyeli, noObedi, noYasiyele waseMezobhayi.
Lawa amadoda afike kuDavide eSikelage, lapho efihla khona ngenxa kaSawule unyana kaKishi; babe phakathi kwamadoda amakhulu asiza uDavide emkhosini.
Babe begqoke izibhamu, begodu bakwazi ukushaya izinhlamvu noma ukubamba amatshe ngesandla sabo sokudla noma sesobunxele. Beyilungu lemindeni kaSawule eyisizwe sikaBhenjamin.
Waba ngu-Ahiezer umholi wabo, noYoashi unyana ka-Shemaya waseGibeha; no-Iziyeli no-Peleti unyana ka-Azmavethi; no-Beraka; no-Yehu owaseAnathothi;
U-Ishmaya waseGibeboni, owayengumuntu onamandla phakathi kwabathathu, waba nguMengameli wabothathu; noYeremiya, noYahaziyeli, noYohanani, no-Yozabadi waseGedara;
u-Eluzayi, no-Yerimothi, no-Behaliya, no-Shemariha, no-Shefatiya umHarufi;
nakwa-Elkana, no-Ishiya, no-Azareli, no-Yozere, no-Yashobham, abaKori;
noYoyela, noZebadia, oonyana bakaYerohamu baseGedori.

Kwaba khona namadoda athile ezweni laseGadi, wahlangana naye uDavide emgodini wakhe esiqhingini. Babantu abadumile khulu(a) abaqeqeshiwe ukubhekana nokulwa, abakwaziyo ukusebenzisa isibhakabhaka nesibhakabhaka; begodu isikhumba sabo safana nesikhumba sengulube, begodu bahamba ngokushesha njengama-gazels emadolobheni.
u-Ezere waba nguMengameli, no-Obhadiya ube yisibili, no-Elihabhi ube wesithathu,
Mishmannah wesithathu, uYeremiya wesithupha,
uAtayi wesishiyagalombili, uEliyeli wesishiyagalolunye,
uYohanane wesishiyagalolunye, uElzabade wesithoba,
uYeremiya owamashumi amabili, noMakbannai owamashumi amathathu.
Lawa amadodana kaGadi, abe yibo abaphathi bemikhosi; umncane kubo wathatha abantu abangamashumi amabili, nomkhulu wabo waba nezigidi.
Badlula emfuleni iYorodani ngonyaka wokuthoma, lapho umlambo ugcwele zonke izintaba zakhe; bahlasela bonke abahlali ezindaweni ezisempumalanga nasezikhungweni.
Kwafika namanye amadoda asuka eBhenjamini naseYuda, waya kuDavide esitezi esiphakeme.

Waphuma uDavide, wabhekana nabo, wathi kubo, Uma nifika ngempilo, ukuze ningisize, ngizohamba nani; kodwana uma nifika bona ningifake ezimpi(i)ni, nakuba kungekho monakalo engiwenzayo, khona-ke uzimu wakwababa bethu angabona, agweme.

Wafika uMoya ku-Amasai, umholi wabo abathathu, wathi: Sikhona wena, uDavide; sikhona nawe, unyana kaYese. Ukuthula, ukuthula kuwe, nokuthula kubo bonke abakusizayo; ngombana uzimu wakho usiza wena. UDavide wabajabulela, wababeka njengezikhulu zamadodana akhe.

Kwaba khona nabanye abantu baseManase, ababeya kuDavide, lapho ehamba namaFilisti ukubhekana noSawule; kodwana uDavide namadodana akhe akhenge awasize amaFilisti. Ke kaloku abaphathi bamaFilisti baxoxa ngalokhu, wathumela kuye, bathi, Uma ebuyela kumnikazi wakhe uSawule, ngeke kube ngekhanda lethu.

Kwathi lapho uDavide ehamba eSikelage, kwafika naye amadoda asuka kuManase: uAdna, noYozabadhi, noYediayeli, noMikayeli, noYozabadhi, noElihu, noZilethai; wonke umuntu waba nguMengameli wamakhulu aseManase.
Basiza uDavide ukubhekana nalabo abahlaselayo, ngombana bonke babe ngamagoli anamandla kanye nabaphathi emikhosini yakhe.
Ngosuku nosuku kwafika abantu ukusiza uDavide, kuze kube khona umkhosi omkhulu kuye, njengemkhosi kaThixo.
Lawa amanani endodana yomndeni kaSawule, abafika kuDavide eHebroni, bona bayidlulise kuye ubukhosi bukaSawule, njengokuthi ikosi.
Ezweni lakwaYuda kwafika abantu abangumakhulu amathandathu, anamashumi ayisishiyagalombili abaqeqeshiwe emkhosini, bezigqoka amagilavu namatshe.
Ngabo-Simeoni kwafika amaphesenti ayishumi nesishiyagalombili, abantu abaqeqeshiwe empilweni.
KwaLevi kwaba ngumakhulu amane, anamakhulu ayisithupha.
UYehoyada, umphathi wendlu ka-Aron, wafika naye abantu abangumakhulu amathathu anamakhulu ayisishiyagalombili;
begodu uTsadoki, umfazi ongumnqobi onamandla, wafika, naye namadodana akhe amashumi amabili namabini.
NaseBhenjamini, isizwe sikaSawule, kwafika abantu abangu-elilodwa nenkulungwane amathathu; ngombana kwabaningi kubo ababehlala emndenini kaSawule.
Ku-Ephrayim bekukhona abantu abakhulu, abanomlando emiphakathini sabo, abangamaphesenti angamashumi amabili anamakhulu ayisishiyagalombili.
Engxenyeni yesizwe sikaManase kwafika abantu abangu-18, abakhethiwe ngegama, ukuba bafike babe ngukumkani uDavide.
Ezweni lika-Issakare bekukhona abaholi abangamakhulu amabili, abakwaziyo ukuqonda izingcezu zesikhathi, bona yini okufanele bayikwenze isiSirayeli; bonke abazalwane babo balandela umthetho wabo.
Ezweni likaZebuloni bekukhona amadoda amashumi amahlanu anamakhulu amahlanu, abantu abaqeqeshiwe empilweni, abanezinto zonke zokuzivikela; bonke babe yindodana kaDavide.
NgaseNaphtali kwaba ngukhulu elilodwa, namaphesenti amashumi amathathu nesishiyagalombili, abathwala amagobolondo namaphiko.
KwaDani kwaba ngamaphesenti angama-28 namaphesenti angama-600, alungiselelwe ukulwa.
Kusuka ku-Ashere kwafika amaphesenti angamashumi amane, abaqeqeshiwe empilweni.
Ngasenyakatho yeJordani, eRubheni nakwaGadi, nasengxenyeni yesizwe sikaManase, kwaba ngumakhulu amahlanu anamashumi amabini amawaka, agqoke zonke izinhlobo zezikhali.

Bonke labo bamadoda anamandla, abakwaziyo ukubhekana nempi. Bafika eHebroni, befuna khulu ukwenza uDavide ukumkani phezu kwabaSirayeli bonke. Nabo bonke abantu baseSirayeli babe nombono wokwenza uDavide ukumkani.
Bahlala khona noDavide amalanga amathathu, bedla nokuphuza; ngombana abazalwane babo babebalungiselelile ukudla.

Nalabo abasenyakatho sabo, kuze kube yi-Issakhar, noZebuloni, noNaphtali, babeletha ukudla ezimvuni, nezingulube, nezinkomo agqugquzelayo, namakhowe. Kwaba khona ubisi oluningi, namajikijolo, namakhowe, newayini, namafutha omnqumo, namakhowe, namakhowe afile; kwaba mnandi khulu eSirayeli.
UDavide wakhuluma ngalezo zinto namadodana akhe amakhulu, namadodana akhe amakhulu, nabantu bakhe bonke.

Wathi kubo bonke isibingelelo samaSirayeli, Uma kulungile emehlo wenu, uma kuyiNkosi ikosi uzimu wethu, sithumelele abafowethu nabangane bethu emazweni onke aseSirayeli, namabhishobhi namaLevi ezifundeni zabo nezifundazwe zazo, bona bafike nathi.
Ake siyibuyisele nathi ibhokisi likaThixo wethu, ngombana asizange siyifune lapho uSawule engumphathi.
Ingqungquthela yonke yavuma ukwenza lokhu, ngombana wonke umuntu wacabanga bona kuyinto efanele ukwenziwa.
UDavide waqoqa wonke amaSirayeli, kusukela emfuleni iShihore eYiputa, kuze kufike eHamati, ukuba athathe isibuko sikaThixo kusuka eKiriyati-yearim.

Wahamba uDavide, naye wonke amaSirayeli, waya eBhala (leyo yiKiriyati-yearimi yaseYuda), ukuba abuyisele ibhokisi likaYehova uzimu, ohlala phezu kweqhwa lakhe phakathi kwezikerubi, ibhokisi elibizwa ngegama lakhe.
Bathwala ibhokisi likaThixo emgodini omusha, besuka endlwini ka-Abinadaba; uUza noAhiyo babehamba ngomgodi.
UDavide namaSirayeli wonke bedlala phambi kukaThixo ngesandla sabo soke, ngokudlalwa kwama-harps, nama-lyras, nama-tamburins, nama-cymbals, nama-trumpets.
Bafika esitezi sokudla sika-Chidon, izingulube ziqhekekile; uUza waphakamisa isandla sakhe ukuba aqinise isithuthi.
UYehova wagwema khulu u-Uza, wambulala ngenxa yokuthi egqoke isibambo; waza wafa khona lapho phambi kukaThixo.
UDavide wagwema, ngenxa yokuthi ikosi wayewugweme uUza; ngalokho kwabizwa igama lesi sifundazwe bona iPerezi-Uza kuze kube manje.
UDavide wakhathazeka ngoNkulunkulu ngalolusuku, wathi, Ngabe ngizoyifaka kanjani ibhokisi likaThixo endlwini yami?
Ngalokho uDavide akayihambisanga ibhokisi kuye edolobhaneni likaDavide, wayisa endlwini ka-Obedi-edomu waseGathi.
Ibhokisi likaThixo lahlala emndenini ka-Obedi-edomu, ekhaya lakhe, iminyaka emithathu; begodu ikosi wabambisana nendlu ka-Obedi-edomo, nazo zonke izinto zakhe.
UHirame, ukumkani waseTire, wathumela abathunywa kuDavide, namatshe aseduzane, nabenzi bezindonga, nabenzi bamapulangwe, ukuba bamkhiphe indlu.
UDavide waqonda bona ikosi wamenza ukumkani phezu kwaSirayeli, begodu ukuba ubukumkani bakhe bukhulu ngenxa yabantu bakhe baseSirayeli.
UDavide washada namanye amabhishobhi eYerusalem, waba nezingane eziningi.
Lawona amagama abo abazalwa kuye eYerusalem: uShamua, noShobabu, noNathani, noSolomoni,
uIbhare, noElishuwa, noElpelethe,
uNoga, noNefegi, noYaphia,
noElishama, noBhiliyada, noElifelethe.
Kwathi lapho abaFilisti beva bona uDavide usayinwe ukumkani phezu kwamadodana kaSirayeli onke, bakhuphuka bonke abantu baseFilisti ukumlandela. UDavide wakwazi lokhu, waphuma wababheka.
Bafika amaFilisti, bahlasela iGoli lika-Refayi.
UDavide wabuza uzimu, wathi, Ngizoya ngihlasela amaFilisti? Ingabe uzobanikela phambi kwami? Waphendula ikosi wathi kuye, Yiya, ngibanikela phambi kwakho.

Waphuma uDavide namadodana akhe, wafika eBhaali-perazime, wababulala khona. UDavide wathi, "uzimu uphonsa izitha zami ngesandla sami, njengokuthi amanzi aphonsa ipayipi"; ngalokho kwabizwa igama lesi sifundazwe bona iBhaali-perazime.
Bashiya khona amaFilisti amadini abo, uDavide wabeka umthetho ukuba aqhume.
Baphinde bahlasela amaFilisti idolobhana.
UDavide wabuza uzimu. Wathi uzimu kuye, Ungawahlasela ngaphesheya; buyela emuva kwabo, uwahlasele ngaphesheya kwezintaba-mlilo.
Uma ubona umsindo wokuhamba ezindaweni eziphezulu zezintaba-mlilo, khona-ke uzophuma ukuhlasela; ngombana uzimu usephuma phambi kwakho, ukuze ahlasele amaFilisti.
Wakwenza uDavide njengokuthi uzimu wamwisela, wahlasela amaFilisti kusukela eGibeyon kuya eGezeri.
UDavide wafumana igama ezweni lonke, begodu ikosi wabangele ukukhathazeka ngaye kuzo zonke izizwe.
Wakha uDavide izindlu zakhe edolobhaneni likaDavide, walungiselela indawo yodoti kaThixo, wamisa itente layo.
Wathi uDavide, Akukho muntu ozothwala ibhokisi likaThixo ngaphandle kwabaLevi; ngombana labo abakhethiwe nguYehova ukuba bathwale ibhokisi likaNkulunkulu, ukuze basebenze naye kuze kube sekupheleni.
UDavide waqoqa wonke amaSirayeli eYerusalem, ukuba akhuphule ibhokisi likaYehova, lifike endaweni ayeyilungiselele.
Wabiza bonke abazalwane baka-Aron nalabaLevi, wathi:
Ezinganeni zikaKohati, uUriyeli owayengumholi, nabangane bakhe abangamakhulu amabili namahlanu.
Ngabo oonyana bakaMerariya, uAsaya owayengumholi, nabangane bakhe abangamakhulu amabili namahlanu.
Ngabo oonyana bakaGershoni, uYoweli umholi, nabangane bakhe abangamakhulu amathathu anamashumi amane.
Ngabo oonyana baka-Elizaphane, uShemaya umholi, nabangane bakhe abangamakhulu amabili.
Kumadodana ka-Hebroni, uEliyeli owayengumholi, nodadewabo abamashumi asibhozo.
Ngabo oonyana baka-Uziyeli, uAminadabi owayengumholi; nabangane bakhe babemakhulu amabili namahlanu.
UDavide wabiza uTsadoki noAbhiyathari ababingeleli, namaLevi, uUriyeli, noAsaya, noYoweli, noShemaya, noEliyele, noAminadabhi.
Wathi kubo, Niyinhloko zezingane zakwaLevi; ziningcwele niwe nabangani benu, ukuze nikhuphule isibambo sikaYehova uzimu kaSirayeli, nifike endaweni engiyilungiselele yona.
Ngaleso sikhathi sokuqala, niyiLevi, akunandaba nalokho; ngalokho ikosi uzimu wethu wagwema ukuthukuthela kuthi; sathi siyambuza bona sikwenze kanjani.
Baphoqeleka ke abapristi nabaLevi ukuba bahlanze izandla zabo, ukuze bakhuphule ibhokisi likaYehova uzimu kaSirayeli.
Bathwala amaLevi ibhokisi likaThixo ezindaweni zazo, ngezinkomishi, ngokusho komthetho kaMoses, ngokwelizwi likaYehova.
Wathi uDavide kubaholi bamaLevi, bona babeke phakathi kwabazalwane babo abadlali bemiculo, abadlala ama-harps, nama-harp, nama-cymbals, nabadlali bemisindo ejabulisayo.
Bathi abaLevi bamisa uHeman, indodana kaYoweli, noAsaphe, indodana kaBerekiya, abazalwane bakhe; namaMerari, abazalwane babo, uEthan, indodana kaKushaya.

Nabo abahlobo babo, abalandelayo ngokulandelana kwabo: uZekariya, noBeni, noYahaziyeli, noShemiramoth, noYehiyeli, noUnni, noEliabhi, noBhenaya, noMaasihiya, noMatithiya, noEliphelehu, noMikneya, na-Obedi-edomu, noJeyeli, abaphathi bezinsiza.
Abaculi, uHeman, noAsaphe, noEthane, babedlala ama-cymbals esiliva.
UZekariya, no-Aziyeli, no-Shemiramoth, no-Yehiyeli, no-Unni, no-Elibham, no-Maaseya, no-Banaiah, badlala ama-harps aphezulu, abizwa bona yi-Alamoth.
UMatithiya, noEliphelehu, noMiknehiya, noObedi-edomu, noJeyeli, noAzaziya, babephethe ama-lairi ahamba ngezinga eliphansi, abizwa bona yiSheminithi.
U-Kenaniya, owayengumholi wabaLevi, wayephethe udaba lwezingoma, begodu wafundisa abaculi; ngombana wayenekhono.
U-Berekiya no-Elkana babezogcina ibhokisi.
UShebhaniya, noYoshafati, noNethaneli, noAmasai, noZekariya, noBhenaya, noEliyezeri, abapristi, babephuza amabhungane phambi kwebhokisi likaThixo; uObhede-Edom noYehiya babegcina ibhokisi.
Waye ke uDavide, namadoda amakhulu aseSirayeli, nabaholi bezinkulungwane, besuka endlwini ka-Obedi-edomu, bethwasa isibambo sesivumelwano sikaYehova.
Banikela ngezinkomo ezisixhenxe, nezimvu ezisixhenxe; ngombana uzimu wasiza amaLevi athwala ibhokisi lesivumelwano sikaYehova.
UDavide wagqoka isibhakabhaka selinen, nalabo bonke abaLevi abathwali isibambo, nabaculi, noChenaniya, umphathi wengoma; begodu uDavide wagqoka i-ephod yelinen.
Ngaleyo le bonke isiSirayeli bakhuphula ibhokisi lesivumelwano sikaYehova, ngezwi lothando, nezwi lezinkomo, nezwi lezimpondo, nama-cymbals, nama-harps, nama-piano.

Kwathi lapho ibhokisi lesivumelwano sikaYehova lifika edolobhaneni likaDavide, uMikhayeli intombi kaSawule, ebheka ngaphesheya kwefasitela, wabona ukumkani uDavide enqoba nokudlalwa, wagwema yena emlonyeni wakhe.
Bafaka khona ibhokisi likaThixo, bamise phakathi kwehholo uDavide abelile lona; begodu banikela ngenhlanhla ngomnikelo wokushiswa nomnikelo wokuthula kukaNkulunkulu.
Kwathi, lapho uDavide eqedile ukunikela ngenhlanhla yokudlwengula nezenhlanhla zokuthula, wabambisa abantu ngegama likaYehova.
Wabanikeza bonke abantu baseSirayeli, amadoda nabesifazane, inkomishi eyodwa yenkomo, nengxenye eyodwa yemifino, nengxenye eyodwa yezithelo.
Wabeka abanye abaLevi ukuba basebenze phambi kwebhokisi likaYehova, bona bakhulume, babonga, begodu bathokozele ikosi, uzimu wakwaSirayeli.

UAsaphe waba nguMengameli, uZekariya ube yindodana yakhe; begodu uJeyeli, noShemiramoti, noYehiyeli, noMatithiya, noElibha, noBhenaya, noObedi-Edom, noJeyili, babezidlala izingoma ezidumile nezingqungquthela. UAsaphe wayezidlala ngezinhlamvu.
UBenaya noYahaziyeli, abapristi, babemele baphuze amabhungane njalo phambi kwesiqokobhe somthetho kaThixo.
Waqala uDavide ngalolu busuku ukubiza uAsaphe nodadewabo, ukuba bathande ikosi ngolimi olunjalo:
Babongani ikosi, nibize igama lakhe; sithi ezizwe zonke izinto azenzayo.
Hamba ukhulume naye, Hamba ukhulume naye, Ukhuluma ngemisebenzi yakhe yonke emangazayo.
Yiba nomhlomulo ngegama lakhe elingcwele, Lijabule inhliziyo labo abafuna ikosi.
Thola ikosi nobunamandla bakhe, Thola yena njalo.
Khumbula izinto zakhe ezimangazayo azenzayo, izibonakaliso zakhe, nezigwebo zakhe awakhulumayo,
Niyimbewu yomkhonzi wakhe uSirayeli, niyizingane zikaYakobi, abakhethiwe bakhe.
uzimu wethu, yena ikosi; Izigwebo zakhe zibonakala emhlabeni wonke.
Khumbulani umnqophiso wakhe kuze kube sekupheleni, isinqumo sakhe sosuku nosuku.
Lo ngumthetho wakhe owenza noAbrahama, kanye negunya lakhe elingu-Isake.
Wakwenza kube yimithetho kuYakobi, ibe ngumthetho ohlala njalo eSirayeli.
Wathi, Ngizokulethela izwe likaKanana njengengxenye yakho yomhlaba.
Nakuba bekungabakho nabani na phakathi kwenu owaziyo bona ikosi yenu, uSomandla, uyayithanda le ndawo?
Bahamba besuka ezweni elilodwa besiya kwelinye izwe, besuka emzini owodwa beya komnye.
Akhenge avumele umuntu bona awabise. Wabatjela ubukhosi ngenxa sabo:
Musa ukubopha abangcwele bami, begodu ungabi nento ebuhlungu kumaprofeti ami.
Umhlaba wonke, ingomani kuYehova; Buza usindiso lwakhe ngosuku ngalunye.
Batshele izizwe ubuhle bakhe, Bakhulume zonke izinhlanga ngezimanga zakhe.
Umkhulu ikosi, ngaphezu kwazo zonke izinto ezidume khulu; kufanele athandeke phezu kwazo zonke izitha.
Amasiko asezizwe onke afana nezinhlamvu, kodwana ikosi wenza izulu.
Ubuhle nobudume bubhekene naye, amandla nethando bugcwele indawo yakhe yokuhlala.
Ninikele ikosi, nizinhlanga zezizwe, ninikeze ikosi ukudumisa nokunamandla!
Ninikele ikosi igama lakhe, ninikeze umnikelo, nifike phambi kwakhe; niwukhonze ikosi ngobuhle bendawo yakhe engcwele.
Umhlaba wonke, cindezela phambi kwakhe. Izwe lihlala liqinile. Akufanele lishintshwe.
Nazithokozele izulu, begodu izwe lijabule; Nathi phakathi kwezizwe zonke, uzimu unguMlawuli.
Ulwandle nezinto zonke ezingaphakathi kulo, kufanele ziqonde; izihlahla nezinto zonke ezingaphakathi kuzo, kumele ziqonde.
Uma kunjalo, izihlahla zesihlabathi zizojabula phambi koYehova; ngombana yena uzofika agweme umhlaba.
Ngiyabonga kuYehova, ngombana ulungile; Uthando lwakhe luhlala kuze kube sekupheleni.
Uthi, Sisindise, Kosi yethu uzimu wokubuyisana kwethu; Sihlanganiseni, sisindise emazweni, ukuze sibonga igama lakho elingcwele, begodu sijabulise ngokukubonga.
Lola ikosi, uzimu kaSirayeli, kuze kube sekupheleni kosuku. Bathi bonke abantu, Amen, baloba ikosi.
Washiya khona uDavide uAsaphe nodadewabo, phambi kwesiqokobhe sesivumelwano sikaYehova, ukuba basebenze khona njalo, ngaso soke isikhathi.
Washiya no-Obedi-Edom, nabangane bakhe abamashumi mane anesibhozo, ukuba basebenze nabo; no-Obedi-Edom unyana kaJeduthuni, no-Hosa babe ngabaphathi besango.
UDavide washiya uTsadoki umbingeleli, nabangane bakhe ababingeleli, phambi kwendlu kaYehova, ezindaweni eziphakeme eGibeyon.

ukuze ba kwenzeke ngokuqhubekayo, ngasekuseni nakusihlwa, bona banikela ngenhlanhla ngomnikelo wokushiswa kuYehova phezu kwesibingelelo sokudla okuncibilikayo, ngokwezinto zonke ezibhalwe emthethweni kaYehova, owawuthi kuSirayeli.
Ngabo uHeman, noJeduthuni, nabanye abakhethiwe ngegama labo, ukuba babonga ikosi, ngokuba uthando lwakhe luhlala njalo.
UHeman noJeduthuni babephethe amabhubesi, nama-cymbals, namanye amathuluzi wokudlalwa kwengoma kaThixo. Oonyana bakaJeduthuni babehlala emnyango.
Basuka bonke abantu ezindaweni zabo, uDavide wabuyela ezindaweni zakhe, ukuze asize imindeni yakhe.
Wathi uDavide kuNathani umprofeti, lapho uhlala khona ekhaya lakhe: "Njengombana ngihlala endlini yesedari, kodwana isibambo somthetho kaYehova sihlala esitezi."
Wathi uNathani kuDavide, Ukwenze konke okusenhliziyoni yakho; ngombana uzimu unguwe.
Kodwana ngaleyo busuku ilizwi likaThixo lafika kuNathani. uzimu wathi,
Iya, utshele umkhonzi wami uDavide, bona, Uthi ikosi lokhu: Awuwukwakha yini indlu yami ukuze ngihlala kuyo?

Ngangihlalanga ekhaya kusukela ngosuku lapho ngakhipha khona amaSirayeli eYiputa, kuze kube manje; kodwana ngihamba ngisuka emgodini ngiye emgodini, begodu ngisuka endaweni yokuhlala ngiye endaweni yokuhlala.

Ngaphi na lapho ngihamba khona nabantu bonke bakaSirayeli, ngathi yini kinanyana ubani wabo bonke abavikeli bezwe lami engiwiselayo ukuba abe ngumlimi walo, ngitjho, Kungani na bona ningangikha indlu yesedru?
Ngalokho manje uzokutshela umkhonzi wami uDavide, uthi, Uthi lokho ikosi wamaSirayeli: Ngikuthathe wena emgwaqeni, elandela izinkomo, ukuze ube ngumholi phezu kwabantu bam baseSirayeli.
Ngibe nawe kiwo onke amadolobha owahamba kiwo, ngazibulala zonke izitha zakho phambi kwakho; begodu manje ngizokwenza igama lakho libe likhulu, njengegama labo abakhulu emhlabeni.
Ngizobeka indawo abantu bam, isiSirayeli, ngibatshale khona; bazohlala ezweni labo, begodu ngeke baphazamiseke nhlobo. Abantu ababi bangawacindezeli kangako, njengombana bekwenze ekuqaleni,
Ngikutshela bona uNdikhoyo uzokwakha indlu kuwe, nomndeni wamabukhosi, njengombana bekwenze kusukela kuleso sikhathi lapho ngabeka khona abaphathi phezu kwabantu bam, isizwe sikaSirayeli.
Uma ubudala bakho buphelile, begodu uyalala nabantu bakababa bakho, ngizomisa umzali wakho endaweni yakho, ovela emilenzeni yakho; begodu ngizoqinisa ibukhosi bakhe.
Uzokwakha indlu yami, begodu ngizokwenza isikhala sakhe sihlale isikhathi eside.
Ngizobe ngubaba wakhe, naye uzobe ngumntwana wami; begodu ngeke ngiyisuse inhlonipho yami kuye, njengokuthi ngiyisuse emkhosini wakho ongaphambili.
begodu ngizomisa phezu kwendlu yami nobukhosi bam kuze kube sekupheleni; isikhala sakhe sizohlala njalo.
Wathi uNathani kuDavide konke amazwi kaYehova ephupheni lakhe.
Wafika uDavide ukumkani, wahlala phambi koYehova, wathi, Ngibani na mina, Kosi yami uzimu? Ingabe yini ikhaya lami, bona ungisize ngifike lapho?
Ngiyabona bona lokhu akuyona into encane ngamehlo akho, uzimu, begodu ukhuluma ngendlu yomkhonzi wakho; ungenza kimi njengomuntu omkhulu khulu, Kosi kazimu.
Ngizokwazi yini ukukutshela okuningi, ngombana usize umkhonzi wakho ngale le? Uyazi umkhonzi wakho.
Kosi, ngenxa yomkhonzi wakho, begodu ngenxa yenhliziyo yakho, wenza konke lokhu okukhulu, ukuveza zonke lezi zinto ezinkulu.
Kosi, akukho muntu ofana nawe, begodu akukho uzimu ngaphandle kwakho, ngokwezinto esizibonayo ngezindlebe zethu.

Ingabe kunezwe elilodwa ezweni elifana nabantu bakho baseSirayeli? uzimu waphuma ukuwasindisa abe ngabantu bakhe, ukuze ukwenze igama lakho, wenze izinto ezinkulundekile. Wakhuphula izizwe phambi kwabantu bakho, owabasindisele emazweni aseMijiphu.
Wakwenza abantu bakho baseSirayeli babe impahla yakho kuze kube sekupheleni; wena, ikosi, waba nguThixo wabo.
Ngokuba manje, Kosi yami, izwi lakho elishoyo mayelana nomkhonzi wakho nomndeni wakhe, lihlale likhona kuze kube sekupheleni; wenze njengombana usho.

Begodu igama lakho lihlale liqinile, libe lihle kuze kube sekupheleni; begodu bathi: UYehova wezizwe zonke, uzimu wakwaSirayeli, nguzimu waseSirayeli; begodu indlu yomkhonzi wakho uDavide ihlale iqinile phambi kwakho.
uzimu wami, wena owazise umkhonzi wakho bona uzowulungisa umndeni wakhe; ngalokho-ke umkhonzi wakho wafumana inhliziyo yakhe ukuthandaza kuwe.
Kosi, wena uzimu; usho lokhu okulungile kumkhonzi wakho.
Ngokuba sekuyintando yakho ukubhekela indlu yomkhonzi wakho, ukuze ihlale phambi kwakho kuze kube sekupheleni; wena, Kosi, uyibhekele, begodu izobe iyibhekile kuze kube sekupheleni.
UDavide wahlasela amaFilisti, wabeka isandla sakhe phezu kwabo, wathatha iGati nezindawo zayo ezingaphansi kwayo ebusweni beFilisti.
Wahlasela begodu amaMowabi; abaMowabi babe ngabakhonzi bakaDavide, benikeza umnikelo.
UDavide wahlasela uHadarezere ukumkani waseZobha, eHamati, lapho ehamba khona uHadarezere ukubeka isandla sakhe emfuleni i-Efrayi.
UDavide wathatha kuye izimoto ezingu-1, namabhayisikili angu-7, namadoda ahamba ngezinyawo angama-20; uDavide wabulala wonke amabhayisikili, ngaphandle kwamabhasi ayikhulu.
Bafika abaArami baseDamasku ukusiza uHadarezere ukumkani waseZoba; uDavide wabulala abantu abangumakhulu mahlanu namashumi amabili.
UDavide wabeka amaqembu emkhosini wama-Aram eDamaseka, begodu ama-Aram waba ngabakhonzi bakaDavide, akhokhela umnikelo wakhe. UYehova wamsindisa uDavide lapho aye khona.
UDavide wathatha izigqoko zegolide, abaphathi bakaHadarezere babezithwala, wabazisa eYerusalem.

UDavide waya eTibhathi naseKuni, emadolobheni kaHadarezere, wafumana igolide eliningi; begodu uSolomoni wasebenzisa leli golide ukwenza i-tank enkulu yegolide ebizwa bona yilwandle, namahlombe, nezinto zegolide zethempelini.
UThowu ukumkani waseHamati, ezwa bona uDavide wahlasela wonke umkhosi kaHadarezere ukumkani waseZoba.

Wathumela uHadoram, unyana wakhe, kuye ukumkani uDavide, bona amhlelele, begodu amuhlele ngenxa yokulwa kwakhe noHadarezere; ngombana uThou ubelokhu ehlasela uHadarezere. UHadoram waba nesigqoko segolide, nesigqoko sesiliva, nesigqoko sensimbi.
Wazinikela ngazo uDavide ukumkani kuYehova, kanye negolide nesilivere ayeyithola emazweni onke: eEdomu, naseMowabhi, nakwa-Amoni, nakwaFilisti, nakwa-Amaleki.
U-Abhishai unyana kaSeruya wahlasela ama-Edomi, amakhulu ayisishiyagalolunye, eGoli laseSalt.
Wabeka amaqembu e-Edom, begodu bonke abantu base-Edom babe ngabakhonzi bakaDavide. UYehova wasiza uDavide ngaso soke isikhathi lapho ehamba khona.
UDavide waba ngukumkani phezu kwamaSirayeli onke, ewenza umthetho nomthetho kiwo wonke abantu bakhe.
UYowabhi unyana kaSeruya ube yisikhulu senkosi; noJehoshafati unyana ka-Ahilodi waba ngumbhali.
USadoko unyana ka-Ahitubhi, no-Abimeleki unyana ka-Abhiyathari, babe ngabapristi; uShavusha ube ngumbhali.
UBenaya unyana kaYehoyada waba nguMengameli wamaKherethi nawamaPhelethi, ababambe isibhamu sobukhosi; begodu oonyana bakaDavide babe ngabaphathi abakhulu emkhosini.
Wafa uNahashi ukumkani wakwa-Amoni, waba ngukumkani unyana wakhe endaweni yakhe.

Wathi uDavide, Ngizobonisa inhlonipho kuHanuni unyana kaNahashi, njengombana ubaba wakhe engenza inhlonipho kimi. UDavide wathumela abantu ukuba amusize ngenxa yokufa kukayise. Bafika abakhonzi bakaDavide kuHanun, ezweni lama-Amoni, ukuba amusize;

Bathi abakhulu baka-Amoni kuHanoni, Ingabe uDavidhi ehlonipha ubaba wakho ngokuthumelela labo bantu ukukuthokozisa? Akekho othile ovela ezindlini zakhe oza ukubheka izwe, noma ukulihlola, noma ukulibulala.
Wathi uHanuni, athabathe abakhonzi bakaDavide, wamisa imilenze sabo, wasusa izigqoko zabo eziphakathi kuya emadodeni abo, wabashiya besuka.
UDavide wathumela abathunywa ukuwamukela, ngombana babengabaza khulu. Wathi kubo ukumkani, Bahlale eJericho kuze kukhule izingulube zenu, bese niya ekhaya.

Babona amadodana ka-Amoni bona abagxekile uDavide, wathumela uHanun namadodana ka-Amoni igolide elingenamakhulu amathathu, ukuze baqeshe izithuthi namabhayisikili eMesopotamia, naseAram Maaka, naseZoba.
Baqasha izimoto ezingu-32, kwafika ukumkani waseMahaka naye nomkhosi wakhe, bamisa isibhedlela eMedeba. Namadodakazi ka-Amoni ahlangana emizini sabo, waphuma ukulwa.
UDavide, lapho ekhuluma ngalolu daba, wathumela uYowabu nomndeni wakhe wonke, abantu abanamandla.
Baphuma oonyana baka-Amoni, bamisa isikhundla sokulwa emgwaqweni wokungena edolobhaneni labo; kodwana abaphathi abafikayo behlala icala labo ezweni.
UYowabhi, nakabona bona kukhona iqembu elibhekene naye phambi kwakhe, neqembu elibhekene naye emuva kwakhe, wakhetha abantu abangcono ukudlula bonke amakhosi aseSirayeli, wabamisa bebhekene nabaAram.
Wabeka amanye amaqembu emkhosini ngaphasi kwesandla senkosikazi yakhe, uAbhishai; bamisa isikhundla sokubhekana namadodana ka-Amoni.
Wathi uYowabha, Uma i-Aram inamandla kunami, wena uzongisiza; kodwana uma izingane zika-Amoni zinamandla kunawe, ngizokusiza.
Uhlale unamandla, sihlale sinamandla ngenxa yezwe lethu, begodu ngenxa yamadolobhana kaThixo wethu; kodwana ikosi akwenze konke okulungile emehlo akhe.
Waphuma uYowabhi, nomndeni wakhe, ukubhekana nama-Aram; begodu ama-Aram awahamba phambi kwakhe.
Babona amadodana ka-Amoni bona ama-Aram ahambe, wahamba nabo phambi kuka-Abhishai udadewabo uYowabhi, babuyela edolobhaneni labo. Wabuya uYowabhi eYerusalem.
Babonama-Aram bona bahlaselwe nguSirayeli, bathumela abathunywa, bahlanganisa ama-Aram asuka ngaphesheya komfula i-Euphrates; noShofakha, umphathi womkhosi kaHadarezere, wayehamba phambi kwabo.
Bathi kuDavide, waqoqa wonke amaSirayeli, wadlula iYordan, waya kubo, wamisa isigungu esibhekene nabase-Aram, bahlaselana naye.

Kodwana amama-Aram ahambe phambi kwaSirayeli. UDavide wabulala eSirayeli abantu abangumakhulu asixhenxe abahamba ngezithuthi, namadoda amakhulu angumashumi amane ananye; wabulala begodu uShofakhi, umphathi wenkosi sabo.
Babona bonke abakhonzi bakaHadarezere bona bahlaselwe ngabaSirayeli, bakwenza uxolo noDavide, babe ngabakhonzi bakhe; begodu amaAram akhenge aphinde asize amadodana ka-Amoni.

Ngonyaka omusha, lapho amakhosana ephuma emkhosini, uYowabhi waphuma, wahlasela izwe lakwa-Amoni, waya eRabha, wavala indawo yayo. UDavide wayehlala eYerusalem; begodu uYowabhi wahlasela iRabha, wayibulala.

Wathatha uDavide isibhakabhaka esisekhanda lomkani wabo, esiyigolide elingamakhilogremu ayishumi nesishiyagalombili, elinabantu ababili abakhulu; kwabe kuyinqwaba yezinto ezisezingeni eliphakeme, zafakwa phezu kwekhanda likaDavide. UDavide wathatha nempahla enkulu khulu emzini.

Wakhipha wabantu abahlala khona, wabeka ezindaweni zabo, wabasiza ngezinkomishi zensimbi, nezingqimba zensimbi. UDavide wenza njalo kiwo wonke amadolobhana ka-Amoni; wabuyela uDavide nomndeni wakhe wonke eYerusalem.
Kwaba khona ukulwa namaFilisti eGezeri. Ngaleso sikhathi uShibekai waseHushathi wabulala uSipai, umfazi wesiRafayi; begodu abaFilisti bahlaselwa.
Kwaba khona uElhanana, unyana kaYahiri, wahlasela amaFilisti, wabulala uLahmi, umngane kaGoliathi waseGethi. ULahmi wayenesihluku esiqinile njengenkomishi yombukiso.

Kwaba nempi entsha eGathi, kwabe kukhona umuntu omkhulu khulu, onezintamo eziyisishiyagalombili ngesandla ngayinye, nezintamo eziyisishiyagalombili ngenyawo ngalinye, ayizinkulungwane ezimbili namashumi amane nanhlanu zonke; naye waba yindodana yamaGayi.
Kwathi, lapho ekhohlisa amaSirayeli, uYonathani unyana kaShimea, umngane kaDavide, wambulala.
Lawa madoda asuka ku-Rafa, eGathi; wababulala uDavide nabangani bakhe.
U-Satani wehla ezweni laseSirayeli, waholela uDavide ukuba abala abantu baseSirayeli.
Wathi uDavide kuYowabhi, nakubaphathi babantu: "Hambani nibala amaSirayeli kusukela eBeer-shebha enyakatho kuze kube eDani enyakatho; nizongitshela inani labo, ukuze ngizi bona bangaki."

Wathi uYowabha, UYehova aphinde abantu bakhe abe ngamaphesenti angamashumi amabili kunalabo abakhona manje; ikosi yami ukumkani, bangabe bonke abakhonzi bakho? Kungani na ukwenza lokhu? Kungani na ubeka isono phezu kwaSirayeli?
UYowabhi waphuma, waya ezweni lonke lakwaSirayeli, wabuyela eYerusalem. Wathi uYowabhi kuye: "Kulungile, ngizokutshela bona yini ongayikwenza?"
UYowabhi waveza uDavide inani eliphelele lamadoda; kwabe yizigidi ezingu-100 abantu abakwaziyo uku одговараιο, begodu isizwe samaSirayeli bonke kwakuyiminyaka eyishumi nesishiyagalombili.
Kodwana uYowabhi akayibala isizwe sikaLawi noBenjamini; ngombana lo mthetho wokumkani wawungathandeki kuYowabhi.
uzimu akathandani nalokho okwenzekile, ngalokho wagwema iSirayeli.
Wathi uDavide kuThixo, Ngibe nephutha elikhulu ngalokhu engikwenzayo; kodwana manje, ngiyakucela, ngisuse ubugebengu bomkhonzi wakho; ngombana ngikwenze ngengqondo encane khulu.
Wathi ikosi kuGadi, umbona kaDavide,
Chofoza lapha, ukhulume noDavide, uthi: Uthi ikosi bona: Ngikubeke phambi kwakho izinto amathathu; khethe enye yazo, ngikwenze kuwe.
Wathi uGadi kuye uDavide, wathi kuye, uzimu uthi: Khetha wena:

noma unyaka owodwa wendlala, noma amasonto amathathu okuhlukunyezwa phambi kwabanye bakho, nekhebula labo likulethe wena; noma usuku olulodwa ikhebula likaYehova, nobhubhu olukhulu ezweni lenu, begodu isithunywa sikaYehova sibulala bonke abantu bakaSirayeli. Ngokuba cabanga bona ngiphendule yini lowo wandithumela.
Wathi uDavide kuGadi, Ngisengozini enkulu khulu; kodwana ngibe sesandlani sikaYehova, ngombana izimilo zakhe zikhulu khulu; angibe sesandlani somuntu.
Wathumela ikosi isifo esibi phezu kwaSirayeli, safa abantu abangumakhulu asixhenxe eSirayeli.

Wathumela uMoya oyiNgcwele isithunywa ukuba sibulala iYerusalem. Kwathi lapho isithunywa sizoyibulala khona, ikosi wabheka, wakhathazeka ngenxa yalo monakalo, wathi kulesi sithunywa esibulala abantu: "Kunembile; hlala!" Umoya kaMoya oNgcwele ubesesitezi sendlu ka-Ornani umJebusi.

UDavide waphakamisa amehlo akhe, wabona isithunywa sikaYehova sikhona phakathi komhlaba nezulu, nesibhamu esiboshwe esandlani sakhe, sibekwe phezu kweYerusalem. Wathi uDavide nabaholi bakhe, abagqoke izicathulo ezingwevu, bahlaliswa ngobuso babo phasi.

Wathi uDavide kuThixo, Ngabe angikaze ngitjho abantu babalolwe? Ngiye ngawulungisa umsebenzi wami; kodwana labo bantu bafana nengulube. Bakwenzeni yini? Kosi yami, uzimu wami, ngicela isandla sakho sihlale phezu kwami, kanye nomndeni wami, begodu akufanele kube nalolu bhubhu phakathi kwabantu bakho.
Wathi umprofeti kaYehova kuGadi, bona akhulume noDavide, athi, Yiya ukwakha isibingelelo kukaNkulunkulu esitezi sokudla sika-Ornani umJebusi.
Wahamba uDavide, njengombana wathi uGadi, ngegama likaYehova.
U-Ornani, lapho enqoba khona inkomo, wabheka emuva, wabona isithunywa; naye nomndeni wakhe wonke bafihla.
Kwathi lapho uDavide efika khona, wabheka uOrhana, wambona. Waphuma emgodini, wehla phambi kukaDavide ngobuso bakhe phasi.
Wathi uDavide ku-Ornani, Ngithengise lendawo yokudlidliza, ukuze ngikhiphe phezu kwayo isibingelelo kuYehova; ngiyithengise ngentengo egcwele, ukuze isifo siphele phakathi kwabantu.

Wathi u-Ornani kuDavide, Uyithathe; begodu umnikazi wami ukumkani akwenze konke okubona bona kulungile emehlo akhe; bona, ngizokunika izinkomo ukuze zibe izipho ezibomvu, namabhodwe ukuze abe imithi yomlilo, nengulube ukuze ibe isiphuzo sokudla; ngizokunikeza konke.
Wathi ukumkani uDavide ku-Ornani, Akunjalo, kodwana ngizokunikeza intengo egcwele; angiyithathe into yakho, ngiyinike ikosi, begodu angizonikela ngesonka esiqhumayo esingadingeki.
Wathi uDavide wanikela ku-Ornana ngegolide elingaphezu kwamakhilogremu ayisishiyagalombili.
Wakha khona uDavide isibingelelo kuYehova, wanikela khona ngezipho ezibomvu nezipho zokuthula; wathandaza kuYehova, waphendula ngomlilo osuka esibhakabhakeni sesibingelelo esibomvu.
Wathi ikosi kulowo wesifazane, wabeka isibhamu sakhe emgodini wayo.
Ngaleso sikhathi, lapho uDavide nakabona bona ikosi wamphendula emgodini ka-Ornani umJebhusi, wanikela khona.
Ikamelo likaYehova, uMosis ayelilungiselela ezweni elimnyama, nesitezi esiphezulu somnikelo wokushiswa kwakungulapho emzini ophakeme eGibeyon.
Kodwana uDavide akakwazanga ukuya khona ukubuza uzimu, ngombana wayekhathazekile ngenxa yekhebula lesithunywa sikaYehova.
Wathi uDavide, Le yindawo lapho indlu kaThixo ikosi izobe ikhona khona, begodu le yindawo lapho isibingelelo somnikelo wokudla sizoba khona khona kwaSirayeli.
Wathi uDavide, aqoqe bonke abangaphandle ezweni laseSirayeli; wabeka phakathi kwabo abaholi bezindonga, ukuba bacwebeze izindonga zokwakha indlu kaThixo.
UDavide wanikeza inani elikhulu lensimbi, ukuze kwenziwe izikhonkwane, nezintambo zeminyango yamasango, kanye negolide elingaphezulu kunalokho okungenzeka ukulilinganisela.
Wabanikeza begodu izihlahla zeqhwa, ezingenakubalwa; ngombana abantu baseSidon neTire babethumelela uDavide izihlahla zeqhwa eziningi.

UDavide wathi, "USolomoni, unyana wami, ungumfundi oncane; begodu indlu edingekayo ukuba ikhiwa kuYehova kumele ibe mkhulu khulu, ibe negama elikhululabalalisa emhlabeni wonke; ngalokho ngizoyilungiselela." UDavide walungisa izinto eziningi ngaphambi kokuba aphele.
Wabiza uSolomoni, unyana wakhe, wathi kuye bona avule indlu kuYehova uzimu kaSirayeli.
Wathi uDavide kuSolomoni, Unyana wami, ngangifuna ukukwakha indlu igama likaYehova uzimu wam.

Kodwana kwafika igama likaYehova kum, lithi, Uthe wageza igazi elikhulu, wabhekana nemibhikisho emikhulu; awuzokwakha indlu ngegama lami, ngombana uthe wageza igazi elikhulu phezu komhlaba phambi kwami.

kodwana uzozala indodana, izobe yindoda yokuthula; begodu ngizonikeza ukuthula kuzo zonke izitha zakhe ezingqondweni zakhe. Igama lakhe lizoba nguSolomoni, begodu ngizonikela ngokuthula ezweni lakwaSirayeli ngesikhathi sakhe sokubusa.
Uzokwakha indlu ngegama lami; yena uzobe ngumntwana wami, begodu mina ngizoba ngubaba wakhe; begodu ngizoqinisa isikhala sobukhosi bakhe phezu kwaSirayeli kuze kube sekupheleni.
Manje ke, unyana wami, ikosi abe nawe, akwenze kube lula kuwe, ukwakha indlu kaYehova uzimu wakho, njengombana wathi.
begodu ikosi akunikeze ubuhlakani nokuqonda, uma ekwenza ube phezu kwaSirayeli, ukuze ugcine umthetho kaYehova uzimu wakho.
Uzophumelela, uma nje ubhekana nokwenza zonke izimiso nezibopho, azenzayo ikosi uMoses ezweni lakwaSirayeli; ube namandla, ube nomphefumulo oqinile. Musa ukukhathazeka, ungabi nenhliziyo ebuhlungu.

Ngabona bona ngisebenze khulu ukulungiselela indlu kaYehova, ngathola igolide lamathani angama-3, nesilivere amathani angamashumi amathathu anesihlanu, kanye nobhedu namafutha omnqumo angeke kubhekwe ngenxa yobukhulu bawo; begodu ukhuni namatshe ngiyawahlinzekela wena.
Unabasebenzi abaningi: abacutha amatshe, abakhonzi, nabakhangisi, nanoma yiluphi uhlobo lomsebenzi oqeqeshiwe nganoma iyiphi imisebenzi.
Igolide, nesilivere, nesiliva, nensimbi, ziningi khulu, zingacaci; qhubeka ukwenze, begodu ikosi abe nawe.
Wathi uDavide kubo bonke abakhulu baseSirayeli, bona basize uSolomoni unyana wakhe, wathi kubo,

UYehova, uzimu wakho, akakho nawe? Wakulethela isikhala ngazo zonke izinhlangothi zakho; wanikela abantu belizwe elingezansi kwami; begodu leli lizwe lise ngaphasi kwesandla soNkulunkulu nesobantu bakhe.

Manje ke, lungisa intliziyo yakho nomoya wakho ukuba ulandele ikosi uzimu wakho; zulazula ukwakha indawo engcwele kaYehova uzimu wakho; bese ufaka isibambo sesivumelwano soNkulunkulu, nezinto ezingcwele zoNkulunkulu, endlwini ebeka igama loNkulunkulu.
Kwathi lapho uDavide esemncane, ephila iminyaka emide, egcwele impilo, wakwenza uSolomoni, unyana wakhe, ube ngukumkani phezu kwaSirayeli.
Waqoqa bonke abakhulu bakaSirayeli, namaLevi namadodakazi abo.
AbaLevi, abaneminyaka engama-30 ubudala nangaphezulu, babalwa ngomuntu ngamunye; kwaba ngamaphesenti angama-38.
Wathi uDavide, Ngabo amashumi amabili nanhlanu amawaka azobe ephethe umsebenzi wendlu kaYehova, namakhulu ayisishiyagalombili abe ngabaphathi nabavikeli.
Amakhulu amane azobe abaphathi bezindonga, begodu amakhulu amane azobonga ikosi ngezinhlamvu zengoma engizenzayo ukubonga.
UDavide wahlukanisa amaLevi abe ngamaqembu, ngokuya ngemindeni yabantwana bakaLevi: uGershoni, noKohati, noMerari.
NgaseGershoni kwaba nguLadani noShimeyi.
Waba nguLadani oonyana abathathu: uJehiyeli owayengumholi, noZethamu noYoweli.
Waba nguShimeyi oonyana abathathu: uShelomothi, noHaziyeli, noHarani; labo babe yinhloko yamakhaya kaLadan.
Oonyana bakaShimehi: uYahati, noZina, noJeushi, noBeriya; labo banezingane zikaShimehi.
UYahathi wayengumholi, uZiza ube yindodana yesithathu. Kodwana uJehushi noBeriya babengenabantwana abaningi; ngalokho bahlukaniswa babe mndeni owodwa, nendlu eyodwa.
Waba nguKohati oonyana ababini: uAmram, no-Izhar, no-Hebron, no-Uziel.

Onyana baka-Amram: u-Aron noMoses. U-Aron nabangane bakhe bahlukaniswa, kuze kube sekupheleni, ukuze bahlanze izinto ezingcwele khulu, bona baphuze insindiso phambi koYehova, bona basebenze kuye, ukubambisane ngegama lakhe kuze kube sekupheleni.
Kwathi uMosis, indodana kaThixo, wabala oonyana bakhe njengomndeni kaLevi.
Oonyana bakaMosesi: uGershom noEliezer.
Amadodakazi kaGershoni aholwa nguShebuyeli.
UEliezere akhenge abe nomunye unyana, kodwana uRehabhia waba nezingane eziningi khulu.
Abazali baka-Izhar babeholwa nguShelomith.
Oonyana bakaHebroni: uJeriya owayengumholi, noAmariya owesibili, noYahaziyeli wesithathu, noJekameam wesithupha.
Oonyana baka-Uziyeli: uMika owayengumholi, noIshiya owesibili.
Oonyana bakaMerari: uMahli noMushi; oonyana kaMahli: uEleazar noKishi.
Wafa u-Eleazari, akhenge abe namadodakazi; waba nezingane ezincane, wazenza izihlobo zabo, izingane zikaKishi.
Waba nguMushi oonyana abathathu: uMahli, noEdere, noYeremota.

Baye labo oonyana bakaLawi ngokwemindeni sabo, abakhulu bezindlu zakwababa babo, ngokusho kokubalwa kwamagama kwabo, babalwa ngomuntu ngamunye, kusukela eminyakeni eyishumi nambili nangaphezulu, abasebenza umsebenzi wokuphatha endlwini kaYehova.
Wayethi uDavide, UYehova, uzimu kaSirayeli, unikeze isikhala abantu bakhe, begodu uzohlala eYerusalem kuze kube sekupheleni.
Ngaleyo le abaLevi abazokwazi ukuthwala itabernakele, noma iyiphi into esetshenziswa kuyo.
Ngokuya ngemiyalelo kaDavide, abaLevi abaneminyaka eyishumi nambili nangaphezulu babalwa.

Umsebenzi wabo wukuthi basebenze ndawonye namadodakazi ka-Aron, emisebenzini yendlu kaYehova, bebhekene nezindlu zangaphandle, nezindawo ezingemuva, nokuhlanza zonke izinto ezingcwele, nokwenza yonke imisebenzi yomsebenzi wendlu kaThixo.
Babe nesibopho sokudla okungcwele embhedeni, noshizi oluhle lwezinto zomnikelo wokudla, namakhowe ancane ayenziwe ngaphandle kobisi, nezitsha zokupheka, nokuxubana kwazo zonke izinto zokulinganisa.
Bahlala njalo ekuseni, bebonga nokuzinikela kukaNkulunkulu, begodu bahlale njalo ebusuku.

Basizakala ngazo zonke izipho eziboshwayo kuYehova, ngezinsuku zosuku lokuphumula, namaholidi enyanga entsha, nakwezinye amalanga zosuku olulodwa; basebenza phambi kukaNkulunkulu ngokuqhubekayo, ngokwenani elifanele.
Lawa amaLevi athatha umsebenzi wesitezi sokuhlangana, nowendawo engcwele, nabangane babo, oonyana baka-Aron, ukuze basebenze endlwini kaYehova.
Lawa amaqembu omndeni ka-Aron. Oonyana baka-Aron: uNadab, no-Abihu, no-Eleazar, no-Ithamari.
Bafa ke uNadabhi noAbhihu phambi kukababa wabo, bengenabantwana; khona-ke uEleazarhi noIthamari babe ngabapristi.
Wabahlukanisa uDavide, ngesandla sikaSadoko, umfazi wase-Elazar, no-Akhimeleki, umfazi wase-Ithamari, yaba ngamaqembu ahlukene.
Bahlukaniswa ngale le: abaphathi bezindlu zakwaElazare babe yishumi nanye nesishiyagalombili, begodu abaphathi bezindlu zakwaIthamari babe yisikhombisa.
Bawahlukanisela ngokuhluza, ngenxa yokuthi kwaba phakathi kwamadodana ka-Elazar nendodana ka-Ithamari abaphathi bendawo engcwele, nabaphathi bakaThixo.

UShemaya unyana kaNethaneli, umbhali, owayengumLevi, wabhala amagama abo phambi kukakumkani, nabangaphathina, noTsadoki umbingeleli, noAhileleki unyana kaAbhiyathari, nabakhulu bezindlu zakwababa ababingeleli, namaLevi; imindeni sabo yahlukaniswa ngezinhlamvu ezimbili: imindeni ye-Eleazar nemindeni ye-Ithamari.
Iphutha lokuqala laphuma kuYoyaribi, lesibili kuJedaya,
isithathu kuHarim, nesishiyagalombili kuSeorim,
isihlanu kuMalkiya, isithandathu kuMiyamina,
isishiyagalolunye kuHakoshe, isishiyagalombili kuAbiha,
isithoba kuYeshua, esiyishumi kuShecaniya,
eyeshumi nambili kuEliashib, eyeshumi nambili kuYakim,
ishumi nambili ku-Hupha, neshumi nambili ku-Yeshebhebhab,
isishiyagalombili kuBilgah, isishiyagalolunye ku-Imer;
ishumi nesishiyagalombili ku-Heziri, ishumi nesishiyagalolunye ku-Happizezi;
eyeshumi nanye uPethahiya, eyishumi nambili uJehezkele,
eyeshumi nambili uYakhini, eyisikhombisa uGamuli,
ishumi nambili nesithathu kuDelaya, neshumi nambili nesithupha kuMaaziya.
Lokho kwakungumsebenzi wabo, lapho bephuma khona endlwini kaYehova, ngokuya ngemithetho ka-Aron, ubaba wabo, njengombana ikosi, uzimu kaSirayeli, abemwisele umthetho ngayo.
Lawa amanye amadodana ka-Lawi: kumadodana ka-Amram, uShubhayeli; kumadodana ka-Shubhayeli, uJedeya.
Ngabo oonyana baka-Rehabhia kwaba nguIshiya, owayengumholi.
Kwaba-Ishari kwaba nguShelomothi, kwabesilisa baka-Shelomothi kwaba nguYahati.
Oonyana baka-Hebroni: uYeriya omkhulu, noAmariya wesithathu, noYahaziyeli wesithathu, noJekameam wesithupha.
Unyana ka-Uziyeli ube nguMikha, noShamire waba yindodana ka-Mikha.
Udadewabo uMikha wayengu-Ishiya, nomndeni ka-Ishiya waba nguZekariya.
Oonyana bakaMerariya: uMahli noMushi. Unyana kaYaaziah, uBheno.
Amadodana kaMerariya, asuka kuYahaziya, nguBeno, noShoham, noZakur, noIbri.
U-Eleazare, owazalwa nguMahli, akhenge abe nabantwana.
EKishi kwavela uJerahmeel, unyana kaKishi.
Oonyana bakaMushi: uMahli, no-Edere, no-Yerimothi; labo abaLevi ngokubhaliswa kwabo ngezinhlanga zabo.

Babeka iziqhamo phambi kukaDavide ukumkani, noTsadoki, noAhileleki, nabaholi bezindlu zakwababa babo phakathi kwababhishobhi nalabaLevi, kanye nezihlobo zabo, izingane zika-Aron; imindeni yendodakazi encane nendodakazi ekhulu.

UDavide, kanye nabaphathi bamabutho, bamisa abanye onyana baka-Asaphe, noHeman, noJeduthuni, ukuba babe yimisebenzi ekhethekile; bekhuluma ngezwi, bedlala ama-harps, nama-lyras, nama-cymbals. Lakho inani lamadoda asebenza kule misebenzi:
Ngabo oonyana baka-Asaphu: uZakhuri, noYosefu, noNethaniya, noAsarela; labo babe ngaphasi kwesandla sika-Asaphu, abaprofetisa ngaphasi kwesandla somkwembu.

Ngabo oonyana bakaJeduthuni: uGedaliya, noZeri, noYeshaya, noShimeyi, noHashabhiya, noMatithiya, abasithandathu bonke; babe ngaphasi kwesandla sikaJedutuni ubaba wabo, okhuluma ngezwi elisha, ebonga begodu ethokozele ikosi.
Ngabo oonyana bakaHeman: uBukhiya, noMatania, noUziyele, noShebuyeli, noJerimothi, noHananiya, noHanani, noEliyata, noGiddalithi, noRomamthi-Ezer, noYoshebekasha, noMalothi, noHothiri, noMahasiothi.
Bonke labo babe yindodana kaHeman, okubonayo ukumkani; njengombana uzimu atjhilo bona uzomqinisa; begodu uzimu wamnika uHeman oonyana abalishumi elinambini nezingane amathathu.

Lawo wonke amabhishobhi aye ngaphasi komthetho wababa babo, ekwenzeni umculo endlwini kaYehova, ngezinkomo, nezingcweti, nezigcawu, ekusebenzeni kwendlu kaThixo; noAsaphu, noJeduthuni, noHeman, bengaphansi komthetho wobukhosi.
Bonke labo, nabangane babo, bonke abaqeqeshiwe, abakwaziyo ukungoma kukaNkulunkulu, babemakhulu amabili, anamanci asibhozo.
Bonke bathwebula izinkontileka zomsebenzi wabo, abancane nabadala ngokufanayo, umfundi nomfundi ngokufana.
Isipho sokuqala safika ku-Asaphe, kwaba nguYosefu; nesipho sesibili safika ku-Gedaliya, nabangane bakhe nabantwana bakhe, abalishumi elinambini.
Ingxenye yesithathu yaba nguZakhuri; yena, noonyana bakhe nabangane bakhe, babe yishumi nambili.
Ingxenye yesine yaba ngu-Izri; yena, noonyana bakhe nabazalwane bakhe, babe ngamashumi amabili.
Isihlanu saphuma kuNethaniya; yena, noonyana bakhe nabazalwane bakhe, babe yishumi nambili.
Ishumi nesishiyagalombili lafika kuBhukukiya; yena, noonyana bakhe, nabangane bakhe, babe ngamahlanu.
Ishumi nesishiyagalombili lafika ku-Yesharela; yena, noonyana bakhe nabazalwane bakhe, babemashumi amabili namahlanu.
Ishumi nesishiyagalombili kwaba nguYeshaya; yena, noonyana bakhe nabazalwane bakhe, babe ngamahlanu.
Ishumi nesishiyagalombili lafika kuMatania; yena, noonyana bakhe nabazalwane bakhe, babemashumi amabili namahlanu.
Ishumi lafika kuShimeyi; yena, noonyana bakhe nabazalwane bakhe, babe yishumi nambili.
Ishumi nalinye laphuma ku-Azareli; yena, noonyana bakhe nabazalwane bakhe, babe yishumi nambili.
ishumi nambili kuHashabiya; yena, noonyana bakhe nabazalwane bakhe, babe yishumi nambili.
ishumi nambili kuShubhayeli; yena, noonyana bakhe, nabazalwane bakhe, babe yishumi nambili.
Ishumi nambili lafika kuMatithaya; yena, noonyana bakhe nabazalwane bakhe, babe yishumi nambili.
ishumi nambili lafika kuYeremota; yena, noonyana bakhe nabazalwane bakhe, babe yishumi nambili.
Ishumi nanye nesithandathu lafika kuHananiya; yena, noonyana bakhe nabazalwane bakhe, babe yishumi nambili.
ishumi nesishiyagalombili kuYoshbekasha; yena, noonyana bakhe nabazalwane bakhe, babe yishumi nambili.
Ishumi nesishiyagalombili lafika kuHanani; yena, noonyana bakhe nabangane bakhe, babe ngamahlanu.
ishumi nambili kuMalothi; yena, noonyana bakhe nabangane bakhe, babe yishumi nambili.
Ishumi nambili lafika kuEliyata; yena, noonyana bakhe nabazalwane bakhe, babe yishumi nambili.
ishumi nambili elilodwa lafika kuHothire; yena, oonyana bakhe nabangane bakhe, babe lishumi linamibini.
Okuyisishiyagalombili kwaba nguGiddalthi, namadodana akhe nabangane bakhe, amashumi amabili nanhlanu.
ishumi nambili nesithathu kuMahasiothi; yena, noonyana bakhe nabazalwane bakhe, babemashumi mabini namahlanu.
ishumi nambili nesine lafika kuRomamthi-ezere; yena, noonyana bakhe nabazalwane bakhe, babe ngamahlanu.
Lawa maqembu ama-portiers: ku-Korah, uMeshelemiya unyana ka-Kore, umfazi wabantwana baka-Asaphe.
Oonyana bakaMeshelemiya: uZekariya omkhulu, noYediyayeli wesithathu, noZebadia wesithathu, noYatniel wesithupha,
uElam wesithupha, noYohanane wesishiyagalombili, noElihoheni wesixhenxe.
Oonyana baka-Obedi-edomu: uShemaya owayengumzali, noYozabadi wesithathu, noYoha wesithathu, noShakare wesithupha, noNethaneli wesishiyagalombili,
u-Amiyeli wesishiyagalombili, no-Issakare wesishiyagalolunye, no-Pehuleti wesishiyagalombili. uzimu wayemsindise khulu u-Obedi-Edom.
UShemaya unyana wakhe wayenamadodakazi, abe yinhloko yamakhaya abo, ngombana babe ngamadoda anamandla.
Oonyana bakaShemaya: uOthni, noRefayeli, no-Obhedi, no-Elzabadi; nabangane babo, uElihu no-Semakiya, abantu abanamandla.
Bonke labo babe yindodana ka-Obedi-edomu, bona nabantwana babo nabangani babo, abantu abanamandla omsebenzi; kwaba ngu-Obedi-edomu amashumi ayisishiyagalombili nabini.
UMeshelemiya wayenezingane eziyisibhozo nesishiyagalombili, nabangani bakhe, abantu abanamandla.
UHosa, umfazi waseMerari, ubenamadodakazi; uShimri wayengumholi, nakuba akhenge abe ngumzali wokuthoma; kodwana ubaba wakhe wakwenza waba nguMengameli.
uHilkiya owesibili, noTebaliya wesithathu, noZekariya wesithupha. UHosa wayenezingane nabangane abamashumi amathathu.
Lawa maqembu amaphoyisa asesitezi sokuqala, kanye namadodana abo, babe nemisebenzi sabo yokukhonza endlwini kaYehova, njengabo bonke abazalwane babo.
Baqala ukuqoqa izinkontileka ngesango ngalinye, imindeni ngomndeni, abancane nabadala.
Ukheshi lomnyango wasempumalanga lwafika kuShelemiya, begodu babeke ukheshi kuZekariya unyana wakhe, umcebisi owaziyo; nokheshi lomnyango wasenyakatho lwafika kuye.
Isango laseNtshonalanga lafika ku-Obedi-Edom, nendlu yokugcina ifike kubo.
Isango laseNtshonalanga, nesango leShalekethi, elisendaweni ephakeme, labekwa ngu-Shuphim noHosa. Abagwebi bahlala ndawonye.
AbaLevi abasithandathu behlala enyakatho, nabanhlanu basentshonalanga, namahlanu asempumalanga; begodu kwabekhona ababili ngasikhathi sinye emgodini.
Enkantolo engxenyeni yasenyakatho, kwakunezintathu enhliziyweni yendlela kanye nezimbili enkantolo.
Lawa maqembu ama-portiers asuka emindenini yamaKora namaMerariya.
Abazalwane babo abaLevi, ngaphasi kuka-Ahiya, babe nesibopho sazo zonke izimpahla zendlu kaThixo, nazo zonke izimpahla zomnikelo wesono.
ULadani waba yindodana kaGershoni, esuka ku-Ladani; uJehiyeli wayeyinhloko yomndeni wakwa-Ladani umGershoni.
UZethamu noYoweli, udadewabo, oonyana bakaJehiyeli, babe ngabaphathi bezitolo zendlu kaYehova.
Emindenini ka-Amram, no-Izhar, no-Hebron, no-Uziyeli:
UShebuyeli, umfazi waseGershoni, unyana kaMosesi, wayeyisikhulu esiphezulu sazo zonke izimpahla.
Abangane bakhe ngoEliezere: uRehabiya unyana kaEliezere, noYeshaya unyana kaRehabiya, noYoram unyana kaYeshaya, noZikri unyana kaJoram, noShelomothi unyana kaZikri.

UShelomothi, nodadewabo, babe ngowezo zonke izimpahla zempahla ethengiswayo, eyanikezwa nguNdunankulu uDavide, nabaholi bezindlu zakwababa, nabaphathi bamakhulu namakhulu, nabo bonke abaphathi bemikhosi.
Banikela ngezinto ezithathwe emdlalweni, ukuze balungise indlu kaYehova.

Nakho konke uSamuweli okubonayo, noSawule unyana kaKishi, no-Abheri unyana kaNeri, noYowabu unyana kaZeruhiya, bekwahlulela ngokuzinikela kwabo kukaNkulunkulu; nakho konke bonke abantu ababezinikela, kwaba ngaphasi kwesandla sikaShelomothi nabangani bakhe.
Kwabe yibo abase-Izhari: uKenaniya nonyana bakhe, ababesebenza emisebenzini yendlu kaThixo; babe ngabaphathi nabaqondisi kwaSirayeli.

Kilabo base-Hebroni, uHashabhiya nabazalwane bakhe abakhulu kunamakhulu ayisishiyagalombili, abantu abanothando, babe ngabaphathi gestuιοra aseSirayeli ngaphesheya kwezilwandle kweYordana ezweni laseYiputa; bamadodana amakhosikazi aseJordani.

Kwaba-Hebroni kwaba nguJeriya, owayenguMengameli, ngokwezinkolelo zomndeni wabo. Ngonyaka omashumi amane wokubusa kukaDavide, kwafunyanwa izinkolelo zomndeni ka-Hebroni, begodu kwatholakala phakathi kwabo abantu abanamandla amakhulu eJazeri eGiliyadi.

UYeriya ubenezinkanyezi ezingu-2, abantu abanolwazi olukhulu, abaphathi bezindlu zabazali. UDavide ukumkani wababeka ngaphesheya kwezintaba zeRubheni noGadi nengxenye yesizwe sikaManase kinanyana yisiphi isinqumo esiphathelene nozimu nomkakhe.

Nalokhu wuhlu lwamadodana kaSirayeli asebenza emkhosini, abezinhloko zemindeni sabo, nabaphathi bamakhulu namakhulu, nabangani babo, nabo bonke abaqondisi babo; basebenza emkhosini ngazo zonke izinto, ngokuya ngezigaba zabo, eziphumayo nezifikayo ngenyanga ngayinye, ngonyaka wonke.
Ngesigaba sokuqala, ngonyaka wokuthoma, kwaba nguYashobhamu unyana kaZabediyeli; nakwisigaba sakhe kwabekhona abantu abangumakhulu amabili nanhlanu.
Wabe yindodana ka-Perezi, waba nguMengameli wamabhishobhi onke empilweni yonyaka wokuthoma.
Engxenyeni yakhe yenyanga yesithathu kwaba nguDodayi u-Ahohati; engxenyeni yakhe kwakunguMiklothi owayengumholi; engxenyeni yakhe bekukhona abantu abangumashumi amabili anane amawaka.
Umphathi wesithathu wesizwe, wenyanga yesithathu, uBhenaya unyana kaYehoyada umpristi; begodu eqenjini lakhe kwabekho abantu abangumashumi amabili anane amawaka.
Lo mbhishobhi uBhenaya waba ngumuntu onamandla phakathi kwabo abamashumi amathathu, waba ngumphathi wabo amashumi amathathu; eqenjini lakhe u-Amizabadi, unyana wakhe, wayengumphathi.
Owesine kunyaka wesithathu ube ngu-Asaheli, udade kaYowabhi; ngemuva kwakhe kwaba nguZebadia unyana wakhe; emkhakheni wakhe kwabekhona abantu abangumashumi amabili nanhlanu amawaka.
Umphathi wesishiyagalombili wenyanga yesishiyagalombili ube nguShamuthu u-Izrahiyethi; emkhosini wakhe kwakungumashumi amabili anane amawaka.
Owesixhenxe kunyaka wesishiyagalombili ube ngu-Ira unyana ka-Ikeshi waseTekoa; emkhosini wakhe kwabengamawaka amabili nanhlanu.
Umphathi wesixhenxe wenyanga yesixhenxe uHelezisi umPheloni, waseEphrayim; nakwisigaba sakhe kwaba ngamaphesenti angamashumi amabili anane amawaka.
Oyisishiyagalombili sonyaka wesishiyagalolunye uSibhekai umHushathi, waseZera; nakwisigaba sakhe kwaba ngamaphesenti angamashumi amabili nanhlanu amawaka.
Owesine kunyaka wesithoba ube ngu-Abiezer waseAnathothi, waseBhenjamin; nakwisigaba sakhe kwaba ngamaphesenti angamashumi amabili anane amawaka.
Owesishiyagalombili wenyanga yesishiyagalombili uMaharayi waseNetofa, waseZera; nakwisigaba sakhe abantu abangumashumi amabili anane amawaka.
Oweshumi nalinye lonyaka oyisishiyagalombili ube nguBenaya uPirathoni, wase-Ephrayim; begodu ngohlobo lwakhe kwaba ngamaphesenti angamashumi amabili nanhlanu amawaka.
Oyishumi nambili lonyaka oyisishiyagalombili ube nguHeledi waseNetofa, wakwa-Othniyeli; ngohlobo lwakhe kwabengamakhulu amabili nanhlanu.
Lawa abaholi bezizwe zakwaSirayeli: ku-Rubhen, uEliyezeri unyana kaZikhri; ku-Shimeoni, uShefatia unyana kaMahaka;
kuLevi, uHashabhiya unyana kaKemuyeli; kumadodana ka-Aron, uTsadoki;
KwaYuda, uElihu, owodwa wabahlobo bakaDavide; kwa-Issakare, uOmri unyana kaMikayeli;
KwaZabuloni, uIshmaya unyana ka-Obadi; kwaNaphtali, uYeremota unyana ka-Azriyeli;
ku-Ephrayim, uHosheya unyana ka-Azaziya; engxenyeni yesizwe sikaManase, uYoweli unyana kaPedaya;
Ngaphezu kwengxenye yesizwe sikaManase eGiliyadi, uIdo unyana kaZekariya; ngaphezu kukaBhenjamin, uYashiyeli unyana kaAbheri;
NgoDani, uAzareli unyana kaYerohamu; labo babe ngabaphathi bezizwe zaseSirayeli.
UDavide akhenge abala labo abaneminyaka eyishumi nesishiyagalombili nangaphezulu; ngombana ikosi wayethe, bona uzokwenza amaSirayeli abe ngamaplanethi ezulu.

UYowabhi unyana kaZeruhiya waqala ukubala, kodwana akaqedi; ngombana kwafika inkohliso ezweni lakwaSirayeli ngenxa yokubalwa kwabo. Ngalokho-ke inani labo lonke alibhalwenga encwadini yamaqiniso kaDavide ukumkani.
UAzmavethi unyana ka-Adiyeli waba nguMengameli wezitolo zobukhosi; noYonathani unyana kaUziya waba nguMengameli wezitolo ezisendaweni, nasezifundeni, nasezindaweni zasemadolobheni, nasezinqaba.
UEzri, unyana ka-Chelub, wayephethe abasebenzi basezimboni abasebenzela izwe.
UShimeyi waseRama wayephethe izivini; uZabdi, umSifemi, wayephatha iwayini elivela ezivinini.
UBaale-hanani waseGederi wayephethe izihlahla ze-olive, nezitshalo zezinkomo ezisenyakatho; uYoashi wayephatha amaphethini e-olive.
UShithayi waseSharon wayephethe izinkomo ezidla imbewu eSharon; uShafati unyana kaAdlai ubephethe izinkomo ezisezigodini.
U-Obile u-Ishmayeli wayephethe izinkomo, no-Yehdeyahu waseMeronothi wabaphatha amakhoboka, no-Yazizi u-Hagri wabaphatha izimvu.
Bonke labo babe ngabaphathi abaphatha izinto zikaMkani uDavide.
UYonathani, udadewabo kaDavide, waba ngumqondisi, nomuntu owaziyo, nombhali; begodu uYehiyeli unyana kaHakmoni, waba ngumphathi wabantwana bakakumkani.
U-Ahitofeli ube ngumcebisi wobukhosi, uHushai wase-Arkhi waba ngumndeni kankosi.
Ngemva kuka-Ahitofele kwafika uYehoyada unyana kaBhenaya, noAbhiyathari; uYowabu ke waba nguMengameli womkhosi wombuso.

UDavide wabiza bonke abakhulu bakaSirayeli eYerusalem, abaholi bezizwe, nabaphathi bemikhosi esebenza ubukhosini, nabangane bamakhulu, nabangamakhulu, nabaphathi bomhlaba wonke, nempahla yonke yombuso, nabantwana bakhe, nabasebenzi bendlu yakhe, namadoda amakhulu, nabo bonke abantu abanothando olukhulu.

UDavide ukumkani wehla, wathi, Ningilalele, inkosikazi yami nezwe lami: Nginethemba lokwakha indlu yokuphumula ibhokisi lesivumelwano sikaYehova, ibe yindawo yokubeka izinyawo zikaThixo wethu; begodu ngacabanga ukuyenza.
Kodwana uzimu wathi kimi, Awuzokwakha indlu igama lami, ngombana ungumuntu wempi, begodu usuphuzile igazi.

Kodwana ikosi, uzimu kaSirayeli, wandikhethela emndenini wami wonke, ukuba ngibe ngukumkani phezu kwaSirayeli kuze kube sekupheleni; wakhetha isi(i)sizwe sakwaYuda ukuba ngumholi, begodu ezweni lakwaYuda wakhetha imindeni yababami. Ezinganeni zabazali bam, wathanda khulu ukungikwenza ngibe ngukumkani phezu kwaSirayeli bonke.
UYehova wandinika oonyana abaningi, kodwana kubo bonke wakhetha uSolomoni unyana wami, ukuba ahlale embhedeni wombuso kaYehova phezu kwaSirayeli.
Wathi kuye: USolomoni unyana wakho, yena ozokwakha indlu yami nezindlu zami; ngombana ngiwukhethele ukuba ngumntwana wami, begodu ngizoba ngubaba wakhe.
Ngizogcina ubukumkani bakhe kuze kube sekupheleni, uma eqhubeka esenza izimiso zami nemithetho yami, njengamanje.

Ngalokho manje, phambi kwabaSirayeli bonke, ibandla leNkosi, emazwini kaThixo wethu, gcinani bona nigcine yonke imiyalo kaYehova uzimu wenu, ukuze niyithathele lona elizweni elilungile, nilidlulisele ezindleleni zenu ngemuva kwenu kuze kube sekupheleni.

Begodu wena, kosi yami uSolomoni, yazi uzimu kababa wakho, uyisebenzele ngenhliziyo yakho yonke, nangemphefumulo othandekako; ngombana ikosi unquma zonke izinhliziyo, begodu uyaqonda wonke amaphupho nemibono. Uma umfuna, uzotholakala; kodwana uma umshiya, uzokususa kuze kube sekupheleni.
Khumbula bona ikosi ukukhethile wena ukuba ukwakha indlu ibe yindawo yakhe engcwele; ube ngumuntu onamandla, uyeke umsebenzi.
UDavide wanikeza uSolomoni, unyana wakhe, izithombe zodonga lwendlu kaThixo, nezindlu zayo, namagumbi ayo okugcina izinto, namagumbi alo aphezulu, namagumbi alo angaphakathi, nendawo yokugquma.

Wathi uSolomoni kuYoshuwa: "Njengombana umphefumulo wakho usesikhumbeni sakho, thola izithombe zezinto zonke ezingaphakathi ethempelini likaYehova, nezindawo zokugcina izinto ethempelini likaThixo, nezindawo zokugcina izinto ezingcwele.

Wathi uSolomoni kuMoses: "Njengombana ungenawo umsebenzi wokuphatha indlu kaYehova, begodu awukwazi ukuphatha zonke izinto ezisetshenziswayo endlwini kaYehova, ungasebenzisi isandla sakho sokudla noma isiphuzo; ngombana uMoya oNgcwele uyasebenza.

Wathi kuye bona iyiphi inqwaba yegolide okufanele isetshenziselwe zonke izinto zegolide ezisetshenziswa ehlobo ngalinye lenkonzo, nokuthi iyiphi inqwaba yesiliva okufanele isetyenziswe kuzo zonke izinto zesilivere ezisetshenziswa ehlobo ngalinye lenkonzo.

Wathi uMoses kuSolomoni: "Uzosebenzisa igolide, ukuze wenze izibani zegolide nezibani zazo, ngokwesisindo sazo zonke izibani nezingcingo zazo; begodu uzosebenzisa isiliva, ukuze wenze isibani segolide nesibani sayo, ngokuya ngemisebenzi yaso soke isibani.
Wathi kuye bona iyiphi inqwaba yegolide ongayisebenzisa ngethebulethi ngayinye yokudla okungcwele, nokuthi iyiphi inqwaba yesilivere ongayisebenzisa ngethebula lesiliva.
Wathi kuye bona zingaki igolide elihlanzekile ukuze lisebenzise ama-forks wenyama, amabhodwe okubhaka, nama-pitchers, nokuthi zingaki igolide nesilivere ngalinye legolide nesilivere.

Wathi kuthiwa uMoses watshela uSolomoni inani legolide elihlanzekile elizosetshenziswa emgodini womlilo, kanye nohlobo lwesithuthuthu samakherubi egolide, aveza amaphiko abo phezu kwebhokisi lomhlangano kaYehova.
Wathi uDavide, Ngasesandla sikaYehova kubhalwe konke lokhu kwami; begodu wangenza ngiqonde zonke izimo ezincane.

Wathi uDavide kuSolomoni, unyana wakhe, Ube namandla, ube nethando olukhulu, wenze umsebenzi; ungakhathazeki, begodu ungabi nenhliziyo ebuhlungu; ngombana ikosi uzimu, uzimu wami, uzobe nawe; akakushiyeli, akakushiya, kuze kuqedwe yonke imisebenzi yomsebenzi wendlu kaYehova.

Bheka, imindeni yamabhishobhi namadodana eLevi ikhona yonke imisebenzi yendlu kaThixo. Nabo bonke abantu abafisayo, abanekhono ngaso soke isikhathi sokwenza umsebenzi, bazosebenza nawe; begodu abaholi nabo bonke abantu bazokwenza konke okushoyo.

Wathi uDavide ukumkani kubo bonke isibingelelo, USolomoni unyana wami, owakhethiwe nguThixo, ungumntwana, akakwazi ukucabanga; begodu le misebenzi ikhulu khulu; ngombana leli ndlu alikho elinamuntu, kodwana liyiNkosi ikosi uzimu.

Ngamandla ami onke ngilungiselele indlu kaThixo wami, igolide ngezinto zegolide, nesilivere ngezinto zesilivere, nesiliva ngezinto zesiliva, nensimbi ngezinto zensimbi, nokhuni ngezinto zokhuni; begodu ngilungiselele amatshe e-onyx, namatshe okudweba, namatshe amhlophe anemibala eminingana, nezinye zonke izinhlobo zamatshe amahle khulu, namatshe omnqumo.

Naphezu kwalokho konke, ngenxa yokuthi ngithanda indlu kaThixo wami, ngabona bona nginikela ngezinto zami zegolide nesilivere endlwini kaThixo wami, ngaphezu kwayo yonke into engiyilungiselele lendlu engcwele.
Ngabona bona ngizonikela ngegolide elingaphezu kwekhulu lamatoni eOfiri, nesiliva elingaphezu kwezinkulungwane ezimbili namashumi amane amatoni, ukuze ligqoke izindonga zezindlu;
begodu ngemisebenzi yonke yegolide nesilivere, ukuze yenziwe ngalabo abasebenza ngayo; ngalokho-ke, ngubani na othanda ukunikela ngokupheleleko kuYehova namuhla?
Bathi abaphathi bezindlu zabazali, nabaphathi bezizwe zakwaSirayeli, nabaphathi bamashumi namakhulu, nabaphathi bemisebenzi yobukhosi, banikela ngokuzithandela.

Banikela, ukuze kwenziwe umsebenzi wendlu kaThixo, ngegolide elinamathani ayikhulu nesishiyagalombili, nezigidi ezingu-10 zezinhlamvu zesiliva, namathanethi angama-340 esilivere, nobhedu elinamakhulu amathathu anamashumi ayisithupha amatonela, namafutha omnqumo ayizinkulungwane amathathu.
Wonke umuntu obenezitshe ezisezingeni eliphakeme, wazisa emgodini wendlu kaYehova, engqondweni kaYehiyeli umGershoni.
Baze bajabulela abantu, ngenxa yokuthi abaphathi babo babenikela ngokuzithandela; ngombana babenikela kuYehova ngenhliziyo sabo yonke. Nakumkani uDavide wathokozela khulu.
UDavide wabonga ikosi phambi kwenkundla yonke, wathi: "Kukuhloswe wena, Kosi, uzimu kaSirayeli ubaba wethu, kuze kube sekupheleni!

uzimu, ubukhulu bakho, nekhono lakho, nobuhle bakho, nokuzinikela kwakho, nokunethezeka kwakho; konke okusezulu nasenhlabathini konke kuyinto yakho. Ubukhosi bakho, Kosi yami, bukhona kuwe; wena omkhulu ukudlula bonke.
Imali nenkundla zivela kuwe, begodu wena ulawula zonke izinto; amandla nokuzibophezela kuyisandla sakho. Ungenza wonke umuntu abe mkhulu, begodu unciphisa bonke.
Begodu manje, Kosi yethu, sikubonga, begodu sibonga igama lakho elingcwele.
Ngabe ngibani mina, nokuthi bangaki abantu bam, bona sikwazi ukunikela ngokuzithandela ngale le? Zonke izinto zivela kuwe, begodu thina sikulethela isandla sakho.
Sifana nabangani bakho, nabahleli ezindaweni ezahlukene, njengabababa bethu bonke; amalanga zethu emhlabeni zifana nesithunzi, azihlalanga.
Kosi yethu, uzimu wethu, le mali yonke esiyilungiselele ukukwakha indlu igama lakho elingcwele, ivela esandla sakho, begodu yiyo yonke.

Ngiyazi, Kosi yami, bona uhlola inhliziyweni, begodu uthanda ubuqotho bomuntu; ngalokho ngazinikela ngazo zonke lezi zinto ngenhliziyo ehlanzekile; begodu manje ngibona ngokunethezeka bona abantu bakho abakhona bayakunikela.
Kosi, uzimu wababa bethu uAbrahama noIsake noSirayeli, ugcine lokhu engqondweni yabantu bakho kuze kube sekupheleni, begodu uqinise intliziyo sabo kuwe.
USolomoni unyana wami, unikele umphefumulo ophelele, ukuze agcine imiyalo yakho, nezibopho zakho, nezimiso zakho, begodu akwenze konke okudingayo ukukwakha indlu engiyilungiselele.
Wathi uDavide kubo bonke isibingelelo, "Namuhla nibonga ikosi uzimu wenu." Ke bonke isibingelelo sabonga ikosi uzimu wababa babo, babhujiswa phambi koNkulunkulu nobukhosi.

Ngosuku olulandelayo banikela ngenhlanhla nomnikelo wokushiswa kuYehova, izinkomo ezingu-1, nezimvu eziyi-1 gestuιοra, izingulube zibe ngamaphesenti angu-1, kanye neminikelo yawo yokuphuza; begodu imindeni yakwaSirayeli ibe nemikhosi eminingi.

Badla baphuza phambi kukaNkulunkulu ngalolu busuku, bethokozela khulu. Bakwenza uSolomoni, unyana kaDavide, waba ngukumkani wesibili; bampompa phambi kukaYehova ukuba abe ngumholi, bampompa noTsadoki ukuba abe ngumpristi.
Wahlala uSolomoni esihlalweni sobukhosi sikaYehova, waba ngukumkani endaweni kaDavide, ubaba wakhe; waphumelela, begodu amaSirayeli onke amlalela.
Bonke abaphathi, nabanqobi abakhulu, nabo bonke oonyana bakaNdunankulu uDavide, bamemezela bona bazobe behlonishwa nguNdunankulu uSolomon.
Wakwenza ikosi ukuba mkhulu khulu uSolomoni phambi kwamehlo wonke amaSirayeli, wamnika ukuphakama kobukhosi obukhulu kunanoma ngimuphi ukumkani waseSirayeli owangaphambili kwakhe.
UDavide unyana kaYese waba ngukumkani phezu kwamaJuda wonke.
Iminyaka engu-40 walawula phezu kwaSirayeli; iminyaka eyisikhombisa eHebroni, begodu eminyakeni engamashumi amathathu nathathu eYerusalem.
Wafa emshadweni omnandi, ephila ubomi obude nobuhle. USolomoni unyana wakhe waba ngukumkani esikhundleni sakhe.
Zonke izinto azenzayo uDavide ukumkani, kusukela ekuqaleni kuze kube sekupheleni, zingakabhalweni ezincwadini zikaSamuweli umfundi, nezincwadi zikaNathani umprofeti, nezincwadi kaGadi umfundi?
Lokhu konke ukuphatha kwakhe, nekhono lakhe, nezimo zakhe, nalokho okwenzekile kuye, nakwaSirayeli, nakwezo zonke izizwe zezindawo.
2Chr: USolomoni, unyana kaDavide, waqinisa ukumkani wakhe; begodu ikosi uzimu wakhe waba naye, wamenza abe mkhulu khulu.
Wathi uSolomoni kiwo wonke amaSirayeli, kwabaphathi bamakhulu namawaka, nabaphathi bamakholo, nabahlengikazi, nabo bonke abavikeli baseSirayeli, abezinhloko zemindeni.

Wahamba uSolomoni, nomphakathi wonke naye, waya ezindaweni eziphakeme eziseGibheyoni; ngombana khona lapho bekukhona itente lokuhlangana likaThixo, itenti uMosis, umkhonzi kaYehova, ayelilungisa emfuleni.
UDavide wayesele ephethe isibambo sikaThixo esisuka eKiriyati-yearimi, waya endaweni ebeyilungiselele yona uDavide; wamisa itente laso eYerusalem.
Kodwana isibingelelo sesiliva, ebesiyilungiselele uBesaleyeli, unyana kaUri, unyana kaHuri, sahlala khona eGibeyon, phambi kwendlu kaYehova. Wahamba khona uSolomoni nebandla lonke, bebuza ikosi.
Wathi uSolomoni, afike esiqongweni sesiliva phambi koYehova, esitezi sokuhlangana, wanikela phezu kwalo izipho eziwukhulu zokuncibilika.
Ngaleyo busuku uzimu wabonakala kuSolomoni, wathi kuye, "Xhumana nanoma yini ofuna bona ngikunike yona."
Wathi uSolomoni kuThixo, Ukwenzele uDavide ubaba wami inhlonipho enkulu ngothando lwakho olukhulu; ngakwenza ngibe ngukumkani endaweni yakhe.
Ngalokho manje, Kosi yami uzimu, liqiniseke igama lakho oliyinikeze uDavide, ubaba wami; ngombana ungenza ngibe ngukumkani phezu kwabantu abaningi njengamatshe ehlabathini.
Ngiyakucela, nginike ubuhlakani nolwazi, ukuze ngikwazi ukuphuma ngapha nangapha kwalesi sizwe; ngombana ngubani ongakwazi ukuphatha isizwe sakho esiningi?

Wathi uzimu kuSolomoni, Lolu lwazi lukhona enhliziyweni yakho; awucelanga umnotho, noma imali, noma inhlonipho, noma inhliziyo yalabo abakuxoshayo, begodu awucelanga nokuphila isikhathi eside, kodwana ucele ubuhlakani nolwazi ukuze ube ngummengameli phakathi kwabantu bam, ngawe ngikwenza ube ngukumkani kubo.

ngalokho ngizokunika ubuhlakani nolwazi; begodu ngizokunika ubuhle, nempahla, nokudumisa, ngaphezu kwanoma ngimuphi ukumkani owawukhona phambi kwakho, begodu ngaphezu kwanoma ngimuphi ukumkani ozoba khona ngemuva kwakho.
Wasuka uSolomoni ezindaweni eziphakeme eGibeboni, phambi kwendlu yokuhlangana, wabuyela eYerusalem, waba ngubukhosi phezu kwaSirayeli.
USolomoni waqoqa izimoto zokugibela, namabhayisikili; waba nezigidi ezingu-1 zezimoto zogibela, namahhashi angama-12. Wabeka emizini yezimoto, naye waya eYerusalem.
Wakwenza bona isiliva negolide libe likhulu eYerusalem njengamatshe, begodu izihlahla zezikebhe zibe likhulu njengezihlahla ze-ficus ezisenyakatho.
Izikebhe zikaSolomoni zavela eYiputa naseKue. origin of the king's merchants bought them in Kue.

Baphuma emazweni aseYiputa, bethenga izithuthuthu ngeshekeli elilodwa legolide lamawaka ayisishiyagalombili, namabhayisikili ngeshekeli elilodwa lesiliva lamawaka amabili namashumi amahlanu; begodu bathengisa kubo bonke abaphathi bamaHethi, nabaphathi baseAram.
Wathi uSolomoni, Ngizokwakha indlu ngegama likaNkulunkulu, begodu ngibuye ngivule isibhedlela sobukhosi.

Wakhetha abantu abangumashumi asixhenxe amawaka ukuba bathwale izithuthi, nabantu abangumakhulu asibhozo amashumi amahlanu abanquma emadolobheni, begodu abantu abangumakhulu amathathu anamakhulu amathandathu ukuba babe ngabaphathi babo.
USolomoni wathumela kuHirame ukumkani waseTire, esithi, Sithumelele izinkuni zeqhwa, njengombana ukwenze kuDavide, ubaba wami, lapho ekwakha khona indlu yakhe ukuba ahlale kuyo.

Ngizokwakha indlu ngegama likaYehova uzimu wami, ukuze ngiyikhethele yena; ukuze siphuze khona isifutho sephunga elimnandi phambi kwakhe, nokudla okusetshenziswe ngokuqhubekayo, begodu silungiselele amadini omlilo ekuseni nakusihlwa, ezinsuku zosuku lokuphumula, nezinsuku zonyaka omusha, namaholidi kaYehova uzimu wethu. Lokhu kufanele kube yimithetho yabaSirayeli kuze kube sekupheleni.
Le ndawo yokuzinikela engiyenzayo kumele ibe mkhulu; ngombana uzimu wethu mkhulu kunawo wonke amasiko.
Ngabe ngubani ongenza indlu yakhe, uma izulu eliphakeme lingeke likwazi ukumgcina? Ngabe ngiwubani lo mntu ongenza indlu yakhe, ngaphandle kokwenza indawo yokudlidliza uvumba phambi kwakhe?

Ngicela, ngithumelele umuntu owaziyo ukwenza ngegolide, nesilivere, nesiliva, nensimbi, nezinto ezibomvu, nezingwevu, neziluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka, owaziyo ukudweba, kanye nalabo abawaziyo umsebenzi ezweni laseYuda naseJerusalema, abewalungiselele uDavide ubaba wami.
Uthi: "Njengombana ngiyazi bona labo abasebenzela wena bakwazi ukusika imithi eLibanoni, khona-ke nalabo abasebenza nami bazosebenza nabo.
ukuze nilungiselele inqwaba enkulu yemithi yami, ngombana ithempeli engiwukwakha lizoba likhulu begodu lihle.

Ngizobanika labo abasebenza nawe, abavuna imithi, ama-cors ayishumi nambili ayizinkulungwane zengulube, nama-cors ayishumi nambili ayizinkulungwane zoshizi, nama-cors ayishumi nambili ayizinkulungwane zewayini, nama-cors ayimashumi amabili ayizinkulungwane zamafutha.
Waphendula uHirame ukumkani waseTyre ngencwadi kuSolomoni, wathi, Ngokuba ikosi ethanda abantu bakhe, wakwenza wena ube ngukumkani kubo.
Wathi uHirame, Kuhloswe ikosi, uzimu kaSirayeli, owenza izulu nezwe, bona wanikeza ukumkani uDavide indodana eyaziwayo, enolwazi oluhle nokuqonda, eyakha indlu yoNkulunkulu, nayo indlu yakhe.
Ngizokuthumelela umuntu owaziyo, onolwazi olukhulu, igama lakhe nguHuram-Abi.

Ubaba wakhe ubengumDani, begodu udadewabo ubengumTire. Wazi ukwenza ngegolide, nesilivere, nesiliva, nensimbi, nensimbi, namatshe, nokhuni, nezinto ezibomvu, neziluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka, nezingwevu, nelinen emhlophe; wakwazi ukudweba ngazo zonke izinhlobo zezinhlamvu, nanoma iyiphi into afuna ukuyikwenza; naye uzosebenza nabantu bakho abaqeqeshiwe, nabaqeqeshwe ngunkosi wami uDavide, ubaba wakho.
Ngiyacela bona umnikazi wami athumelele abakhonzi bakhe imbewu, neshubhu, nophethiloli, newayini, owawuthi.
Sizomisa izihlahla ezidingekayo kuwe eLibanoni, sizithule emfuleni zifike eYopa; bese uzikhuphula ungene eYerusalem.
USolomoni wabala bonke abangaphandle ezweni laseSirayeli, njengombana uDavide, ubaba wakhe, ayebabala; kwaba ngumakhulu ayisishiyagalolunye anamashumi amathathu amawaka namakhulu amathandathu.

Wababeka phakathi kwabo amashumi asixhenxe amawaka abathwali, namakhulu asibhozo amawaka abantu ababhaka emadolobheni; wababeka phakathi kwabo amakhulu amathathu anamakhulu ayisishiyagalombili abaphathi, ukuze basebenzele abantu.
USolomoni waqala ukwakha indlu kaYehova eYerusalem, emfuleni iMoriya, lapho ikosi abevele khona kuDavide, ubaba wakhe, endaweni yokudla kuka-Ornani umJebusi, lapho uDavide ebeyilungiselele khona.
Waqala ukwakha ngomhla wesithathu wenyanga yesithathu, ngonyaka wesithupha wokubusa kwakhe.
