Lezo ziyizilinganiso azenzayo uSolomoni lapho emisa khona isisekelo sendlu kaThixo, ngokuya ngesilinganiso esidala; ubude bayo beyimitha eziyishumi nesishiyagalombili, nobubanzi bawo bube yimitha ezingu-ne.

Nalapho bekukhona i-porch engaphambili kwendlu kaThixo, ebanzi ngamasentimitha ayisishiyagalombili, ngokwesayizi yendlu kaThixo; begodu ubude bayo bemamitha ayishumi nesishiyagalolunye. Wazivikela ngaphakathi ngegolide elihlanzekile.
Wakha igumbi eliyinhloko ngebhodi le-pine, wazigqugquzela ngodayimane oluhle. Wazihlobisa ngezihlahla zezimbali nezintambo zokudweba.
Wazihlobisa indlu ngezintaba ezisezingeni eliphakeme, ukuze ibonakale inhle. Igolide lakhe lavela eParvaim.
Wazigqoka ngodayimane izindonga zendlu, nezingcezu zomnyango, namagquma, namasango ethempelini; waveza amakerubi ezindonga.
Wakwakha indawo engcwele khulu, imilenze emihlanu ubude bayo, kanye nobubanzi bendlu, nemilenze emihlanu ububanzi bayo. Wayigqoka ngegolide elihlanzekile elinamathani ayishumi nambili.
Isisindo sezinhlamvu zegolide saba ngama-gramu ayishumi nesishiyagalombili; begodu izindlu eziphezulu wazigqoka ngegolide.
Wakwenza ngaphakathi kwendawo engcwele khulu amakerubi amabili, agqokwe ngodayimane.

Ubukhulu bemilenze yama-kerubi kwakuyimitha eziyisishiyagalombili. Umlenze owodwa wekherubu lokuqala ube yizinyawo ezimbili ubude, ufinyelela edongweni lethempelini; umlenze wayo wesithathu waba yimizuzwana emihlanu ukuphakama, wafinyelela emlenzeni womlenze wokwesibini.

Iphini elilodwa lekherubi elilandelayo, elingamamitha ayisishiyagalombili ubude, lalimaza umgwaqo wesithathu wendlu; nephini elilodwa lekherubi elilandelayo, elingamamitha ayisishiyagalombili ubude, lalimaza iphini lekherubi lokuqala.
Amaphiko lawo amakerubi afinyelela emilenzeni emine, begodu amakerubi ahlala emehlweni abo, ebhekene ne ohulumeni bendlu.
Wakwenza ifasitela ngendwangu eluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka, nengwevu, nengwevu olumnyama, nelinen emhlophe; wawenza amakerubi kiwo.
Ebusweni bethempelini, wenza izinqola ezimbili, ubude babo buyimitha eziyisishiyagalombili; ngayinye yazo ingaphezulu kwemitha eyishumi.
Wakwenza amabhande, afana nezinhlamvu zegolide, wabeka phezu kwezinhlamvu. Wakwenza ama-granate ayikhulu, wabeka emabhandeni.

Wabeka izinqola phambi kwendlu, enye engxenyeni yasenyakatho, nenye engxenyeni yasenyakatho; wabiza igama lelinye engxenyeni yasenyakatho bona iJakini, kanti elinye engxenyeni yasenyakatho bona uBohazi.
Wakwenza isibambo segolide, esiyimitha eziyisishiyagalombili ubude bayo, namasentimitha ayisithupha ububanzi babo; begodu ukuphakama kwayo kwakuyizimitha ezingu-20.

Wakwenza begodu ibhodlela elikhulu legolide elijikelezayo, elalibizwa bona yilwandle. Lalilinganiselwa ngamasentimitha ayisishiyagalombili ukusuka enkundleni kuya enkundleni, lingaphezulu kwamasentimitha amabili ububanzi, lalinganiswe ngamasentimitha ayishumi nambili nesishiyagalolunye ukujula.

Engezansi kwengcindezi, yonke indlela ejikelezayo, bekukhona izithombe zezinkomo, ezingu-10 ngayinye ngemitha elilodwa noma njalo, zihamba eduze kolwandle. Izinkomo zazimigqa emibini, zenziwe ngomquba owodwa nolwandle.

Le lwandle lahlala phezu kwezinkomo zegolide eziyishumi nambili, amathathu zibheke ngasenyakatho, amathathu zibheke entshonalanga, amathathu zibheke enyakatho, kanye nezithathu zibheke entshonalanga. Le lwandle lahlala phezulu kwazo, begodu ikhanda labo libheke eningizimu.
Ulwandle lwalufana nobubanzi besandla esincane; imingcele yalo yakhiwa njengemigqa yekhofi, njengezimbali ze-lili; lalibambisa amalitha ayishumi nesishiyagalombili amakhulu mane.

Wakwenza begodu izitsha ezingu-10 zokuhlanza, wabeka eziyisishiyagalombili engxenyeni esenyakatho neyesishiyagalolunye engxenyeni esempumalanga; zasetshenziswa kuzo ukuhlamba izinto zomnikelo wokushiswa. Ulwandle lwaluyindawo yokugeza abapristi.
Wakwenza izitsha zegolide ezingu-10, ngokwezimiso zazo, wazisa ethempelini, eziyisishiyagalombili ngasenyakatho, nezishiyagalombili ngasenyakatho.
Wakwenza izitebhisi ezingu-10, wazisa ethempelini, eziyisishiyagalombili ngasenyakatho, neyesishiyagalombili ngasentshonalanga; begodu wenza amabhodwe egolide amakhulu.
Wakwenza nendlu yangasese yamabhishobhi, nendlu yangasese enkulu yangaphandle, namahlombe endlu yangasese; wagqoka amakhabethe ayo ngesiliva.
Wabeka umlambo engxenyeni esenyakatho, enkundleni yasenyakatho-mpumalanga yethempeli.
UHiram wakwenza namabhodwe, nezitsha, nezibhaka. Waqedela uHiram umsebenzi wakhe owawenza kubukhosi baseSolomoni endlwini kaThixo:
izinqola ezimbili; amathuluzi amabili afana nebhodwe engxenyeni ephezulu yezinqola; amasethisi amabili wezakhiwo ze-net ezigqugquzela amathuluzi amabili engxenyeni ephezulu yezinqola;
ama-pomegranates angumakhulu amane, eziqenjini ezimbili zokudweba kwengxowa-mali, imijondolo emibini yama-pomegranates ngayinye yengxowa-mali, eqoqa amabhodlela engxenyeni ephezulu emgodini;
ama-stands, nama-basins kuma-stands;
ilwandle, nezingulube ezilishumi elinambini ngezansi kwalo;
begodu amabhodwe, nama-shovels, nama-forks wenyama, nanoma iyiphi enye imishini. Lokho konke uHiram-abi wakwenza kukumkani uSolomoni, endlwini kaYehova, ngesiliva elimhlophe.
UMbuso Wasendulo wazenza zicwebezelwe ezindaweni ezi originile zeJordani, phakathi kuka-Sukhothi ne-Sareda.
USolomoni wenza lezi zinto eziningi khulu, bona akukho muntu okwazi nguyêna ukuqonda bona igolide liyikuphi.
Wakwenza noSolomoni zonke izinto ezikhona ethempelini likaThixo, isibingelelo segolide, nethebulethi yokudla okusetshenzisiwe,
ama-candles egolide elihlanzekile, nama-candles abo, ukuba umlilo phambi kwegumbi langaphakathi, njengombana umthetho washo;
izimbali zegolide, amalambu, nama-tangs, enziwe ngegolide elihlanzekile;
begodu amabhodlela, namabhayisikili, nezitsha zegolide elihlanzekile; kanye neminyango yethempelini, iminyango yangaphakathi yomhlaba ongcwele khulu nomnyango wendlu enkulu, eyenziwe ngodaka.

USolomoni, lapho eqedile umsebenzi wonke owawenza endlwini kaYehova, wafaka izinto eziboshwe nguDavide ubaba wakhe, isiliva, negolide, nazo zonke izitsha; wazisa ezindaweni zokugcina impahla zendlu kaThixo.

Wathi uSolomoni, wahlanganisa abakhulu bakaSirayeli eYerusalem, nabaholi bonke bezizwe, nabaphathi bezindlu zabazali bakaSirayeli, ukuba bakhuphule isibambo sesivumelwano sikaYehova esisuka emzini kaDavide, okunguZiyoni.
Bahlangana khona bonke amadoda aseSirayeli emkhosini wenyanga yesixhenxe, ekungeneni kobukhosi.
Bafika bonke abakhulu bakaSirayeli, baphakamisa amaLevi ibhokisi.
Bakhuphula ibhokisi, nethenda lokuhlangana, nazo zonke izinto ezingcwele ezingenayo; abapristi, abeLevi, babeziphatha.
USolomoni ukumkani, nomphakathi wonke wamaSirayeli, bahlangana naye phambi kwebhokisi. Banikela ngenkomo nengulube eningi khulu, bona akukho okwazi ukuyibala.
Bathi ababhishobhi bafaka ibhokisi lesivumelwano sikaYehova endaweni yalo, egumbini elingaphakathi lendlu, ezweni elingcwele khulu, libekwe ngezansi kwamaphiko amakerubi.
Amakerubi avule amaphiko akhe phezu kwendawo lapho isipho sakubo khona, begodu amakerubi awagqugquzela isipho kanye nemikhono yayo.
Ama-poles ayede khulu bona amaphethini abo angabonakali ngaphambili kwegumbi elingaphakathi, kodwana hhayi ngaphandle. Bangakhona nanamuhla.

Akukho lutho esiqhingini, ngaphandle kwezincwadi ezimbili zegolide, oMosese ayezibeka kulo emfuleni iHorebi, lapho ikosi wakwenza khona umhlangano nabantu bakaSirayeli, lapho bephuma emazweni aseYiputa.
Baphuma khona ababhishobhi ezindaweni ezingcwele; bonke ababhishobhi ababekhona, ngaso soke isikhathi, bahlanza izandla zabo.

Nabo bonke abaculi baseLevi, uAsaphe, noHeman, noJeduthuni, nabantwana babo, nabazalwane babo, babesenyakatho yesitezi somlilo, begqoke izicathulo zelinen emhlophe, bedlala ama-cymbals, nama-harps, nama-cantors; begodu nabo babekhona abapristi abangamakhulu amabili namashumi mahlanu, bephuza amabhubesi.

Bathi labo abaphuza amaphoyinti, nalabo abadlala umculo, bahlangana ndawonye ngezwi elilodwa ukubonga ikosi; bakhuphula amazwi abo, bewuhlonipha ikosi ngephoyinti, nama-cymballs, neminye imibhoshongo, besithi: Ulungile, ngombana uthando lwakhe luhlala kuze kube sekupheleni.
Abapristi abazange bahlale besebenza, ngenxa yezulu; ngombana ubuhle bukaYehova babugcwele indlu kaThixo.
Wathi uSolomoni, uzimu usho bona uzohlala ezindaweni ezimnyama.
Ngibuye ngakwakha indlu enhle kuwe, indawo yokuhlala kwakho kuze kube sekupheleni.
Ke kaloku ukumkani washintsha ikhanda lakhe, wabambisana nebandla lonke lakwaSirayeli, labo bonke bekhona.
Wathi, Kuhloswe ikosi, uzimu kaSirayeli, owakhuluma ngomlomo wakhe kuDavide, ubaba wami, wakwenza ngesandla sakhe, wathi,

Ngosuku lapho ngakhipha khona abantu bam ezweni laseMisri, angikhethi dolobha emlandweni wonke wamaSirayeli bona likhonjwe khona indlu ukuze igama lami libe khona; angikhethanga nomuntu ukuba abe ngumholi phezu kwabantu bam baseSirayeli.
Kodwana ngikhethe iJerusalema bona lihlale khona igama lami, begodu ngikhethe uDavide ukuba abe ngumholi wabami baseSirayeli.
UDavide, ubaba wami, wabeka engqondweni yakhe yonke ukukwakha indlu igama likaYehova uzimu kaSirayeli.
kodwana ikosi wathi kuDavide, ubaba wami, Ube nenhliziyo yakho yonke ekwenzeni indlu igama lami; kwakulungile bona ube nenhliziyo yakho yonke ekwenzeni lokhu.
Kodwana-ke, awuzokwakha wena indlu; unyana wakho oza kuvela emndenini wakho uzokwakha indlu igama lami.

UYehova uphinde wafeza ilizwi lakhe, wathi: "Ngizohlala endaweni kaDavide, ubaba wami, begodu ngizohlala ebukhosini baseSirayeli isinakho, njengombana uthe ikosi; begodu ngizokwakha indlu ngegama loYehova, farisi.
Begodu ngimise khona ibhokisi, eliqukethe umnqophiso kaYehova, obewenza nabantu bakaSirayeli.
Wahlala uSolomoni phambi kwesibingelelo sikaYehova, ebhekene nebandla lonke lakwaSirayeli, wamisa izandla zakhe.

USolomoni wakwenza isibambo sesiliva, esimaphakathi kwendlu yangasese; ubude bayo buyimitha eziyisishiyagalombili, ububanzi bayo buyimitha eziyisishiyagalombili, begodu ubude bawo buyimitha eyodwa. Wahlala phezu kwayo, wehlisa imilenze yakhe phambi komphakathi wonke wamaSirayeli, wamisa izinyawo zakhe ezingeni lezulu.
Wathi, Kosi, uzimu wakwaSirayeli, akukho uzimu ofana nawe emlilweni noma ezweni, wena ogcina isivumelwano nethando kubakhonzi bakho abalandela wena ngenhlalo sabo yonke;
Owugcinele umkhonzi wakho uDavide, ubaba wami, amazwi akho; owawuthi ngomlomo wakho, wawenza ngesandla sakho, njengombana kwenzeka namuhla.

Manje ke, ikosi, uzimu kaSirayeli, gcina lokho owathi kuye umkhonzi wakho uDavide, ubaba wami, wathi, Akukho muntu ozohlala phambi kwami ohlala esigabeni sikaSirayeli, uma nje izingane zakho zigcina zihamba emthethweni wami, njengokuba wena wahamba.
Ngalokho manje, Kosi, uzimu kaSirayeli, liqiniseke igama lakho oliyinqume kumkhonzi wakho uDavide.
Ingabe uzimu uzohlala emhlabeni namadodana akhe? Izulu, izulu eliphakeme kunazo zonke, alikwazi ukukuthwala wena. Ingabe le ndlu engiyinile?
Kodwana-ke, ngiyakucela, ulalele umthandazo womkhonzi wakho, nombukiso wakhe, Kosi yami, uzimu wami, ukulalela isikhalazo nesithandazo umkhonzi wakho esiwuthandaza kuwe.
Khumbula le ndlu usuku nosuku, indawo othi uzobeka kuyo igama lakho; ulalele umphefumulo womkhonzi wakho uma ethandaza kulolu hlangothi.

Uthi, "uzimu, ngikucela bona uphendule izicelo zomkhonzi wakho nomphakathi wakho waseSirayeli, lapho bethandaza kulesi siqhingi; ngikucela bona uphendule ezulu, endaweni yokuhlala kwakho, uphendule begodu ukhulule.
Uma umuntu ekhohlisa umngane wakhe, begodu ephoqwa bona aphike, afike aphike phambi kwesiqokobhe sakho kulo ndlu;
khona-ke, lalela ezulu, wenze, ugweme phakathi kwabakhonzi bakho; ugweme owinile ngokuvumelana nomsebenzi wakhe, begodu unqume onobulungisa bona angabi necala, ukuwakhokhela ngomsebenzi wabo.
Uma abantu bakho isiSirayeli behlaselwa phambi komshado wabo, ngenxa yobubi babo kuwe, bese bebuyela kuwe, beveza igama lakho, bethandaza, becela usizo phambi kwakho kulo ndlu;
usazise ezulu, ukhulule isono sabantu bakho baseSirayeli, ubabuyisele ezweni olinikeze labo nabababa babo.
Uma isibhakabhaka sivalwa, kungabikho imvula, ngenxa yokuthi abantu bakho babusile kuwe; bese bethandaza ezweni leli, behlonipha igama lakho, bebuyela emthethweni wabo, ngombana ubabambisene nabo;

ulalele ezulu, ukhulule isono samakhonzi akho nabantu bakho baseSirayeli, ubafundise indlela efanele yokuphila ngayo; begodu uthuthe umswakama phezu kwezwe lakho, elinikezwa abantu bakho ukuba libe yindawo sabo.

Uma kwenzeka indlala ezweni, noma umkhuhlane, noma ukulimala, noma inkungu, noma izingulube, noma amakhowa, noma uma isitha sibhekene nanoma iyiphi idolobha labo; noma yiziphi izimo ezibi, noma iyiphi isifo,
uma umuntu othile, noma bonke abantu bakho baseSirayeli, bethandaza, becela usizo kuwe, ngaso soke isikhathi lapho beyazi khona izinkinga zabo, bese befaka izinyawo zabo kulo ndlu;

khona-ke ulalele ezulu, endaweni yokuhlala kwakho, ugweme, ubenze wonke umuntu ngokuya ngalokho akwenzayo, njengombana uyazi inhliziyo yawo; ngombana wena kuphela owazi izinto ezingaphakathi kwenhliziyo.
ukuze bagweme wena, bahambe ngezinqumo zakho zonke amalanga abaphila kuzo phezu komhlaba owawubanikela ngawo ababuphikisi bethu.

Nalowo wesizwe, ongasekho kubo bonke abantu bakho isiSirayeli, uma efika ezweni elisendaweni enhle ngenxa yegama lakho elikhulu, nesandla sakho esinamandla, nomlenze wakho oqinile, bese efika ethandaza kulesi sakhiwo;

khona-ke uphendule ezulu, endaweni yakho yokuhlala, wenze konke okuzokubiza ngawo lo mngane wakho; ukuze zonke izizwe zezulu zikwazi igama lakho, zibe nokuthula nawe, njengabantu bakho isiSirayeli; begodu bayazi bona igama lakho libizwa ngendlu leyo engiyinile.
Uma abantu bakho bephuma empilweni, babhekane nobubi babo, ngaso soke isikhathi lapho uwathumela khona, bese bethandaza kulowo mzi owazikhethele wona, nendlu engiyenze igama lakho;
khona-ke lalela umthandazo wabo nokucela kwabo ezulu, begodu ubasize baphumelele.
Uma bekwenza isono kuwe, (njengombana akukho muntu ongeke akwenze isono), begodu uphoxekile kubo, wabanikela esidlangalaleni ebusweni bomshayeli wabo, ukuze abathunyelwe ezweni elidala noma elisha;
bese bebuyela ezandleni zabo ezweni lapho bathunyelwe khona, bese bebuya becela usizo kuwe khona, bathi, Sithole isono, sakwenza okumbi, sasebenza ngokungemthetho;

uma bebuyela kuwe ngenhliziyo sabo yonke, nangomphefumulo wabo wonke, ezweni labo lapho babeboshwa khona, bese bethandaza bebheke izwe lakho owalibanikela ngaso kubaba babo, nalesi sixeko osikhethile, nendlu engiyenze igama lakho:
khona-ke unqume ukuthandaza kwabo, nokuzicela kwabo ezulu, endaweni yokuhlala kwakho; usizakale kubo, begodu ukhulule abantu bakho abakhelele wena.
Ngalokho manje, Kosi yami, amehlo akho azovuleka, nezindlebe zakho zizolilalela udaba oluvela kule ndawo.
Uzovuka, Kosi uzimu, ufike endaweni yakho yokuphumula, wena nodoti wobukhosi bakho. Kosi uzimu, ababingeleli bakho bagqoke ukusindisa, begodu abangcwele bakho bajabulele ububi bakho.
Ngiyabonga, Kosi yami uThixouNkulunkulu, akufanele ushintshe isandla sakho emkhosini wakho ophakiwe; khumbula inhlonipho yakho yomkhonzi wakho uDavide.
Kwathi lapho uSolomone eqedile ukuthandaza, kwaphuma umlilo esibhakabhakeni, wabulala isonka esibomvu, namabhishobhi; begodu ubucwebe bukaYehova babugcwele indlu.
Abapristi abazange bakwazi ukungenisa ethempelini likaYehova, ngombana ubuhle bukaYehova bugcwele indlu.

Babona bonke abazalwane bakaSirayeli bona umlilo ukhuphuka, begodu babone ubuqotho bukaYehova phezu kwendlu. Baphoqeleka ukuba babeke izandla zabo emgodini, bathandaza, babonga ikosi, bathi, Ulungile; ngombana uthando lwakhe luhlala njalo.
Wathi ukumkani, naye wonke umuntu, wanikela ngezipho phambi koYehova.
USolomoni ukumkani wanikela ngezinkomo ezingu-22, nezingulube ezingu-120; ngaleyo le ukumkani nomphakathi wonke banikela indlu kaThixo.

Bakhona abapristi behlala ezindaweni zabo, namaLevi ezinhlamvu zomuzi kaYehova, azenzayo ukumkani uDavide ukubonga ikosi, lapho uDavide ekhuluma ngazo, ethi: "Uthando lwakhe luyaqhubeka kuze kube sekupheleni." Nakuba amaLevi ebhekene nabo, abapristi baphuza izidumbu, begodu bonke isiSirayeli behlala.

USolomoni wamisa indawo yaphakathi kwendlu yangasese, engaphambili kwendlu kaYehova, ukuba ibe ngcwele, ukuze afake khona izipho zokudlwengula, nenyama yezipho zokuthula; ngombana isibingelelo sesiliva ebesiyenze besingesincane khulu bona sikwazi ukuphatha zonke izipho zokudlwengula, nezipho zesonka, nenyama.

Kwathi lapho, uSolomoni wakwenza isikhumbuzo, naye wonke amaSirayeli naye, amalanga eziyisithupha; kwaba khona inqwaba enkulu khulu, evela emgwaqeni waseHamati enyakatho kuya emfuleni waseMisri enyakatho.
Ngosuku oluyisishiyagalombili bamisa isibingelelo esikhethekile, belungiselela amalanga ezisixhenxe ukuboniswa kwesihlalo sobukhosi, nezinsuku ezisixhenxe umkhosi.

Ngomhla wama-23 wenyanga yesixhenxe, uSolomoni wakhipha abantu ezindaweni zabo; babe bathandazela begodu bethokozela emiphefumlweni sabo ngenxa yobulungisa bonke obewenzayo ikosi kuDavide noSulaimane, nakwaSirayeli abantu bakhe.
USolomoni ke waqedela indlu kaYehova, nendlu yobukhosi; konke okungena engqondweni kukaSolomoni ngendlu kaYehova, nendlu yakhe, kwaphumelela.
Wabonakala ikosi kuSolomoni ngasebusuku, wathi kuye, Ngikuphendulile umthandazo wakho, begodu ngikhethe le ndawo yami ibe yindlu yomnikelo wokudla.
Uma ngivala izulu, ukuze kungabikho umhwamuko, noma uma ngitjho izingulube zidla izwe, noma uma ngithumela ukugula phakathi kwabantu bam,

uma abantu bami, ababizwa ngegama lami, benciphisa inhliziyo sabo, bethandaza, befuna ngami, bebuya ezindaweni zabo ezibi; khona-ke ngizokhuluma emazulwini, begodu ngizoxolisa inkohlakalo sabo, ngiyophilisa izwe labo.
Manje amehlo ami azovuleka, nezindlebe zami zizolilalela umthandazo ovela kulo mhlaba.
Ngikhethe le ndlu, ngiyingcwelele, ukuze igama lami libe khona lapho kuze kube sekupheleni; amehlo ami nezinhliziyo zami zizohlala khona.
Begodu wena, uma ulandela ngami, njengokuba walandela ngawo uDavide ubaba wakho, wenze konke okungiwisela umthetho ngalo, ugcine izimiso zami nemithetho yami;
ngizoqinisa isitulo sakho sobukhosi, njengombana ngathi kuDavide ubaba wakho, esithi, Uzoba nendodana elawula phezu kwaSirayeli.
Kodwana uma nibuya, nishiya izimiso nemiyalelo yami engibeka phambi kwenu, niya, nikhonza amanye amadini, nizibophezele kiwo;
ngizowususa uSirayeli ezweni lami, engiwawubanika lona; begodu indlu le, engiyingcwelele igama lami, ngiyoyishiya. Ngizoyenza ibe yindawo yokugxekwa, nendawo yokuhlukunyezwa phakathi kwamazwe onke.
Nakuba leli thempeli libukeka lihle khulu manje, kodwana wonke umuntu ohamba ngaso uzokhathazeka, begodu uzothi, Kungani ikosi ekwenze lokhu kule ndawo nalesi thempeli?

Bazophendula bathi, Ngenxa yokuthi bashiye ikosi, uzimu wabababa babo, owabasusa ezweni laseMizi-Yiputa, bathathe amadini amanye, bathandaza kubo, bewakhonza; ngalokho wazisa phezu kwabo konke lokhu okumbi.
Wathatha uSolomoni iminyaka eyishumi nambili ekwakha indlu kaYehova, nendlu yakhe.
USolomoni wakwakha kabutjha izidolobhana azenzayo uHirame, wamisa khona abantu bakaSirayeli.
Wahamba uSolomoni waya eHamati-Sobha, wayisazi.
Wakwakha begodu iTadmori esiqhingini, nezindawo zonke zokugcina izinto azenza eHamati.
Wakwakha kabutjha iBhetho-horon ephakeme, neBhetho-horon ephansi, imiphakathi eqinile enodonga, namasango, namabhodwe.
Wakwakha begodu iBhalathi, nezifunda zayo zonke zokugcina izinto, nezifunda zawo onke amabhayisikili, namabhishoshi; wakwenza konke okufunayo eYerusalem, naseLibanoni, nezweni lonke lakhe.
Kwakhona kwashiwo abantu abaseHithi, nama-Amori, namaPerizi, nama-Hivi, namaJebhusi; bebengaba yiSirayeli.
Bayindodana yalabo abazange babhubhise amaSirayeli ezweni. USolomoni wabacindezela ukuba babe ngabakhonzi bakhe, njengabakhona namuhla.
KwabeSirayeli bonke, uSolomoni akhenge asebenzele umsebenzi wakhe; babengamadodana akhe okulwa, nabaphathi bezinkunzi zakhe, nabahlengikazi bezimoto zakhe, nabahlengikazi bamabhayisikili.
Baye nabo abaphathi abakhulu bokumkani uSolomoni, abangamakhulu amabili namashumi mahlanu, ababephatha abantu.

USolomoni waphakamisa intombi kaFaro kusuka edolobhaneni likaDavide, waya endlu yakhe ayeyikwakha kuye; wathi, Akufanele indodana yami ihlale endlwini kaDavide, ukumkani wakwaSirayeli, ngombana indawo lapho isibambo sikaYehova sihlala khona iyingcwele.
Ngaleso sikhathi uSolomoni wanikela ngenhlanhla yokudlwengula kuYehova, phezu kwesibopho sikaYehova, ebesiwukwakha phambi kwendlu.

Wakwenza njalo ngosuku ngalunye, ngokwemiyalo kaMoses, ngezinsuku zeSabhati, nezinsuku zonyaka omusha, namaholidi amathathu eminyaka: iholidi lokudla okungaphekiwe, neholidi lamaviki, neholidi lezindawo zokuphumula.

Wabeka, ngokusho komthetho kaDavide, ubaba wakhe, izikhulu zebandla lamabhishobhi emisebenzini sabo, nalabaLevi emisebenzini sabo, ukuze basize amabhishobhi, begodu basebenze nabo ngosuku ngalunye; wabeka nama-portiers ngezikhulu zabo kumnyango ngamnye; ngombana lokhu kwakuyimiyalelo kaDavide, umuntu kaThixo.
Akekho osuka kinanyana iyiphi imiyalelo kakumkani, awawuthi kubo ababhishobhi nalabaLevi, uma bebhekene nezimpahla.
Ngalokhu kwaqedwa yonke imisebenzi kaSolomoni, kusukela ngosuku lapho kufakwa khona isisekelo sendlu kaYehova, kuze kube sekupheleni kwayo; begodu indlu kaYehova yaqedwa.
Wahamba uSolomoni waya e-Eshon-geberi, ne-Elathi, emfuleni waseEdom.

UHirame wathumela kuye izinqanawa, ngabasebenzi bakhe abakwaziyo ilwandle; bahamba nabangane bakaSolomoni befika eOfiri, babe negolide elinamathani ayishumi nesishiyagalombili, bamnika ukumkani uSolomoni.

Uthe unkosikazi wase-Shebha, lapho ekwazi khona igama likaSolomoni, wafika eYerusalem ukuwubheka ngombuzo onzima. Wafika nabangane abaningi khulu, nezingwegwe ezithwala izithako zokudla, negolide eliningi, namatshe abalulekile. Yafika kuSolomoni, yakhuluma naye ngazo zonke izinto zangaphakathi enhliziyweni yayo.
USolomoni waphendula yonke imibuzo yakhe. Akukho lutho olunzima khulu kuye ukuchaza.
Wabona unkosikazi waseShebha ubuhlakani bukaSolomoni, nendlu yakhe ebeyivulele.

Wabona ukudla kwetafula lakhe, nokuhlala kwabaphathi bakhe, nokusebenza kwabangane bakhe, nezigqoko zabo, nabenzi bakhe beziphuzo, nezigqoko zabo, namadini akhe okushiswayo, ayewanikela endlwini kaYehova; walahlekelwa wumoya wakhe.
Wathi kukumkani, Kulungile lokho engikubona ezweni lami mayelana nemisebenzi yakho kanye nolwazi lwakho.
Kodwana angikaze ngikholwa, kuze kube lapho ngafika, begodu ngabona ngezandla zami; begodu akhenge anitshele isiqingatha sezinhlonipho zakho. Ukhulu khulu kunalokho engikubonayo!
Kuhle khulu abantu bakho! Kuhle khulu abaphathi bakho, abahlala phambi kwakho nsuku zonke, belalela ubuhlakani bakho!

Ngiyabonga ikosi uzimu wakho, owakuthandela, wabeka phezu kwesihlalo sakhe ukuba ube ngukumkani kukaNkulunkulu uzimu wakho; ngombana uzimu wakho ethanda amaSirayeli, ukuze aqinise isikhundla sabo kuze kube sekupheleni, ngalokho wakwenza wena ukumkani wabo, ukuze wenze okulungile nokuhle.
Wayinikeza ukumkani itoni elilodwa legolide, neziphuzo eziningi khulu, namatshe abalulekile; akuzange kube khona iziphuzo ezifana nalezi unkosikazi waseSheba ayezinikela kuSolomoni.
Nabangani bakaHiramu, nabangani bakaSolomoni, abasuka eOfiri bethwala igolide, babethwala nokhuni lwe-almugibe, namatshe amahle.
Wasebenzisa ukumkani imithi ye-almuglam ukwenza izitezi zendlu kaYehova, nendlu yobukhosi, namahhashi, namabhayisikili abo abaculi. Akukho lutho olufana nalo ezweni laseYuda.
USolomoni ukumkani wabanika inkosikazi yaseShebha konke okufunayo, konke afunayo, ngaphezu kwalokho ayemnikeze uSolomoni ukumkani. Wabuyela ezweni lakhe yena nabangani bakhe.
Ngawo wonke unyaka uSolomoni wafumana cishe amathani ayishumi nambili nesikhombisa egolide.
Ngaphandle kwegolide elivela kilabo abahamba ngezimpahla, nalabo abahamba ngezimpahla; begodu bonke amakhosi ase-Arabhu, namaphathi ezweni lonke, babeletha uSolomoni igolide nesilivere.
USolomoni ukumkani wenza izigqoko ezinkulu ezingu-200, ezenziwe ngegolide elihlanganisiwe; isigqoko ngayinye sasebenzisa amakhilogremu ayisishiyagalombili wegolide.

Wakwenza begodu izigoli ezincane ezingumakhulu amathathu, ezenziwe ngodwala olungisiwe; ikhilogramu elilodwa nekhulu legolide lasetshenziswa ngazo zonke lezi zigoli; ukumkani wazibeka endlu yentaba yaseLibanoni.
Wakwenza begodu ukumkani isitulo esikhulu, sakhiwa ngegolide, sagqokwa ngodayimane.

Inkundla yebukhosi ibinezinhlangothi eziyisishiyagalombili, nesihlalo segolide esixhunywe kuyo. Kwabekho izikhonkwane ngakwesobunxele nakwesokudla kwesethi, kwabekhona ingulube uhlala eduze kwezikhonkwane ngayinye.
Kwabekho izimvu ezingu-12 zahlala emadolobhe maxime, ngayinye engxenyeni yazo zonke izinyathelo. Akukho lutho olufana nalo lwakhiwa kulo lonke elaseMpumalanga.
Zonke izinkomishi zikaSolomoni ziyigolide, begodu zonke izitsha zendlu yoMfula iLibanoni zaziyigolide elihlanzekile. Isiliva alizange libhekwe linezinzuzo eziningi ngesikhathi sikaSolomoni.

UMbuso wayenezinqanawa eziya eTarshishi, nazo zonke izinqanawa zikaHiramu; ngonyaka owodwa noma ngonyaka wesithathu zabuya lezi zinqanawa zithwala igolide, nesilivere, nobhontshisi, namahhashi, namakhowa.
USolomoni ukumkani waba mkhulu ukudlula bonke abaphathi bomhlaba, emnothweni nolwazi.
Wonke ubukhosi bomhlaba bafuna ukubona isandla sikaSolomoni, bona balalele ubuhlakani bakhe, obubeka uzimu enhliziyweni yakhe.
Ngawo wonke unyaka, ngaye ngamunye waletha izipho zakhe, izinto zesiliva negolide, nezigqoko, namathuluzi, neziphuzo, amahhashi, namabhuthi.
USolomoni wayenamahhashi ayizinkulungwane ezine, nama-carriages, namabhayisikili ayizigidi ezilishumi elinambini; wababeka emizini yama-carriages, naye eYerusalem.
Walawula phezu kwamakhosi onke, kusukela emfuleni i-Euphrates, kuya ezweni lamaFilisti, kuze kube yisiqhingi saseMizi.
Wakwenza bona isiliva libe likhulu eYerusalem njengamatshe, begodu izikebhe zibe likhulu njengezihlahla zezinkomo ezisenyakatho.
Izikebhe zikaSolomoni zavela eYiputa nakwamanye amazwe wonke.

Okunye konke okwenze uSolomoni, kusukela ekuqaleni kuze kube sekupheleni, akubonakali kubhalwe ezincwadini zikaNathani umprofeti, nezingxoxo ka-Ahiya waseShilo, namaphupho ka-Ido umbona, mayelana noYarobohami unyana kaNabati?
USolomoni waba ngukumkani eYerusalem phezu kwabaSirayeli bonke iminyaka engamashumi amane.
USolomoni waphumula, wabanjwa edolobhaneni likaDavide ubaba wakhe; uRehoboam unyana wakhe waba ngukumkani esikhundleni sakhe.
Wahamba uRehoboam waya eShechem, ngombana bonke isiSirayeli bebengafika eShechem ukuba abe ngukumkani.
UYarobohabhi unyana kaNabati, lapho ekhuluma ngalolu daba, wabuyela eYiputa, lapho wayesuka khona ngenxa yombuso kaSolomoni.
Kwafika uYerobohabhi, namadodakazi kaSirayeli wonke, bakhuluma noRehoboham, bathi,

Ubaba wakho wasebenza nathi kanzima khulu, wabeka umthwalo omkhulu emilenzeni yethu; namuhla ke uqinise umsebenzi wethu onzima nomsebenzi omkhulu owabeka ngawo ubaba wakho phezu kwethu, sizokhonza wena.
Wathi kubo, Kuzohlala amalanga amathathu kuze nibuye kimi; abantu ke basuka.
Ubukhosi buka-Rhobhohamu babuza isiphakamiso abantu abadala, ababesebenzela uSolomoni ubaba wakhe ngesikhathi ephilayo, besithi, Nithi yini uma ngiphendule labo bantu?
Bakhuluma kuye, bathi, Uma uzoba ngumkhonzi kilabo bantu, ubathande, ube nabo amagama amnandi, bazobe abakhonzi bakho yonke imihla.
Kodwana yena washiya incomo labo abakhulu ababemnika yona, wabuza izinja ezincane ezazikhula naye, ezisebenza kuye, bona zithi yini kuye.
Wababuza wathi kubo, Nithi yini, bona siphendule kanjani labo bantu abakhuluma nami, besithi: Ubaba wakho usisihlelele isisindo sakhe?

Wathi kubo amantombazane akhulela naye, uthi kilabo bantu abakutshele bona, Ubaba wakho ukwenze kube nzima isinqumo sethu, kodwana wena siwusheshe; kusho lokhu: Isandla sami esincane sinciphile kunamadolo kayise.
Ubaba wami wakwenza kube nzima kuwe, "isibopho sakho," kodwana ngizokwenza kube nzima khulu. Ubaba wami' wakwenza kube nzima kuwe; kodwana ngizokwenza kube buhlungu.
Wabuya ke uYarobhoamu nomphakathi wonke kuye uRehobhamu ngosuku olulandelayo, njengombana ukumkani atjhilo, esithi, Babuye kum usuku olulandelayo.
Wabaphendula ukumkani ngesandla esinzima. Ubukhosi uRehoboam akhenge acabange ngezincomo zamadoda amakhulu,

Wathi kubo, Ngokungafani nesinqumo samantombazane, wathi, Ubaba wami wakwenza kube nzima umsebenzi wenu, kodwana mina ngizowuqinisa; ubaba wamenza ube buhlungu ngezinhlamvu, kodwana mina ngizowucindezela ngezinkomo.
Ngalokho ukumkani akhenge aphendule abantu; ngombana lokhu kwakwenziwa nguzimu, ukuze ikosi aqinise amagama akhe, ayewakhuluma ngoAhiya waseShilo kuYarobhoamu unyana kaNabati.

Bathe bonke amaSirayeli bebona bona ukumkani akawalalelanga, baphendula abaSirayeli bonke ukumkani, bathi, Ingabe sinengxenye eDavideni? Asinayo inkontileka noyise kaYese. Yiya wonke umuntu ekhaya lakhe, uSirayeli; uDavide, bheka ikhaya lakho. Wahamba ke wonke amaSirayeli ezweni lakhe.
Kusukela lapho, uRehoboam waba ngukumkani kwabaSirayeli abahlala emizini kaYuda.

Ubukhosi buka-Rehoboam bathumela uHadoram, umphathi wabo bonke labo abasebenza ngesandla; kodwana amaSirayeli abulala uHadoram ngamatshe, wafa. UMbuso ka-Rehoboam wehlisa isithuthi sakhe, waya eYerusalem.
Ngaleyo le amaSirayeli asuka emndenini kaDavide, kuze kube namuhla.

Wafika uRehoboam eYerusalem, waqoqa abantu baseYuda nabaseBhenjamini, amashumi amathathu anamakhulu asibhozo amawaka abantu abakhethiwe, ukuba banqobe isizwe samaSirayeli, ukuze babuyisele ukumkani ku-Rehoboam.
Ke kaloku kwafika igama likaYehova kuShemaya, umuntu kaThixo, lithi,
Usho kuRehoboam, unyana kaSolomoni, ukumkani wakwaYuda, nakwabesilisa bonke bakaSirayeli ezweni likaYuda noBenjamini, uthi:
Uthe ikosi bona, Musani ukunyuka nibhekane nabazalwane benu; buyelani wonke umuntu ekhaya lakhe; ngombana ngangikwenzela lokhu. Bathobela ke amazwi kaYehova, bangahamba babhekane noYaroboham.
URehoboam wahlala eYerusalem, wakwakha emizini yaseYuda ukuze agweme.
Wakwakha uBethelehemu, noEthamu, neTekoa,
uBhethure, noSokho, noAdulamu,
neGathi, neMaresha, neZipho,
no-Adorai, neLakishi, neAzeka,
iSora, ne-Ayaloni, neHebroni; lezi ziyidolobhana eliqinile ezweni likaYuda noBenjamin.
Waziqinisa izindlu eziqinile, wabeka kuzo abaphathi, namanzi okudla, nophethiloli newayini.
Wabeka emadolobheni onke amagilavu namaphiko, waqinisa ngazo khulu; begodu uYuda noBhenjamin babe ngaphasi kwakhe.
Bafika abapristi nabaLevi, abavela kiwo wonke amaSirayeli, besuka ezindaweni zabo, bahlala naye.
Bashiya izifunda zabo, nempahla sabo, bafika ezweni laseYuda naseYerusalem; ngombana uYarobhoamu nonyana bakhe abavumelenga ukuba babe ngababhishobhi bakaYehova.
Wathi uYarobhoamu, akhethe abapristi bakhe, abe yibo abaphatha izindlu eziphakamileyo, nabenzi bezinkomo nezingulube.

Balandela labo abaLevi, kwafika eYerusalem, kusukela eziqhingini zonke zakwaSirayeli, labo ababeke intliziyo sabo ukubuza ikosi, uzimu wakwaSirayeli, ukuba banikela ngenhlanhla kuYehova, uzimu wabababa babo.
Baqinisa ukumkani wakwaYuda, basekela uRehoboam, unyana kaSolomoni, iminyaka emithathu; ngombana eminyakeni emithathu behamba ngendlela kaDavide noSolomoni.
URehoboam washada noMahalathi, indodana kaYerimothi unyana kaDavide, no-Abhihayeli, indodana kaEliaba unyana kaYese.
Waba nawo oonyana: uJeushu, noShemariha, noZahamu.
Ngemva kwayo, washada noMahaka, intombi ka-Absalomu; yena wamzalile uAbiya, noAtayi, noZiza, noShelomithi.

URehoboam wathanda uMahaka, intombi ka-Absalomu, ngaphezu kwazo zonke izifazane zakhe namadodakazi akhe; ngombana wayebenezifazane eziyisishiyagalombili nesishiyagalolunye namantombazane ayishumi nesithandathu. Wazalelwa oonyana abamashumi mahlanu anesibhozo nezindodana ezingamakhulu mane.
URehoboam wamisa uAbiya, unyana kaMahaka, ukuba nguMengameli phakathi kwabazalwane bakhe; ngombana wayefuna ukumenza ukumkani.

Wasebenza ngokuhlakanipha, wahlukanisa izingane zakhe ezizweni zonke zakwaYuda nakwaBhenjamini, ezindaweni ngazo zonke ezinodonga oluqinile; wabanikeza ukudla okunethezeka, begodu wabathola amadoda amanengi.
Kwathi lapho ubukumkani buka-Rehoboam buqinile, begodu enamandla khulu, wasuka emthethweni kaYehova, naye wonke amaSirayeli.
Ngomnyaka wesishiyagalombili wokubusa kukaRehoboam ukumkani, uShishaki ukumkani wakwaMisri wahlasela iYerusalem; ngombana bebengakholwa kuYehova.

Wafika ngemoto ezingu-1, namabhayisikili ayizigidi eziyizinkulungwane ezimbili, nabangani abahamba ngezinyawo abangu-60; waphuma naye umkhosi omkhulu khulu osuka eMizithini: abantu baseLibhi, neSukhi, nabaKushi.
Wathatha izidolobhana eziqinile zeYuda, wafika eYerusalem.
Wafika uShemaya umprofeti kuRehoboam, nakwabaholi baseYuda, ababeseJerusalema ngenxa kaShishaki, wathi kubo, Uthi ikosi, Nimi ningishiye; begodu manje nginishiye esandlani sikaShishaki.
Abaholi bakaSirayeli, nakumkani, baxosha izandla zabo, bathi, uzimu ulungile.

Uthe ikosi nakabona bona bahlukunyezwa, kwafika ilizwi likaYehova kuShemaya, lithi, Bahlukunyezwe; ngalokho-ke ngeke ngibasindise; ngizobabambisa ngokushesha, begodu ngeke ngiphuze inkohliso yami phezu kweYerusalem ngesandla sikaShishaki.
Bazobe abakhonzi bakhe, ukuze bakwazi ukubona bona yini ehlukile phakathi kokungisebenzela nami nokungisebenzela amabukhosi amanye amazwe.
Wafika uShishaki ukumkani waseYiputa eYerusalem, wathatha izimpahla zendlu kaYehova, nezimpahla yendlu yokumkani, nazo zonke izinto zakhe; wafumana begodu izigqoko zegolide azenzayo uSolomon.
Umbuso ka-Rehoboam wakwenza izigqoko zegolide, wazibeka endaweni yazo, waza azinikeza abaphathi bezigqoko zokuvikela, ababezigcina emgwaqeni wendlu.
Ngaso soke isikhathi lapho ukumkani ephuma khona endlwini kaYehova, befika abavikeli, babezithwala izibhamu, bese bezibuyisela ekamelweni labavigi.
Ngaleyo le, ngenxa yokuthi uRehovahabhi wanyamalala, inhliziyo kaYehova yabuyela kuye, ukuze agwenywe ngokuphelele; begodu bekukhona izinto eziningi ezinhle ezweni laseYuda.

Wayeneminyaka engu-41 ubudala lapho eqala ukuba ngukumkani; waba minyaka eyishumi nesishiyagalolunye emzini waseYerusalem, owakhetha wona ikosi phakathi kwezizwe zonke zakwaSirayeli, ukuze abeke khona igama lakhe. Ubaba wakhe wayenguNaama umAmoni, wayenguyise kaRehoboam.
Wakwenza okumbi, ngombana akhenge anikeze inhlonipho yakhe ukubuza ikosi.
Wonke umsebenzi ka-Rehoboam, kusukela ekuqaleni kuze kube sekupheleni, akunjalo ubhalwe encwadini yomlando ka-Shemaya umprofeti, no-Ido okubonayo, encwadini yomlando wemindeni?
Waphumula uRehoboam, washiswa edolobhaneni likaDavide; waba ngukumkani esikhundleni sakhe uAbiha unyana wakhe.
Ngonyaka oyisishiyagalombili wombuso kaYerobhoamu ukumkani, waba ngukumkani uAbiha ezweni laseYuda.
Wahlala iminyaka emithathu eYerusalem. Ubaba wakhe ubizwa bona nguMikaya, intombi ka-Uriyeli waseGibeha; kwaba khona umkhosi phakathi kukaAbiya noYarobhohamu.
UAbiha waya emdlalweni, enemikhosi eyikhulu elinamakhulu amane amawaka abantu abakhethiwe; uYarobhoamu wamisa umkhosi wakhe, enemikhosi engumakhulu asishiyagalombili amawaka abantu abakhethiwe.
Wahlala uAbiha emfuleni iZemarayimu, ezweni eliphakeme likaEfrayim, wathi, Ningikhulumela, wena uYarobohami, namadodana kaSirayeli onke!
Awazi yini bona ikosi, uzimu kaSirayeli, wanikela ukumkani kwaSirayeli kuDavide, naye nabantwana bakhe, kuze kube sekupheleni, ngesivumelwano esingenakuqothulwa, isivumelwano sekhowe?
Kodwana uYarobohabhi, unyana kaNabati, umkhonzi kaSolomoni, unyana kaDavide, wavuka, waba ngummelwane wakhe.
Bahlangana naye abantu ababi, nabangane bakhe, babhekana noRehoboam, unyana kaSolomoni. URehoboam wayencane, begodu wakhathazeka, akakwazi ukumelana nabo;

Ngiyabona bona manje nifuna ukubhekana nobukhosi bukaYehova, obusesandlani sabantwana bakaDavide; ningabantu abakhulu khulu, begodu ninezinkomo zegolide, azenzayo uYarobohabhi ukuba zibe ngamadini akho.

Uthi: "Akukho okunye ongakwenza ngaphandle kokushiya ababhishobhi bakaYehova, oonyana baka-Aron nalabaLevi, bese ukhetha ababhishobhi bakho, njengokuthi abantu basezizwe bakwenza? Nabani na ozofika nomuntu omncane wengulube, nenyama yenkomo eyisixhenxe, ukuze ahlanze inhliziyo yakhe, angaba ngumbhishobhi wezitha ezingaba yimimoya?
Kodwana thina, ikosi nguThixo wethu; asiwushiyenga. Sinezingane zika-Aron njengeziphathimandla zethu ezingcwele, kanye nalabaLevi abasebenza nabo.

nsuku zonke, ngazo zonke amalanga bamisa umnikelo wokudla nofuyo olunomsoco kuYehova; nabo abalungiselela isidlo sakusihlwa phezu kwetafula elihlanzekile, begodu bephatha isihlalo somshado segolide nezibani zayo, ukuze bazisindise ekuseni nakusihlwa.

Ngiyabona bona uzimu ukhona nathi, ehamba phambili yethu; namabhishobhi akhe ahlala lapha, ephethe amabhungane, ukuze abe nezwi lokugxeka phezu kwenu. Amadodakazi aseSirayeli, musa ukubhekana noYehova, uzimu wabababa benu; ngombana ngeke niphumelele.
Kodwana uYarobohabhi wathumela abantu bona bafihlakele eduze kwamadodana kaYuda; ngalokho amakhosi akhe aye phambi kwamadodana kaYuda, begodu labo abafihlakele babe ngasemuva kwabo.
Amadodana kaYuda abhekene nabo, nakabona bona bahlaselwa ngaphambili nasemva kwabo; baphoqa ikosi, begodu abapristi baphuza amabhungane.
Amadodana kaYuda ahlaba umxhwele; begodu lapho ahlaba umxhwele khona, uzimu wahlasela uYarobhohamu namadodana kaSirayeli wonke phambi kuka-Abiha nemindeni sabo.
Kwathi amaSirayeli aphuma ezweni laseYuda, begodu uzimu wabanikela kubo.
U-Abiha nomndeni wakhe babulala abantu abaningi khulu; kwaba ngumakhulu amahlanu amaphesenti amadoda akhethiwe eSirayeli abulawa.
Ngaleso sikhathi abaSirayeli bahlaselwa, kodwana amakhosi aseYuda ayenamandla amakhulu; ngombana bethembela kuYehova, uzimu wabababa babo.
UAbiha walandela uYarobhoamu, wathatha emizini yakhe: iBhethiyeli, neJeshana, noEfron, nezifunda zawo.
UYarobhoamu akhenge aphinde aqiniseke nsuku zonke wokuphila kuka-Abiya; ikosi wamshaya, wafa.
Kodwana uAbiha waya enamandla; wathatha izifazane ezilishumi elinambini, wazalelwa oonyana abangumashumi amabili nabini, nezingane eziyishumi nanye.
Okunye konke okwenze uAbiha, nokuphila kwakhe, namazwi akhe, akunjalo, kubhalwe ezincwadini zika-Ido umprofeti?
UAbhiya waphumula, wabanjwa edolobhaneni likaDavide. UAsa unyana wakhe waba ngukumkani esikhundleni sakhe. Ezikhathini zika-Asa izwe lahlala lihlanzekile iminyaka elishumi.
UAsa wakwenza okumbi, nokulungile emehlo kaYehova uzimu wakhe.
Wasusa izibingelelo zezinto ezingaphandle, nama-altare aphezulu ezindaweni zokugcina izinto, waphula amatshe ophahla lwamatshe, wavala ama-ashere.
Wathi kubo bonke abantu baseYuda bona bafune ikosi, uzimu wabababa babo, bagcine umthetho wakhe namalungiselelo akhe.
Wasusa begodu izindlu eziphakeme, nama-altare omlilo emazweni onke kaYuda. Umbuso wawuhlala ukhululekile ezikhathini zakhe zokubusa.
Wakwakha emizini enezindonga ezweni laseYuda, ngombana leli lizwe lahlala lihlanzekile; kwakungekho ukulwa ngaleso sikhathi, ngokuba ikosi wamnika isikhala.

Wathi kuYuda, Siyakwakha la madolobhana, siyibeke imingcele ngazo zonke izingcezu zawo, namabhodlela, namaphenyane, nezintambo; ngombana leli lizwe likhona ezweni lethu, ngombana sibhekene noYehova uzimu wethu. Sibhekane naye, wasisinika isiphepho ngaso soke isikhathi. Baphinde bakwakha, begodu bakwenza kahle.

Wabe uAsa unemikhosi yamaYuda, egqoka izibhamu ezinkulu nezibhamu ezincane, amashumi amathathu amawaka abantu; namaBhenjamini, agqoke izibhamu ezinkulu nezibhamu ezincane, amakhulu amabili namashumi asibhozo amawaka umuntu; bonke labo babe ngamadoda amakhulu.
Waphuma uZerah wase-Ethiopia, wabhekana nabo ngemikhosi eyizinkulungwane ezingu-100, namabhayisikili angumakhulu amathathu; waya kuze kube yiMaresha.
Waphuma uAsa ukumbheka, bamisa isibhamu sokulwa e origini yaseZefata, enhliziyweni yeMaresha.

UAsa wathandaza kuYehova uzimu wakhe, wathi, Ngiyabonga, Kosi, ngombana akukho muntu ongasiza obuthakathaka ngowenamandla, ngaphandle kwakho. Sisize, Kosi, uzimu wethu; ngombana thina sithembela kuwe; ngegama lakho safika kulo mkhosi omkhulu; Kosi, wena uzimu wethu; ngeke kube khona umuntu ozokwazi ukunqoba wena.
Wahlasela ikosi abaKushi phambi kuka-Asa noYuda, begodu babaleka.
UAsa nomndeni wakhe balandela, befika eGerari. Bakhulu khulu abantu base-Ethiopia abafileyo, abakwazi ukubuyela emuva; bahlaselwa nguYehova nomndeni wakhe. Amadodana kaYuda athathe izipho eziningi.

Babulala wonke amadolobhana asendaweni yaseGera; ngombana ukukhathazeka kweNkosi kwafika phezu kwawo, begodu bathatha zonke izinto ezibalulekile zalawo madolobhana, ngenxa yokuthi kwakunezinto eziningi.
Bahlasele begodu izindlu zababusi, bathathe izinkomo eziningi nezingulube, babuyela eYerusalem.
Wafika uMoya kaThixo ku-Azariya unyana ka-Odedi.
Waphuma ebhekene noAsa, wathi kuye: "Ningitshele, Asa, namadodana wonke aseYuda naseBhenjamini! UYehova ukhona nani uma niye naye; uma nimufuna, uzotholakalani; kodwana uma nimushiya, uzowashiya.
Ngosuku olude amaSirayeli ahlala ngaphandle kukaThixo okweliqiniso, ngaphandle kompristi ozowafundisa, begodu ngaphandle komthetho.
Ke kaloku, lapho bebhekene nenkinga, babuyela kuYehova uzimu kaSirayeli, bafunana naye, watholakala kubo.
Kulezi zinsuku kwakungaphephile bona umuntu ahambe. Izinkinga ezinkulu zazikhona kiwo wonke umuntu ohlala kule zindawo.
Izwe labhekana nezwe, begodu idolobha labhekana nedolobha, ngombana uzimu wabacindezela ngazo zonke izinhlobo zezinkinga.
Kodwana wena, ube namandla, ungabi necala; ngombana umsebenzi wakho uzothola umholo.

UAsa, lapho ezwa amazwi la mazwi ka-Odede umprofeti, waqinisa inhliziyo yakhe, wasusa izinyamazane kuzo zonke izifundazwe zakwaYuda nakwaBenjamini, namadolobhana ayewathatha emadolobheni asogwini lwaseEfraim; walungisa isibingelelo sikaYehova esibhekene nomnyango wendlu kaThixo.

Waqoqa bonke abantu baseYuda nabaseBhenjamini, nalabo abavela eEfraim noManase noShimeon, ababehlala phakathi kwabo; ngombana kwafika kuye abantu abaningi emazweni aseSirayeli, bebona bona ikosi uzimu wakhe ube naye.
Bahlangana eYerusalem ngowezithathu, ngonyaka oyisishiyagalombili wokubusa kukaAsa.
Banikela ngomnikelo kuYehova ngalolusuku olulodwa, ezindleleni ababezitholile, izinkomo eziyikhulu nesishiyagalombili, nezingulube ezingu-elilodwa.
Bakwenza isivumelwano, befuna ikosi, uzimu wababa babo, ngentliziyo sabo yonke, nomoya wabo wonke.
Wonke umuntu ongeke afune ikosi, uzimu wakwaSirayeli, kufanele abulawe, kube yindodakazi noma ibe yinkosikazi.
Bathi banikela umnikelo kuYehova ngezwi elikhulu, nangomsindo omkhulu, namaphoyinti namahhashi.
Bathokozela bonke abantu baseYuda ngalolu phawu, ngombana belubonile ngenhliziyo sabo yonke; bafuna ikosi ngothando lwabo lonke, watholakala kubo. Wabanika ikosi isikhala ngazo zonke izinhlangothi.
UAsa ukumkani wasusa noMahaka, udadewabo, ukuba abe nguwesifazane, ngenxa yokuthi wenza isithunzi esibi se-Ashera; uAsa wehlise isithombe sakhe, wayiphonsa emlilweni, wayazibulala eMfuleni weKidron.
Izindawo ezingcwele zentaba-mlilo azisuswa ezweni lakwaSirayeli; kodwana intliziyo kaAsa yayiyiqiniso yonke impilo yakhe.
Wafaka endlwini kaThixo igolide, nesiliva, namanye amathuluzi, ayewalungiselela yena nobaba wakhe.
Akukho mkhosi, kuze kube yiminyaka eyishumi nambili nesishiyagalombili yokubusa kukaAsa.

Ngonyaka oyisithathu nesishiyagalolunye wokubusa kuka-Asa, uBhasha ukumkani wakwaSirayeli waya ezweni laseYuda, wakwakha iRama, ukuze angeke kube khona umuntu ophumayo noma ofikayo ku-Asa ukumkani wakwaSirayeli.
Wathatha uAsa isiliva negolide ezindaweni zokugcina izinto zendlu kaYehova, nasezikhungweni zobukhosi, wazisa kuBhe-hadadi ukumkani waseAram, obehlala eDamaseki, wathi,

Ngiyakwenza isivumelwano phakathi kwami nawe, njengokuba kwaba khona phakathi kukababa wami nobaba wakho; bona, ngithumelele imali yesiliva negolide; uyeke isivumelwano sakho noBhehasha ukumkani wakwaSirayeli, ukuze angishiye.
UBhe-hadade walalela ukumkani uAsa, wathumela abaphathi bemikhosi yakhe emizini yamaSirayeli; bahlasela iIyon, noDani, neAbeli-mayim, namadolobhana onke okugcina izinto kaNaphtali.
Kwathi lapho uBhaasha ekubona khona, wayeka ukukwakha iRama, washiya umsebenzi.
Wathatha ukumkani uAsa bonke amadodana kaYuda, bathwala amatshe neemithi ayeyisebenzisa uBhahasi ekwakha iRama; wasebenzisa wona uAsa ekwakha iGebha neMizpa.

Ngaleso sikhathi wafika uHanani, umprofeti, ku-Asa ukumkani wakwaYuda, wathi kuye, Ngokuba ubeke isandla sakho emkhosini kakumkani waseSiriya, begodu awubeke isandla sakho emkhosini kaYehova uzimu wakho; ngalokho isizwe sikakumkani waseSiriya sithe saphuma kuwe.
AbaKushi nabaseLibhi babe yimikhosi emikhulu, benezithuthi zeqhwa, namabhayisikili amakhulu khulu; kodwana ngenxa yokuthi ubeke ithemba lakho kuYehova, wabanikela phambi kwenu.
Amazwana kaYehova abheka umhlaba wonke, ukuze anikeze amandla labo enhliziyweni sabo elungile kuye. Ukwenze lokhu ngokungaqondi; kusukela manje uzobe unamabhishobhi.
U-Asa wehluleke nombona, wabeka emgodini, ngenxa yokuthi wayephumile kuye ngalolu daba. Ngaleso sikhathi u-Asa waphatha abantu abathile ngokubi.
Zonke izinto azenzayo uAsa, eziqalekayo nazo eziphelile, zingakabhaliwe yini encwadini yamabukhosi baseYuda nabaseSirayeli?

Ngomnyaka weshumi nambili nesishiyagalolunye wokubusa kwakhe, uAsa wagula izinyawo zakhe, begodu isifo sakhe sakhula khulu; kodwana ngisho nasesifoni sakhe akhenge abhekane nozimu, kodwana ngabahlengikazi.
Wafa uAsa ngonyaka wesine nesishiyagalombili wombuso wakhe.

Bathi, "Uzobe uhlala ezweni lethu," begodu, "uzoba yindodana kaDavide." Bemfihla emgodini wakhe, owawusedolobhani likaDavide; babeka phezu kombhede, bewugqoka ngezinto eziphuzayo, nezingxube zezinto eziphuzayo, abazenzayo abantu abanolwazi.
UJehoshafati unyana ka-Asa waba ngukumkani esikhundleni sakhe, waqinisa ukumkani wakhe phezu kwaSirayeli.
Wabeka amaphoyisa kiwo wonke amadolobhana aseYiputa anezindlu zangasese, wabeka nezibhedlela ezweni likaYuda, nasezindaweni zakwaEfrayim, ayezithatha uAsa ubaba wakhe.
Waye ikosi noJehoshafati; ngombana wayehamba ngendlela kaDavide, ubaba wakhe, edlulele ngayo eminyakeni yakhe yokuqala, begodu akhenge akhonza amaBaali.
Wabhekana noThixo kababa wakhe, walandela imiyalo yakhe; akhenge akwenze ngendlela yabantu bakaSirayeli.
UYehova waqinisa ukumkani ngaphasi kwesandla sakhe; bonke abantu baseYuda banikela ngomnikelo kuJehoshafati, waba nemali enkulu nobudumo.
Inhliziyo yakhe yaphakama, ukuze ilandele indlela kaYehova; wasusa naseYiputa izindlu eziphakeme, nama-Ashere.
Ngomnyaka wesithathu wokubusa kwakhe, wathumela abaphathi bakhe, uBenhayeli, noObhadiya, noZekariya, noNethaneli, noMikaya, ukuba bafunde emizini kaYuda.
Wathumela nabo abaLevi: uShemaya, noNethaniya, noZebadia, noAshayeli, noShemiramoti, noYonathani, noAdoniya, noTobiya, noTobadinya; wathumela nabo uElishama noYoram, abapristi.
Bafundisa abantu ezweni laseYuda, begodu incwadi yomthetho kaYehova yaba nesandla sabo; bahamba ngazo zonke izifundazwe zakwaYuda, befundisa abantu.
Kwaba khona ukukhathazeka kweNkosi phezu kwazo zonke izizwe ezibhekene neYuda, ukuze zingangeni emkhosini noJehoshafati.

Nakwamanye amaFilisti aletha umnikelo kuJehoshafati, nemali yokukhokhela umsebenzi wakhe; begodu nalaba base-Arabhu bathumela kuye izinkomo ezincane, izimvu eziyimikhulu eyisixhenxe, nezimbuzi eziyimikhulu eyisishiyagalombili.
Wakhula uJehoshafati, waba mkhulu khulu; wakwakha izindlu eziqinile ezweni laseYuda, namadolobhana okugcina izinto.
Wagcina izimpahla eziningi emizini kaYuda, begodu wagcina eYerusalem abantu abakhulu, abanolwazi oluningi.
Ngabo, ngomndeni wabo, kwaba nguAdna umphathi wamakhulu, naye namadoda amakhulu amashumi amathathu amawaka;
olandelayo, uJohhanan umphathi, namakhulu amabili amashumi asibhozo;
begodu uAmasiya, unyana kaZikri, owanikela ngokwakhe ukuba asebenzele ikosi, nomakhulu amabili amawaka abantu abanamandla.
NgaseBhenjamini: uEliyada, indodana yomuntu onamandla khulu; naye wayenezigidi ezingu-200.
olandelayo, Jehozabade, namadoda angumakhulu ayisishiyagalolunye amawaka alungiselelwe ukulwa.
Baye labo abakhonza ukumkani, ngaphandle kwalabo abebeka ezindaweni eziqinile zedolobha lonke laseYuda.
UJehoshaphat ube nemali enkulu, nodumo olukhulu; wazama ukuhlangana noAhabhi.

Wathi uAhabhi: "Uzohamba naye eRamoti-gileadi," begodu, ngemva kweminyaka eminingana, wabuyela kuAhabhi eSamari. UAhabhi wabulala izimvu nezimbuzi eziningi kuye, nalabo abantu ababene naye, wakhuluma naye ukuba ahambe naye eRamathi-gileadi.

Wathi uAhabhi ukumkani wakwaSirayeli kuYehoshafati ukumkani wakwaYuda, Uzofika yini nami ukuhlasela iRamoti-gileyadi? Waphendula uYehoshafati wathi, Ngine nawe; abantu bami njengabantu bakho; sizohamba nawe.
Wathi uJehoshaphat kukumkani wakwaSirayeli, Kuze kube manje, ngikucela, buza ikosi.
Wathi ukumkani wakwaSirayeli, aqoqe amaprofeti, amadoda angamakhulu amane, wathi kubo, Sizoya eRamoti-gileyadi ukubhekana nokulwa, noma ngiyibeke phasi? Bathi, Yiya; ngombana uzimu uzoyisa emkhosini.
Wathi uJehoshafati, Ingabe akhona lapha omunye umprofeti kaYehova ukuze siwubuze?

Wathi ukumkani wakwaSirayeli kuYehoshafati, Kusekhona umuntu owodwa ongeke siwubuze ikosi ngaye; kodwana ngimthanda, ngombana akusho lutho oluhle ngami, kodwana okumbi kuphela: nguMikaya unyana ka-Imla. Wathi uYehoshafati, Akufanele ukumkani akhulume njalo.
Wathi ukumkani wakwaSirayeli, wabiza omunye wabaphathi, wathi, Thola ngokushesha uMika unyana ka-Imla.

Ubukhosi baseSirayeli kanye noJehoshaphat, ukumkani wakwaYuda, bahlala ezindaweni zabo eziphezulu, begqoke izicathulo zabo zobukhosi, behlala emgwaqweni ovulekile, enkabeni yesango laseSamariya; begodu bonke abaprofeti babekhuluma ngezulu phambi kwabo.
UZedekiya unyana ka-Kenanaha wenza izingulube zensimbi, wathi, Uthi ikosi, Ngalezi uzozibulala ngazo iziAram, kuze kube yilapho ziphele.
Bathi bona bonke abaprofeti ngomthetho owodwa, besithi, Yiya eRamoti-gileyadi, uphumelele; ngombana ikosi uzoyinikela emkhosini.
Wathi kuye umthunywa owawuye wabiza uMika, uthi: "Njengombana bonke abaprofeti bekhuluma ngezwi elilodwa ngokuhle kumkakhe; ngikucela, uxhumane nabo ngamazwi akho, ukhulume ngobuhle."
Wathi uMikaye, Uphila ikosi bona ngizokhuluma lokho uzimu wami akutjhoko.
Wafika ukumkani, ukumkani wathi kuye, UMikaye, kufanele sihambe eRamathi-gileyadi ukubhekana nokulwa, noma kufanele ngiyibeke phasi? Waphendula wathi, Yiya uphumelele; bazothunyelwa kuwe.
Wathi ukumkani kuye, Ingabe ngizokubiza ngamazwi aphikisayo, bona ungamitshela lutho ngaphandle kweqiniso ngegama likaYehova?

Wathi uMika, Ngabona bonke isiSirayeli behlukanisiwe emadolobheni amakhulu, njengamakhoboka angeke abe nomnikazi; begodu ikosi wathi, Leyo ndoda akukho mnikazi wayo; kumele ahambe wonke umuntu ekhaya lakhe ngoxolo.
Wathi ukumkani wakwaSirayeli kuYehoshafati, Angikushonga yini kuwe bona akakhuluma ngami lutho oluhle, kodwana ubuhlungu?
Wathi uMika, Yiqiniso, lalela ilizwi likaYehova: Ngibona ikosi uhlala esihlalweni sakhe sobukhosi, nemikhosi yonke yezulu ikhona ngakwesokudla kwakhe nakwesobunxele kwakhe.
Wathi ikosi, Nguwubani ozoba yingozi kuAhabhi ukumkani wakwaSirayeli, ukuba ahambe eRamoti-gileyadi, ukuze afe khona? Omunye wathi into eyodwa, omunye wathi enye.
Waphuma umoya, wahlala phambi koYehova, wathi, Ngizowukhohlisa. UYehova wathi kuye, Ngabe yini?
Wathi, Ngizophuma, ngibe ngumphefumulo wokukhohlisa emlonyeni wabaprofeti bakhe bonke. Wathi ikosi, Uzowukhohlisa, begodu uzophumelela; uye, yenza.
Ngalokho manje, bona, ikosi wabeka umphefumulo wokukhohlisa emlonyeni wabo bonke abaprofeti bakho; begodu ikosi uthe, Kuzofika kuwe ingozi.
UZedekiya, unyana ka-Kenanaha, wafika, wehlisa umlomo wakhe emlonyeni kaMikhaya, wathi, Ngayiphi indlela edlula ngayo umoya kaYehova ngami, ukuze akhulume nawe?
Waphendula uMika, wathi, Uzokwazi ngalolu busuku lapho uzohamba khona ekamelweni ngalinye ukuze ufihlakale.
Wathi ukumkani wakwaSirayeli, Nciphisa uMika, uyithumelele ku-Amoni umphathi wedolobha, noYowashi unyana kakumkani.
Nithi kubo, Lokho kusho ukumkani: Nciphisa lo muntu ezindaweni zokugcina izinto, begodu umnikeze ukudla okuncane namanzi, kuze ngibuye ngempilo.
Wathi uMika, Uma ubuyela ngokunethezeka, khona-ke ikosi akathethi ngami. Wathi ke uMika, Khumbulani lokhu, nibantu bonke!
Wahamba ke ukumkani wakwaSirayeli, naye uJehoshafati ukumkani wakwaYuda, waya eRamoti-gileyadi.

Wathi ukumkani wakwaSirayeli kuYehoshafati, Ngizogqoka izicathulo zami, ngiye emidlalweni; kodwana wena ugqoke izicathulo zakho. Wazigqoka ke ukumkani wakwaSirayeli izicathulo zakhe, waphuma emdlalweni.
Wathi ukumkani waseSirayeli wabawisela umthetho abaphathi bezimoto zakhe, esithi, Musani ukulwa nabani na, oncane noma omkhulu, ngaphandle komnikazi wakwaSirayeli.
Kwathi lapho abaphathi bezimoto bebona uJehoshafati, bathi, Lokho wukumkani wakwaSirayeli. Baphindela babhekana naye; kodwana uJehoshafati wavuma, begodu ikosi wamsiza; uzimu wabasusa kuye.
Kwathi lapho abaphathi bezimoto bebona bona akayena ukumkani wakwaSirayeli, babuyela emuva.

Kwathi umsolwa washaya isibhamu, engazange abeke isinqumo, sahlasela ukumkani wakwaSirayeli phakathi kwempahla yakhe yokuzivikela. Wathi ukumkani kulowo ophethe imoto yakhe, Yibuyela, ngisuse emidlalweni; ngombana ngidlwengula khulu.
Impi yaqhubeka ibuhlungu ngalolusuku lonke, begodu ukumkani wakwaSirayeli wahlala enkabeni yemoto yakhe ebhekene nabase-Aram kuze kube sebusuku; lapho ilanga liphuma khona, wafa.
UJehoshaphat, ukumkani wakwaYuda, wabuyela ekhaya lakhe eJerusalema.

Waphuma uYehu, unyana kaHanani, umbonayo, wambhekana naye, wathi kukumkani uJehoshafati, Uzosiza yini umuntu ongalungile, begodu uthandane nalabo abakhohlisayo ikosi? Ngenxa lalokho ikosi unesiyezi kuwe.
Kodwana-ke, kukhona okuthile okuhle kuwe; ngombana ukhiphe amatshe eAshere ezweni, begodu ubeke intliziyo yakho ukubuza uzimu.
Wahlala ke uJehoshafati eYerusalem; waphuma begodu phakathi kwabantu, kusukela eBhe-shebha kuze kube yindawo entaba yeEfrayim, wababuyisela kuYehova, uzimu wakwababa babo.
Wabeka abavikeli ezweni lonke, kiwo wonke lamadolobha aseYiputa anezindlu.
Wathi kilabo abavikeli, Khumbulani lokho nikwenzayo; ngombana angeke nigweme umuntu, kodwana nigweme ikosi; naye uzobe nani uma nigwema.
Ngalokho-ke, ukukhathazeka kweNkosi kufanele kube phezu kwenu, nibheke bona yini eninikele ngayo; ngombana ikosi uzimu wethu akabi necala; akabhekana nomuntu, begodu akathatha inkokhelo.
UYoshafate wamisa abantu eYerusalem, abaLevi, nababhishobhi, nabaholi bezindlu zakwaSirayeli, ukuba babe ngamagoli kaYehova, ukuze baxazulule izingqungquthela. Bahlala eYerusalem.
Wabamisa, wathi kubo: "Njengombana nikhonza ikosi ngokuthembekile, ngenhliziyo yenu yonke, ngothando lukaNkulunkulu.

Uma imindeni yenu uhlala emizini yenu ifika kuni ngecala lokubulala, noma ngomthetho, noma ngomyalo, noma ngezimiso, noma ngezimiso zomthetho, kufanele nibatshele ngazo zonke lezi zinto, ukuze bangabi nesono kukaNkulunkulu; ngombana uma benjalo, ubuhlungu bakhe buzofika kuwe nakubo bonke abazalwane bakho. Yenza lokhu, begodu ngeke ube necala.

U-Amariya, umpristi omkhulu, uzobe phezu kwenu kiwo wonke umsebenzi kaYehova; uZebadiya, unyana ka-Ishmayeli, umholi wezwe laseYuda, uzobe phezu kwenu kiwo wonke umsebenzi wokumkani; nalaba baLevi bazoba ngabaphathi bakho. Kuze kube namandla, nisebenze; begodu ikosi abe nabo abakwenzayo okulungile.
Ngemuva kwalokho, kwafika abantu baseMowabhi nabase-Ammon, kanye nabantu abathile baseMeunithi, bahlasela uJehoshafati.
Kwafika abantu, batshela uJehoshafati, bathi, Iqembu elikhulu livela eEdomi liya kuwe, lisuka ngaphesheya koLwandle Olufihliwe; bona, bahlala eHazason-tamari, elibizwa bona yiEngedi.
UJehoshaphat wakhathazeka, wamisa inhliziyo yakhe ecela ikosi, wathi kubo bonke abantu baseYuda bona baphuze inyama.
Bahlangana abantu baseYuda ukuba babuze ikosi, bevela emizini yonke yaseYuda, bona bafune ikosi.
UJehoshaphat wahlala phambi kwamadodana kaYuda nawaseYerusalem, endlwini kaYehova, phambi kwendlu entsha.
Wathi, Kosi, uzimu wababa bethu, awukho yini wena uzimu esibhakabhakeni? Ulawula phezu kwazo zonke izizwe zamazwe; unamandla obukhulu, akukho muntu ongakumelana nawe.
uzimu wethu, awazi bona uthathe izizwe ezihlala kulolu mhlaba phambi kwabantu bakho baseSirayeli? Awazi bona uyinikeze imbewu ka-Abrahamu umngane wakho kuze kube sekupheleni?
Bahlala kuyo, bakwakha khona ithempeli ukuhlonipha igama lakho. Bathi,

Uma sifika empilweni yethu, noma ukulwa, noma inkohliso, noma isifo, noma ukungcola, sizohlala phambi kwendlu lenu, nangemva kwakho; ngombana igama lakho likhona kule ndlu. Sizokhala kuwe empikisweni wethu, begodu wena uzosiphendula, usizakala.
Ngabona abantu baka-Amoni, namaMowabi, nedolobha elikhulu laseSeiri; lapho amaSirayeli ephuma eYiputa, awukaze uvumele ukuba bafike ezizweni zazo; ngalokho amaSirayeli asuka kiwo, awabulala.
Ngiyabona bona bangasikhokhela kanjani lokhu, uma befika ukusisusa ezweni olisinikezile ukuba libe yilungelo lethu.
uzimu wethu, awukawulungisa yini lo mkhosi? Asikho isandla sethu esikwaziko ukubhekana nalo mkhosi omkhulu ophuma ezweni lethu. Singazi bona singakwenzani; kodwana amehlo ethu abheke kuwe."
Bakhona bonke abantu baseYuda behlala phambi koYehova, nabangani babo abancane, nababhishobhi babo, nezingane zabo.
Wafika khona uMoya kaYehova kuYahaziyeli, owesiLevi, emndenini ka-Asaphi, indodana kaZekariya, indodana kaBhenaya, indodana kaYehiyeli, indodana kaMatania, lapho wayephakathi komphakathi.

Wathi, Ngisho, bonke abantu baseYuda, nabahlali baseYerusalem, nakumkani uJehoshafati: uzimu uthi kuni, Musani ukukhathazeka, noma ukuba nobuhlungu ngenxa yalo mkhosi omkhulu; ngombana lo mdlalo awuyena wenu, kodwana ngukaNkulunkulu.
NgoMsombuluko, zula ubhekane nabo. Bazofika ngendlela yokungena eZize. Uzowathola emgwaqeni obheke ezweni laseJeruyeli.

Ngiyakutjela bona awudingi ukubhekana nalo mqhudelwano, kodwana uhlale ezindaweni zenu, uhlale ezindaweni zenu, ubheke ikosi bona akusindise, wena uYuda noYerusalem. Ungakhathazeki, begodu ungakhohlwa; phuma ubhekane nabo ngoLwesihlanu, ngombana ikosi uneni.
Ke kaloku uJehoshafati wehla ngobuso bakhe phasi ezweni; bonke abantu baseYuda nabaseYerusalem bawela phambi koYehova, bewukhonza.
Baphuma namanye amaLevi, emindenini yamaKahati nemindenini yakwaKora, baphakamisa izandla zabo, babonga ikosi, uzimu kaSirayeli, ngezwi elikhulu.

Bavuka ekuseni, baphuma besuka ezweni laseTekoa. Beqala ukuphuma, uJehoshaphat wahlala, wathi, Ningilalelani, niYuda nabaseYerusalem; nikholwa kuYehova uzimu wenu, begodu nizohlala; nikholwa kumaprofeti bakhe, begodu nizophumelela.
Wakhuluma nabantu, wakhetha abaculi ukuba bahambe phambi komkhosi, bebonga ikosi ngenxa yobuhle bakhe obungcwele, besithi: "Nxusa ikosi, ngombana uthando lwakhe luhlala njalo."
Kwathi lapho beqala khona ukudumisa, ikosi wabeka abantu ababhekene namadodana ka-Amoni, namaMowabi, nezindawo eziphakeme zaseSeiri, aphuma ezweni likaYuda; babulawa.

Baphinde babuyela abantu base-Ammon nabaseMowabi, babhekana nabo bonke abahlala emfuleni iSeyiri, babulala bonke abahlala emfuleni iSeyiri; begodu lapho beqedile ukubulala labo abahlala eSeyiri, babuyela bahlaselana.
Kwathi lapho amaYuda efika endaweni ebhekene nesiqhingi, babheka phambili, bebona iqembu elikhulu; begodu bona, kubonakala sengathi izicubu zilele phezu komhlaba; kwakungekho muntu osele.

Wafika uJehoshaphat namadodana akhe, baqoqa izinto ezilahlekileyo. Bathola phakathi kwalabo abafileyo izinto eziningi zempahla, nezigqoko, nezinto ezinhle khulu; babezithatha ngaphezu kokukwazi kwabo ukuzithwala. Kwaba nzima khulu ukuzoziqoqa zonke, kuze kube yizinsuku amathathu.
Ngosuku lwesine bahlangana emfuleni i-Beraka, lapho babonga khona ikosi; ngalokho kwabizwa bona umlambo i-Beraka, kuze kufike ngalolu busuku.
Baphindela bonke abantu baseYuda nabaseYerusalem, noJehoshafati enhloko sabo, babuyela eYerusalem bethokozela; ngombana ikosi wabajabulisa ngabo ababi babo.
Bafika eYerusalem, baphuma ethempelini likaYehova, bedlala ama-harps, nama-cantors, namaphuzu.
Nokho, ukukhathazeka kukaThixo kwafika ezibukhosini zonke zalezi zindawo, uma beva bona ikosi wabhekana nabaphikisi bamaSirayeli.
Umbuso ka-Jehoshaphat wawunethezeka, begodu uzimu wakhe wamnika isikhala ngazo zonke izinhlangothi.

UJehoshafati waba ngukumkani ezweni laseYuda. Waneminyaka engamashumi amathathu anesihlanu ubudala lapho eqala ukumkani, wahlala iminyaka eyishumi nambili nesishiyagalombili engukumkani eYerusalem; indodana yakhe yayinguAzuba intombi kaShilhi.
Wahamba yonke indlela kaAsa, ubaba wakhe; akhenge ayishintshe, ekwenzeni okulungile ebusweni bukaYehova.
Kodwana izindlu ezingcwele zezintaba azisuswa, begodu abantu abazange babeke inhlonipho sabo kuThixo wababa babo.
Okunye konke okwenze uJehoshafati, kusukela ekuqaleni kuze kube sekupheleni, akubonakali kubhalwe emlandweni kaYehu unyana kaHanani, owabhalwa encwadini yamaNgisi aseSirayeli?
UJehoshaphat, ukumkani wakwaYuda, wenza isivumelwano noAhaziya, ukumkani wakwaSirayeli, owayengalungile khulu.
Bathi, "Sizokwakha izinqanawa eziya eTarshishi," begodu bazenza izinqanawa e-Ezion Geber.
UEliezere unyana kaDodavahu, waseMaresha, waprofetisa ngoJehoshafati, wathi, Ngokuba uxhumane noAhaziya, ikosi izobulala konke okwenzekile. Iinqanawa zaphoqwa ukuba zingahambanga eTarshishini.
Waphumula uJehoshafati, washiswa nababa bakhe edolobhaneni likaDavide. UYoram unyana wakhe waba ngukumkani esikhundleni sakhe.
UYoram ubenabazalwane, abanye oonyana baka-Jehoshaphat: uAzariya, noYehiyeli, noZekariya, noAzariya, noMikayeli, noShefatia; labo bonke babe yizingane zika-Jehoshaphat ukumkani wakwaSirayeli.
Ubaba wabo wabanika izipho eziningi zesiliva, negolide, nezitho ezibaluleke khulu, namadolobha aqinile ezweni laseYuda; kodwana ukumkani wamnikeza uYoram, ngombana yena wayeyindodana yokuqala.
Kwathi lapho uYoram ephakama ebukhosini bukayise, begodu eqinise isandla sakhe, wabulala bonke abazalwane bakhe ngeqhwa, nabanye abakhulu baseSirayeli.
UYoramu ubeminyaka imashumi mathathu nambili ezelwe, ukuba ngukumkani kwakhe; waba neminyaka esibhozo eYerusalem.
Wahamba ngezinqumo zamakhosikazi aseSirayeli, ngaso soke isikhathi ahambe ngayo indlu ka-Ahabhi; ngombana wayeyindodana ka-Ahabhi; wakwenza okumbi emehloni kaYehova.
Kodwana-ke, ikosi akafuni ukucima ikhaya likaDavide, ngenxa yesivumelwano sakhe noDavide; ngombana wayethi bona uzobe enikeza uDavide nezingane zakhe isibani somlilo kuze kube sekupheleni.
Ngosuku lapho uYoram engumnikazi khona, amaEdomi asuka eYuda, wakhetha ukumkani wakhe.
Wadlula khona uYoram, namadoda amakhulu akhe, nezithuthi zakhe zonke; begodu ama-Edomi awabeke phezu kwakhe. Wavuka ngobusuku, wahlasela aba Edomu nabaphathi bezithuthi zabo.
Ngaleso sikhathi iLibna yabuya nayo, ngenxa yokuthi washiya ikosi, uzimu wakwababa bakhe; ngalokho ama-Edom aphuma ngaphasi kwesandla sikaYuda, kuze kube ngalolusuku.
Wakha begodu izindlu eziphakeme emadolobheni amakhulu aseYiputa, waholela abantu baseYerusalem ukuba bakhohlise uzimu, njengendoda ethengisa isisu sayo; waholela namaJuda bona ahambe.
Kwafika ke kuYoramu incwadi evela kuEliya umprofeti, isithi, Uthi ikosi, uzimu kaDavide ubaba wakho: Awuhambanga ngezinqumo zikaJehoshafati ubaba wakho, noma zezinqumo kaAsa ukumkani wakwaYuda.

kodwana ukhambe ngezinqumo zamakhosi aseSirayeli, wabangela bona abantu baseYuda nabahlali baseYerusalem baphindwe ngami, njengokuthi ikhaya lika-Ahabhi laphindwa; begodu wabulala abazalwane bakho, oonyana bakababa wakho, abangcono kuwe.
Ngalokho manje ikosi uzobulala abantu bakho, nabantwana bakho, namabhishobhi akho, nezinto zakho zonke, ngengozi enkulu.
Uzothola ubuhlungu obukhulu emithanjeni yakho. Ngosuku ngalunye kuzoba buhlungu khulu kuze kube yilapho imithanjeni yakho iphuma khona."
Wavusa ikosi amaFilisti, nabase-Arabhu abahlala eduze kwabaKushi, ukuba bahlasele uYoramu.
Bafika ezweni laseYuda, bahlasela, bathatha konke okutholakalayo endlu kakumkani, nabantwana bakhe, namabhishobhi akhe; kwashiwo kuphela uYowahazi, unyana wakhe omncane.
Ngemuva kwalokho konke, ikosi wabulala uYoramu ngesifo se origini esingeke sithole ukwelashwa.
Kwathi ngemva kweminyaka emibini, izitho zakhe zaphuma ngenxa yokugula kwakhe, wafa ebuhlungu khulu. Amadodana akhe akhenge avule umlilo ukuhlonipha yena, njengokuba babeyenze kwabababa bakhe.

UYoramu ubeminyaka imashumi mathathu nambili ezelwe, lapho eqala ukumkani; waba neminyaka eyishumi nesishiyagalombili engukumkani eYerusalem. Akukho muntu owawumthandazela ngesikhathi esefa. Bawubulala emzini kaDavide, kodwana bekungase kube phakathi kwamagugu wamabukhosi.

Abantu baseYerusalem bakwenza uAhaziya, unyana wakhe omncane, waba ngukumkani esikhundleni sakhe; ngombana bonke abakhulu bakhe babebulawa yimikhosi esuka emazweni ase-Arabhu eyasesitezi. Waba ngukumkani uAhaziya, unyana kaYoram, ukumkani wakwaYuda.
UAhaziya ubeneminyaka emashumi mane nambili ubudala lapho eqala ukumkani; waba ngukumkani ngonyaka owodwa eYerusalem. Umzali wakhe wayengu-Athaliya, intombi kaOmri.
Wahamba begodu ngezindlela zomndeni ka-Ahabhi, ngombana udadewabo wayemtshela bona akwenze kabi.
Wakwenza okumbi emehloni kaYehova, njengombana bekwenze ikhaya likaAhabhi; begodu, ngemuva kokufa kukababa wakhe, babe ngabacebisi bakhe.
Wahamba, elandela incomo sabo, noYoram unyana ka-Ahabhi ukumkani wakwaSirayeli, wahlasela uHazayeli ukumkani waseAram eRamoti-gileyadi; begodu ama-Aram abulala uYoram.

UYoramu wabuyela eJezreyeli, ukuze aphilise izicubu zakhe, eziwulwe ngazo eRama, lapho ehlasela khona uHazayeli ukumkani wakwa-Aram. Waphuma uAhaziya unyana kaYoramu, ukumkani wakwaYuda, waya eJezreyeli ukubhekana noYoramu unyana ka-Ahabhi, ngombana wayefile.
Kwathi lapho efika khona uAhaziya, waphuma noYoram ukubhekana noYehu, unyana kaNimshi, umfazi ongumnikazi wendlu ka-Ahabhi, owayenqunywe nguYehova ukuba asuse indlu ka-Ahabhi.
Kusukela lapho uYehu ebulala khona ikhaya lika-Ahabhi, wafumana abaholi baseYuda, nabenzi bomndeni ka-Ahaziya, abasebenza ku-Ahaziya, wababulala.

Wahamba wafuna uAhaziya, begodu abakhonzi bakaYehu bamthola eSamari. Bamwisela kuYehu, babulala uAhaziya, babulawa naye; ngombana bathi, Uyise kaJehoshaphat, owabhekana noYehova inhliziyweni yakhe yonke; kodwana kwakungasekho umuntu onamandla emndenini kaAhaziya ukuba abe ngukumkani.
U-Athaliya, ubaba kaAhaziya, lapho nakabona bona unyana wakhe ufile, wehla wabulala wonke amakhosikazi aseYuda.

Kodwana uYoshabhetha, intombi kaYehoram ukumkani, wathatha uYohashi, unyana kaAhaziya, wabafihla emiphakathini yabantwana bakakumkani abazobulawa, wamfihla yena nobabakazi wakhe ekamelweni lokuphumula. UYoshabhetha, intombi kaYehoram ukumkani, indodana kaYehoyada umpristi, owayeyinkosikazi kaAhaziya, wafihla lo mntwana ku-Athaliya; ngalokho-ke uAthaliya akawubulala.
Wahlala nabo ethempelini likaThixo, efihlakele iminyaka emihlanu; begodu uAthaliya waba nguMengameli wezwe.

Ngonyaka wesixhenxe, uYehoyada wafumana inhliziyo yakhe, wabambisana nabaphathi bezikhulu eziyinkulungwane: uAzariya unyana kaYerohamu, no-Ishmayeli unyana kaYohanan, no-Azariya unyana kaObedi, no-Maaseya unyana kaAdaya, no-Elishafati unyana kaZikri.
Baye behamba ezweni lonke laseYuda, baqoqa amaLevi emadolobheni abo onke, nabaholi bezindlu zakwaSirayeli, bafika eYerusalem.
Wathi ke uYehoyada kubo, Thola, unyana wokumkani uzobe ngummengameli, njengokuthi ikosi wathi ngomndeni kaDavide. USolomoni naye waba ngumelwane wakhe, begodu wahlala endlwini yakhe.
Le yindlela ongayikwenza ngayo: isithathu sabantu bakho, abapristi nabaLevi, abebefika emini yeShabbati, bagcine izindonga.
ingxenye yesithathu izobe endlu kabukhosini, ingxenye yesithathu izobe emnyango wesisekelo; bonke abantu abasezindaweni zangaphandle zendlu kaYehova.

Akukho muntu ovunyelwe ukuba afike ethempelini likaYehova, ngaphandle kwababhishobhi nalabaLevi abakhonzayo; labo bangafika, ngombana bangcwele; kodwana bonke abantu bahlale ngaphandle, bagcine imithetho kaThixo.
Lawa maLevi azobe ebhekene nobukhosi, wonke umuntu enesibhamu sakhe esandleni sakhe; begodu uma kukhona ozama ukungena endlwini kaThixo, nizowubulala. Nizohlala eduze koMbuso lapho ehamba khona.

Bathi labo abaLevi, namadodana kaYuda wonke, bakwenza konke okumwiselayo uYehoyada ukumkani; bethatha bonke abaholi amadoda abo, labo abaphumayo emkhosini ngeSabhati nolabo abasukayo emkhosini; ngombana uYehoyada ukumkani wayengeke avumele umuntu ukuba ahambe.
UYehoyada umbingeleli wabanikeza abaphathi bamakhulu amabhodlela, namabhande amakhulu, namabhande amancane, ayewo ukumkani uDavide, abekwe endlwini kaThixo.
Wabeka bonke abantu, wonke umuntu enesithuthuthu sakhe esandleni sakhe, kusukela engxenyeni esekunene yendlu kuya engxenyeni esekhohlo, ngaphesheya kwesibingelelo nesihlalo sobukhosi.
Bakhipha ke unyana kakumkani, bamisa phezu kwakhe isibhakabhaka, nomthetho wesivumelwano, bakwenza ube ngukumkani; begodu uYehoyada nezingane zakhe bampompa, bathi, Uphile ukumkani.
U-Athaliya, lapho esikia khona umsindo wabo bonke abantu abahamba, nalabo abadumisa ukumkani, waya kubo endlwini kaYehova odibeni.

Wabheka, wabona ukumkani uhlala eduze kombhoshongo wakhe emgwaqweni wokungena, nabangani bakhe abakhulu, nabaphikisayo, bebhekene naye; begodu bonke abantu basezweni babezithokozisa, bephuza amaphoyinti, namacwecwe adlalayo abephethe ukubonga. U-Athaliya wehlisa izigqoko zakhe, wathi, Abaphikisayo! Abaphikisayo!

UYehoyada umbingeleli wathumela abaphathi bamakhulu, abephethe isibhakabhaka, wathi kubo, Yikhuphele ngaphandle phakathi kwezinqwaba zempi; nanoma ubani olandela yena, abulalane naye; ngombana umbingeleli ubethi, Ungambulalanga endlwini kaYehova.
Bathi ke, uma efika emgwaqeni we-Horse Gate, eduze kwendlu kakumkani, babulala khona khona.
Wakwenza uYehoyada isivumelwano phakathi kwakhe, naphakathi kwabantu bonke nobukhosi, bona bazobe abantu bakaYehova.
Wathi uMosis ku-Amoni: "Uya ethempelini likaBhaali, uyeke isakhiwo sakhe; begodu izibingelelo zakhe kanye nemifanekiso yakhe yamatshe yazibulala zonke.

UYehoyada wabeka umsebenzi wendlu kaYehova ngaphasi kwesandla samaLevi abapristi, abewahlukanisile uDavide endlwini kaYehova ngezigaba zabo, ukuze banikela ngenhlanhla izipho ezibomvu kuYehova, njengokusho komthetho kaMosesi, nokuzijabulisa nokugqugquzela, ngokwemiyalo kaDavide.
Wabeka abagwebi emigwaqweni yendlu kaYehova, ukuze akukho muntu ongcolile nganoma iyiphi indlela ongeke afike.

Wathatha abaphathi bezikhulu ezingu-makhulu, namadoda amakhulu, nabaqondisi babantu, nabo bonke abantu basezweni, wakhipha ukumkani ethempelini likaYehova, waya emnyango ophezulu wendlu kakumkani, wamisa ukumkani phezu kwesihlalo sobukhosi.
Abantu bonke bezwe baphumula, begodu idolobha lakhululeka; ngombana uAthaliya wabulala ngeqhwa.
UYowashe ubeneminyaka eyisikhombisa ubudala lapho eqala ukumkani; waba ngukumkani iminyaka engu-40 eYerusalem. Umkakhe wayenguSibiya waseBherisheba.
UYoashi wenza okulungile emehloni kaYehova, zonke amalanga wokuphila kukaYehoyada ukumkani.
UYehoyada wamthatha amadodanakazi amabili, wazala unyana nozina.
Ngosuku oluthile, uYoashi wacabanga ukulungisa indlu kaYehova.

Wahlanganisa abapristi nabaLevi, wathi kubo: "Niya emizini kaYuda, niqoqe imali ezweni lonke likaSirayeli, ukuze nilungise indlu kaThixo wenu ngonyaka ngamunye; begodu niyigcine ngokushesha." Kodwana amaLevi akhenge ahlele.

Wathi ukumkani wabiza uYehoyada, umbhishobhi omkhulu, wathi kuye, Kungani na bona ungathumeli amaLevi ukuba afike ezweni laseYuda naseYerusalem? UMosis, umkhonzi kaYehova, nezingane zakwaSirayeli babeke lezo zimali zendlu yomhlangano.
U-Athaliya, indodana yowesifazane onobubi, wavula ithempeli likaThixo, wasebenzisa izinto ezingcwele ethempelini likaYehova ukukhonza amaBaali.
Wathi ukumkani, bayenze ibhokisi lemithi, bayibeke ngaphandle, emnyango wendlu kazimu.
Baphoqelela bonke abantu baseYuda nabaseYerusalem bona baveze kuYehova inkontileka kaMosis, umkhonzi kaThixo, eyayinqunyelwe amaSirayeli esiqhingini.
Abaphathi bonke, nabantu bonke, bajabulela ukukwenza lokhu. Bathatha imali sabo, bayifaka ebhokisini, kuze kube ligcwele.

Kwathi lapho amaLevi efaka khona ibhokisi eziphathini zikakumkani, bese bebona bona kukhona imali eningi kulo, wafika umbhali kakumkani, nowesikhulu sikambingeleli omkhulu, wamisa phasi. Baphinde babeka ibhokisi endaweni yayo; bekwenza njalo usuku ngalunye, bethola imali eminingi.

Wathi ukumkani, noYehoyada, wabeka lemali ezindlebeni zalabo abaphatha umsebenzi endlwini kaYehova; bona baqasha abaholi bezindonga, nabenzi bezinhlamvu, ukuba balungise indlu kaYehova, nabenzi bensimbi nesiliva, ukuba bayiqinise.
Abasebenzi basebenze kanzima, begodu ukulungisa kwaqhubeka kahle. Baphinde bakwakha kabutjha ithempeli likaThixo ngendlela eyenziwe ngayo, bayenza ibe namandla.

Baqedile ukwakha, bakhipha imali eyayisele emkhosini noYehoyada, beyenza izinto zendlu kaYehova, izimpahla zomsebenzi wendlu kaYehova, nezinto zomnikelo wokudla, namabhodlela, nezitsha zegolide nesilivere. Ngosuku ngalunye lokuphila kukaYehoyada, kwaba khona amadini okushiswa ethempelini likaNkulunkulu.
UYehoyada waba mkhulu, waphila iminyaka eminingi; wayeneminyaka eyikhulu namashumi amathathu ubudala lapho wafa.
Wagcwaliswa phakathi kwabakumkani edolobhaneni likaDavide, ngenxa yezinto ezinhle khulu azenzayo kumaSirayeli ngoNkulunkulu nendlu yakhe. Concealed category
Kwathi, ngemuva kokufa kukaYehoyada, kwafika abakhulu baseYuda, babhujiswa phambi komkakhe; nomkakhe walalela imibono sabo.
Bashiya indlu kaYehova, uzimu wababa babo, bakhonza amatshe e-Ashere, namathoyizi; ngaleyo le kwafika ukukhathazeka kuYuda neYerusalem ngenxa sabo.
Wathumela kubo amaprofeti, ukuba ababuyisele kuye ikosi; bashumayela phakathi kwabo, kodwana abengawatholi.

Wafika uMoya kaThixo kuZekariya, unyana kaYehoyada umpristi; wahlala phezu kwabantu, wathi kubo, Uthi uzimu: Kungani na bona niphula amazwi kaYehova? Akufanele nikwenze kahle. Ngokuba nishiye ikosi, yena naye ushiye wena.
Bakwenza udaba kuye, begodu, ngenxa yomthetho kakumkani, bamwisela amatshe, wafa esitezi sangaphakathi sendlu kaYehova odibeni.
UYoashi ukumkani akhenge acabange ngothando uJehoyada, ubaba wakhe, owakwenza kuye; kodwana wabulala unyana wakhe. Nokho lapho uZekariya efa khona, wathi, uzimu angabona, begodu angakukhokhela.
Ngonyaka odlule, kwafika umkhosi wama-Aram ukulwa noYowashi; bahlasela iYuda neYerusalem, babulala bonke abakhulu bomphakathi, bathumela zonke izinto ezilahliwe kubo ukumkani wabo eDamaseki.
Iqembu lakwaSirayeli lincane khulu, kodwana ikosi wanikela ngaphambili labo iqembu elikhulu khulu; ngenxa yokuthi amaYuda ashiye ikosi, uzimu wabafazi babo; ngalokho kwathiwa kuYoashi.

UYoashi, lapho ama-Aram ephuma khona, wahlaselwa wubuhlungu obukhulu; begodu abakhonzi bakhe baphikisana naye, ngenxa yokubulala kwakhe unyana kaYehoyada ukumkani. Bamwisela emgodini wakhe, waba mnyama. Wagcwaliswa edolobhaneni likaDavide, kodwana akhenge afakwe ezindlini zokufa kwabakumkani.
Amadoda awaphikisayo ngaye nguZabadi unyana kaShimeathi, indodakazi ka-Amoni, noYozabadi unyana kaShimriti, indodana kaMowabi.
Nasezinkondlweni zakhe, nezinto eziningi ezithunyelwe ngaye, nokuthi walungisa kanjani indlu kaThixo, zibhalwe encwadini yamaNgisi. U-Amasiya unyana wakhe waba ngukumkani esikhundleni sakhe.
UAmasiya ubeneminyaka eyishumi nambili nesishiyagalombili ubudala lapho eqala ukumkani; waba ngukumkani iminyaka eyisikhombisa nesishiyagalolunye eYerusalem. Umkakhe wayenguYehodan waseYerusalem.
Wakwenza okulungile emehlo kaYehova, kodwana akhenge akwenze ngenhliziyo yakhe yonke.
Uma ubukhosi bube buqinile ngaphasi kwakhe, wabulala abaphathi ababulale ubaba wakhe umkweluleki.

Abantwana babo akawabulala; njengombana kubhalwe emthethweni, encwadini kaMoses, lapho ikosi ewiselayo, esithi, Abazali bangafa ngenxa yabantwana babo, nabantwana bangafa ngenxa yabazali babo; wonke umuntu azofa ngenxa yobubi bakhe.

UAmasiya waqoqa abantu baseYuda, wabamisa ngezindlu zabazali babo, abe ngabaphathi bezinkulungwane, nabaphathi bezikhulu, bonke abantu baseYuda nabaseBhenjamini. Wabala abaneminyaka eyishumi nesishiyagalombili nangaphezulu; wafumana amashumi amathathu amawaka akhethiwe, abanekhono lokulwa, abakwaziyo ukuthwala isibhamu nogesi.
Waqasha begodu amaphesenti angama-100 amaphoyisa amahle khulu eSirayeli, ngezinto ezingaphezu kuka-3 zegolide.
Kwafika kuye indodana kaThixo, yathi kuye, Ubukhosi, akufanele isizwe sakwaSirayeli sihambe nawe; ngombana ikosi akasekho nakwaSirayeli, ngaso soke isizwe sama-Efraim.
Nakuba ukhambe begodu ubhekane nethando, u-Allaah uzovumela umnakwabo ukuba akunqobe. U-Allaah unekhono lokukusiza noma ukukwenza uphume."
Wathi uAmasiya kulowo muntu kaThixo, Ingabe le imali yonke engiyikhokhele ikosi yamaSirayeli? Waphendula lowo muntu kaThixo wathi, uzimu unelungelo lokukunika okuningi kunalokho.
Wathi uAmasiya, wasusa abantu abavela eEfrayim ababefike kuye, wathi kubo: "Thina sizobuyela ekhaya lethu." Baphoqeleka ukuba bahambe ngenxa yothando lwabo lwamaYuda.
UAmasiya wehlise inhliziyo yakhe, waya eGoli leNhlanzi, wabulala abantu abangumakhulu ayisishiyagalombili baseSeiri.
Bathi ke uYuda: "Kubo bonke abantu abahlala ezweni lakwaSirayeli, labo abakhulu kunawo wonke, ngizowasusa emathunjini abo, begodu ngizowasusa emigwaqweni sabo.

Amadodana ka-Amasiya, akhenge avumele ukuba aphume empilweni yakhe, wahlasela izifundazwe zakwaYuda, kusukela eSamariya kuya eBethhoroni; babulala abantu abangumakhulu amathathu, begodu bathwala izinto eziningi.
UAmasiya, lapho ebuya ehlasela iEdomu, wafumana izitha zakwaSeyiri, wazibeka zibe ziyimikhosi yakhe, wazinikela ngazo, wazenza umlilo womlilo.
UYehova wagwema uAmasiya, wathumela kuye umprofeti, wathi kuye, Kungani na bona ukhonza izitha zalabo bantu? Baze bakwazi ukusindisa abantu babo phambi kwakho.

Wathi ukumkani kuye, Ngabe sikwenze wena ube ngumcebisi kumkakhe? Yiba khona; kungani ubulawa? Wayeka umprofeti, wathi, Ngiyazi bona uzimu unesiqiniseko sokuthi uzokubulala, ngenxa yokuthi wenze lokhu, begodu awuqondi isinqumo sami.
Wakhuluma uAmasiya ukumkani wakwaYuda, wathumela kuYoashi unyana kaYehohazazi, unyana kaYehu, ukumkani wakwaSirayeli, esithi, Yiza, sibhekane ngobuso nobuso.

UYohashi, ukumkani wakwaSirayeli, waphendula uAmasiya, ukumkani wakwaYuda, wathi, Umnqumo eLibanoni wawuthumelele umnqumo osematsheni aseLibanoni, esithi, Nceda unikele indodana yakho kumntwana wami ukuba abe ngumkakhe; kwathi kwafika isilwane sasendaweni esiseLibanoni, saphula umnqumo.
Uthi, "Uyinqobe i-Edom," begodu manje ufisa ukudubula; hlala ekhaya lakho; kungani ucela inhlekelele, ukuze ube yingozi kuwe, noYuda nawe?
Kodwana uAmasiya akhenge ayiqonde le nto, ngombana uzimu wakwenza lokhu, ukuze abonise isandla sakhe kubo, ngenxa yokuthi bakhonza amadini aseEdom.
Waphuma uYoashi ukumkani wakwaSirayeli, wabhekana naye noAmasiya ukumkani wakwaYuda emdlalweni eBhethe-shemesi, ezweni likaYuda.
USirayeli wahlasela uYuda, begodu wonke umuntu waseJuda waya ekhaya.

UYohashi ukumkani wakwaSirayeli wathatha uAmasiya ukumkani wakwaYuda, unyana kaYohashi, unyana kaYehohahazi, eBhethe-shemesi; wamletha eYerusalem, waphula ingqalasizinda yaseJerusalema kusukela ngesango likaEfrayim kuya ngesango lesiqhingi, amasentimitha ayishumi nesishiyagalombili.
Wathatha igolide lonke, nesiliva lonke, nazo zonke izinto ezifunwa endlwini kaThixo, ezigcinwe ngu-Obedi-Edom; wathatha begodu izimpahla zendlu kakumkani, nabangani bakhe, wabuyela eSamari.
UAmasiya unyana kaYowashi, ukumkani wakwaYuda, wahlala iminyaka eyisishiyagalombili ngemuva kokufa kukaYowashi unyana kaYehohazazi, ukumkani wakwaSirayeli.
Okunye konke okwenze uAmasiya, kuqala nokuphela, akubonakali kubhalwe encwadini yamaNgisi kaYuda nakwaSirayeli?
Ngaleso sikhathi lapho uAmasiya esuka enhliziyweni yakhe, engalandelanga ikosi, abantu baseJerusalema bakwenza umshado naye; waphuma waya eLakishi. Bathumela emuva kwakhe eLakishi, bambulala khona.
Bayamthwala emgwaqeni, bamwikela ezindaweni zakhe zokugcina izinto, bawufaka phakathi kwababa bakhe edolobhaneni laseYuda.
Abantu bonke baseYuda bathatha uUziya, owayeneminyaka eyisishiyagalombili ubudala, bamenza ukumkani endaweni kaAmasiya ubaba wakhe.
UUziya wakwakha kabutjha idolobhana lase-Elathi, labuya libuyiselwe ezweni likaYuda ngemuva kokufa kukababa wakhe.
UUziya ubeminyaka ilishumi elinamihlanu ezelwe, lapho eqala ukumkani; waba neminyaka eyishumi nambili nesishiyagalombili engukumkani eYerusalem. Umkakhe wayenguJekoliya waseYerusalem.
Wakwenza okulungile emehlo kaYehova, ngokwezinto zonke azenzayo uAmasiya ubaba wakhe.
