Wabhekana nozimu yonke imihla kaZekhariya, umuntu owaziyo bona agweme uzimu; ngaso soke isikhathi lapho ebhekene khona noYehova, uzimu wayemsiza.
Waphuma wahlasela amaFilisti, waphula izindonga zeGathi, neJabneha, neAshdodi; wakwakha izidolobhana eAshdodi, nakwamanye amazwe aseFilisti.
uzimu wamsiza ngabaFilisti, nakwa-Arabhu abahlala eGur-bhahali, nakwa-Meunithi.
Amadodana ka-Amoni anikela uUziya ngemali yomnikelo. Waba nomsindo kuze kube yilapho kufike khona umkhawulo waseYiputa, ngombana wayenamandla amakhulu.
U-Uziya wakwakha izindlu eziphakeme eYerusalem, endaweni yesango lendawo esemqoka, nasedonga loLwandle, nasengxenyeni yodonga, wazenza ziqinile.

Wakha begodu izindlu eziphakeme esiqhingini, wavula izintaba-mlilo eziningi; ngombana wayenazo izinkomo eziningi emadolobheni aphansi nasezindaweni ezisempumalanga; waba nezindawo zokulima kanye nezihlahla zezimbali ezimaphandleni nasezintabeni, ngenxa yokuthi wayethanda ukulima.
U-Uziya wayeneqembu eliqeqeshiwe lemikhosi, elinqunyelwe ukubhekana nempi; babalolwa nguJeyeli umbhali, noMaaseya umphathi, ngaphasi kwesandla sikaHananiya, owodwa wabaphathi bakakumkani.
Kube nezikhulu zemindeni ezingu-2 ezinqunyelwe ukuphatha le mikhosi enamandla.

Ngabo bekukhona umkhosi oyizinkulungwane amathathu neziyisishiyagalombili zamawaka namakhulu amahlanu abantu, abaqeqeshiwe ukubhekana nokulwa ngesandla esinamandla khulu, ukuze basize ukumkani ezimpini zakhe.
U-Uziya wanikela emkhosini wonke ngemikhumbi, namabhodlela, nezingcezu zokulwa, nezigqoko zokuzivikela, namathonsi, namathafa.

EJerusalema, waba nemishini eyenziwe ngabantu abaqeqeshiwe, ukuze ifakwe ezitezi nasezinhlangothini zezingcezu zodonga, ukuze kuqhutshekwe amabhodlela, begodu kube namatshe amakhulu. Waba mkhulu khulu emhlabeni wonke, ngombana uzimu wamsiza ngezindlela ezimangazayo, kuze kube yilapho wayenamandla.
Ke kaloku, lapho uUziya enamandla khona, ukudubula kwakhe kwaholela ekutheni agweme ikosi uzimu wakhe; wafika esibhedlela sikaNkulunkulu, ukuba asindise umlilo emgodini wokubulala umlilo.
U-Azariya umbingeleli waphuma emuva kwakhe, naye namadoda amakhulu amashumi asibhozo eNkosini.

Bafike kukumkani uUziya, bathi kuye, Uziya, akukubeni kwakho ukudlidliza insindiso kuYehova; yibo ababingeleli, oonyana baka-Aron, abanelungelo lokudlidliza insindiso; phuma endaweni engcweleni, ngombana sekuyinto oyenzayo, begodu ikosi uzimu wakho akakuhloniphi ngenxa lalokho.

U-Uziya wayenebhodwe lokudlidliza uvumba esandlani sakhe, waphoqelela; begodu ngesikhathi ephoqelela abapristi phambi kwesibingelelo sokudubula uvumba ethempelini likaYehova, kwavela isifo esibuhlungu emlonyeni wakhe phambi kwabo.

U-Azariya, umbingeleli omkhulu, nabanye bonke ababingeleli babhekana naye, bebona bona ubuhlungu bukhona emlonyeni wakhe. Bamukhipha ngejubane ngaphandle kwendlu kaThixo; yena wayehamba ngejubane ukuba aphume, ngombana ikosi ubemshaya.

UUziya ukumkani waba nesifo sesikhumba kuze kube yilapho efa khona, wahlala ekhaya elilodwa, ngenxa yesifo sakhe, akhenge afike ethempelini likaYehova. UYothamu unyana wakhe wayeyisikhulu sendlu kayise, elawula abantu basezweni.
UIsaya umprofeti, unyana ka-Amozi, wabhala konke origini nokuphela kwazo zonke izinto azenzayo uUziya.
UUziya waphumula, wabanjwa nababa bakhe ezindaweni zokuzibophezela zenkundla yomkhosi; ngombana besithi: "Ube negciwane." UYothamu unyana wakhe waba ngukumkani esikhundleni sakhe.
UYothamu ubeneminyaka eyishumi nambili nesishiyagalombili ubudala lapho eqala ukumkani; waba ngukumkani iminyaka engu-16 eYerusalem. Umzali wakhe wayenguYerusha, intombi kaTsadoki.

Wakwenza okulungile emehlo kaYehova, ngazo zonke izinto azenzayo uUziya ubaba wakhe; kodwana akhenge afike ethempelini likaYehova, njengokuba wayengene ubaba wakhe. Kodwana abantu baqhubeka besenza okumbi.
UYothamu wakwakha kabutjha isango eliphezulu ethempelini likaYehova, begodu wenza ukwakhiwa okuningi emgodini waseOfel.
Wakha izifunda ezindaweni eziphakeme zezwe laseYuda, namahholo nezindlu ezinkulu emadolobheni asendle.

Wahlasela ukumkani wama-Amoni, wababulala. Kwathi ngalo nyaka ama-Ammon ayemnika itoni elilodwa nesishiyagalombili segolide, namahora ayishumi embewu yengulube, namahora ayisithupha wengqolowa; begodu ngonyaka wesithathu neyesibili bayamnikela ngokulinganayo.
UYothamu waqhubeka enamandla, ngenxa yokuthi wayehamba ngokuzinikela kukaNkulunkulu wakhe.
Okunye konke okwenze uYothamu, nazo zonke izimpi zakhe, nezindlela zakhe, akubonakali kubhalwe encwadini yamaNgisi kaSirayeli noYuda?
Ubeminyaka imashumi amabili anesihlanu ezelwe, lapho eqala ukumkani; waba neminyaka engama-16 engubukhosi eYerusalem.
UYothamu waphumula, wabanjwa edolobhaneni likaDavide; uAhazi unyana wakhe waba ngukumkani esikhundleni sakhe.

UAhazi ubeneminyaka eyishumi nambili ubudala lapho eqala ukumkani, waba ngukumkani iminyaka engu-16 eYerusalem; kodwana akakwenzanga okulungile ngamehlo kaYehova, njengokuthi wayekwenzela uDavide umzali wakhe.
Wayehamba ngezinqumo zamakhosi aseSirayeli, wakwenza namatshe afana nalawo amaBaali.

Wakhipha umlilo emfuleni ka-Ben-hinnom, wakhipha nabantwana bakhe, waba yimikhosi yomlilo; wakwenza ngokwezinto ezingcolile zomhlaba, azenzayo izizwe, ezozibulala ikosi phambi kwamadodana aseSirayeli.
Wanikela ngezinhlanzi, wasindisa umlilo emadolobheni amahle, nasezindaweni eziphakeme, nasezikhungweni, nangaphansi komthi onsundu.

Wathi ikosi, uzimu wakhe, wamnikela phambi kukakumkani waseSirayeli. Bawuhlasela, bathatha abantu bakhe abafileyo baya eDamaseki; wabekwa begodu phambi komkani wakwaSirayeli, wababulala abantu bakhe abaningi khulu.
UPekahi unyana ka-Remaliya wabulala ezweni laseYuda abantu abakhulu abangumakhulu amabili anamashumi amahlanu amawaka, ngosuku olulodwa, ngenxa yokuthi bashiye ikosi, uzimu wabababa babo.
UZikri, umfazi onamandla, waseEphrayi, wabulala uMaasihiya, unyana kankosi, noAzrikam, umphathi wendlu, noElkana, owayenguMengameli wesithathu.
Bathi ke amaSirayeli, bathathe abahlobo babo ezweni laseYuda, amadodana abo, namadodakazi abo, amashumi amabili amawaka abantu; begodu babe nempahla enkulu khulu, bayisa eSamari.

Kwabe khona khona umprofeti kaYehova, igama lakhe ngu-Odedi; waphuma wahlangana nalo mkhosi, lapho befika eSamariya, wathi, Beka, ngenxa yokuthi ikosi, uzimu wabababa bakho, ekhala ngezwe lakwaYuda, wabanikela enhliziyweni yenu; kodwana niwabulala ngobuhlungu obufinyelele esibhakabhakeni.
Ngiyabona bona nicabanga ukwenza abantu baseYuda nabaseJerusalema babe ngabakhonzi benu, amadoda nababhishobhi; kodwana-ke, ningabi nobubi phambi kuYehova uzimu wenu?
Manje, ngikutshele, ubuyisele ababoshwa, obaba bakho nibathathe; ngombana inkohliso yomlilo kaYehova ikhona phezu kwenu.
Basuka khona abanye abakhulu baseEfrayim, babhekana nalabo ababebuya emkhosini: uAzariya unyana kaYohanani, noBerekiya unyana kaMeshilemothi, noYehezkiya unyana kaShalumu, noAmasa unyana kaHadlayi.
Bathi kubo, Musani ukuletha lapha labo ababoshwe; ngombana nizongeza kububi bethu nobubi bethu phambi koYehova; ngombana ububi bethu bukhulu khulu, begodu inkohliso yakhe inamandla phezu kwaSirayeli.
Lawa mabutho ashiya abafileyo nento elahlekile phambi kwabaphathi kanye nabantu bonke.

Bathi, "Bona udadewethu," waphendula yena, "ubani owaziyo bona ngikhona?" Wathi kubo, "Akekho umuntu owaziyo bona ngikhona." Bathi, "Intombi yami," waphendula yena, "ayikho intombi yami," Bathi, "Intombi yami," waphendula yena, "ingane yami," Bathi, "Indodakazi yami," waphendula yena.
Ngaleso sikhathi ukumkani u-Ahazi wacela usizo kumakumkani base-Ashuri.
Baphinde babuya aba-Edomi, bahlasela uYuda, bathatha abantu abafileyo.
Baphinde bahlasela amadolobhana asezintabeni, namadolobhana asenyakatho yezwe laseYuda; bathatha iBethe-shemesi, neAyaloni, neGederothi, neSoko, neThimna, neGimzo nezifunda zawo, bahlala kuzo.
uzimu wakhuphula uYuda ngenxa ka-Ahazazi ukumkani wakwaSirayeli, ngombana yena washiya izwe likaYuda lihambe, wakwenza okumbi khulu kuYehova.
Wafika kuye uTiglatha-pilesere ukumkani wakwa-Ashuri, wakwenza umonakalo, engasizakali.
U-Ahashe wathatha izimpahla zendlu kaNdikhoyo, nezimpahla yendlu kaSirayeli, nezimpahla yamadoda amakhulu, wayazinika ukumkani wase-Ashuri; kodwana kwakungasizakali.
Ngaleso sikhathi, lapho ebhekene nezinkinga, ukumkani uAhabhi waqhubeka nokwenza okumbi kukaNkulunkulu.

Wanikela ngamadini amagugu aseDamaseki, awawumbulala. Wathi, "Imimoya yamabukhosi baseSirayeli isiza labo; ngalokho ngizonikela ngamakhambi azo, ukuze bandise usizo lwami." Nokho wabangela ukufa kwakhe, nokufa kwabaSirayeli bonke.
U-Ahazazi waqoqa zonke izinto zendlu kaThixo, wazenza izingcezu ezincane, wavala iminyango yendlu kaYehova, wamisa izibingelelo ezindaweni zomhlaba wonke zaseYerusalem.
Wakha izindlu eziphakeme ezweni lonke laseYuda, ukuze asindise umlilo emadini angaphandle; ngaleyo le wamangalisa ikosi, uzimu wakwababa bakhe.
Okunye konke okwenze, nezindlela zakhe zonke, kusukela ekuqaleni kuze kube sekupheleni, akubonakali kubhalwe encwadini yamaNgisi kaYuda nakwaSirayeli?
Wafa uAhazi, washiswa eJerusalema, kodwana akhenge agcinwe emgodini wamabukhosi bamaSirayeli. UHezekiya unyana wakhe waba ngukumkani esikhundleni sakhe.

UHezekiya ubeneminyaka eyishumi nambili nesishiyagalombili ubudala lapho eqala ukumkani; waba ngukumkani iminyaka eyisikhombisa nesishiyagalolunye eYerusalem. Ubaba wakhe wayenguAbiha, intombi kaZekariya.
Wakwenza okulungile emehlo kaYehova, ngokwezinto zonke azenzayo uDavide, ubaba wakhe.
Ngonyaka wokuthoma wokubusa kwakhe, ngonyaka wesithathu wenyanga yokuqala, wavula amasango ethempelini likaYehova, walungisa.
Wafumana abapristi nabaLevi, wabahlanganisa ndawonye emgwaqweni nguyênu engxenyeni esenyakatho.
Wathi kubo, Ningikhulumela, nilabaLevi; zinihlanze manje, niyihlanze indlu kaYehova uThixoubaba benu, nisuse konke okumbi ezindaweni ezingcwele.
Abababa bethu bakwenza okumbi phambi kwamehlo kaYehova uzimu wethu, babemshiya; besuka ezindaweni zokuhlala kukaYehova, babeka emuva kwabo kuye.
Bavala iminyango yodonga, bamisa izibani zabo, bengazithuthisi ifuthe, begodu bangabi nesondlo somlilo ezindaweni ezingcwele kuThixo wakwaSirayeli.
Ngenxa lalokho, uMoya oNgcwele wehla phezu kwaYuda neYerusalem; wabeka phakathi kwabo ukukhathazeka, nokugxekwa, nokuzingela, njengombana nibona ngamehlo wenu.
Ngenxa lalokho abazali bethu babulawa emdlalweni, begodu izingane zethu, namadodakazi ethu athathwe njengeziboshwa.
Manje ngicabanga bona ngizokwenza isivumelwano noYehova, uzimu kaSirayeli, ukuze inkohliso yakhe enamandla ihambe kuthi.
Abantwana bam, ningabi nokungakhathali manje; ngombana ikosi uzikhethele bona nihlale phambi kwakhe, nisebenze kuye, nibe ngabakhonzi bakhe, nifuthe inkungu kuye.

Bathi labo abaLevi, bamisa izandla zabo, beqala umsebenzi: emndenini wakwaKohati, uMahati unyana ka-Amasai, noYoweli unyana ka-Azaria; emndenini wakwaMerari, uKishi unyana ka-Abdi, no-Azaria unyana kaJehaleleli; emndenini wakwaGershoni, uYowa unyana kaZima, no-Eden unyana ka-Jowa.
Kwa-Elizaphane: uShimri noYehuyeli; kwa-Asaphe: uZekariya noMatania.
Emndenini kaHeman, nguJehuyeli noShimeyi; emndenini kaJeduthuni, nguShemaya noUziyele.
Bahlanganisana nabo abazalwane babo, bahlanza izandla zabo, befika behlanza indlu kaYehova, njengombana ukumkani abewisela umthetho ngayo, ngokusho kwezwi likaYehova.

Baphuma ababhishobhi endlwini kaYehova yangaphakathi, ukuze bayihlanze; bakhipha zonke izinto ezingcolile ababezithola ethempelini likaYehova, bazisa emgwaqeni wendlu kaYehova. AbaLevi babezithatha, bazithwale efulethini laseKidron.

Baqala ukungcwelesa indlu ngomhla wokuthoma wenyanga yokuqala, begodu ngomhla wesishiyagalombili wonyaka bafika emgodini kaYehova; bachitha usuku oluyisishiyagalombili bengcwelesa indlu kaYehova, bagqiba ngomhla wesishiyagalolunye wonyaka wokuthoma.
Bafika ke kuHezekiya ukumkani, bathi, Sihlanze yonke indlu kaYehova, nesihlalo somlilo, nezimpahla zayo zonke, nethebulethi yokudla okusetshenzisiweyo, nezimpahla zayo zonke.
Siyazilungiselela begodu zonke izinto azenzayo ukumkani uAhashe, lapho uhlala khona emkhosini wakhe, lapho ekhohlisa khona uzimu, sizingcwelele; zikhona phambi kwesihlalo sobukhosi sikaYehova.
UHezekiya ukumkani, evuka ekuseni khulu, waqoqa abakhulu bedolobha, waya endlini kaYehova.

Bathi: "Sizonikela ngengulube eziyisithupha, nezimvu eziyisishiyagalombili, nezinkomo eziyisishiyagalombili, namabhodwe embuzi ayisishiyagalombili, ukuze kube yisondlo sesono sombuso, nendlu kaThixo, nakwaYuda; begodu ubukhosi bucela ababhishobhi, oonyana baka-Aron, ukuba banikela ngazo emgodini kaYehova.

Babulala khona izingulube, baqoqa igazi labo, balihlisa phezu kwesibingelelo; babulala amakhowe, balihlisa igazi labo phezu kwesibingelelo; babulala amaqanda, balihlisa igazi labo phezu kwesibingelelo.
Baphinde baletha amakhowe omnikelo wesono phambi kukakumkani kanye nabantu, babeka izandla zabo phezu kwawo.

Bathi abapristi babulala amakhowe, babeka ubisi lwawo emgodini wokubhekwa kwesono, ukuze kukhululwe bonke isiSirayeli; ngombana ukumkani wayewisela umthetho ukuba kube khona isonka somlilo kanye nesonka sesono sabaSirayeli.

Wabeka uHizekiya amaLevi ethempelini likaYehova, namahhashi, nama-canticles, nama-harps, ngokusho komyalo kaDavide, noGadi umprofeti wobukhosi, noNathani umprofeti; ngombana lo myalo wawusuka kukaNkulunkulu, ngamazwi abaprofeti bakhe.
Bahlala khona amaLevi, namathuluzi kaDavide, namadodakazi kambingeleli, namahhashi.

Wathi uHizekiya bona bafake isonka esishiswayo phezu kwesibopho; begodu lapho kuqalwa khona isiboniso somlilo, kwaqala nokudlalwa umculo kaYehova, namabhungane, nezinsimbi zikaDavide ukumkani wakwaSirayeli.
Abantu bonke bathandaza, nabangani bengoma bekhuluma, namabhungane embuzane adlala, kuze kuqedwe umnikelo wokushiswa.
Bekuphelile ukunikela, ukumkani nalabo bonke ababene naye babhujiswa, bakhonza ikosi.
Wathi uHezekiya ukumkani, kanye nabakhulu, kwabaLevi bona ba praise ikosi ngamagama kaDavide, nakwaAsaphe umfundi; begodu ba praise ngothando, babhujululwa, besola.

Wathi uHizekiya, Namuhla nimise isandla enhliziyweni yenu kuYehova; phumani, ninikeze izipho zokudla nezipho zokubonga endlwini kaYehova. Bathe abantu banikela ngezipho zokudla nezipho zokubonga, nanoma ubani ofuna ukunikela ngezinto ezibomvu.
Kwathi abantu baletha izingulube eziyisixhenxe, nezimvu eziyikhulu, nezimbuzi eziyinkulungwane ezimbili; lezi zonke ziyizipho zokushiswa kuYehova.
Ezinye izilwane ezihlukaniswe zibe yizibopho ezingcwele, zaziyizinja eziyikhulu nesishiyagalombili, nezingulube eziyizigidi amathathu.

Kodwana kwaba khona ababhishobhi abanganelanga ukuba bahlanze zonke izimpahla ezibomvu; ngalokho abazalwane babo, amaLevi, wabasiza, kuze kube kuqediwe umsebenzi, begodu kuye kwakhululwa inani lamaBhenjamini. Naphezu kwalokho, imindeni sabo yaba yishumi nambili.
Kwaba khona amadini okudlidliza amakhulu, kanye nesisindo samadini okuthula, nama-odolo okuphuza ahambisana nanoma iyiphi inhlanhla yokudlidliza. Ngaleyo le kwamiswa umsebenzi endlwini kaYehova.
Wajabula uHizekiya, naye wonke umuntu, ngalokho uzimu ayekwenza kubo bonke abantu; ngombana zonke lezi zinto zakwenziwa ngokushesha.
UHizekiya wathumela kiwo wonke amaSirayeli neYuda, begodu wababhalela noEfrayim naManase, ukuba bafike endlwini kaYehova eYerusalem, ukuze benze iPasha kuYehova, uzimu kaSirayeli.
Ubukhosi, nabaholi bakhe, nabantu bonke baseJerusalema bathathe isiná isinqumo sokwenza uPasha ngonyaka wesithathu.
Bangeke bakwazi ukuyenza ngesikhathi esifanele, ngombana abapristi abazange bahlanzeke ngokwanele, begodu abantu abazange bahlangana eYerusalem.
Isinqumo sabonakala silungile kukumkani nakwabo bonke abantu.

Bathi, sithi, sithunyelwe isimemezelo ngaso soke isizwe samaSirayeli, kusukela eBheri-shebha kuze kube eDani, bona bafike eYerusalem, bagcine iPasha kuYehova, uzimu wamaSirayeli; ngombana abantu abaningi abazange bayenze ngokwemithetho.

Bathi ke abathunywa, bathatha izincwadi ezisuka emkhosini, nasezikhululweni zakhe, zafika ezweni lonke likaSirayeli nakwaYuda, zithi, Ngokusho komthetho wokumkani, Nibuye kuYehova, uzimu ka-Abrahama, no-Isake, no-Isirayeli, ukuze aphinde abuye kubo bonke abaseSirayeli abasele phakathi kwenu, abaphuma emazulwini ase-Ashuri.
Musani ukuba njengababa bakho, nabangani bakho, ababengakholwa kuYehova, uzimu wababa babo; ngalokho wabashiya ekufakeni, njengombana nibona.

Mhlawumbe ngeke nibe nenhliziyo eqinile, njengokuthi kwaba ubaba benu; zinikele kukaNkulunkulu, nifike ethempelini lakhe, elingcwele kuye kuze kube sekupheleni, nisebenzele ikosi uzimu wenu, ukuze inkohliso yakhe iguquke kuwe.

Uma nibuya kuye ikosi, khona-ke labo abantu abathule abazalwane benu nabantwana benu bazoba nenhlonipho kubo, baphinde babuye kule lizwe; ngombana ikosi uzimu wenu unenhlanhla begodu unesibopho; ngeke alungise ubuso bakhe kuwe, uma nibuyela kuye.
Bahamba ke labo abathunyelwe, besuka edolobhaneni elilodwa befika edolobhaneni elilodwa, badlula eEfraim naseManasethi, bafike eZebuloni; kodwana abantu babebakhohlisa, babebaxosha.
Bakhona abantu abathile eAshere, naseManase, naseZabuloni, ababehlaza, befika eYerusalem.
NakwaYuda, isandla sikaThixo sakwenza abantu bavume ukulalela ukumkani nabaholi bakhe, ngokusho kwezwi likaYehova.
Bahlangana abantu abaningi khulu eJerusalema, ngonyaka wesithathu, ukubhiyozela isikhumbuzo sokudla okungabhakiwe.
Basusa ama-altare aseJerusalema, basusa nama-altare onsundu onke, bazibeka emfuleni iKidron.
Babulala amaqanda ePasha ngomhla wesishiyagalombili wenyanga yesithathu; begodu abapristi nabaLevi bakhathazekile, bahlanza izandla zabo, bengeza izipho ezibomvu endlini kaYehova.
Bahlala endaweni sabo, ngokusho komthetho kaMosis, indodana kaThixo; begodu abapristi bafafaza igazi, labaLevi belibanika labo.
Baningi abantu engqungqutheleni abazange bahlanzeke; ngalokho amaLevi abulala izingulube zepasha kiwo wonke umuntu ongahlanzekile, ukuze bazingcwelele kuYehova.

Baningi abantu, ikakhulukazi abasuka ku-Ephrayim, noManase, noIssakare, noZebuloni, ababengenakuzihlanza; badla iPasha, engafanele ngokwemthetho. Kodwana uHizekiya wathandaza kubo, wathi, "uzimu othandekako alungise wonke umuntu,
obeka inhliziyo yakhe efuna uzimu, ikosi, uzimu wabababa bakhe, nakuba angeke ahlanzeke ngemithetho yendlu.
Waphendula ikosi uHezekiya, wabaphilisa abantu.

Bakwenza ke oonyana bakaSirayeli eYerusalem usuku lwezithelo ezingenamafutha, nsuku eziyisixhenxe, ngothando olukhulu; abaLevi nabababhi babonga ikosi ngosuku ngalunye, besebenzisa amathuluzi anamandla okudlalela kukaNkulunkulu.

UHizekiya waqinisa inhliziyo sabo bonke abaLevi abakwaziyo ukukhonza ikosi. Badla isiphuzo sabo, benikela ngezipho zokuthula, babonga ikosi, uzimu wakwababa babo, ngezinsuku ezisixhenxe zosuku olukhulu.
Bathi bonke abantu, baxoxa bona benze isidlo sakusihlwa ezinye amalanga eziyisithupha; besenza isidlo sakusihlwa ezinye amalanga eziyisishiyagalombili, bevuya.

UHizekiya, ukumkani wakwaYuda, wanikela abantu ngezinkomo ezingu-1, nezimvu eziyi-7; begodu abaphathi banikeza izingulube ezingu-1, nezinkwa zezimbuzi ezingama-10. Kwaba khona amabhishoshi amanengi abekezelayo.
Baze bonke abantu baseYuda, nabapristi, nalabaLevi, nabo bonke abantu abasuka eSirayeli, nalabo bangaphandle abasuka eSirayeli, nalabo abahlala eSirayeli, bajabulela.
Kwaba nenjabulo enkulu eYerusalem; ngombana kusukela ngezinsuku zikaSolomoni, unyana kaDavide, ukumkani wakwaSirayeli, akuzange kwenzeke okunjalo eYerusalem.
Baphuma khona ababhishobhi nalabaLevi, babambisa abantu; begodu uzimu wabaphendula, begodu ukuthandaza kwabo kwafika esibhakabhakeni sakhe esingcwele.

Kwathi lapho lokhu konke kuqediwe, bonke abakwaSirayeli abakhona bephuma ezindaweni zakwaYuda, baphula amatshe ophahla, basusa ama-ashere, bavala izindlu eziphakamileyo, namathafa, kiwo wonke uJuda noBhenjamini, naseEphrayim naseManase, kuze kube sekuphele konke. Baphinde babuyela emizini sabo yonke, ezweni labo, bonke amaJuda.

UHizekiya wahlukanisa ababhishobhi nalabaLevi ngezigaba zabo, wonke umuntu ngemisebenzi yakhe; abanye benikela ngenhlanhla yokudlwengula, nezenhlanhla zokuthula, kanti abanye bekhonza, bebonga, bezithokozisa emgwaqeni wendlu kaYehova.

Wanikela ukumkani ngezinto zakhe eziphilako, izipho zokudlwengula, izipho zokudlwengula ekuseni nakusihlwa, nezipho zokudlwengula zezinsuku zosuku lokuphumula, nezinsuku zonyaka omusha, nezinsuku zonyaka omusha, njengombana kubhalwe emthethweni kaYehova.
Wathi begodu kilabo abahlala eYerusalem, bona banikezele amafelokazi abo kwabapristi nalabaLevi, ukuze bakwazi ukunikela ngokupheleleko emthethweni kaYehova.

Kwathi lapho isinqumo saphuma, amakhosikazi aseSirayeli wanikela ngokuzithandela ngezinto zokuqala zembewu sabo, kanye newayini elisha, kanye ne-olive oil, kanye namakhowe, kanye nanoma yini ekhiqizwa ezindaweni zabo; begodu kwafika inani elikhulu lazo zonke izinto.

Nabo abazalwane bakaSirayeli nakwaYuda, ababehlala emizini kaYuda, babeletha nengxenye yeshumi yezingulube zabo, nezimvu zabo, nengxenye yeshumi yazo zonke izinto ezingcwele ezinikezelwe kuYehova uzimu wabo; bazenza zibe ngamatshe.
Baqala ukwenza amagobolondo enyanga yesithathu, bagqiba ngonyaka wesixhenxe.
Kwafika uHizekiya namadodana akhe, babona amagobolondo, babonga ikosi nomndeni wakhe waseSirayeli.
UHizekiya wabuza abapristi nalabaLevi ngezinsalela.

Waphendula uAzariya, umbhishobhi omkhulu, ongumndeni kaTsadoki, wathi, Ngosuku lapho abantu beqala khona ukuletha izipho endlwini kaYehova, sadla sashiywa, begodu sashiya okuningi; ngombana ikosi ubambisene nabantu bakhe, sagcina lokhu okukhulu khulu.
Wathi uHizekiya bona balungiselele izindlu zokugcina endlwini kaYehova. Bakwenza njalo.
Bafaka ngokuthembekile iminikelo, nengxenye yeshumi, nezinto ezingcwele; kwaba nguKonania uLevi ophethe kubo, noShimehi udadewabo owayenguwesibini.

UJehiyeli, no-Azaziya, no-Nahathi, no-Asaheli, no-Yerimothi, no-Yozabadi, no-Eliyeli, no-Ishmakiya, no-Mahati, no-Benaya, babe ngabaphathi ngaphasi kukaKonania, noShimeyi udadewabo. UHezekiya ukumkani kanye no-Azariya, umphathi wendlu kaThixo, babeka labo abathathu.
UKore unyana ka-Imna, umLevi, umphathi wesitezi esisenyakatho, wayephethe izipho ezikhethwayo zikaThixo; yena wanikela ngezipho ezikhethwayo zikaYehova, nezipho ezingcwele khulu.

Ngaphasi kwakhe kwakungu-Eden, noMinaamini, noJeshuwa, noShemaya, noAmariya, noShekaniya; labo basebenza ngokuthembekile emizini yamabhishobhi, benikeza abazalwane babo izingxenye ngokulandelana kwezikhulu zabo, abancane nabadala.

Nabo bonke abesilisa abaneminyaka emithathu ubudala nangaphezulu, ababhaliswe ngomndeni wakwaSirayeli, bonke abaphumayo endlwini kaYehova ukuba benze umsebenzi wabo ngosuku ngalunye, ngokuya ngezigaba zabo, ngokwemisebenzi sabo.
Babanikeza abapristi, ngokubhaliswa kwemindeni sabo, namaLevi aneminyaka eyishumi nambili ubudala nangaphezulu, ngokwemisebenzi sabo, ngezigaba zabo.
Banikeza begodu izingane ezincane, namadodakazi, namadodakazi, nabantwana ababhaliswe encwadini yomndeni webandla lonke, ngenxa yokuthi bagcine bengcwele ngokholo.

Kilabo ababingeleli, oonyana baka-Aron, ababehlala ezifundeni zezindawo zabo zasemaphandleni, ezindaweni zamadolobha abo, bekukhona amadodana abizwa ngegama, emzini ngamnye, ukuze abe nengxenye kiwo wonke umuntu umfazi phakathi kwababingeleli, nalowo wonke umuntu owabhalwa encwadini yamaLevi.
Wakwenza njalo uHizekiya ezweni lonke laseYuda; wakwenza okumbi, nokulungile, nokuthembekile phambi koNkulunkulu wakhe.
Ngazo zonke izinto aqale ukwenza, ngomsebenzi wendlu kaThixo, nomthetho nemiyalelo, wenza ngaso soke isinhliziyo sakhe, efuna uzimu wakhe; waphumelela.

Kwathi, ngemva kokuba uHizekiya ekwenzele zonke lezi zinto ngokuthembekile, kwafika uSanheribi ukumkani wakwa-Ashuri, wahlasela amaYuda, wamisa isibhedlela emizini enezindlu eziqinile, efuna ukuyithatha.
UHezekiya wabona bona uSenakheribi ufike, efuna ukuhlasela iYerusalem.
Wakhuluma nabaphathi bakhe kanye nabagqugquzeli bemikhosi ngokuvala amanzi ezindaweni ezingaphandle kwedolobha, begodu basizakala.
Bahlangana abantu abaningi, bavala izimpophoma zonke, namabhayisikili adlula phakathi kwezwe, bathi, Ingabe abaphathi base-Ashuri bangafika bathola amanzi amanengi?

UHizekiya wasebenza kanzima, wakwakha kabutjha zonke izingxenye zodonga, wazenza izindlu ezinkulu phezu kwalo. Wakwenza begodu udonga olulodwa ngaphandle kwalo, waqinisa ama-terraces edolobhana likaDavide; wayenza nemiyalelo nemigodi emikhulu.
Wabeka abaphathi bokulwa phezu kwabantu, wabahlanganisa esitezi esivulekile sesango ledolobha; waqinisa inhliziyo sabo, wathi,
Beka isandla sakho esiqinile, begodu ube nethando olukhulu; ungakhathazeki, noma ugweme ukumkani wase-Ashuri, kanye neqembu elikhulu lakhe; ngombana lowo okhona nathi umkhulu kunalowo okhona naye.

Wathi uHezekiya ukumkani wakwaYuda: "uzimu wethu, uzimu kaSirayeli, uzosisiza, begodu uzobhekana nathi emabhisholweni ethu; kodwana wena, uNdikhoyo, uzimu wethu, uzosisiza, begodu uzobhekana nathi emabhisholweni ethu.

Wathumela abaphathi bakhe eYerusalem kuHezekiya ukumkani wakwaYuda, nakubo bonke abantu baseYuda ababeseJerusalema, ngenkathi uSanheribi ukumkani wakwaAsiriya, naye wonke umkhosi wakhe, ehlasela iLakishi.
Wathi, Usho lokhu uSanheribi ukumkani wakwa-Ashuri: Yini le nto oyithembayo, bona uhlale eYerusalem, uma ibekwe ngaphasi kokulwa?
UHizekiya, uma ekhuluma, uthi: UYehova uzimu wethu uzosisindisa kukumkani wase-Ashuri; ngalokho nizofa ngendlala, begodu nizofa ngomoya.
UHizekiya akhenge asuse izindlu eziphakeme, nama-altare kaYehova, wathi kuYuda nakwaYerusalem, Nizibophezele esibhedlela esisodwa, nifuthe phezu kwayo inkungu?
Ungazi bona ngikwenze yini, nami nababami, kilabo bonke abantu basezizwe? Ingabe amasiko lamazwe awakwazi ukusindisa izwe labo phambi kwami?
Akunamuntu nanye phakathi kwamagugu ezweni labo, ababuphikisi abababami, okwaziyo ukusindisa abantu bakhe phambi kwami; ngalokho-ke uzimu wenu angakusindisa kanjani phambi kwami?

Akufanele uHizekiya akukhohlise, akwenzele lokhu; awukholwanga kuye; ngombana akukho uzimu wezwe ngalinye, noma ilizwe ngalinye, okwaziyo ukusindisa abantu bakhe emgodini wami, noma emigodini yababami. Ingabe uzimu wenu angakusindisa nisemgodini wami?
Baphinde bakhuluma okuningi abaphathi bakhe ngoYehova uzimu, noHezekiya umkhonzi wakhe.
Wabhala begodu uNdunankulu incwadi yokunquma ikosi, uzimu kaSirayeli, wathi: "Imimoya yamazwe awasindisi abantu bakhe ngami; ngalokho-ke nozimu kaHizekiya ngeke asindise abantu bakhe ngami."
Bathi abaphathi bakhe ngesiHebhere kubo bonke abantu baseJerusalema ababesesitezi esiphezulu, befuna ukubaphazamisa, ukuze bathathe lo dolobha.
Bakhuluma ngoNkulunkulu waseJerusalema, bathi ufana noThixo wabanye abantu bomhlaba, okungukuthi, izinto eziyenziwe ngezandla zabantu kuphela.
UHezekiya ukumkani, noIsaya umprofeti, unyana ka-Amozi, bathandaza ngalolu daba, bekhala emazulu.

Wathumela ikosi isithunywa, sabulala bonke abasoli abakhulu, nabaholi, namakhomishana, esiteji somphathi wakwa-Ashuri. Wabuyela ezweni lakhe, ehlonishwa; wafika ethempelini likaThixo wakhe, wabulawa khona ngeqhwa yindodakazi yakhe.
Ngalokho ikosi wasindisa uHizekiya, nabahlali baseJerusalema, esandlani sikaSanheribi ukumkani wakwa-Ashuri, nasesandlani sabo bonke ababi babo; wabanika isikhala ngazo zonke izinhlangothi.
Abantu abaningi baletha izipho kuYehova eYerusalem, nezipho ezisezingeni eliphakeme uHezekiya ukumkani wakwaYuda; begodu kusukela ngalolu sikhathi zonke izizwe zamangalisa khulu.
Ngaleso sikhathi uHizekiya waba nesifo sokufa, wathandaza kuYehova; begodu ikosi wamphendula, wamnika iphawu.
Nokho uHizekiya waba mkhulu, begodu akayibonga inhlonipho eyenziwe kuye; khona-ke ikosi wagwema yena noYuda noYerusalem.
Ke kaloku uHizekiya, nalabo abasemaJerusalema, bahlanganiswa, bebuyela ekuphileni kwabo okumbi; begodu inhliziyo kaYehova ayizange ifike phezu kwawo yonke imihla kaHizekiya.
UHizekiya ube nezimali eziningi, nobudume obuningi. Wakha izindlu zokugcina isiliva, negolide, namatshe amahle, neziphuzo, namagalelo, nazo zonke izinto ezithandekayo.
Wakha namahhovisi embewu, newayini elisha, nophethiloli we-olive, nezindlu zezilwane zazo zonke izinhlobo, namahhovisi ezimvu.
Wakha izidolobhana, wafumana izinkomo nezimvu eziningi khulu; ngombana uzimu wamenza abe mkhulu.
UHizekiya wavala umlambo ophezulu weGihoni, wabeka amanzi ehla eningizimu yedolobha likaDavide. UHizekiya waphumelela ngazo zonke izinto azenzayo.
Kwathi lapho abaphathi baseBhabheli bethumela izithunywa, bona babuze kuye ngophawu olumangalisayo olwenziwe ezweni lonke, uzimu wamshiya, ukuze amhlole, ukuze abone konke okusemandleni akhe.
Okunye konke okwenze uHizekiya, nemisebenzi yakhe yothando, akubonakali kubhalwe ephupheni likaIsaya umprofeti, unyana ka-Amozi, encwadini yamaNgisi aseYuda nawaseSirayeli?
Wafa uHizekiya, wabanjwa emfuleni wezingqimba zamadodana kaDavide; bonke abantu baseYuda nabaseJerusalema bamhlonipha ngesikhathi efa. UManase unyana wakhe waba ngukumkani esikhundleni sakhe.
UManase ubeneminyaka engu-12 ubudala lapho eqala ukumkani; waba ngukumkani iminyaka eyishumi nasihlanu eYerusalem.
Wakwenza okumbi emehloni kaYehova, walandela izinto ezingathandeki zezinto zakwamanye amazwe, ayezikhipha ikosi phambi kwabanaSirayeli.
Wakwakha kabutjha izindlu eziphakeme, oHezekiya ubaba wakhe ayeziphonsa phasi; wamisa izibingelelo kuBaali, wakwenza ama-ashere, waphakamisa ikhanda lakhe ezindaweni zonke zezulu, wakhonza.
Wakha izibingelelo ethempelini likaYehova, lapho ikosi abekhuluma khona, esithi, EYerusalem lizoba igama lami kuze kube sekupheleni.
Wakha izibingelelo zazo zonke izinkanyezi zezulu, ezindaweni ezimbili zendlu kaYehova.

Wabeka izingane zakhe emlilweni, eGoli lika-Benhinnom; wasebenza ngezinhlamvu, nezingqungquthela, nokuzibulala, wahamba nabangani bezinhlamvu, nabangani bezinhlamvu. Wakwenza okumbi khulu ngamehlo kaYehova, wayalela bona agweme.

Wathatha isithombe esicwebezelayo, asiphikisayo, wamise endlwini kaThixo, lapho uzimu abewisela khona uDavide noSolomoni unyana wakhe, esithi, Endluni le, naseJerusalema, engikhethele kuyo zonke izizwe zakwaSirayeli, ngibeka igama lami kuze kube sekupheleni.

Ngizothi, Ngami ngizoyisa isizwe sakwaSirayeli ezweni engilibazile oobaba babo; uma nje begcina ukukwenza konke okungiwisela umthetho ngalo, namasiko awo, nezimiso zakhe, nezigwebo zakhe zonke, ngaso isandla sikaMoses.
Nokho uManase wakhohlisa abantu baseYuda nabaseYerusalem, ukuba benze okumbi khulu kunazo zonke izizwe azenzayo ikosi phambi kwabantwana bakaSirayeli.
Wakhuluma ikosi kuManase nomndeni wakhe, kodwana abawutholi umsindo.
Wathi ikosi wabaletha phezu kwabo abaphathi bamabutho kakumkani wase-Ashuri; bathatha uManase, babeka izintambo emlonyeni wakhe, babamba ngezingcezu zesiliva, bamthwala eBhabheli.
UManase, lapho enhliziyweni yakhe ibuhlungu, wacela usizo kuYehova uzimu wakhe, waxolisa khulu phambi koNkulunkulu wabababa bakhe.
Wathandaza, begodu ikosi wamlalela, waphendula izicelo zakhe, wambuyisela eYerusalem, waya emkhosini wakhe. Waqonda khona uManase bona ikosi nguThixo.

Ngemva kwalokho, uManase wakwakha umgwaqo ongaphandle wedolobha likaDavide, enyakatho-ntshonalanga yeGihoni, enhliziyweni, kuze kube yilapho kungena khona isango lezinhlanzi. Wakwenza ngaphesheya komfula iOfel; wawenza ubude khulu, begodu wababeka abaphathi bemikhosi emizini yonke kaYuda enezindonga.
Wasusa izitha zakwamanye amazwe, ne-Astarte, ethempelini likaYehova; wasusa nezibingelelo zonke azenzayo emfuleni wendlu kaThixo, naseJerusalema, waza wazisa ngaphandle komzi.
Wakwakha kabutjha isibingelelo sikaYehova, wanikela phezu kwayo izipho zokuthula nezipho zokubonga, wathi kuYuda bona basebenzele ikosi, uzimu wakwaSirayeli.
Abantu baqhubeka benikela ezindaweni eziphakeme, kodwana kuYehova uzimu wabo kuphela.

Okunye konke okwenze uManase, nokuthandaza kwakhe kuThixo wakhe, namazwi alabo ababonayo abekhuluma kuye ngegama likaYehova, uzimu kaSirayeli, kubonakala sengathi ayabhalwe encwadini yamakumkani baseSirayeli.

Umthandazo wakhe, nokuthi ikosi wamphendula kanjani, nazo zonke izigebengu zakhe, nokungathembeki kwakhe, nezindawo lapho ekha khona ama-altare, begodu abeke khona ama-ashere namatshe, ngaphambi kokuba ahlonipheke, akubona bonke babhalwe ezincwadini zababona.
UManase waphumula, wabanjwa endlu yakhe; uAmoni unyana wakhe waba ngubukhosi endaweni yakhe.
UAmoni ubeneminyaka eyishumi nambili ubudala lapho eqala ukumkani; waba ngukumkani iminyaka emibini eYerusalem.
Wakwenza okumbi emehloni kaYehova, njengokuthi wenza uManase ubaba wakhe; wanikela ngazo zonke izinhlamvu zegolide, azenzayo uManase ubaba wakhe, waziyala.
Akekho owawuzinikela phambi kukaNkulunkulu, njengokuthi uManase ubaba wakhe abewenza; kodwana uAmoni waqhubeka nokwenza isono.
Abaphathi bakhe baphikisana naye, babulala ehlathini lakhe.
Kodwana abantu basezweni babulala bonke labo abaphikisayo ukumkani uAmoni; begodu abantu basezwe bakwenza uYosiya, unyana wakhe, waba ngukumkani endaweni yakhe.
UYosiya ubeneminyaka eyisishiyagalombili ubudala lapho eqala ukumkani; waba ngukumkani iminyaka engamashumi amathathu nenye eYerusalem.
Wakwenza okulungile emehlo kaYehova; wahamba ngezindlela zikaDavide, ubaba wakhe, akashintshi ngazo isandla sokudla noma isandla sobunxele.

Ngomnyaka wesishiyagalombili wokubusa kwakhe, eneminyaka eyishumi nesishiyagalolunye ubudala, waqala ukubuza uzimu kaDavide ubaba wakhe. Ngonyaka oyisishiyagalombili waqalisa ukuhlanza iYudeya neYerusalem, wasusa izindlu eziphakeme, nama-Asherethi, nezifanekiso ezicwebezelayo, nezibonakaliso zegolide.

Wabona, begodu, bona izibingelelo zeBaali zasuswa, nama-altare omlilo abekwe phezu kwazo, wawususa; begodu ama-ashere, nezithombe ezicwebezelwe, nezifanekiso zokhuni, wazenza zibe yizicubu ezincane khulu, wazibonela izicubu ezandleni zalabo ababezinikela kuzo.
Washisa izicubu zababingeleli phezu kwama-altare abo, begodu wahlanza uYuda noYerusalem.
Wakwenza njalo emizini kaManase, noEfraim, noSimeoni, kuze kube yiNaphtali, nasezikhungweni zabo ezijikeleze.
Waphula izibingelelo, washaya ama-ashere, namathafa, waya emathunjini, wasusa zonke izingosi zomlilo ezweni lonke likaSirayeli; wabuyela eYerusalem.

Ngonyaka oyisishiyagalombili wokubusa kwakhe, lapho ehlanze khona izwe nendlu, wathumela uShafani unyana ka-Asaliya, noMaaseya umphathi wedolobha, noYowa unyana ka-Yehohazazi umbhali, ukuba balungise indlu kaYehova uzimu wakhe.

Baye bafika kuHilkiya, umbingeleli omkhulu, babanika izimali ezithunyelwe endlwini kaThixo; abaLevi abagcina amasango babeziqoqile emazweni aseManase, naseEfrayim, nakwamanye amazwe aseSirayeli, namaYuda wonke, neBhenjamini, nabahlali baseYerusalem.
Bezibeka ezinyaweni zalabo abaphatha umsebenzi endlwini kaYehova, bakhokhela labo abasebenza umsebenzi, belungisa indlu, beyilungisa.
Baye banikela ngemali kilabo abasebenza ngokhuni, nabenzi bezindlu, ukuba bathenge amatshe aqoshwe, neemithi yokwakha izindonga, nezindonga zezindawo ezishisayo, ababezishiya izikhulu zaseYiputa.

Amadodana abo ayewenza umsebenzi ngokuthembekile. Abaphathi babo babe yiJahati no-Obadiya, abaLevi abasuka emndenini kaMerari; noZekariya noMeshulamu, abavela emndenini kaKohati; namanye amaLevi, bonke abezingoma,
begodu abaphathi babasebenzi, abaphatha izithuthi, begodu waqondisa bonke abasebenzi emisebenzini yonke. Nakuba abanye abaLevi babe abagxeki, abaphathi, nabahwebi.
Kwathi lapho bekhipha khona imali eyafakwa endlwini kaYehova, uHilkiya umbingeleli wafumana incwadi yomthetho kaYehova, onikezelwe ngoMosesi.
Waphendula uHilkiya, wathi kuShafani umbhali, Ngithole incwadi yomthetho ethempelini likaYehova; wanikela lo ncwadi kuShafani.
Wathi uShafani, ethatha incwadi kuye ukumkani, waveza umbiko kuye, wathi, Zonke izinto ozitshele ngazo izisebenzi zakho zizenza.
Bakhiphe izimali ezikhona endlwini kaYehova, bazisa kilabo abalawulayo, nalabo abasebenzayo.
Wathi uShafani umbhali kuye ukumkani, ethi, UHilkiya umbingeleli wangisinika incwadi. Wafunda kuyo uShafani phambi kukakumkani.
Kwathi lapho ukumkani ekhuluma ngamazwi omthetho, waxosha izigqoko zakhe.
Wathi uSolomoni kuHilkiya, no-Ahikamu unyana kaShafani, no-Abdonu unyana kaMikha, no-Shafani umbhali, no-Asaya umkhonzi wobukhosi:

Hamba nibuze ikosi ngami, nalabo abasele eSirayeli naseYuda, ngezinto ezibhalwe kulolu ncwadi oluthunyelwe; ngombana indlala kaYehova ikhulu phezu kwethu, ngenxa yokuthi ababa bethu bangabi nentshisekelo enhliziyweni yoNkulunkulu, ukuba bakwenze konke okubhalwa kulolu ncwadi.

Wathi uHilkiya, nalabo abathunyelwe ngukumkani, baya ku-Hulda umprofeti, indodana kaShalumu, unyana kaTokhathi, unyana kaHasra, umphathi wezigqoko zobukhosi; yena wayehlala eJerusalema eningizimu. Bathi kuye lokhu okushiwo.
Wathi kubo, Uthi ikosi, uzimu kaSirayeli, Nithi kulowo mntu owawuthumelele kuye:
Uthi ikosi bona, Bheka, ngizoletha umonakalo phezu kwalo mhlaba, naphezu kwalabo abahlala kulo, zonke izibulala-zinambuzane ezibhalwe encwadini eyafundwa phambi kukakumkani wakwaYuda.
Ngokuba bamishiya, bamisa umlilo emathinini amanye amadini, ukuze bangisizise ngezinto zabo zonke ezifakiwe ngamehlo abo; ngalokho indlala yami izoqhuma phezu kwalo mhlaba, begodu ayizofihlwa.
Kodwana ukumkani wakwaYuda, owabathumela bona nibuze ikosi, nithi kuye, uzimu kaSirayeli uthi lokhu mayelana namazwi awaziyo:

Ngokuba inhliziyweni yakho yanyamalala, begodu ukhohlakele phambi kukaThixo, lapho ulalela khona amazwi akhe ngalesi siqhingi, nalabo abahlala kulo; begodu ukhohlakele phambi kwami, waxosha izigqoko zakho, wakhala phambi kwami; ngalokho ngikuphendule, kusho ikosi.
Ngiyakushiya ukhambe ngokuthula, ube nomndeni wakwababa bakho; ngeke ubone izinkinga zonke engizokuletha kuzo le ndawo nalabo abahlala kuyo. Baphinde baphendula ukumkani, bathi:
Ke kaloku ukumkani wahlanganisa bonke abakhulu baseYuda nabaseYerusalem.

Waphuma ubukhosi endlwini kaYehova, naye wonke umuntu waseYuda nowaseYerusalem, namabhishobhi nalabaLevi, nabantu bonke, kusukela kuncane kuye kukhulu; wafunda emlonyeni wabo zonke izindaba zencwadi yesivumelwano esithunyelwe ethempelini likaYehova.

Wahlala ukumkani endaweni yakhe, wakwenza isivumelwano phambi kweNkosi, bona uzolandela ikosi, begodu uzogcina imiyalo yakhe, nemibandela yakhe, nezimiso zakhe, inhliziyweni yakhe yonke, nomoya wakhe wonke, ukuze agcine amazwi lesivumelwano esibhalwe kulo ncwadi.
Wakwenza bona bonke abantu baseYerusalem nabaseBhenjamini bavume ukukwenza; begodu abahlali baseJerusalema bathobela isivumelwano soNkulunkulu, uzimu wababa babo.

UYosiya wasusa zonke izinyamazane ezidumile ezweni lonke labantwana bakaSirayeli, wabavumela bonke abantu baseSirayeli ukuba bakhonza ikosi uzimu wabo. Kuzo zonke amalanga zakhe abengashintshi ekutholeni ikosi, uzimu wakwababa babo.
UYosiya walungisa uPasha kuYehova eYerusalem; babulala amaqanda oPasha ngomhla wesishiyagalombili wenyanga yokuqala.
Wabeka ababhishobhi emisebenzini sabo, wabakhuthaza ukuba basebenze endlwini kaYehova.

Wathi kwabaLevi, abafundisa wonke amaSirayeli, ababehlukaniswe ikosi, wathi: Nibeke isibambo esingcwele endlwini kaSolomoni, unyana kaDavide, ukumkani wakwaSirayeli; ngeke niyithwale phezu kwezinwele zenu; kodwana manje nisebenzele ikosi uzimu wenu, nabantu bakhe baseSirayeli.
Balungiseleleni ngokuya ngemindeni yenu, ngezigaba zenu, njengokusho kukaDavide ukumkani wakwaSirayeli noSolomoni unyana wakhe.
Uzohlala endaweni engcwele, nawe uzoba neqembu elilodwa lamaLevi, ngendlu ngayinye yomndeni wabo bonke abazalwane bakho, bonke abantu.
Nquma ukubulala izingulube zepasha, nizihlanze, nizilungiselele izingulube zabangani benu, njengokuthi ikosi awawisele umthetho ngaMoses.

UYosiya wanikela abantu izingulube ezingu-1, namakhowe amancane emindenini yakhe, ngezipho zepasha kiwo wonke umuntu ohlala khona; namahhashi ayizinkulungwane amathathu. Lawo onke awasuka emnothweni kankosi.

Abaphathi bakhe banikela ngokuzithandela abantu, nabapristi nalabaLevi. UHilkiya noZekariya noYehiyeli, abaphathi bendlu kaThixo, babenikeza abaholi bomndeni wakwa-Israyeli izinkomo ezingu-2 kanye nengulube eyizinkulungwane amathathu, ukulungiselela iPasha;

UKonaniya, nabangane bakhe uShemaya, noNethaneli, noHashabiya, noYeyeli, noYozabadi, abaphathi bamaLevi, banikela kumaLevi ngezinkomo nezimbuzi ezingu-elilodwa nezigidi eziyisishiyagalombili, namakhowe amakhulu amahlanu.
Wathi uMosis, "Njengombana zonke izinto zilungiselelwe ukukhonza, khona-ke ababhishobhi bahlala endaweni sabo, nalabaLevi ngokuhlukaniswa kwabo, njengombana ukumkani abewisela umthetho.
Babulala izinkomo zepasha, begodu ababhishobhi bafafaza igazi elivela kumaLevi; amaLevi wasusa isikhumba sazo.
Bahlukanisa izipho zokusindisa, ukuze bazinike abantu ngokwemindeni sabo, ukuba zinikezelwe kuYehova, njengokusho kwencwadi kaMoses; kanjalo bakwenza nezilwane.
Bapheka amaqanda epasha emlilweni, njengombana kusho umthetho; begodu baphotha izinto ezingcwele emigodini, namabhodwe, namaphayini, bazilungiselela ngokushesha abantu bonke.

Baphinde balungiselela labo, nalabapristi; ngombana abapristi, oonyana baka-Aron, babesebenza ngokunikela ngezinto ezibomvu, namaphethini, kuze kube sebusuku; ngalokho labaLevi balungiselela labo, nalabapristi.

Nabo abaculi, oonyana baka-Asaphu, babe ezindaweni zabo, ngokusho komthetho kaDavide no-Asaphu no-Heman no-Yeduthuni, okubonayo ukumkani; nalabo abagcina amasango babe emgwaqweni ngamnye, bengenakuyeka umsebenzi wabo, ngombana abazalwane babo, abeLevi, babebalungiselela.

Ngaleyo le kwaqedwa yonke imisebenzi kaYehova ngalolusuku, ukuba kwenziwe iPasha, begodu ukuba kunikezwe izipho ezibomvu phezu kwesibambo somlilo sikaYehova, njengokuthi ukumkani uYosiya abewisela umthetho.
Bathi abazalwane bakaSirayeli abakhona, bagcine uPasha ngalolu sikhathi, nosuku lwezithelo ezingenamafutha, amalanga eziyisithupha.

Akukho iPasha eyafana nale ezweni lakwaSirayeli kusukela ngezinsuku zikaSamuweli umprofeti; begodu akukho phakathi kwamadodana kaSirayeli akwenzele iPasha efanako neleyo uYosiya ayeyenza, naye amabhishobhi nalabaLevi, nabo bonke abantu baseYuda nabaseSirayeli abakhona, nabantu baseYerusalem.
Le-Pasha yasenziwa ngonyaka oyisishiyagalombili wokubusa kukaYosiya.

Ngemuva kwalokho konke, lapho uYosiya elungiselele khona indlu kaThixo, waphuma uNekho ukumkani waseYiputa ukuba ahlangane naye eKarkemishi, enkabeni yomfula i-Efrayi. UYoshiya waphuma ukuba ahlangane naye.

UNekho wathumela abathunywa kuye, esithi, Ingabe kukhona okuthile phakathi kwami nawe, ukumkani wakwaYuda? Angifikanga namuhla ukubhekana nawe, kodwana nobukhosi obungihlaselayo; begodu uzimu uthi ngihambe ngokushesha; ungaze uyinqobe ikosi, ekhona ndawonye nami, ukuze akulahle.

Kodwana uYosiya akhenge abuyele emuva, washintsha isithombe sakhe ukuba abe ngumfakazi wakhe. Akayiqondi impendulo kaNekho, naphezu kokuthi umlayezo wawuvela kukaNkulunkulu; waya ezindaweni eziseduze neMegido ukuze abe ngumfakazi wawo.
Abagqugquzeli babulala uNdunankulu uYosiya, wathi abaphathi bakhe, "Ninikele; ngidlwengula khulu!"

Bathi abaphathi bakhe, bakhipha uYosiya ebhasini lakhe, babeka ebhasini lakhe elilandelayo, bamthwala eYerusalem. Wafa khona lapho, wabulawa ezindaweni zokuzibophezela zababa bakhe. Abantu bonke baseYuda nabaseJerusalema babhikisha uYosiya.

UYeremiya wabhala izingoma ezibuhlungu mayelana noYosiya. Kuye kulesi sikhathi, bonke abaculi, amadoda nabesifazane, bakhumbula uYosiya ngezingoma zabo ezibuhlungu. Lezi zingoma zaqala ukuba yisiko eSirayeli, begodu zibhalwe encwadini yamaLaments.
Ezinye zonke izinto azenzayo uYosiya, nezenzo zakhe ezingcwele, ekwenzeni konke okubhalwe emthethweni kaYehova,
Zonke izinto zakhe, kusukela ekuqaleni kuze kube sekupheleni, akubonakali xâyiwe encwadini yamaNdiya kaSirayeli nakwaYuda.
Abantu bezwe bathatha uYowahazi, unyana kaYosiya, bakwenza waba ngukumkani endaweni yoyise eYerusalem.
UYohahazi ubeminyaka imashumi mahlanu nathathu ezelwe, lapho eqala ukumkani; waba neminyaka emithathu engukumkani eYerusalem.
Kwathi ukumkani waseMisri wamsusa emzini wakhe eYerusalem, wabeka phezu kwalolu lizwe inhlawulo yegolide eyishumi nesishiyagalombili sekhilogramu.

Ubukhosi baseYiputa bakwenza uEliyakabhi, umngane wakhe, waba ngukumkani ezweni laseYuda naseYerusalem, bashintsha igama lakhe libe nguYehoyakimi. UNeko wathatha uYohahazi, umngane kaEliyakabhi, waya eYiputa.
UYehoyakimu ubeneminyaka eyishumi nambili nesishiyagalombili ubudala lapho eqala ukumkani; waba minyaka ilishumi elinanye engukumkani eYerusalem. Wakwenza okumbi phambi kwamehlo kaYehova uzimu wakhe.
UNebhukadnezare ukumkani waseBhabheli wahlasela yena, wamveza emgodini wegolide, ukuze amthathe eBhabheli.
UNebhukadnezare wathatha namanye amatshe ethempelini likaYehova waya eBhabheli, wababeka ethempelini lakhe.

Okunye konke okwenze uYehoyakimi, nezinto zakhe ezingathandeki azenzayo, nobubi bakhe bonke obutholakale kuye, akubonakali kubhalwe encwadini yamaNgisi kaSirayeli nakwaYuda? UJehoyakine unyana wakhe waba ngukumkani esikhundleni sakhe.
UYehoyakimu ubeminyaka imashumi asibhozo ezelwe, lapho eqala ukumkani; waba ngukumkani eminyakeni emithathu nezinsuku eziyishumi eYerusalem. Wakwenza okumbi phambi kwamehlo kaYehova.

Kwathi lapho kwafika unyaka omusha, ukumkani uNebhukadnezare wathumela, wamthatha waya eBhabheli, naye nezinto ezibaluleke khulu zendlu kaYehova; wakwenza uZedekiya, umngane wakhe, waba ngukumkani phezu kweYuda noYerusalem.
UZedekiya ubeminyaka imashumi amabili anesithupha ezelwe, lapho eqala ukubusa; waba neminyaka eyishumi nanye engubukhosi eYerusalem.
Wakwenza okumbi emehloni kaYehova uzimu wakhe; akhenge ahloniphe phambi kukaYeremiya umprofeti, okhuluma amazwi kaYehova.
Wagqugquzela begodu ukumkani uNebhukadnezare, owenza ukuba abeke isandla sakhe emgodini kaThixo; wagwema ukubuyela kuYehova, uzimu wakwaSirayeli.

Nabo bonke abaphathi bamabhishobhi, nalabo bonke abantu, baphinde baqhubeka nokwenza izigebengu, belandela zonke izinto ezingathandeki zazo zonke izizwe; begodu bahlanza indlu kaYehova, eyayiyingcwele eYerusalem.
Nokho ikosi, uzimu wabababa babo, wathumela kubo ngezandla zakhe izithunywa zakhe, ephuma ekuseni nakusihlwa; ngombana wayethandazela abantu bakhe, nendawo yakhe.

Kodwana bona baphoxeka izithunywa kaThixo, begodu baphoxeka amazwi akhe, begodu baphoxeka abaprofeti bakhe. Ngaleso sikhathi inhliziyo kaYehova yanyuka phezu kwabantu bakhe, begodu kwakungekho ongayivimbela.

Wathi ikosi wabaletha phezu kwabo ukumkani waseBhabheli, wabulala amadodana abo ngeqhwa ethempelini labo elingcwele; akawakhathaleli amadodana abo, namadodakazi abo, namadoda amakhulu abo, namadoda amancane abo. Wabanikela kiwo wonke umuntu.
Wathatha zonke izimpahla zendlu kaThixo, ezikhulu nezincane, kanye nempahla yendlu kaYehova, nempahla yokumkani, nabasebenzi bakhe, waya eBhabheli.
Babulala isibhedlela sikaThixo, baphonsa phasi idonga laseYerusalem, babulala zonke izindlu zikabukhosi, babulala yonke into ebalulekile.
Alabo abantu abaye bagcina bephila, uHezekiya wabathumela eBhabheli; babe ngabakhonzi bakhe nabenzana bakhe, kuze kube yilapho izwe lasePersiya lifika.
Lokhu kwakwenza bona izwe lijabulele ukuphumula kweSonto layo, kuze kube sekuphele iminyaka eyishumi nesishiyagalombili, njengombana ikosi atjhilo ngaye kuYeremiya.

Ngomnyaka wokuthoma ka-Koresh ukumkani wasePerishi, ikosi wenza bona kwenzeke ilizwi lakhe, elinguYeremiya. uzimu wavusa inhliziyweni ka-Koresh ukumkani wasePerishi, ukuba amemezele ngaso soke isizwe sakhe, wathi:

UKoresh, ukumkani wasePersi, uthi: UYehova, uzimu wasezulwini, unikezile zonke izizwe zezulu; begodu yena ukhethela bona ngikhiphe indlu yakhe eYerusalem, eyaseYuda. Uma kukhona phakathi kwenu othile phakathi kwabantu bakhe, angaya khona, begodu ikosi, uzimu wabo, abe naye.
Ezra: Ngomnyaka wokuthoma ka-Koresh ukumkani wasePerishi, ikosi wenza bona kwenzeke ilizwi lakhe, elinguYeremiya. uzimu wavusa inhliziyweni ka-Koresh ukumkani wasePerishi, ukuba amemezele ngaso soke isizwe sakhe, wathi:
Uthi uKore, ukumkani wasePersi: UYehova, uzimu wasezulwini, unikezile zonke izizwe zezulu; yena ukhethela bona ngikhele indlu yakhe eYerusalem, eseYuda.
Uma kukhona phakathi kwenu othile emndenini wakhe, afike eYerusalem eYuda, begodu uzimu wakhe abe naye; baphinde bavule indlu kaYehova uzimu wakwaSirayeli, yena uzimu ohlala eYerusalem.
Uma kukhona umuntu osele ezweni lakhe, abantu balo mhlaba basizane naye ngesiliva, negolide, nezimpahla, nezilwane, kanye nalokho abazokhetha ukunikela ngalo endlini kaThixo eYerusalem.
Basuka khona abakhulu bezindlu zakwaYuda nakwaBhenjamini, namabhishobhi, namaLevi, bonke labo asezulwini uzimu wabo wabeka engqondweni sabo ukuya kwakha indlu kaYehova eYerusalem.
Nabo bonke abasondelene nabo basizakala ngezinto zesiliva, negolide, nezimpahla, nezilwane, namathoyizi, ngaphezu kwazo zonke izinto ezithandekayo.
UKumkani uKoresh wakhipha begodu izinto zendlu kaYehova, azenzayo uNebhukadnezare eYerusalem, waza azibeka endlwini yoThixo wakhe.
UKoresh, ukumkani wasePersi, wathumela uMitredathi, umphathi wezimali, wayazikhipha; wababala kuSheshbazar, umholi wakwaYuda.
Le yinombolo sabo: amabhodwe egolide amashumi amathathu, namabhodlela wesilivere elilodwa, izinkomishi eziyisishiyagalombili nesithoba;
izitsha zegolide ezingu-30, izitsha zesilivere ezingu-400 ezilinganayo ezingu-10, nezinye izinto eziyizigidi.
Zonke lezi zinto zaziyizigidi eziyisishiyagalombili nekhulu elinamashumi amane zegolide nosiliva. Wazithatha zonke uSheshbazar, lapho abantu ababoshiwe besuka eBhabheli befika eYerusalem.
Nalaba babantu besifundazwe abasuka ezweni elihambayo, labo uNebhukadnezare ukumkani waseBhabheli abewathatha waya eBhabheli; babebuya eYerusalem naseYuda, wonke umuntu edolobhaneni lakhe.
Bafika nabo uZerubabele, noYeshua, noNehemiya, noSeraya, noRelaya, noMordekayi, noBilshan, noMishpar, noBigwai, noRehumu, noBaana. Lokho yinani lamadoda aseSirayeli:
Amadodana kaParosh, amawaka amabili nekhulu elilodwa nesishiyagalombili.
Oonyana baka-Shefatiya, amakhulu amathathu, ayisishiyagalolunye nambili.
Oonyana baka-Araha, inani labo liyikhulu nesishiyagalolunye.
Oonyana bakaPahati-Mowabhi, ngoYeshuwa noYowabha, abe yizigidi ezimbili namakhulu ayisishiyagalombili namahlanu.
Oonyana baka-Elam, inkulungwane namakhulu amabili namashumi mahlanu anane.
Amadodana kaZathu, amakhulu ayisishiyagalombili namahlanu.
Oonyana baka-Zakhayi, inani labo ngumakhulu asixhenxe, ayisishiyagalolunye.
Amadodakazi ka-Bani, inani labo likhulu elinamashumi mane nambili.
Amadodana kaBebhayi, amakhulu ayisishiyagalombili namashumi amathathu.
Amadodana ka-Azgadi, ikhulu elilodwa nenkulungwane ezimbili namashumi mabini namahlanu.
Oonyana baka-Adonikam, inani labo likhulu elinamashumi mane anesithandathu.
Amadodana kaBhigwayi, amawaka amabili anesihlanu nesishiyagalombili.
Amadodakazi ka-Adin, inani labo ngumakhulu amane, anamahlanu anane.
Amadodana ka-Atere, ngoHizekiya, amashumi ayisishiyagalolunye namane.
Amadodana kaBezayi, amakhulu amathathu namahlanu namashumi amathathu.
Oonyana bakaJora, inani labo liyikhulu elilodwa nambili.
Amadodana kaHashumu, amakhulu amabili namashumi mathathu namahlanu.
Amadodana kaGibhari, amashumi ayisishiyagalombili nasihlanu.
abantu base-Bethlehem, inani labo liyikhulu elinamashumi mathathu.
Amadodana kaNetofa, amashumi amahlanu anesithandathu.
Amadodana kaAnathothi, amakhulu ayisishiyagalombili anesibhozo.
Amadodana ka-Azmavethi, amashumi amane nambili.
Abantu baseKiriyati-arimu, naseKefira, naseBherothi, amakhulu asixhenxe, anamahlanu namashumi amathathu.
Amadodana eRama neGeba, amakhulu ayisishiyagalombili namahlanu.
Amadodana kaMikmas, amakhulu ayisishiyagalombili namahlanu.
Amadoda aseBhetheleli ne-Ai, amakhulu amabili namashumi mathathu.
abantu baseNebo, abamashumi amane nambili.
abantu baseMagbish, ikhulu elinhlanu nesishiyagalombili.
Amadodana ka-Elam amanye, abe yizigidi ezimbili nekhulu namashumi amane anesihlanu.
Oonyana baka-Harim, amakhulu amathathu namahlanu.
Amadodana kaLodi, noHadidi, noOno, amakhulu asixhenxe, anamahlanu namabini.
abantu baseJericho, amakhulu amathathu anamashumi amane nahlanu.
Amadodana kaSinaya, amawaka amathathu, namakhulu ayisishiyagalombili namashumi amathathu.
Ababhishobhi: oonyana bakaJedaya, emndenini ka-Yeshuwa, abengumakhulu asithoba, anamashumi nesithupha.
Amadodana ka-Imer, elilodwa elinamashumi mahlanu nambili.
Amadodana kaPashure, izigidi ezingu-200 amashumi amane nesikhombisa.
Oonyana baka-Harim, inkulungwane eyodwa nesishiyagalombili.
AbaLevi: oonyana bakaYeshua noKadmiyeli, bomndeni kaHodaviya, babemashumi asixhenxe nane.
Abaculi: oonyana baka-Asaphu, amakhulu amabili namashumi ayisithupha.
Amadodana kaShalumu, no-Atere, no-Talmone, no-Akube, no-Hatitha, no-Shobhayi, abengumakhulu amathathu ananye.
Amadodakazi kaSiha, noHashupha, noTabhaothi,
uKeros, noSiaha, noPadon,
uLebhana, noHagaba, noAkubu,
uHaghabhi, noShamlayi, noHanani,
uGideyeli, noGahare, noRehaya,
uRezin, noNekoda, noGazam,
no-Uza, no-Paseha, no-Besayi,
i-Asna, neMeunim, neNephishim,
Bakbuk, Hakupha, Harhur
Bazluth, Mehida, Harsha
uBarkhoshi, noSisera, noTema,
uNeziah, noHatipha.
Amadodakazi abangani bakaSolomoni: amadodana kaShotai, noHasoferethi, noPeruda,
Jaalah, Darkon, Giddel,
noShefatiya, noHathili, noPokerethi Hazebayim, noAmi.
Wonke amaNethinimi, namadodakazi amakhosikazi kaSolomoni, kwaba ngumakhulu amathathu, anamashumi ayisishiyagalolunye namabini.
Abanye abantu bafika ezindaweni zaseTel Melah, neTel Harsha, neCherub, neAddan, ne-Immer, kodwana abakwazi ukukhombisa bona izingane zabo zivela kuSirayeli.
Oonyana bakaDelaya, noTobiya, noNekoda, abemakhulu amathandathu, anamahlanu nambili.
Kilabo ababingeleli: oonyana bakaHobhaya, uHakosi, noBarzilayi. UBarzilayi washada nenkosikazi kaBarzilayi waseGiliyadi, wathatha igama lomndeni wakhe.
Bafuna amagama abo ezincwadini zomndeni, kodwana abakwazi ukuwathola; ngalokho baphoqeleke ukuba bangasebenzi njengeziphathimandla.
Wabatjela bona bangadli ukudla okungcwele khulu, kuze kube khona umpristi ongakwazi ukubuza uzimu ngo-Urim no-Tummim.
Wonke lo mhlangano waba ngamaphesenti angama-42 namakhulu amathathu namashumi ayisishiyagalombili,

kufaka phakathi abakhonzi babo, amadoda namabhishobhi, ayizinkulungwane eziyisixhenxe namakhulu amathathu namashumi amathathu nesishiyagalombili. Babe nezingcweti ezingamakhulu amabili, amadoda nabesifazane.
Babenezimvu ezingumakhulu asixhenxe, amashumi amathathu anesithandathu, nezingulube eziyinkulungwane ezimbili ne Corri.
izinkomo ezingumakhulu amane, amashumi amathathu anesihlanu, namabhubesi ayizigidi eziyisishiyagalombili namashumi ayisithupha.
Bafika ethempelini lika-Yehova eYerusalem, kwathi abanye abakhulu bezindlu zakubo banikela ngomnikelo wokudla ukuze baphinde bavule kabutjha ithempeli likaThixo endaweni yayo yokuqala.
Banikela ngalokho abakwaziyo ngemali yokwakha: amakhilogremu ayisishiyagalombili wegolide, namathani amathathu esiliva, kanye nezigqoko ezingu-100 zabapristi.
Bahlala khona ababhishobhi, nalabaLevi, nabanye abantu, namangomani, nabaphathi bezingcingo, nabenzi bezindlu zakwaNethinimi, emizini sabo; nabo bonke isiSirayeli bahlala emizini sabo.
Kwafika unyaka wesixhenxe, begodu izingane zakwaSirayeli zazihlala emizini yazo; abantu bonke bahlangana ndawonye eYerusalem njengendoda eyodwa.

Baqala ke uYeshua, unyana kaYosadaki, nabangane bakhe abapristi, noZerubabele, unyana kaShealtiyele, nabangane bakhe, ukukwakha isibhedlela sikaThixo wakwaSirayeli, ukuba banikela phezu kwayo ngezipho ezishisayo, njengombana kubhalwe emthethweni kaMoses, umuntu kaThixo.
Baphinde bakwakha isibingelelo endaweni yayo, begodu benikela phezu kwayo ngenhlanhla yokudlwengula kuYehova ekuseni nakusihlwa; ngombana babekhathazekile ngalabo abahlala emazweni asendaweni sabo.
Bagcine usuku lwezindlu zokuphumula, ngokusho komthetho, benikela ngosuku ngalunye ngezipho ezibomvu, ngokwenani elidingekayo ngalolusuku.
Ngemuva kwalokho, banikela ngezipho ezibomvu eziqhubekayo, nezipho zezinsuku zonyaka omusha, nezipho zazo zonke amalanga ezingcwele zikaYehova; nabo bonke abantu abakhetha ukunikela ngazo kuYehova.
Ngosuku lokuqala lwenyanga yesixhenxe baqala ukunikela ngenhlanhla yokudlwengula kukaNkulunkulu; kodwana isisekelo sethempeli likaYehova asikube sibekwe.

Banikela ngemali kubo bonke abaqambi bezindonga, nabenzi bezinhlamvu; banikela ngokudla nokuphuza nophethiloli kubantu baseSidoni nabaseTyre, ukuze bathuthe izinkuni zesithelo elwandle kusuka eLibanoni kuya eYopa, njengombana uKoresh ukumkani wasePersia abewavumele.

Ngonyaka wesithathu ngemuva kokufika kwabo eJerusalema, ngonyaka owesibili wenyanga yesibili, baqala umsebenzi uZerubabele indodana kaShealtiyele, noYeshuwa intombi kaYosadaka, namanye abazalwane babo ababhishobhi nabaLevi, nabo bonke labo ababesuka emgodini befika eYerusalem. Bahlukanisa amaLevi abeneminyaka eyishumi nesishiyagalombili nangaphezulu, ukuba babe ngabaphathi bezindlu zikaYehova.

Bahlangana uYeshua, nabantwana bakhe, nabazalwane bakhe, noKadmiyeli, nabantwana bakhe, bonke amakhosikazi kaYuda, ukuba babambe iqhaza labo abasebenza endlwini kaThixo; kwasizakala nabo izingane zikaHenadadi, nabantwana babo, nabangane babo, abeLevi.

Kwathi lapho labo abaqambi bemisa isisekelo sethempelini likaYehova, kwaba khona amabhishobhi agqoke izingubo zabo ezimhlophe, namahhashi; namaLevi, oonyana baka-Asaphu, abe nezinhlamvu, ebonga ikosi, ngokwemiyalo kaDavide ukumkani wakwaSirayeli.
Bathi, "uzimu ulungile, ngombana inhlonipho yakhe kuSirayeli ihlala kuze kube sekupheleni." Abantu bonke bamemezela ngezwi elikhulu ukubonga ikosi, ngenxa yokuthi isisekelo sendlu kaThixo safakwa.
Baningi abakhulu phakathi kwababhishobhi, nabaLevi, namadodakazi emindenini sabo, abebona indlu yokuqala, lapho isisekelo saleyo ndlu sifakwa khona, bashaya ngamandla; abanye nabo bashaya ngokuthula.
Akukho muntu okwaziyo ukuhlukanisa phakathi kwengxoxo yothando nengxoxo yokulingisa, ngombana abantu bakwenza umsindo omkhulu. Umsindo wawudlalwa kude.
Kwathi lapho beva abasolwa baseYuda nabaseBhenjamini bona labo ababuyayo empilweni yokuzibophezela bekwakha indlu kaYehova, uzimu wakwaSirayeli.

Bafike kuZerubabele, nabakhulu bezindlu zakwababa, bathi kubo, Sizokwakha nawe; ngombana sikhonza uzimu wakho njengawe, begodu siyamnikela kuye kusukela ezikhathini zika-Esarhaddoni ukumkani wakwa-Ashuri, owathuthela lapha.

Kodwana uZerubabele, noYeshuwa, nabanye abakhulu bemindeni yamaSirayeli, baphendula bathi kubo: Akunakho okuzokwenzekani nani nathi ukukwakha indlu yoNkulunkulu wethu; thina kuphela sizoyenza kuYehova, uzimu wamaSirayeli, njengokuthi ukumkani uKoresh, ukumkani wasePerisi, awisenzile.
Kwathi abantu belizwe bafuna ukukhohlisa abantu bakaYuda, ukuze bagweme ukukwakha.
Baqasha abacebisi ukuba basebenze nabo, ukuze bagweme isinqumo sabo; bakwenza njalo yonke imihla ka-Koresh ukumkani wasePersi, kuze kube nguDarius ukumkani wasePersi.
Kuqaleni kokubusa kuka-Xerxes, babhalela isimangalo abantu baseYuda nabaseJerusalema, bathi:
Ngosuku luka-Artaxerxes, uBishlam, noMitredath, noTabeel, nabangane babo babhala incwadi ku-Artaxerxes, ukumkani wasePersia; yabhalwa ngohlobo lwesiArami, nelimi laseArami.
U-Rehumu, umphathi omkhulu, no-Shimshai, umbhali, babhale incwadi eJerusalema kukumkani u-Artaxerxesha, bathi:
Kusuka ku-Rehumu umphathi, no-Shimshai umbhali, nabangane babo, abameli, nabaphathi, nabaqondisi bomphakathi wase-Ereki, naseBhabheli, naseShushani e-Elam, nakwamanye amadolobha;
kanye nezinye izizwe, okuthiwa u-Ashurbanipal omkhulu, owaziwa khulu, wazisa ezweni laseSamariya, nakwamanye amadolobha asenyakatho yomfula i-Ephrate.
Le yikopi yeleta labo elithunyelwe, bathi: Kukumkani u-Artahsazare, abakhonzi bakho, abantu abasenyakatho yomfula i-Ephratha.
Kucace kuye ukumkani, bona abantu baseYiputa abasuka kuwe bafika nathi eYerusalem, behlala khona, bekwakha kabutjha lo mzi okhohlakelayo nobi, beqedela imingcele yawo, bezilungisa izifunda.
Ubukhosi buzokwazi bona uma lo mzi ukhiwa kabutjha, begodu amadonga awo eqediwe, bazoyeka ukukhokha inzalo, nokukhokhwa kwempahla, nezindleko; khona-ke isibopho sombuso sizoba nzima.
Ngokuba siyilungu lepalati, asifuni ukubona ukumkani ehlonishwa. Ngalokho sithumela ukutjela ukumkani bona:

ukuze ukwazi ukuhlola iincwadi zomlando zababa bakho. Kulezi ncwadi uzothola bona le ndawo iyidolobha elibusayo, elibangela ukukhathazeka kwabakumkani nezifundazwe. Liyindawo yobugebengu kusukela eminyakeni eminingi eyadlulayo. Lokhu kuyisizathu sokuthi yalahlekile.
Siyazitshela ukumkani bona, uma lo mzi ukhiwa kabutjha, begodu amadonga awo eqediwe, ngeke kubekho okusele kuwe ngaphesheya komfula i-Ephratha.
Waphendula ukumkani wathi, Ku-Rehumu umvikeli, noShimshai umbhali, nabangane babo abahlala eSamariya, nakwezinye izizwe ezisentshonalanga yeMfula i-Ephrathi: Ukuthula.
Lo mbhalo othunyelwe thina uguqulwe begodu wafundwa kimi.
Nginikeze umyalelo, begodu kwenziwa uphenyo. Kuboniswa bona lo mzi ubelokhu engqubuzana nobukhosi kusukela kuleso sikhathi eside. Ube yindawo yokungqubuzana nokunqoba.
Bakhona abaphathi abanamandla eYerusalem, nasezweni lonke elasenyakatho yomfula i-Euphrates; begodu bakhokhelwa izibopho, namaholo, nezimali.
Ngalokho namuhla ngizokunikeza umyalelo wokumisa labo bantu. Lo mzi akufanele ubuyiselwe emuva kuze kube yilapho nginika umyalelo.
Khumbula bona ungayikhohlwa le nto. Kungani likhula leli gciwane, libe yingozi kumakumkani?"
Uma nje ikopi leposi likakumkani u-Artaxerxes lifundeka ku-Rehumu, noShimshai umbhali, nabangane babo, bahamba ngejubane baya kumaYuda eYerusalem, baphoqelela ukuba bagweme.
Ngalokhu kwamiswa umsebenzi wokwakha indlu kaThixo eYerusalem, wamiswa kuze kube yiminyaka emibini yokubusa kukaDariyosi ukumkani wasePerisi.
UHaggai umprofeti, noZekariya unyana ka-Iddo, abaprofeti, bakhuluma ngezwi likaThixo kubo bonke amaJuda aseYuda naseYerusalem; bekhuluma ngegama loMdali wakwaSirayeli.
UZerubabele unyana kaShealtiyele, noYeshuwa unyana ka-Yosadaki, baphinde baqala ukukwakha indlu kaThixo eYerusalem; babe nabo abaprofeti bakaThixo, besiza.

Ngaleso sikhathi kwafika kubo uTatenai, umphathi wasenyakatho-mpumalanga yeMfula i-Ephrathi, noShethar-bozenai, nabangane babo, wathi kubo, Ubani owakulethela ukuba nivule indlu leyo, niqedele idonga?
Baye babuza begodu, "Yintoni amagama abantu abasebenza kule ndawo?"
Kodwana uzimu wayezihlola izikhulu zakwaYuda, ngalokho abaphathi abazange bagweme ukuboshwa kwabo, kuze kube yilapho kuthunyelwe inhlolovo ku-Darius, begodu impendulo ifike ngenhla.
Ikopi leposi elithunyelwe nguTatenai, umphathi wesifundazwe esisenyakatho yeMfula i-Ephrate, noShethar-bozenai, nabangane babo, abavikeli basenyakatho yeMfula, kukumkani uDarius.
Bathumela incwadi bathi, Kukumkani uDariuse: Ukuthula noxolo.

Kucace bona ukumkani, safika esifundazweni saseYuda, siye ethempelini likaThixo omkhulu; lisetshenziswe amatshe amakhulu ukulilungisa, begodu imilenze yokhuni ifakwa emaphahleni. Le misebenzi isebenza ngokucophelela khulu, ihamba kahle.
Sibuze abaphathi, 'Ubani owakulethela imvume yokwakha kabutjha lesi sigodlo nokuqedela lodonga?
Sicela begodu amagama abo, ukuze sikwazi ukubhala phasi amagama abaphathi babo kuwe.
Bathi kuthi: "Siyimikhonzi kaThixo wezulu nephasi, begodu sibuye sakhiwa indlu eyenziwe eminyakeni eminingi eyadlulayo. Ubukhosi obukhulu baseSirayeli buyivulela begodu buyiqedile.
Kodwana abazali bethu bacindezela uzimu wasezulwini, ngalokho wabanikela kuNebhukadnezare waseBhabheli, ukumkani wakwaBabiloni; waphula indlu leyo, wayisa abantu eBhabeli.
Kodwana ngonyaka wokuthoma kaKoresh, ukumkani waseBhabheli, uKumkani uKoresh wakhipha umyalelo wokwakha kabutjha lesi sibhedlela sikaThixo.

UKoresh ukumkani wakhipha ethempelini laseBhabheli izinto zegolide nesiliva zendlu kaThixo, oNabukodonozore awathathele ethempelini laseYerusalem, wayazifaka ethempelini laseBhabheli; wazisa kulowo owayebizwa bona nguSheshbazar, owakwenza umphathi.
Wathi uKoresh kuye, Thola lezi zinto, uzibeke ethempelini elisesiJerusalema; ukwakha kabutjha indlu kaThixo endaweni yayo.
Wafika ke uSheshbazar, wabeka isisekelo sendlu kaThixo eYerusalem; kusukela ngaleso sikhathi yakhiwa, kodwana ayiqediwe kuze manje.

Manje, uma kungalungile kukumkani, kufanele kwenziwe uphenyo encwadini yombuso yaseBhabheli, bona ngabe uKumkani uKoresh wakhipha umthetho wokwakha kabutjha indlu kaThixo eYerusalem. Uma kunjalo, khona-ke umkani asikuthumelele isinqumo sakhe mayelana nale nto.
Kwathi lapho, ukumkani uDariyos wakhipha umthetho, bafuna izincwadi ezigcinwe ezindaweni zezimali eBhabheli.
Uncwadi lwafunyanwa esitezi esiphakeme sase-Ecbatana, esifundazweni sakwaMediya. Lolu yilokho okubhalwe kulo:

Ngomnyaka wokuthoma ka-Koresh ukumkani, ubukhosi bakhipha umthetho mayelana nendlu kaThixo eYerusalem, bathi: Le ndlu kumele ibuyiselwe ibe yindawo yokunikela ngenhlanhla; isisekelo sayo kufanele sibekwe ngokuqinile; ubude bayo kufanele bube ngamasentimitha ayishumi nesishiyagalombili, begodu ububanzi bayo kufanele bube ngamasentimitha ayisikhombisa.
Kudingeka kube nama-layers amathathu amatshe amakhulu kanye ne-layer eyodwa yomthi omusha. Izindleko zizokhokhwa kusuka ebhange likankosi.

Nakuba izinto zegolide nesiliva zendlu kaThixo, azenzayo uNebhukadnezare ethempelini laseYerusalem, wazisa eBhabhiloni, kufanele zibuyiselwe, zithunyelwe ethempelini laseYerusalem, zibekwe endaweni yazo ethempelini likaThixo.
Wabhala ke uDarius, wathi, Ngokuba manje, Tatenai, umphathi wasenyakatho yeMfula i-Ephrathi, naShethare-bozenai, nabangani bakho abasemaphandleni kweMfula, zinikele.

Wathi kubo, "Kulungile. Kulungile, ushiye umsebenzi kule ndawo yokuzinikela kaThixo, begodu umphathi waseYiputa nabaholi baseYiputa baphinde bavule kabutjha le ndawo yokuzinikela kaThixo endaweni yayo yakudala.

Ngiyakucela bona usize labo abakhulu baseYiputa bavule indlu kaThixo leyo; begodu izindleko zabo zonke zikhokhwe kubo, kusuka ezimalini zikakumkani, ezisuka emfuleni i-Euphrates, ukuze le misebenzi ingapheleli.

Okunye okudingayo kufanele kunikezwe kubo ngosuku ngalunye: izinkomo ezincane, namakhowe, namabele, ukuze kube yiminikelo yokushiswa kuThixo wasezulu; nengulube, noshizi, newayini, nephethiloli, ngokuya ngesicelo samabhishobhi aseYerusalem.
Bazokwazi ukunikela ngezinkondlo ezithandekayo kuThixo wasezulu, begodu bathandaza ngokuphila kukakumkani nabantwana bakhe.

Ngicela begodu bona uma kukhona umuntu oshintsha lo mthetho, kufanele kuqhutshwe i-beam kusuka efulethini lakhe, begodu kumele baphakanyiswe bese beboshwe kuyo. Ifulethi labo kumele lishintshe libe yipulasitiki ngenxa yalokhu.

uzimu owenza igama lakhe lihlale khona, agweme wonke ukumkani nanoma yiliphi izwe elizozama ukushintsha lesi simiso, ukuze lisuse le ndlu kaThixo eYerusalem. Ngami, uDariyosi, ngikhiphe umthetho; kufanele kube njalo.
Wathi uTatenai, umphathi wasenyakatho yeMfula i-Ephrate, noShethar-bozenai, nabangane babo, bakwenza ngokucophelela konke okumwise ngawo ukumkani uDarius.

Baphinde balungisa, begodu bakwenza kahle, ngenxa yezwi likaHaggai umprofeti, noZekariya unyana ka-Iddo. Baqedile ukukwakha indlu ngomthetho kaThixo wakwaSirayeli, kanye nomthetho kaKoresh noDarius noArtaxerxeshi, abaphathi basePersiya.
Waqedwa lo ndlu ngomhla wesithathu wenyanga ka-Adare, ngonyaka wesixhenxe wokubusa kukaDariyo ukumkani.
Baphoqeleka ke bonke abantu baseSirayeli, nabapristi, nalabaLevi, neminye imindeni sabo, ababuyayo empilweni yobugebengu, ukuba benze isibingelelo salesi sibhedlela sikaThixo.

Banikela ekuqondeni lendlu kaThixo ngezinkomo ezingu-100, nezimvu eziyinkulungwane ezimbili, namabele angama-400; begodu ngesondlo sesono sakwaSirayeli bonke banikeza amabhokhwe alishumi elinambini, esinye isizwe ngayinye samaSirayeli.
Babeka ababhishobhi nalabaLevi ngezigaba zabo, ukuba basebenzele uzimu eYerusalem, njengombana kubhalwe encwadini kaMoses.
Bathi abantu abasuka empilweni yobugebengu, bagcine iPasha ngomhla wesithupha wenyanga yokuqala.
Bathi abapristi nalabaLevi bahlanza izandla zabo ndawonye, bonke behlanzekile; begodu babulala izinyamazane zepasha zalabo bonke abantu ababuyayo, nabangani babo ababingeleli, nabasebo.
Baye badla amaSirayeli, labo ababuyayo empilweni yobugebengu, kanye nalabo bonke ababezihlukanisile nezindlela ezingcolile zezwe lakwaSirayeli, ukuba babe nguYehova uzimu kaSirayeli.

Bagcine usuku lwezithelo ezingekho emthethweni amalanga eziyisixhenxe, bewujabulela; ngombana ikosi wabathokozisa ngokushintsha umphefumulo kakumkani wase-Ashuri, ukuba awasize ekwenzeni umsebenzi wendlu kaThixo, uzimu wakwaSirayeli.
Ngemuva kwalezi zinto, ezikhathini zika-Artaxerxes, ukumkani wasePersiya, bekukhona umuntu okuthiwa nguEzra, indodana kaSeraya, indodana kaAzaria, indodana kaHilkiya,
unyana kaShalum, unyana kaTsadoki, unyana ka-Ahitubi,
unyana ka-Amariya, unyana ka-Azariya, unyana ka-Meraiothi,
unyana kaZerahiya, unyana kaUzi, unyana kaBukki,
indodana ka-Abishuwa, indodana ka-Phinehasi, indodana ka-Eleazare, indodana ka-Aron umpristi omkhulu.

UEzra lo waphuma eBhabheli, ube ngumfundi owaziyo ngokupheleleko umthetho kaMosis, omthetho kaYehova uzimu kaSirayeli owanikela ngawo; begodu ukumkani wamnika yonke into ayeyicela, ngenxa yosizo lukaYehova uzimu wakhe.
Ngomnyaka wesixhenxe wokumkani u-Artaxerxes, kwafika naye eYerusalem amanye amadodana aseSirayeli, namabhishobhi, namaLevi, nabaculi, nabaphathi bezindonga, nabaseNethinimi.
Wafika uEzra eYerusalem ngonyaka wesixhenxe wokumkani, ngenyanga yesihlanu.
Waphuma eBhabheli ngomhla wokuthoma wenyanga yokuqala, wafika eYerusalem ngomhla wokuthoma wenyanga yesishiyagalombili, ngenxa yokuthi isandla esihle sikaThixo wakhe sakuba phezu kwakhe.
UEzra wabeka intliziyo yakhe ekufundeni umthetho kaYehova, ukuze ukwenze, begodu afundise ezweni lakwaSirayeli izimiso zalo nomthetho.
Le yikopi yeleta uKumkani Artaxerxes awanika uEzra, umbhishobhi, umfundi, owazi izimiso nomthetho kaYehova ngabaseSirayeli.
U-Artaxerxes, ukumkani wabakumkani, ubhalela uEzra, umpristi, owaziyo umthetho kaThixo wasezulu.
Ngibeka umthetho bona wonke umuntu ezweni lami, phakathi kwamadodana kaSirayeli, naphakathi kwababhishobhi babo, nabaLevi, ofuna ukuya eYerusalem, ahambe nawe.
Uthunyelwe ngukumkani, nabangane bakhe abasebathathu, ukuba ubheke izwe laseYuda neJerusalema, bona bangawulungisa kanjani umthetho kaThixo wakho, okhona kuwe.
uthathe ngesandla sakho igolide nesilivere, okuthi ukumkani nabangane bakhe banikela ngayo ngokuzithandela kuThixo wakwaSirayeli, ohlala eYerusalem.
begodu uthathe igolide nesilivere zonke, ongazithola ezweni laseBhabheli, kanye nomnikelo womuntu, nalowo wamabhishobhi, abawunikela ngokukhululekileyo indlu kaThixo wabo eYerusalem.
Uzosebenzisa lemali ngokucophelela, uthenge izingulube, nezimvu, namabele, kanye nesibopho sabo sokudla nokuphuza; uzozinikela phezu kwesibingelelo sendlu kaThixo wakho eYerusalem.
Uzokwenza, wena nabangani bakho abaYuda, ngaleyo golide nesilivere esele, konke okungekuhle engqondweni yenu, ngokwesifiso soThixo wenu.
Uzonikela kuThixo waseJerusalema zonke izinto ezinikeziwe kuwe, ukuze zisetshenziswa endlwini kaThixo wakho.
Uma kukhona okuthile okudingayo endlwini kaThixo wakho, ungayikhokhela kusuka emgodini wombuso.

Ngami, ukumkani u-Artaxerxes, ngitjho kubo bonke abaphathi bezimpahla ezisentshonalanga yeMfula i-Euphrates, bona konke okuzokucela wena uEzra umpristi, owaziyo umthetho kaThixo wasezulu, bakulethe ngokucophelela;
kuze kube ngamathani amathathu nesishiyagalombili wegolide, namatoni ayikhulu engulube, namalitha amabili omnqumo, namalitha amabili ophethiloli we-olive, kanye noshizi oluningi njengombana efuna.
Wonke umyalo kaThixo wasezulu mayelana nendlu yakhe kufanele kwenziwe ngokucophelela, ukuze kungaze kube khona inkohliso phezu kobukhosi bokumkani nabantwana bakhe.

Ngiyakutjela begodu bona akufanele ukhokhe noma yikuphi ukukhokhelwa, noma inkokhelo, noma umshwalense kinanyana ngubani osebenza kulendlu kaThixo, phakathi kwababhishobhi, nabaLevi, nabaculi, nabangani besango, nabenzi bezindlu,

Begodu wena, Ezra, sebenzisa ubuhlakani boNkulunkulu wakho obubekwe kuwe, ukhethe abavikeli nabaphathi ukuba bagweme bonke abantu abasenyakatho-mpumalanga yeMfula i-Efrayi, labo abawazi umthetho kaThixo wakho; nalowo ongawazi umthetho wakhe, ufundise.

Wonke umuntu ongeke agcine umthetho kaThixo wakho, nomthetho wokumkani, kufanele kuhlolwe ngokucophelela, nokuba wukufa, noma ukuboshwa, noma ukwehliswa kwempahla yakhe, noma ukuba ezindaweni zokugcina.
Wathi uEzra, Kuhloswe ikosi, uzimu wakwababa bethu, owabeka kulobu hlobo enhliziyweni yokumkani, ukuba ahlobise indlu kaYehova eYerusalem.
Wathi: "uzimu, uzimu kaSirayeli, usindise isizwe sakwaSirayeli, begodu wabonisa inhlonipho yakhe ngami phambi kukakumkani, nabangcwabi bakhe, nangenxa yalabo bonke abaphathi bakhe abavukayo.
Lezi zikhulu zemindeni sabo, nalabo ababhaliswe nabo, abasuka eBhabheli bephuma nami, ngesikhathi uKumkani uArtakserkses elawula.
Kwabesilisa bakaPhinehasi, uGershoni; kwabesilisa baka-Ithamari, uDaniyeli; kwabesilisa bakaDavide, uHatushi.
Ngabo oonyana baka-Shekaniya, ngabo oonyana baka-Paroshe, uZekariya; naye namadodana akhe amakhulu amahlanu, abhalwe ngomlando womndeni.
Kumadodana kaPahati-Mowabi, uElihoheni unyana kaZerahiya; naye amadoda amakhulu amabili.
Ngabo oonyana bakaShekaniya, uYahaziyeli; naye namadodana akhe amakhulu amathathu.
Kumadodana ka-Adin, uEbedi unyana kaYonathani; naye amadoda amashumi amahlanu.
Kumadodana ka-Elam, uYeshaya unyana ka-Athaliya; naye amadoda amashumi asixhenxe.
Ngabo oonyana bakaShefatiya, uZebadia unyana kaMikayeli; naye namadoda angamashumi asibhozo.
Ngabo oonyana bakaYowabha, uObadiya unyana kaJehiyeli; naye namadodana akhe amakhulu mabini, anamashumi nesishiyagalolunye.
Ngabo oonyana bakaShelomith, uYosifohiya unyana wakhe; naye namadodana akhe amakhulu ayisishiyagalombili.
Kumadodana ka-Bebhayi, uZekariya unyana ka-Bebhayi; naye amadoda amashumi amabili anesibhozo.
Ngabo oonyana baka-Azgadi, uYohanan unyana kaHakatani; naye namadodana akhe amakhulu amabili namahlanu.
Ngabo oonyana baka-Adonikam: uElifelethe, noYehuyeli, noShemaya; nabo amadoda amashumi ayisishiyagalombili.
Kumadodana kaBigwai, nguUthai noZabhudi; nabo amadoda amashumi asixhenxe.
Ngabaqoqa emfuleni osuka e-Ahava, sahlala khona amalanga amathathu; ngabheka abantu nabapristi, ngabona bona akunandaba nabantu baseLevi.
Kwathi ngathumela, ngibiza labo abakhulu: uEliyezere, noAriel, noShemaya, noElnathani, noYaribe, noElnathani, noNathane, noZekariya, noMeshulamu; begodu ngathumela uYoyaribi, noElnathani, abafundi.
Ngabathumela ku-Iddo, umphathi waseKasifiya; ngabeka engqondweni sabo bona bangathi yini ku-Iddo nabangane bakhe, abapristi baseKasiphia, ukuze basithumelele abaholi bendlu kaThixo wethu.

Ngokuba isandla esithandekayo saNkulunkulu wethu sikhona phezu kwethu, basithumelele umuntu owaziyo igama lakhe nguSherebiya, ongumzali kaMahli, unyana kaLevi, unyana kaSirayeli. Wafika naye nabantwana bakhe nabangane bakhe, amadodana ayishumi nesishiyagalombili.
Bathatha begodu uHashabiya, naye noYeshaya, kwabaseMerariya, nabangane bakhe nabantwana babo, amadoda angumashumi amabili.
Nabo abaphathi bezindlu zakwaNethinimi, abangamakhulu amabili namashumi amabili, abebeka uDavide nabaphathi bakhe ukuba basebenzela amaLevi; bonke bahlukaniswa ngegama.
Kwathi lapho eMfuleni i-Ahava, ngamemezela bona sizoyeka ukudla, begodu sizoba nokuthula phambi koNkulunkulu wethu; sacela yena indlela ephephile nathi, nabantwana bethu, nezinto zethu zonke.

Kwathi uma sikhuluma ukumkani, esithi: "Isandla esilungile sikaThixo wethu kilabo bonke ababheka kuye; kodwana amandla akhe nobubi bakhe kulowo wonke oshiya yena," Wathi uSolomon kuyise: "Ngikutshele bona, 'UNkulunkulu wethu unesandla esingcono kunawo wonke umuntu.
Sathi ke, Sihlale siphuza ukudla, sathandaza kuThixo wethu ngalolu daba; waphendula umthandazo wethu.
Ngathi ngakhetha abakhulu baka-Israyeli, abapristi abalishumi elinambini, noSherebiya, noHasabiya, nabazalwane babo abashumi.
begodu ngazilinganisela kubo isiliva, negolide, namathuluzi, owanikela wona ukumkani, nabangane bakhe, nabaphathi bakhe, nabo bonke abantu bakaSirayeli abakhona, endlwini kaThixo wethu.
Ngazilinganisela kubo amathani ayishumi nesishiyagalombili esiliva, namathani amathathu nesishiyagalombili ezinto zegolide;
amabhodlela egolide amashumi ayisishiyagalombili obunzima obuyishumi nesigamu sekhilogremu, kanye nezitho ezimbili ezincane zesibhakabhaka esicwebezelayo, ezingabizi njengegolide.
Wathi kubo: Niyingcwele kuYehova, begodu lezi zinto zingcwele; igolide nesilivere yisibopho somuntu siqu esinikezwe ikosi, uzimu wababa bakho.
Uzozigcina kahle, kuze kube yilapho uzilinganisela khona ezibhedlela zendlu kaYehova eYerusalem, phambi kwabaholi bamaBhenjamini, namaLevi, namadodana amakhulu emindeni yakwaSirayeli.
Bathi ababhishobhi nalabaLevi bathathe isiliva, negolide, namathuluzi, ngokulinganiselwa kwabo, ukuba afake endlwini kaThixo wethu eYerusalem.

Ngonyaka wokuthoma, ngomhla wama-12 wenyanga yokuqala, sasuka emfuleni iAhava sihambe siye eYerusalem. Isandla sikaThixo wethu sakuba phezu kwethu; wasisigcina esandleni somshayeli nesihlalo somlilo esihambayo.
Safika eYerusalem, sahlala khona amalanga amathathu.

Kwathi ngosuku lwesine, sazilinganisela isiliva negolide, namathuluzi endlu kaThixo wethu, sazinikela kuMeremothi unyana kaUriya, umpristi; no-Eleazaru unyana kaPhinehasi, naye, no-Yozabadhi unyana kaYeshua, noNoadiya unyana kaBinnui, abaLevi.
Konke kwabalwa begodu kwalinganiselwa, kanye nesisindo esiphelele sabhalwa phasi ngalo nyaka.

Baphinde banikela ngenhlanhla umnikelo wokushiswa kuThixo wakwaSirayeli, izinkomo ezingu-12 zakwaSirayeli bonke; izimvu eziyisithoba nesishiyagalolunye; amaqanda ayishumi namashumi asixhenxe anesibhozo; namabhokhwe ayisithupha ayisishiyagalombili njengesondlo sesono; konke lokhu kwakuyiminikelo yokushisa kaYehova.
Babeka begodu umthetho wokumkani kubo bonke abavikeli bokumkani, nabaphathi bendawo esenyakatho yeMfula i-Efrayi; bona basiza abantu, nendlu kaThixo.

Kwathi, ngemuva kwalezi zinto, abaphathi bafika kuye, besithi: "Abantu bakaSirayeli, kanye nabaphakazi babo nalabaLevi, abengahlukaniseki nomphakathi walawo mazwe asendaweni sabo; Bakwenza izinto ezingathandeki njengabaKanana, namaHeti, namaPerizi, namaJebhusi, nama-Amoni, namaMowabi, namaMisri, nama-Amoreti.

Bathe babhikisha izingane zabo, begodu babeke amadodana abo ezandleni zawo; ngalokho abangcwele bakaThixo baxhumana nabo bonke abantu abasendaweni sabo. Nabo abaphathi nabaphathiswa babo baqala ukukhohlisa ngalokhu.
Kwathi lapho ngikubona lokhu, ngaphuza izigqoko zami nezicathulo zami, ngasusa izinwele ezisuka ekhanda lami nembeba yami, begodu ngahlala ngezansi, ngikhathazeke.

Bahlangana ndawonye ngami bonke labo abakhathazekile ngenxa yamazwi kaThixo wakwaSirayeli, ngenxa yobugebengu bezizwe ezibuyayo; ngahlala khona bengikhathazekile kuze kube yisikhathi sokunikela ngomnikelo wesono.

Ngaleso sikhathi sokudla isidlo sakusihlwa, ngaphuma enhliziyweni yami, ngemigqomo yami nempahla yami ephuziwe, ngase ngijikele emilenzeni yami, ngaphakamisa izandla zami kuYehova uThixouNkulunkulu wami.

Ngitjho, uzimu wami, ngikhohlwa khulu, begodu ngikhathazekile ukuphakamisa ubuso bam kuwe, Kosi yami; ngombana izinkohlakalo zethu zikhulu kunamahlombe ethu, begodu ubugebengu bethu bukhula kuze kube sezulu.

Kusuka ezikhathini zababa bethu kuze kube manje, iphutha lethu likhulu; begodu ngenxa yezinkohliso zethu, sanikezwa thina, namakhosi ethu, namabhishobhi ethu, ngaphasi kwesandla samabukhosi basezizwe, ngekhefu, nokuboshwa, nokuhlukunyezwa, nangenhlanhla, njengokuba namuhla.

Kodwana manje, uma nje amalanga ezimbalwa, ikosi uzimu wethu wakwenza nathi okumbi, ukuze ashiye isizukulwane esincane phakathi kwethu, begodu anikeze indawo ephephile ezweni lakhe elingcwele. uzimu wethu wanikela ngamehlo ethu ngokukhanyayo, nokuphila okungenani isikhathi esithileko, ngenkathi siyimikhonzi yakhe.

Siyimikhonzi, kodwana uzimu wethu asikushiyenga empilweni yethu yobumpophoma; wabonisa ukubambisana kwakhe nathi phambi kwamakhosi asePersiya, begodu usindise inhliziyo yethu, ukuze siphinde sivule indlu kaThixo wethu, begodu silungise izinhlekelele zayo. Wasizala isikhala esiqinile eYuda naseYerusalem.
Begodu manje, uzimu wethu, singasho yini ngemuva kwalokho? Siyiphula imiyalo yakho,
