begodu ugcine zonke izimiso zakho, ozenza ngamazwi abakhonzi bakho abaprofeti, uthi: Izwe eliphumayo niya kulo lingcolile; abantu abahlala kulo balimele ngezinto zabo ezingathandeki, belizigcwele izinto zabo ezingathandeki kusukela enhliziyweni yaso kuya enhliziyweni yayo.

Ngalokho-ke, amakhosikazi akho angeke athathe amadodana abo, begodu amakhosikazi akho angeke athathe amadodana abo; begodu ngeke nizame ukuwasiza ngokuthula noma ngokuhle, ukuze nikhulule, nidla izinto ezinhle zezwe, niyishiye izingane zenu ibe yindawo yazo kuze kube sekupheleni.
Ngokuba konke okuthunyelwe kithi ngenxa yobubi bethu, nobubi bethu obukhulu, wena, Kosi yethu, usindisele thina ngaphezu kwezinkohliso zethu, begodu ushiye imindeni emincane.

Ingabe sizophinde saphula imiyalelo yakho, begodu sizoshada nabantu abakwenzayo lezi zinto ezibi? Ingabe ungeke ube nomsindo ngokwanele ukusibulala ngaso soke isikhathi, ukuze akukho muntu ozoshiywa ophuma?
Kosi, uzimu wakwaSirayeli, ulungile wena; thina sashiywa ngaso soke isikhathi; bona, sihlala phambi kwakho ngenxa yobubi bethu, begodu akukho muntu wethu okwaziyo ukumelana nawe ngenxa yalo.
UEzra ke wayethandaza, ekhuluma, emlilweni, ehleli phasi phambi kwendlu kaThixo. Bahlangana naye abantu abaningi khulu baseSirayeli, amadoda nabafazi nabantwana; nabo babelile ngokukhulu.

Waphendula ke uShekaniya, unyana kaJehiyeli, umfazi wase-Elam, wathi kuEzra, Sithe saphula umthetho kaThixo wethu, sithathe izingane zakwamanye amazwe ezweni elibhekene nathi; kodwana kunethemba lakwaSirayeli.

Ngiyakwenza isivumelwano nozimu wethu, bona sizoshiya zonke lezi zingane namadodakazi abo, ngokusho kwakho, kosi yami, kanye nabo bonke labo abakhathazekile ngamandla kaThixo wethu; begodu kufanele kube ngokwemithetho.
Nciphisa! Le yimisebenzi yakho, begodu sikhona nawe. Khumbula bona kufanele uyenze."
Wavuka uEzra, wabeka izikhulu zebandla lamabhishobhi nalabaLevi, nabo bonke isizwe samaSirayeli, bona bakwenze lokhu. Bakwenza njalo.
Waphuma uEzra phambi kwendlu kaThixo, waya ekamelweni likaYohanane, unyana kaEliashibe; wahlala khona, engadli ukudla, angadla amanzi, ngombana wayemsola ngenxa yobugebengu bezizwe ezibuyayo.
Kwathunyelwa isimemezelo ezweni lonke laseYuda naseJerusalema, sithi kilabo bonke ababuyayo emgodini bona bahlangane eYerusalem.
Nabani na ongeke afike ngezinsuku amathathu, uzolahlekelwa impahla yakhe yonke, njengombana abaphathi nabakhulu besinqume, begodu uzosuswa emphakathini walabo ababebuye.

Bahlangana bonke amadodana kaYuda noBhenjamin eYerusalem ngosuku olulandelayo, ngomhla wama-20 wenyanga yesishiyagalombili; begodu abantu bonke bahlala emgwaqweni ovulekile phambi kwendlu yoNkulunkulu, bekhathazekile ngenxa yalesi simo kanye nemvula.
UEzra umbingeleli wehla, wathi kubo, Niye naphikelela, nithathe izingane zakwamanye amazwe, ukuze nikhuphule isono samaSirayeli.
Manje ke, zinikele kuYehova, uzimu wabababa benu, niyenze into ethandekayo kuye; nihlukanise phakathi kwazo zonke izizwe ezingaphansi kwenu, namadodana angaphandle.
Baphendula bonke abantu ngezwi elikhulu, bathi, Ulungile; kufanele senze njengombana usho.

Kodwana kukhona abantu abaningi lapha, begodu yisikhathi semvula. Ngalokho-ke asikwazi ukuhlala ngaphandle. Ngaphezu kwalokho, lokhu akufanele kwenziwe ngosuku olulodwa noma olubini, ngombana siningi khulu esibiwe ngale le.

Ngiyacela bona abaphathi bethu basebenzela ibandla lonke, begodu wonke umuntu ezindaweni zethu, umfazi waseSirayeli, athathe indodakazi yamanye amazwe, azofika emahoreni afanele, namadoda amakhulu edolobhana ngalinye, namajaji awo, nabo; kuze kube sengathi ubuhlungu benhliziyo kaThixo wethu, ngenxa yalolu daba, busuka kuthi.
UYonathani unyana ka-Asaheli, noYahaziya unyana ka-Tikwa kuphela abelokhu ephikisana nalokho; begodu uMeshulamu noShabhethai umLevi babexhasa.

Bathi labo ababuyayo, bakwenza njalo; begodu uEzra umpristi wakhetha abaholi bezindlu zababa, umuntu ngamunye emndenini wakhe womndeni, ngamagama abo bonke. Bahlala ndawonye ngomhla wokuthoma wenyanga yesishumi, bebhekana necala ngalinye.
Ngosuku lokuqala lwenyanga yokuqala, baqedile ukubhekana nabantu bonke ababulale abesifazane baseSirayeli.
Ngabo bonke ababingeleli, labo ababulale izingane zakwamanye amazwe; kwaba yizingane zikaYeshua unyana ka-Yosadaki, nabangane bakhe: uMaaseya, noEliyezere, noYaribi, noGedaliya.
Bonke banikela ngendodana yengulube, ibe yisondlo sokuhlukunyezwa, ngenxa yobubi babo; begodu bonke banikela ngamadodakazi abo.
Kilabo abazali baka-Immer: uHanani noZebadia.
Ngabo oonyana baka-Harim: uMaasihiya, noEliya, noShemaya, noYehiyeli, noUziya.
Ngabo oonyana bakaPashure: uEliyenai, noMaaseya, noIshmayeli, noNethaneli, noYozabadhi, noElasa.
Ngabo abaLevi: uYozabadi, noShimeyi, noKelaya, owaziwa nangokuthi nguKelita, noPethahiya, noYuda, noEliyezere.
Ngabo abaculi: uEliashibhi; ngabo abagwebi: uShalumu, noTelem, noUri.
Ezinye zamadodakazi kaSirayeli: emindenini yamaFaroshi: uRamiya, no-Izihiya, no-Malkiya, no-Miyamina, no-Eleazar, no-Malkiya, no-Banaya.
Ezinganeni zika-Elam: uMatania, noZekariya, noYehiyeli, noAbdi, noJerimothi, noEliya.
Ezinganeni zikaZathu: uEliyonani, noEliyasibhi, noMatania, noJerimothi, noZabhadi, noAzisa.
Ngabo oonyana baka-Bebhayi: uYohanan, noHananiya, noZabhayi, noAthalai.
Ngabo oonyana baka-Bani: uMeshulamu, noMaluku, noAdaya, noYashubu, noSheali, noYeremota.
Ngabo oonyana bakaPahati-Mowabi: uAdna, noKhelali, noBhenaya, noMaaseya, noMatania, noBezaleli, noBinui, noManase.
Ngabo oonyana bakaHarimi: uEliyezere, noIshiya, noMalkiya, noShemaya, noShimeoni,
uBhenjamin, noMaluku, noShemariha.
Ngabo oonyana bakaHashumu: uMatheni, noMatata, noZabadi, noElifelethi, noJeremayi, noManase, noShimeyi.
Ezinganeni zika-Bani: uMaadayi, no-Amram, no-Ueli,
uBhenaya, noBedehiya, noKeluhi,
uVaniya, noMeremothi, noEliashib,
uMathaniya, noMatheni, noYashu,
uBhani, noBinui, noShimehi,
uShelemiya, noNathane, noAdahiya,
Machnadebai, Shashai, Sharai
no-Azareli, no-Shelemiya, no-Shemariha,
uShalum, noAmariya, noYosefu.
Ngabo oonyana bakaNebo: uJeyeli, noMatithiya, noZabadi, noZebina, noIdo, noYoweli, noBenaya.
Lawa madoda wonke abulawe izifazane zakwamanye amazwe, begodu abanye babo babe nezingane ngalezi zizwana.
Neh: Izindaba zikaNehemiya unyana kaHakaliya, ngonyaka weshumi nambili wenyanga iKislevu, lapho ngibe eShushani, enhlokodolobha yombuso.
Kwafika uHanani, owodwa wabahlobo bam, naye namanye amadoda asuka ezweni laseYuda; ngawabuza ngezwe lakwaSirayeli elisele, labo ababoshwe, kanye neJerusalema.
Bathi kuye, Abantu abashiywe, abasele kule ndawo yesifundazwe, bakhona engozini enkulu, necala elikhulu; begodu idonga laseYerusalem liqhutshwe phasi, namasango ayo aphuziwe.
Kwathi ngikuthe ngizizwa lezi zinto, ngase ngihlala, ngalile; begodu ngazisola amalanga eziningi, ngaphuza ukudla, ngathandaza kuThixo wasezulu.
Ngitjho, Kosi, uzimu wasezulu, ngicela uphendule; wena uzimu omkhulu, ongathandeki, ogcina isivumelwano sakho nethando labo abakuthandayo, nalabo abagcine amalungiselelo akho.

Ngicela uvule amehlo akho, ulalele umthandazo wami umkhonzi wakho, engiwuthandaza phambi kwakho ekuseni nakusihlwa ngenxa yabantwana bakaSirayeli, abakhonzi bakho; ngiziveza izigebengu zethu, izingane zakwaSirayeli, esizenza kuwe; nami nendlu yobaba wami sithe senze isono.
Siwenzile okumbi khulu phambi kwakho; asizange sigcine imiyalo yakho, nezimiso zakho, namalungiselelo akho, awawisela umkhonzi wakho uMoses.
Ngiyakhumbula, ngiyakucela, bona utshele umkhonzi wakho uMoses, uthi: Uma nikhohlisa, ngizokwahlukanisa phakathi kwezizwe.
kodwana uma nibuya kuni, nigcine amazwi ami; noma ngabe abathunyelwe kwenu bafika esiphethweni sezulu, ngizowaqoqa nalapho, ngibaveze endaweni engiyikhethile ukuba lihlale khona igama lami.
Bangaba abakhonzi bakho, abantu bakho; wabasindise ngekhono lakho elikhulu, nesandla sakho esinamandla.

Ngicela, Kosi, ngihelele umthandazo womkhonzi wakho, nomthandazo wabakhonzi bakho abathanda ukuhlonipha igama lakho; ngicela, ngize ngiphumelele namhlanje, begodu ngibonise ukumkani inhlonipho kuye. Ngalokhu ngadla iwayini emkhosini wakhe.
Ngomnyaka weshumi nambili wokumkani u-Artaxerxes, ngonyaka wenyanga kaNisan, kwafakwa isiphuzo kumkakhe; ngathatha isiphuzo, ngasinikela kuye. Ngangingeke ngibe nomsindo phambi kwakhe ngaphambilini.
Wathi ke ukumkani kuye, Kungani ubona ubuhlungu? Awunawo umkhuhlane. Lokhu kufanele kube wubuhlungu benhliziyo. Ngiye ngikhathazekile khulu,
ngathi kukumkani, Ubukhosi buphile kuze kube sekupheleni! Ingabe ngingeke ngibona buhlungu? Lo mzi, indawo yokuzibophezela kwababami, ugcwele izikhukhula, namasango ayo aqhutshwa ngumlilo.
Wathi ukumkani kuye, Ufuna ntoni? Ngaye ngathandaza kuThixo wasezulu;
Kwathi ngaphendula ukumkani, ngitjho, Uma kungalungile kukumkakhe, begodu uma ngiye ngabona ubuhle phambi kwakho, ngithunyelwe ezweni laseYuda, edolobhaneni lezindlu zababami, ukuze ngiyivule.

Unkosikazi wahlala eduze komkakhe. Wabuza bona, "Uzothatha isikhathi esingakanani ukhambe? Uzobuya nini?" Umkakhe wayethanda ukungithumela, ngalokho ngathi kuye bona ngizohlala isikhathi esingakanani.
Kwathi ke ngathi kukumkani, Uma kungathandeki kumkani, ngicela unganginikeze incwadi yabaphathi abasenyakatho-mpumalanga yeMfula i-Efrayi, bona bamivumele ngihambe ngokuphephile, kuze ngifike eYuda.

Ngicela, nginikeze begodu incwadi ka-Asaphu, umphathi wemithi yobukhosi, bona anikeze imithi, ukuze ngiyisebenzise ekwenzeni izindonga zendlu yokuzivikela enhliziyweni yendlu kazimu, kanye nodonga lwedolobha, kanye nendlu lapho ngihlala khona. Umkhuluwa wamnika lokho engikufunayo, ngenxa yokuthi isandla esihle sikaThixo wami sikhona phezu kwami.
Kwathi lapho ngifika ezindaweni ezisempumalanga yeMfula i-Euphrates, ngazinikela kubo izibhalo zokumkani; wathumela nabangani bakhe abakhulu, nabahamba ngebhayisikili.
USanbalathi waseHoroni, noTobiyasi umphathi wezingane zika-Amoni, lapho bekubona lokhu, bakhathazeka khulu, ngombana kwafika umuntu osiza amaSirayeli.
Ngafika eYerusalem, ngahlala khona amalanga amathathu.

Kwathi ngavuka ekuseni, nami abantu abambalwa; angikaze ngitshele umuntu othile bona uzimu wami wabeka yini enhliziyweni yami ukuba ngikwenzele iYerusalem. Inyama kuphela enganginayo, yileyo engihamba ngayo.
Ngobusuku obunjalo ngaphuma ngesango leNtaba, ngiya efulethini lika-Asikali, nomnyango wezinto ezilahlekile; ngabheka amadonga aseYerusalem, bona aphuziwe, namasango ayo, bona aqhutshwa.
Ngemuva kwalokho ngiye ku-Fountain Gate neKing's Pool, kodwana kwakungekho nendawo eyaneleyo yomuntu wami ukudlula.
Ngaye ngaya emfuleni ngalo busuku, ngabheka umgwaqo, ngabuyela emuva, ngafika kabutjha ngesango le-Valley Gate.
Abaphathi bedolobha abazange bakwazi bona ngiyephi, noma bona ngikwenzani; ngombana angikaze ngitshele nanoma yini amaYuda, namabhishobhi, namadoda amakhulu, nabaholi, nanoma ubani owenza umsebenzi.
Ngathi kubo, Nibona ububi obukhona kithi, bona iJerusalema iyigugu, namasango ayo aqhutshwa umlilo; yize ke nizokwakha kabutjha ingqalasizinda yaseJerusalema, ukuze singabi necala.

Kwathi lapho ngibatshela khona bona isandla sikaNkulunkulu wami sihle kangakanani, begodu bona ukumkani ukhuluma kanjani nami, bathi kimi: "Sizoqala ukukwakha!" Baphinde balungiselela ukwenza lomsebenzi omuhle.

Kwathi lapho ekubona khona uSanbalati waseHoroni, noTobiya umphathi we-Amoni, noGishemi umArabhu, bakhuluma nathi ngokungezinhle, babhekana nathi ngamehlo aphansi, besithi, Uyini lo msebenzi owenzayo? Ingabe ufuna ukunqoba ukumkani?
Ngibaphendula ngitjho kubo, uzimu wasezulu uzosisiza; nathi abakhonzi bakhe sizoqala ukwakha; kodwana wena awunayo inkontileka, noma ilungelo, noma incwadi eYerusalem.

UEliyashibhi, umbingeleli omkhulu, nabangane bakhe ababingeleli baqala umsebenzi wabo, bakwakha isango lezinkomo, banikela ngalo, bamisa amaphiko alo endaweni yawo. Baphinde balungisa umgwaqo kuze kube yi-Tower of the Hundreds, ne-Tower of Hananel, banikela ngalo.
Kusukela lapho, abantu baseJericho basungula isigaba esilandelayo; ngemuva kwakhe, uZakhuri unyana ka-Imri wasungula isigaba.
Isango lezinhlanzi lakhiwa yizingane zikaHasenaha; bafaka izindonga zalo, bamisa amakhabethe alo, namabhodlela alo, namahlombe alo.
Okulandelayo walungisa uMeremothi, unyana kaUriya, unyana kaHakhozi; ngemuva kwakhe walungisa uMeshulam, unyana kaBerekiya, unyana kaMeshezabele; ngemva kwakhe walungisa uTsadoki, unyana kaBaana.
Ingxenye elandelayo yayilungisa abantu baseTekoa; kodwana abaphathi babo babengeke bakwenze umsebenzi wabo, njengombana amakhosi abo abewathumela.
Isango elidala lilungiswe nguYehoyada unyana kaPasheha, noMeshulamu unyana kaBesodeya; bafaka izindonga zalo, bamisa amakhabethe alo, namabhodlela alo, namahlombe alo.

Ngasenyakatho, ngasenyakatho-ntshonalanga, kwabe sekhona uMelatiyahu waseGibheboni, noYadoni waseMeronothi, nabantu baseGibeboni nabaseMizpa, kuze kube yindlu yomphathi wesifundazwe esiseMfuleni i-Efrayi.

Kusukela ngaphesheya kwabo walungisa uUziyeli, unyana ka-Harhaya, omunye wabakhiqizi begolide; begodu kusukela ngaphesheya kwawo walungisa uHananiya, omunye wabakhiqizi bezinhlanzi. Baphinde bathuthukisa ingqalasizinda yaseYerusalem kuze kube yindawo ebanzi.
Ngaphesheya kwawo walungisa uRefaiya, unyana kaHure, umphathi wesigamu sesifunda saseYerusalem.
Ngaphesheya kwabo walungisa uJedaya unyana kaHarumafa, ngaphesheya kwendlu yakhe; ngaphesheya kwakhe walungisa uHatusha unyana kaHashabneya.
UMalkiya unyana kaHarim, noHashubu unyana kaPahati-Mowabhi, balungisa enye ingxenye kanye neTower of the Furnaces.
Ngasenyakatho yakhe walungisa uShalumu unyana kaHaloheshi, umphathi wengxenye yesithathu yesifunda saseYerusalem, naye nezingane zakhe.

UHanun namadodana kaZanoa balungisa iGate yeNtaba, beyithuthukisa, bamisa amasango ayo, namabhodlela awo, nezintambo zakhe. Baphinde balungisa umgwaqo kuze kube yi-Gate Yezinhlanzi, ngamamitha ayikhulu nesishiyagalombili.
UMalekiyasi unyana ka-Rehabhi, umphathi wesifundazwe sase-Beth-hakerem, walungisa isango lezinto ezilahlayo; wayenza, wamisa amakhabethe ayo, namabhodlela ayo, namahhashi ayo.

Isango lempucuko lilungiswe nguShaluni unyana kaKhole-hoze, umphathi wephaneli yaseMizpa. Wabuye wakwakha isango lamanzi, walingemisa, wabeka amakhabethe alo, namabhodlela alo, namahhashi alo; begodu walungise ingqalasizinda yolwandle lwaseShiloamu, elibhekene negadi likakumkani, kuze kube yilapho kunyuka khona eMzini kaDavide.

Ngemva kwakhe walungisa uNehemiya unyana ka-Azbuka, umphathi wengxenye yesifundazwe sase-Beth-sur, kuze kube ngaphesheya kwezintaba zikaDavide, kuze kube yindawo yokudlela eyenziwe ngumuntu, nendlu yamabhishobhi.
Ngemva kwakhe walungisa uRehumu unyana kaBani, umLevi; ngemuva kwakhe walungisa uHashabhiya, umphathi wengxenye yesifunda saseKehila, esifundazweni sakhe.
Ngemva kwakhe balungisa abazalwane babo abaLevi, uBavai unyana kaHenadadi, umphathi wengxenye yesifundazwe saseKehila.
Ngakwesobunxele kwakhe walungisa u-Ezer, unyana kaYeshua, umphathi waseMizpa, isigaba esisodwa esibhekene nesiteshi sesitimela, kuze kube yindawo yokugcina izikhali, ekhoneni ledonga.
Ngemva kwakhe, uBharuki unyana kaZabhayi walungisa enye inqwaba, kusukela ekhoneni kuya emgwaqene wendlu uEliyashib, umpristi omkhulu.
Ngemva kwakhe walungisa uMeremothi, unyana kaUriya, unyana kaHakosi, isigaba esisodwa, kusukela emgwaqweni wendlu kaEliyashibhi kuya ekugcineni kwayo.
Ngemuva kwakhe, ababhishobhi ezindaweni ezishisayo balungisa.
Ngabo walungisa uBhenjamin noHashub, ngaphesheya kwendlu sabo. Ngabo walungisa uAzariya, unyana kaMaaseya, unyana kaAnaniya, eduze kwendlu yakhe.
Ngemva kwakhe walungisa uBinui, unyana kaHenadadi, isiqephu esisodwa, kusukela endlwini ka-Uzariya, kuze kube yilapho kufakwa khona umkhonyovu, nalapho kufakwa khona isikhunta.
Walungisa uPalal unyana ka-Uzai, ebhekene nenkundla yodonga, nodonga oluphumayo endlu enkulu yasebukhosini ephakeme, eduze kwendlu yamaphoyisa; ngemuva kwakhe walungisa uPedaya unyana kaParosh.
Bahlala abakhonzi bethempeli emfuleni i-Ophel, kuze kube yilapho kubhekene khona neGoli Lamanzi enyakatho, kanye nodonga olusobala.
Ngemva kwawo, abantu baseTekoa balungisa isiqephu esisodwa, kusukela ngaphesheya kombhoshongo omkhulu ophumayo kudonga lwe-Opheli.
Ngasentshonalanga ye-Horse Gate, ababhishobhi balungisa, wonke umuntu ebhekene nendlu yakhe.
Ngemva kwabo walungisa uTsadoki unyana ka-Imer, ngaphesheya kwendlu yakhe; ngemva kwakhe walungisa uShemaya unyana ka-Shekaniya, umphathi wesango lasenyakatho.
Ngemva kwakhe walungisa uHananiya unyana kaShelemiya, noHanuni unyana wesishiyagalombili kaZalaphu, isigaba esisodwa; ngemuva kwabo walungisa uMeshulam unyana kaBerekiya, ngaphesheya kwendlu yakhe.
Ngemva kwakhe walungisa uMalkiya, owodwa wabakhiqizi begolide, kuze kube yindlu yama-Nethinimi nabahleli bezitolo, ebhekene nesango lokuhlola, kuze kube yigumbi eliphakeme elasekhoneni.
Abakhiqizi begolide nabahwebi balungisa phakathi kwegumbi phezulu kwe-corner neGate yezinyoni.
USanbalathi, lapho ezwa bona sibuye siphinde sivule udonga, wakhathazeka khulu, waba nomsindo omkhulu, wathi: "Akekho umuntu ongeke akwazi ukuwulungisa lodonga.

Wathi, phambi kwabangane bakhe namadodakazi aseSamariya, "Iyini le nto abaYiputa bayenzayo? Bacabanga yini bona bangawukwakha kabutjha udonga ngezandla zabo? Ingabe bazonikela izipho? Ingabe bazoyiqedela ngosuku olulodwa? Ingabe bazozibuyisela ezitsheni ezishisayo ezisuka emigodini yamatshe?"
UTobiyasi, umAmoni, wayesebhekene naye. Wathi uTobiyasi, "Nakuba ingulube ikhuphuka phezu kwalokho abakwenzayo, izowushaya phasi umgwaqo wabo!"
Ngithe: "uzimu wethu, lalela, ngombana sibhekwa ngamehlo aphansi; ubuyisele ubugebengu babo ezindlebeni zabo; bathunyelwe ezweni elisha njengezibopho.
Musa ukufihla ubugebengu babo, noma ukucisha isono sabo ebusweni bakho; ngombana baphoxekile labo abawenzayo.
Siphinde sakwakha idonga, kuze kufike engxenyeni yobude bayo; ngombana abantu basebenza ngenhliziyo sabo yonke.

Kwathi lapho uSanbalati, noTobiya, nama-Arabhu, namadodana ka-Amoni, nabahlali base-Ashdodi, beva bona ukumiswa kwengqalasizinda yaseJerusalema kuqhubeka, begodu bona izinkinga zivalwa, baphoxeka khulu.
Bonke baphikisa ndawonye, bona bazofika banqobe iYerusalem, bakwenze kube nzima.
Kodwana-ke, sathandaza kuThixo wethu, sabeka izigwegwe ekuseni nakusihlwa, ukuze sikhuseleke kubo.
Bathi abantu bakaYuda, Abasebenzi balahlekile, begodu amatshe angaphezu kwamandla ethu ukuwukwakha umgwaqo; ngalokho-ke asikwazi ukuwulungisa.
Abaphikisi bethu bathi, "Phambi kokuba bazi noma babone nathi, sizobe silungile phakathi kwabo. Sizowabulala begodu sinciphise umsebenzi."
AbaYuda abahlala eduze kwabo bafika, basitshela izikhathi ezingu-10 bathi: "Bazothuka ngaso soke isikhathi."
Ngibeka abantu ezindaweni eziphansi eduze kwedonga, ezindaweni ezivulekile; ngibabeka ngemindeni sabo,lezo zinkimbinkimbi zabo, nezimpondo zabo, namabhubesi abo.

Kwathi lapho ngibona khona, ngavuka, ngathi kubo bonke abakhulu, nabaphathi, nalabo bonke abantu: Musani ukukhathazeka ngenxa sabo; khumbulani ikosi omkhulu, nongathandeki, begodu nihlangane ngenxa yabazalwane benu, nezingane zenu, nezingane zenu, nezifazane zenu, nezindlu zenu.
Bathe ababi bethu bakwazi bona sazi isinqumo sabo, begodu bona uzimu wabakhanyise izinhloso zabo; ngalokho sibuyela ndawonye edonga, wonke umuntu umsebenzi wakhe.

Ngaleso sikhathi, isigamu sabantu bami besenza umsebenzi; kanti isiqingatha esisha saba nesibhakabhaka, nesibhakabhaka, nesibhakabhaka, nezikhali zokulwa; begodu abaphathi babe ngasenyakatho-ntshonalanga kwamadodakazi kaYuda wonkeo.
abazokwakha idonga. labo abathwala izithuthi enza umsebenzi wabo ngesandla esisodwa begodu wagcina isibhamelo esinye.
Nabo bonke abaqambi, ngaso soke isikhathi lapho besebenza khona, bagqoka isibhamu sawo ekhanda labo; begodu lowo ophuza ibhungane wayehlala nami.
Ngathi kilabo abakhulu, nabaphathi, neminye imindeni sabo: "Imisebenzi ikhulu khulu, begodu inobubanzi obuningi; nathi sihlala eduze kwengqalasizinda.
Ngawo wonke indawo lapho nikhuluma khona ngebhungane, nizofikani nathi; uzimu wethu uzobhekana nathi.
Ngalokho saqhubeka sisebenza, nesigamu samantombazane agcina ama-spears, kusukela emini kuze kube yilapho izinkanyezi ziphuma.
Kwathi ngathi abantu ngalolu sikhathi, Nihlale eJerusalema ngobusuku, wonke umuntu nomuntu osebenza naye, ukuze bagweme ubusuku, begodu basebenze usuku lonke.

Ngalokho-ke, ngami, nabangani bam, nabangani bam, nabangani bam, nabangani bam, nabangani bam, sihlala sigqoka izicathulo zethu; ngaso soke isikhathi lapho sihamba khona ukuthenga amanzi, sagcina isandlami.
Amadodakazi abo nabesifazane babo baqala ukukhathazeka ngemicabango emibi mayelana nabaYuda.
Abanye bathi, Siningi izingane zethu nabantwana bethu; sidinga ukudla, ukuze siphile.
Bathi abanye, "Sinikeza iimila zethu, amaviniga ethu, namakhaya ethu njengeziqinisekiso zezimali ukuze sithole ubisi ngesikhathi sendlala."
Bathi abanye, Sidinga ukudlulisa imali, ukuze sikhokhele inkontileka yobukhosi ngezinkomo zethu nezivini zethu.

begodu, njengombana sifana nabangane bethu, begodu izingane zethu zifana nezingane zabo; begodu, thina sidinga ukuthengisa izingane zethu, amadoda nabafazi, ukuba abakhonzi; begodu, abanye phakathi kwamadodana ethu abaye babekwa abezinkontileka; begodu, thina asikwazi ukwenza okuthile, ngombana iimila zethu, kanye namavinine zethu, ziyizinto zabanye.
Uma ngibuka bona baphikisani nalokho abakushoyo, ngangikhathazekile.
Ngicabanga ngalokho, begodu ngathi kilabo abakhulu nabaphathi, ngitjho kubo, "Ubakhokhela inkontileka yemindeni yenu!" Ngalokho ngibiza ingqungquthela enkulu ukubhekana nabo.

Ngathi kubo: "Sibuye sathenga abazalwane bethu, abathengiswe kwamanye amazwe, njengombana sikwaziyo; begodu nizothengisa nabangani benu, ukuze bathengiswe kuthina." Bakhala, bangatholanga bona baphendule yini.
Ngitjho kubo, Akulungile lokho okwenzayo; kufanele nihambe ngothando loNkulunkulu wethu, ukuze asikho isizathu sokuba abaphikisi bethu phakathi kwezizwe bona baphuze.
Abangani bam, abafowethu nodadewethu, kanye nami sidlulisa abantu imali nembewu. Nceda, siyayeka ukukhokha inkokhelo!

Babuyisele manje iimila zabo, nezihlahla zezinkomo, nezihlahla ze-olive, namakhaya abo; begodu babuyisele nemali, nembewu, newayini elisha, nephethiloli, kanye nenani elilinganayo lazo zonke izimpahla.
Bathi kubo, Sizoyibuyisela, begodu sizozicela lutho; njengombana usho, sizokwenza. Kwathi ngibiza ababhishobhi, ngabeka izikhulu phambi kwabo, bona bakwenze lokhu, bathi: "Sizokwenza lokho,"

Ngathi, uma umuntu engahambisani nale ncwadi, uzimu ayenze ngokufana naleyo le endlwini yakhe nephasi wakhe. Akwenzelwe njalo, ukuze angabi nento ngaye. Bathi bonke abantu: "Amen," babonga ikosi; begodu abantu bakwenza njengombana besithi.

Ngaleso sikhathi ngabe ngihelelwe ukuba ngumphathi ezweni lakwaYuda, kusukela ngonyaka wezinkulungwane kuze kube ngonyaka wezinkulungwane ezimbili nomashumi amathathu ubukhosi buka-Arthasxerxes, iminyaka eyishumi nambili yonke; mina nodadewethu sasingadlanga ukudla komphathi.

Kodwana ngibe ngathi, "Akekho umuntu owenza lokhu." Ngokuba labo abaphathi ababekhona phambi kwami babeke abantu ngaphasi kwengcindezi enkulu, bethatha ukudla kwabo newayini labo, kanye negolide elilodwa, begodu nabangane babo babephatha abantu ngokuqinile.
Ngisebenza kanzima begodu esitezi. Asikuthengi lutho lwendawo, begodu bonke abantu bam bahlangana khona ukusebenzela
Ngidlalela emathinini ami abantu baseYiputa abakhulu kunamakhulu amane namashumi amahlanu, kanye nabantu abaye bafika ezweni lethu elibhekene nathi.

Ngosuku ngalunye ingulube eyodwa, nezinkomo ezingu-6 ezinhle khulu, nezilwane ezahlukahlukene zalungiselelwa kimi; nsuku zonke eziyishumi kwafakwa ubisi olukhulu lwazo zonke izinhlobo zewayini. Naphezu kwalokho, angizange ngifune ukudla okuvunyelwe ngumphathi, ngombana abantu babe nesisindo esinzima.
uzimu wami, khumbula ngami ngokunethezeka konke okuhle engikwenzele labo bantu.

Kwathi lapho uSanbalati, noTobiya, noGishemi wase-Arabhu, nabanye ababi bethu, beva bona ngibuyele ngakwakha umgwaqo, bona asikho isikhala esisele kuso, noma ngabe angizange ngibeke amasango emigwaqeni.
USanbalathi noGishemi bathumela kuye, bathi, Yiza, sihlangane ndawonye esinye sezindawo ezisemaphandleni zase-Ono; kodwana befuna ukungibulala.
Ngithumelele abathunywa, ngitjho kubo, Ngisebenza umsebenzi omkhulu; angikwazi ukuwela ngezansi. Ingabe kufanele isebenze, uma ngiyishiya ngiye kuwe?
Bemithumelele umlayezo ofanayo izikhathi ezine, begodu ngazo zonke izikhathi ngibaphendule ngokufana.
Kwathi ngesikhathi esiyisihlanu, uSanbalati wathumela umkhonzi wakhe ngami, nalowo myalezo ofanayo; begodu wayenelete elivulekile esandla sakhe.
Wathi, "Kuthunyelwe phakathi kwezizwe, begodu uGeshemi uthi kuyiqiniso, bona wena namaJuda nifuna ukubhikisha; ngalokho-ke ukwakha kabutjha idonga. Kuthunyelwe bona uzobe ungukumkani wabo.
Uthi,u-ke, uma ukhetha abaprofeti bona bakhulume ngawe eYerusalem, besithi: "Kukhona ukumkani ezweni laseYuda!" Lokhu kuzofika kukumkakhe; ndiza, sixoxe ngalolu daba.
Ngimthumelele lo mbuzo: "Akukho lutho olufana nalokho okushoyo lukhona. Ukwenza lokhu ngengqondo yakho."
kokuthi, befuna ukusithukuthelisa, bathi, Izandla zabo zizoba zimbi khulu ukwenza umsebenzi wokwakha, begodu ngeke ziqedwe; kodwana ngathandaza, ngitjho, Ngalokho-ke, uzimu, uqinise izandla zami.

Ngiye endlini kaShemaya, unyana kaDelaya, unyana kaMehetabele; yena wayehlala efulethini. Wathi, Sizohlangana ekhaya likaThixo, ngaphakathi kwendlu kaThixo, sivale izindonga zendlu kaThixo; ngombana abantu bazofika ukukubulala; le busuku bazofika ukukubulala.
Ngitjho, Ingabe umuntu ofana nami kufanele ahambe? Ngabe umuntu ofana nami kumele afike ethempelini ukuze agcine impilo yakhe? Angizoya!
Ngazi bona uzimu akamuthumeli, kodwana wathi lo mprofeti lokhu ngami, ngombana uTobiya noSanbalathi bengawukhokhela.
Bemkhokhele bona amkhulise ukuze ngikwenze lokhu begodu ngizinikele. Bazokwazi ukunginika igama elibi begodu bangisize.
Ngiyakhumbula, uzimu wami, lokho akwenze uTobiya noSanbalathi, kanye nomprofeti uNoadiya,ynye namanye amaprofeti, abafuna ukungiphoqa.
Waqedwa udonga ngomhla wama-25 wenyanga kaElule, ngezinsuku eziyishumi nambili nesihlanu.

Kwathi uma bekubona bonke abasolwa bethu, baphoqeleka ukuba bakhathazeke, begodu inhliziyo sabo yanyamalala phakathi kwazo zonke izizwe ezibhekene nathi; ngombana babeyazi bona le misebenzi yenziwa nguThixo wethu.
Kwathi ngaleso sikhathi, abantu abakhulu baseYuda bathumela izincwadi eziningi kuTobiya, begodu izincwadi zikaTobiya zafika kubo.
Baningi abantu baseYuda ababemthobela, ngombana wayeyindodana yomndeni kaShekaniya unyana ka-Araha; begodu uYohanane unyana wakhe ubethathe indodana kaMeshulamu unyana ka-Berekiya.
Bemitshela bona uTobiya wenza izinto ezinhle, begodu bemitshela bona ngikhuluma naye; begodu uTobiya wathumela incwadi yami, ukuze angikhoxe.
Kwathi lapho ingqalasizinda yakhiwa khona, nalapho ngimise khona amasango, kwabekwa abaphathi bezindonga, nabaculi, nalabaLevi, ezindaweni zabo.
Kwathi ngabeka uHanani, umngane wami, eJerusalema, naye noHananiya, umphathi wesitezi. UHananiya wayengumntu othembekile, wagwema uzimu khulu ukudlula bonke abantu.

Ngathi kubo, Musani ukuvula amasango eYerusalem, kuze kube yilanga elisha; bese bevala amasango, bavale izintambo, lapho abaphathi beminyango behlala khona. Bakhethe abantu abahlali eYerusalem ukuba babe ngamagquma, babeke abanye endaweni sabo yokugcina izinto, nabanye ezindaweni zabo zokuhlala.
Lo mzi wawubanzi begodu omkhulu, kodwana kwaba khona abantu abambalwa kuphela kiwo, begodu izindlu zazingeke ziphinde zakhiwe.

uzimu wami wabeka enhliziyweni yami bona ngiqoqe abantu abakhulu, nabaphathi, nabantu, ukuze bahlukaniswe ngezindlu zabazali babo; ngathola umlando wezindlu zomndeni walezo zizwe ezidlulele kuqala, begodu lokhu kwabhalwa kiwo:
Nalaba babantu besifundazwe, abasuka empilweni yokuzibophezela, ababethunyelwe nguNabukodonozoro ukumkani waseBhabheli; babebuya eYerusalem naseYuda, wonke umuntu edolobhaneni lakhe.
Bafika nabo uZerubabele, noJeshua, noNehemiya, noAzariya, noRamiya, noNahamani, noMordecai, noBilshan, noMishpereth, noBigwai, noNehumu, noBaana. Lolu yinani lamadoda aseSirayeli:
Amadodana kaFaroshe, ayizinkulungwane ezimbili nekhulu elilodwa nesishiyagalombili.
Oonyana baka-Shefatiya, amakhulu amathathu, ayisishiyagalombili.
Amadodana ka-Araha, inani labo likhulu elinamashumi mane namabini.
Oonyana bakaPahati-Mowabhi, ngoYeshuwa noYowabha, yizinkulungwane ezimbili namakhulu ayisishiyagalolunye namahlanu.
Amadodana ka-Elam, ayizinkulungwane ezimbili namakhulu amahlanu anane.
Amadodana kaZathu, amakhulu asibhozo, anamahlanu namashumi amane.
Amadodakazi ka-Zakhayi, inani labo ngumakhulu asixhenxe, aneshumi nanye.
Amadodakazi kaBinnui: amakhulu ayisishiyagalolunye namashumi amane anesibhozo.
Amadodana kaBebhayi, amakhulu amabili nesishiyagalombili.
Amadodana ka-Azgadi, ayizinkulungwane ezimbili namakhulu amathathu namashumi amabili nambili.
Amadodana ka-Adonikam, amakhulu ayisishiyagalolunye namahlanu nesishiyagalombili.
Amadodana kaBhigwayi ayizinkulungwane ezimbili nesishiyagalombili nesithupha.
Abazali baka-Adin: inani labo ngumakhulu amathandathu, anamahlanu anabahlanu.
Amadodana ka-Atere, asuka kuHizekiya, abeyizinkulungwane nesishiyagalolunye.
Amadodana kaHashumu, amakhulu amathathu aneshumi nambili nesishiyagalolunye.
Amadodana kaBezayi, amakhulu amathathu namahlanu namashumi amane.
Amadodakazi kaHariphu: amakhulu amabili namahlanu.
Abantu baseGibheyoni, amashumi ayisishiyagalolunye namahlanu.
Amadodana eBethelehemu neNetofa, amakhulu ayisishiyagalolunye namahlanu.
Amadodana eAnathothi, amakhulu ayisishiyagalombili anesibhozo.
abantu baseBhethe-azmavethi, abamashumi amane nambili.
Amadoda aseKiriyati-yearimi, neKefira, neBherothi, amakhulu asixhenxe, anamahlanu nesithathu.
Amadodana eRama neGeba, amakhulu ayisishiyagalombili namahlanu.
Amadodana kaMikmas, amakhulu ayisishiyagalombili namabini.
Amadoda aseBhetheleli ne-Ayi, amakhulu ayisishiyagalombili namathathu.
Amadodana eNebo eyesibili, amashumi amahlanu nambili.
Amadodana ka-Elam amanye, abe yizigidi ezingu-205.4.
Oonyana baka-Harim, amakhulu amathathu namahlanu.
abantu baseJericho: amakhulu amathathu namahlanu namashumi amane.
Amadodana kaLodi, noHadidi, noOno, amakhulu asixhenxe, anamahlanu nambili.
Amadodana kaSinaya, ayizinkulungwane amathathu namakhulu ayisishiyagalombili namathathu.
Ababhishobhi: oonyana bakaJedaya, emndenini ka-Yeshuha, abengumakhulu asithoba, anamashumi nesishiyagalolunye.
Amadodana ka-Imer: elilodwa elinamashumi mahlanu nambili.
Amadodana kaPashure, ayizinkulungwane ezimbili namashumi amane nesikhombisa.
Oonyana baka-Harim, inkulungwane eyisishiyagalolunye.
AbaLevi: oonyana bakaYeshua, ngoKadmiyeli, bomndeni ka-Hodeva, babemashumi asixhenxe nane.
Abaculi: oonyana baka-Asaphu, amakhulu amane anamashumi ayisishiyagalombili.
Abaphathi bezingcingo: oonyana bakaShalumu, no-Atere, no-Talmon, no-Akubu, no-Hatitha, no-Shobhayi, abengumakhulu amathathu anesibhozo.
Amadodakazi kaSiha, noHashupha, noTabhaothi,
i-Keros, ne-Siha, ne-Padon,
uLebhana, noHagaba, noSalmai,
uHanani, noGideyeli, noGahari,
uRehaya, noRezin, noNekoda,
noGazamu, noUza, noPaseha,
uBezezi, noMeunim, noNephusheshim,
Bakbuk, Hakupha, Harhur
uBazlith, noMehida, neHarsha,
uBarkhoshi, noSisera, noTema,
uNeziah, noHatipha.
Amadodakazi abangani bakaSolomoni: amadodana kaShotai, noSoferethi, noPerida,
Jaala, Darkon, Giddel,
noShefatiya, noHathili, noPokerethe-hazebayim, noAmoni.
Wonke amaNethinimi, namadodakazi amakhosikazi kaSolomoni, kwaba ngumakhulu amathathu, anamashumi ayisishiyagalolunye namabini.
Abanye abantu bafika ezindaweni zaseTeli-mela, neTheli-harsha, neCherub, neAddon, ne-Immer, kodwana abakwazi ukuveza bona izingane zabo zivela kuSirayeli.
Oonyana bakaDelaya, noTobiya, noNekoda, abengumakhulu amathandathu, anamahlanu nambili.
Kilabo ababingeleli: oonyana bakaHobhaya, noHakosi, noBarzilayi. UBarzilayi washada nenkosikazi kaBarzilayi waseGiliyadi, wathatha igama lakhe lomndeni.
Bafuna amagama abo ezincwadini zomndeni, kodwana abakwazi ukuwathola; ngalokho baphoqeleke ukuba bangasebenzi njengeziphathimandla.
Wabatjela bona bangadli ukudla okungcwele khulu, kuze kube khona umpristi ongakwazi ukubuza uzimu ngo-Urim no-Tummim.
Wonke lo mhlangano waba ngamaphesenti angama-42 namakhulu amathathu namashumi ayisishiyagalombili,

kufaka phakathi abakhonzi babo, amadoda nababhishobhi, abeyizinkulungwane eziyisixhenxe namakhulu amathathu namashumi mathathu nesishiyagalolunye. Babenezinkondlo zamadoda nezingane ezingamakhulu amabili anamahlanu anesihlanu.
Babenezimvu ezingumakhulu asixhenxe, amashumi amathathu anesithandathu, nezingulube eziyinkulungwane ezimbili ne Corri.
izinkomo ezingumakhulu amane, amashumi amathathu anesihlanu, namabhubesi ayizigidi eziyisishiyagalombili namashumi ayisithupha.

Bakhona abaphathi bezindlu zakwaSirayeli abanikela ngezinto zokwakha; u-Ahikamu wanikela ngegolide elinamakhilogremu ayishumi nesishiyagalombili, namabhodlela amashumi amahlanu, nezigqoko zamabhishobhi ezingumakhulu mahlanu namashumi amathathu.
Abanye abaphathi bezindlu banikela ngemali yokwakha elinganiselwa kumakhilogremu ayikhulu nesishiyagalombili wegolide kanye netoni elilodwa lesiliva.

Amanye amalungu omphakathi wanikela ngegolide elingamathani ayishumi nesishiyagalombili, nesiliva elingamathani ayisishiyagalombili namashumi amabili anesihlanu, namabhulukwe kambingeleli ayizinkulungwane eziyisishiyagalolunye.

Bathi abapristi, nabaLevi, nabenzi bezindonga, namangomani, nabanye abantu, nabenzi bezindlu zakwaNethinimi, nalabo bonke abahlala ezweni laseSirayeli, bahlala emizini sabo. Ngonyaka wesixhenxe kwaqala ukuhlala amaSirayeli emizini sabo.
Bahlangana abantu bonke, njengamuntu owodwa, ezindaweni ezivulekile ezibhekene neGoli Lamanzi, bathi kuEzra umfundi, bona athathe incwadi yomthetho kaMosesi, owawusho ikosi kwaSirayeli.
Wathi uEzra umpristi, emnyangweni wonyaka wesixhenxe, ngosuku lokuqala lwenyanga yesishiyagalombili, waveza umthetho phambi komphakathi, amadoda nabesifazane, bonke abakwaziyo ukucabanga.

Waqala ukuyifunda, ebhekene nesiteshi esingaphambili kweGoli Lamanzi, kusukela ekuseni kuze kube phakathi kosuku; wabhala ngaso emlonyeni wamabhishobhi, namabhishobhikazi, nalabo bonke abakwaziyo ukuqonda; begodu abantu bonke balalela incwadi yemithetho.

Wahlala uEzra, umfundi, esitezi esiphezulu somthi owenziwe ngalolu hlelo. Ngakwesokudla kwakhe kwahlala uMatithiya, noShema, noAnaya, noUriya, noHilkiya, noMaaseya; ngakwesobunxele kwakhe kwahlala uPedaya, noMishayeli, noMalkiya, noHashume, noHashbaddana, noZekariya, noMeshulam.
Wavula ke uEzra incwadi phambi kwamehlo abantu bonke, ngombana wayesemile phezu kwabo; begodu lapho evula khona, abantu bonke bavuka.
UEzra wabonga ikosi, uzimu omkhulu; begodu abantu bonke baphakamisa izandla zabo, bephendula bona: "Amen! Amen!" Bahlangula, bakhonza ikosi ngobuso babo ezweni.

Bathi abaLevi, uYeshua, noBani, noSherebiya, noYamin, noAkubu, noShabhethai, noHodiya, noMaaseya, noKelitha, noAzariya, noYozabadi, noHanani, noPelaya, bafundisa abantu umthetho; abantu ke behlala endaweni sabo.
Bafunda encwadini yomthetho kaThixo ngokucacile, bachaza amagama ayo, ukuze abantu baqonde lokho okufundwayo.

Wathi uNehemiya umphathi, noEzra umbingeleli owaziyo, nalabaLevi abafundisa abantu, kubo bonke abantu, bathi, Lemini ingcwele kuYehova uThixou wenu; namuhla; musa ukukhathazeka, ningalili; ngombana abantu bonke babelili, bekhuluma amazwi omthetho.

Wathi uNehemiya, "Hambani nidla ukudla okuhle, niphuze amanzi amnandi, begodu nithumelele labo abanganakho okulungiselelwe; ngombana lo mhla ngusuku olungcwele kukaNkulunkulu wethu. Mhlawumbe ngeke nikhathazeke, ngombana uthando lukaNkulunkulu luyisiqiniseko sami."
Baphoqelela bonke abantu, bathi, Nciphisani izingcingo zenu; ngombana lemini iyingcwele; ngalokho-ke mna-ke angeke ngibizele.
Bahamba bonke abantu, badla, baphuze, begodu bathuthe ukudla, begodu bajabulele ngothando olukhulu; ngombana babeqonde amazwi abo, awaziswe kubo.
Ngosuku lwesibili, abaphathi bezindlu zakwa-Israyeli bonke, namabhishobhi nalabaLevi, bahlangana kuEzra umfundi, ukuze bafunde amazwi omthetho.
Bathola bona kubhalwe emthethweni, owawusho ikosi ngesandla sikaMoses, bona izingane zakwaSirayeli kumele zihlale ezindaweni zokuhlala ngesikhathi sosuku lokuzalwa lwenyanga yesixhenxe.

Yathi begodu bona bamemezele emadolobheni abo onke, namaJerusalema, bathi, Yendeni ezindaweni eziphakeme, nithole izimbali ze-olive, nezihlahla ze-olive, nezihlahla ze-myrte, nezihlahla zezintaba, neminye imithi enezihlahla, ukuze niyenze izindlu zokuhlala, njengombana kubhalwe.

Baphuma ke abantu, bathola amaqabunga abo, bazenza izindlu zangasese; bazenza ezindlini zabo, nasezindaweni zazo, nasezindaweni zendlu ka Armani, nasezindaweni ezivulekile zeGate yamanzi, nasezindaweni ezivulekile zeGate kaEfraim.
Nabo bonke ababuyayo empilweni yobugebengu bamisa izindlu, behlala kuzo; ngombana abengazange benze njalo abantu bakaSirayeli kusukela ngezinsuku zikaYoshuwa unyana kaNune.

Wafunda incwadi yomthetho kaThixo ngosuku ngalunye, kusukela mhla wokuthoma kuze kube mhla oluphelile; bakwenza usuku lwesikhumbuzo ngezinsuku ezisithupha, begodu ngomhla wesishiyagalolunye babe nengqungquthela ekhethekile, ngokwemithetho.
Kwathi ngomhla wama-24 wonyaka lowo, bahlangana bonke oonyana bakaSirayeli, bephuza ukudla, bezigqoka izingwegwe ezimnyama, namathumbu abo epulazini.
Bahlukaniswa labo abavela ezweni laseSirayeli nanoma ubani ongaphandle, babekwa phezulu, bavuma izigebengu zabo, nezigebengu zabababa babo.
Bahlala endaweni sabo, balalela incwadi yomthetho kaYehova uzimu wabo, ihora elilodwa nengxenye yemini; begodu ihora elilodwa nengxenye yemini babhikisha, bethandaza kuYehova uzimu wabo.
Bathi uYeshua, noBani, noKadmiyeli, noShebaniya, noBuni, noSherebiya, noBani, noKenani, abaLevi, behlala esitezi esiphezulu, bavuma ngokuthula kuYehova uzimu wabo.

Wathi uYeshua, noKadmiyeli, noBani, noHashabneya, noSherebiya, noHodiya, noShebania, noPethahiya, abaLevi: Nciphisani, nithokozele ikosi uzimu wenu, ophilayo kuze kube sekupheleni kosuku; nijabulele igama lakho elingcwele, Kosi, ngombana likhulu kunazo zonke izipho zethu nezithokozelo zethu.

uzimu, wena kuphela owenza izulu, izulu elikhulu kunazo zonke, nezinkanyezi zonke; ungenza umhlaba nezinto zonke ezikhona kiwo, izilwandle nezinto zonke ezikhona kuzo; wena ozozigcina ziphila zonke lezi zinto, begodu imikhosi yezulu izokuhlonipha.
uzimu, wena ikosi, owazikhethela uAbrama, owamukhipha eUre waseBhabheli, wabiza igama lakhe nguAbrahama.

Wabona bona inhliziyweni yakhe ithembekile kuwe, wakwenza naye umhlangano wokuthi uzowanikeza isizukulwane sakhe izwe lamaKanana, namaHeti, namaAmori, namaPerizi, namaJebhusi, namaGirgasi. Ugcine amazwi akho, ngombana wena ulungile, begodu uneqiniso.
Wabona bona abazali bethu bahlupheka kuphi eYiputa, walalela ukukhuluma kwabo emfuleni omnyama.
Wabonisa izibonakaliso nezimangalo kuFaro, nakwabo bonke abaphathi bakhe, nakwabo bonke abantu bezwe lakhe; ngombana uwazi bona babekezela ebantwini bethu bokuqala; wakwenza igama kuwe, njengalemini.
ko-ke wamisa ilwandle phambi kwabo, bahamba phakathi kwalo emhlabathini omnyama; begodu wabasusa abalandelana ezindaweni ezishisayo, njengamatshe enkabeni yamanzi abandayo.
Wabaqondisa ngophahla lwezulu usuku lonke, nophahla lwamlilo busuku bonke, ukuze usindise indlela abahamba ngayo.
Wakhuphuka phezu komfula iSinayi, wakhuluma nabo esibhakabhakeni, wabanika izimiso ezilungile, nezimiso zobuqiniso, nezimiso ezinhle, namalungiselelo.
Wabafundisa iSonto lakho elingcwele, wabeka phambi kwabo imiyalo, nezimiso, nemithetho, ngesandla somkhonzi wakho uMoses.
Wabanikeza ukudla okusuka emkhathini, lapho bekhala khona; wabakhipha amanzi emhlabathini, lapho bephuza khona. Wathi kubo: "Niya, niyithathe izwe, elinikezwayo ngomlomo wakho."
Kodwana abazalwane bethu babhikishela, baphikisa ikhanda labo, bangawaphula amazwi akho.

Bathi, "Akekho umuntu owaziyo bona siyini ikosi yethu uzimu wethu," begodu akhenge ukulalela. Wakhohlwa izibonakaliso zakho ekwenzeni phakathi kwabo. Begodu baphenduka imilenze sabo, begodu wakhetha umholi, emshadweni wabo, ukuba aphinde abe yimikhosi ezweni laseYiputa.
Bathi, 'Leli liwuNkulunkulu wenu owenza ukuba niphume eMisri.' Bathe bathi: 'UNkulunkulu wethu u-Abdullah (u-Ibrahimi), begodu u-Abdullah (u-Isa) no-Amra (u-Musa) bakwenza lokhu.

Kodwana-ke, ngenxa yothando álo olukhulu lwakho, awuwashiyenga ezweni laseNdiya; umbhoshongo wezulu akhenge abuyele emuva ukuwaqondisa ngemini indlela sabo, begodu umbhoshongo womlilo akhenge abuyele emuva ukuwakhanya indlela sabo ngobusuku.
Wabanikeza umphefumulo wakho omhle, wabafundisa; wabeka i-manna yakho phambi kwabo ukuze bayidle, begodu wabanika amanzi uma bephuza.
Wabasiza iminyaka emashumi mane emfuleni, begodu bathola konke okudingekayo kubo; izigqoko zabo aziphuzi, nezinyawo zabo azigqwali.
Wabanikela ngamandla, namazwe, begodu wabanikeza imiphakathi ezindaweni ezahlukene; bathathe izwe likaSihon ukumkani waseHeshboni, nelizwe likaOg ukumkani waseBhashani.
Wakwenza izingane zabo zingaba yizinkanyezi zezulu, wazisa ezweni owawuthi kubaba babo bona bazoya kulo ukuze baphile kulo.

Baye befika, bathathe izwe; wena wahlasela abantu baseKanana abahlala kulolu mhlaba phambi kwabo, wabanikela esihlalweni sabo, nabo bonke amakhosi abo, nabantu balolu mhlaba, ukuze benze kubo konke okubizelayo.

Bathatha imiphakathi enezindonga, nezwe elihlanzekile; bathola izindlu ezigcwele izinto ezinhle, nezimpophoma ezenziwe ngokhuni, namaviniga, nama-olive, nemihlahla eminingi yezithelo. Badla, baphuze, bakhulule, bajabulele ubuhle bakho obuningi.
Baye bakwenza okumbi kuwe, bekukhohlisa wena, besuka emthethweni wakho, babulala abaprofeti bakho, ababebatshela bona babuye kuwe; bakhuluma ngezinkolelo ezikhulu kuwe.

Wabanikela ngaso isandla samagugu abo, abagqugquzelayo; kodwana ngesikhathi sobuhlungu babo bathandaza kuwe, wena waphendula emazulwini; begodu ngenxa yobukhulu bezinhlekelele zakho, wabanikeza abasindisi, ababebakhulula kumagugu abo.

Kodwana lapho behlala khona, baphinde baphinde bakwenza okumbi phambi kwakho; ngalokho wabeka emgodini wababi babo, ukuba babe ngubukhosi phezu kwabo. Baphinde bathandaza kuwe, wena waphendula emazulwini, wabakhulula ngokuqhubekayo ngenxa yobulungisa bakho.

Wabatjela bona babuyiselwe emthethweni wakho; kodwana bona babekezela, bangawatholi amazwi akho; baphula izibopho zakho, eziphilako uma umuntu ezithela, begodu babeka ikhanda labo phezulu, bangakulalelanga.
Nakuba ubabambisene nabo iminyaka eminingi, begodu umphefumulo wakho wabaxwayisa ngezandla zabaprofeti bakho; kodwana abazange baqaphele; ngalokho wabeka phakathi kwabo izizwe zezizwe.
Kodwana-ke, ngenxa yothando lwakho olukhulu, awukaze ubasuse ngokuphelele, awukade ubashiye; wena uzimu othandekako, onethemba.

Begodu manje, uzimu wethu, wena uzimu omkhulu, onamandla, owamangalisayo, ozogcina isivumelwano sakho kanye nethando lwakho, ungakhohlwa yonke le nkinga esethukile, esiyi ngaye thina, nabaphathi bethu, nabaholi bethu, namabhishobhi ethu, namaprofeti ethu, nababa bethu, nabantu bakho bonke, kusukela ezikhathini zikakumkani wase-Ashuri kuze kube namhlanje.
Uthe: "uzimu, wena ulungile ngazo zonke izinto ezithunyelwe kuthi; wena uthembekile, kodwana thina sakwenza okumbi.
Nakumkani bethu, nabaphathi bethu, nabaholi bethu, nababa bethu, abazange bagcine umthetho wakho; bangawutholi umlayezo wakho, noma izibhengezo zakho.
ko konke okumbi kwabo, nalapho behlala khona ezweni lakho elibanzi, nelizwe lakho elinempilo, lapho wabeka khona izandla zakho phezu kwazo, abakusebenzisi wena, bangase bashintshe indlela sabo embi.
Begodu, bona, manje siyimikhonzi; begodu ezweni olibambisene lona nababa bethu, ukuze badla izithelo zayo neziphuzo zayo, thina siyimikhonzi.
Izithelo zayo ezikhulu ziye kumabukhosi, owabeka phezu kwethu ngenxa yamaphutha ethu. Balawula izitho zethu nezilwane zethu ngokufuna kwabo. Sisengozini enkulu.
Ngenxa yalokhu konke, thina siyakwenza umhlangano oqinile, begodu siwubhalela phasi; begodu abaphathi bethu, nalabaLevi bethu, nababaphazi bethu, babeka izibopho zabo kiwo.
Lezi zizinto abantu ababeka izibopho zabo phezu kwesivumelwano: uNehemiya, umphathi, uHakaliya, noZedekiya;
uSeraya, noAzariya, noYeremiya,
noPashure, noAmariya, noMalkiya,
uHatushe, noShebaniya, noMaluku,
uHarimu, noMeremothi, noObhadiya,
uDaniyeli, noGinethon, noBaruki,
uMeshulamu, noAbiha, noMiyamina,
uMahaziya, noBilgai, noShemaya; labo babe ngabapristi.
AbaLevi: uYeshua unyana ka-Azaniya, noBinui umfazi waseHenadadi, noKadmiyeli,
nabangane babo abaLevi: uShebaniya, noHodiya, noKelitha, noPelaya, noHanani,
uMikha, noRehobho, noHashabiya,
noZakhuri, noSherebiya, noShebaniya,
Hodiah, Bani, noBeninu.
BekunguParosh, noPahati-Mowabi, noElam, noZathu, noBani, abaphathi babantu.
uBuni, noAzgadi, noBebai,
u-Adoniya, no-Bigwai, no-Adin,
u-Atere, noHizekiya, no-Azure,
uHodiya, noHashumu, noBezai,
uHarifi, noAnathothi, noNobayi,
uMagpiyashi, noMeshulamu, noHeziri,
uMeshezabele, noTsadoki, noYaduya,
uPelatiya, noHanani, noAnaya,
uHosheya, noHananiya, noHashubu,
Halohesh, Pilha, Shobek,
noRehumu, noHashabna, noMaaseya,
u-Ahiya, noHanani, noAnani,
Maluku, noHarim, noBaana.

Nabo bonke abantu, abapristi, nalabaLevi, nabaphathi bezindonga, nabalobi, nabaseNethinimi, nabo bonke labo abahlukanise inhliziyo sabo nalabo bantu abasendaweni sabo, ukuze balandele umthetho ka-Yehova, nababhishobhi babo, namadodakazi abo, namadodana abo, namakhosikazi abo, wonke umuntu okwaziyovihambele.

Bahlangana nabangane babo, nabaphathi babo, bamisa isinqumo, bathi, Uma siwuphula umthetho kaThixo, onikezelwe ngesandla sikaMoses umkhonzizwe kaThixo, bazoyigcina yonke imiyalo kaYehova uzimu wethu, nezimiso zakhe, namalungiselelo akhe.
Sithembisa bona ngeke sivumele izingane zethu ukuba ziqhamuke nabantu abasendaweni yethu, begodu ngeke sivumele izingane zethu ukuba ziqhamuke izingane zabo.
Uma izizwe ezibhekene nathi zithi, Sizothenga yini ngeSabhati, noma nganoma iyiphi enye imini engcwele? Kuphela ngonyaka wesixhenxe sizoyeka ukulima umhlaba, begodu sizosusa zonke izikweletu zethu.
Siyavuma begodu bona sizonikela ngonyaka ngamnye ngama-gramu amane egolide, ukuze kusebenze indlu kaThixo wethu.

Lokhu kuzoba yinkomishi engcwele, nama-odolo okudla ahlala njalo, nama-odolo okuphanela, nama-odolo aseSabhati, namaholidi enyanga entsha, namaholidi amiswayo, nama-odolo angcwele, nama-odolo okuhlukunyezwa, ukuze silungise amaSirayeli, kanye nemisebenzi yonke yendlu kaThixo wethu.

Nami, mina umbingeleli, nalabo abaLevi, nalaba bantu, sakhipha iziqhamo zethu, bona sizoletha yini imithi endlwini kaThixo wethu ngonyaka ngamunye, imindeni ngayinye yomndeni wayo, ukuze siyisindise phezu kwesibingelelo sikaYehova uzimu wethu, njengombana kubhalwe emthethweni.
Sithe sizoletha ethempelini likaYehova, ngonyaka ngamunye, okungenani kwezinto zethu ezivunayo, kanye nezithelo zokuqala zezihlahla zonke.

begodu bona sizozisa izingane zethu ezizalwa kuqala, nezizalwa kuqala zezilwane zethu ezifuywayo, namakhowe ethu, namahhashi ethu, endlwini kaThixo wethu, kubabhishobhi abasebenza khona, njengombana kubhalwe emthethweni.

begodu bona sizozisa izithelo zokuqala zezinkomishi zethu, nezipho zethu eziphakeme, namajikijolo ezinhlobonhlobo zemithi yethu, kanye newayini lethu elisha, namafutha ethu, kumaLevi, emagumbini okugcinwa kwendlu kaThixo wethu; begodu bona sizonikeza amaLevi ingxenye yesishiyagalombili yezitshalo zethu, ngombana labo abaLevi baqoqa ingxenye yesishiyagalombili emizini yonke yokulima kwethu.

begodu kufanele kube nombingeleli osuka emndenini ka-Aron kanye nalabo abaLevi, lapho beqoqa khona ishumi; begodu labo abaLevi kumele bafake ishumi lezinto abaziqoqayo endlwini kaThixo wethu, ezindlini zokugcina.

Bathi: "Kulezo zindawo, lapho kugcinwa khona izinto zendlu kaThixo, lapho behlala khona abavikeli bezindonga, nabaculi, nababambiqhaza, kufanele abantu baseSirayeli nabaseLevi bafake iminikelo sabo yokudla, kanye newayini elisha nophethiloli, ukuze sigcine indlu kaThixo wethu.

Bathi abaphathi bezindlu zakwaSirayeli bahlala eYerusalem, kanti abanye bemiphakathi yabaseYiputa babebeka izikhundla, ukuze kube ngumuntu oyedwa osuka ezindlini zomndeni ngazo zonke imindeni engu-10 ukuhlala eJerusalema, emzini ongcwele; kodwana amanye amakhaya asezifundeni zabo.
Abantu babonga bonke abantu abamemezele bona bazohlala eYerusalem.
Nalaba banjengoba behlala eYerusalem, nalabo abasemazweni aseYuda, bonke abantu baseSirayeli, nabapristi, nabaLevi, namaNethinimi, nezingane zabakhonzi bakaSolomoni, bahlala emizini sabo.
EYerusalem kwahlala abanye abantu baseYuda nabaseBhenjamini; eYuda: uAtahiya, unyana kaUziya, unyana kaZekariya, unyana kaAmariya, unyana kaShefatiya, unyana kaMahalaleli, umfazi wasePerezi;
noMaaseya, unyana kaBharuki, unyana kaKolhoze, unyana kaHazaya, unyana kaAdaya, unyana kaYoyaribhi, unyana kaZekariya, umfazi waseShela.
Amadodana kaPerezi, ahlala eYerusalem, ayemakhulu amane, anamashumi amathandathu anesibhozo, amadoda amakhulu.
Ezweni likaBhenjamini: uSalu indodana kaMeshulamu, indodana kaYode, indodana kaPedaya, indodana kaKolaya, indodana kaMaaseya, indodana kaIthiyeli, indodana kaYeshaya;
begodu ngemuva kwakhe, uGabayi noSalai, amadoda angumakhulu ayisishiyagalombili namahlanu.
UYoweli unyana kaZikhri waba nguMengameli wabo, noYuda unyana kaHasenuaha ube yikosi yesithathu ezweni.
Kwabebhishophi: uJedaya unyana kaYoyaribi, noYakhi;
uSeraya indodana kaHilkiya, indodana kaMeshulam, indodana kaTsadoki, indodana kaMerayothi, indodana kaAhitubu, umphathi wendlu kaThixo;

nabangane babo ababhishobhi, ababesebenza endlwini kaThixo, kwaba ngumakhulu asibhozo, amashumi amabili nanhlanu; noAdaya unyana kaYerohamu, unyana kaPelaliya, unyana kaAmzi, unyana kaZekariya, unyana kaPashure, unyana kaMalkiya;
nabangane bakhe, abaphathi bezindlu zabazali babo, amadodana angumakhulu amabili anamashumi amane nambili; noAmashai unyana ka-Azareli, unyana ka-Ahzai, unyana ka-Meshilemothi, unyana ka-Imer;
nabangane bakhe, amadoda anamandla amakhulu, abengumakhulu ayisishiyagalombili anesibhozo; umholi wabo ube nguZabdiyeli unyana kaHagedolimu.
KwabaLevi: uShemaya unyana kaHashubu, unyana kaAzrikam, unyana kaHashabiya, unyana kaBuni;
noShabhethai, noYozabadi, abakhulu beLevi, ababephethe imisebenzi yangaphandle yendlu kaThixo;

UMatania unyana kaMikha, unyana kaZabdi, unyana kaAsaphi, owayephethe ukubonga nokuthandaza; noBakbukiya, umfazi phakathi kwabazalwane bakhe; noAbda unyana kaShamua, unyana kaGalal, unyana kaJeduthuni.
Ngabo bonke amaLevi edolobhaneni elingcwele kwaba ngumakhulu amabili, anamanci asibhozo.
Abaphathi beminyango: uAkubu, noTalmoni, nabazalwane babo, abagcina iminyango; babemakhulu ayisishiyagalolunye namabini.
Amanye amaSirayeli, namabhishobhi, namaLevi, ahlala ezindaweni zonke zaseYiputa, wonke umuntu ezweni lemindeni yakhe.
Bahlala emadolobheni ase-Ofel; uZiha noGishpa babe yibo abaphathi babo.
Omkhulu kwabaLevi eYerusalem uUzi, indodana kaBani, indodana kaHashabhiya, indodana kaMatania, indodana kaMikha; waba yindodana ka-Asaphu, yaba ngumuntu ophethe umsebenzi wendlu kaThixo.
Ubukhosi babenikeze imiyalo mayelana nabaculi, begodu bathola inani eliqinile ngosuku ngalunye.
UPethahiya unyana kaMesezabele, umfazi waseZera, unyana kaYuda, waba ngumphathi wombuso ngazo zonke izinto eziphathelene nabantu.
Ezindaweni zakwa-Abha, nasezindaweni zayo, naseDiboni nasezindaweni zayo, naseJekabseyeli nasezindaweni zayo, kwahlala abanye abantu baseYuda.
eJeshua, eMolada, eBeth Pelet,
begodu eHazar-shuali, naseBheri-shebha nasezindaweni zayo,
eZiklagi, naseMekona kanye nezifunda zayo,
e-En Rimmon, eZorah, eJarmuth,
Bahlala eZanoa, ne-Adulam, nezifundela zazo, eLakishi nasezindaweni zayo, nase-Azeka nasezindaweni zayo; bahlala kusukela eBhe-shebha kuya emfuleni uHinom.
Amadodana kaBhenjamin ahlala eGibeha, naseMikmashheni, naseAhiyani, naseBetheleli nezindawo zayo,
eAnathothi, eNobi, eAnaniya,
noHasoro, neRama, neGitayimu,
uHadidi, noZeboyim, noNebalathi,
uLodi, noOno, emfuleni wama-Craftmen.
Ezweni lakwaBhenjamin kwahlala amaLevi asuka eYuda, abe ngamaqembu.
Nalaba ababingeleli nabaLevi, ababesuka noZerubabele unyana kaShealthiyeli, noYeshua: uSeraya, noYeremiya, noEzra,
uAmariya, noMaluku, noHatushi,
uShekaniya, noRehumu, noMeremoth,
uIdo, noGinethoyi, noAbiha,
uMiyamina, noMadiya, noBilga,
noShemaya, noYoyaribi, noJedaya,
USalu, noAmoki, noHilkiya, noJedaya. Lokho kwakungubo bonke abaphathi bezindlu zakwaLevi, kanye nabangane babo, ngesikhathi sikaYeshua.
AbaLevi: uYeshua, noBinnui, noKadmiyeli, noSherebiya, noYuda, noMataniya. UMataniya nabangane bakhe babephethe ingoma yokubonga.
UBakbukiah no-Unno, abahlobo babo, behlala eduze kwabo ngesikhathi somsebenzi.
UYeshua waba ubaba kaYoyakim, noYoyakim waba ubaba kaEliashib, noEliashib waba ubaba kaYehoyada.
UYehoyada waba ubaba kaYonathani, noYonathani waba ubaba kaYaduya.
Ezikhathini zikaYehoyakime, kwabekho abaphathi bezindlu zakubo abapristi: ezweni likaSeraya, uMeraia; ezweni likaYeremiya, uHananiya;
ku-Ezra, nguMeshulamu; ku-Amariya, uYohanan;
ku-Maluchi, uYonathani; ku-Shebania, uYosefu;
ngoHarimu, uAdna; ngoMeraiothi, uHelekayi;
ku-Iddo, uZekariya; ku-Ginethon, uMeshulamu;
ku-Abiha, uZikri; ku-Minaamini noModiya, uPiltai;
ku-Bilga, uShamua; ku-Shemaya, uYonathani;
ku-Yoyaribhi, uMatheni; ku-Yedaya, uUzi;
ku-Sallai, uKalai; ku-Amoki, u-Ebheri;
ku-Hilkiya, uHashabiya; ku-Yedaya, uNathaneli.
Ngosuku lukaEliyashibhi, noYehoyada, noYohanane, noYaduya, abakhulu bezindlu zakwaLawi, nabapristi, babhalwa, lapho uDariyosi wasePerisi engumkani.
Abaphathi bezindlu zakwaLevi babhalwa encwadini yomlando, kuze kube yizinsuku zikaYohananu unyana kaEliashibi.

Nabo abaphathi bamaLevi: uHashabhiya, noSherebiya, noYeshuwa unyana kaKadmiyeli; begodu abazalwane babo bahlala bebhekene nabo ukubonga nokubonga, iqembu elilodwa liphendula iqembu elilodwa, ngokwemiyalelo kaDavide umuntu kaThixo.
UMatania, noBakbukiya, noObadia, noMeshulamu, noTalmoni, noAkubu, abaphathi bezindonga, bagcina izindlu zokugcina ezingcezu.
Basebenza ezikhathini zikaYehoyakim, unyana kaYeshua, unyana kaYosadaki, nasezikhathinikhanselo kaNehemiya, noEzra, umpristi, nombhali.

Kwathi, ngesikhathi kuqedwa ingqalasizinda yaseYerusalem, kwavela amaLevi kiwo wonke amadolobha abo eJerusalema, ukuba balungiselele ukubekwa kwengqalasizinda ngothando nokuzibophezela, nama-cymbals, nama-harps, nama-piare.
Bahlangana nabangani abavela ezindaweni ezishisayo zaseYerusalem, nasezindaweni zakwaNetofathi;
kusukela Beth-gilgal, begodu kusuka ezindaweni zeGeba neAzmaveth. Abaculi babe kwakha izindlu zabo phezu kweYerusalem.
Bahlanza labo ababhishobhi nalabaLevi; bahlanza abantu, namasango, nedonga.

ko kwalokho, ngabeka abaphathi baseYuda bafike phezu kwengqalasizinda. Ngakhetha begodu amakhoriya amakhulu amabili ukubonga, ahambe eduze kwengqalasizinda. Ikhoriya eyodwa yahamba ekunene, ibhekene neGoli Lezinhlanzi.
Hoshaiah kanye nengxenye abaphathi baseYuda walandela kubo,
kanye no-Azariya, Ezra, Meshullam,
uYuda, noBhenjamini, noShemaya, noYeremiya.
Balandela nabanye ababhishobhi abanezinhlamvu; noZekariya unyana kaYonathani, unyana kaShemaya, unyana kaMatania, unyana kaMikaya, unyana kaZakhuri, unyana kaAsaphe;
kanye nabangane bakhe uShemaya, noAzareli, noMilalai, noGilalai, noMahai, noNethaneli, noYuda, noHanani. Badlala ngezinhlamvu zomuzi kaDavide, indodana kaThixo. UEzra umfundi wayephethe leli qembu.
Basuka emnyango wempucuko, bahamba phezulu ngezingcezu zedolobha likaDavide, ngaphesheya kodonga, phezu kwendlu kaDavide, befika emgwaqeni wamanzi enyakatho.
I-choir yesithathu yahamba ngenye indlela, ngakwesobunxele. Ngiwalandela phezulu kwedonga, kanye nengxenye yabantu. Siye ngaphesheya kweTower of the Ovens kuya eBroad Wall,
begodu, esigabeni uEphrayim, kanye nesigabeni elisha, kanye nesigabeni iinhlapi, begodu iTower Hananel, begodu iTower amashumi amane, kuze kube iGate Sheep.
Kwathi lapho amakhoriya amabili abonga khona ethempelini likaThixo, ngangihlala lapha, nami nengxenye yabaholi,
begodu uEliyakimu, noMaaseya, noMinaamini, noMika, noEliyonai, noZekariya, noHananiah, ababingeleli, namahhashi abo;
kanye noMaaseya, noShemaya, noEleazarhi, noUzi, noYohanani, noMalkiya, noElam, no-Ezer. Abaculi babedlala ngezwi elikhulu, eholwa nguJezrahiya.
Banikela ngamadini amanengi, bajabulela ngalolu busuku, ngombana uzimu wabajabulisa khulu; begodu namadodakazi nabantwana bathokozela. Izwi lothando eYerusalem lazwakala kude.

Ngosuku olulodwa kwakhethwa abantu ukuba babe ngabaphathi bezindlu zokugcina izinto ezinikezelwe umnikelo wesono, nengxenye yokuqala yembewu, nengxenye yesishiyagalombili, ukuze bafake ezindaweni zasemaphandleni ezibhekene nezifundazwe izingxenye zemithetho yamaLevi nabapristi ezindlini zokugcina izinto. Abantu baseYuda baba mnandi ngenxa yalabo ababingeleli nalabaLevi ababesebenza.
Bakwenza umsebenzi kaThixo wabo, nomsebenzi wokuhlanza, kanye nabaculi, nabangani besango, ngokwemiyalo kaDavide noSolomoni unyana wakhe.
Kusukela eminyakeni eminingi, ngesikhathi sikaDavide noAsaphe, bekukhona abaphathi bezingoma, nezingoma zokubonga nokuzithokozisa kuThixo.

Ngosuku lukaZerubabele, nosuku lukaNehemiya, bonke isiSirayeli banikela ngezinkontileka zabagibeli nabangani besango, ngazo zonke amalanga; nabo bonke amaLevi banikela ngezinkontileka zabo; begodu amaLevi anikela ngezinkontileka zabo kubo bonke ababhishobhi, izingane zika-Aron.
Ngomhla owodwa kwafundwa incwadi kaMoses emlonyeni wabo bonke abantu, bathola kuso kubhalwe bona umAmoni noma uMowabi angeke afike engqungqutheleni kaThixo, kuze kube yilapho;
ngombana abakwazi ukuhlangabezana Isirayeli nge ukudla namanzi. endaweni sabo bakhokhele Balaam ukuba abulawe kubo, kodwana uzimu wethu washintsha izulazumo ekubambisani.
Kwathi lapho abantu bekhuluma ngalolu mthetho, bahlukanisa wonke umuntu ovela kwamanye amazwe ezweni lakwaSirayeli.
Ngaleso sikhathi uEliyashabi, umbhishobhi, owayeyilungu lomndeni kaTobiya, wabekwa phezu kwezindlu zokugcina zendlu kaThixo wethu.

Wathi uSolomoni wamnika uTobiya igumbi elikhulu, ukuze kugcinwe khona izipho zakudla Urethi, nofuzo, nezitho zendlu, nengxenye yeshumi eyisishiyagalombili yamafutha omnqumo, nomvinyo omusha, nama-oyile, eziboshwe ngamaLevi, namangomani, nabangani besango, kanye nezipho zabaphazi.

Ngaleso sikhathi, ngangingeke ngibe eYerusalem. Ngonyaka oyisithathu nesimbili ka-Artaxerxes, ukumkani waseBhabheli, ngabuya ngaya kukumkani; begodu ngemuva kwezinsuku ezimbalwa ngacela ukumkani bona amvumele ukuba ahambe,
Kwathi lapho ngifika eYerusalem, ngathola bona uEliashibe wenza okumbi ngenxa kaTobiya, ngokumnika indlu ezindaweni zendlu kazimu.
Ngangikhathazekile khulu, ngakhipha zonke izinto zikaTobiya egumbini.
Kwathi lapho, ngiphoqelela ukuba zihlanzwe izindlu, begodu ngazibeka kabutjha izinto zethempelini likaThixo, kanye nezinto zomnikelo wesonka, nomlilo.
Ngathola begodu bona amaLevi amanani abo awanikezelwanga; ngalokho abaLevi, nabangani abasebenza umsebenzi, bonke basuka ezindaweni zabo.
Ngathi, ngazibulala iziphathimandla, ngathi kubo, Kungani na bona indlu kaThixo ilahlekile? Kwathi lapho ngibiza amaLevi, ngawabeka endaweni sabo.
Bathi bonke abantu baseYuda baveza ishumi lembewu, newayini elisha, nophethiloli, ezindaweni zokugcina.

Ngathi ngabeka uShelemiya ukumkani, noTsadoki umfundi, noPedaya, owesiLevi, abaphathi bezindlu zokugcina izinto; noHanan unyana kaZakhuri, unyana kaMatania, wabasiza; ngombana laba bantu bayaziwa bona bathembekile, begodu babe nemisebenzi yokwabelana ngomnikelo phakathi kwabazalwane babo.
uzimu wami, khumbula ngalokhu, ukuze ungazilungise zonke izinto ezinhle engizenzayo ngendlu kaThixo wami, nemisebenzi yami.

Ngaleso sikhathi ngabona abantu ezweni laseYuda becindezela izithelo ngeSonto, begodu abanye beziphanela imbewu, bezifaka ezindleni, kanye newayini, nezithelo, nama-tines, nazo zonke izinhlobo zezinto ezithwalayo; babezifaka eYerusalem ngeSonto. Ngize ngibatshela bona bangathengi ukudla ngalolusuku.
Bakhona abantu base-Tyre abahlala eYerusalem, beletha iinhlapi nezimpahla ezahlukahlukene, bezithengisa ngeSabhati kubantu bakaYuda eJerusalema.
Ngathi, ngiziphoxela izikhulu zakwaYuda, ngathi kubo, Yintoni le nto ebi niyenzayo, bona niyenze amalanga zosuku lokuphumula njengezinye amalanga?

uzimu wethu akhenge akwenze lokhu kuphela, kodwana waletha zonke lezi zinto ezibi phezu kwethu, naphezu kwalo mzi; begodu manje niyaqhubeka nokwengeza ukucasuka kwakhe ezweni lakwaSirayeli, ngokungcolisa iSonto.

Kwathi lapho isithunzi selanga siqala ukubopha amasango eYerusalem, ngaphambi kosuku lokuphumula, ngasho bona bavale amasango, begodu bangavuleki kuze kudlule usuku lokuphumula; ngabeka abantu abathile emigwaqeni yami, ukuze akukho mthwalo ovunyelwe ukuba ufike ngosuku lwesonto.
Ngalinye noma izikhathi ezimbili, abahwebi nabenzi bezimpahla zazo zonke izinhlobo bachitha ekuseni ngaphandle kweYerusalem.
Kwathi ngabatshela, ngitjho kubo, Yini na bona nihlale nsuku zonke enkabeni yesitezi? Uma niphinda nikwenze lokhu, ngizokwenza ngesandla sami. Ngaleso sikhathi bebengafikanga ngosuku lweSabhati.
Kwathi ngathi kumaLevi, bona bahlanzeke, bafike bagweme amasango, bagcine usuku lweShabbat lingcwele. Kulokhu begodu, Kosi yami, ngingakukhumbula, ngibe nenhlanhla ngenxa yothando lwakho olukhulu.
Ngaleso sikhathi ngabona namadodana aseYuda athathe amadodakazi aseAshdodi, nama-Amoni, namaMoabi.
Ngaphakathi kwabo kwamatomkhulu abo bekhuluma ulwimi lwe-Ashdodi, noma ulwimi lwabanye abantu; kodwana abakwazi ukukhuluma ulwimi lwaseYuda.

Ngabaphoxela, ngabaphazamisa, ngawashaya amanye phakathi kwabo, ngawasusa izinwele zabo; begodu ngababeka emthethweni ngegama likaThixo, ngitjho: Akufanele nizithathe izingane zenu zibe ngamantombazane onyana babo, begodu akufanele nizithathe izingane zabo zibe ngamantombazane onyana benu noma kwabanye.

USolomoni, ukumkani wakwaSirayeli, akawinile yini ngenxa yazo zonke lezi zinto? Ezweni lonke kwakungekho ukumkani ofana naye; kodwana uzimu wakhe wamthanda, wakwenza waba ngukumkani phezu kwabaSirayeli bonke. Kodwana-ke, nalowo wagwetywa yizingane zakwamanye amazwe.
Ngabe sizokulalela wena, bona senze lokhu okumbi khulu? Ngabe sizokwenqaba uzimu wethu, ukushada izingane zakwamanye amazwe?"
Omunye wamadodana kaYehoyada, unyana kaEliashibi, umpristi omkhulu, wayeyindodakazi ka-Sanbalathi waseHoroni; ngalokho ngawususa ekuphileni kwam.
Khumbula labo, Kosi yami, ngenxa yokuthi baphonsa ubuthi bendlu kambingeleli, begodu baphula isivumelwano senkundla yamabhishobhi namaLevi.
Ngathi ngahlanza ababhishobhi nalabaLevi kinanyana yini engaphandle, ngabanikeza imisebenzi sabo, wonke umuntu umsebenzi wakhe.
Nami ngalungiselela imithi, ukuze ibe yiyo ezikhathini ezifanele, kanye nengxenye yokuqala yokuvuna. Khumbulana nami ngokunethezeka, uzimu wami.
Esth: Kwaba njalo ezikhathini zokumkani uXeshashe, owaziwa nangokuthi ngu-Ashureshi; walawula izifunda ezingamakhulu amabili nesishiyagalolunye, kusukela eNdiya kuya eEthiopia.
Ngaleso sikhathi, uKumkani u-Xerxes wayelawula izwe lakhe kusuka esihlalweni sakhe sebukhosini edolobhaneni laseSusa.
Ngomnyaka wesithathu wokubusa kwakhe, wenza isidlo esikhulu kuzo zonke iziphathimandla zakhe, nezisebenzi zakhe; begodu abakhulu bePersia neMediya, namadoda amakhulu, nabaphathi bezifunda, babe naye.
Wabonisa izimali ezinkulu zobukhosi bakhe, nobuhle obukhulu bombuso wakhe, ngezinsuku ezingu-ishumi nesishiyagalombili, isikhathi eside.

Uma amalanga ezinjalo ziphelile, ukumkani wahlela isidlo sansuku eziyisixhenxe kiwo wonke umuntu ohlala eShushan, edolobhaneni eliqinile, kusukela omkhulu kuye komncane, emgwaqeni wegadi yendlu kabukhosi.

Kwaba khona amafasitela amhlophe naluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka, axhunywe ngentambo yelinen emhlophe neyombala oluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka, afakwe izikhonkwane zegolide ezimilenzeni yamatshe; kwaba khona izibhedlela zegolide neyesilivere emgodini wamatshe obomvu, namacwecwe amhlophe, namacwecwe amnyama.
Iziphuzo zafakwa emabhodweni egolide, ngalinye lihlukile kwezinye. Kube newayini eliningi lenkosi, ngombana ukumkani wayenothando olukhulu.
Ngomyalo wokumkani, akukho muntu ovunyelwe ukuthatha isiphuzo. Ukumkani watshela bonke abaphathi bendlu yakhe bona banikeze wonke umuntu okudingayo.
Unkosikazi uVashti walungiselela begodu isidlo samabhishi kwabesifazane ehlathini likaMkani uXerxes.

Ngosuku oluyisixhenxe, lapho umkwezi-bukhosini asinaso isifiso sokuphuza utshwala, watshela abaphathi bakhe abangusikhombisa abasebenza kuye: uMehumani, noBiztha, noHarbona, noBigtha, noAbagtha, noZethari, noKarkashi.
Wabatjela bona bafike bamveze uVashti, inkosikazi yakhe, egqoke isibhakabhaka sakhe sobukhosi, ukuze abonisane nobuhle bakhe nabantu nabaphathi; ngombana wayebukeka kahle.
Wathi uVashti, indodakazi kakumkani, engathandanga ukubuya, ngenxa yesinqumo sokumkani; khona-ke ukumkani waphoqelela khulu, begodu inhliziyo yakhe yaphuza.
Wakhuluma ukumkani namadoda amakhulu awaziyo amalanga, ngombana kwakuyisiko lakhe ukubuza iziphakamiso ezivela kilabo abakwaziyo umthetho nomthetho.

Amadodana akhe aphakathi kwaba nguKarshena, noShethar, noAdmatha, noTarshish, noMeresh, noMarsena, noMemukan, abaphathi bakwaPersia nakwaMediya, abasebathathu; bona bebengafika emkhosini nganoma yisiphi isikhathi, begodu babe nesikhundla esiphezulu ezweni.
Wathi ukumkani, Usho ukuthini umthetho ukuba kwenziwe ngowesifazane uVashti? Ngokuba akhenge alandele isinqumo sokumkani uXeshazare, esithunyelwe kuye ngabaphathi.

Waphendula uMemukana phambi kukakumkani nabangaphathimandla, wathi, Uwesifazane uVashti akhenge agweme ukumkani kuphela, kodwana wagwema nabo bonke abaphathimandla, namazwe onke asezindaweni zonke zikakumkani u-Asheshazare.

Bazothi, Uma izifazane zonke zikhuluma ngalolu msebenzi owenziwe ngunkosikazi, begodu uma bebona bona amadodana abo awela phasi, bazothi, UMbuso Wase-Asheshazare waagiza ukuba kuthunyelwe kuye inkosikazi uVashti, kodwana yena akaze afike.

Ngosuku lwalezo zinsuku, abesifazane abakhulu basePersia nabaseMediya, abakwaziyo bona unkosikazi ukwenze lokhu, bazokhuluma ngalokhu kubo bonke abaphathi bakabukhosi; begodu kuzoba khona in Amrayeli.

Uma kungathandeki kumkakhe, khona-ke alungise umthetho womkakhe, abhalwe phakathi kwamasiko amaPersia namaMediya, angashintshwanga, bona uVashti angeke aphinde afike phambi komkakhe uXeshazare. Umbuso wakhe umkakhe amnikeze omunye ongcono kunaye. Wathi ke uBhenjamin: "Kulungile!
Uma isinqumo sokumkani sithunyelwe kiwo wonke ummandla wakhe omkhulu, khona-ke zonke izifazane zizozibophezela kumadodana abo, kusukela obaluleke khulu kuye komncane.
Le nto yamangalisa ukumkani nabangani bakhe. Wakwenza ukumkani ngokusho kukaMemukana.

Wathumela incwadi kuzo zonke izifundazwe zombuso wakhe, ezweni ngalinye ngokubhala kwalo, nakwazo zonke izizwe ngolimi lwazo. Le ncwadi yathi: Wonke umuntu kufanele abe ngumphathi wendlu yakhe, begodu kumele akhulume ngolimi lwabantu bakhe.
Kwathi, lapho ubukhosi buka-Asheshazare buhlanjululwa khona, wakhumbula uVashti, nokuthi yini ayeyenze, nokuthi yini ebeyigunyazwe ngayo.
Bathi abakhonzi bakakumkani, Kudinga bona kuhlolwe umkakhe amantombazane abukekayo, angabi nenkontileka yomndeni.

Ubukhosi bufanele bukhethe abaphathi emazweni onke ombuso wakhe, baveze zonke lezi zintatheli ezibukekayo endlu yamantombazane eShushan, idolobhana eliqinile; babe ngaphasi kwesandla sika-Hegai, umphathi wamabhishobhi uMbuso, olawula amadodakazi, begodu babe nokunakekelwa kwabo.
begodu umfazi ongathandeki emkhosini, ahlale eyisifazane endaweni kaVasti. Umbuso wathanda lo mbuzo, wakwenza njalo.
Kwabe kukhona umuntu oYuda, eShushani idolobhana eliqinile; igama lakhe lalinguMordekhai, unyana kaYaire, unyana kaShimehi, unyana kaKishi, wesizwe sikaBhenjamin.
Uthethwe waya eYerusalem, naye noJekoniya ukumkani wakwaYuda, lapho uNebhukadnezare ukumkani waseBhabheli abewathatha khona.

UMordecai wakhula udadewabo Hadassah, begodu kwabizwa bona Esther, ngombana yena akhenge abe nobaba noma umama. Le ntombazane encane wayenesimo esithandekayo begodu ebukekayo. Lapho ubaba wakhe nomama bakhe bafa, Mordecai wathatha yena njengendodakazi yakhe.

Kwathi lapho isinqumo sokumkani saphuma, kwathathwa amadodana amakhulu abesifazane eSusa, edolobhaneni elinabantu abaningi; begodu uEstere uthethwe waya emzini kakumkani, wabekwa ngaphasi kokunakekelwa kuka-Hegai, ophethe amadodana.

U-Estere wathandana no-Hegai, begodu u-Hegai wamthandela. Washesha ukumnika izimonyo neziphuzo ezikhethekile. Wamunikela ngamadodakazi amane akhethiwe endlu kakumkani, wamisa yena namadodakazi akhe endaweni engcono khulu yendlu yamabhishobho.
U-Estere akhenge atshele umuntu bona yimiphi abantu bakhe, noma imindeni yakhe; ngombana uMordekayi wayemtshela bona angakutshela.
UMordekayi wayehamba nsuku zonke, ehamba phambili nobuyela emuva, phambi kwendlu yamantombazane, ukuze abone bona uEsther usenjani, nokuthi kwenzekani kuye.

Phambi kokuba umshado wesifazane ufike eKing Xerxes, wayedinga ukuqedela izinyanga ezingu-12 zokunakekelwa kwezinwele: amalanga eziyisishiyagalombili nge-oyile ye-myrrh, kanye nezinsuku ezingama-6 neziphuzo nama-creams zabesifazane.
Uma indodakazi encane ifika kumkakhe, inikezwa noma yini afuna ukuyithatha nayo kusuka endlu yamantombazane kuya ePalace yomkakhe.

Kwathi uma efika kukumkani ekuseni, ngasekupheleni kwemini wabuyela endlini yesithathu yamabhishobhi, ngaphasi kokunakekelwa kuka-Shaashgaz, umphathi wenkosi, ophethe izifazane zikakumkani. Akhenge aphinde afike kukumkani, ngaphandle kokuthi athandeke kuye, begodu abizwa ngegama lakhe.

U-Estere wayeyindodana ka-Abihayeli, umngane ka-Mordecai. U-Mordecai wathatha u-Estere abe yinkosikazi yakhe. Kwathi lapho kwafika isikhathi sakhe sokungena kukumkani, u-Estere wacela konke okunikezwa nguHegai, umphathi wesifazane wokumkani. Wonke umuntu owabona u-Estere wamthanda.
Uthethwe u-Estere kuye uMbuso WaseXeshashe, endlu yakhe yasebukhosini, ngonyaka oyisishiyagalombili wenyanga, oyinyanga yeTebhethi, ngonyaka wesixhenxe wokubusa kwakhe.

Unkosi wathanda u-Esther ngaphezu kwazo zonke izifazane. Wathandana naye, wafumana inhlonipho ebusweni bakhe ngaphezu kwazo zonke izinja ezincane. Wabeka isibhamu sobukhosi phezu kwekhanda lakhe, wamenza abe nguwesifazane endaweni kaVashti.

Wakwenza ukumkani isidlo esikhulu kubo bonke abaphathi bakhe, nabakhonzi bakhe; kwakungusidla sika-Esther. Wamemezela usuku lokuphumula ezifundazweni zonke, wanikela ngemiklomelo eminingi, njengokuba umkakhe angenza ngayo.
Kwathi, lapho amantombazane ahlangana khona kathathu, uMordekayi uhlala emgwaqeni wobukhosi.
U-Estere akhenge acacisele umuntu imindeni yakhe, noma abantu bakhe, njengombana uMordekayi abemtshela; walalela uMordekhai, njengokuba wayekwenza ngesikhathi ekhula.
Ngaleso sikhathi, lapho uMordekayi uhlala khona emgwaqweni wobukhosini, kwaphuma abantu ababini, uBigthani noTereshi, abaphathi bombuso, abagcina umngcele, baphoxeka, befuna ukumkani uXeshazare.
Wathi uMordekayi, lapho ekwazi khona isinqumo sakhe, wathi ku-Esteri, indodakazi kankosi. U-Esteri watshela ukumkani, wathi: "U-Mordekhai uwazi."
Wathi uHezekiya, "Iqiniso," begodu wafumana bona izindaba ezinjalo ziyiqiniso. Baphoqeleka ukubopha labo ababili abaphathi emgodini; begodu konke lokhu kwabhalwa encwadini yomlando phambi kobukhosi.
Ngemuva kwalezi zinto, ukumkani u-Asheshazare wavusa uHaman, unyana ka-Hammedatha, umAgagi, wamphakamisa phezu kwabanye bonke abaphathi.

Nabo bonke abaphathi bakakumkani emnyango kakumkani baphakamisa ikhanda labo, babe nomhlomulo kuHaman; ngombana ukumkani wayesho njalo; kodwana uMordekayi akawuphakamisa umhlomulo wakhe, akhenge amhlomule.
Bathi abaphathi bakakumkani emnyango kuMordekayi, Kungani na bona uphula umthetho kakumkani?
Bathi kuye usuku nosuku, kodwana akhenge ayiqonde; ngalokho baveza lokhu kuHaman, ukuze babone bona isinqumo sikaMordekayi sizophumelela yini; ngombana wabatjela bona yena uYuda.
UHaman, lapho nakabona bona uMordekayi angeke akhonze, begodu angeke amhloniphe, wehla emlonyeni.
UHaman akhenge agweme uMordekayi kuphela, ngombana kwathiwa kuye bona yimiphi abantu bakaMordekhai; ngalokho wazama uHaman ukucima bonke abantu bakaMordekhai, abaYuda, ezweni lonke lika-Asheshe.

Ngonyaka oyisishiyagalombili wokumkani uXeshazare, ngonyaka wesithupha wenyanga yokuqala, leyo yinyanga ka-Nisan, bakhipha iPuri phambi kukaHaman, ukuze bakhethe usuku nenyanga; ishumi nambili lenyanga, leyo yinyanga ka-Adare, yakhishwa.

Wathi uHaman kukumkani u-Asheshazare, Kukhona abantu ababili abahlukanisiwe phakathi kwezizwe zonke izifundazwe zombuso wakho; begodu imithetho sabo ayifani nanoma iyiphi enye imithetho yoMbuso, begodu bangawasebenzisi umthetho wobukhosi; ngalokho akulungile kumkakhe ukuba awashiye.
Uma kungathandeki ukumkani, abhaleke umthetho wokuthi bakhululwe; begodu ngizobala amathani amane esiliva ezincwadini zalabo abaphatha ibhizinisi likakumkani, ukuze lifakwe emgodini womkhosi.
Wathi ukumkani, wasusa isibopho sakhe esimhlophe esandlani sakhe, wamnika uHaman, unyana ka-Hammedatha, umAgagi, umnakwabo wamaYuda.
Wathi ukumkani ku-Haman, Imali ihlale kuwe; yenza nalabo abantu konke okubona kulungile.

Ngonyaka wokuthoma, ngomhla wama-13 wenyanga yokuqala, babizwa ababhali bakakumkani. Babhalela iziphathimandla zikaKumkani, nabavikeli besifundazwe ngayinye, nabangani bomphakathi ngamnye, ngokusho komthetho kaHaman; kuzwelonke ngalinye ngemibhalo yawo, nomndeni ngayinye ngezilimi zawo; kwabhalwa igama likakumkanikazi uAsheshazarethi, begodu kwaba yisipho sobukhosi.

Bathi abathunywa bathumela izincwadi kuzo zonke isifundazwe sobukhosi, bona bangagcini nje kuphela abantu baseYiputa, kodwana nabo bonke abazalwane babo namadodakazi abo, nabantu abadala nezingane kanye nezifazane, ngosuku olulodwa, ngomhla wesithupha wenyanga yesishiyagalombili (leyo ngunyaka ka-Adare), begodu ngazo zonke izinto zabo.
Ikhophi yalo mthetho kumele ibe yimithetho ezweni ngalinye, begodu iboniswe kuzo zonke izizwe, ukuze zibe zilungiselelwe ngalolusuku.

Kwathi, ngenxa yomthetho kakumkani, abathunywa baphuma ngokushesha, begodu isinqumo sashicilelwa eShushani, edolobhaneni elinabantu abaningi; khona-ke ukumkani noHaman bahlala bephuza; kodwana idolobhana laseShushani lakhathazeka.
UMordekayi, lapho eqonda khona konke okwenzekile, waxosha izigqoko zakhe, wagqoka isigqoko esingwevu, wagqoka uthuli, waphuma waya edolobhaneni, ephuca ngezwi elikhulu khulu.
Wahamba kuphela kuze kufike emnyango wobukhosi, ngombana angeke kube khona umuntu ogqoke izicathulo ezimnyama.

Kuzo zonke izifundazwe, lapho isinqumo sokumkani sifike khona, kwaba nobuhlungu obukhulu phakathi kwaBayuda; baphuza ukudla, bevutha, bezama, begodu abaningi babo bagqoka izingubo zokuzigqoka, namathumba.

Kwafika amantombazane ka-Esther, nabangani bakhe, bakhuluma kuye ngoMordekayi. Uwesifazane wakhathazeka khulu; wathumela izigqoko uMordekhai ukuba azigqoke endaweni yendwangu yakhe, kodwana yena akhenge azithathe.
Wathi u-Estere, wabiza uHathaki, owodwa wabaphathi bakakumkani, umfazi owake wamsiza, wathi kuye, Yeka, uye kuMordekayi, ukuze wazi bona yini le nto, nokuthi kungani.
Waphuma ke uHathaki, waya kuMordekayi, esitezi esivulekile sedolobhana, esibhekene nesango lobukhosi.
Wathi uMordekayi kuye konke okwenzekile, kanye nenani lemali akhenge alinde bona uHaman ayeyikhokhela izimali zombuso, ngenxa yokubulala amaYuda.

Wabanikeza nekopi yesinqumo sokubulala amaYuda, esithunyelwe eSusa, ukuba asibonise ku-Estere, begodu ayichaze kuye; wathi uHathaki bona ayise emkhosini, aze amcela umhlomulo wakhe, abe nomsindo phambi kwakhe ngezwe lakhe.
Wabuya uHathaki, waveza ku-Estere amazwi kaMordecai.
Wathi uEsther kuHathaki, bona abize uMordekhai, athi:

Bayazi bonke abaphathi bakakumkani, nabantu bezifunda zikakumkani, bona uma umuntu umfazi noma umfazi efika kukumkani enkundleni yangaphakathi, engasekho owabizwayo, kufanele abulawe; kodwana uma umkwenu ephakamisa isandla sakhe segolide kuye, khona-ke uphila. Ngami ke angikaze ngivunywe ukuba ngifike kukumkani eminyakeni emashumi mathathu.
Bathi kuMordecai, bona uEstere uthini.
Waphendula uMordekayi, wathi ku-Esther: "Ungacabangi bona, ngenxa yobukhona bakho endlwini kakumkani, uzosindiswa uma bonke amaJuda bebulawa.

Uma ungenzi nto ngesikhathi esinjalo, khona-ke usizo nokusindisa kwabaYuda kuzofika ezindaweni ezahlukene; kodwana wena nomndeni wakwababa wakho uzofa. Ubani owaziyo? Kungenzeka bona ube yinkosikazi ngenxa yesikhathi esinjalo.
U-Estere waphendula uMordekayi, wathi:

Yathi ikosi kuSolomoni, Iya, uhlanganise wonke amaYuda aseSusa; nihlale ningadli noma ningaphuzi kuze kube yizinsuku amathathu, ekuseni nakusihlwa. Nami namadodakazi ami sizohlala ningadli noma ningaphuzi; begodu ngiya ebukhosini, nakuba kuyinto engavumelekile; uma ngifa, ngifile.
Wahamba ke uMordekayi, wakwenza konke okuthiwa nguEstere.

Ngosuku lwesithathu, u-Esther wagqoka izicathulo zakhe zobukhosi, wahlala emgwaqweni ongaphakathi wendlu yasebukhosini, ebhekene negumbi likakumkani. Ukumkani wayesesitezi sakhe sombuso, egumbini elibhekene nokungena.
Kwathi lapho ukumkani nakabona u-Esteri, indodakazi kankosi, ehleli emgwaqeni, wathandana naye, waphakamisa isandla sakhe esiyigolide, waya kuye. Wafika u-Esteri, wehlisa intamo yesandla.
Wathi ukumkani kuye, Yini ofuna yona, uEstere umkakhe? Ingabe ufuna lutho? Nakuba kube yingxenye yombuso wami, ngizokunika.
Waphendula u-Esther, wathi, Uma kungathandeki ukumkani, afike ukumkani noHaman namuhla emdlalweni engiwulungiselele ukumkani.
Wathi ukumkani, Nciphisani ukuletha uHaman, ukuze sikwenze lokho akusho khona u-Estere. Waphuma ke ukumkani no-Haman ekudlaleni okulungiselelwe u-Estere.
Wathi ukumkani ku-Esther, lapho bedla khona iwayini, bona, Uyini umbuzo wakho? Kuzokulethwa kuwe. Yimiphi imibuzo yakho? Nakuba kube nengxenye yombuso wami, ngizoyifeza.
Waphendula u-Esther, wathi, Lokho ngiyenzile, begodu ngicela.

Uma kungenxa yami ukumkani ethanda, begodu uma kungenxa yokumkani bona anikeze isifiso sami, begodu akwenze umbuzo wami, khona-ke umkwenzi noHaman bangafika ngoLwesihlanu emdlalweni ongeke ngiwulungiselele kubo; ngaleso sikhathi ngizotshela umkwenzi.

Waphuma ke uHaman ngalolusuku, ethokozela begodu enenhliziyo emnandi. Kodwana lapho nakabona uMordekayi emgwaqeni wobukhosi, bona uMordekhai akasekho, begodu angeke agweme, wagcwele uHaman inkohliso ngoModekayi.
Kodwana uHaman wagwema, waya ekhaya lakhe, wababiza bonke abazalwane bakhe, noZereshe indodana yakhe.
Wathi uHaman kubo yonke imisebenzi yakhe, nezingane zakhe eziningi, nazo zonke izinto ayvukile ngazo ukumkani, nokuthi waphakama kanjani ngaphezu kwanoma ngimuphi umphathi noma umkhonzi kakumkani.

Wathi uHaman, "Akekho okunye ongakwenza, ngombana inkosikazi ka-Esther akayibizanga omunye umuntu ukuba abe nokumkani emdlalweni wakhe, ngaphandle kwami; begodu namanje uHaman ungibiza ngeSonto nokumkani.
Ngalokho-ke, konke lokhu akungithokozisi, uma ngibona uMordekayi, lo Yuda, uhlala emgwaqweni wobukhosi.

Wathi uZereshi indodana yakhe, nabangane bakhe bonke kuye, Uzobekwa umnqumo, ubude bawo bube amakomidi ayisishiyagalombili, begodu ekuseni utshele ukumkani bona umkhonze khona uMordekayi; bese uya nokumkani emdlalweni, ube nomsindo. Kuhle lokhu kuHaman, wabeka umnqumo.
Ngobusuku obunjalo, ukumkani akakwazi ukuphumula. Wathi ke bona bathathe incwadi yomlando, yafundwa kuye.
Kuthe kwafunwa okubhalwe khona bona uMordekayi wakhuluma ngoBigthana noTereshi, abaphathi ababini bokumkani abagcina ifasitela, ababefuna ukumbulala uKhisimesi.
Wathi ukumkani, Ingabe kunikezwe uMordekayi inhlonipho noma isipho ngalolu daba? Baphendula abakhonzi bakakumkani ababekhona naye, bathi, Akunalutho okwenziwe kuye.
Wathi ukumkani, Nibani esihlalweni sangaphandle? (Haman wafika esihlalweni sangaphandle sendlu yasebukhosini, ukuba atshele ukumkani bona abeke uMordekayi emgodini abewulungiselele.)
Bathi kuye abakhonzi bakakumkani, besithi, Khamana ukhona emgwaqweni. Wathi ukumani, Ake afike.
Wafika uHaman, ukumkani wathi kuye, Yini okufanele kwenziwe ngomntu ofuna ukumkani ukuwuhlonipha? Wathi uHaman engqondweni yakhe, Ubani ongathanda ukumkani ukuba awumhlonishwa ngaphandle kwami?
Waphendula uSolomoni ukumkani, wathi, "Ngomuntu ofuna ukumkani ukuwuhlonipha,
