baveze isigqoko sokumkani, umfazi obewugqoke umkakhe, nesibhakabhaka ebesihamba ngaso umkakhe; kube nenkundla yombuso ekhanda lakhe.

Lawo mahembe nalowo mkhosi kufanele anikezelwe komunye wabaphathi abakhulu bakakumkani, ukuze amgqoke umuntu ofuna ukumkani ukuba ngumhlonishwayo, ahambe naye emgwaqeni wedolobha phezu komkhosi wakhe, abe nomsindo phambi kwakhe, athi, Kunjalo okungenziwa umuntu ofuna ukumkani ukuba ngumhlonishwayo.
Wathi ukumkani ku-Haman, Yiya ngokushesha, uthathe isigqoko nesibhakabhaka, njengokuthi wena, wenze njalo noMordekayi, umYuda, ohlala emnyango wobukhosi; ungagcini lutho ohlwini lwakho.

Wathi uHaman, athathe isigqoko nesibhakabhaka, wagqoka uMordekayi, wahamba naye ngesibhakabhaka ezindaweni ezivulekile zedolobhana, ekhuluma phambi kwakhe, esithi, Kunjalo okungenziwa umuntu ofuna ukumkani ukubambisa.
UMordekayi wabuyela emnyango wobukhosi, kodwana uHaman wahamba ngokushesha waya ekhaya lakhe, ehloniphekile, egqoke ikhanda lakhe.

Wathi uHaman kuZereshe indodana yakhe, nakwabo bonke abahlobo bakhe, konke okwenzekile kuye. Bathi kuye abaholi bakhe, noZereshe indodana yakhe, Uqale ukufa phambi kukaMordekayi; ngombana yena unguYuda, awukwazi ukumnqoba, kodwana uya kufa.
Belokhu bekhuluma naye, kwafika abaphathi bakakumkani, bakhawulela uHaman ukuba afike emcimbini owalungiselela u-Estere.
Wathi ukumkani noHaman: "Siya ku-Esther, inkosikazi yami."

Kwathi ngosuku olulandelayo, lapho bedla khona utshwala, wathi ukumkani ku-Esther: Uyini umbuzo wakho, umkakhe u-Esther? Kuzokulethwa kuwe. Yimiphi imibuzo yakho? Nakuba kube yingxenye yombuso wami, ngizoyenza.

Waphendula u-Esther inkosikazi, wathi: Uma ngibona ukuthandeka kuwe, ukumkani wami, begodu uma kukuhle phambi kwakho, ngicela ugcine impilo yami, njengombana ngifuna; begodu ngicela ugcine abantu bam, njengombana ngifisa.

Ngithengiswe, mina nomndeni wami, ukuze silahleke, sibulawe, sikhululwe. Uma sengithengiswe singamakhoboka, amadoda nabesifazane, ngingeke ngihlale ngingasho lutho; kodwana akukho mnqobi okwaziyo ukubuyisela umonakalo wokumkani ngalokhu.
Wathi uKumkani uXeshazaresi kunkosikazi ka-Esther, Ubani lo muntu, naphi lowo mntu owenza lokhu?
Wathi u-Esther, Lo mnqobi, lo mhlaseli, nguwo lowo muntu omnyama, uHaman. UHaman wakhathazeka phambi kukakumkani nonkosikazi.
Umbuso wavuka iwayini, begodu waphuma emgwaqeni wendlu yasebukhosini; kodwana Hamane wahlala ephaketheni, ukucela umkakhe uEstere, ngombana yena wayebona bona uMbuso waba nesinqumo sokumsusa.

Kwathi lapho ukumkani ebuyela egumbini lokudlela, esuka engadini yendlu yasebukhosini, ngabona uHaman esele embhedeni lapho i-Esther ihlala khona. Wathi ukumkani, Ingabe uzohlasela indodakazi yomkakhe, nami ngisendlu yasebukhosini? Uma ukumkani ekhuluma lokhu, abakhonzi bakhe bavala ubuso bukaHaman.

Wathi uHarbona, owodwa wabaphathi abasebenza emkhosini, sithi, Bheka, kukho indlu ka-Haman itshe elinezinyawo eziyisishiyagalombili ubude, elizobekwa nguMordekayi, umuntu okhulumela ukumkani. Wathi ubukhosi, Libeke phezu kwalo!
Bathi ke, baphonsa uHaman emgodini, obewubeke uMordekayi; begodu inhliziyo yomkakhe yaphumula.

Ngosuku olulodwa, uMbuso WaseXeshazare wanikela ku-Esteri, indodakazi kankosi, zonke izinto ezibekiwe nguHaman, umnakwabo wamaYuda. Wafika uMordekayi phambi kuka Amram; ngombana uEstere wayemtshela ukumkani bona unenhlanhla naye.
Wakhipha ukumkani isikhunta sakhe, ebesithathwe kuHaman, wamnika uMordekayi. U-Estere wabeka uMordekhai phezu kwazo zonke izinto zakumnikazi kaHaman.
U-Estere waqhubeka ekhuluma nomkakhe, wehla emlenzeni wakhe, wathandaza, wamcela bona alungise isinqumo esibi sika-Haman wase-Agagi, ebesilungiselele ngabaseYiputa.
Ubukhosi budlulisa isandla segolide ku-Esther; yena wavuka, wahlala phambi koMbuso.

Wathi, Uma kungalungile kukumkani, uma ngikuthandela, begodu uma kuyiqiniso emehlo akhe, begodu uma ngikuthandela ebusweni bakhe, khona-ke kufanele kubhalwe incwadi bona zibuyiselwe emuva izincwadi ezibhalwe nguHaman, unyana kaHamedatha, umAgagi; ngombana wabhala ngazo ukuba asuse amaYuda asezindaweni zonke zomkwelwane.
Ingabe ngizokwazi ukumelana nokubona ingozi efika kubantu bam? Ingabe ngizokwazi ukulwa nokubona imindeni yami ihlulekile?"
Wathi uHezekiya ukumkani ku-Esteri umkakhe, noMordekayi umYuda, Thola, nginika u-Esteri konke okubekho kukaHaman; naye bamphikisa emgodini, ngenxa yokuthi wahlasela amaYuda.

Ngiyakucela, ubhale isinqumo esisha ngegama lomkakhe mayelana nabaYuda, njengombana kubukeka sengathi kulungile kuwe, begodu uqinise ngesikhunta somkakhe; ngombana akukho sinqumo esibhalwe ngegama lomkakhe, begodu siqinisekiswe ngesikhunta somkakhe, esingashintshwa.

Bathi, "Sibhalela abaphathi bezifundazwe ezingu-127, kusukela eNdiya kuze kube iEthiopia; kinanyana yisiphi isiFundazweni ngokubhala kwayo, nakwaso soke isizwe ngesilimi sayo; begodu kumaYuda ngokubhala kwaso kanye nesilimi sawo. Kuzo zonke lezi zifundazwe zabhalwa ngamazwi kaMordekayi, owawusho bona: 'Izifundeni zesiFulentshi nezifundweni zaseGibhithe zingamaphesenti angamashumi amabili nanhlanu anesishiyagalombili!'

UMordekayi wabhala ngegama likakumkani u-Ashesheshi, wavala izibhengezo ngezinhlamvu zobukhosi; wabathumela ngocingo lwabathunywa abahamba ngamabhayisikili asheshayo, abaqeqeshiwe ukuba basebenze emkhosini kakumkani.

Kulezi zincwadi, ubukhosi bavumela amaYuda ezindaweni zonke ukuba aqoqe begodu avikele impilo sabo. Bangakwazi ukulahla, ukubulala, nokususa noma yiluphi iqembu elibusayo lanoma yiliphi izwe noma isifundazwe elihlasele labo, izingane zabo, nabesifazane babo. Bayakwazi nokuthatha impahla yababi babo.
ukuze kube ngosuku olulodwa kuzo zonke izifundazwe zikakumkani u-Asheshazare, ngomhla wesishiyagalombili wenyanga yeshumi nambili, eyaziwa bona inyanga ka-Adare.
Ikhophi yalo myalo yabekwa umthetho kiwo wonke umkhandlu, yashicilelwa kuzo zonke izizwe, ukuze abantu baseYiputa babe kulungele ngalolusuku ukubhekana nobubi babo.
Baphuma khona labo abathunyelwe, behamba ngejubane ezinyathelweni zobukhosi, behamba ngejubane ngenxa yomthetho kakumkani; begodu isinqumo sashicilelwa eSusa, emzini wendlunkulu.

Waphuma uMordekayi emkhosini, egqoke izicathulo zobukhosi eziluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka nezimhlophe, egqoke inkosikazi enkulu yegolide, egqoke isiketi esibomvu selinen; khona-ke idolobhana laseShushani lavuya.
KwabaYuda kwakuyisikhathi sokukhanya, sothando, sokuzithokozisa, nesonka.

Ezweni ngalinye, edolobhaneni ngalinye, lapho isinqumo sokumkani safika khona, kwabe sengathi amaYuda ajabulile, abe nesikhathi esimnandi; begodu abantu abaningi basuka ezindleleni zakwamanye amazwe babe ngamaYuda, ngombana bebakhathazekile ngezintatheli.

Ngomhla wesithathu nesishiyagalombili wenyanga yesithupha, okungunyaka ka-Adare, lapho isinqumo sokumkani sizokwenziwa khona; ngaleso sikhathi izitha zesiYuda zacabanga bona zizowanqoba. Nokho izinto zazishintshile, begodu isiJuda sahlasela labo ababavuzayo.

Bahlangana amaYuda emizini sabo, ezindaweni zonke zombuso ka asinakhesi ukumkani, ukuba bahlasele labo abafuna ukulimala kwabo; begodu akukho muntu okwaziyo ukumelana nabo, ngombana izwe lonke lisemqoka ngenxa sabo.
Nabo bonke abaphathi bezifundazwe, namakhansela, namagosa, nabaphathi bakakumkani, basiza amaYuda; ngombana babekhathazekile ngoMordekayi.
UMordekayi waba mkhulu khulu endlunkuluni, begodu igama lakhe lasakazeka ngazo zonke izifundazwe, waqhubeka enamandla.
Bathi amaYuda abulala bonke abaphikisi babo ngeqhwa, babulawa, bakhululwe; bakwenza ngazo zonke izinto abazifunayo labo ababebaxolisa.
ESusa, edolobhaneni elinabantu abaningi, abaYuda babulala abantu abangumakhulu amahlanu.
Babulala begodu uParshandatha, noDalphon, noAspatha,
iPoratha, neAdaliya, neAridata,
Parmashta, Arisai, Aridai, noVaizatha,
odade abalishumi kaHaman, unyana kaHammedatha, umnakwabo wamaYuda. Kodwana akhenge athathe noma iyiphi yempahla sabo.
Ngosuku olufanayo kwathunyelwe ukumkani inani labantu ababulawe eSusa, edolobhaneni lendlunkulu.

Wathi ukumkani ku-Esther inkosikazi, EShushani idolobhana elinabantu abangumakhulu amahlanu, abantu baseYiputa babulale begodu babulale amadoda angamashumi ayisishiyagalombili nabantwana bakaHaman; bangakwenza kuphi eminye imiphakathi yombuso? Manje yini oyifunayo? Kuzokunikezelwa kuwe. Yini eyengeziwe ongayicela? Izokwenziwa.

Wathi u-Esther, Uma kubukeka sengathi kuyamangalisa ukumkani, amaJuda aseShushani angakwenza begodu ngoLwesihlanu ngokusho komthetho wosuku olulodwa; namadodana ayisithupha kaHaman azokhonjululwa emgodini.
Wathi ukumkani, Bakwenze njalo; begodu kwakhishwa umthetho eSusa, waphonswa khona uHaman nonyana bakhe abalishumi.
Baphinde bahlangana amaJuda aseSusa, ngomhla wesishiyagalombili wenyanga ka-Adare, babulala abantu abangumakhulu amathathu eSusa; kodwana kungekho nto ababeyithathela.

Nabo bonke amaJuda, abasezindaweni zombuso, bahlangana nabo, befuna ukuzivikela empilweni sabo, ukuze babe nokuthula ezimpini zabo. Babulala phakathi kwalabo abawakhohlisayo abantu abangumakhulu asixhenxe namashumi amahlanu; kodwana ungenawo umkhosi wabo.
Ngosuku oluyisishiyagalombili lwenyanga ka-Adare, baphumula ngosuku oluyisishiyagalolunye, bakwenza kube ngusuku lokudla nokuzijabulisa.
AmaJuda ase-Susa ahlangana ngosuku oluyisishiyagalombili, nosuku oluyisishiyagalolunye; ngalokho ngosuku oluyisishiyagalombili baphumula, bakwenza kube usuku lokudla nokujabulisa.
Ngalokho, amalanga ezingu-14 zenyanga ka-Adar ziyisuku lokuphumula nokuzijabulisa kwabaYuda abahlala ezindaweni zasemaphandleni nasezifundeni ezingagcini emgwaqeni; bathumelana izipho zokudla.
UMordekayi wabhala zonke lezi zinto, wathumela izincwadi kiwo wonke amaYuda ezweni lonke likakumkani uXeshazare, abasenyakatho nasebenyakatho.
Wabatjela bona bajabulele amalanga ezingu-14 no-15 zenyanga kaAdar ngonyaka ngamunye.

Lezo zizinsuku lapho amaYuda ethola khona ukuphumula emgodini wabo, begodu lapho ubuhlungu babo buguqukela kujabulise, nobuhlungu babo bushintshe ube ngusuku lokuphumula. Wabatjela bona bagcine lezi zinsuku ngokudla nokunethezeka, bethumelana izipho zokudla, begodu babenika izipho labo abahlwempu.
Bathi ke amaYuda bona baqhubeke nokwenza lokho abaqale ukukwenza, njengombana uMordekayi abebhalela.
ngombana uHaman, unyana ka-Hammedatha, umAgagithi, umnakwabo wamaJuda onke, wayebeke isinqumo sokuthi abulala amaYuda; begodu wabeka iPuri, okungukuthi, inqubekela phambili, ukuba abulawe.
Kwathi lapho ukumkani ekwazi khona, wathumela amaphepha athisa, bona isinqumo sakhe esibi esibekiwe ngabaseYiputa sibuyiselwe emlonyeni kaHaman; ngalokho bamisa uHaman no Amram.

Ngenxa lalokho kwabizwa lezi zinsuku bona iPuri, kusukela kulelo gama elibizwa bona iPuri; ngenxa yazo zonke izinto ezibhalwe encwadini kaMordekayi, begodu ngenxa lalokho abakubonayo, nalokho okube kwenzeka kubo.

begodu iSirayeli bathathe isigqibo ukukwenza ukuba umkhuba kubo, nabangane babo, nanoma ubani oxhumana nabo. Ngonyaka ngayinye, ngaphandle kwephutha, bazozijabulisa lezi zinsuku ezimbili ngesikhathi esifanele, ngendlela ebhalwe ngayo.

bona lezi zinsuku ziphawulwe, zigcinwe ezizukulwaneni zonke, emindenini yonke, emazweni onke, nasezifundeni onke, nasezindaweni onke; bona lezi zinsuku zePhurim azipheleli ukugcinwa ngabaYuda, begodu izingane zabo azikhohlwa.
Wabhala khona u-Esteri, indodana ka-Abihayeli, umkakhe, noMordecai, umYuda, ngesandla esigcwele, ukuze baqinise lesi sitatimende sesithathu sePuri.
Ke kaloku uMordekayi wathumela amaphepha kiwo wonke amaYuda, ezifundazweni eziyishumi nambili nesishiyagalolunye zombuso ka-Asheshazare, ngamazwi okuthula nokholo.

Lezo zincwadi zaqinisa amalanga zePurimu ngezikhathi zawo, njengokuthi uMordekayi umYuda no-Esther indodakazi kankosi, babeke umthetho ngazo, nanjengoko amaYuda abewazibophezele ngokwabo nabangane babo, kanye nesikhathi sabo sokuxosha nokusola.
Isinqumo sika-Esther saqinisa le mithetho yoPuri, begodu sabhalwa encwadini.
UMengameli Xerxes wenza abantu bezwe lonke kanye neziqhingi zaselwandle bakhokhele izimali.

Nazo zonke izinto azenzayo ngekhono lakhe, nangomqondo wakhe onamandla, nazo zonke izindaba zakhe, bona uMordekayi wakhululwa kanjani, lapho ukumkani esemsize khona, zingakabhaliwe ezincwadini zomlando wamabukhosi bamaMediya namaPersia?

UMordekayi, umYuda, wayeyinto elandelayo ngobukhulu emkhosini, ngaphandle kuka-Xerxes ukumkani. Waba mkhulu phakathi kwamaYuda, wathandeka khulu kubo bonke abazalwane bakhe abaJuda, ngombana wayesebenza ngempumelelo yabantu bakhe, begodu wayekhuluma ngokuzola nokuphephile kwalabo bonke abazali babo.
Job: Kwakungumuntu okuthiwa nguJob, owayehlala ezweni lase-Uz. Wabe umuntu omhle, ariyakho inkinga ngaye; waba nobulungisa, wagwema konke okumbi, wayemthanda uzimu.
Ubenezingane eziyisishiyagalombili.
Ube nengulube ezingu-7, nezimvu ezingu-3, nezinkomo ezingu-500, nezimbuzi ezingu-500; begodu wayenabasebenzi abaningi khulu. Waba ngumuntu omkhulu ukudlula bonke abantu baseMpumalanga.
Bahamba bonke oonyana bakhe, behlela ezindaweni ezahlukene, belungiselela isidlo sakusihlwa, wonke umuntu ngemini yakhe; babiza nabazalwane babo abathathu, ukuba babe nabo ekudleni nasekudlaneni.

UJob, lapho amalanga zokudla ziphelile, wathumela wababiza izingane zakhe, wazihlanza phambi kukaThixo. Wavuka ekuseni, wanikela ngenhlanhla yokudlwengula ngengane ngayinye yazo. UJob wathi, Kungenzeka bona izingane zami zithobekile, zibe nenhliziyo ephikisayo kukaNkulunkulu. UJob wenza njalo.
Ngosuku olulodwa kwafika amazulu, ebhekene nozimu; kwafika begodu uShatana, umkhonzi kaSathane.
Wathi ikosi kuSatani, Uvela phi wena? Waphendula uSatani ikosi, wathi, Ngisuka ezindaweni ezahlukahlukene zezulu, ngihamba ngazo.
Wathi ikosi ku-Satani, Ubone yini umkhonzi wami uYobhi? Akukho umuntu ofana naye emhlabeni; indoda elungile, engabi necala ngaye, begodu ilungile, ikhathazekile ngoNkulunkulu, ibhekene nobubi.
Waphendula uSatani ikosi, wathi, Ingabe uYobhi unquma uzimu ngento engafanele?
Wakwenza umgwaqo wokuzivikela kuye, nomndeni wakhe, nezinto zakhe zonke. Ubabalisele konke okwenze; izingulube zakhe nezimbuzi zakhe zisakazeka phezu kwezwe lonke.
Kodwana uphakamise isandla sakho, uthathe zonke izinto zakhe, begodu uzokubulala phambi kwakho.
Wathi ikosi kuSatani, Yabona, yonke into yakhe ingaphansi kwesandla sakho; kodwana ngaye-ke uYobhi, ungawungeni umlomo wakho kiwo. Waphuma ke uSatani phambi koNkulunkulu.
Ngosuku oluthile, izingane zakhe zidla begodu ziphuze isiphuzo endlwini yodadewabo omkhulu.
Kwafika umthunywa kuJob, wathi, Izingulube ziyimisa imbewu, namabhungane adla izithelo eduze kwayo.
Bafika khona abantu baseSabheni, bathabathela, babulala abakhonzi ngeqhwa; ngangihlala ngifile nje, ukuze ngikutshele.
Wayeqhubeka ekhuluma, kwafika omunye, wathi, Umlilo weNkosi ukhuphuka esibhakabhakeni, wabulala izinkomo nabangani; bengingeke ngihambe ngaphandle ngami, ukuze ngikutshele.

Wayeqhubeka ekhuluma, kwafika omunye, wathi, Amadodakazi aseKhaledi ahlukanise amaqembu amathathu, ahlasele izimvu, awathathe, wabulala nabangani ngeqhwa; ngaphuma nje ngingumuntu owodwa, ukuze ngikutshele.
Wayeqhubeka ekhuluma, kwafika omunye, wathi, "Onyana bakho nabantwana bakho bekudla nokudla iwayini endlwini yodadewabo omdala.
Ngabona, kwafika umoya omkhulu osuka emfuleni, washaya izinhlangothi ezine zendlu, yawela phezu kwabancane, bafa. Nginguwo kuphela owasindiwe, ukuze ngikutshele.
UJobu wehla, waxosha isigqoko sakhe, wamisa ikhanda lakhe, wawela phasi ezweni, wathandaza.
Wathi, Ngizalelwa ngingenalutho, begodu uma ngifa ngeke nginalutho; ikosi wanikela ariya ikosi. Likhululwe igama loNkulunkulu.
Kulezi zinto zonke, uJobu akhenge abe nesono, noma agweme uzimu ngenxa yokwenza okumbi.
Kwathi ngosuku olulandelayo, kwafika amazulu ukuba ahlale phambi koYehova; wafika noSatani phakathi kwabo ukuba ahlale phambi koYehova.
Wathi ikosi kuSatani, Uvela phi wena? Waphendula uSatani ikosi, wathi, Ngisuka ezindaweni ezahlukahlukene zezulu, ngihamba ngazo.

Wathi ikosi kuSatani, Ubone yini umkhonzi wami uYobhi? Akukho umuntu ofana naye emhlabeni; indoda elungile, engabi necala ngaye, begodu ilungile, ikhathazekile ngoNkulunkulu, ihlala eduze kokunambitheka okumbi, begodu ithembekile kuze kube manje; naphezu kwalokho, ngikutshele bona unqume ukumbulala ngaphandle kwesizathu.
USathane waphendula ikosi, wathi, Isikhumba ngesikhumba; begodu umuntu uzoshiya yonke into yakhe ukuze agcine impilo yakhe.
Kodwana uphakamise isandla sakho, ugweme amathambo akhe namafutha akhe; begodu uzokubulala phambi kwakho.
Wathi ikosi ku-Satani, Yabona, usesandlani sakho; kodwana ugweme impilo yakhe.
Waphuma uSatani phambi kweNkosi, wabulala uYobhi ngezinto ezifani Gim związwa-ke, kusukela ngaphasi kwezinyawo zakhe kuze kube phezulu kwesifuba sakhe.
UYobhi wathatha isikhunta esibikile, wamisa phakathi kwengcindezi yakhe.
Wathi yena indodana yakhe kuye, Ingabe uqhubeka nokwethembeka kwakho? Uphuze igazi lakho, uphele.
Waphendula uYobhi, wathi, Ukhuluma njengowesifazane ongenangqondo. Ingabe sizothola ariya engcono kukaNkulunkulu, begodu asithole inhlekelele? Kulokhu konke, uJobhi akhenge aphelelwe yilutho.

UJobu wayenezingane amathathu: uEliphaz waseTeman, noBildad waseShuah, noZofar waseNaama. Bathi uma beva bona uJobu unezinkinga eziningi, baphuma emakhaya abo, bahlangana ndawonye, bafike bavuyisa uJobu, begodu bawuthokozele umsebenzi wakhe.
Babona uYobhi emgwaqeni, bengeke bakwazi ukumqonda; baqala ukushaya ngezwi ariya, bamisa izigqoko zabo, bathutha umhlabathi phezu kwezindlebe zabo.
Bahlala ndawonye naye phezu komhlaba amahora asixhenxe, nezinsuku eziyisithupha; kwakungekho muntu okhuluma naye lutho, ngombana bebona bona ubuhlungu bakhe bukhulu.
Ngaleso sikhathi, uJobu wavula umlomo wakhe, wabulala usuku lwakhe lokuzalwa.
UJob uthe:
Usuku lapho ngazalwa khona, luphele, kanye nobusuku obuthi, Kuzofika indodakazi!
Kuze kube yimini emnyama. Kuze uzimu ophezulu akhathazeke ngayo. Kuze akukho kukhanya okukhanya kuyo.
Kuze kube mnyama nesithunzi esinzulu siyithathe emuva. Kuze kube amafu ahlala phezu kwayo. Kuze kube mnyama ungayikhohlisa.
Vumela ubumnyama obuqinile buthathe lo busuku. Vumela bona abubalofani Gim związa ngonyaka. Vutela bona abube yingxenye yonyaka.
Ubusuku obunjalo bube mnyama, begodu akudingeki bona kube khona umsindo wokuthula.
Kuze labo abakhohlisa amalanga bayikhohlise, labo abakulungele ukuvusa ulwandle olukhulu lweLeviathan.
Vumela izinkanyezi zayo zobusuku zihlale zimnyama. Vubirola ukukhanya okungafikanga. Vubirola bona ingabonakali imisebe yokuqala yosuku
Akuvumeli bona ibele lenkosikazi yami livuleke, ukuze ngingazalwa; begodu akufihlanga ukukhathazeka emilenzeni yami.
Ngabe angikaze ngife uma sengizalwa? Ngabe angikaze ngife lapho ngiphuma enyameni yomnene wami?
Ngabe bekukhona umlenze wokungibamba, namabele okungidla?
Uma ngifile, khona-ke ngizohlala ngiphumule. Ngizolala begodu ngiphumule;
nobukhosi kanye nabangane babo, abakhileyo izindlu ezinkulu ezikhona namuhla,
noma nabaphathi abanegolide begodu bagcwele izakhiwo zabo ngesiliva.

Ububi bakho bubuhlungu kuphela kubantu abafana nawe, begodu imisebenzi yakho engcono isiza abanye abantu.
Abantu bakhala uma becindezelwa yinyamakazi. Bacela usizo ngokumelene nekhono lalabo abanamandla amakhulu.
Kodwana akukho umuntu othi, 'Ikuphi uzimu umenzi wami, onikeza izingoma emini,
ofundisa nathi ngaphezu kokufundisa izilwane, begodu esenza sibe nolwazi ngaphezu kwezinyoni zezulu?'
Bakhala, kodwana akaphendulanga, ngenxa yobuqili abantu abamnyama.
uzimu akawutholi umsindo wabo ongenalutho, begodu uMoya oNgcwele akawaboni.
Ngalokho-ke ngeke alalele uma usho bona awukwazi ukumbona, bona ifani Gim związbanani naye begodu ulinde yena.
Begodu manje usho bona yena akhenge agweme inkohliso yakhe begodu akhenge acabange khulu isono.
UJob uvula umlomo wakhe, begodu akusho lutho olufanele; ukhuluma khulu, kodwana akakwazi.
Elihu waqhubeka ekhuluma:
"Beka isandla sakho ngami kancane, begodu ngizokukhombisa bona kukhona okuningi ukukusho ku-Allah.
Ngizoqoqa ulwazi lwami ezindaweni ezide nezibanzi, begodu ngizobonisa bona umenzi wami ulungile.
Uqiniseke bona amazwi ami ayikho engalungile. Omunye nolwazi oluphelele ukhona lapha nawe.
U-Allaah unamandla, kodwana angeke abhekane nomuntu ophansi. U-Allaah unamandla begodu unenhloso eqinile.
Akekho ogcina abantu ababi bephila, kodwana unikeza ubulungisa labo abahluphekayo.
Angeke asuse imehlo akhe kilabo abalungile, kodwana azobabeka ezindaweni eziphakeme namakhosi, begodu uzowaphakamisa kuze kube sekupheleni.
Kodwana uma abantu ziboshwe ezinyaweni, eqashwe emigodini yokugula,
ubonisa kubo bona yini abayenze, nokuthi bangaphi na amaphutha abo ekuphileni kwabo.
Ukwenza bona bacabangele ukulungisa kwakhe, begodu ubuza ukuba bahambe kude nobubi.
Uma bethobela begodu basebenzela yena, bazochitha ingxenye yezinsuku zabo emnothweni kanye neminyaka sabo emnandini.
Kodwana uma bengenakulalela, bazofa ngeqhwa; bazofa ngaphandle kokukwazi.
Abantu ababi bagcina ubuhlungu babo, begodu uma uzimu ebamba izintambo zabo, angeke bazibuze.
Bafa uma sebencane, phakathi kwalabo abantu abakhohlisayo ezindaweni zokugcina.
Kodwana uzimu usindisa labo abahluphekayo ngobuhlungu babo. Ukhuluma nabo ezimpilweni zabo.
Wayefuna ukuletha wena ngaphandle kwezinkinga endaweni evulekile, talantbiro, kuthebula eligcwele ukudla okuhle.
Kodwana manje ugcwele isinqumo esifanele abantu ababi; sinqumo kanye nomthetho ziwuthathele wena.
Khumbula bona impahla yakho akufanele ikhombise inkohliso, begodu inzuzo enkulu akufanele ikhombise ukukhohlisa.
Ingabe izimali zakho, noma amandla akho amakhulu, azosiza wena uma kufika umonakalo?
Akufanele ulinde ekuseni, lapho abantu bethathwa ezindaweni zabo.
Qiniseka bona awushintshi ekubenifilosofi, ngombana lokhu kubukeka sengathi kuyinto ongayikhetha endaweni yokuhlupheka.
Beka, uzimu umkhulu ngomsebenzi wakhe; ngubani ofundisa njengaye?
Ubani owathi kuye bona akwenze yini? Ubani ozothi kuye, Wakwenza okumbi?
Khumbula ukubonga lokho akwenzele, lapho abantu bedlala khona.
Wonke umuntu uyibona. Abantu bayibheka kusuka kude.
uzimu umkhulu khulu, ngaphezu kokuqonda kwethu; akukho muntu ongabala inani laminyaka yakhe.
Ukhipha amaconsi amanzi begodu aguqule abe yimvula esuka emlilweni.
Amafu akhipha umswakama, bese kugwazwa abantu ngemvula eningi.
Ingabe kukhona owaziyo bona ukhipha kanjani amafu, noma imvula ephuma endaweni yakhe yokuhlala?
Bheka bona aphikisa kanjani isibhamu sakhe ngaphesheya kwakhe, begodu agqoke ngezansi komfula.
Ngalokhu ulawula izizwe, begodu ubanikeza ukudla okuningi.
Ugcwalisa izandla zakhe ngomlilo begodu uvumela bona uhlasele isitha.
Umsindo wakhe usho bona uzofika. Nakuba izilwane ziyazi bona imvula iyahamba.
Kulesi simo, intamo yami ishaya begodu iphuma endaweni.
Nquma! Nquma ubuhlungu bezwi lakhe, i-rumbling ephuma emlonyeni wakhe.
Uthumela umlilo wakhe phezu kwezulu lonke, kuze kube iziphezu zezulu.
Phakathi nomlilo kuvela umsindo ophuthumayo. Uthutha ngezwi lakhe elinamandla. Akuvimbeli umlilo lapho umsindo wakhe uzwakala khona.
Umsindo kaThixo uqhuma ngezindlela ezimangazayo. Ukwenza izinto ezinkulu esingaziqondi.
Uthi ikhephu, 'Lahla phezu komhlaba.' Uthi umswakama ukhambe phasi, begodu umswakama omkhulu ukhambe phasi.
Uvimbela bonke abantu ekusebenzeni, ukuze wonke umuntu owenza akwazi ukwazi amandla akhe
Izilwane ziya ezindaweni zabo zokuzivikela begodu zihlala ezindlini zabo.
Isiphepho siphuma egumbini laso, begodu ukushisa kuvela emthonjeni wasenyakatho.
Umoya kaThixo wenza ikhephu, begodu amanzi abanzi ancibilika.
Ufaka emanzini amafu aqinile, begodu usakaze umlilo wakhe ngazo.
Zihamba ngaso soke isikhathi lapho afisa khona, zenza noma yini afuna ngayo phezu kobuso bomhlaba.
Uthumela amafu ukuba agweme abantu, noma ubisi izwe lakhe, noma ukuveza uthando lwakhe oluthembekile.
Lindela lokhu, uJob. Nciphisa bese ucabanga ngemisebenzi emangazayo kaThixo.
Uyazi kanjani bona u-Allaah ulawula amafu begodu enze i-flash ye-umlilo?
Uyazi bona izintaba-mlilo zihamba kanjani emkhathini, imisebenzi emangazayo yomuntu owaziyo konke?
Ugqoka izicathulo zakho uma izwe lihlanzekile ngaphasi kwengcindezi yomoya wasenyakatho.
Ingabe ungamsiza ukuba ahlukanise izulu, elinzima khulu njengengcindezi eyenziwe ngegolide?
Sitshele bona kufanele sisho yini kuye. Ngalokho-ke asikwazi ukuveza isinqumo sethu, ngombana siya emnyama.
Ingabe kufanele acaciswe bona ngifuna ukukhuluma? Ingabe umuntu uzocela ukuba aphuzwe?
Akukho muntu ongakwazi ukubheka ilanga uma likhanya ngokucacile esibhakabhakeni ngemuva kokuthi umoya uhlanze amafu.
Ukukhanya okuluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka kuvela enyakatho. uzimu uvela ngentandokazi emangalisayo.
Singeke sifinyelele kulowo onamandla onke. Umkhulu amandla akhe. Ufanele begodu ulungile ngokuphelele, begodu awugqwala abantu
Lokhu kungenxa yokuthi abantu bahlonipha yena. Akekho obhekana nalabo abacabanga bona sebezimele."
Waphendula ikosi uJobu emgwaqeni, wathi:
Ubani lowo omnyamaza imibono yami ngolimi olungenalwazi?
Silungiselele njengendoda. Ngizokubuza imibuzo, begodu uzongiphendula.
Ubephi lapho ngibeka khona isisekelo sezulu? Bheka, uma ukuqondayo.
Ubani othathe isigqibo sokuthi incane kangakanani? Ngokuqinisekile uyazi! Ubani owamisa umgwaqo wokulinganisa ngaphesheya kwayo?
Ubani owabeka isisekelo sayo? Ubani owabeka isikhala sayo,
ngenkathi izinkanyezi zobusuku zidlala ndawonye begodu zonke izithiyo zavuma ngenjabulo?
Owavala umlambo ngasemva kwamasango, uma uphuma emlonyeni wakhe-
lapho ngakwenza amafu ingubo yayo, begodu wagqoka kuyo emnyama eqinile,
lapho ngibeka khona imikhawulo yayo begodu ngibeke amabha kanye namafasitela endaweni,
begodu wathi, 'Ungase ufike lapha kude, kodwana hhayi eduze. Lapha izintaba zakho ezidume kufanele ziphele?'
Ingabe usuvele empilweni yakho wanikeza umyalo ekuseni, noma wabonisa ubusuku indawo yayo,
ukuze ikwazi ukuthwala izinhlangothi zezwe, begodu icindezele ababi ngaphandle kwayo?
Iplanethi ibukeka njengenhlabathi ngezansi komgwaqo, begodu izakhiwo zayo zibonakala njengamaphiko empahla.
Ukukhanya kuthathwa kubo ababi, begodu isandla sabo esiphakamisayo ukudubula silahlekile.
Ingabe udlule ngezansi emazingeni aphansi elwandle, noma ukhambe emigwaqweni engcupheni khulu ye-ocean?
Ingabe izingcezu zokufa ziboniswa kuwe? Ingabe izingcezu zesibhakabhaka esimnyama uzibona?
Uqonda bona umhlaba ubanzi kangakanani? Ngisho uma uyazi konke lokhu.
Yini indlela eya ekhaya lokukhanya? Naphi lapho umnyama uhlala khona?
Ingabe ungawathatha ezindaweni zabo? Uyazi indlela eya ekhaya labo?
Ngokuqinisekile uyazi, ngombana uzalwa ngaleso sikhathi, begodu waphila iminyaka eminingi!
Ingabe usuye ezindaweni zokugcinwa kweqhwa, noma ubone izindawo zokugcinwa kweqhwa,
ongeke ngiwugcine ngezikhathi zobuhlungu, ngezinsuku zempi nokulwa?
Ingabe ikhona indlela eya endaweni lapho umlilo usakazeka khona, noma lapho umoya wasenyakatho usakazwa khona phezu kwezwe?
Ubani ovula umngcele wezikhukhula, noma indlela yemvula enamandla,
ukuletha umswakama ezweni lapho akukho muntu ohlala khona, emhlabathini lapho akukho muntu kuyo,
ukuwageza umhlaba ongenalutho noshisayo begodu wenze imbewu entsha ikhule? notifications
Ingabe imvula inebaba? Ubani ubaba wezinhlayiya zesihlabathi?
Ngawuphi umgogodla lapho ikhephu livela khona? Ngawuphi umuntu ozalise isiphepho esisuka ezulu
Uma amanzi eqala ukuba anzima njengamatshe, begodu ungqimba lwelwandle olunzulu lubanda?
Ingabe ungaxhuma iqembu lezinkanyezi elibizwa nge-Pleiades, noma uvule umlenze we-Orion?
Ingabe ungaveza amaqembu elanga ezinyangeni zabo, noma uqondise i-Bear nezingane zayo?
Uyazi izimiso zezulu? Ingabe ungazenza zilawula phezu kweplanethi?
Ingabe ungashaya umsindo emathunjini bese uzenza zikugubuzele ngemvula yamanzi?
Ingabe ungathumela amabhuleki omlilo ukuze ahambe? Ingabe bayakutshela, 'Sikhona'?
Ubani owanikela ubuhlakani enhliziyweni? Ubani owanikela ukuqonda emlonyeni?
Ubani onolwazi olunembile lokulinganisa amafu? Ubani ongakwazi ukugibela phezu kwamabhodlela amanzi ezulu
Uma uthuli luguquka lube lunzima begodu izicubu zezulu zixhuma ndawonye?
Ingabe ungadla ukudla kwe-lioness, noma uhlangabezane nokudla kwezinkomo ezincane
lapho behlala khona ezindaweni zabo noma belinde emaqabunga?
Ubani onikela ngokudla ingulube, uma izingane zayo zicela uzimu, begodu zihamba ngezinyawo zingadli?
Uyazi lapho izinkomo zasemgwaqweni zibeletha khona? Ingabe ubheka lapho izingulube zinezingane zabo?
Ingabe ungazibala izinyanga kuze kube yilapho bazalwa khona? Uyazi bona isikhathi sifika nini?
Bakhulisa, bazala izingane zabo, begodu ubuhlungu babo bomsebenzi buphela.
Izingane zazo zikhula zibe namandla ezindaweni ezivulekile. Ziya, azibuyeli.
Ngabe ubani owakhulula isidumbu esimnyama? Ngabe ubani owavula izintambo zayo?
Ngimnike isiqhingi njengekhaya layo, begodu izintaba-mlilo zibe yindawo yokuhlala kwayo.
Ikhala ngengxolo yedolobha. Ayikwazi ukulalela umshayeli ophucayo.
Ihamba emadolobheni ifuna ukudla begodu ifuna noma yini eluhlaza ukuyodla.
Ingabe ingulube emnyama izovuma ukukhonza wena? Ingabe izohlala eduze kokudla kwakho ngobusuku?
Ingabe ungayibopha ngentambo ukulima iimila zakho? Ingabe izothutha imbewu emigwaqweni yakho emuva kwakho?
Ingabe uzoya kuyo ngombana inamandla khulu? Ingabe uzoshiya umsebenzi wakho onzima kuyo?
Ingabe ukholwa wukuthi izokulethela imbewu yakho, begodu izoyiqoqa esitezi sakho sokudla?
I-ostriche ishaya amaphiko ayo ngokunethezeka, kodwana izingulube zayo azifana ne-stork's ezikhathalela izingane zayo.
Ifaka amaqanda ayo phasi begodu ivumela bona afudumeze emhlabathini.
Ikhohlwa bona inyawo lingabacindezela, noma bona inhlanzi ephilayo ingahamba phezu kwabo.
Iphatha izingane zayo ngokujulile, njengokuthi azikho zazo. Ngalokho-ke ayikhathazeki bona umsebenzi wayo ungaba wusizo,
ngombana uzimu akhenge anikeze ubuhlakani noma inzalo yokuqonda okuhle.
Kodwana-ke, uma ifaka amaphiko ayo ukugibela, idlala ngebhayisikili nendodakazi yayo.
Ingabe unikeza isibhakabhaka amandla ayo? Ingabe ugqoka umlenze wayo ngemilenze ehambayo?
Ingabe ungayenza ihambe njengentaka? Ukudlalwa kwayo okudume khulu kubuhlungu.
Ifaka izinyawo zayo emfuleni begodu ijabulela amandla ayo. Iphuma ukubhekana namathuluzi.
Ikhala ngokukhathazeka begodu ayikhathazeki ngalutho. Ngalokho-ke, ayikho into eyenza bona ihambe kude nekhebula.
I-quiver yama-arrows iqhutshwa ngakwesobunxele, kanye ne-flashing spear ne-javelin.
Ihamba ngejubane elikhulu phezu komhlaba. Ngalokho-ke ayikwazi ukuhlala ihlala lapho i-trumpet iphuma khona.
Uma i-trumpet iqhuma, inquma, 'Aha!' Inquma ukulwa kusuka kude. Inquma izingcingo zamakhomanisi kanye nezingxoxo zokulwa.
Ingabe ingqondo yakho yenza bona i-hawk ihambe begodu ivule amaphiko ayo enyakatho?
Ingabe i-eagle ihamba ngemiyalo yakho begodu yenza insimu yayo phezulu?
Ihlala emadolobheni begodu ihlala khona ekuseni, esitezi esiqinile lapho iphephile.
Kusuka lapho ifuna ukudla. Amehlo ayo akubona kusukela kude.
Izingane zayo zidla igazi. lapho kukhona izicubu ezifile, khona-ke i-eagle ikhona."
Wathi ikosi kuJobu,
Ingabe lowo obhekana nozimu Onamandla onke angawulungisa? Nathi lowo ophikisana noThixo aphendule kuye.
Waphendula uJob ikosi wathi,
Ngingakuphendula kanjani? Ngibeka isandla sami emlonyeni wami.
Ngikhuluma kathathu, kodwana angikwazi ukuphendula; ngikhuluma kabili, kodwana ngeke ngiphinde ngikhulume.
Waphendula ikosi uJobu emgwaqeni, wathi:
"Sebenzisa njengendoda. Ngizokubuza imibuzo, begodu uzongiphendula.
Ingabe ucabanga bona isinqumo sami asilungile? Ingabe ungisola ukuze uqinisekise bona unelungelo?
Ingabe unesandla esinamandla njengaso uzimu? Ingabe umsindo wakho unenkani njengento yakhe?
Uma kunjalo, gqoka wena ngokwakho ngenkundla nobuhle, gqoka wena ngokwakho ngenhlanhla nobukhulu.
Lahla inkohliso yakho enamandla. Bona wonke umuntu othandekako begodu ubakhuphe phasi.
Thola wonke umuntu othandekako begodu ubekezele kubo. Khubaza ababi lapho behlala khona.
Zibophe bonke ndawonye emhlabathini. Zibophe emgodini.
Ngalokho ngizokuvuma bona isandla sakho sokudla singakwazi ukusindisa.
Thola i-Behemoth, engiyenzayo njengombana ngikwenza wena. Idla izithelo njengengulube.
Thola amandla ayo emilenzeni yayo, amandla emathunjini ekhanda lakhe.
Umlenze wayo ujikeleza njengesihlahla somnqumo. Ama-muscles emilenze yawo axhunywe ngokuqinile.
Izicubu zayo ziyimibhoshongo yensimbi, izinyawo zayo ziyizintambo zensimbi.
Kuyinto enkulu kunazo zonke iinhlapi uzimu azenzayo. Umlasthisa kuphela ongakwazi ukufinyelela kuyo ngeqhwa.
Izintaba ziyiletha ukudla, lapho zonke izilwane ezifuywayo zidlala khona.
Itholakala ngaphasi kwezitshalo ze-lotus, efihlakele phakathi kwamatshe emhlabathini.
Izihlahla ze-lotus ziyigubungela ngesithunzi sazo, begodu izihlahla ze-wild willows ezibhekene nomfula ziyijikeleza.
Uma umlambo unqoba, awukhathazeki. Uhlala ukhululekile nakuba umlambo i-Jordan uqhuma kuze kube emlonyeni wayo.
Ingabe umuntu angayiqoqa ngenkathi ibheka, noma ayibeke emgodini begodu afake inkinobho emilenzeni yayo?
Ingabe ungakwazi ukudlulisa iLeviathan nge-fishhook, noma ubeke phasi ulimi lwayo ngentambo?
Ingabe ungabeka intambo emlonyeni wayo, noma i-hook enhliziyweni yakhe?
Ingabe izohlala icela usizo kuwe? Ingabe izokhuluma nawe ngothando?
Ingabe izokwenza inkontileka nawe bona ube ngumkhonzi wakho nsuku zonke?
Ingabe ungadlalwa ngayo njengombana udlala nezinyoni? Ingabe ungayibeka emgodini wamantombazane akho?
Ingabe abahwebi bazoxoxa ngayo? Ingabe bazoyihlukanisa phakathi kwabahwebi?
Ingabe ungagcwalisa isikhumba sayo nge-harpoons, noma intamo yayo ngezinhlamvu zokudoba?
Faka isandla sakho ngaso kabili, begodu uzokhumbula ukulwa. Awuzokwazi ukukwenza njalo!
Nanoma iyiphi ithemba lokuyinqoba ayisebenzi. Ukuyibona kuphela kwenza umuntu ahlaselwe ubuhlungu.
Akukho mntu onamandla ngokwanele ukuwuvusa. Ngabe ngubani ozohlala engibhekana naye?
Ubani owanginikela nganoma yini, ukuze ngiyibuyisele? Zonke izinto ezingaphansi kwesibhakabhaka zimi.
Angeke ngihlale ngingasho lutho ngemilenze yayo, nekhono layo elikhulu, nobuso bayo obuhle.
Ngabe kukhona ongakwazi ukuyisusa isikhumba sayo esingaphandle? Ngabe kukho umuntu ongafinyelela emilenzeni yayo evulekile?
Ubani ozowuvula umlomo wayo? Izicubu zayo zonke zinde khulu.
Umlenze wayo unezinhlamvu zesibhakabhaka, eziboshwe ndawonye.
Yonke enye incane khulu kuleyo elandelayo bona akukho umoya ongadlula phakathi kwazo.
Zixhunywe ngazo zonke. Zihlala ndawonye begodu azikwazi ukususwa ngabanye.
Uma ikhala, ukukhanya kuvela. Amehlo ayo afana nokukhanya kokuqala kwemini.
Ama-torches omlilo aphuma emlonyeni wayo. Izingcindezi zomlilo ziphuma.
Umhluzi uphuma emlonyeni wayo, njengengcindezi evela emgodini obandayo phezu kwezinkuni ezishisayo.
Umphefumulo wayo umisa amakhoyi emlilweni. Amafu aphuma emilenzeni yayo.
Intamo yayo inamandla khulu. Ubuhlungu buhamba phambili.
Imilenze yenyama yayo ixhunywe ngokuqinile ndawonye. Ziqinile begodu azikwazi ukuhanjiswa
Intliziyo yayo inzima njengentaba, inzima njengengcindezi ephansi.
Uma ivuka, labo abanamandla bakhathazeka; Basuka emgwaqweni wayo.
Ikhebula elihlukumeza alingenakulimaza. Ngalokho-ke, inkosikazi, i-dart, noma umcibisholo ayisebenzi.
Iphatha insimbi njengetshe kanye negolide njengesihlahla esithosiwe.
Ama-arrows angeke ayenze ihambe kude. Izintaba ezisuka ku-sling zifana nezingcezu zesihlabathi.
Icabanga bona ama-clubs afana ne-straw. Ilalela umsindo we-spear ohamba kuyo.
Isifuba sayo sifakwe izinhlamvu eziqinile njengezi talantbiro ezibomvu. Ishiya umkhondo emhlabathini njengama-slides okudla.
Ukwenza amanzi abandayo ahlanzekile njengamabhodlela, begodu ucindezela umlambo njengebhodlela le-oyile.
Ishiya umkhondo okhanyayo ngasemva kwayo. Ungacabanga bona lwandle olunzulu lunezinwele ezimhlophe.
Akukho lutho ezweni elifana nalo. Yakhiwa bona ingabi nenkinga.
Ibheka phasi yonke into ehlonishwayo, iyinkosi phezu kwazo zonke izilwane ezihlonishwayo."
Waphendula uJob ikosi wathi,
"Ngiyazi bona ungakwenza noma yini. Akukho sinqumo sakho esingamiswa.
Wathi, 'Ubani lowo ofihla imibono yami ngolimi olungenalwazi?' Ngikhuluma ngezinto ariyaziyo, izinto ezithakazelisayo khulu bona ngikwazi.
Wathi, Ngisho namuhla, ngikhuluma; Ngizokubuza, begodu uphendule.
Ngaleso sikhathi ngangikubona nje, kodwana manje ngikubone ngamehlo ami.
Ngalokho ngithandana nomuntu ngenxa lalokho engikushoyo, begodu ngibuyela umva isono sami, uhlala emhlabathini namanzi.

Kwathi, ngemuva kokuba ikosi ekhuluma amazwi lawa kuYobhi, ikosi wathi kuElifazi waseTemani: Inkanuko yami igcwele kuwe, nabangani bakho ababini; ngombana ningasho iqiniso ngami, njengokuthi umkhonzi wami uJob.

Manje ke, nithathe izinkomo eziyisishiyagalombili nezimvu eziyisishiyagalombili, niye kumkhonzi wami uYobhi, ninikeze isiphuzo somlilo ngezenu; begodu umkhonzi wami uJobhi uzothandaza ngenxa yenu, begodu ngizowuphendula lo mthandazo wakhe, ukuze ngikususe enhliziyweni yenu. Ngalokho-ke, ningakhuluma ngami ngokweqiniso, njengokuthi umkhonzi wami uYobhi.
Wahamba ke uEliphazi umTemani, noBiledadi umShuhi, noZofari umNaamathi, bakwenza njengokuthi ikosi wabatjela; begodu ikosi waphendula uJobu.
uzimu uphinde walungisa umsebenzi ka-Ayobu, lapho ethandaza khona ngenxa yabangane bakhe; begodu ikosi wamnika u-Ayobu izinto eziphindwe kabili.

Bafika bonke abazalwane bakhe, namadodakazi akhe, nalabo ababemthanda ngaphambilini, badla naye ukudla endlwini yakhe; bamphikisisa, bewusola ngenxa yobuhlungu bonke ikosi abewulahla phezu kwakhe. Banikela kuye wonke umuntu inkomishi yesilivere, nezinkomo zegolide.
begodu waqhubeka ehamba, asuka ngemva kwe kulesi simo sezulu. Isikhathi sokuphila kwaJoba saqala ngasekupheleni konyaka.
Ube nezingane eziyisishiyagalombili.
Wabiza indodakazi yakhe yokuqala ngegama likaJemimah, eyesibili ngegama likaKeziah, neyesibili ngegama likaKeren-Happuch.
Akukho besifazane ababukekayo njengamantombazane kaYobhi, ezweni lonke; begodu ubaba wabo wabanika inkontileka phakathi kwabazalwane babo.
Waphila uYobhi ngemuva kwalokho iminyaka engu-140, wabona izingane zakhe nezingane zabantwana bakhe, imindeni emine yomndeni wakhe.
Wafa uJob, esemdala, ephila ubomi obude nobugcwele.
